name: ae_circle_pullback
stmt: {p : ℂ → Prop} (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), p x) : ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, p (q+direction t)
body:
:= by
  have hq : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun z : ℂ × Angles => z.1+direction z.2)
      (volume.prod angularMeasure) volume :=
    QuasiMeasurePreserving.prod_of_left
      (measurable_fst.add (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
      (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (measurePreserving_add_right volume (direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving)
  exact Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (hq.ae hp)
def circleAverage (f : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ) : ℂ := ∫ t, f (q+direction t) ∂angularMeasure

name: circleOperator_toLp_ae
stmt: {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) : circleOperator (hf.toLp f) =ᵐ[volume] circleAverage f
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [circleOperator_ae (hf.toLp f),ae_circle_pullback (MemLp.coeFn_toLp hf)] with q hq he
  exact hq.trans (integral_congr_ae he)

name: circleOperator_difference_ae
stmt: {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (h : ℂ) : circleOperator (hf.toLp f-planeTranslate h (hf.toLp f)) =ᵐ[volume] circleAverage (fun q => f q-f (q+h))
body:
:= by
  have hfh : MemLp (fun q => f (q+h)) 2 volume :=
    hf.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_add_right volume h)
  have he : (hf.sub hfh).toLp (fun q => f q-f (q+h)) = hf.toLp f-planeTranslate h (hf.toLp f) := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp (hf.sub hfh),Lp.coeFn_sub (hf.toLp f) (planeTranslate h (hf.toLp f)),
      MemLp.coeFn_toLp hf,planeTranslate_ae h (hf.toLp f),
      (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (MemLp.coeFn_toLp hf)] with q h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    change ((hf.sub hfh).toLp (fun q => f q-f (q+h))) q = _ at h1
    simp only [h1,h2,Pi.sub_apply,h3,h4,h5]
  rw [← he]
  exact circleOperator_toLp_ae (hf.sub hfh)
def colorMass {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t, sampleFn c q 1 i t ∂angularMeasure

name: colorMass_measurable
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) : Measurable (colorMass c i)
body:
:= by
  have hm : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℂ × Angles => sampleFn c p.1 1 i p.2) := by
    simp only [sampleFn,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul]
    exact (measurable_one.piecewise (measurableSet_eq_fun
      (hc.comp (measurable_fst.add (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd))) measurable_const)
      measurable_zero).stronglyMeasurable
  exact hm.integral_prod_right'.measurable

name: colorMass_nonneg
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : 0≤colorMass c i q
body:
:=
  integral_nonneg (sampleFn_nonneg c q 1 i)

name: colorMass_le_one
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : colorMass c i q≤1
body:
:= by
  exact (integral_mono ((sampleFn_memLp c hc q 1 i).integrable (by norm_num)) (integrable_const 1)
    (sampleFn_le_one c q 1 i)).trans_eq (by simp)
def colorCutoff {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  (Metric.closedBall x (R+2)).indicator (fun q => if c q=i then 1 else 0)

name: colorCutoff_memLp
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) : MemLp (colorCutoff c i x R) 2 volume
body:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x (R+2))) :=
    ⟨by simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using (isCompact_closedBall x (R+2)).measure_lt_top (μ := volume)⟩
  have hm : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun q : ℂ => if c q=i then (1:ℂ) else 0) 2
      (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x (R+2))) := by
    apply MemLp.of_bound ((measurable_one.piecewise (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)
      measurable_zero).aestronglyMeasurable) 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by simp only [Set.piecewise]; split_ifs <;> simp
  exact (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict measurableSet_closedBall).mpr hm

name: colorCutoff_sample
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (x q h : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ Metric.ball x R) (hh : ‖h‖<1) (t : Angles) : colorCutoff c i x R (q+direction t+h) = if c (q+direction t+h)=i then 1 else 0
body:
:= by
  apply Set.indicator_of_mem
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm]
  have hn := norm_add_le (q-x) (direction t+h)
  have hn' := norm_add_le (direction t) h
  have hd : ‖direction t‖=1 := Circle.norm_coe _
  have hqr : ‖q-x‖<R := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hq
  rw [show q+direction t+h-x=(q-x)+(direction t+h) by ring]
  linarith

name: colorCutoff_circleDifference
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) (x q h : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ Metric.ball x R) (hh : ‖h‖<1) : circleAverage (fun y => colorCutoff c i x R y-colorCutoff c i x R (y+h)) q = ((colorMass c i q-colorMass c i (q+h) : ℝ) : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  have he (t : Angles) : colorCutoff c i x R (q+direction t)-colorCutoff c i x R (q+direction t+h) =
      ((sampleFn c q 1 i t-sampleFn c (q+h) 1 i t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have h0 := colorCutoff_sample c i x q 0 R hq (by simp) t
    simp only [add_zero] at h0
    rw [h0,colorCutoff_sample c i x q h R hq hh t]
    simp only [sampleFn,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,show q+direction t+h=q+h+direction t by ring,
      Complex.ofReal_sub]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  unfold circleAverage
  simp_rw [he,integral_complex_ofReal]
  rw [integral_sub ((sampleFn_memLp c hc q 1 i).integrable (by norm_num))
    ((sampleFn_memLp c hc (q+h) 1 i).integrable (by norm_num))]
  rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: continuous_eval
stmt: (a : E) : Continuous (eval a)
body:
:=
  (continuous_apply (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).comp
    ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosedEmbedding_coe.continuous

name: measurable_eval
stmt: (a : E) : Measurable (eval a)
body: := (continuous_eval a).measurable

name: measurable_eval_coe
stmt: (a : E) : Measurable (fun d => (eval a d : ℂ))
body:
:=
  ((show Continuous (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) from continuous_subtype_val).comp
    (continuous_eval a)).measurable

name: eval_zero
stmt: (d : D) : eval 0 d = 1
body: := map_one d

name: eval_add
stmt: (a b : E) (d : D) : eval (a+b) d = eval a d * eval b d
body:
:=
  map_mul d (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) (Multiplicative.ofAdd b)

name: eval_neg
stmt: (a : E) (d : D) : eval (-a) d = (eval a d)⁻¹
body:
:=
  d.map_inv (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)

name: eval_sub
stmt: (a b : E) (d : D) : eval (a-b) d = eval a d / eval b d
body:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, eval_add, eval_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: eval_nat_mul
stmt: (n : ℕ) (a : E) (d : D) : eval (n*a) d = eval a d ^ n
body:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_mul, one_mul,
      eval_add, ih, pow_succ]

name: eval_scalar
stmt: (a b : E) (d : D) : eval a (scalar b d) = eval (b*a) d
body: := rfl

name: eval_smul_one
stmt: (u : K) (d : D) : eval 1 (u • d) = eval (kCoeff u) d
body:

  rw [mul_one]

name: lineFourier_eq
stmt: (ν : Measure D) (a : E) (t : F) : lineFourier ν a t = ∫ d, (eval (a * ofF t) d : ℂ) ∂ν
body:
:= rfl

variable {X W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [MeasurableSpace W]

name: predecessor_moment_sq
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p : X → W) (b : X → D) (hp : Measurable p) (hb : Measurable b) (a : E) : (∫ w, ‖∫ x, (eval a (b x) : ℂ) ∂condDistrib id p μ w‖^2 ∂μ.map p) = (∫ d, (eval a d : ℂ) ∂DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ)).re
body:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map p) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hp.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  rw [DifferenceFourier.difference_coefficient (eval a) (measurable_eval_coe a),
    Complex.ofReal_re]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ConditionalFiber.map_identity_fiber μ p hp.aemeasurable b hb] with w hw
  congr 1
  rw [← hw, integral_map hb.aemeasurable (measurable_eval_coe a).aestronglyMeasurable]

name: integrable_predecessor_moment_sq
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p : X → W) (b : X → D) (hp : Measurable p) (hb : Measurable b) (a : E) : Integrable (fun w => ‖∫ x, (eval a (b x) : ℂ) ∂condDistrib id p μ w‖^2) (μ.map p)
body:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map p) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hp.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hm := ((measurable_eval_coe a).comp hb).stronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel
    (κ := condDistrib id p μ)
  apply Integrable.of_bound (hm.norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro w
  have hh : ‖∫ x, (eval a (b x) : ℂ) ∂condDistrib id p μ w‖ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := condDistrib id p μ w)
      (C := (1 : ℝ)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (Circle.norm_coe _).le))
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.pow_apply, Function.comp_apply, abs_sq, one_pow] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hh 2

end

name: real_algebraic_sum_two_rotations
stmt: (x : F) (hx : |(x : ℝ)| < 2) : ∃ u v : K, ofF x = kCoeff u + kCoeff v
body:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := (x : ℝ)/2
  have hr : |r| < 1 := by dsimp [r]; rw [abs_div]; norm_num; linarith
  have hnon : 0 ≤ 1-r^2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs r, abs_nonneg r]
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1-r^2)
  have hs : s^2 = 1-r^2 := Real.sq_sqrt hnon
  have hrAlg : IsAlgebraic ℚ r := by
    change IsAlgebraic ℚ ((x / 2 : F) : ℝ)
    exact mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp (x / 2 : F).property
  have hsAlg : IsAlgebraic ℚ s := IsAlgebraic.of_pow (by norm_num : 0 < 2) (by
    rw [hs]; exact isAlgebraic_one.sub (hrAlg.pow 2))
  have huAlg : IsAlgebraic ℚ ((r : ℂ) + Complex.I * s) :=
    (hrAlg.algebraMap (A := ℂ)).add
      ((isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mpr (Complex.isIntegral_I ℚ)).mul (hsAlg.algebraMap (A := ℂ)))
  have hvAlg : IsAlgebraic ℚ ((r : ℂ) - Complex.I * s) :=
    (hrAlg.algebraMap (A := ℂ)).sub
      ((isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mpr (Complex.isIntegral_I ℚ)).mul (hsAlg.algebraMap (A := ℂ)))
  have huNorm : ‖(r : ℂ)+Complex.I*s‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one]
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    nlinarith
  have hvNorm : ‖(r : ℂ)-Complex.I*s‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one]
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    nlinarith
  let u : K := ⟨⟨(r : ℂ)+Complex.I*s, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr huNorm⟩, huAlg⟩
  let v : K := ⟨⟨(r : ℂ)-Complex.I*s, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hvNorm⟩, hvAlg⟩
  refine ⟨u, v, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((r : ℂ)+Complex.I*s)+((r : ℂ)-Complex.I*s)
  simp only [r, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
  ring

name: kernelEncoding_covariance
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) (β : Kernel Y G) (R : Y → Y) (T : G → G) (hT : Measurable T) (χ : G → ℂ) (hχ : Measurable χ) (m : ℕ) (hβ : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, β (R y) = (β y).map T) : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, kernelEncoding β χ m (R y) = kernelEncoding β (χ ∘ T) m y
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hβ] with y hy
  have he (n : ℕ) : (∫ d, χ d ^ n ∂β (R y)) = ∫ d, χ (T d)^n ∂β y := by
    rw [hy, integral_map hT.aemeasurable (hχ.pow_const n).aestronglyMeasurable]

abbrev MomentTest (M N : ℕ) := Fin N × {p : Fin M × Fin M // p.1 ≠ p.2}

def momentArgument {M N : ℕ} (z : MomentTest M N) : E :=
  (z.1.val + 1) * ((z.2.val.1.val : E) - z.2.val.2.val)

name: momentArgument_ne_zero
stmt: {M N : ℕ} (z : MomentTest M N) : momentArgument z ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  unfold momentArgument
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero z.1.val
  · apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
    intro h
    have hh : z.2.val.1.val = z.2.val.2.val := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact z.2.property (Fin.ext hh)

name: momentTest_nonempty
stmt: {M N : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hN : 0 < N) : Nonempty (MomentTest M N)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨⟨0, hN⟩, ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, ⟨1, by omega⟩), ?_⟩⟩⟩
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
  norm_num at hh

name: exists_simultaneous_moment_parameter
stmt: (ν : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsWild ν) (hn : ∀ a : E, 0 ≤ (∫ d, (eval a d : ℂ) ∂ν).re) (M N : ℕ) (hM : 2 ≤ M) (hN : 0 < N) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) : ∃ t : F, t ≠ 0 ∧ |(t : ℝ)| < 1/(M : ℝ) ∧ ∀ z : MomentTest M N, (∫ d, (eval (momentArgument z * ofF t) d : ℂ) ∂ν).re < ε
body:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (MomentTest M N) := momentTest_nonempty hM hN
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < M)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htr, hh⟩ := exists_small_wild_parameter
    (Finset.univ : Finset (MomentTest M N)) Finset.univ_nonempty ν hν
    momentArgument momentArgument_ne_zero
    (fun z t => by simpa only [lineFourier_eq] using hn (momentArgument z * ofF t))
    (one_div_pos.mpr hMr) hε hε1
  exact ⟨t, ht, htr, fun z => hh z (Finset.mem_univ z)⟩

name: eval_dist
stmt: (a b : E) (d : D) : dist (eval a d : ℂ) (eval b d : ℂ) = ‖(eval (a-b) d : ℂ)-1‖
body:
:= by
  rw [eval_sub, Circle.coe_div, dist_eq_norm]
  have he : (eval a d : ℂ) / (eval b d : ℂ) - 1 =
      ((eval a d : ℂ) - (eval b d : ℂ)) / (eval b d : ℂ) := by
    field_simp
  rw [he, norm_div, Circle.norm_coe, div_one]

name: pair_collision_upper
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (b : X → D) (hb : Measurable b) (a₁ a₂ : E) (m N : ℕ) (ρ c : ℝ) (harc : ∀ (ω : Measure Circle) [IsProbabilityMeasure ω], (∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ N → ‖∫ w, (w : ℂ)^n ∂ω‖ < c) → ω.real {w | ‖(w : ℂ)-1‖ ≤ 4*ρ} < 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2)) (hMom : ∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ N → ‖∫ x, (eval ((n : E)*(a₁-a₂)) (b x) : ℂ) ∂μ‖ < c) : μ.real {x | dist (eval a₁ (b x) : ℂ) (eval a₂ (b x) : ℂ) ≤ 4*ρ} < 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2)
body:
:= by
  let φ : X → Circle := fun x => eval (a₁-a₂) (b x)
  have hφ : Measurable φ := (measurable_eval _).comp hb
  let ω := μ.map φ
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ω :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hφ.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hco : Measurable (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) :=
    (show Continuous (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) from continuous_subtype_val).measurable
  have hmom : ∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ N → ‖∫ z, (z : ℂ)^n ∂ω‖ < c := by
    intro n hn hnN
    rw [show ω = μ.map φ from rfl,
      integral_map hφ.aemeasurable (hco.pow_const n).aestronglyMeasurable]
    simpa only [φ, eval_nat_mul, Circle.coe_pow] using hMom n hn hnN
  have hu := harc ω hmom
  have hs : MeasurableSet {z : Circle | ‖(z : ℂ)-1‖ ≤ 4*ρ} :=
    measurableSet_le ((hco.sub_const 1).norm) measurable_const
  rw [Measure.real, show ω = μ.map φ from rfl, Measure.map_apply hφ hs] at hu
  simpa only [Measure.real, Set.preimage_ofPred_eq, φ, eval_dist] using hu

end

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped BigOperators
local instance : MeasurableSpace Circle := borel Circle
local instance : BorelSpace Circle := ⟨rfl⟩

variable {X Y W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [MeasurableSpace W] [StandardBorelSpace W] [Nonempty W]

def FiniteEncodingApproximationAt (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p : X → Y) (q : Y → W)
    (b : X → D) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (H : Fin r → Y → Fin m → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖H i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ coeff : W → Fin r → ℂ,
      (∀ w, ‖coeff w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => dist
        (PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ)
          (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m (p x))
        (∑ i, coeff (q (p x)) i • H i (p x)) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ x, dist
        (PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ)
          (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m (p x))
        (∑ i, coeff (q (p x)) i • H i (p x)) ^ 2 ∂μ) < γ^2

def FiniteEncodingApproximation (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (p : X → Y) (q : Y → W) (b : X → D) (m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → FiniteEncodingApproximationAt μ p q b m γ

name: two_array_norm_bound
stmt: {r : ℕ} {a b : Fin r → ℂ} {B : ℝ} (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ B) (hb : ‖b‖ ≤ B) (hB : 0 ≤ B) : ‖![a,b]‖ ≤ B
body:
:= by
  rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hB]
  intro j
  fin_cases j <;> assumption

name: simultaneous_test_budget
stmt: {T : Type*} [Fintype T] (v : T → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hv : ∀ t, v t < min 1 (c^2 / (4*(Fintype.card T+1)))) : (∑ t, v t)/(c^2) < 1/4
body:
:= by
  have hs : (∑ t, v t) ≤ (Fintype.card T : ℝ) *
      (c^2 / (4*(Fintype.card T+1))) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _t : T, c^2 / (4*(Fintype.card T+1)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => (hv t).le.trans (min_le_right _ _)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card T+1 := by positivity
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hc)]
  apply hs.trans_lt
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4*(Fintype.card T+1))]
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hc]

omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: finite_uniform_precision_contradiction
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p : X → Y) (q : Y → W) (b : X → D) (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q) (hb : Measurable b) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (g : Y → Fin m → D) (hg : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, condDistrib b p μ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g y i)) (hwild : IsWild (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map (q ∘ p)) (condDistrib b (q ∘ p) μ))) (ρ c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hc : 0 < c) (hN : 0 < N) (harc : ∀ (ω : Measure Circle) [IsProbabilityMeasure ω], (∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ N → ‖∫ w, (w : ℂ)^n ∂ω‖ < c) → ω.real {w | ‖(w : ℂ)-1‖ ≤ 4*ρ} < 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2)) (happrox : FiniteEncodingApproximationAt μ p q b m (((ρ^m/(m : ℝ))/100)/100)) : False
body:
:= by
  classical
  let P : X → W := q ∘ p
  have hP : Measurable P := hq.comp hp
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map P) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hP.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  let ν := DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map P) (condDistrib b P μ)
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := inferInstance
  have hn (a : E) : 0 ≤ (∫ d, (eval a d : ℂ) ∂ν).re := by
    rw [← predecessor_moment_sq μ P b hP hb a]
    exact integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
  let τ := (ρ^m/(m : ℝ))/100
  let γ := τ/100
  have hmr : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hτ : 0 < τ := by dsimp [τ]; positivity
  have hτδ : 18*τ^2 < (ρ^m/(m : ℝ))^2/20 := by
    dsimp [τ]
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos (div_pos (pow_pos hρ m) hmr)]
  obtain ⟨r, B, C, H, hB, hC, hH, happ⟩ := happrox
  choose coeff hcoeff hInt hErr using happ
  obtain ⟨L, bins, hbins⟩ := FiniteBins.bounded_coefficient_bins
    (V := Fin m → ℂ) r B C τ hC hτ
  let M := 20*(L+1)*m^2
  have hM : 2 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; nlinarith [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm.ne']
  let : NeZero M := ⟨by omega⟩
  let T := MomentTest M N
  let ε := min 1 (c^2/(4*(Fintype.card T+1)))
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; apply lt_min (by norm_num); positivity
  have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htM, hTest⟩ := exists_simultaneous_moment_parameter ν hwild hn M N hM hN ε hε hε1
  let xs : Fin M → F := fun j => (j.val+1)*t
  have hxs (j : Fin M) : |(xs j : ℝ)| < 2 := by
    have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < M := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hj : (j.val+1 : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast j.isLt
    have hx : |(xs j : ℝ)| = (j.val+1 : ℝ)*|(t : ℝ)| := by
      simp [xs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ j.val+1 by positivity)]
    rw [hx]
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left htM (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < j.val+1)
    have hbound : (j.val+1 : ℝ) * (1/(M : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one hMr]
      exact hj
    linarith
  choose u v huv using fun j => real_algebraic_sum_two_rotations (xs j) (hxs j)
  let β := condDistrib b p μ
  let enc : K → Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun k =>
    PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding β (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m
  let Hp : Fin M → X → Fin m → ℂ := fun j x => enc (u j) (p x)
  let Hm : Fin M → X → Fin m → ℂ := fun j x => enc (v j) (p x)
  let Ap : Fin M → X → Fin m → ℂ := fun j x => ∑ i, coeff (u j) (P x) i • H i (p x)
  let Am : Fin M → X → Fin m → ℂ := fun j x => ∑ i, coeff (v j) (P x) i • H i (p x)
  let ap : Fin M → X → Circle := fun j x => eval (kCoeff (u j)) (b x)
  let am : Fin M → X → Circle := fun j x => eval (kCoeff (v j)) (b x)
  let zp : X → Fin M → Fin m → Circle := fun x j i => eval (kCoeff (u j)) (g (p x) i)
  let zm : X → Fin M → Fin m → Circle := fun x j i => eval (kCoeff (v j)) (g (p x) i)
  have henc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, PhaseEncoding.encoding (zp x j) = Hp j x ∧
      PhaseEncoding.encoding (zm x j) = Hm j x := by
    filter_upwards [ae_of_ae_map hp.aemeasurable hg] with x hx
    intro j
    exact ⟨(PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding_eq_encoding β (eval (kCoeff (u j))) m hm (p x) (g (p x)) hx).symm,
      (PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding_eq_encoding β (eval (kCoeff (v j))) m hm (p x) (g (p x)) hx).symm⟩
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, (∃ i, ap j x = zp x j i) ∧ (∃ i, am j x = zm x j i) := by
    filter_upwards [SampledAtoms.ae_sampled_list μ p b hp hb hm g hg] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    intro j
    exact ⟨⟨i, congrArg (eval (kCoeff (u j))) hi⟩, ⟨i, congrArg (eval (kCoeff (v j))) hi⟩⟩
  let f : T → W → ℝ := fun z w =>
    ‖∫ x, (eval (momentArgument z * ofF t) (b x) : ℂ) ∂condDistrib id P μ w‖^2
  have hf (z : T) : Integrable (f z) (μ.map P) :=
    integrable_predecessor_moment_sq μ P b hP hb _
  have hfTest (z : T) : (∫ w, f z w ∂μ.map P) < ε := by
    rw [show (∫ w, f z w ∂μ.map P) =
      (∫ d, (eval (momentArgument z * ofF t) d : ℂ) ∂ν).re from
        predecessor_moment_sq μ P b hP hb _]
    exact hTest z
  have hfBudget : (∑ z, ∫ w, f z w ∂μ.map P)/(c^2) < 1/4 :=
    simultaneous_test_budget _ c hc hfTest
  have heBudget : 10*(∑ j, ((∫ x, dist (Hp j x) (Ap j x)^2 ∂μ) +
      (∫ x, dist (Hm j x) (Am j x)^2 ∂μ)))/((M : ℝ)*τ^2) < 1/4 := by
    have hs : (∑ j, ((∫ x, dist (Hp j x) (Ap j x)^2 ∂μ) +
        (∫ x, dist (Hm j x) (Am j x)^2 ∂μ))) < (M : ℝ)*(2*γ^2) := by
      calc
        _ < ∑ _j : Fin M, 2*γ^2 := Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun j _ => by
            have h1 : (∫ x, dist (Hp j x) (Ap j x)^2 ∂μ) < γ^2 := hErr (u j)
            have h2 : (∫ x, dist (Hm j x) (Am j x)^2 ∂μ) < γ^2 := hErr (v j)
            linarith)
        _ = _ := by simp
    have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < M := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hMr (sq_pos_of_pos hτ))]
    dsimp [γ] at hs
    nlinarith
  let arr : W → Fin M → {a : Fin 2 → Fin r → ℂ // ‖a‖ ≤ B} := fun w j =>
    ⟨![coeff (u j) w, coeff (v j) w], two_array_norm_bound (hcoeff _ _) (hcoeff _ _) hB⟩
  let bin : W → Fin M → Fin L := fun w j => bins (arr w j)
  have hlarge : (L : ℝ)*(10*m^2 : ℕ) < (9/10 : ℝ)*Fintype.card (Fin M) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    dsimp [M]
    push_cast
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hmr, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) L]
  have hbin : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.map P, ∀ i j, bin w i = bin w j →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂condDistrib id P μ w, dist (Ap i x) (Ap j x) ≤ τ ∧
        dist (Am i x) (Am j x) ≤ τ := by
    filter_upwards [ConditionalFiber.ae_in_own_fiber μ P hP] with w hw
    intro i j hij
    filter_upwards [hw] with x hx
    have hh := hbins (arr w i) (arr w j) hij (fun k => H k (p x)) (hH (p x))
    have h0 := (hh 0).le
    have h1 := (hh 1).le
    change dist (∑ k, coeff (u i) (P x) k • H k (p x))
      (∑ k, coeff (u j) (P x) k • H k (p x)) ≤ τ ∧
      dist (∑ k, coeff (v i) (P x) k • H k (p x))
      (∑ k, coeff (v j) (P x) k • H k (p x)) ≤ τ
    rw [hx]
    exact ⟨h0, h1⟩
  have hupper : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.map P, (∀ z, f z w < c^2) → ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      (condDistrib id P μ w).real {x |
        dist ((ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)) ((ap j x : ℂ)*(am j x : ℂ)) ≤ 4*ρ}
        < 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro w hw i j hij
    have hMom : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → n ≤ N →
        ‖∫ x, (eval ((n : E)*(ofF (xs i)-ofF (xs j))) (b x) : ℂ)
          ∂condDistrib id P μ w‖ < c := by
      intro n hn hnN
      let z : T := (⟨n-1, by omega⟩, ⟨(i,j), hij⟩)
      have he : (n : E)*(ofF (xs i)-ofF (xs j)) = momentArgument z * ofF t := by
        have hnv : (n-1)+1 = n := by omega
        have hnv' : ((n-1 : ℕ) : E)+1=(n : E) := by exact_mod_cast hnv
        simp only [momentArgument, z, hnv']
        dsimp [xs]
        simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_natCast, map_one]
        ring
      have hh := hw z
      change ‖∫ x, (eval (momentArgument z * ofF t) (b x) : ℂ)
         ∂condDistrib id P μ w‖^2 < c^2 at hh
      rw [he]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (∫ x, (eval (momentArgument z * ofF t) (b x) : ℂ)
         ∂condDistrib id P μ w)]
    have hh := pair_collision_upper (condDistrib id P μ w) b hb
      (ofF (xs i)) (ofF (xs j)) m N ρ c harc hMom
    have he (j : Fin M) (x : X) : (ap j x : ℂ)*(am j x : ℂ) =
        (eval (ofF (xs j)) (b x) : ℂ) := by
      change (eval (kCoeff (u j)) (b x) : ℂ) * (eval (kCoeff (v j)) (b x) : ℂ) = _
      rw [huv j]
      exact congrArg (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) (eval_add _ _ _).symm
    simpa only [he] using hh
  apply FiniteModule.common_fiber_contradiction μ P hP m hm ρ τ (c^2) hρ hτ
    (sq_pos_of_pos hc) hτδ Hp Hm Ap Am
    (fun j => (PhaseEncoding.measurable_kernelEncoding β _ (measurable_eval_coe _) m).comp hp)
    (fun j => (PhaseEncoding.measurable_kernelEncoding β _ (measurable_eval_coe _) m).comp hp)
    (fun j => hInt (u j)) (fun j => hInt (v j)) zp zm ap am
    (fun j => (measurable_eval _).comp hb) (fun j => (measurable_eval _).comp hb)
    henc hmem f hf (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun w z => sq_nonneg _))
    (by simp only [Fintype.card_fin]; linarith) L bin hlarge hbin hupper

omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: finite_uniform_successor_contradiction
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p : X → Y) (q : Y → W) (b : X → D) (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q) (hb : Measurable b) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (g : Y → Fin m → D) (hg : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, condDistrib b p μ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g y i)) (hwild : IsWild (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map (q ∘ p)) (condDistrib b (q ∘ p) μ))) (happrox : FiniteEncodingApproximation μ p q b m) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, c, N, hρ, hc, hN, harc⟩ := SmallArc.exists_small_arc_constants m hm
  exact finite_uniform_precision_contradiction μ p q b hp hq hb m hm g hg hwild
    ρ c N hρ hc hN harc (happrox _ (by positivity))

name: approx_norm_le
stmt: (i : Finset G × ℕ) (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : ‖approxAt b i f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
body:
:=
  ((cube i.1.toList i.2 f).norm_coe_le_norm (b i)).trans (cube_norm_le _ _ _)

name: approx_has_limit
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : ∃ r : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => approxAt b i f) (averagingUF G : Filter _) (𝓝 r)
body:
:= by
  have hb : (Ultrafilter.map (fun i => approxAt b i f) (averagingUF G) : Filter ℝ) ≤
      𝓟 (Set.Icc (-‖f‖) ‖f‖) := by
    rw [Ultrafilter.coe_map, Filter.le_principal_iff, Filter.mem_map]
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro i
    exact abs_le.mp (approx_norm_le b i f)
  obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := isCompact_Icc.ultrafilter_le_nhds
    (Ultrafilter.map (fun i => approxAt b i f) (averagingUF G)) hb
  exact ⟨r, hr⟩

                                                                                    
def meanAt (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (averagingUF G : Filter _).limUnder (fun i => approxAt b i f)

name: tendsto_approx
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : Tendsto (fun i => approxAt b i f) (averagingUF G : Filter _) (𝓝 (meanAt b f))
body:
:=
  tendsto_nhds_limUnder (approx_has_limit b f)

name: mean_add
stmt: (f h : G →ᵇ ℝ) : meanAt b (f+h) = meanAt b f + meanAt b h
body:
:= by
  apply Tendsto.limUnder_eq
  convert (tendsto_approx b f).add (tendsto_approx b h) using 1
  simp only [approxAt, cube_add, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]

name: mean_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : meanAt b (c • f) = c * meanAt b f
body:
:= by
  apply Tendsto.limUnder_eq
  convert (tendsto_approx b f).const_mul c using 1
  simp only [approxAt, cube_smul, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: mean_const
stmt: (c : ℝ) : meanAt b (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G c) = c
body:
:= by
  apply Tendsto.limUnder_eq
  convert (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : Finset G × ℕ => c)
    (averagingUF G : Filter _) (𝓝 c)) using 1
  simp only [approxAt, cube_const, BoundedContinuousFunction.const_apply]

name: mean_nonneg
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ meanAt b f
body:
:= by
  exact ge_of_tendsto (tendsto_approx b f) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun i =>
    cube_nonneg i.1.toList i.2 f hf (b i))

name: mean_norm_le
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : ‖meanAt b f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
body:
:= by
  exact le_of_tendsto (tendsto_approx b f).norm
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun i => approx_norm_le b i f)

name: mean_shift
stmt: (g : G) (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : meanAt b (shift g f) = meanAt b f
body:
:= by
  have hz : Tendsto (fun i : Finset G × ℕ => approxAt b i (shift g f) - approxAt b i f)
      (averagingUF G : Filter _) (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero_norm' _ (tendsto_boundary f)
    filter_upwards [eventually_mem g] with i hi
    have h := ((cube i.1.toList i.2 (shift g f-f)).norm_coe_le_norm (b i)).trans
      (cube_coboundary_norm i.1.toList g (Finset.mem_toList.mpr hi) i.2 f)
    simpa only [cube_sub, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, approxAt] using h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (tendsto_nhds_unique ((tendsto_approx b _).sub (tendsto_approx b _)) hz)

                                                                               
def meanCLM : (G →ᵇ ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := meanAt b, map_add' := mean_add b, map_smul' := mean_smul b }
    1 (by intro f; change ‖meanAt b f‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖; simpa only [one_mul] using mean_norm_le b f)

name: meanCLM_apply
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : meanCLM b f = meanAt b f
body:
:= rfl

def toMean : Amenable.Mean G where
  map := meanCLM b
  map_const := mean_const b
  positive := mean_nonneg b
  invariant g f := mean_shift b g f
end

open PlaneFiveColor.InvariantMean
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
local instance : DecidableEq G := Classical.decEq _
def cubeSupport : List G → ℕ → Finset G
  | [], _ => {0}
  | g::L, n => (Finset.range (n+1)).biUnion (fun k => (cubeSupport L n).image (fun h => k • g+h))

name: cube_le_of_support
stmt: (L : List G) (n : ℕ) (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) (v : G) (c : ℝ) (hf : ∀ h ∈ cubeSupport L n, f (v+h) ≤ c) : cube L n f v ≤ c
body:
:= by
  induction L generalizing v with
  | nil => simpa [cubeSupport, cube] using hf 0 (by simp [cubeSupport])
  | cons g L ih =>
    rw [cube, single_apply]
    have hb : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), cube L n f (v+k • g) ≤ (n+1 : ℕ) * c := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), c := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk =>
          ih _ (by
            intro h hh
            have hm : k • g+h ∈ cubeSupport (g::L) n := by
              apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
              exact ⟨k, hk, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨h,hh,rfl⟩⟩
            simpa only [add_assoc] using hf _ hm)
        _ = _ := by simp
    calc
      _ ≤ ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n+1 : ℕ) * c) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity)
      _ = c := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]

name: syndetic_of_all_means
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hf : ∀ M : Amenable.Mean G, c < M.map f) : ∃ S : Finset G, ∀ v : G, ∃ s ∈ S, c < f (v+s)
body:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  choose b hb using (fun i : Finset G × ℕ => hn (cubeSupport i.1.toList i.2))
  have hle : meanAt b f ≤ c := by
    apply le_of_tendsto (tendsto_approx b f)
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro i
    exact cube_le_of_support _ _ _ _ _ (hb i)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) (hf (toMean b))
end EuclideanFiveColor.MovingMean
end

section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

section
variable {G X : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [MeasurableSpace X]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
namespace Family
def energy (F : Family G X) : G →ᵇ ℝ := Amenable.Mean.squareNorm (toL2 μ F)
omit [AddCommGroup G] in

name: energy_apply
stmt: (F : Family G X) (g : G) : energy μ F g = ‖l2 μ (F g)‖^2
body:
:=
  Amenable.Mean.squareNorm_apply _ _

name: energy_mean_eq_of_meanNorm_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (F H : Family G X) (he : meanNorm μ M (F-H) = 0) : M.map (energy μ F) = M.map (energy μ H)
body:
:= by
  have hb : |M.map (energy μ F - energy μ H)| ≤
      M.map (((bound F : ℝ)+(bound H : ℝ)) • Amenable.Mean.normFn (toL2 μ (F-H))) := by
    apply M.abs_le
    intro g
    simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, energy_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, Amenable.Mean.normFn_apply, toL2_apply,
      sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [map_sub]
    have hn := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (l2 μ (F g)) (l2 μ (H g))
    have hF := l2_norm_le μ (F g) (F.norm_le_bound g)
    have hH := l2_norm_le μ (H g) (H.norm_le_bound g)
    calc
      _ = |‖l2 μ (F g)‖-‖l2 μ (H g)‖| * (‖l2 μ (F g)‖+‖l2 μ (H g)‖) := by
        have heq : ‖l2 μ (F g)‖^2 - ‖l2 μ (H g)‖^2 =
            (‖l2 μ (F g)‖-‖l2 μ (H g)‖) * (‖l2 μ (F g)‖+‖l2 μ (H g)‖) := by ring
        rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
      _ ≤ ‖l2 μ (F g)-l2 μ (H g)‖ * ((bound F : ℝ)+bound H) :=
        mul_le_mul hn (add_le_add hF hH) (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  rw [map_sub, map_smul] at hb
  change |M.map (energy μ F) - M.map (energy μ H)| ≤ _ * meanNorm μ M (F-H) at hb
  rw [he, mul_zero] at hb
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hb (abs_nonneg _)))

name: avg_const
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (f : Func X) : avg μ M (const (G := G) f) = l2 μ f
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro v
  rw [avg_pair]
  have he : Amenable.Mean.pairing (toL2 μ (const (G := G) f)) v =
      BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (inner ℝ (l2 μ f) v) := rfl
  rw [he, M.map_const]
end Family

def normSquare (f : Func X) : Func X := f * bmConj f

name: normSquare_apply
stmt: (f : Func X) (x : X) : normSquare f x = (‖f x‖^2 : ℝ)
body:
:= by
  change f x * star (f x) = _
  rw [← starRingEnd_apply, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

name: integral_normSquare
stmt: (f : Func X) : ∫ x, normSquare f x ∂μ = (‖l2 μ f‖^2 : ℝ)
body:
:= by
  simp only [normSquare_apply, norm_l2_sq, integral_complex_ofReal]

name: inner_normSquare
stmt: (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ (normSquare f)) (l2 μ (normSquare h)) = ‖l2 μ (f*h)‖^2
body:
:= by
  rw [inner_l2, norm_l2_sq]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact .of_forall fun x => by
    simp only [normSquare_apply, Complex.inner, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re,
      mul_apply, norm_mul]
    ring

variable [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]

name: avg_orbit_const
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (f : Func X) : Family.avg μ M (Family.orbit φ f) = l2 μ (algebraMap ℂ (Func X) (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
body:
:= by
  let c : Func X := algebraMap ℂ (Func X) (∫ x, f x ∂μ)
  have hc : ∫ x, l2 μ (f-c) x ∂μ = 0 := by
    rw [integral_l2]
    change ∫ x, f x-c x ∂μ = 0
    rw [integral_sub (integrable μ f) (integrable μ c)]
    change (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - (∫ _x : X, (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ∂μ) = 0
    simp
  have hv := Amenable.Koopman.vector_orbit_hom_zero μ M φ hs (l2 μ (f-c)) hc
  have he : Family.avg μ M (Family.orbit φ (f-c)) =
      M.vector (Amenable.Mean.orbit (fun g => Amenable.Koopman.action μ (φ g)) (l2 μ (f-c))) := by
    congr 1
  rw [← he] at hv
  have ho : Family.orbit φ (f-c) = Family.orbit φ f - Family.const c := by
    ext g x
    rfl
  rw [ho, (Family.avg μ M).map_sub, Family.avg_const] at hv
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hv

name: pair_energy_mean
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (f h : Func X) : M.map (Family.energy μ (Family.const f * Family.orbit φ h)) = ‖l2 μ f‖^2 * ‖l2 μ h‖^2
body:
:= by
  have he : Family.energy μ (Family.const f * Family.orbit φ h) =
      Amenable.Mean.pairing (Family.toL2 μ (Family.orbit φ (normSquare h))) (l2 μ (normSquare f)) := by
    ext g
    rw [Family.energy_apply, Amenable.Mean.pairing_apply, Family.toL2_apply]
    change ‖l2 μ (f*act (φ g) h)‖^2 = inner ℝ (l2 μ (act (φ g) (normSquare h))) (l2 μ (normSquare f))
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact (inner_normSquare μ f (act (φ g) h)).symm
  rw [he, ← Family.avg_pair, avg_orbit_const μ M φ hs]
  rw [integral_normSquare]
  rw [inner_l2]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, ‖l2 μ h‖^2 * ‖f x‖^2 ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact .of_forall fun x => by
        change inner ℝ ((‖l2 μ h‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) (normSquare f x) = _
        rw [normSquare_apply]
        simp only [Complex.inner, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
        ring
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul, ← norm_l2_sq]; ring
end

variable {G X : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X]
  (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]

name: energy_two_orbits
stmt: (φ θ : G →+ G) (f h : Func X) : Family.energy μ (Family.orbit φ f * Family.orbit θ h) = Family.energy μ (Family.const f * Family.orbit (θ-φ) h)
body:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [Family.energy_apply, Family.energy_apply]
  have he : act (φ g) f * act (θ g) h = act (φ g) (f * act ((θ-φ) g) h) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mul_apply, act_apply, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, ← add_vadd]
    congr 2
    abel_nf
  change ‖l2 μ (act (φ g) f * act (θ g) h)‖^2 = _
  rw [he, l2_act]
  simp
omit [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]

name: two_orbit_energy_mean
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (φ θ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective (θ-φ)) (f h : Func X) : M.map (Family.energy μ (Family.orbit φ f * Family.orbit θ h)) = ‖l2 μ f‖^2 * ‖l2 μ h‖^2
body:
:= by
  rw [energy_two_orbits]
  exact pair_energy_mean μ M (θ-φ) hs f h
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
end

section
open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]
  (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
  (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
omit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] in
include hq hqcov in

name: factor_ergodic
stmt: : ErgodicVAdd G Y (μ.map q)
body:
:= by
  have hp (g : G) : MeasurePreserving (fun y : Y => g +ᵥ y) (μ.map q) (μ.map q) := by
    refine ⟨measurable_const_vadd _, ?_⟩
    rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_const_vadd _) hq]
    calc
      _ = μ.map (q ∘ (fun x => g +ᵥ x)) := Measure.map_congr (hqcov g).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [← Measure.map_map hq (measurable_const_vadd _), (measurePreserving_vadd g μ).map_eq]
  have : VAddInvariantMeasure G Y (μ.map q) := ⟨fun g s hs => (hp g).measure_preimage hs.nullMeasurableSet⟩
  constructor
  intro s hs hinv
  have hc : EventuallyEmptyOrUniv (q ⁻¹' s) (ae μ) := by
    apply ErgodicVAdd.aeconst_of_forall_preimage_vadd_ae_eq (G := G) (hs.preimage hq)
    intro g
    filter_upwards [ae_of_ae_map hq.aemeasurable (hinv g), hqcov g] with x hx he
    change (q (g +ᵥ x) ∈ s) = (q x ∈ s)
    rw [he]
    exact hx
  rw [eventuallyEmptyOrUniv_iff] at hc ⊢
  rcases hc with hc | hc
  · exact Or.inl ((ae_map_iff hq.aemeasurable hs).mpr hc)
  · exact Or.inr ((ae_map_iff hq.aemeasurable hs.compl).mpr hc)
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
  (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]
  (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
  (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
variable [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
variable [ErgodicVAdd G (X×X) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]
include hq hqcov in

name: conditional_pair_energy
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (f h : Func X) : M.map (Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const f * Family.orbit φ h))) = ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q f)‖^2 * ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q h)‖^2
body:
:= by
  have : ErgodicVAdd G Y (μ.map q) := factor_ergodic μ q hq hqcov
  have hp := pairVanishing_of_ergodic μ q hq M
  have he := covariance_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs f h
  have hv := Family.energy_mean_eq_of_meanNorm_zero (μ.map q) M _ _ he
  rw [hv]
  exact pair_energy_mean (μ.map q) M φ hs (conditional μ q f) (conditional μ q h)
include hq hqcov in

name: conditional_integer_pair_energy
stmt: (hdiv : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (scaleHom (G := G) n)) (M : Amenable.Mean G) {n m : ℤ} (hnm : n ≠ m) (f h : Func X) : M.map (Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q (Family.orbit (scaleHom n) f * Family.orbit (scaleHom m) h))) = ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q f)‖^2 * ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q h)‖^2
body:
:= by
  have : ErgodicVAdd G Y (μ.map q) := factor_ergodic μ q hq hqcov
  have hp := pairVanishing_of_ergodic μ q hq M
  have hn : Set.InjOn (![n,m]) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) := by
    intro i _ j _ he
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all
  have he := conditional_integer_multiple_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov hdiv M hp
    Finset.univ ![n,m] ![f,h] hn
  simp only [Fin.prod_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at he
  rw [Family.energy_mean_eq_of_meanNorm_zero (μ.map q) M _ _ he]
  apply two_orbit_energy_mean
  rw [← scaleHom_sub]
  exact hdiv _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hnm.symm)
include hq hqcov in

name: conditional_integer_triple_energy
stmt: (hdiv : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (scaleHom (G := G) n)) (M : Amenable.Mean G) (f h k : Func X) : M.map (Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q (Family.orbit (scaleHom 0) f * Family.orbit (scaleHom 1) h * Family.orbit (scaleHom 2) k))) = M.map (Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.orbit (scaleHom 0) (conditional μ q f) * Family.orbit (scaleHom 1) (conditional μ q h) * Family.orbit (scaleHom 2) (conditional μ q k)))
body:
:= by
  have hp := pairVanishing_of_ergodic μ q hq M
  have hn : Set.InjOn (![(0:ℤ),1,2]) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) := by
    intro i _ j _ he
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all
  have he := conditional_integer_multiple_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov hdiv M hp
    Finset.univ ![(0:ℤ),1,2] ![f,h,k] hn
  simp only [Fin.prod_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_two] at he
  exact Family.energy_mean_eq_of_meanNorm_zero (μ.map q) M _ _ he
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
end

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped ENNReal NNReal ComplexConjugate
namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

                                                                        
def char (z : E) : Func D := ⟨fun d => (eval z d : ℂ), measurable_eval_coe z,
  1, fun d => by simp only [Circle.norm_coe, NNReal.coe_one, le_refl]⟩

name: char_apply
stmt: (z : E) (d : D) : char z d = (eval z d : ℂ)
body: := rfl

name: norm_char
stmt: (z : E) (d : D) : ‖char z d‖ = 1
body: := Circle.norm_coe _

name: char_zero
stmt: : char 0 = 1
body: := by ext d; simp

name: char_add
stmt: (z w : E) : char (z+w) = char z * char w
body:
:= by
  ext d
  exact congrArg (fun a : Circle => (a : ℂ)) (eval_add z w d)

name: char_neg
stmt: (z : E) : char (-z) = bmConj (char z)
body:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [char_apply, eval_neg, conj_apply]
  exact Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj _

name: char_act
stmt: (g : Rot) (z : E) : act g (char z) = char (kCoeff (rotMul g)*z)
body:
:= rfl

variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : D → Y)
def projectedMass (z : E) : ℝ := ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (char z))‖^2

name: projectedMass_nonneg
stmt: (z : E) : 0 ≤ projectedMass μ q z
body: := sq_nonneg _

name: projected_char_bound
stmt: (z : E) (y : Y) : ‖conditional μ q (char z) y‖ ≤ 1
body:
:=
  expect_bound _ _ (fun d => le_of_eq (norm_char _ d)) y
variable (hq : Measurable q)
include hq in

name: projectedMass_le_one
stmt: (z : E) : projectedMass μ q z ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hq.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have hn := l2_norm_le (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (char z)) (projected_char_bound μ q z)
  unfold projectedMass
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (char z)))]
include hq in

name: projectedMass_zero
stmt: : projectedMass μ q 0 = 1
body:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hq.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  have he : conditional μ q (char 0) = 1 := by
    ext y
    change (∫ d, char 0 d ∂condDistrib id q μ y) = 1
    simp
  unfold projectedMass
  rw [he, norm_l2_sq]
  simp
include hq in

name: differenceFourier_projectedMass
stmt: (z : E) : ∫ d, (eval z d : ℂ) ∂DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map q) (condDistrib id q μ) = (projectedMass μ q z : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hq.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  rw [DifferenceFourier.difference_coefficient (eval z) (measurable_eval_coe z)]
  congr 1
  exact (norm_l2_sq (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (char z))).symm

variable [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y] [SMulInvariantMeasure K D μ]
variable (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ d ∂μ, q (k • d) = k • q d)
include hq hqcov in

name: projectedMass_rotation
stmt: (u : K) (z : E) : projectedMass μ q (kCoeff u*z) = projectedMass μ q z
body:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hq.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  unfold projectedMass
  rw [← norm_project_l2 μ q hq, ← norm_project_l2 μ q hq]
  have hchar : char (kCoeff u*z) = act (mulRot u) (char z) := rfl
  rw [hchar]
  have he := (l2_eq_iff μ _ _).mpr (project_act μ q hq (fun g : Rot => hqcov (rotMul g)) (mulRot u) (char z))
  rw [he, l2_act]
  simp
include hq hqcov in

name: projectedMass_radial
stmt: {z w : E} (hn : ‖(z : ℂ)‖ = ‖(w : ℂ)‖) : projectedMass μ q z = projectedMass μ q w
body:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w = 0
  · have hz : z = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply norm_eq_zero.mp
      simpa [hw] using hn
    rw [hz, hw]
  have hwc : (w : ℂ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hw (Subtype.ext h)
  let c : Circle := ⟨(z : ℂ)/(w : ℂ), mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr (by

  exact projectedMass_rotation μ q hq hqcov u w

structure ConvexAverage (G : Type*) where
  n : ℕ
  pt : Fin n → G
  weight : Fin n → ℝ
  nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ weight i
  total : ∑ i, weight i = 1
namespace ConvexAverage
variable {G H : Type*}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
def apply (A : ConvexAverage G) (f : G → H) : H := ∑ i, A.weight i • f (A.pt i)

name: norm_le
stmt: (A : ConvexAverage G) (f : G → H) {C : ℝ} (hf : ∀ g, ‖f g‖ ≤ C) : ‖A.apply f‖ ≤ C
body:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖A.weight i • f (A.pt i)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, A.weight i * C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
      rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (A.nonneg i)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf _) (A.nonneg i)
    _ = C := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul,A.total,one_mul]

name: of_mem_convexHull
stmt: {f : G → H} {v : H} (hv : v ∈ convexHull ℝ (Set.range f)) : ∃ A : ConvexAverage G, A.apply f = v
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι,hi,w,z,hw,ht,hz,he⟩ := mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype.mp hv
  choose g hg using hz
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  refine ⟨⟨Fintype.card ι,g ∘ e,w ∘ e,fun i => hw _,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using (e.sum_comp w).trans ht
  · dsimp [apply]
    simp only [hg]
    exact (e.sum_comp (fun i => w i • z i)).trans he
end ConvexAverage

variable {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]

name: exists_finite_approx
stmt: (M : Mean G) (V : G →ᵇ H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ A : ConvexAverage G, ‖A.apply V - M.vector V‖ < ε
body:

  obtain ⟨v,hv,he⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp h ε hε
  obtain ⟨A,rfl⟩ := ConvexAverage.of_mem_convexHull hv
  exact ⟨A,by simpa [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using (show dist (M.vector V) (A.apply V) < ε from he)⟩

name: setIntegral_bm
stmt: (A : ConvexAverage G) (f : Func X) (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hinv : ∀ g : G, (fun x => g +ᵥ x) ⁻¹' s =ᵐ[μ] s) : ∫ x in s, A.bm f x ∂μ = ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ

variable (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated X]
def testSet (s : Finset ℕ) : Set X := ⋂ n ∈ s, MeasurableSpace.natGeneratingSequence X n

name: measurable_testSet
stmt: (s : Finset ℕ) : MeasurableSet (testSet X s)

:=

name: testSet_union
stmt: (s t : Finset ℕ) : testSet X (s ∪ t) = testSet X s ∩ testSet X t
body:

name: pi_testSet
stmt: : IsPiSystem (Set.range (testSet X))
body:
:= by

  exact ⟨s ∪ t,testSet_union X s t⟩

name: generate_testSet
stmt: : MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (Set.range (testSet X)) = ‹MeasurableSpace X›
body:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le
    rintro _ ⟨s,rfl⟩; exact measurable_testSet X s
  · conv_lhs => rw [← MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_natGeneratingSequence X]
    apply MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_mono
    rintro _ ⟨n,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨{n},by simp [testSet]⟩
def test (s : Finset ℕ) : Func X :=
  ⟨(testSet X s).indicator (fun _ => 1),(measurable_const.indicator (measurable_testSet X s)),1,
    fun x => by by_cases hx : x ∈ testSet X s <;> simp [hx]⟩

stmt: (s : Finset ℕ) (x : X) : test X s x = (testSet X s).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℂ)) x
body:

  (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]

name: ergodic_of_test_limits
stmt: (A : Finset ℕ → ℕ → ConvexAverage G) (c : Finset ℕ → ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => (A i n).bm (test X i) x) atTop (𝓝 (c i))) : ErgodicVAdd G X μ
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun {s} hs hinv => ?_⟩
  have hall (i : Finset ℕ) : ∫ x, test X i x ∂μ = c i := by
    simpa using ConvexAverage.setIntegral_of_limit μ (test X i) (A i) (c i) (hA i)
      Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ (fun _ => Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))
  have htest (i : Finset ℕ) : (μ.restrict s).real (testSet X i) = μ.real s * μ.real (testSet X i) := by
    have he := ConvexAverage.setIntegral_of_limit μ (test X i) (A i) (c i) (hA i) s hs hinv
    rw [← hall i] at he
    simp only [test_apply] at he
    rw [integral_indicator_const _ (measurable_testSet X i),
      integral_indicator_const _ (measurable_testSet X i)] at he
    simpa using congrArg Complex.re he
  have he : μ.restrict s = μ s • μ := by
    apply ext_of_generate_finite (Set.range (testSet X)) (generate_testSet X).symm (pi_testSet X)
    · rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
      apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (by finiteness) (by simp; finiteness)).mp
      simpa [Measure.real,Measure.smul_apply,ENNReal.toReal_mul] using htest i
    · simp
  have hr : μ.real s = μ.real s * μ.real s := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun ν : Measure X => ν.real s) he
    simpa [Measure.real,Measure.restrict_apply hs,Set.inter_self] using hh
  have hz : μ.real s = 0 ∨ μ.real s = 1 := by
    have hh : μ.real s * (μ.real s-1) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hh with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
  rw [eventuallyEmptyOrUniv_iff]
  rcases hz with h | h
  · right
    rw [ae_iff]
    simpa using (show μ s = 0 by rw [← ofReal_measureReal]; simp [h])
  · left
    apply (ae_iff_measure_eq hs.nullMeasurableSet).mpr
    change μ s = μ Set.univ
    rw [← ofReal_measureReal (μ := μ) (s := s)]
    simp [h]
end ErgodicCriterion

stmt: : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map (code μ M), VAddInvariantMeasure G X (condDistrib id (code μ M) μ y)

      (condDistrib id (code μ M) μ y).map (fun x => g +ᵥ x) = condDistrib id (code μ M) μ y := by
    have h := KernelSupport.condDistrib_equivariant μ id (code μ M) measurable_id (code_measurable μ M)
      (MeasurableEquiv.vadd g) (MeasurableEquiv.refl _) (fun x => g +ᵥ x)
      (measurable_const_vadd g) (measurePreserving_vadd g μ) (code_fixed μ M g)
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))

  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr h] with y hy
  constructor
  intro g s hs
  rw [← Measure.map_apply (measurable_const_vadd _) hs,hy]

stmt: : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map (code μ M), ErgodicVAdd G X (condDistrib id (code μ M) μ y)
body:
:= by
  choose A hA using (fun i => InvariantSequence.exists_averages μ M (test X i))
  have hc := ConditionalFiber.ae_fiber_of_ae μ (code μ M) (code_measurable μ M) (ae_all_iff.mpr hA)
  filter_upwards [fiber_invariant μ M,hc, ConditionalFiber.ae_in_own_fiber μ (code μ M) (code_measurable μ M)] with y hy hlim hcode
  let := hy
  apply ergodic_of_test_limits (condDistrib id (code μ M) μ y) A y
  intro i
  filter_upwards [hlim,hcode] with x hx he
  have hh := hx i

  rwa [he] at hh

body:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · simp [hμ]
  have hu : μ Set.univ ≠ 0 := Measure.measure_univ_ne_zero.mpr hμ
  let ν := (μ Set.univ)⁻¹ • μ
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := ⟨by
    rw [Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hu (measure_ne_top μ Set.univ)]⟩
  have hwν : IsWild ν := ⟨fun k => (hw.1 k).smul_measure _,by simp [ν,Measure.smul_apply,hw.2]⟩
  have hh := wild_fourier ν hwν z hz
  rw [integral_smul_measure] at hh
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left (by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv]
    exact inv_ne_zero ((ENNReal.toReal_pos hu (measure_ne_top μ Set.univ)).ne'))
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (U : DiscreteE →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (W : K → unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))
  (hcov : ∀ k z w, (W k : H →L[ℂ] H) (ContinuousVectors.op U z w) =
    ContinuousVectors.op U ((kCoeff k)*z) ((W k : H →L[ℂ] H) w))
include hcov

name: vectorMeasure_invariant
stmt: (v : H) (hfix : ∀ k, (W k : H →L[ℂ] H) v = v) : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun d : D => k • d) (measure (calculus U) v) (measure (calculus U) v)
body:
:= by
  intro k
  have hm : Measurable (fun d : D => k • d) := (continuous_scalar (kCoeff k)).measurable
  refine ⟨hm,measure_eq_of_fourier _ _ (fun z => ?_)⟩
  change (∫ d, evaluation z d ∂(measure (calculus U) v).map (fun d : D => k • d)) = _
  rw [integral_map hm.aemeasurable ((evaluation z).continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable)]
  change (∫ d, (eval (kCoeff k * Multiplicative.toAdd z) d : ℂ) ∂measure (calculus U) v) = _
  have hc (a : E) : (∫ d, (eval a d:ℂ) ∂measure (calculus U) v) =
      ⟪v,ContinuousVectors.op U a v⟫_ℂ := by
    have hh := integral_complex (calculus U) v (evaluation (G := DiscreteE) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))
    rw [calculus_evaluation U (Multiplicative.ofAdd a : DiscreteE)] at hh
    exact hh
  change (∫ d, (eval (kCoeff k * Multiplicative.toAdd z) d : ℂ) ∂measure (calculus U) v) =
    ∫ d, (eval (Multiplicative.toAdd z) d:ℂ) ∂measure (calculus U) v
  rw [hc,hc]
  calc
    _ = ⟪(W k : H →L[ℂ] H) v,ContinuousVectors.op U (kCoeff k * Multiplicative.toAdd z) ((W k : H →L[ℂ] H) v)⟫_ℂ := by rw [hfix k]
    _ = ⟪(W k : H →L[ℂ] H) v,(W k : H →L[ℂ] H) (ContinuousVectors.op U (Multiplicative.toAdd z) v)⟫_ℂ := by rw [hcov]
    _ = _ := Unitary.inner_map_map (W k) v (ContinuousVectors.op U (Multiplicative.toAdd z) v)

name: residual_fourier
stmt: (v : H) (hv : v ∈ (ContinuousVectors.space U)ᗮ) (hfix : ∀ k, (W k : H →L[ℂ] H) v = v) (z : E) (hz : z ≠ 0) : ⟪v,ContinuousVectors.op U z v⟫_ℂ = 0
body:
:= by
  have hw : IsWild (measure (calculus U) v) :=
    ⟨vectorMeasure_invariant U W hcov v hfix,measure_ordinary_zero_of_orthogonal U v hv⟩
  have hh := finite_wild_fourier (measure (calculus U) v) hw z hz
  have hc := integral_complex (calculus U) v (evaluation (G := DiscreteE) (Multiplicative.ofAdd z))
  rw [calculus_evaluation U (Multiplicative.ofAdd z : DiscreteE)] at hc
  exact hc.symm.trans hh
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

name: apply_ae
stmt: (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : apply μ f hf hbound g =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x*g x
body:
:= MemLp.coeFn_toLp _
def linear (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) :
    Lp ℂ 2 μ →ₗ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ where
  toFun := apply μ f hf hbound
  map_add' g h := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [apply_ae μ f hf hbound (g+h),apply_ae μ f hf hbound g,apply_ae μ f hf hbound h,
      Lp.coeFn_add g h,Lp.coeFn_add (apply μ f hf hbound g) (apply μ f hf hbound h)] with x ha hb hc hd he
    simp only [ha,he,Pi.add_apply,hb,hc,hd,mul_add]
  map_smul' c g := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [apply_ae μ f hf hbound (c • g),apply_ae μ f hf hbound g,
      Lp.coeFn_smul c g,Lp.coeFn_smul c (apply μ f hf hbound g)] with x ha hb hc hd
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply,ha,hd,Pi.smul_apply,hb,hc,smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: apply_norm_le
stmt: (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : ‖apply μ f hf hbound g‖ ≤ C*‖g‖
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
  filter_upwards [apply_ae μ f hf hbound g,hbound] with x hx hf
  rw [hx,norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf (norm_nonneg _)
def clm (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) :
    Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
  (linear μ f hf hbound).mkContinuous C (apply_norm_le μ f hf hbound)

name: clm_ae
stmt: (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : clm μ f hf hbound g =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x*g x
body:
:= apply_ae μ f hf hbound g
end Multiplier
abbrev ComplexPlaneL2 := Lp (α := ℂ) ℂ 2 volume
def planeTranslate (h : ℂ) : ComplexPlaneL2 →ₗᵢ[ℂ] ComplexPlaneL2 :=
  Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun x => x+h) (measurePreserving_add_right volume h)

name: planeTranslate_ae
stmt: (h : ℂ) (g : ComplexPlaneL2) : planeTranslate h g =ᵐ[volume] fun x => g (x+h)

name: planePhase_norm
stmt: (h ξ : ℂ) : ‖planePhase h ξ‖=1
body: := Circle.norm_coe _

name: planePhase_continuous
stmt: (h : ℂ) : Continuous (planePhase h)
body:
:= by
  unfold planePhase
  fun_prop

def phaseMultiplier (h : ℂ) : ComplexPlaneL2 →L[ℂ] ComplexPlaneL2 :=
  Multiplier.clm volume (planePhase h) (planePhase_continuous h).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => (planePhase_norm h ξ).le)

name: phaseMultiplier_ae
stmt: (h : ℂ) (g : ComplexPlaneL2) : phaseMultiplier h g =ᵐ[volume] fun ξ => planePhase h ξ*g ξ
body:
:= Multiplier.clm_ae _ _ _ _ _
def schwartzTranslate (h : ℂ) : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ →L[ℂ] SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ :=
  SchwartzMap.compCLMOfAntilipschitz ℂ
    (Function.HasTemperateGrowth.id.add (Function.HasTemperateGrowth.const h)) (isometry_add_right h).antilipschitzWith

name: schwartzTranslate_apply
stmt: (h : ℂ) (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (x : ℂ) : schwartzTranslate h f x = f (x+h)
body: := rfl

name: schwartzTranslate_toLp
stmt: (h : ℂ) (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) : (schwartzTranslate h f).toLp 2 = planeTranslate h (f.toLp 2)
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(schwartzTranslate h f).coeFn_toLp 2,planeTranslate_ae h (f.toLp 2),
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (f.coeFn_toLp 2 volume)] with x hx hy hz
  exact hx.trans ((schwartzTranslate_apply h f x).trans (hz.symm.trans hy.symm))

name: fourier_schwartzTranslate
stmt: (h : ℂ) (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (ξ : ℂ) : 𝓕 (schwartzTranslate h f) ξ = planePhase h ξ * 𝓕 f ξ
body:
:= by
  have hh := congrFun (VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_comp_add_right Real.fourierChar volume
    (innerₗ ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) h) ξ
  simpa only [SchwartzMap.fourier_coe,Real.fourier_eq,schwartzTranslate_apply,
    planePhase,Circle.smul_def,smul_eq_mul,VectorFourier.fourierIntegral,Function.comp_def,innerₗ_apply_apply] using hh

name: fourier_planeTranslate
stmt: (h : ℂ) (g : ComplexPlaneL2) : 𝓕 (planeTranslate h g) = phaseMultiplier h (𝓕 g)
body:
:= by
  apply DenseRange.induction_on (p := fun g : ComplexPlaneL2 => 𝓕 (planeTranslate h g) = phaseMultiplier h (𝓕 g))
    (SchwartzMap.denseRange_toLpCLM (E := ℂ) (F := ℂ) (p := 2) ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top) g
  · exact isClosed_eq ((Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℂ ℂ).continuous.comp (planeTranslate h).continuous)
      ((phaseMultiplier h).continuous.comp (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℂ ℂ).continuous)
  intro f
  change 𝓕 (planeTranslate h (f.toLp 2)) = phaseMultiplier h (𝓕 (f.toLp 2))
  rw [← schwartzTranslate_toLp,SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq,SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(𝓕 (schwartzTranslate h f)).coeFn_toLp 2,phaseMultiplier_ae h ((𝓕 f).toLp 2),
    (𝓕 f).coeFn_toLp 2] with ξ hξ hmul hf
  rw [hξ,hmul,hf]
  exact fourier_schwartzTranslate h f ξ
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: norm_integral_sq
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : X → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f μ) (hf₂ : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x‖^2) μ) : ‖∫ x, f x ∂μ‖^2 ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂μ
body:
:= by
  let a := ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂μ
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
  have hvar : 0 ≤ (∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂μ) - a^2 := by
    have h : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ x, (‖f x‖-a)^2 ∂μ :=
      integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (‖f x‖-a))
    have he : (fun x => (‖f x‖-a)^2) = fun x => ‖f x‖^2 - (2*a)*‖f x‖ + a^2 := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [he, integral_add (f := fun x => ‖f x‖^2 - (2*a)*‖f x‖) (g := fun _ => a^2) (hf₂.sub (hf.norm.const_mul (2*a))) (integrable_const (a^2)),
      integral_sub (f := fun x => ‖f x‖^2) (g := fun x => (2*a)*‖f x‖) hf₂ (hf.norm.const_mul (2*a)), integral_const_mul] at h
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at h
    change 0 ≤ (∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂μ) - (2*a)*a + a^2 at h
    nlinarith
  have hn : ‖∫ x, f x ∂μ‖ ≤ a := norm_integral_le_integral_norm f
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (∫ x, f x ∂μ)]

variable (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ] (ν : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
def average (F : X × Ω → ℂ) (x : X) : ℂ := ∫ ω, F (x,ω) ∂ν

name: average_measurable
stmt: {F : X × Ω → ℂ} (hF : StronglyMeasurable F) : StronglyMeasurable (average ν F)
body: := hF.integral_prod_right'

name: fiber_memLp
stmt: {F : X × Ω → ℂ} (hF : StronglyMeasurable F) (hF2 : Integrable (fun z => ‖F z‖^2) (μ.prod ν)) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, MemLp (fun ω => F (x,ω)) 2 ν
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hF2.prod_right_ae] with x hx
  exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm
    (hF.comp_measurable measurable_prodMk_left).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hx

name: average_memLp
stmt: {F : X × Ω → ℂ} (hF : StronglyMeasurable F) (hF2 : Integrable (fun z => ‖F z‖^2) (μ.prod ν)) : MemLp (average ν F) 2 μ
body:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (average_measurable ν hF).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  apply hF2.integral_prod_left.mono' ((average_measurable ν hF).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [fiber_memLp μ ν hF hF2,hF2.prod_right_ae] with x hx hx2
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,Pi.pow_apply,abs_sq,average] using
    norm_integral_sq ν (fun ω => F (x,ω)) (hx.integrable (by norm_num)) hx2

name: average_toLp_integral
stmt: {F : X × Ω → ℂ} (hF : StronglyMeasurable F) (hF2 : Integrable (fun z => ‖F z‖^2) (μ.prod ν)) (G : Ω → Lp ℂ 2 μ) (hG : Integrable G ν) (hrep : ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν, G ω =ᵐ[μ] fun x => F (x,ω)) : (average_memLp μ ν hF hF2).toLp (average ν F) = ∫ ω, G ω ∂ν
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro g
  have hg2 : Integrable (fun z : X × Ω => ‖g z.1‖^2) (μ.prod ν) :=
    ((memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable g)).mp (Lp.memLp g)).comp_fst ν
  have hpair : Integrable (fun z : X × Ω => inner ℂ (g z.1) (F z)) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply (hg2.add hF2).mono'
      (((Lp.stronglyMeasurable g).comp_measurable measurable_fst).inner hF).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => (norm_inner_le_norm _ _).trans
      (by dsimp only [Pi.add_apply]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖g z.1‖-‖F z‖)])
  rw [L2.inner_def,← integral_inner hG g]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, inner ℂ (g x) (average ν F x) ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (by
      filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp (average_memLp μ ν hF hF2)] with x hx
      rw [hx])
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ ω, inner ℂ (g x) (F (x,ω)) ∂ν ∂μ := integral_congr_ae (by
      filter_upwards [fiber_memLp μ ν hF hF2] with x hx
      exact (integral_inner (hx.integrable (by norm_num)) (g x)).symm)
    _ = ∫ ω, ∫ x, inner ℂ (g x) (F (x,ω)) ∂μ ∂ν := integral_integral_swap hpair
    _ = _ := integral_congr_ae (by
      filter_upwards [hrep] with ω hω
      rw [L2.inner_def]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hω] with x hx
      rw [hx])
end EuclideanFiveColor.ProbabilityL2

name: integralReal_congr
stmt: (f g : AF → ℝ) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ} (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → f t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B) (gs : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → g t = 0) (gb : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ C) (he : ∀ t, f t = g t) : integralReal f hs hb = integralReal g gs gb
body:
:= by
  unfold integralReal
  congr 1
  ext x
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H t => simp only [periodBCF_mk, periodSum, he]

name: integralReal_mul
stmt: (f : AF → ℝ) (c : ℝ) {N M : ℕ} {B C : ℝ} (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → f t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B) (gs : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → c*f t = 0) (gb : ∀ t, ‖c*f t‖ ≤ C) : integralReal (fun t => c*f t) gs gb = c * integralReal f hs hb
body:
:= by
  have he : periodBCF (fun t => c*f t) gs gb = c • periodBCF f hs hb := by
    ext x
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H t =>
      change (∑' k : ℤ, c * f (t+k)) = c * (∑' k : ℤ, f (t+k))
      exact tsum_mul_left
  exact (congrArg mean he).trans (mean_smul _ _)

name: integralReal_sum
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AF → ℝ) {N M : ℕ} {B : ι → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hs : ∀ i, ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → f i t = 0) (hb : ∀ i t, ‖f i t‖ ≤ B i) (gs : ∀ t : AF, (M : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → (∑ i ∈ s, f i t) = 0) (gb : ∀ t, ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i t‖ ≤ C) : integralReal (fun t => ∑ i ∈ s, f i t) gs gb = ∑ i ∈ s, integralReal (f i) (hs i) (hb i)
body:
:= by
  have he : periodBCF (fun t => ∑ i ∈ s, f i t) gs gb =
      ∑ i ∈ s, periodBCF (f i) (hs i) (hb i) := by
    ext x
    rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.sum_apply]
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H t =>
      simp only [periodBCF_mk, periodSum]
      exact Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i _ => period_summable (hs i) t)
  unfold integralReal
  rw [he]
  exact map_sum (meanCLM (G := PeriodGroup)) _ _

name: weighted_bound
stmt: (φ f : AF → ℝ) {B : ℝ} (hb : ∀ t, ‖φ t‖ ≤ B) (hf : ∀ t, 0 ≤ f t ∧ f t ≤ 1) : ∀ t, ‖φ t * f t‖ ≤ B
body:
:= by
  intro t
  rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hf t).1]
  exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (hf t).2).trans (hb t)

name: exists_small_nonnegative_tests
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (φ : AF → ℝ) (f : ι → AF → ℝ) {N : ℕ} {B ε : ℝ} (hs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → φ t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, ‖φ t‖ ≤ B) (hp : ∀ t, 0 ≤ φ t) (hI : 0 < integralReal φ hs hb) (hε : 0 < ε) (hf : ∀ i t, 0 ≤ f i t ∧ f i t ≤ 1) (hz : ∀ i, integralReal (fun t => φ t * f i t) (fun t ht => by rw [hs t ht, zero_mul]) (weighted_bound φ (f i) hb (hf i)) = 0) : ∃ t : AF, 0 < φ t ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, f i t < ε
body:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  let g : AF → ℝ := fun t => ∑ i ∈ s, φ t * f i t
  have gs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → g t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    simp [g, hs t ht]
  have gb : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * B := by
    intro t
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖φ t*f i t‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ s, B := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => weighted_bound φ (f i) hb (hf i) t)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have gi : integralReal g gs gb = 0 := by
    rw [integralReal_sum s (fun i t => φ t*f i t)
      (fun i t ht => by rw [hs t ht, zero_mul])
      (fun i => weighted_bound φ (f i) hb (hf i)) gs gb]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have cs : ∀ t : AF, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → ε*φ t = 0 := by
    intro t ht; rw [hs t ht, mul_zero]
  have cb : ∀ t, ‖ε*φ t‖ ≤ |ε| * B := by
    intro t
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb t) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hle : ∀ t, ε*φ t ≤ g t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : 0 < φ t
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := hn t ht
      have hterm : φ t*f i t ≤ g t :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hp t) (hf j t).1) hi
      exact (by nlinarith : ε*φ t ≤ φ t*f i t).trans hterm
    · have hφ : φ t = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt ht) (hp t)
      simp [g, hφ]
  have hmono := integralReal_mono (fun t => ε*φ t) g cs cb gs gb hle
  rw [integralReal_mul φ ε hs hb cs cb, gi] at hmono
  exact (not_le_of_gt (mul_pos hε hI)) hmono

name: lineFourier_zero
stmt: (ν : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (a : E) : lineFourier ν a 0 = 1
body:
:= by
  simp [lineFourier]

name: lineFourier_re_le_one
stmt: (ν : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (a : E) (t : F) : (lineFourier ν a t).re ≤ 1
body:
:=
  (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (lineFourier_norm_le ν a t)

name: wild_line_average_re_zero
stmt: (ν : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsWild ν) {a : E} (ha : a ≠ 0) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hc : UniformContinuous φ) {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hs : ∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → φ t = 0) (hb : ∀ t, |φ t| ≤ B) : integralReal (fun t : F => φ t * (lineFourier ν a t).re) (fun t ht => by rw [hs t ht, zero_mul]) (fun t => by rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (lineFourier_norm_le ν a t))).trans (hb t)) = 0
body:
:= by
  let f : F → ℂ := fun t => (φ t : ℂ) * lineFourier ν a t
  have fs : ∀ t : F, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → f t = 0 := by
    intro t ht; simp [f, hs t ht]
  have fb : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B := by
    intro t
    dsimp [f]
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (lineFourier_norm_le ν a t)).trans (hb t)
  have rs : ∀ t : F, (N : ℝ) < |(t : ℝ)| → (f t).re = 0 := by
    intro t ht; rw [fs t ht]; rfl
  have rb : ∀ t, ‖(f t).re‖ ≤ B := by
    intro t
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (f t)).trans (fb t)
  have hz : integralReal (fun t => (f t).re) rs rb = 0 := by
    rw [← integralComplex_re f fs fb rs rb]
    rw [show integralComplex f fs fb = 0 from wild_line_average_zero ν hν ha φ hc hs hb]
    rfl
  exact (integralReal_congr _ _ _ _ rs rb (fun t => by simp [f])).trans hz

name: exists_positive_window
stmt: {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : ∃ (φ : C(ℝ, ℝ)) (N : ℕ) (B : ℝ), (∀ t : ℝ, (N : ℝ) < |t| → φ t = 0) ∧ (∀ t, ‖φ t‖ ≤ B) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ φ t) ∧ UniformContinuous φ ∧ (0 < ∫ t : ℝ, φ t) ∧ (∀ t, 0 < φ t → |t| < r)
body:
:= by
  let φ : C(ℝ, ℝ) := ⟨fun t => max 0 (r-|t|), by fun_prop⟩
  have hp (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ φ t := le_max_left _ _
  have hb (t : ℝ) : ‖φ t‖ ≤ r := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hp t)]
    exact max_le hr.le (sub_le_self _ (abs_nonneg _))
  have houtside (t : ℝ) (ht : r ≤ |t|) : φ t = 0 := max_eq_left (sub_nonpos.mpr ht)
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport φ := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro' (K := Set.Icc (-r) r) isCompact_Icc isClosed_Icc
    intro t ht
    apply houtside
    by_contra hn
    exact ht (abs_le.mp (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hn)))
  have hi : 0 < ∫ t : ℝ, φ t :=
    φ.continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hcomp hp
      (show φ 0 ≠ 0 by simpa [φ, max_eq_right hr.le] using hr.ne')
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt r
  refine ⟨φ, N, r, (fun t ht => houtside t (le_of_lt (hN.trans ht))), hb, hp,
    hcomp.uniformContinuous_of_continuous φ.continuous, hi, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  by_contra hn
  rw [houtside t (le_of_not_gt hn)] at ht
  exact lt_irrefl _ ht

name: exists_small_wild_parameter
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (hne : s.Nonempty) (ν : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (hν : IsWild ν) (a : ι → E) (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0) (hn : ∀ i t, 0 ≤ (lineFourier ν (a i) t).re) {r ε : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) : ∃ t : F, t ≠ 0 ∧ |(t : ℝ)| < r ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, (lineFourier ν (a i) t).re < ε
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, N, B, hs, hb, hp, hc, hi, hradius⟩ := exists_positive_window hr
  have hz := fun i => wild_line_average_re_zero ν hν (ha i) φ hc hs
    (fun t => by simpa only [← Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb t)
  have hI : 0 < integralReal (fun t : F => φ t)
      (fun t ht => hs t ht) (fun t => hb t) := by
    rw [integralReal_ordinary φ hs hb]
    exact hi
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htest⟩ := exists_small_nonnegative_tests s
    (fun t : F => φ t) (fun i t => (lineFourier ν (a i) t).re)
    (fun t ht => hs t ht) (fun t => hb t) (fun t => hp t) hI hε
    (fun i t => ⟨hn i t, lineFourier_re_le_one ν (a i) t⟩)
    (fun i => by convert hz i using 1)
  refine ⟨t, ?_, hradius t ht, htest⟩
  intro he
  obtain ⟨i, his⟩ := hne
  have hh := htest i his
  rw [he, lineFourier_zero, Complex.one_re] at hh
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hε1) hh

end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

variable {G Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableSpace Y]
  [CommGroup G] [MeasurableMul₂ G] [MeasurableInv G]

noncomputable def differenceLaw (ν : Measure Y) (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    Measure G := ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2)

instance differenceLaw_probability (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : IsProbabilityMeasure (differenceLaw ν κ) := by
  unfold differenceLaw
  infer_instance

variable (χ : G →* Circle)

omit [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableMul₂ G] [MeasurableInv G] in

name: coe_character_div
stmt: (d e : G) : (χ (d / e) : ℂ) = (χ d : ℂ) * conj (χ e : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  rw [map_div, div_eq_mul_inv, Circle.coe_mul, Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj]

omit [MeasurableMul₂ G] [MeasurableInv G] in

name: independent_coefficient
stmt: (κ : Measure G) [IsProbabilityMeasure κ] : (∫ p : G × G, (χ (p.1 / p.2) : ℂ) ∂κ.prod κ) = (‖∫ d, (χ d : ℂ) ∂κ‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)
body:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ p : G × G, (χ p.1 : ℂ) * conj (χ p.2 : ℂ) ∂κ.prod κ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => coe_character_div χ p.1 p.2))
    _ = (∫ d, (χ d : ℂ) ∂κ) * (∫ d, conj (χ d : ℂ) ∂κ) := by
      convert integral_prod_mul (fun d => (χ d : ℂ)) (fun d => conj (χ d : ℂ)) using 1 <;> infer_instance
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_conj, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

name: difference_coefficient
stmt: (hχ : Measurable (fun d => (χ d : ℂ))) (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : (∫ d, (χ d : ℂ) ∂differenceLaw ν κ) = ((∫ y, (‖∫ d, (χ d : ℂ) ∂κ y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) ∂ν : ℝ) : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  have hm := hχ
  have hdiv : Measurable (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) :=
    measurable_fst.div measurable_snd
  rw [differenceLaw, integral_map hdiv.aemeasurable hm.aestronglyMeasurable,
    Measure.comp_eq_comp_const_apply]
  rw [Kernel.integral_comp]
  · simp only [Kernel.const_apply, Kernel.prod_apply]
    change (∫ y, (∫ p : G × G, (χ (p.1 / p.2) : ℂ) ∂(κ y).prod (κ y)) ∂ν) = _
    rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => independent_coefficient χ (κ y))
  · exact Integrable.of_bound (hm.comp hdiv).aestronglyMeasurable 1
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => (Circle.norm_coe _).le))

name: difference_coefficient_nonneg
stmt: (hχ : Measurable (fun d => (χ d : ℂ))) (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : 0 ≤ (∫ d, (χ d : ℂ) ∂differenceLaw ν κ).re
body:
:= by
  rw [difference_coefficient χ hχ]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro y
  positivity
