name: sameBin_card
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ) : ((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2)).card = ∑ b : κ, (s.filter (fun i => f i = b)).card ^ 2
body:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun p : ι × ι => f p.1)
    (t := Finset.univ) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  have he : (((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2)).filter
      (fun p => f p.1 = b)) =
      (s.filter (fun i => f i = b)) ×ˢ (s.filter (fun i => f i = b)) := by
    ext p
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
    aesop
  rw [he, Finset.card_product, pow_two]

omit [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] in

name: sameBin_card_eq
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ) : ((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2)).card = (repeatedPairs s f).card + s.card
body:
:= by
  classical
  let T := (s ×ˢ s).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2)
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := T)
    (p := fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)
  have hfirst : T.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) = repeatedPairs s f := by
    ext p
    simp only [T, repeatedPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
    tauto
  have hsecond : T.filter (fun p => ¬p.1 ≠ p.2) = s.diag := by
    ext p
    simp only [T, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, not_not, Finset.mem_diag]
    aesop
  rw [hfirst, hsecond, Finset.diag_card] at hsplit
  exact hsplit.symm

                                                  
omit [Fintype ι] in

name: repeated_bin_lower_bound
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ) : (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * ((repeatedPairs s f).card + (s.card : ℝ))
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : ∑ b : κ, (s.filter (fun i => f i = b)).card = s.card := by
    symm
    exact Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (t := Finset.univ) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
  have hs' : ∑ b : κ, ((s.filter (fun i => f i = b)).card : ℝ) = s.card := by
    exact_mod_cast hs
  have hpair : ∑ b : κ, ((s.filter (fun i => f i = b)).card : ℝ) ^ 2 =
      (repeatedPairs s f).card + (s.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (sameBin_card s f).symm.trans (sameBin_card_eq s f)
  simpa only [hs', hpair, Finset.card_univ] using
    (sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun b : κ => ((s.filter (fun i => f i = b)).card : ℝ)))

variable [PseudoMetricSpace V]

                                                            
def closePairs (v : ι → V) (r : ℝ) : Finset (ι × ι) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ dist (v p.1) (v p.2) ≤ r)

name: close_pair_lower_bound
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ) (v : ι → V) (w : κ → V) (r : ℝ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, dist (v i) (w (f i)) ≤ r) : (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * ((closePairs v (2 * r)).card + (Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : repeatedPairs s f ⊆ closePairs v (2 * r) := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [repeatedPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp
    simp only [closePairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    refine ⟨hp.2.1, ?_⟩
    calc
      dist (v p.1) (v p.2) ≤ dist (v p.1) (w (f p.1)) +
          dist (w (f p.1)) (v p.2) := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ r + r := by
        apply add_le_add (h p.1 hp.1.1)
        rw [hp.2.2, dist_comm]
        exact h p.2 hp.1.2
      _ = 2 * r := by ring
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * ((repeatedPairs s f).card + (s.card : ℝ)) :=
      repeated_bin_lower_bound s f
    _ ≤ _ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_card hsub))
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.card_le_univ s))) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: normalized_close_pair_lower_bound
stmt: [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → κ) (v : ι → V) (w : κ → V) (r : ℝ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, dist (v i) (w (f i)) ≤ r) : ((s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι) ^ 2 / Fintype.card κ - 1 / Fintype.card ι ≤ (closePairs v (2 * r)).card / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ^ 2
body:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card κ := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hc := close_pair_lower_bound s f v w r h
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hn)).mpr
  field_simp
  nlinarith

end

variable {Ω ι κ V : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
variable [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] [PseudoMetricSpace V]

name: average_cover_forces_collision
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Ω → Finset ι) (f : Ω → ι → κ) (v : Ω → ι → V) (w : Ω → κ → V) (r : ℝ) (hcov : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i ∈ s x, dist (v x i) (w x (f x i)) ≤ r) (hm : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun x => dist (v x i) (v x j))) (hq : Measurable (fun x => ((s x).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι)) (hlarge : 10 * Fintype.card κ < Fintype.card ι) (havg : (19/20 : ℝ) < ∫ x, ((s x).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι ∂μ) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1 / (4 * (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)) ≤ μ.real {x | dist (v x i) (v x j) ≤ 2*r}
body:
:= by
  classical
  let n : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
  let k : ℝ := Fintype.card κ
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hk : 0 < k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hlarge' : 10*k < n := by dsimp [k, n]; exact_mod_cast hlarge
  let q : Ω → ℝ := fun x => (s x).card / n
  have hq0 (x) : 0 ≤ q x := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hn.le
  have hq1 (x) : q x ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hn).mpr
    dsimp [n]
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_univ (s x)
  have hiq : Integrable q μ := Integrable.of_bound hq.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hq0 x)]; exact hq1 x))
  have hiq2 : Integrable (fun x => (q x)^2) μ := Integrable.of_bound
    (hq.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable 1 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact pow_le_one₀ (hq0 x) (hq1 x)))
  have hsq : (19/20 : ℝ)^2 < ∫ x, (q x)^2 ∂μ := by
    have hv : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (q x-19/20)^2 ∂μ :=
      integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (q x - 19/20))
    have he : (fun x => (q x-19/20)^2) =
        (fun x => (q x)^2 - (19/10)*q x + (19/20)^2) := by funext x; ring
    have hsub : Integrable (fun x => (q x)^2 - (19/10)*q x) μ :=
      hiq2.sub (hiq.const_mul (19/10))
    rw [he, integral_add hsub (integrable_const ((19/20 : ℝ)^2)),
      integral_sub hiq2 (hiq.const_mul (19/10)), integral_const_mul] at hv
    simp only [integral_const, Measure.real, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one,
      smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at hv
    change 19/20 < ∫ x, q x ∂μ at havg
    linarith
  let a : (ι × ι) → Ω → ℝ := fun p x =>
    if p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ dist (v x p.1) (v x p.2) ≤ 2*r then 1 else 0
  have hma (p : ι × ι) : Measurable (a p) := by
    have hset : MeasurableSet {x | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ dist (v x p.1) (v x p.2) ≤ 2*r} := by
      by_cases h : p.1 = p.2
      · simp [h]
      · simpa [h] using
          (measurableSet_le (hm p.1 p.2) (measurable_const (a := 2*r)))
    exact measurable_const.ite hset measurable_const
  have hia (p : ι × ι) : Integrable (a p) μ := Integrable.of_bound
    (hma p).aestronglyMeasurable 1 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
      dsimp [a]; split_ifs <;> norm_num))
  have hcnt (x : Ω) : ((closePairs (v x) (2*r)).card : ℝ) = ∑ p, a p x := by
    simp only [closePairs, a, Finset.cast_card, Finset.sum_filter]
  have hic : Integrable (fun x => ((closePairs (v x) (2*r)).card : ℝ)/n^2) μ := by
    simp_rw [hcnt]
    exact (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun p _ => hia p)).div_const _
  have hlow := integral_mono_ae (μ := μ) ((hiq2.div_const k).sub (integrable_const (1/n))) hic
    (hcov.mono (fun x hx =>
      normalized_close_pair_lower_bound (s x) (f x) (v x) (w x) r hx))
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hlow
  rw [integral_sub (hiq2.div_const k) (integrable_const (1/n)), integral_div,
    integral_const, Measure.real, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul] at hlow
  have hstrict : 1/(4*k) < (∫ x, (q x)^2 ∂μ)/k - 1/n := by
    have hi : 1/n < 1/(10*k) := one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity) hlarge'
    have hsq' := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hk).mpr hsq
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ (le_of_lt (sub_lt_sub hsq' hi))
    field_simp
    norm_num
  by_contra hh
  push Not at hh
  have hailt (p : ι × ι) : ∫ x, a p x ∂μ < 1/(4*k) := by
    by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2
    · simp only [a, hp, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and, ↓reduceIte, integral_zero]
      positivity
    · have he : a p = Set.indicator {x | dist (v x p.1) (v x p.2) ≤ 2*r}
          (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
        funext x
        simp [a, hp, Set.indicator_apply]
      rw [he, integral_indicator (measurableSet_le (hm p.1 p.2) measurable_const)]
      simpa only [setIntegral_const, Measure.real, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hh p.1 p.2 hp
  have hiupper : (∫ x, ((closePairs (v x) (2*r)).card : ℝ)/n^2 ∂μ) < 1/(4*k) := by
    simp_rw [hcnt]
    rw [integral_div, integral_finsetSum _ (fun p _ => hia p)]
    have hsum := Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (ι × ι)))
      Finset.univ_nonempty (fun p _ => hailt p)
    have hnum : (∑ _p : ι × ι, 1/(4*k)) = n^2/(4*k) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, nsmul_eq_mul,
        Nat.cast_mul, n, pow_two, mul_div_assoc]
      ring
    rw [hnum] at hsum
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hn)).mpr
    convert hsum using 1
    ring
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hstrict.le.trans hlow)) hiupper

end EuclideanFiveColor.PhaseCollision

variable {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]

                                                                            
def goodFraction (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : Ω) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i x < t)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Nonempty ι] in

name: goodFraction_eq_sum
stmt: (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : Ω) : goodFraction e t x = (∑ i, if e i x < t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / Fintype.card ι
body:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [goodFraction, Finset.cast_card, Finset.sum_filter]

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: measurable_goodFraction
stmt: (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (he : ∀ i, Measurable (e i)) : Measurable (goodFraction e t)
body:
:= by
  classical
  change Measurable (fun x => goodFraction e t x)
  simp_rw [goodFraction_eq_sum]
  exact (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => measurable_const.ite
    (measurableSet_lt (he i) measurable_const) measurable_const)).div_const _

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Nonempty ι] in

name: goodFraction_nonneg
stmt: (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : Ω) : 0 ≤ goodFraction e t x
body:
:= by unfold goodFraction; positivity

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] in

name: goodFraction_le_one
stmt: (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : Ω) : goodFraction e t x ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  classical
  apply (div_le_one (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos)).mpr
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_univ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i x < t))

name: integrable_goodFraction
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (he : ∀ i, Measurable (e i)) : Integrable (goodFraction e t) μ
body:
:=
  Integrable.of_bound (measurable_goodFraction e t he).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (goodFraction_nonneg e t x)]
      exact goodFraction_le_one e t x)

name: average_goodFraction
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (e : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (he : ∀ i, Measurable (e i)) (hi : ∀ i, Integrable (e i) μ) (hn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i x) (havg : ∀ i, ∫ x, e i x ∂μ < t/20) : (19/20 : ℝ) < ∫ x, goodFraction e t x ∂μ
body:
:= by
  classical
  let n : ℝ := Fintype.card ι
  have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      1 - (∑ i, e i x) / (n*t) ≤ goodFraction e t x := by
    filter_upwards [hn] with x hx
    have hi' (i) : 1 - e i x / t ≤ if e i x < t then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
      split_ifs with h
      · have : 0 ≤ e i x / t := div_nonneg (hx i) ht.le
        linarith
      · have : 1 ≤ e i x / t := (le_div_iff₀ ht).mpr (by simpa using le_of_not_gt h)
        linarith
    have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hi' i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, ← Finset.sum_div] at hs
    rw [goodFraction_eq_sum]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hnpos).mpr
    have heq : (1 - (∑ i, e i x)/(n*t))*n = n - (∑ i, e i x)/t := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact hs
  have hil : Integrable (fun x => 1 - (∑ i, e i x)/(n*t)) μ :=
    (integrable_const 1).sub ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)).div_const _)
  have hlow := integral_mono_ae hil (integrable_goodFraction μ e t he) hpoint
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const 1) ((integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)).div_const _),
    integral_div, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)] at hlow
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at hlow
  have hu := Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι))
    Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i _ => havg i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at hu
  have hr : (∑ i, ∫ x, e i x ∂μ) / (n*t) < 1/20 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hnpos ht)).mpr
    convert hu using 1
    dsimp [n]
    ring
  linarith

end EuclideanFiveColor.AverageErrors

open MeasureTheory

variable {Ω ι κ V : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
variable [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] [PseudoMetricSpace V]

name: average_exists_cover_forces_collision
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Ω → Finset ι) (v : Ω → ι → V) (w : Ω → κ → V) (r : ℝ) (hcov : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i ∈ s x, ∃ j, dist (v x i) (w x j) ≤ r) (hm : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun x => dist (v x i) (v x j))) (hq : Measurable (fun x => ((s x).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι)) (hlarge : 10 * Fintype.card κ < Fintype.card ι) (havg : (19/20 : ℝ) < ∫ x, ((s x).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card ι ∂μ) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1 / (4 * (Fintype.card κ : ℝ)) ≤ μ.real {x | dist (v x i) (v x j) ≤ 2*r}
body:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Ω → ι → κ := fun x i =>
    if h : ∃ j, dist (v x i) (w x j) ≤ r then h.choose else Classical.choice inferInstance
  apply average_cover_forces_collision μ s f v w r _ hm hq hlarge havg
  filter_upwards [hcov] with x hx
  intro i hi
  dsimp [f]
  rw [dite_eq_left (hx i hi)]
  exact (hx i hi).choose_spec

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ]
  [PseudoMetricSpace V] in

name: circle_product_dist
stmt: (a b c d : Circle) : dist ((a : ℂ)*(b : ℂ)) ((c : ℂ)*(d : ℂ)) ≤ dist (a : ℂ) (c : ℂ) + dist (b : ℂ) (d : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  simp only [dist_eq_norm]
  have he : (a : ℂ)*(b : ℂ)-(c : ℂ)*(d : ℂ) =
      ((a : ℂ)-(c : ℂ))*(b : ℂ) + (c : ℂ)*((b : ℂ)-(d : ℂ)) := by ring
  rw [he]
  simpa only [norm_mul, Circle.norm_coe, mul_one, one_mul] using
    norm_add_le (((a : ℂ)-(c : ℂ))*(b : ℂ)) ((c : ℂ)*((b : ℂ)-(d : ℂ)))

end EuclideanFiveColor.PhaseCollision

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.EncodedCollision
local instance : MeasurableSpace Circle := borel Circle
local instance : BorelSpace Circle := ⟨rfl⟩
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators
open PhaseEncoding AverageErrors PhaseCollision
variable {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]

name: collision_from_close_encodings
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (zp zm : Ω → ι → Fin m → Circle) (ap am : ι → Ω → Circle) (j₀ : ι) (hap : ∀ j, Measurable (ap j)) (ham : ∀ j, Measurable (am j)) (hDp : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀)))) (hDm : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀)))) (hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, (∃ r, ap j x = zp x j r) ∧ (∃ r, am j x = zm x j r)) (hi : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀))^2 + dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀))^2) μ) (he : ∀ j, (∫ x, dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀))^2 + dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀))^2 ∂μ) < (ρ^m / m)^2 / 20) (hlarge : 10 * m^2 < Fintype.card ι) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2) ≤ μ.real {x | dist ((ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)) ((ap j x : ℂ)*(am j x : ℂ)) ≤ 4*ρ}
body:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : ℝ := ρ^m / m
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos (pow_pos hρ _) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  let e : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun j x =>
    dist (encoding (zp x j)) (encoding (zp x j₀))^2 +
    dist (encoding (zm x j)) (encoding (zm x j₀))^2
  have hem (i) : Measurable (e i) :=
    (hDp i |>.pow_const 2).add (hDm i |>.pow_const 2)
  have hen (x) (i) : 0 ≤ e i x := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have havg := average_goodFraction μ e (δ^2) (sq_pos_of_pos hδ) hem hi
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hen) he
  let s : Ω → Finset ι := fun x => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i x < δ^2)
  let v : Ω → ι → ℂ := fun x i => (ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)
  let w : Ω → (Fin m × Fin m) → ℂ := fun x p =>
    (zp x j₀ p.1 : ℂ)*(zm x j₀ p.2 : ℂ)
  have hcover : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i ∈ s x, ∃ p, dist (v x i) (w x p) ≤ 2*ρ := by
    filter_upwards [hmem] with x hx
    intro i hi'
    have hie : e i x < δ^2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
    have hp : dist (encoding (zp x i)) (encoding (zp x j₀)) < δ := by
      dsimp [e] at hie
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist (encoding (zm x i)) (encoding (zm x j₀))), dist_nonneg
        (x := encoding (zp x i)) (y := encoding (zp x j₀))]
    have hm' : dist (encoding (zm x i)) (encoding (zm x j₀)) < δ := by
      dsimp [e] at hie
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist (encoding (zp x i)) (encoding (zp x j₀))), dist_nonneg
        (x := encoding (zm x i)) (y := encoding (zm x j₀))]
    obtain ⟨⟨rp, hrp⟩, ⟨rm, hrm⟩⟩ := hx i
    obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ := close_encoding_each_phase hm (zp x i) (zp x j₀) hρ hp rp
    obtain ⟨cm, hcm⟩ := close_encoding_each_phase hm (zm x i) (zm x j₀) hρ hm' rm
    refine ⟨(cp, cm), ?_⟩
    dsimp [v, w]
    rw [hrp, hrm]
    exact (circle_product_dist _ _ _ _).trans (by linarith)
  let : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hm⟩⟩
  have hv' (i j) : Measurable (fun x => dist (v x i) (v x j)) := by
    have hco : Continuous (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) := continuous_subtype_val
    have hvm (i) : Measurable (fun x => v x i) :=
      (hco.measurable.comp (hap i)).mul (hco.measurable.comp (ham i))
    exact (hvm i).dist (hvm j)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hc⟩ := average_exists_cover_forces_collision μ s v w (2*ρ)
    hcover hv' (measurable_goodFraction e (δ^2) hem)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, pow_two] using hlarge) havg
  refine ⟨i, j, hij, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_mul, pow_two,
    v, show 2*(2*ρ)=4*ρ by ring] using hc

name: collision_from_measurable_encodings
stmt: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (zp zm : Ω → ι → Fin m → Circle) (ap am : ι → Ω → Circle) (j₀ : ι) (Hp Hm : ι → Ω → Fin m → ℂ) (henc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, encoding (zp x j) = Hp j x ∧ encoding (zm x j) = Hm j x) (hap : ∀ j, Measurable (ap j)) (ham : ∀ j, Measurable (am j)) (hDp : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x))) (hDm : ∀ j, Measurable (fun x => dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x))) (hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ j, (∃ r, ap j x = zp x j r) ∧ (∃ r, am j x = zm x j r)) (hi : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x)^2 + dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x)^2) μ) (he : ∀ j, (∫ x, dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x)^2 + dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x)^2 ∂μ) < (ρ^m / m)^2 / 20) (hlarge : 10 * m^2 < Fintype.card ι) : ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2) ≤ μ.real {x | dist ((ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)) ((ap j x : ℂ)*(am j x : ℂ)) ≤ 4*ρ}
body:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : ℝ := ρ^m / m
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos (pow_pos hρ _) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  let e : ι → Ω → ℝ := fun j x =>
    dist (Hp j x) (Hp j₀ x)^2 +
    dist (Hm j x) (Hm j₀ x)^2
  have hem (i) : Measurable (e i) :=
    (hDp i |>.pow_const 2).add (hDm i |>.pow_const 2)
  have hen (x) (i) : 0 ≤ e i x := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have havg := average_goodFraction μ e (δ^2) (sq_pos_of_pos hδ) hem hi
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hen) he
  let s : Ω → Finset ι := fun x => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i x < δ^2)
  let v : Ω → ι → ℂ := fun x i => (ap i x : ℂ)*(am i x : ℂ)
  let w : Ω → (Fin m × Fin m) → ℂ := fun x p =>
    (zp x j₀ p.1 : ℂ)*(zm x j₀ p.2 : ℂ)
  have hcover : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i ∈ s x, ∃ p, dist (v x i) (w x p) ≤ 2*ρ := by
    filter_upwards [hmem, henc] with x hx hxe
    intro i hi'
    have hie : e i x < δ^2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
    have hp : dist (Hp i x) (Hp j₀ x) < δ := by
      dsimp [e] at hie
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist (Hm i x) (Hm j₀ x)), dist_nonneg
        (x := Hp i x) (y := Hp j₀ x)]
    have hm' : dist (Hm i x) (Hm j₀ x) < δ := by
      dsimp [e] at hie
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist (Hp i x) (Hp j₀ x)), dist_nonneg
        (x := Hm i x) (y := Hm j₀ x)]
    have hp' : dist (encoding (zp x i)) (encoding (zp x j₀)) < δ := by
      rw [(hxe i).1, (hxe j₀).1]; exact hp
    have hm'' : dist (encoding (zm x i)) (encoding (zm x j₀)) < δ := by
      rw [(hxe i).2, (hxe j₀).2]; exact hm'
    obtain ⟨⟨rp, hrp⟩, ⟨rm, hrm⟩⟩ := hx i
    obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ := close_encoding_each_phase hm (zp x i) (zp x j₀) hρ hp' rp
    obtain ⟨cm, hcm⟩ := close_encoding_each_phase hm (zm x i) (zm x j₀) hρ hm'' rm
    refine ⟨(cp, cm), ?_⟩
    dsimp [v, w]
    rw [hrp, hrm]
    exact (circle_product_dist _ _ _ _).trans (by linarith)
  let : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hm⟩⟩
  have hv' (i j) : Measurable (fun x => dist (v x i) (v x j)) := by
    have hco : Continuous (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) := continuous_subtype_val
    have hvm (i) : Measurable (fun x => v x i) :=
      (hco.measurable.comp (hap i)).mul (hco.measurable.comp (ham i))
    exact (hvm i).dist (hvm j)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hc⟩ := average_exists_cover_forces_collision μ s v w (2*ρ)
    hcover hv' (measurable_goodFraction e (δ^2) hem)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, pow_two] using hlarge) havg
  refine ⟨i, j, hij, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_mul, pow_two,
    v, show 2*(2*ρ)=4*ρ by ring] using hc

end EuclideanFiveColor.EncodedCollision

end

name: card_phases
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) : (phases z).card = m
body:
:= by
  simp [phases]

name: elem_zero
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) : elem z 0 = 1
body:
:= by
  simp [elem, Multiset.esymm]

name: elem_eq_sum
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) (n : ℕ) : elem z n = ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).powersetCard n, ∏ i ∈ t, (z i : ℂ)
body:
:=
  Finset.esymm_map_val _ _ n

name: continuous_encoding
stmt: {m : ℕ} : Continuous (encoding (m := m))
body:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  simp only [encoding, elem_eq_sum]
  fun_prop

name: polynomial_expansion
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) : phasePolynomial z = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1) ^ n * (C (elem z n) * X ^ (m - n))
body:
:= by
  have he : phasePolynomial z = ((phases z).map (fun t => X - C t)).prod := by
    rw [phasePolynomial, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod]
    simp only [phases, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  rw [he, Multiset.prod_X_sub_X_eq_sum_esymm, card_phases]
  rfl

name: eval_at_phase
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) (i : Fin m) : (phasePolynomial z).eval (z i : ℂ) = 0
body:
:= by
  rw [phasePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
  simp

name: eval_expansion
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) (a : ℂ) : (phasePolynomial z).eval a = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : ℂ) ^ n * (elem z n * a ^ (m - n))
body:
:= by
  rw [polynomial_expansion, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  simp

name: eval_difference
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z w : Fin m → Circle) (a : ℂ) : (phasePolynomial w).eval a - (phasePolynomial z).eval a = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℂ) ^ (n+1) * ((elem w (n+1) - elem z (n+1)) * a ^ (m-(n+1)))
body:
:= by
  rw [eval_expansion, eval_expansion, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [pow_zero, elem_zero, one_mul, sub_self, add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n _
  ring

name: eval_difference_bound
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z w : Fin m → Circle) (a : Circle) : ‖(phasePolynomial w).eval (a : ℂ) - (phasePolynomial z).eval (a : ℂ)‖ ≤ m * dist (encoding z) (encoding w)
body:
:= by
  rw [eval_difference]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
      ‖(-1 : ℂ) ^ (n+1) * ((elem w (n+1) - elem z (n+1)) * (a : ℂ) ^ (m-(n+1)))‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range m, dist (encoding z) (encoding w) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, Circle.norm_coe,
        one_mul, mul_one]
      have h := dist_le_pi_dist (encoding z) (encoding w) ⟨n, Finset.mem_range.mp hn⟩
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm, encoding, norm_sub_rev] using h
    _ = _ := by simp

name: close_encoding_each_phase
stmt: {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (z w : Fin m → Circle) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hzw : dist (encoding z) (encoding w) < ρ ^ m / m) : ∀ i, ∃ j, dist (z i : ℂ) (w j : ℂ) < ρ
body:
:= by
  intro i
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hl : ρ ^ m ≤ ‖(phasePolynomial w).eval (z i : ℂ)‖ := by
    rw [phasePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [norm_prod]
    calc
      ρ ^ m = ∏ _j : Fin m, ρ := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => hρ.le) (fun j _ => by
        simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using h j)
  have hu := eval_difference_bound z w (z i)
  rw [eval_at_phase, sub_zero] at hu
  have hm' : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hb : (m : ℝ) * dist (encoding z) (encoding w) < ρ ^ m := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (lt_div_iff₀ hm').mp hzw
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hl.trans hu)) hb

open scoped BigOperators

                                                                    
def fromPowers (p : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  match n with
  | 0 => 1
  | k + 1 => (k + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹ * (-1) ^ (k + 2) *
      ∑ i : Fin (k + 1), (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * fromPowers p i * p (k + 1 - i)
termination_by n
decreasing_by
  exact i.isLt

name: measurable_fromPowers
stmt: {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] (p : Y → ℕ → ℂ) (hp : ∀ n, Measurable (fun y => p y n)) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (fun y => fromPowers (p y) n)
body:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [fromPowers]; exact measurable_const
    | succ k =>
      simp only [fromPowers]
      apply Measurable.const_mul
      apply Finset.measurable_sum
      intro i _
      exact (Measurable.const_mul (ih i i.isLt) _).mul (hp _)

name: newton_elem
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) (k : ℕ) : (k : ℂ) * elem z k = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * ∑ a ∈ (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k).filter (fun a => a.1 < k), (-1) ^ a.1 * elem z a.1 * (∑ i, (z i : ℂ) ^ a.2)
body:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => (z i : ℂ)))
    (MvPolynomial.mul_esymm_eq_sum (Fin m) ℂ k)
  simpa only [map_mul, map_natCast, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, map_sum,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_esymm_eq_multiset_esymm, MvPolynomial.psum, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
    elem, phases] using h

name: filtered_antidiagonal_sum
stmt: (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : (∑ a ∈ (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (k+1)).filter (fun a => a.1 < k+1), f a.1 a.2) = ∑ i : Fin (k+1), f i (k+1-i)
body:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => f i (k+1-i)) (k+1), Finset.sum_filter, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk,
    Finset.sum_range_succ]
  simp only [lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp [Finset.mem_range.mp hi]

name: fromPowers_eq_elem
stmt: {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → Circle) (n : ℕ) : fromPowers (fun k => ∑ i, (z i : ℂ) ^ k) n = elem z n
body:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [fromPowers]
    | succ k =>
      rw [fromPowers]
      have hs : (∑ i : Fin (k+1), (-1 : ℂ)^(i : ℕ) *
          fromPowers (fun n => ∑ j, (z j : ℂ)^n) i * (∑ j, (z j : ℂ)^(k+1-i))) =
          ∑ i : Fin (k+1), (-1 : ℂ)^(i : ℕ) * elem z i *
            (∑ j, (z j : ℂ)^(k+1-i)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [ih i i.isLt]
      rw [hs, mul_assoc, ← filtered_antidiagonal_sum
        (fun i j => (-1 : ℂ)^i * elem z i * (∑ l, (z l : ℂ)^j)) k]
      have hn := newton_elem z (k+1)
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hn
      rw [← hn, inv_mul_cancel_left₀]
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)

end

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

variable {Y G : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace G]

                                                                               
def kernelEncoding (β : Kernel Y G) (χ : G → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (y : Y) : Fin m → ℂ :=
  fun i => fromPowers (fun n => (m : ℂ) * ∫ d, χ d ^ n ∂β y) (i.val + 1)

name: measurable_kernelEncoding
stmt: (β : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel β] (χ : G → ℂ) (hχ : Measurable χ) (m : ℕ) : Measurable (kernelEncoding β χ m)
body:
:= by
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i
  apply measurable_fromPowers
  intro n
  exact (((hχ.pow_const n).stronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel).measurable).const_mul _

name: moments_uniform_list
stmt: [MeasurableSingletonClass G] (χ : G → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (g : Fin m → G) (μ : Measure G) (hμ : μ = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i)) (n : ℕ) : (m : ℂ) * (∫ d, χ d ^ n ∂μ) = ∑ i, χ (g i) ^ n
body:
:= by
  classical
  rw [hμ, integral_smul_measure, integral_finsetSum_measure]
  · simp only [integral_dirac, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
      Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀, one_mul]
    exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  · intro i _
    exact integrable_dirac (by simp)

name: kernelEncoding_eq_encoding
stmt: [MeasurableSingletonClass G] (β : Kernel Y G) (χ : G → Circle) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (y : Y) (g : Fin m → G) (hβ : β y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i)) : kernelEncoding β (fun d => (χ d : ℂ)) m y = encoding (fun i => χ (g i))
body:
:= by
  have hp : (fun n => (m : ℂ) * ∫ d, (χ d : ℂ)^n ∂β y) =
      fun n => ∑ i, (χ (g i) : ℂ)^n := by
    funext n
    exact moments_uniform_list (fun d => (χ d : ℂ)) m hm g (β y) hβ n
  funext i
  change fromPowers _ (i.val+1) = elem _ (i.val+1)
  rw [hp]
  exact fromPowers_eq_elem (fun i => χ (g i)) (i.val+1)

end

name: exists_encoding_bound
stmt: (m : ℕ) : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z : Fin m → Circle, ‖encoding z‖ ≤ B
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (isCompact_range (continuous_encoding (m := m))).isBounded.exists_norm_le
  exact ⟨B, fun z => hB _ ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor.PhaseEncoding

name: equal_moduli_quadratic
body:
:= by
  have hu : (u : ℂ) * conj (u : ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Circle.normSq_coe, Complex.ofReal_one]
  have hreal : (u : ℂ).re^2 + (u : ℂ).im^2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Complex.normSq_apply, sq] using Circle.normSq_coe u
  have hleft : (A : ℂ) - B*(u : ℂ)^2 =
      (u : ℂ) * ((A : ℂ)*conj (u : ℂ) - B*(u : ℂ)) := by
    calc
      _ = A*((u : ℂ)*conj (u : ℂ)) - B*(u : ℂ)^2 := by rw [hu, mul_one]
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hright : -(L : ℂ) + (A-B : ℝ)*(u : ℂ) + L*(u : ℂ)^2 =
      (u : ℂ) * (((A-B : ℝ) : ℂ) + L*((u : ℂ)-conj (u : ℂ))) := by
    calc
      _ = -L*((u : ℂ)*conj (u : ℂ)) + (A-B : ℝ)*(u : ℂ) + L*(u : ℂ)^2 := by rw [hu, mul_one]
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [hleft, hright, norm_mul, norm_mul, Circle.norm_coe, one_mul, one_mul]
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
  nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (A-B), mul_self_nonneg (A+B),
    congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (A-B)^2*x) hreal,
    congrArg (fun x : ℝ => 4*x*(u : ℂ).im^2) hL]
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter EuclideanFiveColor

namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K D μ]
  (q : D → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
  [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]
  (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ d ∂μ, q (k • d) = k • q d)
  [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]

name: projectedMass_pair_mean
stmt: [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)] (M : Amenable.Mean Rot) (a b : E) : M.map (Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const (G := Rot) (char a) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) (char b)))) = projectedMass μ q a * projectedMass μ q b
body:
:= by
  exact conditional_pair_energy μ q hq (fun g : Rot => hqcov (rotMul g)) M
    (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) (rot_zsmul_surjective 2 (by decide)) (char a) (char b)

name: kCoeff_scale_two
stmt: (g : Rot) : kCoeff (rotMul ((scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) g)) = kCoeff (rotMul g)^2
body:
:= by
  change kCoeff ((rotMul g)^2) = _
  simp only [pow_two, kCoeff_mul]

name: kCoeff_scale_one
stmt: (g : Rot) : kCoeff (rotMul ((scaleHom (G := Rot) 1) g)) = kCoeff (rotMul g)
body:
:= by
  change kCoeff (rotMul ((1:ℤ) • g)) = _
  rw [one_zsmul]

name: char_two_term
stmt: (a b : E) (g : Rot) : (Family.const (G := Rot) (char a) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) (char b)) g = char (a + kCoeff (rotMul g)^2*b)
body:
:= by
  simp only [Family.mul_apply, Family.const_apply, Family.orbit_apply, char_act,
    kCoeff_scale_two, char_add]

name: char_three_term
stmt: (a b c : E) (g : Rot) : (Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 0) (char a) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 1) (char b) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) (char c)) g = char (a+kCoeff (rotMul g)*b+kCoeff (rotMul g)^2*c)
body:
:= by
  simp only [Family.mul_apply, Family.orbit_apply, char_act, kCoeff_scale_one, kCoeff_scale_two,
    char_add]
  congr 2
  change char (kCoeff (rotMul ((0:ℤ) • g))*a) = char a
  simp only [zero_zsmul]
  change char (1*a) = char a
  rw [one_mul]

include hq hqcov in

name: quadratic_mass_inequality
stmt: (a b l h k : E) (hn : ∀ u : K, ‖((a + kCoeff u^2*b : E) : ℂ)‖ = ‖((l+kCoeff u*h+kCoeff u^2*k : E) : ℂ)‖) : projectedMass μ q a * projectedMass μ q b ≤ projectedMass μ q h
body:
:= by
  let : ErgodicVAdd Rot Y (μ.map q) := factor_ergodic μ q hq (fun g : Rot => hqcov (rotMul g))
  let M : Amenable.Mean Rot := MovingMean.toMean (fun _ => 0)
  have he : Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q
      (Family.const (G := Rot) (char a) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) (char b))) =
      Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q
        (Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 0) (char l) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 1) (char h) *
          Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2) (char k))) := by
    ext g
    simp only [Family.energy_apply, Family.conditional_apply, char_two_term, char_three_term]
    exact projectedMass_radial μ q hq hqcov (hn (rotMul g))
  rw [← projectedMass_pair_mean μ q hq hqcov M a b, he,
    conditional_integer_triple_energy μ q hq (fun g : Rot => hqcov (rotMul g)) rot_zsmul_surjective]
  calc
    _ ≤ M.map (BoundedContinuousFunction.const Rot (projectedMass μ q h)) := by
      apply M.mono
      intro g
      simp only [Family.energy_apply, Family.mul_apply, Family.orbit_apply,
        BoundedContinuousFunction.const_apply]
      have h1 := l2_mul_norm_le (μ.map q)
        (act (scaleHom (G := Rot) 0 g) (conditional μ q (char l)) * act (scaleHom (G := Rot) 1 g) (conditional μ q (char h)))
        (act (scaleHom (G := Rot) 2 g) (conditional μ q (char k)))
        (fun y => projected_char_bound μ q k ((scaleHom (G := Rot) 2 g) +ᵥ y))
      have h2 := l2_norm_mul_le (μ.map q)
        (act (scaleHom (G := Rot) 0 g) (conditional μ q (char l))) (act (scaleHom (G := Rot) 1 g) (conditional μ q (char h)))
        (fun y => projected_char_bound μ q l ((scaleHom (G := Rot) 0 g) +ᵥ y))
      simp only [one_mul, l2_act, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] at h1 h2
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h1.trans h2) 2
    _ = _ := M.map_const _
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped ENNReal NNReal ComplexConjugate BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

def sqrtF (a : F) : F := ⟨Real.sqrt a, mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr (by
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ (a : ℝ)
  · apply IsAlgebraic.of_pow (n := 2) (by decide)
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt ha]
    exact mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp a.property
  · rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge ha)]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)⟩

name: sqrtF_sq
stmt: (a : F) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : sqrtF a ^ 2 = a
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Real.sq_sqrt ha

name: norm_ofF
body:
:= by
  change ‖((a : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = _
  rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]

variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K D μ]
  (q : D → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
  [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]
  (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ d ∂μ, q (k • d) = k • q d)
  [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]
def massReal (a : F) : ℝ := projectedMass μ q (ofF a)
include hq hqcov in
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)] in

name: projectedMass_neg
stmt: (a : E) : projectedMass μ q (-a) = projectedMass μ q a
body:
:= by
  apply projectedMass_radial μ q hq hqcov
  exact norm_neg (a : ℂ)
include hq hqcov in
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)] in

name: massReal_abs
stmt: (a : F) : massReal μ q |a| = massReal μ q a
body:
:= by
  apply projectedMass_radial μ q hq hqcov
  rw [norm_ofF, norm_ofF]
  change abs (abs (a : ℝ)) = abs (a : ℝ)
  exact abs_abs _
include hq hqcov in

name: massReal_difference
stmt: (A B : F) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) : massReal μ q A * massReal μ q B ≤ massReal μ q |A-B|
body:
:= by
  let l := sqrtF (A*B)
  have hl : (l : ℝ)^2 = (A : ℝ)*(B : ℝ) := by
    exact congrArg (fun x : F => (x : ℝ)) (sqrtF_sq (A*B) (mul_nonneg hA hB))
  have he := quadratic_mass_inequality μ q hq hqcov (ofF A) (-ofF B) (-ofF l) (ofF (A-B)) (ofF l) (fun u => by
    have hh := equal_moduli_quadratic (A : ℝ) (B : ℝ) (l : ℝ) hl u.val
    convert hh using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> simp only [map_sub, ofF, RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk,
      OneHom.coe_mk, kCoeff] <;> push_cast <;> ring)
  rw [projectedMass_neg μ q hq hqcov] at he
  rw [massReal_abs μ q hq hqcov]
  exact he
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

open scoped ComplexConjugate

name: reF_sum
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (z : ι → E) : reF (∑ i ∈ s,z i) = ∑ i ∈ s,reF (z i)
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [reF]

name: reF_zsmul
stmt: (a : ℤ) (z : E) : reF (a • z) = a • reF z
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [reF, zsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  simp

name: reF_nsmul
stmt: (a : ℕ) (z : E) : reF (a • z) = a • reF z
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [reF,nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  simp

name: selected_mass_bound
stmt: (m : F → ℝ) (hm0 : m 0 = 1) (hd : ∀ a b : F, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → m a*m b ≤ m |a-b|) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (r : F) (hr : 0 < r) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n → E) (a b : Fin n → ℤ) (D M : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (hM : 0 < M) (ha : (∑ j, a j • k j) = D • (1:E)) (hb : (∑ j, b j • k j) = D • imagUnit) (hab : (∑ j, ((a j).natAbs+(b j).natAbs)) ≤ M) (v : E) (hv : ‖(v:ℂ)‖ = 1) (hsmall : |reF v| < (M:F)⁻¹) (hgood : ∀ j, c ≤ m |2*r*reF (k j*v)|) : c^(4*M) ≤ m |2*r*D*reF v|
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hac : (∑ j, a j • (k j:ℂ)) = D • (1:ℂ) := by
    have he := congrArg (fun z : E => (z:ℂ)) ha
    simpa using he
  have hbc : (∑ j, b j • (k j:ℂ)) = D • Complex.I := by
    have he := congrArg (fun z : E => (z:ℂ)) hb
    simpa [imagUnit] using he
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := selection_transverse (fun j => (k j:ℂ)) a b D M hD hac hbc hab (v:ℂ) hv
  have hmax (j : Fin n) : |reF (k j*v)| ≤ |reF (k i*v)| := by
    exact_mod_cast (hi j).1
  have htrans : (D:F) ≤ (M:F)*|reF (k i*v)| := by exact_mod_cast (hi i).2
  have hDp : (0:F) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hMp : (0:F) < M := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hM
  have hip : 0 < |reF (k i*v)| := by nlinarith
  let x := fun j => 2*r*reF (k j*v)
  let p := |x i|
  have hx (j : Fin n) : |x j| = 2*r*|reF (k j*v)| := by
    dsimp [x]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2*r)]
  have hp : 0 < p := by dsimp [p]; rw [hx]; positivity
  have hsum : (∑ j, a j • x j) = 2*r*D*reF v := by
    have he := congrArg reF (congrArg (fun z : E => z*v) ha)
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul,reF_sum,smul_mul_assoc,reF_zsmul,one_mul,reF_nsmul] at he
    calc
      (∑ j, a j • x j) = 2*r * ∑ j, a j • reF (k j*v) := by
        simp only [x,Finset.mul_sum,zsmul_eq_mul]; congr 1; ext j; ring_nf
      _ = 2*r*D*reF v := by rw [he,nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hz : |∑ j, a j • x j| < p := by
    rw [hsum,abs_mul,abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:F) < 2*r*D)]
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [hx]
    have hvM : (M:F)*|reF v| < 1 := by
      have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsmall hMp
      rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ hMp.ne'] at hh
    have ht : (D:F)*|reF v| < |reF (k i*v)| := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htrans (abs_nonneg (reF v))
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht (by positivity : (0:F) < 2*r)]
  have hcap := CappedResidues.integer_abs_cap m hm0 hd c hc0 hc1 hp
    (by simpa only [CappedResidues.Good,p,pow_one] using hgood i)
    Finset.univ a x (fun j _ => ⟨by dsimp only [p]; rw [hx,hx]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmax j) (by positivity),
      by simpa only [CappedResidues.Good,pow_one] using hgood j⟩) hz
  have hlen : ∑ j, (a j).natAbs ≤ M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j, ((a j).natAbs+(b j).natAbs) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.le_add_right _ _)
      _ ≤ M := hab
  have hpow : c^(4*M) ≤ c^(4*∑ j,(a j).natAbs) :=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one hc0 hc1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hlen)
  exact hpow.trans (by simpa only [CappedResidues.Good,hsum] using hcap)
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open EuclideanFiveColor EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic

name: circle_realPart
body:
:= by
  let y := sqrtF (1-t^2)
  have hy : y^2 = 1-t^2 := sqrtF_sq _ (by have hh := sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg t) zero_le_one |>.mpr ht; nlinarith [sq_abs t])
  let v := ofF t + imagUnit * ofF y
  have hv : (v:ℂ) = (t:ℝ) + Complex.I*(y:ℝ) := rfl
  refine ⟨v,?_,?_⟩
  · have hh : ‖(v:ℂ)‖^2 = 1 := by
      rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,hv]
      simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
        zero_mul,one_mul,mul_zero,sub_zero,add_zero,zero_add]
      have hyc : (y:ℝ)^2 = 1-(t:ℝ)^2 := by exact_mod_cast hy
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (v:ℂ)]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change (v:ℂ).re = (t:ℝ)
    simp [hv]

name: cover_mass_positive
stmt: (m : F → ℝ) (hm0 : m 0 = 1) (hd : ∀ a b : F, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → m a*m b ≤ m |a-b|) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (r : F) (hr : 0 < r) (Q : Finset E) (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, ‖(q:ℂ)‖ = 1) (hcover : ∀ v : E, ‖(v:ℂ)‖ = 1 → ∃ q ∈ Q, c ≤ m |2*r*reF (q*v)|) : ∃ δ : F, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ s : F, 0 < s → s < δ → ε ≤ m s
body:
:= by
  classical
  let A : ℂ → Prop := fun w => ∃ z : E, (z:ℂ) = w ∧ c ≤ m |2*r*reF z|
  have hQN : ∀ q ∈ Q.image (fun z : E => (z:ℂ)), ‖q‖ = 1 := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    exact hQ z hz
  have hQA : ∀ q ∈ Q.image (fun z : E => (z:ℂ)), IsAlgebraic ℚ q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    exact mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp z.property
  have hA : ∀ v : ℂ, ‖v‖ = 1 → IsAlgebraic ℚ v → ∃ q ∈ Q.image (fun z : E => (z:ℂ)), A (q*v) := by
    intro v hv hva
    let v' : E := ⟨v,mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr hva⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hgood⟩ := hcover v' hv
    exact ⟨q,Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩,q*v',rfl,hgood⟩
  obtain ⟨D,M,hD,hM,hsel⟩ := uniform_selection _ hQN hQA A hA
  have hDp : (0:F) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hMp : (0:F) < M := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hM
  let δ : F := 2*r*D/(M+1)
  refine ⟨δ,by dsimp [δ]; positivity,c^(4*M),pow_pos hc0 _,pow_le_one₀ hc0.le hc1,?_⟩
  intro s hs hsδ
  let t := s/(2*r*D)
  have ht : 0 < t := div_pos hs (by positivity)
  have htM : t < ((M:F)+1)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [t,δ] at *
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:F) < 2*r*D)).mpr
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using hsδ
  have ht1 : |t| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos ht]
    have hh : ((M:F)+1)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
    exact htM.le.trans hh
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hvt⟩ := circle_realPart t ht1
  obtain ⟨n,k,a,b,hkg,ha,hb,hab⟩ := hsel (v:ℂ) hv (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp v.property)
  let k' : Fin n → E := fun j => ⟨k j,mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr (hkg j).2.1⟩
  have ha' : (∑ j, a j • k' j) = D • (1:E) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [k'] using ha
  have hb' : (∑ j, b j • k' j) = D • imagUnit := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [k',imagUnit] using hb
  have hgood (j : Fin n) : c ≤ m |2*r*reF (k' j*v)| := by
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hg⟩ := (hkg j).2.2
    have he : z = k' j*v := Subtype.ext hz
    rwa [he] at hg
  have hsmall : |reF v| < (M:F)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hvt,abs_of_pos ht]
    exact htM.trans (inv_lt_inv₀ (by positivity : (0:F) < M+1) hMp |>.mpr (by linarith))
  have hh := selected_mass_bound m hm0 hd c hc0.le hc1 r hr k' a b D M hD hM ha' hb' hab v hv hsmall hgood
  convert hh using 1
  have he : 2*r*(D:F)*reF v = s := by rw [hvt]; dsimp [t]; field_simp
  rw [he,abs_of_pos hs]
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped ENNReal NNReal ComplexConjugate BoundedContinuousFunction

name: kCoeff_scale_neg_one
stmt: (g : Rot) : ((kCoeff (rotMul (scaleHom (G := Rot) (-1) g)) : E) : ℂ) = conj ((kCoeff (rotMul g) : E) : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  change ((rotMul ((-1:ℤ) • g)).val : ℂ) = _
  rw [neg_one_zsmul]
  exact Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj _

name: char_symmetric
stmt: (r : F) (g : Rot) : (Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 1) (char (ofF r)) * Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) (-1)) (char (ofF r))) g = char (ofF (2*r*reF (kCoeff (rotMul g))))
body:
:= by
  simp only [Family.mul_apply, Family.orbit_apply, char_act, kCoeff_scale_one, ← char_add]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((kCoeff (rotMul g) : E) : ℂ)*(r : ℝ) +
    ((kCoeff (rotMul (scaleHom (G := Rot) (-1) g)) : E) : ℂ)*(r : ℝ) =
    ((2*r*reF (kCoeff (rotMul g)) : F) : ℝ)
  rw [kCoeff_scale_neg_one]
  push_cast
  change _ = 2*(r : ℝ)*(((kCoeff (rotMul g) : E) : ℂ).re : ℂ)
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  ring

variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K D μ]
  (q : D → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
  [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]
  (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ d ∂μ, q (k • d) = k • q d)
  [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]
def radiusFamily (r : F) : Rot →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
    (fun g => massReal μ q (2*r*reF (kCoeff (rotMul g)))) continuous_of_discreteTopology 1
    (fun g => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      change |projectedMass μ q (ofF _)| ≤ 1
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (projectedMass_nonneg _ _ _)]
      exact projectedMass_le_one μ q hq _)
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [ErgodicSMul K D μ]
  [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]
  [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)] in

name: radiusFamily_apply
stmt: (r : F) (g : Rot) : radiusFamily μ q hq r g = massReal μ q (2*r*reF (kCoeff (rotMul g)))
body:
:= rfl
include hq hqcov in

name: radiusFamily_mean
stmt: (r : F) (M : Amenable.Mean Rot) : M.map (radiusFamily μ q hq r) = massReal μ q r ^2
body:
:= by
  have he : radiusFamily μ q hq r = Family.energy (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q
      (Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) 1) (char (ofF r)) *
        Family.orbit (scaleHom (G := Rot) (-1)) (char (ofF r)))) := by
    ext g
    simp only [radiusFamily_apply, Family.energy_apply, Family.conditional_apply, char_symmetric]
    rfl
  rw [he, conditional_integer_pair_energy μ q hq (fun g : Rot => hqcov (rotMul g))
    rot_zsmul_surjective M (by decide : (1:ℤ) ≠ -1)]
  exact (pow_two _).symm
include hq hqcov in

name: radius_syndetic
stmt: (r : F) (c : ℝ) (hc : c < massReal μ q r ^2) : ∃ S : Finset Rot, ∀ v : Rot, ∃ s ∈ S, c < massReal μ q (2*r*reF (kCoeff (rotMul (v+s))))
body:
:= by
  apply MovingMean.syndetic_of_all_means (radiusFamily μ q hq r) c
  intro M
  rwa [radiusFamily_mean μ q hq hqcov r M]
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped ENNReal NNReal ComplexConjugate BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure D) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K D μ]
  (q : D → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
  [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]
  (hqcov : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ d ∂μ, q (k • d) = k • q d)
  [ErgodicVAdd Rot (D×D) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]

include hq hqcov in

name: radial_positive_near_zero
stmt: (r : F) (hr : 0 < r) (hm : massReal μ q r ≠ 0) : ∃ δ : F, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ s : F, 0 < s → s < δ → ε ≤ massReal μ q s
body:
:= by
  classical
  let c := massReal μ q r ^2/2
  have hp : 0 < massReal μ q r := lt_of_le_of_ne (projectedMass_nonneg μ q _) (Ne.symm hm)
  have hc : 0 < c := div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hp) (by norm_num)
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := by
    have h := projectedMass_le_one μ q hq (ofF r)
    change massReal μ q r ≤ 1 at h
    dsimp [c]; nlinarith
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := radius_syndetic μ q hq hqcov r c (by dsimp [c]; nlinarith)
  let Q := S.image (fun s => kCoeff (rotMul s))
  apply cover_mass_positive (massReal μ q) (projectedMass_zero μ q hq)
    (massReal_difference μ q hq hqcov) c hc hc1 r hr Q
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    exact Circle.norm_coe _
  · intro v hv
    let u : K := ⟨⟨(v:ℂ),mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hv⟩,mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp v.property⟩
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hsg⟩ := hS (mulRot u)
    refine ⟨kCoeff (rotMul s),Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    rw [massReal_abs μ q hq hqcov]
    have he : kCoeff (rotMul (mulRot u+s)) = kCoeff (rotMul s)*v := by
      change kCoeff (u*rotMul s) = _
      rw [kCoeff_mul,mul_comm]
      rfl
    rw [he] at hsg
    exact hsg.le

include hq hqcov in

name: massReal_vanish
stmt: (hw : IsWild (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map q) (condDistrib id q μ))) (r : F) (hr : 0 < r) : massReal μ q r = 0
body:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,ε,hε,hε1,hpos⟩ := radial_positive_near_zero μ q hq hqcov r hr hn
  let ν := DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map q) (condDistrib id q μ)
  have he (t : F) : lineFourier ν 1 t = (massReal μ q t : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [ν,massReal,lineFourier_eq,one_mul] using differenceFourier_projectedMass μ q hq (ofF t)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,htδ,htε⟩ := exists_small_wild_parameter ({()} : Finset Unit) (by simp)
    ν hw (fun _ => (1:E)) (fun _ => one_ne_zero)
    (fun i t => by rw [he,Complex.ofReal_re]; exact projectedMass_nonneg μ q _)
    (show 0 < (δ:ℝ) from hδ) hε hε1
  have htest : massReal μ q t < ε := by
    have hh := htε () (by simp)
    rwa [he,Complex.ofReal_re] at hh
  have hgood := hpos |t| (abs_pos.mpr ht) (by exact_mod_cast htδ)
  rw [massReal_abs μ q hq hqcov] at hgood
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hgood) htest
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

name: rotMul_mulRot
stmt: (k : K) : rotMul (mulRot k) = k
body: := rfl

name: mulRot_rotMul
stmt: (g : Rot) : mulRot (rotMul g) = g
body:
:= rfl
instance rotAction (X : Type*) [MulAction K X] : AddAction Rot X where
  vadd g x := rotMul g • x
  zero_vadd x := one_smul K x
  add_vadd g h x := mul_smul (rotMul g) (rotMul h) x

name: rot_vadd
stmt: {X : Type*} [MulAction K X] (g : Rot) (x : X) : g +ᵥ x = rotMul g • x
body:
:= rfl
instance rotMeasurable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MulAction K X]
    [MeasurableConstSMul K X] : MeasurableConstVAdd Rot X where
  measurable_const_vadd g := measurable_const_smul (rotMul g)
instance rotInvariant {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MulAction K X]
    (μ : Measure X) [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] : VAddInvariantMeasure Rot X μ where
  measure_preimage_vadd g s _hs := measure_preimage_smul μ (rotMul g) s
instance rotErgodic {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MulAction K X]
    (μ : Measure X) [ErgodicSMul K X μ] : ErgodicVAdd Rot X μ where
  aeconst_of_forall_preimage_vadd_ae_eq hm he :=
    ErgodicSMul.aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq hm (fun k => he (mulRot k))

name: rot_zsmul_surjective
stmt: (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective (EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable.scaleHom (G := Rot) n)
body:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := K_pow_surjective n.natAbs (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hn) (rotMul g)
  rcases n with n | n
  · refine ⟨mulRot k, ?_⟩
    change Additive.ofMul (k^n) = g
    exact congrArg mulRot hk
  · refine ⟨mulRot k⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change Additive.ofMul (k⁻¹ ^ (Int.negSucc n)) = g
    have he : k⁻¹ ^ (Int.negSucc n) = k^(n+1) := by simp
    rw [he]
    exact congrArg mulRot hk
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

open MeasureTheory
namespace PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel
open Spectral
variable (k : ℕ)
def Proper (ω : E → Fin k) : Prop := ∀ x y : E, ‖(x:ℂ)-(y:ℂ)‖ = 1 → ω x ≠ ω y
abbrev Space := {ω : E → Fin k // Proper k ω}

name: closed_proper
stmt: : IsClosed {ω : E → Fin k | Proper k ω}
body:
:= by
  unfold Proper
  simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
  refine isClosed_iInter fun (x:E) => isClosed_iInter fun (y:E) => isClosed_iInter fun _ => ?_
  have hc : Continuous (fun ω : E → Fin k => (ω x,ω y)) := (continuous_apply x).prodMk (continuous_apply y)
  exact (isClosed_discrete {p : Fin k × Fin k | p.1 ≠ p.2}).preimage hc
instance : CompactSpace (Space k) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (closed_proper k).isCompact
def trans (a : E) (ω : Space k) : Space k := ⟨fun x => ω.val (x+a),by
  intro x y h
  apply ω.property (x+a) (y+a)
  change ‖(x:ℂ)+(a:ℂ)-((y:ℂ)+(a:ℂ))‖ = 1
  simpa only [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using h⟩
def rotate (b : K) (ω : Space k) : Space k := ⟨fun x => ω.val (kCoeff b * x),by
  intro x y h
  apply ω.property (kCoeff b*x) (kCoeff b*y)
  change ‖(b.val:ℂ)*(x:ℂ)-(b.val:ℂ)*(y:ℂ)‖ = 1
  rw [← mul_sub,norm_mul,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul,h]⟩

name: trans_apply
stmt: (a : E) (ω : Space k) (x : E) : (trans k a ω).val x = ω.val (x+a)
body: := rfl

name: rotate_apply
stmt: (b : K) (ω : Space k) (x : E) : (rotate k b ω).val x = ω.val (kCoeff b*x)
body: := rfl

name: trans_continuous
stmt: (a : E) : Continuous (trans k a)
body:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_pi fun x => (continuous_apply (x+a)).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: rotate_continuous
stmt: (b : K) : Continuous (rotate k b)
body:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_pi fun x => (continuous_apply (kCoeff b*x)).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: trans_zero
stmt: (ω : Space k) : trans k 0 ω = ω
body: := by apply Subtype.ext; funext x; simp

name: trans_add
stmt: (a b : E) (ω : Space k) : trans k a (trans k b ω) = trans k (a+b) ω
body: := by apply Subtype.ext; funext x; simp [add_assoc]

name: rotate_one
stmt: (ω : Space k) : rotate k 1 ω = ω
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext x
  have h1 : kCoeff 1 = 1 := rfl
  simp [h1]

name: rotate_mul
stmt: (a b : K) (ω : Space k) : rotate k a (rotate k b ω) = rotate k (a*b) ω
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext x
  change ω.val (kCoeff b * (kCoeff a * x)) = ω.val (kCoeff (a*b)*x)
  have he : kCoeff (a*b) = kCoeff a * kCoeff b := by rfl
  rw [he]; ring_nf

name: covariance
stmt: (a : E) (b : K) (ω : Space k) : trans k a (rotate k b ω) = rotate k b (trans k (kCoeff b*a) ω)
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext x
  simp only [trans_apply,rotate_apply,mul_add]
def transHomeo (a : E) : Space k ≃ₜ Space k where
  toFun := trans k a
  invFun := trans k (-a)
  left_inv ω := by rw [trans_add,neg_add_cancel,trans_zero]
  right_inv ω := by rw [trans_add,add_neg_cancel,trans_zero]
  continuous_toFun := trans_continuous k a
  continuous_invFun := trans_continuous k (-a)
def rotateHomeo (b : K) : Space k ≃ₜ Space k where
  toFun := rotate k b
  invFun := rotate k b⁻¹
  left_inv ω := by rw [rotate_mul,inv_mul_cancel,rotate_one]
  right_inv ω := by rw [rotate_mul,mul_inv_cancel,rotate_one]
  continuous_toFun := rotate_continuous k b
  continuous_invFun := rotate_continuous k b⁻¹
abbrev Trans := Additive DiscreteE
def tr (a : Trans) : Space k → Space k := trans k (Multiplicative.toAdd (Additive.toMul a))
def ro (b : Rot) : Space k → Space k := rotate k (rotMul b)
def measure (ω : Space k) : Measure (Space k) := EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.measure (tr k) (ro k) ω
instance (ω : Space k) : IsProbabilityMeasure (measure k ω) := inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.measure (tr k) (ro k) ω))

name: trans_preserving
stmt: (ω : Space k) (a : E) : MeasurePreserving (trans k a) (measure k ω) (measure k ω)
body:
:= by
  apply EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.preserving_of_average (tr k) (ro k) ω (transHomeo k a)
  intro f
  apply EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.average_translation (tr k) (ro k) ω
    (fun a b x => trans_add k _ _ x) (fun b a => Additive.ofMul (Multiplicative.ofAdd (kCoeff (rotMul b)*Multiplicative.toAdd (Additive.toMul a))))
    (fun a b x => covariance k _ _ x) (Additive.ofMul (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)) f (trans_continuous k a)

name: rotate_preserving
stmt: (ω : Space k) (b : K) : MeasurePreserving (rotate k b) (measure k ω) (measure k ω)
body:
:= by
  apply EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.preserving_of_average (tr k) (ro k) ω (rotateHomeo k b)
  intro f
  exact EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.average_rotation (tr k) (ro k) ω
    (fun a b x => rotate_mul k _ _ x) (mulRot b) f (rotate_continuous k b)
end PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel
end

open MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Koopman
variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)
def isometry (s : X ≃ᵐ X) (hs : MeasurePreserving s μ μ) : Lp ℂ 2 μ ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ where
  __ := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ s hs
  invFun := Lp.compMeasurePreserving s.symm (hs.symm s)
  left_inv v := by
    change Lp.compMeasurePreserving s.symm (hs.symm s) (Lp.compMeasurePreserving s hs v) = v
    rw [← Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply]
    have he : (s : X → X) ∘ s.symm = id := funext s.apply_symm_apply
    simp only [he,Lp.compMeasurePreserving_id_apply]
  right_inv v := by
    change Lp.compMeasurePreserving s hs (Lp.compMeasurePreserving s.symm (hs.symm s) v) = v
    rw [← Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply]
    have he : (s.symm : X → X) ∘ s = id := funext s.symm_apply_apply
    simp only [he,Lp.compMeasurePreserving_id_apply]
def unitary (s : X ≃ᵐ X) (hs : MeasurePreserving s μ μ) : unitary (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) :=
  Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm (isometry μ s hs)

name: unitary_apply
stmt: (s : X ≃ᵐ X) (hs : MeasurePreserving s μ μ) (v : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : (unitary μ s hs : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) v = Lp.compMeasurePreserving s hs v
body: := rfl

name: nonlinear_commute
stmt: (s : X → X) (hs : MeasurePreserving s μ μ) {F : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith c F) (h0 : F 0 = 0) (v : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : Lp.compMeasurePreserving s hs (hF.compLp h0 v) = hF.compLp h0 (Lp.compMeasurePreserving s hs v)
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving (hF.compLp h0 v) hs,
    hs.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hF.coeFn_compLp h0 v),
    hF.coeFn_compLp h0 (Lp.compMeasurePreserving s hs v),Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving v hs] with x h1 h2 h3 h4
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,h1,h2,h3,h4]
end EuclideanFiveColor.Koopman
end

open Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
variable {A H : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (U : Multiplicative A →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))
def op (a : A) : H →L[ℂ] H := U (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)

name: op_zero
stmt: (v : H) : op U 0 v = v
body: := by simp [op]

name: op_add
stmt: (a b : A) (v : H) : op U (a+b) v = op U a (op U b v)
body:
:= by
  change ((U (Multiplicative.ofAdd a * Multiplicative.ofAdd b) : unitary _) : H →L[ℂ] H) v = _
  rw [map_mul]; rfl

name: op_comm
stmt: (a b : A) (v : H) : op U a (op U b v) = op U b (op U a v)
body:
:= by
  rw [← op_add,← op_add,add_comm]

name: norm_op
stmt: (a : A) (v : H) : ‖op U a v‖ = ‖v‖
body: := Unitary.norm_map _ _

name: dist_op
stmt: (a : A) (v w : H) : dist (op U a v) (op U a w) = dist v w
body:
:= by
  simp only [dist_eq_norm,← map_sub,norm_op]
variable [TopologicalSpace A]
def space : Submodule ℂ H where
  carrier := {v | Tendsto (fun a => op U a v) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 v)}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro v w hv hw
    change Tendsto (fun a => op U a (v+w)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (v+w))
    simpa only [map_add] using hv.add hw
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c v hv
    change Tendsto (fun a => op U a (c • v)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (c • v))
    simpa only [map_smul] using hv.const_smul c

name: mem_space
stmt: (v : H) : v ∈ space U ↔ Tendsto (fun a => op U a v) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 v)
body: := Iff.rfl

name: isClosed_space
stmt: : IsClosed (space U : Set H)
body:
:= by
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro v hv
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨w,hw,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hv (ε/4) (by positivity)
  have ht := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hw (ε/2) (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [ht] with a ha
  have he : dist (op U a v) v ≤ 2 * dist v w + dist (op U a w) w := by
    calc
      _ ≤ dist (op U a v) (op U a w) + dist (op U a w) v := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ dist (op U a v) (op U a w) + (dist (op U a w) w + dist w v) :=
        by linarith [dist_triangle (op U a w) w v]
      _ = _ := by rw [dist_op,dist_comm w v]; ring
  linarith
instance : CompleteSpace (space U) := (isClosed_space U).completeSpace_coe

name: op_mem
stmt: (a : A) {v : H} (hv : v ∈ space U) : op U a v ∈ space U
body:
:= by
  have ht := ((op U a).continuous.tendsto v).comp hv
  change Tendsto (fun z => op U z (op U a v)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (op U a v))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,op_comm U a] using ht
variable [IsTopologicalAddGroup A]

name: orbit_continuous
stmt: {v : H} (hv : v ∈ space U) : Continuous (fun a => op U a v)
body:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro a
  have ht0 : Tendsto (fun b : A => b-a) (𝓝 a) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := ((tendsto_id : Tendsto (fun b : A => b) (𝓝 a) (𝓝 a)).sub_const a)
    rw [sub_self] at hh
    exact hh
  have ht := (((op U a).continuous.tendsto v).comp hv).comp ht0
  change Tendsto (fun b => op U b v) (𝓝 a) (𝓝 (op U a v))
  convert ht using 1
  ext b
  change op U b v = op U a (op U (b-a) v)
  rw [← op_add]
  congr 1
  abel_nf
end EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
end

variable (k : ℕ) (ω : Space k)
abbrev Hilbert := Lp ℂ 2 (measure k ω)
def translation (a : E) : unitary (Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) :=
  Koopman.unitary (measure k ω) (transHomeo k a).toMeasurableEquiv (trans_preserving k ω a)
def rotation (b : K) : unitary (Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) :=
  Koopman.unitary (measure k ω) (rotateHomeo k b).toMeasurableEquiv (rotate_preserving k ω b)

stmt: (a : E) (v : Hilbert k ω) : (translation k ω a : Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) v = Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k a) (trans_preserving k ω a) v
body: := rfl

stmt: (b : K) (v : Hilbert k ω) : (rotation k ω b : Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) v = Lp.compMeasurePreserving (rotate k b) (rotate_preserving k ω b) v
body:
:= rfl
def representation : DiscreteE →* unitary (Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) where
  toFun a := translation k ω (Multiplicative.toAdd a)
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k 0) (trans_preserving k ω 0) v = v
    have he : trans k 0 = id := funext (trans_zero k)
    simp only [he,Lp.compMeasurePreserving_id_apply]
  map_mul' a b := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k (Multiplicative.toAdd a+Multiplicative.toAdd b)) _ v =
      Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k (Multiplicative.toAdd a)) _ (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k (Multiplicative.toAdd b)) _ v)
    rw [← Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply]

    funext x
    exact (congrArg (fun c => trans k c x) (add_comm _ _)).trans (trans_add k _ _ x).symm

name: op_apply
stmt: (a : E) (v : Hilbert k ω) : op (representation k ω) a v = Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k a) (trans_preserving k ω a) v
body: := rfl

name: rotation_covariance
stmt: (b : K) (a : E) (v : Hilbert k ω) : (rotation k ω b : Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) (op (representation k ω) a v) = op (representation k ω) (kCoeff b*a) ((rotation k ω b : Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) v)
body:
:= by
  simp only [rotation_apply,op_apply,← Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply]
  congr 2
  funext x
  exact covariance k a b x
end PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel

name: projection_fixed_of_contraction
stmt: (S : Submodule ℂ H) [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] (F : H → H) (hF : LipschitzWith 1 F) (hS : ∀ v ∈ S, F v ∈ S) (v : H) (hv : F v = v) : F (S.starProjection v) = S.starProjection v
body:
:= by
  let p := S.starProjection v
  have hp : p ∈ S := S.starProjection_apply_mem v
  have hh : ‖v-F p‖ ≤ ‖v-p‖ := by
    simpa only [hv,NNReal.coe_one,one_mul,dist_eq_norm] using hF.dist_le_mul v p
  have ho : ⟪v-p,p-F p⟫_ℂ = 0 := S.starProjection_inner_eq_zero v _ (S.sub_mem hp (hS p hp))
  have he := norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero (v-p) (p-F p) ho
  rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at he
  have hz : ‖p-F p‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (v-p),norm_nonneg (p-F p),norm_nonneg (v-F p)]
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz)).symm
end EuclideanFiveColor

  (μ : Measure X) (U : Multiplicative A →* unitary (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ))
  (s : A → X → X) (hs : ∀ a, MeasurePreserving (s a) μ μ)
  (hU : ∀ a v, op U a v = Lp.compMeasurePreserving (s a) (hs a) v)

name: nonlinear_mem
stmt: {F : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith c F) (h0 : F 0 = 0) {v : Lp ℂ 2 μ} (hv : v ∈ space U) : hF.compLp h0 v ∈ space U

  change Tendsto (fun a => op U a (hF.compLp h0 v)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (hF.compLp h0 v))
  convert ht using 1
  funext a

def clamp (z : ℂ) : ℂ := (max 0 (min 1 z.re) : ℝ)

name: clamp_lipschitz
stmt: : LipschitzWith 1 clamp
body:
:= by
  have hr : LipschitzWith 1 (fun z : ℂ => z.re) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro a b
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul,Real.dist_eq,dist_eq_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,← Complex.sub_re] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (a-b)
  change LipschitzWith 1 (fun z : ℂ => ((max 0 (min 1 z.re) : ℝ) : ℂ))
  simpa only [one_mul,Function.comp_def] using Complex.isometry_ofReal.lipschitzWith.comp ((hr.const_min 1).const_max 0)

name: clamp_range
stmt: (z : ℂ) : (clamp z).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (clamp z).re ∧ (clamp z).re ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  change (0 : ℝ) = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ max 0 (min 1 z.re) ∧ max 0 (min 1 z.re) ≤ 1
  exact ⟨rfl,le_max_left _ _,max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left _ _)⟩

name: clamp_eq
stmt: {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ 1) : clamp z = z
body:
:= by
  rw [clamp,min_eq_right hz.2.2,max_eq_right hz.2.1]
  exact Complex.ext (by simp) (by simpa using hz.1.symm)
include hU

name: projection_range
stmt: (v : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (hv : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (v x).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (v x).re ∧ (v x).re ≤ 1) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ((space U).starProjection v x).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ ((space U).starProjection v x).re ∧ ((space U).starProjection v x).re ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  have he : clamp_lipschitz.compLp clamp_zero v = v := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [clamp_lipschitz.coeFn_compLp clamp_zero v,hv] with x hx hvx
    exact hx.trans (clamp_eq hvx)
  have hp := projection_fixed_of_contraction (space U) (clamp_lipschitz.compLp clamp_zero)
    (clamp_lipschitz.lipschitzWith_compLp clamp_zero)
    (fun v hv => nonlinear_mem μ U s hs hU clamp_lipschitz clamp_zero hv) v he
  have hae := clamp_lipschitz.coeFn_compLp clamp_zero ((space U).starProjection v)
  rw [hp] at hae
  filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
  exact hx.symm ▸ clamp_range _
end EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
end
