open Filter Topology
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
variable {A H : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (U : Multiplicative A →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))

name: covariance_mem
stmt: (W : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (φ : A ≃ₜ A) (hφ : φ 0 = 0) (hc : ∀ a v, (W : H →L[ℂ] H) (op U a v) = op U (φ a) ((W : H →L[ℂ] H) v)) {v : H} (hv : v ∈ space U) : (W : H →L[ℂ] H) v ∈ space U
body:
:= by
  have h0 : φ.symm 0 = 0 := by simpa only [hφ] using φ.symm_apply_apply 0
  have ht0 := φ.symm.continuous.tendsto 0
  rw [h0] at ht0
  have ht := ((W.val.continuous.tendsto v).comp hv).comp ht0
  change Tendsto (fun a => op U a ((W : H →L[ℂ] H) v)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 ((W : H →L[ℂ] H) v))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,hc,φ.apply_symm_apply] using ht

name: projection_covariance_fixed
stmt: (W : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (φ : A ≃ₜ A) (hφ : φ 0 = 0) (hc : ∀ a v, (W : H →L[ℂ] H) (op U a v) = op U (φ a) ((W : H →L[ℂ] H) v)) (v : H) (hv : (W : H →L[ℂ] H) v = v) : (W : H →L[ℂ] H) ((space U).starProjection v) = (space U).starProjection v
body:
:= by
  exact projection_fixed_of_contraction (space U) (W : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv W).lipschitz (fun w hw => covariance_mem U W φ hφ hc hw) v hv

name: op_orthogonal
stmt: (a : A) {v : H} (hv : v ∈ (space U)ᗮ) : op U a v ∈ (space U)ᗮ
body:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal'] at hv ⊢
  intro w hw
  have hh := hv (op U (-a) w) (op_mem U (-a) hw)
  have he := Unitary.inner_map_map (U (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)) v (op U (-a) w)
  change ⟪op U a v,op U a (op U (-a) w)⟫_ℂ = _ at he
  rw [← op_add,add_neg_cancel,op_zero] at he
  exact he.trans hh

name: projection_coefficient
stmt: (v : H) (a : A) (hb : ⟪v-(space U).starProjection v, op U a (v-(space U).starProjection v)⟫_ℂ = 0) : ⟪(space U).starProjection v,op U a ((space U).starProjection v)⟫_ℂ = ⟪v,op U a v⟫_ℂ
body:
:= by
  let p := (space U).starProjection v
  let b := v-p
  have hp : p ∈ space U := (space U).starProjection_apply_mem v
  have hbmem : b ∈ (space U)ᗮ := (space U).sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal v
  have h1 : ⟪b,op U a p⟫_ℂ = 0 := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal' _ _).mp hbmem _ (op_mem U a hp)
  have h2 : ⟪p,op U a b⟫_ℂ = 0 := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).mp (op_orthogonal U a hbmem) _ hp
  have he : v = p+b := by dsimp [b]; abel
  change ⟪p,op U a p⟫_ℂ = ⟪v,op U a v⟫_ℂ
  rw [he,map_add,inner_add_left,inner_add_right,inner_add_right,h1,h2]
  change _ = _ + 0 + (0 + ⟪b,op U a b⟫_ℂ)
  rw [hb]; simp
end EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped ComplexConjugate InnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.VectorMeasure
variable {X H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (Φ : C(X,ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (v : H)
def realCM (f : C(X,ℝ)) : C(X,ℂ) := ⟨fun x => (f x : ℂ),by fun_prop⟩

name: realCM_apply
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) (x : X) : realCM f x = (f x : ℂ)
body: := rfl

name: realCM_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : realCM (f+g) = realCM f+realCM g
body: := by ext; simp

name: realCM_sub
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : realCM (f-g) = realCM f-realCM g
body: := by ext; simp

name: realCM_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : realCM (c • f) = (c:ℂ) • realCM f
body: := by ext; simp

name: realCM_one
stmt: : realCM (1:C(X,ℝ)) = 1
body:
:= by ext; simp
variable [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
omit [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] in

name: real_nonneg
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) (hf : 0 ≤ f) : 0 ≤ (⟪v, Φ (realCM f) v⟫_ℂ).re
body:
:= by
  let g : C(X,ℂ) := realCM ⟨fun x => Real.sqrt (f x),by fun_prop⟩
  have he : star g * g = realCM f := by
    ext x
    simp only [ContinuousMap.mul_apply,ContinuousMap.star_apply,realCM_apply,g,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,Complex.star_def,Complex.conj_ofReal]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    exact congrArg Complex.ofReal (Real.mul_self_sqrt (show 0 ≤ f x from hf x))
  rw [← he,map_mul,map_star]
  change 0 ≤ (⟪v, (star (Φ g)) ((Φ g) v)⟫_ℂ).re
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  exact inner_self_nonneg (𝕜 := ℂ) (x := (Φ g) v)

def functional : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun f := (⟪v,Φ (realCM f.toContinuousMap) v⟫_ℂ).re
  map_add' f g := by
    change (⟪v,Φ (realCM (f.toContinuousMap+g.toContinuousMap)) v⟫_ℂ).re = _
    simp
  map_smul' c f := by
    change (⟪v,Φ (realCM (c • f.toContinuousMap)) v⟫_ℂ).re = c * _
    rw [realCM_smul,map_smul]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_smul,Pi.smul_apply,inner_smul_right,Complex.mul_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,sub_zero]
  monotone' f g hfg := by
    have he := real_nonneg Φ v (g.toContinuousMap-f.toContinuousMap) (sub_nonneg.mpr hfg)
    simpa [inner_sub_right] using he

def measure : Measure X := RealRMK.rieszMeasure (functional Φ v)
instance : IsFiniteMeasure (measure Φ v) := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance
instance : (measure Φ v).Regular := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance

name: integral_real
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) : ∫ x, f x ∂measure Φ v = (⟪v,Φ (realCM f) v⟫_ℂ).re
body:
:= by
  exact RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure (functional Φ v) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.continuousMapEquiv f)

name: integral_complex
stmt: (f : C(X,ℂ)) : ∫ x, f x ∂measure Φ v = ⟪v,Φ f v⟫_ℂ
body:
:= by
  let fr : C(X,ℝ) := ⟨fun x => (f x).re,by fun_prop⟩
  let fi : C(X,ℝ) := ⟨fun x => (f x).im,by fun_prop⟩
  have he : f = realCM fr + Complex.I • realCM fi := by
    ext x
    simpa [fr,fi,smul_eq_mul,mul_comm] using (Complex.re_add_im (f x)).symm
  have hi_real (g : C(X,ℝ)) : (⟪v,Φ (realCM g) v⟫_ℂ).im = 0 := by
    have hs : star (Φ (realCM g)) = Φ (realCM g) := by
      rw [← map_star]; congr 1; ext x; simp
    have ht := inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) v (Φ (realCM g) v)
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,hs] at ht
    have hh := congrArg Complex.im ht
    simp only [Complex.conj_im] at hh
    linarith
  have hb (g : C(X,ℝ)) : ∫ x, (g x : ℂ) ∂measure Φ v = ⟪v,Φ (realCM g) v⟫_ℂ := by
    rw [integral_complex_ofReal,integral_real]
    exact Complex.ext (by simp) (by simp [hi_real])
  rw [he,map_add,map_smul]
  simp only [ContinuousMap.add_apply,ContinuousMap.smul_apply,realCM_apply,add_apply,
    smul_apply,inner_add_right,inner_smul_right]
  have hir : Integrable (fun x => (fr x : ℂ)) (measure Φ v) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp fr.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hii : Integrable (fun x => (fi x : ℂ)) (measure Φ v) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp fi.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  calc
    _ = (∫ x, (fr x : ℂ) ∂measure Φ v) +
        (∫ x, Complex.I • (fi x : ℂ) ∂measure Φ v) := integral_add hir (hii.smul Complex.I)
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_smul,hb,hb]; rfl

name: measure_univ
stmt: : (measure Φ v).real Set.univ = ‖v‖^2
body:
:= by
  have he := integral_real Φ v (1:C(X,ℝ))
  simp only [ContinuousMap.one_apply,integral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_one,realCM_one,map_one,one_apply_eq_self] at he
  exact he.trans (inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) v)
end EuclideanFiveColor.VectorMeasure
end

end OAI

name: spanning_selection
stmt: {ι : Type*} (Q : Finset ι) (S : Finset V) (hS : General S) (hcard : Q.card*(finrank ℚ V-1) < S.card) (A : ι → V → Prop) (hA : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ i ∈ Q, A i x) : ∃ i ∈ Q, ∃ T ⊆ S, T.card = finrank ℚ V ∧ Submodule.span ℚ (T : Set V) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ x ∈ T, A i x
body:
:= by
  classical
  choose f hfQ hfA using fun x : S => hA x x.property
  have hs : Fintype.card Q * (finrank ℚ V-1) < Fintype.card S := by simpa using hcard
  let g : S → Q := fun x => ⟨f x,hfQ x⟩
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Fintype.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card g hs
  have hi' : finrank ℚ V ≤ (S.filter (fun x => A i x)).card := by
    have hx : (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : S => g x = i)).card ≤
        (S.filter (fun x => A i x)).card := by
      apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x : S => x.val)
      · intro x hx
        have hg : g x = i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨x.property,by
          have hh := hfA x
          change A (g x).val x.val at hh
          rwa [hg] at hh⟩
      · intro x hx y hy hxy
        exact Subtype.ext hxy
    omega
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hTc⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hi'
  have hTS : T ⊆ S := fun x hx => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hT hx)).1
  exact ⟨i,i.property,T,hTS,hTc,hS.spans hTS hTc, fun x hx => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hT hx)).2⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor.GeneralPosition
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic

name: common_denominator
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℚ) : ∃ D : ℕ, 0 < D ∧ ∃ a : ι → ℤ, ∀ i, (D:ℚ)*c i = a i
body:
:= by
  classical
  let D := ∏ i, (c i).den
  let a := fun i => ((∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (c j).den : ℕ) : ℤ)*(c i).num
  refine ⟨D,Finset.prod_pos (fun _ _ => Rat.den_pos _),a,fun i => ?_⟩
  have hD : D = (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (c j).den)*(c i).den :=
    (Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm
  rw [hD, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc, Rat.den_mul_eq_num]
  simp only [a, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]

name: uniform_integral_representations
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {κ : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (κ i)] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] (v : ∀ i, κ i → V) (x y : V) (hx : ∀ i, ∃ c : κ i → ℚ, ∑ j, c j • v i j = x) (hy : ∀ i, ∃ c : κ i → ℚ, ∑ j, c j • v i j = y) : ∃ D M : ℕ, 0 < D ∧ 0 < M ∧ ∃ a b : ∀ i, κ i → ℤ, ∀ i : ι, (∑ j, a i j • v i j) = D • x ∧ (∑ j, b i j • v i j) = D • y ∧ (∑ j : κ i, ((a i j).natAbs+(b i j).natAbs)) ≤ M
body:
:= by
  classical
  choose c hc using hx
  choose d hd using hy
  let f : (Σ i, κ i) × Bool → ℚ := fun p => if p.2 then c p.1.1 p.1.2 else d p.1.1 p.1.2
  obtain ⟨D,hD,A,hA⟩ := common_denominator f
  let a := fun (i : ι) (j : κ i) => A (⟨i,j⟩,true)
  let b := fun (i : ι) (j : κ i) => A (⟨i,j⟩,false)
  let m := fun i => ∑ j : κ i, ((a i j).natAbs+(b i j).natAbs)
  let M := (∑ i, m i)+1
  refine ⟨D,M,hD,Nat.zero_lt_succ _,a,b,fun i => ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · calc
      (∑ j, a i j • v i j) = ∑ j, ((D:ℚ)*c i j) • v i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        have hh := hA (⟨i,j⟩,true)
        simp only [f,ite_true] at hh
        rw [hh,Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      _ = (D:ℚ) • ∑ j, c i j • v i j := by simp only [Finset.smul_sum,smul_smul]
      _ = D • x := by rw [hc,Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  · calc
      (∑ j, b i j • v i j) = ∑ j, ((D:ℚ)*d i j) • v i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        have hh := hA (⟨i,j⟩,false)
        simp only [f,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] at hh
        rw [hh,Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      _ = (D:ℚ) • ∑ j, d i j • v i j := by simp only [Finset.smul_sum,smul_smul]
      _ = D • y := by rw [hd,Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  · exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (m j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
end EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic
end

noncomputable section
open Module
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic
open AlgebraicCayley GeneralPosition

name: span_mult_rep
stmt: (N : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (T : Finset N) (hT : Submodule.span ℚ (T : Set N) = ⊤) (q : N) (hq : q ≠ 0) (x : N) : ∃ c : T → ℚ, ∑ j, c j • (q*j.val) = x
body:
:= by
  have hs : Set.range (fun j : T => j.val) = (T : Set N) := Subtype.range_coe
  have hx : q⁻¹*x ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (fun j : T => j.val)) := by rw [hs,hT]; trivial
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℚ).mp hx
  refine ⟨c,?_⟩
  calc
    (∑ j, c j • (q*j.val)) = q * ∑ j, c j • j.val := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum, mul_smul_comm]
    _ = x := by rw [hc,← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hq,one_mul]

name: uniform_selection
stmt: (Q : Finset ℂ) (hQn : ∀ q ∈ Q, ‖q‖ = 1) (hQa : ∀ q ∈ Q, IsAlgebraic ℚ q) (A : ℂ → Prop) (hA : ∀ v : ℂ, ‖v‖ = 1 → IsAlgebraic ℚ v → ∃ q ∈ Q, A (q*v)) : ∃ D M : ℕ, 0 < D ∧ 0 < M ∧ ∀ v : ℂ, ‖v‖ = 1 → IsAlgebraic ℚ v → ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ k : Fin n → ℂ, ∃ a b : Fin n → ℤ, (∀ j, ‖k j‖ = 1 ∧ IsAlgebraic ℚ (k j) ∧ A (k j*v)) ∧ (∑ j, a j • k j) = D • (1:ℂ) ∧ (∑ j, b j • k j) = D • Complex.I ∧ (∑ j, ((a j).natAbs+(b j).natAbs)) ≤ M
body:
:= by
  classical
  let N := generatedField Q
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ N := generatedField_finite Q hQa
  obtain ⟨S,hSc,hSn,hSg⟩ := numberField_general_position N (generatedField_I Q)
    (generatedField_re_closed Q) (generatedField_im_closed Q)
    (Q.card*(finrank ℚ N-1)+1)
  let TS : Finset (Finset N) := S.powerset.filter (fun T => Submodule.span ℚ (T:Set N) = ⊤)
  let I := Q × TS
  let κ : I → Type := fun i => i.2.val
  let qs : Q → N := fun q => ⟨q.val,generatedField_contains Q q.val q.property⟩
  have hqs (q : Q) : qs q ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hec := congrArg (fun z : N => (z:ℂ)) he
    have hn := hQn q q.property
    change q.val = 0 at hec
    simp [hec] at hn
  let k : ∀ i : I, κ i → N := fun i j => qs i.1*j.val
  have hs (i : I) : Submodule.span ℚ (i.2.val:Set N) = ⊤ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp i.2.property).2
  obtain ⟨D,M,hD,hM,a,b,hab⟩ := uniform_integral_representations k (1:N) (iN N (generatedField_I Q))
    (fun i => span_mult_rep N i.2.val (hs i) _ (hqs _) _)
    (fun i => span_mult_rep N i.2.val (hs i) _ (hqs _) _)
  refine ⟨D,M,hD,hM,fun v hv hva => ?_⟩
  have hAlg (z : N) : IsAlgebraic ℚ (z:ℂ) :=
    IsAlgebraic.algHom N.val (IsAlgebraic.of_finite ℚ z)
  obtain ⟨q,hq,T,hTS,hTc,hTspan,hTA⟩ := spanning_selection Q S hSg (by omega)
    (fun q s => A (q*(s:ℂ)*v)) (by
      intro s hs
      have hn : ‖(s:ℂ)*v‖ = 1 := by rw [norm_mul,hSn s hs,hv,one_mul]
      obtain ⟨q,hq,hqA⟩ := hA ((s:ℂ)*v) hn ((hAlg s).mul hva)
      exact ⟨q,hq,by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hqA⟩)
  have hTmem : T ∈ TS := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hTS,hTspan⟩
  let i : I := (⟨q,hq⟩,⟨T,hTmem⟩)
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin (κ i)).symm
  refine ⟨Fintype.card (κ i),fun j => (k i (e j):ℂ),fun j => a i (e j),fun j => b i (e j),?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hj : (e j).val ∈ T := (e j).property
    refine ⟨?_,hAlg (k i (e j)),?_⟩
    · change ‖q*((e j).val:ℂ)‖ = 1
      rw [norm_mul,hQn q hq,hSn _ (hTS hj),one_mul]
    · exact hTA _ hj
  · have he := congrArg (fun z : N => (z:ℂ)) (hab i).1
    push_cast at he
    rw [← he]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (fun _ => by simp)
  · have he := congrArg (fun z : N => (z:ℂ)) (hab i).2.1
    push_cast at he
    change (∑ j, b i j • (k i j:ℂ)) = D • Complex.I at he
    rw [← he]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (fun _ => by simp)
  · rw [Fintype.sum_equiv e _ (fun j => (a i j).natAbs+(b i j).natAbs) (fun _ => rfl)]
    exact (hab i).2.2
end EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic

name: real_sum_bound
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℤ) (x : ι → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ B) : |∑ i, (a i : ℝ)*x i| ≤ (∑ i, ((a i).natAbs : ℝ))*B
body:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |(a i:ℝ)*x i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ((a i).natAbs : ℝ)*B := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [abs_mul]
      have he : |(a i:ℝ)| = ((a i).natAbs : ℝ) := by simp
      rw [he]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx i) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm

name: selection_transverse
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℂ) (a b : ι → ℤ) (D M : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (ha : (∑ i, a i • k i) = D • (1:ℂ)) (hb : (∑ i, b i • k i) = D • Complex.I) (hM : (∑ i, ((a i).natAbs+(b i).natAbs)) ≤ M) (v : ℂ) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) : ∃ i, ∀ j, |(k j*v).re| ≤ |(k i*v).re| ∧ (D:ℝ) ≤ (M:ℝ)*|(k i*v).re|
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : Nonempty ι := by
    by_contra hh
    have : IsEmpty ι := not_nonempty_iff.mp hh
    have he : (D:ℂ) = 0 := by simpa using ha.symm
    have : D = 0 := by exact_mod_cast he
    omega
  have := hn
  obtain ⟨i,_,him⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun j => |(k j*v).re|) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hm (j : ι) : |(k j*v).re| ≤ |(k i*v).re| := him j (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have h1 : (∑ j, (a j:ℝ)*(k j*v).re) = (D:ℝ)*v.re := by
    have he := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (z*v).re) ha
    simpa only [Finset.sum_mul, Complex.re_sum, zsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul,
      mul_assoc, Complex.mul_re, Complex.intCast_re, Complex.intCast_im, zero_mul,
      sub_zero, Complex.natCast_re, Complex.natCast_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im,
      mul_one] using he
  have h2 : (∑ j, (b j:ℝ)*(k j*v).re) = -(D:ℝ)*v.im := by
    have he := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (z*v).re) hb
    simpa only [Finset.sum_mul, Complex.re_sum, zsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul,
      mul_assoc, Complex.mul_re, Complex.intCast_re, Complex.intCast_im, zero_mul,
      sub_zero, Complex.natCast_re, Complex.natCast_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      one_mul, zero_sub, mul_neg, neg_mul] using he
  have h1b := real_sum_bound a (fun j => (k j*v).re) _ hm
  have h2b := real_sum_bound b (fun j => (k j*v).re) _ hm
  rw [h1,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg D)] at h1b
  rw [h2,abs_mul,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg D)] at h2b
  have hcomp : 1 ≤ |v.re|+|v.im| := hv ▸ Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im v
  have hMc : (∑ j, ((a j).natAbs:ℝ))+(∑ j, ((b j).natAbs:ℝ)) ≤ (M:ℝ) := by
    have he : ((∑ j, ((a j).natAbs+(b j).natAbs) : ℕ):ℝ) =
        (∑ j, ((a j).natAbs:ℝ))+(∑ j, ((b j).natAbs:ℝ)) := by
      simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [← he]
    exact_mod_cast hM
  have hexp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMc (abs_nonneg (k i*v).re)
  have hfinal : (D:ℝ) ≤ (M:ℝ)*|(k i*v).re| := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcomp (Nat.cast_nonneg D)]
  exact ⟨i,fun j => ⟨hm j,hfinal⟩⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor.Arithmetic
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.CappedResidues
variable {α : Type*} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]
variable (m : α → ℝ) (hm0 : m 0 = 1)
  (hd : ∀ a b : α, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → m a * m b ≤ m |a-b|)
  (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)

def Good (n : ℕ) (x : α) : Prop := c^n ≤ m x
include hc0 hc1 in
omit [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: good_mono
stmt: {n k : ℕ} {x : α} (h : Good m c n x) (hnk : n ≤ k) : Good m c k x
body:
:=
  (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hc0 hc1 hnk).trans h
include hm0 hc0 hc1 in
omit [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: good_zero
stmt: (n : ℕ) : Good m c n 0
body:
:= by
  unfold Good
  rw [hm0]
  exact pow_le_one₀ hc0 hc1
include hd hc0 in
omit [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: good_diff
stmt: {n k : ℕ} {a b : α} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hA : Good m c n a) (hB : Good m c k b) : Good m c (n+k) |a-b|
body:
:= by
  unfold Good at *
  rw [pow_add]
  exact (mul_le_mul hA hB (pow_nonneg hc0 k) ((pow_nonneg hc0 n).trans hA)).trans (hd a b ha hb)

variable {p : α} (hp : 0 < p) (hpG : Good m c 1 p)
include hd hc0 hc1 hp hpG in

name: add_residues
stmt: {a b : α} {n k : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ Set.Ico 0 p) (hb : b ∈ Set.Ico 0 p) (hA : Good m c n a) (hB : Good m c k b) : ∃ r : α, r ∈ Set.Ico 0 p ∧ Good m c (n+k+2) r ∧ ∃ j : ℤ, a+b = r+j•p
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, hap⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨hb0, hbp⟩ := hb
  have ha : a ∈ Set.Ico 0 p := ⟨ha0,hap⟩
  have hb : b ∈ Set.Ico 0 p := ⟨hb0,hbp⟩
  by_cases hs : a+b < p
  · refine ⟨a+b, ⟨add_nonneg ha.1 hb.1, hs⟩, ?_, 0, by simp⟩
    have hpa : Good m c (1+n) (p-a) := by
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2.le)] using
        good_diff m hd c hc0 hp.le ha.1 hpG hA
    have hsub : Good m c (1+n+k) ((p-a)-b) := by
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (p-a)-b by linarith)] using
        good_diff m hd c hc0 (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2.le) hb.1 hpa hB
    have hfinal := good_diff m hd c hc0 hp.le (show 0 ≤ (p-a)-b by linarith) hpG hsub
    have he : |p-((p-a)-b)| = a+b := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; abel
    simpa only [he, show 1+(1+n+k) = n+k+2 by omega] using hfinal
  · refine ⟨a+b-p, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_, 1, by simp⟩
    have hpb : Good m c (1+k) (p-b) := by
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2.le)] using
        good_diff m hd c hc0 hp.le hb.1 hpG hB
    have hfinal := good_diff m hd c hc0 ha.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2.le) hA hpb
    have he : |a-(p-b)| = a+b-p := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; abel
    apply good_mono m c hc0 hc1 (n := n+(1+k)) (hnk := by omega)
    simpa only [he] using hfinal

include hm0 hd hc0 hc1 hp hpG in

name: input_residue
stmt: {x : α} (hx : |x| ≤ p) (hG : Good m c 1 |x|) : ∃ r : α, r ∈ Set.Ico 0 p ∧ Good m c 2 r ∧ ∃ j : ℤ, x = r+j•p
body:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : 0 ≤ x
  · have hxp : x ≤ p := by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hx0] using hx
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hxp with hlt | rfl
    · exact ⟨x, ⟨hx0,hlt⟩, good_mono m c hc0 hc1 (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hx0] using hG) (by omega), 0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl,hp⟩, good_zero m hm0 c hc0 hc1 2, 1, by simp⟩
  · have hn : 0 < -x := neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hx0)
    have hnx : -x ≤ p := by simpa [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hx0)] using hx
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hnx with hlt | heq
    · refine ⟨p+x, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_, -1, by simp⟩
      have hneg : Good m c 1 (-x) := by simpa [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hx0)] using hG
      have hfinal := good_diff m hd c hc0 hp.le hn.le hpG hneg
      simpa only [show |p- -x| = p+x by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]] using hfinal
    · refine ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl,hp⟩, good_zero m hm0 c hc0 hc1 2, -1, ?_⟩
      simp only [neg_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
      linarith

include hm0 hd hc0 hc1 hp hpG in

name: list_residue
stmt: (l : List α) (hl : ∀ x∈l, |x| ≤ p ∧ Good m c 1 |x|) : ∃ r : α, r ∈ Set.Ico 0 p ∧ Good m c (4*l.length) r ∧ ∃ j : ℤ, l.sum = r+j•p
body:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl,hp⟩, good_zero m hm0 c hc0 hc1 _, 0, by simp⟩
  | cons x l ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,ha,hA,i,hi⟩ := input_residue m hm0 hd c hc0 hc1 hp hpG (hl x (List.mem_cons_self)).1 (hl x (List.mem_cons_self)).2
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hB,j,hj⟩ := ih (fun y hy => hl y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    obtain ⟨r,hr,hR,k,hk⟩ := add_residues m hd c hc0 hc1 hp hpG ha hb hA hB
    refine ⟨r,hr,?_,i+j+k,?_⟩
    · simpa only [List.length_cons, show 2+4*l.length+2 = 4*(l.length+1) by omega] using hR
    · simp only [List.sum_cons, hi, hj, add_zsmul]
      calc
        _ = (a+b)+(i•p+j•p) := by abel
        _ = _ := by rw [hk]; abel

include hm0 hd hc0 hc1 hp hpG in

name: list_cap
stmt: (l : List α) (hl : ∀ x∈l, |x| ≤ p ∧ Good m c 1 |x|) (hz : l.sum ∈ Set.Ico 0 p) : Good m c (4*l.length) l.sum
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hR,j,hj⟩ := list_residue m hm0 hd c hc0 hc1 hp hpG l hl
  have hzero : j = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hn | hn
    · have hle : j ≤ -1 := by omega
      have hh : j•p ≤ (-1:ℤ)•p := by
        simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hle) hp.le
      simp only [neg_smul, one_smul] at hh
      linarith [hz.1, hr.2]
    · have hge : 1 ≤ j := by omega
      have hh : (1:ℤ)•p ≤ j•p := by
        simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hge) hp.le
      simp only [one_smul] at hh
      linarith [hz.2, hr.1]
  have he : l.sum = r := by simpa only [hzero, zero_smul, add_zero] using hj
  rw [he]
  exact hR
end EuclideanFiveColor.CappedResidues
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.CappedResidues
variable {α : Type*} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]

def signedList (a : ℤ) (x : α) : List α :=
  match a with
  | .ofNat n => List.replicate n x
  | .negSucc n => List.replicate (n+1) (-x)
omit [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: signedList_length
stmt: (a : ℤ) (x : α) : (signedList a x).length = a.natAbs
body:
:= by
  cases a <;> simp [signedList]
omit [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: signedList_sum
stmt: (a : ℤ) (x : α) : (signedList a x).sum = a • x
body:
:= by
  cases a <;> simp [signedList]
  ring
omit [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: signedList_mem
stmt: (a : ℤ) (x v : α) (hv : v ∈ signedList a x) : |v| = |x|
body:
:= by
  cases a <;> simp only [signedList,List.mem_replicate] at hv
  · rw [hv.2]
  · rw [hv.2,abs_neg]

omit [IsStrictOrderedRing α] in

name: integer_list
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (x : ι → α) : ∃ l : List α, l.length = ∑ i ∈ s, (a i).natAbs ∧ l.sum = ∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i ∧ ∀ v ∈ l, ∃ i ∈ s, |v| = |x i|
body:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨[],by simp,by simp,by simp⟩
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    obtain ⟨l,hl,hs,hv⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨signedList (a i) (x i) ++ l,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · simp [hl,hi]
    · simp [hs,hi]
    · intro v hv'
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hv' with hv' | hv'
      · exact ⟨i,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,signedList_mem _ _ _ hv'⟩
      · obtain ⟨j,hj,he⟩ := hv v hv'
        exact ⟨j,Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj,he⟩

variable (m : α → ℝ) (hm0 : m 0 = 1)
  (hd : ∀ a b : α, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → m a*m b ≤ m |a-b|)
  (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
  {p : α} (hp : 0 < p) (hpG : Good m c 1 p)
include hm0 hd hc0 hc1 hp hpG in

name: integer_cap
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (x : ι → α) (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, |x i| ≤ p ∧ Good m c 1 |x i|) (hz : (∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i) ∈ Set.Ico 0 p) : Good m c (4*∑ i ∈ s, (a i).natAbs) (∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hs,hv⟩ := integer_list s a x
  have he := list_cap m hm0 hd c hc0 hc1 hp hpG l (by
    intro v hvl
    obtain ⟨i,hi,he⟩ := hv v hvl
    rw [he]
    exact hx i hi) (hs.symm ▸ hz)
  rwa [hl,hs] at he
include hm0 hd hc0 hc1 hp hpG in

name: integer_abs_cap
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (x : ι → α) (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, |x i| ≤ p ∧ Good m c 1 |x i|) (hz : |∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i| < p) : Good m c (4*∑ i ∈ s, (a i).natAbs) |∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i|
body:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hn] at hz ⊢
    exact integer_cap m hm0 hd c hc0 hc1 hp hpG s a x hx ⟨hn,hz⟩
  · have hs : (∑ i ∈ s, a i • (-x i)) = -∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i := by simp
    have hz' : (∑ i ∈ s, a i • (-x i)) ∈ Set.Ico 0 p := by
      rw [hs]
      have he : |∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i| = -∑ i ∈ s, a i • x i := abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hn)
      exact ⟨by linarith,he ▸ hz⟩
    have he := integer_cap m hm0 hd c hc0 hc1 hp hpG s a (fun i => -x i)
      (fun i hi => by simpa only [abs_neg] using hx i hi) hz'
    simpa only [hs,abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hn)] using he
end EuclideanFiveColor.CappedResidues
end

end OAI

name: pow_sub_one_bound
body:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : z ^ (n+1) - 1 = z ^ n * (z - 1) + (z ^ n - 1) := by ring
    rw [he]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖z ^ n * (z - 1)‖ + ‖z ^ n - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖z - 1‖ + n * ‖z - 1‖ := by
        simpa only [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, one_mul] using
          add_le_add_right ih ‖z - 1‖
      _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

name: phaseSum_sub_bound
stmt: (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (N : ℕ) : ‖phaseSum z N - (N : ℂ)‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)^2 * ‖z-1‖
body:
:= by
  have he : phaseSum z N - (N : ℂ) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (z^n-1) := by
    simp [phaseSum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖z^n-1‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N, (N : ℝ) * ‖z-1‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      exact (pow_sub_one_bound z hz n).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_range.mp hn).le)
          (norm_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

name: phaseSum_lower
body:
:= by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hb := phaseSum_sub_bound z hz N
  have he : (N : ℝ)^2 * ‖z-1‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)/2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (sq_nonneg (N : ℝ))
    calc
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ)^2 * (1 / (2 * (N : ℝ))) := this
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have ht := norm_sub_norm_le (N : ℂ) (phaseSum z N)
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at ht
  have hn : ‖(N : ℂ)‖ = (N : ℝ) := by simp
  rw [hn] at ht
  linarith

name: phase_energy
stmt: (z : ℂ) (N : ℕ) : ‖phaseSum z N‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (z^i * conj (z^j)).re
body:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (phaseSum z N * conj (phaseSum z N)).re := by
      rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [phaseSum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      change Complex.reCLM (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, _) = _
      simp only [map_sum]
      rfl

name: pow_mul_conj_pow
stmt: (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) {i j : ℕ} (hji : j ≤ i) : z^i * conj (z^j) = z^(i-j)
body:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hji]
  rw [pow_add, mul_assoc, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, norm_pow,
    hz, one_pow, one_pow, Complex.ofReal_one, mul_one]

variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (z : X → ℂ) (hz : Measurable z) (hu : ∀ x, ‖z x‖ = 1)

include hz hu

name: integrable_pair
stmt: (i j : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => z x ^ i * conj (z x ^ j)) μ
body:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp [hu])

omit hz in

name: pair_moment_bound
stmt: {N : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hm : ∀ n, 0 < n → n < N → ‖∫ x, z x ^ n ∂μ‖ ≤ c) {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < N) (hj : j < N) : (∫ x, z x^i * conj (z x^j) ∂μ).re ≤ (if i=j then 1 else 0) + c
body:
:= by
  by_cases he : i = j
  · subst j
    have he : (fun x => z x^i * conj (z x^i)) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
      funext x
      simpa using pow_mul_conj_pow (z x) (hu x) (le_refl i)
    rw [he, integral_const]
    simp [hc]
  · simp only [he, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
    by_cases hji : j ≤ i
    · have he : (fun x => z x^i * conj (z x^j)) = fun x => z x^(i-j) := by
        funext x
        exact pow_mul_conj_pow (z x) (hu x) hji
      rw [he]
      exact (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (hm (i-j) (by omega) (by omega))
    · have he : (fun x => z x^i * conj (z x^j)) =
          fun x => conj (z x^(j-i)) := by
        funext x
        rw [← pow_mul_conj_pow (z x) (hu x) (by omega : i ≤ j)]
        simp only [map_mul, starRingEnd_self_apply]
        exact mul_comm _ _
      rw [he, integral_conj]
      exact (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (by simpa using hm (j-i) (by omega) (by omega))

name: phase_energy_integral_bound
stmt: {N : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hm : ∀ n, 0 < n → n < N → ‖∫ x, z x ^ n ∂μ‖ ≤ c) : (∫ x, ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ N + (N : ℝ)^2 * c
body:
:= by
  simp_rw [phase_energy]
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          (∫ x, z x^i * conj (z x^j) ∂μ).re := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [integral_finsetSum]
        · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          exact (integral_re (integrable_pair μ z hz hu i j))
        · intro j _
          exact (integrable_pair μ z hz hu i j).re
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          ((if i=j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + c) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        exact pair_moment_bound μ z hu hc hm (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left hi])]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
  · intro i _
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (integrable_pair μ z hz hu i j).re)

name: integrable_energy
stmt: (N : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖^2) μ
body:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x, ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖ ≤ N := by
    intro x
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖z x ^ n‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ = N := by simp [hu]
  apply Integrable.of_bound (by unfold phaseSum; fun_prop) ((N : ℝ)^2)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h x) 2)

name: small_arc_bound
body:
:= by
  have hNp : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hs : {x | ‖z x-1‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ))} ⊆
      {x | (N : ℝ)^2 / 4 ≤ ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖ ^ 2} := by
    intro x hx
    have hh := phaseSum_lower (z x) (hu x) hN hx
    change (N : ℝ)^2 / 4 ≤ _
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (phaseSum (z x) N)]
  have hmark := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖))
    (integrable_energy μ z hz hu N) ((N : ℝ)^2/4)
  have he := phase_energy_integral_bound μ z hz hu hc hm
  have hreal := measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hs
  have hm' : (N : ℝ)^2/4 * μ.real {x | ‖z x-1‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ))} ≤
      N + (N : ℝ)^2*c :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (by positivity)).trans (hmark.trans he)
  calc
    _ ≤ (N + (N : ℝ)^2*c)/((N : ℝ)^2/4) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith [hm'])
    _ = _ := by field_simp

local instance : MeasurableSpace Circle := borel Circle
local instance : BorelSpace Circle := ⟨rfl⟩

name: exists_small_arc_constants
stmt: (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : ∃ (ρ c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < N ∧ ∀ (ω : Measure Circle) [IsProbabilityMeasure ω], (∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ N → ‖∫ w, (w : ℂ)^n ∂ω‖ < c) → ω.real {w | ‖(w : ℂ)-1‖ ≤ 4*ρ} < 1/(4*(m : ℝ)^2)
body:
:= by
  let N := 64*m^2
  have hN : 0 < N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hNp : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hmp : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  refine ⟨1/(8*N), 1/N, N, by positivity, by positivity, hN, ?_⟩
  intro ω _ hω
  have hco : Continuous (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ)) := continuous_subtype_val
  have hcm : Measurable (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ)) := hco.measurable
  have hb := small_arc_bound ω (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ))
    hcm Circle.norm_coe hN (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/N)
    (fun n hn hnN => (hω n hn (le_of_lt hnN)).le)
  have hr : 4*(1/(8*(N : ℝ))) = 1/(2*N) := by ring
  rw [hr]
  apply hb.trans_lt
  have he : (N : ℝ) = 64*(m : ℝ)^2 := by dsimp [N]; push_cast; rfl
  rw [he]
  field_simp
  norm_num

end

name: measurable_atom_mass
stmt: (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] : Measurable (fun p : Y × G => κ p.1 {p.2})
body:
:= by
  classical
  let η : Kernel (Y × G) G := κ.comap Prod.fst measurable_fst
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : (Y × G) × G =>
      if p.2 = p.1.2 then (1 : ℝ≥0∞) else 0) :=
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_eq_fun measurable_snd (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))
      measurable_const measurable_const
  have h := hm.lintegral_kernel_prod_right' (κ := η)
  convert h using 1
  ext p
  change κ p.1 {p.2} = ∫⁻ d, (if d=p.2 then (1:ℝ≥0∞) else 0) ∂κ p.1
  simpa only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Pi.one_apply] using
    (lintegral_indicator_one (μ := κ p.1) (measurableSet_singleton p.2)).symm

variable [StandardBorelSpace G] [Nonempty G]

name: ae_sampled_positive_atom
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (p : X → Y) (b : X → G) (hp : Measurable p) (hb : Measurable b) (ha : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ∀ᵐ d ∂condDistrib b p μ y, 0 < condDistrib b p μ y {d}) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < condDistrib b p μ (p x) {b x}
body:
:= by
  have hm : MeasurableSet {z : Y × G | 0 < condDistrib b p μ z.1 {z.2}} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_atom_mass _)
  have he : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map p ⊗ₘ condDistrib b p μ,
      0 < condDistrib b p μ z.1 {z.2} := (Measure.ae_compProd_iff hm).mpr ha
  rw [compProd_map_condDistrib hp.aemeasurable hb.aemeasurable] at he
  exact ae_of_ae_map (hp.prodMk hb).aemeasurable he

omit [StandardBorelSpace G] [Nonempty G] in

name: uniform_list_positive_atoms
stmt: (μ : Measure G) {m : ℕ} (_hm : 0 < m) (g : Fin m → G) (hμ : μ = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i)) : ∀ᵐ d ∂μ, 0 < μ {d}
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hi : (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (by simp)
  have hpt (i : Fin m) : 0 < μ {g i} := by
    rw [hμ, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    apply ENNReal.mul_pos hi
    have hle : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (∑ j, Measure.dirac (g j)) {g i} := by
      rw [Measure.finsetSum_apply]
      calc
        _ = Measure.dirac (g i) {g i} := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ j, Measure.dirac (g j) {g i} :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : Fin m => Measure.dirac (g j) {g i})
            (fun j _ => bot_le) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hle)
  rw [hμ] at hpt ⊢
  rw [Measure.ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff hi, ae_finsetSum_measure_iff]
  intro i _
  simpa only [ae_dirac_eq, Filter.eventually_pure] using hpt i

omit [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace G] [Nonempty G] in

name: in_list_of_positive_atom
stmt: (μ : Measure G) {m : ℕ} (g : Fin m → G) (hμ : μ = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i)) {d : G} (hd : 0 < μ {d}) : ∃ i, d = g i
body:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  have hne (i : Fin m) : g i ≠ d := by intro hi; exact hn ⟨i, hi.symm⟩
  have hz : μ {d} = 0 := by
    rw [hμ, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.finsetSum_apply]
    simp [Measure.dirac_apply', hne]
  exact (ne_of_gt hd) hz

name: ae_sampled_list
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (p : X → Y) (b : X → G) (hp : Measurable p) (hb : Measurable b) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (g : Y → Fin m → G) (hg : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, condDistrib b p μ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g y i)) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ i, b x = g (p x) i
body:
:= by
  have hat := ae_sampled_positive_atom μ p b hp hb
    (hg.mono fun y hy => uniform_list_positive_atoms _ hm (g y) hy)
  filter_upwards [hat, ae_of_ae_map hp.aemeasurable hg] with x hx hxl
  exact in_list_of_positive_atom _ _ hxl hx

name: inner_toLp
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℂ)) : ⟪ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ f, ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ g⟫_ℂ = ⟪Φ f v,Φ g v⟫_ℂ
body:
:= by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, (star f*g) x ∂measure Φ v := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (μ := measure Φ v) (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℂ) f,
        ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (μ := measure Φ v) (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℂ) g] with x hx hy
      simp only [hx,hy,RCLike.inner_apply,ContinuousMap.mul_apply,ContinuousMap.star_apply,Complex.star_def]
      ring
    _ = ⟪v,Φ (star f*g) v⟫_ℂ := integral_complex Φ v _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [map_mul,map_star]
      change ⟪v,star (Φ f) (Φ g v)⟫_ℂ = _
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
def vectorLinear : C(X,ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] H where
  toFun f := Φ f v
  map_add' f g := by simp
  map_smul' c f := by simp

name: norm_toLp
stmt: (f : C(X,ℂ)) : ‖ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ f‖ = ‖vectorLinear Φ v f‖
body:
:= by
  have he := congrArg Complex.re (inner_toLp Φ v f f)
  change RCLike.re (⟪ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ f,ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ f⟫_ℂ) =
    RCLike.re (⟪Φ f v,Φ f v⟫_ℂ) at he
  rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq,inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at he
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp he
def cyclicMap : Lp ℂ 2 (measure Φ v) →L[ℂ] H :=
  (vectorLinear Φ v).extendOfNorm (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ).toLinearMap

name: cyclicMap_toLp
stmt: (f : C(X,ℂ)) : cyclicMap Φ v (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ f) = Φ f v
body:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm_eq
  · exact ContinuousMap.toLp_denseRange (E := ℂ) (p := 2) (μ := measure Φ v) (𝕜 := ℂ) (by norm_num)
  · exact ⟨1,fun g => by simp only [one_mul]; exact le_of_eq (norm_toLp Φ v g).symm⟩

name: norm_cyclicMap
stmt: (f : Lp ℂ 2 (measure Φ v)) : ‖cyclicMap Φ v f‖ = ‖f‖
body:
:= by
  refine (ContinuousMap.toLp_denseRange (E := ℂ) (p := 2) (μ := measure Φ v) (𝕜 := ℂ) (by norm_num)).induction
    (fun y hy => ?_) (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)) f
  obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [cyclicMap_toLp]
  exact (norm_toLp Φ v g).symm
def cyclicIsometry : Lp ℂ 2 (measure Φ v) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] H :=
  ⟨(cyclicMap Φ v).toLinearMap,norm_cyclicMap Φ v⟩

open MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
def mulLp (f : Func X) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
  ((memLp μ f ∞).fun_mul (Lp.memLp g)).toLp (fun point => f point * g point)

name: mulLp_ae
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : mulLp μ f g =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x * g x
body:
:= MemLp.coeFn_toLp _
def mulLpLinear (f : Func X) : Lp ℂ 2 μ →ₗ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ where
  toFun := mulLp μ f
  map_add' g h := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [mulLp_ae μ f (g+h),mulLp_ae μ f g,mulLp_ae μ f h,
      Lp.coeFn_add g h,Lp.coeFn_add (mulLp μ f g) (mulLp μ f h)] with x ha hb hc hd he
    simp only [ha,he,Pi.add_apply,hb,hc,hd]
    exact mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' c g := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [mulLp_ae μ f (c • g),mulLp_ae μ f g,
      Lp.coeFn_smul c g,Lp.coeFn_smul c (mulLp μ f g)] with x ha hb hc hd
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply,ha,hd,Pi.smul_apply,hb,hc,smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: mulLp_norm_le
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) {C : ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) : ‖mulLp μ f g‖ ≤ C * ‖g‖
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
  filter_upwards [mulLp_ae μ f g] with x hx
  rw [hx,norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hf x) (norm_nonneg _)
def mulLpCLM (f : Func X) : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
  (mulLpLinear μ f).mkContinuous (bound f) (fun g => mulLp_norm_le μ f g (norm_le_bound f))

name: mulLpCLM_ae
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : mulLpCLM μ f g =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x * g x
body: := mulLp_ae μ f g

name: mulLp_l2
stmt: (f g : Func X) : mulLpCLM μ f (l2 μ g) = l2 μ (f*g)
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [mulLpCLM_ae μ f (l2 μ g),l2_ae μ g,l2_ae μ (f*g)] with x hx hy hz
  rw [hx,hy,hz]; rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.CommutingSpectral
variable {G H : Type*} [CommGroup G]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (U : G →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))
abbrev algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  (StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun g => (U g : H →L[ℂ] H)))).topologicalClosure
instance algebra_closed : IsClosed (algebra U : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) :=
  StarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _

name: adjoin_comm
stmt: : IsMulCommutative (StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (fun g => (U g : H →L[ℂ] H))))
body:
:= by
  apply StarAlgebra.isMulCommutative_adjoin
  · rintro _ ⟨element,rfl⟩
    infer_instance
  · rintro _ ⟨left,rfl⟩ _ ⟨right,rfl⟩ _
    change ((U left * U right : unitary _) : H →L[ℂ] H) = ((U right * U left : unitary _) : H →L[ℂ] H)
    rw [← map_mul,← map_mul,mul_comm]
  · rintro _ ⟨left,rfl⟩ _ ⟨right,rfl⟩ _
    change ((U left * (U right)⁻¹ : unitary _) : H →L[ℂ] H) = (((U right)⁻¹ * U left : unitary _) : H →L[ℂ] H)
    rw [← map_inv,← map_mul,← map_mul,mul_comm]
open scoped IsMulCommutative in
instance algebra_commRing : CommRing (algebra U) :=
  let := adjoin_comm U
  inferInstance
instance algebra_commCStar : CommCStarAlgebra (algebra U) where

def generator (g : G) : algebra U :=
  ⟨U g,StarSubalgebra.le_topologicalClosure _ (StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Set.mem_range_self g))⟩

name: generator_one
stmt: : generator U 1 = 1
body: := by ext; simp [generator]

name: generator_mul
stmt: (g h : G) : generator U (g*h) = generator U g * generator U h
body:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; change (U (g*h) : H →L[ℂ] H) = (U g : H →L[ℂ] H) * U h
  rw [map_mul]; rfl

name: generator_unitary
stmt: (g : G) : generator U g ∈ unitary (algebra U)
body:
:= by
  constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
  · exact (U g).property.1
  · exact (U g).property.2
variable [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
abbrev Spectrum := WeakDual.characterSpace ℂ (algebra U)
def character (φ : Spectrum U) : PontryaginDual G where
  toFun g := ⟨gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U g) φ, by
    change gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U g) φ ∈ Metric.sphere (0:ℂ) 1
    rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right]
    apply CStarRing.norm_of_mem_unitary
    exact Unitary.map_mem ((ContinuousMap.evalStarAlgHom ℂ ℂ φ).comp
      (gelfandStarTransform (algebra U)).toStarAlgHom) (generator_unitary U g)⟩
  map_one' := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change _ = (gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U g) φ) *
      (gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U h) φ)
    simp
  continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology

name: character_apply
stmt: (φ : Spectrum U) (g : G) : (character U φ g : ℂ) = gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U g) φ
body: := rfl

name: character_continuous
stmt: : Continuous (character U)
body:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosedEmbedding_coe.isEmbedding.isInducing.continuous_iff.mpr
  apply continuous_pi; intro g
  exact Continuous.subtype_mk (map_continuous (gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U g))) _
def calculus : C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  (algebra U).subtype.comp <| (gelfandStarTransform (algebra U)).symm.toStarAlgHom.comp
    (ContinuousMap.compStarAlgHom' ℂ ℂ ⟨character U,character_continuous U⟩)
def evaluation (g : G) : C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun d => (d g : ℂ),continuous_subtype_val.comp ((continuous_apply g).comp ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosedEmbedding_coe.continuous)⟩

name: calculus_evaluation
stmt: (g : G) : calculus U (evaluation g) = U g
body:
:= by
  change ((gelfandStarTransform (algebra U)).symm ((evaluation g).comp ⟨character U,character_continuous U⟩) : H →L[ℂ] H) = U g
  have he : (evaluation g).comp ⟨character U,character_continuous U⟩ =
      gelfandStarTransform (algebra U) (generator U g) := by ext φ; rfl
  rw [he,StarAlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]; rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor.CommutingSpectral

name: mulCM_toLp
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℂ)) : mulLpCLM (measure Φ v) (boundedCM f) (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ g) = ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (measure Φ v) ℂ (f*g)

name: cyclicMap_inner
stmt: (f g : Lp ℂ 2 (measure Φ v)) : ⟪cyclicMap Φ v f,cyclicMap Φ v g⟫_ℂ = ⟪f,g⟫_ℂ

name: cyclicMap_pair_one
stmt: (f : Func X) : ⟪v,cyclicMap Φ v (l2 (measure Φ v) f)⟫_ℂ = ∫ x, f x ∂measure Φ v

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (U : DiscreteE →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) (v : H)
def ordinaryIndicator : Func D :=
  ⟨(C:Set D).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℂ)),measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_C,
    1,fun d => by by_cases hd : d ∈ C <;> simp [Set.indicator_of_mem,Set.indicator_of_notMem,hd]⟩

name: ordinaryIndicator_apply
stmt: (d : D) : ordinaryIndicator d = (C:Set D).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℂ)) d
body: := rfl

name: ordinary_eval_continuous
stmt: {d : D} (hd : d ∈ C) : Continuous (fun z : E => (eval z d : ℂ))
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ,rfl⟩ := hd
  change Continuous (fun z : E => (Circle.exp (inner ℝ (Multiplicative.toAdd ξ) (z:ℂ)) : ℂ))
  fun_prop

name: ordinary_difference_tendsto
stmt: (μ : Measure D) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : Tendsto (fun z : E => ∫ d, ‖((eval z d : ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d‖^2 ∂μ) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  have hm (z : E) : Measurable (fun d => ‖((eval z d : ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d‖^2) := by
    have he : Measurable (fun d : D => (eval z d : ℂ)) := (evaluation (G := DiscreteE) (Multiplicative.ofAdd z)).continuous.measurable
    exact ((he.sub measurable_const).mul (measurable ordinaryIndicator)).norm.pow_const 2
  have hb (z : E) (d : D) : ‖‖((eval z d : ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d‖^2‖ ≤ (4:ℝ) := by
    have hi : ‖ordinaryIndicator d‖ ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases hd : d ∈ C <;> simp [ordinaryIndicator_apply,hd]
    have he : ‖(eval z d : ℂ)-1‖ ≤ 2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖(eval z d : ℂ)‖ + ‖(1:ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = 2 := by rw [Circle.norm_coe, norm_one]; norm_num
    have hn : ‖((eval z d : ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d‖ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact (mul_le_mul he hi (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (by norm_num)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (((eval z d:ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d)]
  have hl (d : D) : Tendsto (fun z : E => ‖((eval z d : ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d‖^2)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0:ℝ)) := by
    by_cases hd : d ∈ C
    · have he := ((ordinary_eval_continuous hd).tendsto (0:E)).sub_const (1:ℂ)
      have ht := (he.mul_const (ordinaryIndicator d)).norm.pow 2
      have hz : (eval (0:E) d : ℂ) = 1 := by
        change (d 1 : ℂ) = 1
        rw [map_one]; rfl
      simpa only [hz,sub_self,zero_mul,norm_zero,zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)] using ht
    · simp only [ordinaryIndicator_apply,Set.indicator_of_notMem hd,mul_zero,norm_zero,zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
  have ht := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (μ := μ) (fun _ : D => (4:ℝ))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z : E => (hm z).aestronglyMeasurable))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z : E => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hb z)))
    (integrable_const (4:ℝ)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hl)
  simpa only [integral_zero] using ht

def ordinaryVector : H := cyclicMap (calculus U) v (l2 (measure (calculus U) v) ordinaryIndicator)

name: ordinaryVector_continuous
stmt: : ordinaryVector U v ∈ ContinuousVectors.space U
body:
:= by
  let μ := measure (calculus U) v
  have he (z : E) : ContinuousVectors.op U z (ordinaryVector U v) - ordinaryVector U v =
      cyclicMap (calculus U) v (l2 μ ((boundedCM (evaluation (G := DiscreteE) (Multiplicative.ofAdd z))-1)*ordinaryIndicator)) := by
    dsimp [ordinaryVector,μ]
    rw [sub_mul,map_sub,one_mul,map_sub]
    rw [← mulLp_l2,cyclicMap_mul]
    rw [calculus_evaluation U (Multiplicative.ofAdd z : DiscreteE)]
    rfl
  have hn (z : E) : ‖ContinuousVectors.op U z (ordinaryVector U v) - ordinaryVector U v‖^2 =
      ∫ d, ‖((eval z d:ℂ)-1)*ordinaryIndicator d‖^2 ∂μ := by
    rw [he]
    change ‖cyclicIsometry (calculus U) v _‖^2 = _
    rw [LinearIsometry.norm_map,norm_l2_sq]
    rfl
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have ht := Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto (0:ℝ) |>.comp (ordinary_difference_tendsto μ)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,← hn,Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _),Real.sqrt_zero] using ht

name: measure_ordinary_zero_of_orthogonal
stmt: (hv : v ∈ (ContinuousVectors.space U)ᗮ) : measure (calculus U) v (C:Set D) = 0
body:
:= by
  have ho := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal' _ _).mp hv (ordinaryVector U v) (ordinaryVector_continuous U v)
  have hp := cyclicMap_pair_one (calculus U) v ordinaryIndicator
  change ⟪v,ordinaryVector U v⟫_ℂ = _ at hp
  rw [ho] at hp
  have hz : (measure (calculus U) v).real (C:Set D) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg Complex.re hp
    simpa only [ordinaryIndicator_apply,integral_indicator measurableSet_C,integral_const,
      Measure.restrict_apply_univ,Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul,mul_one,Complex.zero_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Measure.real] using this.symm
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz |>.resolve_right (measure_ne_top _ _)
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

name: evaluation_one
stmt: : evaluation (1:G) = 1
body:
:= by
  ext d
  change (d 1 : ℂ) = 1
  rw [map_one]; rfl

name: evaluation_mul
stmt: (g h : G) : evaluation (g*h) = evaluation g * evaluation h
body:
:= by
  ext d
  change (d (g*h) : ℂ) = (d g : ℂ)*(d h : ℂ)
  rw [map_mul]; rfl

name: star_evaluation
stmt: (g : G) : star (evaluation g) = evaluation g⁻¹
body:
:= by
  ext d
  change star (d g : ℂ) = (d g⁻¹ : ℂ)
  rw [map_inv]
  exact (Circle.coe_inv_eq_conj (d g)).symm
@[simps] def evaluationHom : G →* C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ) where

name: evaluation_span_dense
stmt: : Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (evaluation (G := G))) : Set C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ))
body:
:= by
  let A := StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (Set.range (evaluation (G := G)))
  have hs : star (Set.range (evaluation (G := G))) = Set.range (evaluation (G := G)) := by
    ext f
    rw [Set.mem_star]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
      refine ⟨g⁻¹,?_⟩
      rw [← star_evaluation,hg,star_star]
    · rintro ⟨g,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨g⁻¹,(star_evaluation g).symm⟩
  have he : A.toSubalgebra.toSubmodule = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (evaluation (G := G))) := by
    rw [StarAlgebra.adjoin_eq_span,hs,Set.union_self]
    have hc : Submonoid.closure (Set.range (evaluation (G := G))) = MonoidHom.mrange (evaluationHom (G := G)) :=
      Submonoid.closure_eq (MonoidHom.mrange (evaluationHom (G := G)))
    rw [hc]
    rfl
  have hsep : A.SeparatesPoints := by
    intro d e hde
    have hn : ∃ g, d g ≠ e g := by
      by_contra! h
      exact hde (DFunLike.ext _ _ h)
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hn
    refine ⟨evaluation g,⟨evaluation g,StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Set.mem_range_self g),rfl⟩,?_⟩
    change (d g : ℂ) ≠ (e g : ℂ)
    exact fun h => hg (Subtype.ext h)
  have ht := ContinuousMap.starSubalgebra_topologicalClosure_eq_top_of_separatesPoints A hsep
  rw [dense_iff_closure_eq,← he]
  change closure (A:Set C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ)) = _
  rw [← StarSubalgebra.topologicalClosure_coe,ht]
  rfl

name: integrableCM
stmt: (f : C(X,ℂ)) : Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ

:=

def linear : C(X,ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun f := ∫ x, f x ∂μ
  map_add' f g := integral_add (integrableCM μ f) (integrableCM μ g)
  map_smul' c f := integral_smul c f

name: norm_le
stmt: (f : C(X,ℂ)) : ‖linear μ f‖ ≤ μ.real Set.univ * ‖f‖
body:
:= by
  simpa only [linear,LinearMap.coe_mk,AddHom.coe_mk,mul_comm] using
    norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := μ) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm f))
def clm : C(X,ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := (linear μ).mkContinuous (μ.real Set.univ) (norm_le μ)

name: apply_clm
stmt: (f : C(X,ℂ)) : clm μ f = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
body:
:= rfl

  [MeasurableSpace (PontryaginDual G)] [BorelSpace (PontryaginDual G)]

name: measure_eq_of_fourier
stmt: (μ ν : Measure (PontryaginDual G)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular] (h : ∀ g, ∫ d, (d g : ℂ) ∂μ = ∫ d, (d g : ℂ) ∂ν) : μ = ν
body:
:= by

    rintro _ ⟨g,rfl⟩
    exact h g
  apply Measure.ext_of_integral_eq_on_compactlySupported
  intro f
  let fc : C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ) := ⟨fun d => (f d : ℂ),by fun_prop⟩
  have hh := congrArg (fun L : C(PontryaginDual G,ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ => (L fc).re) he
  simpa only [CompactIntegral.apply_clm,fc,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,integral_complex_ofReal,Complex.ofReal_re] using hh

name: normalized_increment_endpoint_gap
stmt: {l r a : ℝ} (hlr : l<r) {u δ : ℕ → ℝ} {v : ℝ} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hv : (a=l ∧ 0<v) ∨ (a=r ∧ v<0)) (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a)) (hs : Tendsto (fun n => (u n-a)/δ n) atTop (𝓝 v)) : ∀ᶠn in atTop,u n∈Ioo l r
body:
:= by
  rcases hv with ⟨rfl,hv⟩ | ⟨rfl,hv⟩
  · exact positive_normalized_increment_enters_gap hlr hδ hv hu hs
  · filter_upwards [hu.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hlr),hs.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hv)] with n hn hp
    exact ⟨hn,sub_neg.mp ((div_neg_iff.mp hp).resolve_left (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge (hδ n).le) h.2)).1⟩
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)

name: four_support_positive
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) : 0<volume (fourSupport c hc x s)
body:
:= by
  apply (four_realState_positive c hc hw hx hs).trans_le
  apply measure_mono_ae
  exact (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x s)).mp
    (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x s)).support_mem_ae

name: four_other_union
stmt: (x : ℂ) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) : fourNonSingleton c hc x=fourSupport c hc x s∪fourSupport c hc x (if s=1 then 2 else 1)
body:
:= by
  fin_cases s
  · exact (hs rfl).elim
  · rfl
  · exact Set.union_comm _ _

name: four_endpoint_sequence_false
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FourCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FourCenter c x) (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)) atTop (𝓝 H)) {l r a : ℝ} (hlr : l<r) (haEnd : a=l ∨ a=r) (hgap : Ioo l r⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) (ha : a∈fourSupport c hc x s) (hHa : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0) : False
body:
:= by
  classical
  let t : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have ht : t≠0 := by dsimp [t]; split <;> decide
  have hRaN := four_gap_shift_subset c hc hw hx hlr hgap
    (show a+sixty∈Icc (l+sixty) (r+sixty) from by rcases haEnd with rfl|rfl <;> constructor <;> linarith)
  have hRa : a+sixty∈fourSupport c hc x t := by
    change a+sixty∈fourNonSingleton c hc x at hRaN
    rw [four_other_union c hc x hs] at hRaN
    exact hRaN.resolve_left (four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hs ha)
  obtain ⟨b0,hb0,b1,hb1,hb0a,hb1a,hv01⟩ := exists_transportVelocity_lt
    (four_support_positive c hc hw hx ht) hHa
  have hp : ∃b b',b∈fourSupport c hc x t ∧ b'∈fourSupport c hc x t ∧
      Real.sin (b-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (b'-a)≠0 ∧
      ((a=l ∧ 0<transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b') ∨
       (a=r ∧ transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b'<0)) := by
    rcases haEnd with hal|har
    · exact ⟨b1,b0,hb1,hb0,hb1a,hb0a,Or.inl ⟨hal,sub_pos.mpr hv01⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨b0,b1,hb0,hb1,hb0a,hb1a,Or.inr ⟨har,sub_neg.mpr hv01⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨b,b',hb,hb',hab,hab',hvel⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨bn,hbn,hbt⟩ := four_support_continuity c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hb'
  obtain ⟨dn,hdn,hdt⟩ := four_support_continuity c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hRa
  let Hn := fun n => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)
  have hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self,map_zero,Function.comp_def] using
      Complex.equivRealProdCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hy.sub_const x)
  let cn := fun n => (sumTransport hab (Hn n) (a,b)).1
  have hcn : Tendsto cn atTop (𝓝 a) := (sumTransport_tendsto hab hH tendsto_const_nhds).fst_nhds
  have hneg : Tendsto (fun n => -Hn n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hH.neg
  let un := fun n => (sumTransport hab' (-Hn n) (cn n,bn n)).1
  have hun : Tendsto un atTop (𝓝 a) :=
    (sumTransport_tendsto hab' hneg (hcn.prodMk_nhds hbt)).fst_nhds
  have huGap : ∀ᶠn in atTop,un n∈Ioo l r := normalized_increment_endpoint_gap hlr hδ hvel hun
    (sumTransport_double_increment hab hab' hH hbt hδ hdir)
  obtain ⟨P,V,hP,hP0,hV,haV,K,hbranch⟩ := sumTransport_neighborhood hab
  have hcN : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∈fourNonSingleton c hc (yn n) := by
    filter_upwards [hH.eventually (hP.mem_nhds hP0)] with n hn
    exact (four_support_transport c hc hw hx (hyn n) hs ha hb hab hV haV hbranch hn).1
  obtain ⟨P',V',hP',hP0',hV',haV',K',hbranch'⟩ := sumTransport_neighborhood hab'
  have hcNot : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∉fourSupport c hc (yn n) s := by
    filter_upwards [hneg.eventually (hP'.mem_nhds hP0'),
      (hcn.prodMk_nhds hbt).eventually (hV'.mem_nhds haV'),huGap] with n hn hqn hgn hcu
    have hcenter : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x-yn n)= -Hn n := by
      dsimp [Hn]
      rw [← map_neg,neg_sub]
    have htr := four_support_transport_general c hc hw (hyn n) hx hs hab' hcu (hbn n)
      hV' hqn hbranch' (hcenter.symm ▸ hn)
    rw [hcenter] at htr
    exact hgap hgn htr.1
  have hcT : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t := by
    filter_upwards [hcN,hcNot] with n hn hnot
    rw [four_other_union c hc (yn n) hs] at hn
    exact hn.resolve_left hnot
  let vn := fun n => if h : cn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t then cn n
    else (four_support_nonempty c hc hw (hyn n) ht).choose
  have hvn : ∀n,vn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t := by
    intro n
    dsimp [vn]
    split
    · assumption
    · exact (four_support_nonempty c hc hw (hyn n) ht).choose_spec
  have hvlim : Tendsto vn atTop (𝓝 a) := hcn.congr' (by
    filter_upwards [hcT] with n hn
    simp only [vn,dite_eq_left hn])
  exact four_support_sequence_no_unit c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hvlim hdt hvn hdn (direction_sixty_unit_real a)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: gap_endpoint_nonorthogonal
stmt: {H : ℝ×ℝ} (hH : H≠0) {a b : ℝ} (hab : 0<b-a) (hab' : b-a<Real.pi) : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0 ∨ H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b≠0
body:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have hs := (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hab hab').ne'
  have h1 : H.1*Real.sin (b-a)=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination Real.sin b*h.1-Real.sin a*h.2
  have h2 : H.2*Real.sin (b-a)=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination -Real.cos b*h.1+Real.cos a*h.2
  apply hH
  exact Prod.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_right hs) ((mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_right hs)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: triple_subset_pair
stmt: {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {S : Finset α} {a b d : α} (hS : S.card ≤ 2) (hsub : S ⊆ {a,b,d}) : S ⊆ {a,b} ∨ S ⊆ {a,d} ∨ S ⊆ {b,d}
body:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a=b
  · subst b
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by simpa using hsub))
  by_cases ha : a∈S
  · by_cases hb : b∈S
    · left
      intro x hx
      by_contra hn
      have hxne : x≠a ∧ x≠b := by simpa only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] using hn
      have : 3 ≤ S.card := by
        have hh : ({a,b,x} : Finset α) ⊆ S := by simp only [Finset.insert_subset_iff,Finset.singleton_subset_iff]; exact ⟨ha,hb,hx⟩
        have hc := Finset.card_le_card hh
        simpa [hab,hxne.1.symm,hxne.2.symm] using hc
      omega
    · right; left
      intro x hx
      have := hsub hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at this ⊢
      rcases this with h|h|h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact False.elim (hb (h ▸ hx))
      · exact Or.inr h
  · right; right
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_insert.mp (hsub hx)).resolve_left (fun h => ha (h ▸ hx))

name: triangle_binary
stmt: (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {a b d i j : Fin 5} (hab : TransitionEdge c a b x) (had : TransitionEdge c a d x) (hbd : TransitionEdge c b d x) (hcomp : Finset.univ\{a,b,d}={i,j}) : BinaryCenter c hc x i j
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [palette_cardinality c hc hw x,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hab,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw had,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hbd] with t ht hab had hbd
  by_contra hn
  have hnot : i∉palette c hc x t ∧ j∉palette c hc x t := by
    simpa only [mem_palette,not_or] using hn
  have hsub : palette c hc x t ⊆ {a,b,d} := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hns
    have : s∈({i,j} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by rw [← hcomp]; simp [hns]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at this
    rcases this with rfl|rfl
    · exact hnot.1 hs
    · exact hnot.2 hs
  rcases triple_subset_pair ht.2 hsub with h|h|h
  · exact hab h
  · exact had h
  · exact hbd h

name: triangle_centers_separated
stmt: (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) (a b d i j : Fin 5) (hcomp : Finset.univ\{a,b,d}={i,j}) : ∃ δ>0, ∀ x z : ℂ, TransitionEdge c a b x → TransitionEdge c a d x → TransitionEdge c b d x → TransitionEdge c a b z → TransitionEdge c a d z → TransitionEdge c b d z → x≠z → δ≤dist x z
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsep⟩ := binary_centers_separated c hc hw
  exact ⟨δ,hδ,fun x z h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 hne => hsep x z i j
    (triangle_binary c hc hw h1 h2 h3 hcomp) (triangle_binary c hc hw h4 h5 h6 hcomp) hne⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k)

name: transitionRatio_mono
stmt: {i j : Fin k} {x y : ℂ} {R S : ℝ} (hB : Metric.ball x R ⊆ Metric.ball y S) (h : ℂ) : transitionRatio c i j x R h ≤ transitionRatio c i j y S h
body:
:= by
  apply ENNReal.div_le_div_right
  exact measure_mono (fun _ hq => ⟨hB hq.1,hq.2⟩)

name: transitionEdge_closed
stmt: (i j : Fin k) : IsClosed {x | TransitionEdge c i j x}
body:
:= by
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro x hx
  have hne : i≠j := by
    obtain ⟨y,_,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hx Set.univ isOpen_univ (mem_univ _)
    exact hy.1
  refine ⟨hne,fun R hR => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hyB,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hx (Metric.ball x (R/2)) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith))
  have hB : Metric.ball y (R/2) ⊆ Metric.ball x R := by
    intro z hz
    have ht := dist_triangle z y x
    have hz' : dist z y < R/2 := hz
    have hy' : dist y x < R/2 := hyB
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt ht (by linarith)
  exact (hy.2 (R/2) (by linarith)).trans_le (limsup_le_limsup
    (Eventually.of_forall (transitionRatio_mono c hB)))

name: missing_edge_lim
stmt: (i j : Fin k) (hne : i≠j) {x : ℂ} (he : ¬TransitionEdge c i j x) : ∃ R>0, Tendsto (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hr⟩ : ∃ R, 0<R ∧ ¬0<limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) := by
    have hh : ¬∀ R, 0<R → 0<limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) :=
      fun hh => he ⟨hne,hh⟩
    push Not at hh
    exact ⟨hh.choose,hh.choose_spec.1,not_lt.mpr hh.choose_spec.2⟩
  refine ⟨R,hR,?_⟩
  have hs : limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ))=0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hr) (bot_le)
  exact tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le (bot_le) hs.le
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: four_normalized_sequence_false
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FourCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FourCenter c x) (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hH : H≠0) (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)) atTop (𝓝 H)) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hab,hab',hgap⟩ := four_gap_exists c hc hw hx
  have hp : b-a<Real.pi := hab'.trans_lt (by dsimp [sixty]; linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  rcases gap_endpoint_nonorthogonal hH (sub_pos.mpr hab) hp with hda|hdb
  · rcases ha with ha|ha
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inl rfl) hgap (by decide) ha hda
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inl rfl) hgap (by decide) ha hda
  · rcases hb with hb|hb
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inr rfl) hgap (by decide) hb hdb
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inr rfl) hgap (by decide) hb hdb

name: four_sequence_no_accumulation
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FourCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FourCenter c x) (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) (hne : ∀n,yn n≠x) : False
body:
:= by
  let Hn := fun n => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)
  have hn : ∀n,Hn n≠0 := by
    intro n h
    apply hne n
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    exact Complex.equivRealProdCLM.injective (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  let δ := fun n => ‖Hn n‖
  have hδ : ∀n,0<δ n := fun n => norm_pos_iff.mpr (hn n)
  have hd : ∀n,(δ n)⁻¹•Hn n∈Metric.sphere 0 1 := by
    intro n
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    exact norm_smul_inv_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) (hn n)
  obtain ⟨H,hH,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : RealPlane) 1).tendsto_subseq hd
  have hH0 : H≠0 := by
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm] at hH
    intro hz
    simp only [hz,norm_zero] at hH
    norm_num at hH
  exact four_normalized_sequence_false c hc hw (fun n => hyn (φ n)) hx
    (hy.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hδ (φ n)) hH0 hlim
omit hc in

name: fourCenter_closed
stmt: : IsClosed {x | FourCenter c x}
body:
:=
  (transitionEdge_closed c 0 1).inter ((transitionEdge_closed c 1 2).inter
    ((transitionEdge_closed c 2 3).inter (transitionEdge_closed c 3 0)))

name: fourCenter_discrete
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) : IsDiscrete {x | FourCenter c x}
body:
:= by
  apply isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mpr
  apply discreteTopology_of_noAccPts
  intro x hx ha
  obtain ⟨yn,hyn,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp
    (accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt.mp ha).mem_closure
  exact four_sequence_no_accumulation c hc hw (fun n => (hyn n).1) hx hy
    (fun n => by simpa only [mem_singleton_iff] using (hyn n).2)

name: fourCenter_compact_finite
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) : (K∩{x | FourCenter c x}).Finite
body:
:=
  (hK.inter_right (fourCenter_closed c)).finite ((fourCenter_discrete c hc hw).mono inter_subset_right)

name: weak_relabel
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) : WeakColoring k (e ∘ c)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨(measurable_of_finite e).comp_aemeasurable hw.1,?_⟩
  exact hw.2.mono fun p hp h => hp (e.injective h)

name: transitionSet_relabel
stmt: (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ℂ) : transitionSet (e ∘ c) (e i) (e j) x R h=transitionSet c i j x R h
body:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [transitionSet,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,Function.comp_apply,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]

name: transitionEdge_relabel
stmt: (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) : TransitionEdge (e ∘ c) (e i) (e j) x ↔ TransitionEdge c i j x
body:
:= by
  have he : transitionRatio (e ∘ c) (e i) (e j) x=transitionRatio c i j x := by
    funext R h
    unfold transitionRatio
    rw [transitionSet_relabel]
  simp only [TransitionEdge,he,ne_eq,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]

name: transitionEdge_symm
stmt: {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (h : TransitionEdge c i j x) : TransitionEdge c j i x
body:
:= by
  have he : transitionRatio c j i x=transitionRatio c i j x := by
    funext R z
    have hs : transitionSet c j i x R z=transitionSet c i j x R z := by
      ext q
      simp only [transitionSet,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,or_comm]
    change volume _ / _ = volume _ / _
    rw [hs]
  exact ⟨h.1.symm,by simpa only [he] using h.2⟩

name: palette_eq_measurable

    (Measurable.ite (palette_eq_measurable c hc x _) measurable_const

name: dense_isolated_value_constant
stmt: {E F : Type*} [MetricSpace E] [PreconnectedSpace E] {G : Set E} (hG : Dense G) (f : E → F) {b : F} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hne : ∃x∈G,f x=b) (hl : ∀x∈G,f x=b → ∀y∈G,dist x y<ε → f y=b) : ∀y∈G,f y=b
body:
:= by
  let A : Set E := {x | x∈G ∧ f x=b}
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := hne
  have hAopen : IsOpen (closure A) := by
    apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hx ε hε
    have hsub : Metric.ball a ε∩G⊆A := by
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨hy.2,hl a ha.1 ha.2 y hy.2 (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using hy.1)⟩
    have hball : Metric.ball a ε⊆closure A := by
      intro y hy
      apply closure_mono hsub
      exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter_closure ⟨hy,hG y⟩
    exact ⟨Metric.ball a ε,hball,Metric.isOpen_ball,had⟩
  have hfull : closure A=univ := (show IsClopen (closure A) from ⟨isClosed_closure,hAopen⟩).eq_univ
    (hAne.mono subset_closure)
  intro y hy
  have hym : y∈closure A := by rw [hfull]; trivial
  obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hym ε hε
  exact hl a ha.1 ha.2 y hy (by simpa only [dist_comm] using had)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: sixty_six
stmt: : (6 : ℕ) • (sixty : Angles)=0

name: four_words_no_mixed
stmt: (G : Set Angles) (hG : Dense G) (w : Angles → Fin 6 → Fin 3) (hv : ∀t∈G,FourWordValid (w t)) (hshiftG : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G) (hshift : ∀t∈G,∀j,w (t+(sixty : Angles)) j=w t (j+1)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hcross : ∀t∈G,∀u∈G,dist t u<ε → FourWordCross (w t) (w u)) : ∀t∈G,¬FourWordMixed (w t)
body:
:= by
  intro t ht hm
  have he : ∀u∈G,w u=w t := by
    apply dense_isolated_value_constant hG w hε ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
    intro u hu hue v hv' hdist
    exact (four_word_mixed_isolated (w u) (hv u hu) (by rw [hue]; exact hm)
      (w v) (hv v hv') (hcross u hu v hv' hdist)).trans hue
  have hconst := congrFun (he (t+(sixty : Angles)) (hshiftG t ht)) 0
  rw [hshift t ht 0] at hconst
  exact (hv t ht).1 0 hconst.symm
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
                                                                                 
def Straddle (K : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ := {z | ∃p∈K,∃q∈K,dist z p<1 ∧ 1<dist z q}

name: straddle_isOpen
stmt: (K : Set ℂ) : IsOpen (Straddle K)
body:
:= by
  have he : Straddle K=⋃p∈K,⋃q∈K,{z | dist z p<1 ∧ 1<dist z q} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Straddle,mem_iUnion,mem_ofPred_eq,exists_prop]
  rw [he]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ =>
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const))

name: straddle_connected_unit
stmt: {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K) {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈Straddle K) : ∃p∈K,dist z p=1
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,q,hq,hp1,hq1⟩ := hz
  exact hK.intermediate_value hp hq (continuous_const.dist continuous_id).continuousOn ⟨hp1.le,hq1.le⟩

name: approaching_direction_inside
stmt: {r : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℂ} {v e : ℂ} (hr : ∀n,0<r n) (hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hw : ∀n,‖w n‖=1) (hwv : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 v)) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : 0<⟪e,v⟫) : ∀ᶠn in atTop,‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖<1
body:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => 2*⟪e,w n⟫-r n) atTop (𝓝 (2*⟪e,v⟫)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using ((tendsto_const_nhds.inner hwv).const_mul 2).sub hr0
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2*⟪e,v⟫))] with n hn
  have heq : ‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖^2=1-2*r n*⟪e,w n⟫+(r n)^2 := by
    change ‖e-r n • w n‖^2= _
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real,inner_smul_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hr n),he,hw]
    ring
  have hpos := mul_pos (hr n) hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (e-(r n : ℂ)*w n)]

name: approaching_direction_outside
stmt: {r : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℂ} {v e : ℂ} (hr : ∀n,0<r n) (hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hw : ∀n,‖w n‖=1) (hwv : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 v)) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : ⟪e,v⟫<0) : ∀ᶠn in atTop,1<‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖
body:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => 2*⟪e,w n⟫-r n) atTop (𝓝 (2*⟪e,v⟫)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using ((tendsto_const_nhds.inner hwv).const_mul 2).sub hr0
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by linarith : 2*⟪e,v⟫<(0:ℝ)))] with n hn
  have heq : ‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖^2=1-2*r n*⟪e,w n⟫+(r n)^2 := by
    change ‖e-r n • w n‖^2= _
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real,inner_smul_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hr n),he,hw]
    ring
  have hneg := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (hr n) hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (e-(r n : ℂ)*w n)]

name: outer_straddle_strip
stmt: {K : Set ℂ} {x e q : ℂ} (hx : x∈K) (hq : q∈K) (_he : ‖e‖=1) (hed : dist (x+e) q<1) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,1<r → r<1+δ → x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K
body:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ᶠp : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (1,e),dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q<1 :=
    (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q) by fun_prop).continuousAt.eventually
      (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] using hed))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' heδ r hr hrδ => ⟨q,hq,x,hx,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · apply hsub (a := (r,e'))
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨by rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0<r-1)]; linarith,heδ⟩
  · rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0<r),he',mul_one]
    exact hr

name: inner_straddle_strip
stmt: {K : Set ℂ} {x e q : ℂ} (hx : x∈K) (hq : q∈K) (_he : ‖e‖=1) (hed : 1<dist (x+e) q) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,0<r → 1-δ<r → r<1 → x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K
body:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ᶠp : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (1,e),1<dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q :=
    (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q) by fun_prop).continuousAt.eventually
      (lt_mem_nhds (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] using hed))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' heδ r hr hrδ hr1 => ⟨x,hx,q,hq,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hr,he',mul_one]
    exact hr1
  · apply hsub (a := (r,e'))
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨by rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_neg (by linarith : r-1<0)]; linarith,heδ⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: finite_positive_lower_bound
stmt: {ι : Type*} (E : Finset ι) (d : ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀i∈E,0<d i) : ∃δ>0,δ≤1 ∧ ∀i∈E,δ≤d i
body:
:= by
  classical
  induction E using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1,by norm_num,le_rfl,by simp⟩
  | @insert a E ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδ1,hδd⟩ := ih (fun i hi => hd i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    refine ⟨min δ (d a),lt_min hδ (hd a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)),(min_le_left _ _).trans hδ1,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl|hi
    · exact min_le_right _ _
    · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (hδd i hi)
                                                                                
                                           
structure ApproachingContinuum (x : ℂ) (K : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ) where
  center_mem : x∈K
  r : ℕ → ℝ
  w : ℕ → ℂ
  r_pos : ∀n,0<r n
  r_tendsto : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)
  w_unit : ∀n,‖w n‖=1
  w_tendsto : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 v)
  point_mem : ∀n,x+(r n : ℂ)*w n∈K

name: ApproachingContinuum.outer_strip
stmt: {x : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} {v e : ℂ} (h : ApproachingContinuum x K v) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : 0<⟪e,v⟫) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,1<r → r<1+δ → x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := (approaching_direction_inside h.r_pos h.r_tendsto h.w_unit h.w_tendsto he hv).exists
  apply outer_straddle_strip h.center_mem (h.point_mem n) he
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using hn

name: ApproachingContinuum.inner_strip
stmt: {x : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} {v e : ℂ} (h : ApproachingContinuum x K v) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : ⟪e,v⟫<0) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,0<r → 1-δ<r → r<1 → x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := (approaching_direction_outside h.r_pos h.r_tendsto h.w_unit h.w_tendsto he hv).exists
  apply inner_straddle_strip h.center_mem (h.point_mem n) he
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using hn
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)

name: continuum_outer_restriction
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (E : Finset ι) {x : ℂ} {K : ι → Set ℂ} {v : ι → ℂ} (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hJ : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈J) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,(∀i∈E,0<⟪direction t,v i⟫) → (palette c hc x t∩J).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  classical
  apply ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure
  intro t ht
  have hex (i : E) := (hK i).outer_strip (direction_norm t) (ht i i.2)
  choose d hd hs using hex
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,_,hδd⟩ := finite_positive_lower_bound Finset.univ d (fun i _ => hd i)
  let W : Set ℂ := ⋂i : E,Straddle (K i)
  have ho : IsOpen W := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => straddle_isOpen (K i)
  have hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J := hJ.mono fun z hz hzW => hz
    (fun i hi => mem_iInter.mp hzW ⟨i,hi⟩)
  exact outer_strip_trace c hc hδ ho hW (fun u hu r hr hrδ => by
    apply mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    apply hs i (direction u) (direction_norm u) (hu.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) r hr
    linarith [hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _)])

name: continuum_inner_restriction
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (E : Finset ι) {x : ℂ} {K : ι → Set ℂ} {v : ι → ℂ} (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hJ : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈J) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,(∀i∈E,⟪direction t,v i⟫<0) → (palette c hc x t∩J).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  classical
  apply ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure
  intro t ht
  have hex (i : E) := (hK i).inner_strip (direction_norm t) (ht i i.2)
  choose d hd hs using hex
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,_,hδd⟩ := finite_positive_lower_bound Finset.univ d (fun i _ => hd i)
  let W : Set ℂ := ⋂i : E,Straddle (K i)
  have ho : IsOpen W := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => straddle_isOpen (K i)
  have hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J := hJ.mono fun z hz hzW => hz
    (fun i hi => mem_iInter.mp hzW ⟨i,hi⟩)
  exact inner_strip_trace c hc hδ ho hW (fun u hu r hr hrδ hr1 => by
    apply mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    apply hs i (direction u) (direction_norm u) (hu.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) r hr
    · linarith [hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    · exact hr1)
end EuclideanFiveColor

def spatialSupport (i : Fin k) : Set ℂ := (volume.restrict {z | c z=i}).support

name: mem_spatialSupport_ae
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,c z=i → z∈spatialSupport c i
body:
:=
  (ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)).mp
    (volume.restrict {z | c z=i}).support_mem_ae

name: support_exclusion_ae
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {i : Fin k} {W : Set ℂ} (h : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) W) : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z≠i
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [mem_spatialSupport_ae c hc i] with z hz hzW hzcol
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h (hz hzcol) hzW

name: finite_support_exclusion_ae
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (K : ι → Set ℂ) (F : ι → Finset (Fin k)) (h : ∀i,∀j∈F i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,∀i,z∈Straddle (K i) → c z∉F i
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀i,∀j,∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,j∈F i → z∈Straddle (K i) → c z≠j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hj : j∈F i
    · exact (support_exclusion_ae c hc (h i j hj)).mono fun z hz _ => hz
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h => (hj h).elim
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (hh i))] with z hz i hi hj
  exact hz i (c z) hj hi rfl
