def angleEssential (s : Angles → Bool) (b : Bool) : Set Angles :=
  {t | ∃U : Set Angles,IsOpen U ∧ t∈U ∧ ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈U → s u=b}

name: angleEssential_open
stmt: (s : Angles → Bool) (b : Bool) : IsOpen (angleEssential s b)
body:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
  rintro t ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩
  exact ⟨U,fun u hu => ⟨U,hU,hu,ha⟩,hU,ht⟩

name: angleEssential_ae
stmt: (s : Angles → Bool) (b : Bool) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈angleEssential s b → s t=b
body: := ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure (fun _ h => h)

name: angleEssential_disjoint
stmt: (s : Angles → Bool) {a b : Bool} (hab : a≠b) : Disjoint (angleEssential s a) (angleEssential s b)
body:
:= by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro t ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩ ⟨V,hV,ht',hb⟩
  have hpos := (hU.inter hV).measure_pos angularMeasure ⟨t,ht,ht'⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu,huab⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae (ha.and hb))
  exact hab ((huab.1 hu.1).symm.trans (huab.2 hu.2))
def angleBoundary (s : Angles → Bool) : Set Angles := (⋃b,angleEssential s b)ᶜ

name: angleBoundary_closed
stmt: (s : Angles → Bool) : IsClosed (angleBoundary s)
body:
:=
  (isOpen_iUnion (angleEssential_open s)).isClosed_compl

name: angleEssential_shift
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (t : Angles) (b : Bool) : t+(sixty : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b) ↔ t∈angleEssential s b
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩
    refine ⟨(fun q : Angles => q+(sixty : Angles)) ⁻¹' U,hU.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const),ht,?_⟩
    filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ha,hf] with q hq hqf hqU
    have hh := hq hqU
    rw [hqf] at hh
    exact Bool.not_injective hh
  · rintro ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩
    refine ⟨(fun q : Angles => q-(sixty : Angles)) ⁻¹' U,hU.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const),by simpa,?_⟩
    have hh := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (-(sixty : Angles))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ha.and hf)
    filter_upwards [hh] with q hq hqU
    have hcol := hq.1 hqU
    have hflip := hq.2
    change s (q-(sixty : Angles))=b at hcol
    simpa only [←sub_eq_add_neg,sub_add_cancel,hcol] using hflip

name: angleBoundary_shift
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (t : Angles) : t+(sixty : Angles)∈angleBoundary s ↔ t∈angleBoundary s
body:
:= by
  simp only [angleBoundary,mem_compl_iff,mem_iUnion,not_exists]
  constructor
  · intro h b hb
    exact h (!b) ((angleEssential_shift hf t b).mpr hb)
  · intro h b hb
    apply h (!b)
    apply (angleEssential_shift hf t (!b)).mp
    simpa only [Bool.not_not] using hb

name: angleBoundary_nonempty
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) : (angleBoundary s).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hcov : (univ : Set Angles)⊆angleEssential s false∪angleEssential s true := by
    intro t _
    have ht : t∉angleBoundary s := fun h => hn ⟨t,h⟩
    simp only [angleBoundary,mem_compl_iff,not_not,mem_iUnion] at ht
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := ht
    cases b
    · exact Or.inl hb
    · exact Or.inr hb
  have hzero := hcov (mem_univ (0:Angles))
  have hconst : ∃b,∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s t=b := by
    rcases hzero with h0|h0
    · have hs := isPreconnected_univ.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s false)
        (angleEssential_open s true) (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide)) hcov ⟨0,mem_univ _,h0⟩
      exact ⟨false,(angleEssential_ae s false).mono fun t ht => ht (hs (mem_univ _))⟩
    · have hs := isPreconnected_univ.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s true)
        (angleEssential_open s false) (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide))
        (by simpa only [union_comm] using hcov) ⟨0,mem_univ _,h0⟩
      exact ⟨true,(angleEssential_ae s true).mono fun t ht => ht (hs (mem_univ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hconst
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,False := by
    filter_upwards [hb,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hb,hf] with t ht ht' he
    rw [ht,ht'] at he
    cases b <;> cases he
  exact hh.exists.choose_spec

name: sixAngle_add
stmt: (i j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (i+j)=sixAngle i+sixAngle j
body:
:= by
  induction j using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp [sixAngle]
  | succ j hj =>
    have he : j.succ=(j.castSucc : Fin 6)+1 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_add,Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_one]
      exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)).symm
    rw [he,←add_assoc,sixAngle_step,sixAngle_step,hj]
    abel

name: sixty_order
stmt: : addOrderOf (sixty : Angles)=6
body:
:= by
  convert (AddCircle.addOrderOf_period_div (p:=2*Real.pi) (by norm_num : 0<(6:ℕ))) using 1
  congr 2
  dsimp [sixty]
  ring

name: sixAngle_injective
stmt: : Function.Injective sixAngle
body:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  apply nsmul_injOn_Iio_addOrderOf (x := (sixty : Angles))
  · simpa only [sixty_order,mem_Iio] using i.isLt
  · simpa only [sixty_order,mem_Iio] using j.isLt
  · exact hij
def sixAngleHom : Fin 6 →+ Angles where
  toFun := sixAngle
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := sixAngle_add

name: sixAngle_sub
stmt: (i j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (i-j)=sixAngle i-sixAngle j
body: := sixAngleHom.map_sub i j

name: angleBoundary_six
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) {t : Angles} (ht : t∈angleBoundary s) (j : Fin 6) : t+sixAngle j∈angleBoundary s
body:
:= by
  have hh (n : ℕ) : t+n•(sixty : Angles)∈angleBoundary s := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using ht
    | succ n ih =>
      simpa only [add_nsmul,one_nsmul,←add_assoc] using (angleBoundary_shift hf (t+n•(sixty : Angles))).mpr ih
  exact hh j.val

name: six_antipodal_vertex_cover
stmt: : ∀b : Fin 6 → Bool, (∀j,b (j+3)=b j) → (∀j,b j=true ∨ b (j+1)=true) → 4≤(Finset.univ.filter fun j => b j=true).card
body: := by decide

name: angleBoundary_one_orbit
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (B : Finset Angles) (hB : B.card≤6) (hanti : ∀t,t+(Real.pi : Angles)∈B ↔ t∈B) (hl : ∀t,t∉B → t+(sixty : Angles)∉B → ∃b,t∈angleEssential s b) : ∃t,angleBoundary s={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=t+sixAngle j}
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := angleBoundary_nonempty hf
  let O (q : Angles) : Finset Angles := Finset.univ.image (fun j : Fin 6 => q+sixAngle j)
  have hcard (q : Angles) (hq : q∈angleBoundary s) : 4≤(B∩O q).card := by
    let b : Fin 6 → Bool := fun j => decide (q+sixAngle j∈B)
    have ha (j) : b (j+3)=b j := by
      simp only [b,sixAngle_half,←add_assoc,hanti]
    have hc (j) : b j=true ∨ b (j+1)=true := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh : q+sixAngle j∉B ∧ q+sixAngle (j+1)∉B := by simpa only [b,decide_eq_true_eq,not_or] using hn
      obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hl (q+sixAngle j) hh.1 (by simpa only [sixAngle_step,←add_assoc] using hh.2)
      exact (angleBoundary_six hf hq j) (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨v,hv⟩)
    have hcount := six_antipodal_vertex_cover b ha hc
    have hi : Function.Injective (fun j : Fin 6 => q+sixAngle j) := (add_right_injective q).comp sixAngle_injective
    have him : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => b j=true).image (fun j : Fin 6 => q+sixAngle j)=B∩O q := by
      ext u
      simp only [Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,b,decide_eq_true_eq,
        Finset.mem_inter,O]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩; exact ⟨hj,j,rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨hu,j,rfl⟩; exact ⟨j,hu,rfl⟩
    rw [←him,Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hi]
    exact hcount
  refine ⟨t,Set.ext fun u => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hu
    by_contra hn
    have hd : Disjoint (O t) (O u) := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro q hqt hqu
      obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqt
      obtain ⟨j,_,hj⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqu
      apply hn
      refine ⟨i-j,?_⟩
      rw [sixAngle_sub]
      have he : t+sixAngle i=u+sixAngle j := hi.trans hj.symm
      calc u = (u+sixAngle j)-sixAngle j := by abel
           _ = (t+sixAngle i)-sixAngle j := by rw [he]
           _ = t+(sixAngle i-sixAngle j) := by abel
    have hd' : Disjoint (B∩O t) (B∩O u) := hd.mono Finset.inter_subset_right Finset.inter_subset_right
    have hh := Finset.card_le_card (show (B∩O t)∪(B∩O u)⊆B from Finset.union_subset Finset.inter_subset_left Finset.inter_subset_left)
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd'] at hh
    have hct := hcard t ht
    have hcu := hcard u hu
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j,rfl⟩
    exact angleBoundary_six hf ht j
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: exists_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
stmt: {X I : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {k : ℕ} (center : I → X) (color : I → Fin k) (r : ℝ) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : I, dist x (center i) ≤ r) (hdiam : 2 * r < 1) (hsep : ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → color i = color j → 1 + 2 * r < dist (center i) (center j)) : ∃ c : X → Fin k, ∀ x y : X, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y

    have htriangle₂ := dist_triangle x y (center (cell y))
    have hx := hcell x
    have hy := hcell y
    rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) x] at htriangle₁
    linarith

name: binaryQ_range
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) : 0 < binaryQ d t ∧ binaryQ d t < 4 ∧ 0 < 1-d*Real.cos t
body:
:= by
  have hdc : |d*Real.cos t| ≤ |d| := by
    simpa only [abs_mul,mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one t) (abs_nonneg d)
  have hdc' := abs_le.mp hdc
  have hd' := abs_lt.mp hd
  dsimp [binaryQ]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [sq_nonneg d]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [sq_abs d,abs_nonneg d]
  · linarith

name: binaryR_pos
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) : 0 < binaryR d t
body:
:= by
  have h := binaryQ_range hd t
  unfold binaryR
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h.1)) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [h.2.1]))

name: binary_arctan_identity
stmt: (d t : ℝ) : (1-d*Real.cos t)^2+(d*Real.sin t)^2=binaryQ d t
body:
:= by
  have h := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
  dsimp [binaryQ]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg d]

name: binary_arctan_recip
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2=1/binaryQ d t
body:
:= by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hi := binary_arctan_identity d t
  field_simp [hq.1.ne',hq.2.2.ne']
  simp only [mul_pow] at hi
  rw [hi,div_self hq.1.ne']

name: binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (binaryCircleMap d) (1+d*binaryB d t) t
body:
:= by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ -1 := by linarith
  have hc' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ 1 := by intro h; nlinarith [hq.2.1]
  have hqd : HasDerivAt (binaryQ d) (2*d*Real.sin t) t := by
    convert (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).const_mul (2*d)).const_sub 1).add_const (d^2) using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | ring
  have hat := (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).const_mul d).div
    (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).const_mul d).const_sub 1) hq.2.2.ne').arctan
  have hac := (Real.hasDerivAt_arccos hc hc').comp t ((hqd.sqrt hq.1.ne').div_const 2)
  have hh := (((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (Real.pi/3)).add hat).sub hac
  change HasDerivAt (binaryCircleMap d) _ t at hh
  convert hh using 1
  dsimp [binaryB,binaryR]
  have hss : 1-(Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)^2=1-binaryQ d t/4 := by nlinarith [hsq]
  rw [hss]
  have hrec := binary_arctan_recip hd t
  have hnum : d*Real.cos t*(1-d*Real.cos t)-d*Real.sin t*-(d*-Real.sin t)=
      d*(Real.cos t-d) := by linear_combination -d^2*(Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)
  rw [hnum]
  have hrearr : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)*
      (d*(Real.cos t-d)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2) = d*(Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2)*(d*(Real.cos t-d)) := by ring
      _ = d*(Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t := by rw [hrec]; ring
  rw [hrearr]
  ring

name: binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_d
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) (binaryM d t) d
body:
:= by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ -1 := by linarith
  have hc' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ 1 := by intro h; nlinarith [hq.2.1]
  have hqd : HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryQ s t) (2*(d-Real.cos t)) d := by
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (2*Real.cos t)).const_sub 1).add ((hasDerivAt_id d).pow 2) using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | (funext s; dsimp only [binaryQ,Pi.add_apply,Pi.pow_apply,id_eq]; ring) |
        (try dsimp only [id_eq]; ring)
  have hat := (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (Real.sin t)).div
    (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (Real.cos t)).const_sub 1) hq.2.2.ne').arctan
  have hac := (Real.hasDerivAt_arccos hc hc').comp d ((hqd.sqrt hq.1.ne').div_const 2)
  have hh := (hat.const_add (t+Real.pi/3)).sub hac
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) _ d at hh
  convert hh using 1
  dsimp [binaryM,binaryR]
  have hss : 1-(Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)^2=1-binaryQ d t/4 := by nlinarith [hsq]
  rw [hss]
  have hrec := binary_arctan_recip hd t
  simp only [one_mul]
  have hnum : Real.sin t*(1-d*Real.cos t)-d*Real.sin t*-(Real.cos t)=Real.sin t := by ring
  rw [hnum]
  have hrearr : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)*
      (Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2) = Real.sin t/binaryQ d t := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2)*Real.sin t := by ring
      _ = Real.sin t/binaryQ d t := by rw [hrec]; ring
  rw [hrearr]
  ring
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: periodic_reduce_to_period
stmt: {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (t : ℝ) : ∃ u ∈ Icc 0 P, ∃ n : ℤ, t=u+(n : ℝ)*P
body:
:= by

  · exact ⟨(Int.fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico P t hP).1,(Int.fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico P t hP).2.le⟩
  · simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (Int.fract_div_mul_self_add_zsmul_eq P t hP.ne').symm

name: compact_periodic_uniform
stmt: {g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {a P : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hP : 0 < P) (hg : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g p.1 p.2) (Icc (-a) a ×ˢ Icc 0 P)) (hper : ∀ d, Function.Periodic (g d) P) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ δ > 0, δ ≤ a ∧ ∀ d, |d| < δ → ∀ t, |g d t-g 0 t| < ε
body:
:= by
  have hu := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hg
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδg⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hu ε hε
  refine ⟨min a δ,lt_min ha hδ,min_le_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro d hd t
  obtain ⟨u,hu,n,rfl⟩ := periodic_reduce_to_period hP t
  have hper' : ∀ d, g d (u+(n : ℝ)*P)=g d u := fun d => by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (hper d).int_mul n u
  rw [hper' d,hper' 0]
  have hda := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _))
  have hh := hδg (d,u) ⟨⟨hda.1.le,hda.2.le⟩,hu⟩ (0,u) ⟨⟨by linarith,ha.le⟩,hu⟩
  rw [Prod.dist_eq,dist_self,dist_zero_right,max_eq_left (norm_nonneg d)] at hh
  exact hh (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _))

name: compact_periodic_bounded
stmt: {g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {a P : ℝ} (_ha : 0 ≤ a) (hP : 0 < P) (hg : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g p.1 p.2) (Icc (-a) a ×ˢ Icc 0 P)) (hper : ∀ d, |d| ≤ a → Function.Periodic (g d) P) : ∃ C > 0, ∀ d, |d| ≤ a → ∀ t, |g d t| ≤ C
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := ((isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image_of_continuousOn hg).isBounded |>.exists_pos_norm_le
  refine ⟨C,hC.1,?_⟩
  intro d hd t
  obtain ⟨u,hu,n,rfl⟩ := periodic_reduce_to_period hP t
  have he : g d (u+(n : ℝ)*P)=g d u := by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (hper d hd).int_mul n u
  rw [he]
  exact hC.2 _ ⟨(d,u),⟨abs_le.mp hd,hu⟩,rfl⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: binary_uniform_controls
stmt: {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1/4 ∧ 0 < C ∧ (∀ d, |d| < δ → ∀ t, |binaryB d t-binaryB 0 t| < ε ∧ |binaryM d t-binaryM 0 t| < ε) ∧ (∀ d, |d| ≤ δ → ∀ t, |binaryB d t| ≤ C ∧ |binaryM d t| ≤ C ∧ |binaryE d t| ≤ C)
body:
:= by
  have hB : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryB p.1 p.2)
      (Icc (-(1/4)) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (binaryB_contDiffAt (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1,hp.1.2])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hM : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryM p.1 p.2)
      (Icc (-(1/4)) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (binaryM_contDiffAt (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1,hp.1.2])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hE : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryE p.1 p.2)
      (Icc (-(1/4)) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (binaryE_continuousAt (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1,hp.1.2])).continuousWithinAt
  have hP : 0 < 2*Real.pi := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δB,hδB,hδBa,hδBg⟩ := compact_periodic_uniform (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/4) hP hB binaryB_periodic hε
  obtain ⟨δM,hδM,hδMa,hδMg⟩ := compact_periodic_uniform (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/4) hP hM binaryM_periodic hε
  obtain ⟨CB,hCB,hCBg⟩ := compact_periodic_bounded (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/4) hP hB (fun d _ => binaryB_periodic d)
  obtain ⟨CM,hCM,hCMg⟩ := compact_periodic_bounded (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/4) hP hM (fun d _ => binaryM_periodic d)
  obtain ⟨CE,hCE,hCEg⟩ := compact_periodic_bounded (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/4) hP hE
    (fun d hd => binaryE_periodic d (by linarith))
  refine ⟨min δB δM,CB+CM+CE,lt_min hδB hδM,(min_le_left _ _).trans hδBa,by positivity,?_,?_⟩
  · intro d hd t
    exact ⟨hδBg d (hd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) t,hδMg d (hd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) t⟩
  · intro d hd t
    have hda := hd.trans ((min_le_left δB δM).trans hδBa)
    exact ⟨(hCBg d hda t).trans (by linarith),(hCMg d hda t).trans (by linarith),(hCEg d hda t).trans (by linarith)⟩

    (fun s hs => hM s (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2.trans hdδ) t) (left_mem_Icc.mpr hd) (right_mem_Icc.mpr hd)

name: expansion_alternation_false
stmt: {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L P B κ : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x) (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U) (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x) (hadvance : ∀ x, ∃ j, x+e ≤ F j x) (hdispl : ∀ j x, F j x ≤ x+B) (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 < U) (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P) (hB : B ≤ L/2) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hper : ∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*P ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) (halt : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+κ ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) : False
body:
:= by
  have hpos : volume A ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have ha : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∉ A := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      convert hz using 2
      ext x
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,not_not]
    have hf : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, False := by
      filter_upwards [ha,(measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ha,halt] with x hx hx' hh
      exact hx' (hh.mpr hx)
    exact hf.exists.choose_spec
  obtain ⟨a,b,hlen,hnull⟩ := expansion_conull_interval hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hL hP hinv hA hpos hper
  have hLip : ∀ j, LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal U) (F j) := by
    intro j
    apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le (fun x => (hd j x).differentiableAt)
    intro x
    rw [(hd j x).deriv]
    apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hU.le,coe_nnnorm,Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) (hp j x))]
    exact hup j x
  have hmono : ∀ j, Monotone (F j) := by
    intro j
    apply StrictMono.monotone
    apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
    intro x
    rw [(hd j x).deriv]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp j x)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((κ-(b-a))/e)
  have hnn : κ < b+(n : ℝ)*e-a := by
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ he).mp hn
    linarith
  obtain ⟨b',hb',hnull'⟩ := conull_extend_intervals hLip hmono hadvance hdispl he
    (by linarith) (hB.trans_eq hlen.symm) hinv hnull n
  exact conull_interval_alternation_false hκ (by linarith) hnull' halt
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def binaryConjugate (d : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  binaryCircleMap d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))-(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)

name: binaryConjugate_hasDeriv
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (binaryConjugate d n) (1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) t
body:
:= by
  convert ((binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).comp t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const ((n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))).sub_const ((n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) using 1 <;> first | rfl | simp

name: binaryCircleMap_advance
stmt: {d δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hδ : δ ≤ 1/4) (hdδ : d < δ) (hM : ∀ s, |s| < δ → ∀ t, |binaryM s t-binaryM 0 t| < 1/8) {t : ℝ} (ht : 1/4 ≤ binaryM 0 t) : t+d/8 ≤ binaryCircleMap d t
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 d, HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) (binaryM s t) s := by
    intro s hs
    exact binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_d (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; linarith [hs.2]) t
  obtain ⟨s,hs,he⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) (fun s => binaryM s t) hd
    (fun s hs => (hh s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun s hs => hh s ⟨hs.1.le,hs.2.le⟩)
  have hms := (abs_lt.mp (hM s (by rw [abs_of_pos hs.1]; exact hs.2.trans hdδ) t)).1
  rw [binaryCircleMap_zero,sub_zero] at he
  have hl : 1/8 ≤ (binaryCircleMap d t-t)/d := by rw [← he]; linarith
  have := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp hl
  linarith

name: binary_dynamics_controls
stmt: : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ d, 0 < d → d < δ → ∃ C L : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < L ∧ C*d ≤ L/2 ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) t, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) t, 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (d*C)) (fun t => 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))) ∧ (∀ t, ∃ n : ℕ, 1+d/8 ≤ 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) ∧ (∀ t, ∃ n : ℕ, t+d/8 ≤ binaryConjugate d n t) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) t, binaryConjugate d n t ≤ t+C*d) ∧ d*C*L ≤ d/8 ∧ d < 1/2
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,C,hδ,hδa,hC,hclose,hbound⟩ := binary_uniform_controls (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/8)
  let L := 1/(8*C)
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  refine ⟨min δ (min (1/(2*C)) (L/(2*C))),lt_min hδ (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)),?_⟩
  intro d hd hds
  have hdδ : d < δ := (lt_min_iff.mp hds).1
  have hda : d < 1/2 := by linarith
  have hdC : d*C < 1/2 := by
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*C)).mp ((lt_min_iff.mp (lt_min_iff.mp hds).2).1)
    nlinarith
  have hdL : C*d ≤ L/2 := by
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*C)).mp ((lt_min_iff.mp (lt_min_iff.mp hds).2).2)
    nlinarith
  have hbd := hbound d (by rw [abs_of_pos hd]; exact hdδ.le)
  have hdd : |d|<1/2 := by rwa [abs_of_pos hd]
  refine ⟨C,L,hC,hL,hdL,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,hda⟩
  · intro n t
    have h := (abs_le.mp (hbd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).1).1
    nlinarith
  · intro n t
    have h := (abs_le.mp (hbd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).1).2
    nlinarith
  · intro n
    have hder : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t => 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))
        (d*binaryE d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) t := by
      intro t
      convert (((binaryB_hasDeriv_t hdd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).comp t
        ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const ((n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))).const_mul d).const_add 1 using 1 <;> first | rfl | simp
    apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le (fun t => (hder t).differentiableAt)
    intro t
    rw [(hder t).deriv]
    apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity),coe_nnnorm,norm_mul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hd,Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbd _).2.2 hd.le
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := binaryB_zero_large t
    refine ⟨n,?_⟩
    have hh := (abs_lt.mp (hclose d (by rwa [abs_of_pos hd]) (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).1).1
    nlinarith
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := binaryM_zero_large t
    refine ⟨n,?_⟩
    have hh := binaryCircleMap_advance hd hδa hdδ (fun s hs u => (hclose s hs u).2) hn
    dsimp only [binaryConjugate]
    linarith
  · intro n t
    have hh := binaryCircleMap_displacement hd.le (lt_of_le_of_lt hδa (by norm_num)) hdδ.le
      (fun s hs u => (hbound s hs u).2.1) (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))
    dsimp only [binaryConjugate]
    linarith [(abs_le.mp hh).2]
  · dsimp [L]
    field_simp
    norm_num
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: binaryConjugate_step
stmt: (d : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : binaryConjugate d n (x+Real.pi/3)=binaryConjugate d (n+1) x+Real.pi/3
body:
:= by
  unfold binaryConjugate
  push_cast
  have h : x+Real.pi/3+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)=x+((n : ℝ)+1)*(Real.pi/3) := by ring
  rw [h]
  ring

name: binary_conjugates_invariant
stmt: {d : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (binaryConjugate d n) volume volume) (hF : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ binaryCircleMap d x ∈ A) (halt : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+Real.pi/3 ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ binaryConjugate d n x ∈ A
body:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [binaryConjugate,Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero,sub_zero] using hF
  | succ n ih =>
    have hshift := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (Real.pi/3)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ih
    filter_upwards [hshift,halt,(hq (n+1)).ae halt] with x hx ha hb
    rw [binaryConjugate_step] at hx
    exact not_iff_not.mp (ha.symm.trans (hx.trans hb))

name: binary_alternating_invariant_false
stmt: : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ d, 0 < d → d < δ → ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → (∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) → (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+Real.pi/3 ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) → (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ binaryCircleMap d x ∈ A) → False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hctrl⟩ := binary_dynamics_controls
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
  intro d hd hdδ A hA hper halt hF
  obtain ⟨C,L,hC,hL,hB,hlo,hhi,hLip,hlarge,hadvance,hdispl,hKL,hda⟩ := hctrl d hd hdδ
  have hdd : |d|<1/2 := by rwa [abs_of_pos hd]
  have hder := fun n t => binaryConjugate_hasDeriv hdd n t
  have hinv := binary_conjugates_invariant (fun n => deriv_lower_qmp (hder n) (hlo n)) hF halt
  exact expansion_alternation_false hder hlo hhi hLip hlarge hadvance hdispl (by positivity)
    (by simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_pos hd hC).le] using hKL) (by norm_num) hL
    (by positivity : 0<2*Real.pi) hB (by positivity : 0<Real.pi/3) hinv hA hper halt
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: binary_alternation
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i j : Fin k} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x i j) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, (t+(sixty : Angles) ∈ paletteSet c hc x i ↔ t ∉ paletteSet c hc x i) ∧ (t ∈ paletteSet c hc x j ↔ t ∉ paletteSet c hc x i)
body:
:= by
  have hb' := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hb
  filter_upwards [hb,hb',palette_sixty c hc hw x i,palette_sixty c hc hw x j] with t h h' hi hj
  constructor
  · constructor
    · exact fun ht ht' => hi ht' ht
    · intro hnot
      exact h'.resolve_right (hj (h.resolve_left hnot))
  · constructor
    · intro ht ht'
      rcases h' with hpi | hpj
      · exact hi ht' hpi
      · exact hj ht hpj
    · exact h.resolve_left

name: binary_pair_distinct
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i j : Fin k} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x i j) : i ≠ j
body:
:= by
  intro hij
  subst j
  have h := binary_alternation c hc hw hb
  have hf : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, False := by
    filter_upwards [h,hb] with t ht hb
    have hp := hb.elim id id
    exact (ht.2.mp hp) hp
  exact hf.exists.choose_spec
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: binary_cover_real
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) {x : ℂ} {i j : Fin k} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x i j) : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t ∈ liftPalette c hc x i ∨ t ∈ liftPalette c hc x j
body:
:=
  angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hb

name: binary_alternation_real
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i j : Fin k} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x i j) (φ : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t+Real.pi/3+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i ↔ t+φ ∉ liftPalette c hc x i
body:
:= by
  have h := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (binary_alternation c hc hw hb)
  have h' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume φ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h
  filter_upwards [h'] with t ht
  simpa only [liftPalette,mem_preimage,sixty,← AddCircle.coe_add,show t+φ+Real.pi/3=t+Real.pi/3+φ by ring] using ht.1

name: alternating_twostep
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {κ : ℝ} (h : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t+κ ∈ A ↔ t ∉ A) : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t+2*κ ∈ A ↔ t ∈ A
body:
:= by
  have h' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h
  filter_upwards [h,h'] with t ht ht'
  rw [show t+κ+κ=t+2*κ by ring] at ht'
  exact ht'.trans (not_congr ht) |>.trans not_not

name: liftPalette_shift_periodic
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (φ : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) : t+(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i ↔ t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i
body:
:= by
  have he : ((t+(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)+φ : ℝ) : Angles)=((t+φ : ℝ) : Angles) := by
    rw [show t+(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)+φ=t+φ+n • (2*Real.pi) by rw [zsmul_eq_mul]; ring,
      AddCircle.coe_add,AddCircle.coe_zsmul,AddCircle.coe_period,smul_zero,add_zero]
  change ((t+(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)+φ : ℝ) : Angles) ∈ paletteSet c hc x i ↔ ((t+φ : ℝ) : Angles) ∈ paletteSet c hc x i
  rw [he]
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: binary_transport_invariant
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x z : ℂ} {i j : Fin k} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x i j) (hz : BinaryCenter c hc z i j) {d φ : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (hD : ∀ t, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ 1+d*binaryB d t) (hxr : (z-x).re=d*Real.cos φ) (hxi : (z-x).im=d*Real.sin φ) : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i ↔ binaryCircleMap d t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i
body:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ r, HasDerivAt (fun t => binaryTarget d t+φ) (1+d*binaryB d (-r)) r :=
    fun r => (binaryTarget_hasDeriv hd r).add_const φ
  have hs : ∀ r, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t+φ) 1 r := fun r => (hasDerivAt_id r).add_const φ
  have ht : ∀ r, HasDerivAt (fun t => binaryOther d t+φ) (1+d*binaryB d r) r :=
    fun r => (binaryOther_hasDeriv hd r).add_const φ
  have hn : ∀ r, Real.sin ((binaryOther d r+φ)-(r+φ))≠0 := by
    intro r
    simpa only [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using binary_nonparallel hd r
  have hn' : ∀ r, Real.sin ((r+φ)-(binaryOther d r+φ))≠0 := by
    intro r
    rw [show (r+φ)-(binaryOther d r+φ)=-((binaryOther d r+φ)-(r+φ)) by ring,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
    exact hn r
  have he := binary_geometry_rotated hd hxr hxi
  have he' : ∀ r, circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,binaryTarget d r+φ)=
      circleSum 1 (binaryOther d r+φ,r+φ) := by
    intro r
    rw [he r]
    simp only [circleSum,Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> ring
  have hp (l : Fin k) := palette_transport_param c hc hw ha (fun r => hD (-r)) hs ht
    (fun _ => one_ne_zero) hn he l
  have hp' (l : Fin k) := palette_transport_param c hc hw ha (fun r => hD (-r)) ht hs
    (fun r => ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hD r))) hn' he' l
  have hpat := (deriv_lower_qmp ha (fun r => hD (-r))).ae (binary_cover_real c hc hz)
  have hpx := (measurePreserving_add_right volume φ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (binary_cover_real c hc hb)
  have hpx' := (deriv_lower_qmp ht hD).ae (binary_cover_real c hc hb)
  have hsame : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i ↔ binaryOther d t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i := by
    filter_upwards [hpat,hpx,hpx',hp i,hp j,hp' i,hp' j] with t hy hx hx' hii hjj hi' hj'
    rcases hy with hy|hy
    · exact ⟨fun hx => False.elim (hii hy hx),fun hx => False.elim (hi' hy hx)⟩
    · exact ⟨fun _ => hx'.resolve_right (hj' hy),fun _ => hx.resolve_right (hjj hy)⟩
  let A : Set ℝ := {t | t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i}
  have hA : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t+Real.pi/3 ∈ A ↔ t ∉ A := binary_alternation_real c hc hw hb φ
  have hp2 := (deriv_lower_qmp (binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd) hD).ae (alternating_twostep hA)
  filter_upwards [hsame,hp2] with t ht hp2
  exact ht.trans hp2
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: binary_centers_separated
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (x z : ℂ) (i j : Fin k), BinaryCenter c hc x i j → BinaryCenter c hc z i j → x ≠ z → δ ≤ dist x z
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ₁,hδ₁,hctrl⟩ := binary_dynamics_controls
  obtain ⟨δ₂,hδ₂,hfalse⟩ := binary_alternating_invariant_false
  refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂,lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂,?_⟩
  intro x z i j hx hz hne
  by_contra! hdδ
  let d := ‖z-x‖
  have hd : 0 < d := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne))
  have hdδ' : d < min δ₁ δ₂ := by simpa only [d,dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hdδ
  obtain ⟨C,L,hC,hL,hB,hlo,hhi,hLip,hlarge,hadvance,hdispl,hKL,hda⟩ :=
    hctrl d hd (lt_min_iff.mp hdδ').1
  let φ := Complex.arg (z-x)
  let A : Set ℝ := {t | t+φ ∈ liftPalette c hc x i}
  apply hfalse d hd (lt_min_iff.mp hdδ').2 A
  · exact (liftPalette_measurable c hc x i).preimage (measurable_id.add_const φ)
  · exact liftPalette_shift_periodic c hc x i φ
  · exact binary_alternation_real c hc hw hx φ
  · apply binary_transport_invariant c hc hw hx hz (by rwa [abs_of_pos hd])
    · intro t
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] using hlo 0 t
    · exact (Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (z-x)).symm
    · exact (Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (z-x)).symm
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: binary_centers_countable
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (i j : Fin k) : {x | BinaryCenter c hc x i j}.Countable
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsep⟩ := binary_centers_separated c hc hw
  have hp : {x | BinaryCenter c hc x i j}.PairwiseDisjoint (fun x => Metric.ball x (δ/2)) := by
    intro x hx z hz hne
    change Disjoint (Metric.ball x (δ/2)) (Metric.ball z (δ/2))
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro w hwx hwz
    have := dist_triangle x w z
    have hxw : dist x w < δ/2 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using hwx
    have hwz' : dist w z < δ/2 := hwz
    have := hsep x z i j hx hz hne
    linarith
  exact hp.countable_of_isOpen (fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    (fun x _ => ⟨x,Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)⟩)

name: ae_not_binary_circle
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) (i j : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ¬ BinaryCenter c hc (x+direction t) i j
body:
:= by
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun t => x+direction t) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact AddCircle.injective_toCircle (by positivity : (2*Real.pi:ℝ)≠0)
      (Subtype.ext (add_left_cancel hab))
  have hn := ((binary_centers_countable c hc hw i j).preimage hi).measure_zero angularMeasure
  exact (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem).mp hn

name: exact_sample_isTrace
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) {y : ℂ} (hy : TypicalSampling c y 1) : IsTrace c hc y (sampleCode c hc y 1)
body:
:=
  subset_closure ⟨hy,rfl⟩

name: trace_positive_le_palette
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) {y : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc y b) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, 0 < traceValue b i t → t ∈ paletteSet c hc y i
body:
:=
  tracePositive_le_palette c hc y i ⟨b,hb⟩

name: trace_sample_ae
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : traceValue (sampleCode c hc y 1) i =ᵐ[angularMeasure] sampleFn c y 1 i
body:
:= by
  rw [traceValue_sampleCode]
  exact sample_ae c hc y 1 i

name: exact_sample_palette_fixed
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) {y : ℂ} (hy : TypicalSampling c y 1) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, c (y+direction t)=i → t ∈ paletteSet c hc y i
body:
:= by
  have hp := trace_positive_le_palette c hc (exact_sample_isTrace c hc hy) i
  have hs := trace_sample_ae c hc y i
  apply (hp.and hs).mono
  intro t ht hcolor
  apply ht.1
  rw [ht.2]
  change 0 < if c (y+(1:ℂ)*direction t)=i then (1:ℝ) else 0
  rw [one_mul,ite_eq_left hcolor]
  exact zero_lt_one

name: typical_sample_palette
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) {y : ℂ} (hy : TypicalSampling c y 1) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, t ∈ paletteSet c hc y (c (y+direction t))
body:
:= by
  exact (ae_all_iff.mpr (exact_sample_palette_fixed c hc hy)).mono
    (fun t ht => ht (c (y+direction t)) rfl)

name: ae_circle_palette_exclusion
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ∀ᵐ v ∂angularMeasure, c (x+direction t+direction v) ∉ palette c hc x t
body:
:= by
  have hh := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i))
  apply hh.mono
  intro t ht
  apply ht.mono
  intro v hv hmem
  apply hv (c (x+direction t+direction v)) ((mem_palette c hc x t _).mp hmem)
  simp only [angularSum,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul]

name: ae_circle_typicalSampling
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, TypicalSampling c (x+direction t) 1
body:
:= by
  have htyp := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod ((angularSum_quasiMeasurePreserving x (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)≠0)).ae (ae_density_actual c hc))
  apply htyp.mono
  intro t ht
  refine ⟨by norm_num,?_⟩
  simpa only [Typical,angularSum,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] using ht

name: two_complement_pred
stmt: {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {S : Finset α} {i j a : α} (hcomp : Finset.univ\S={i,j}) (hnot : a∉S) (P : α → Prop) (hp : P a) : P i ∨ P j
body:
:= by
  have ha : a∈({i,j} : Finset α) := by rw [← hcomp]; simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]; exact hnot
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
  rcases ha with h|h
  · exact Or.inl (h ▸ hp)
  · exact Or.inr (h ▸ hp)

name: circle_complement_binary
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {S : Finset (Fin k)} {i j : Fin k} (hcomp : Finset.univ\S={i,j}) (hsub : S ⊆ palette c hc x t) (ht : ∀ᵐ v ∂angularMeasure, c (x+direction t+direction v) ∉ palette c hc x t) (hy : TypicalSampling c (x+direction t) 1) : BinaryCenter c hc (x+direction t) i j
body:
:= by
  apply (ht.and (typical_sample_palette c hc hy)).mono
  intro v hv
  exact two_complement_pred hcomp (fun hq => hv.1 (hsub hq))
    (fun a => v ∈ paletteSet c hc (x+direction t) a) hv.2

name: palette_triple_null
stmt: (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) (x : ℂ) (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (hS : S.card=3) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ¬ S ⊆ palette c hc x t
body:
:= by
  have hSc : (Finset.univ\S).card=2 := by rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ S)]; simp [hS]
  obtain ⟨i,j,_,hcomp⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hSc
  filter_upwards [ae_circle_palette_exclusion c hc hw x,ae_circle_typicalSampling c hc x,
    ae_not_binary_circle c hc hw x i j] with t ht hy hn
  exact fun hsub => hn (circle_complement_binary c hc hcomp hsub ht hy)

name: palette_cardinality
stmt: (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, 1 ≤ (palette c hc x t).card ∧ (palette c hc x t).card ≤ 2
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [palette_nonempty c hc x,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun S : Finset (Fin 5) =>
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun hS : S.card=3 => palette_triple_null c hc hw x S hS))] with t ht htriple
  refine ⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr ht),?_⟩
  by_contra! hcard
  obtain ⟨S,hsub,hS⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (by omega : 3 ≤ (palette c hc x t).card)
  exact htriple S hS hsub
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def triangleAngle : ℝ := Real.arccos (5/6)

name: triangleAngle_cos
stmt: : Real.cos triangleAngle=5/6
body:
:= by
  exact Real.cos_arccos (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: triangleAngle_pos
stmt: : 0<triangleAngle
body: := Real.arccos_pos.mpr (by norm_num)

name: triangleAngle_lt_pi
stmt: : triangleAngle<Real.pi
body: := Real.arccos_lt_pi.mpr (by norm_num)

name: triangleAngle_ratio_irrational
stmt: : Irrational (triangleAngle/Real.pi)
body:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q,hq⟩
  have hh := niven (θ := triangleAngle) ⟨q,(div_eq_iff Real.pi_ne_zero).mp hq.symm⟩
    ⟨5/6,by norm_num only [Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_ofNat]; exact triangleAngle_cos⟩
  rw [triangleAngle_cos] at hh
  norm_num at hh

name: triangle_rotation_ergodic
stmt: : Ergodic (fun t : Angles => ((2*triangleAngle : ℝ) : Angles)+t) angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  apply ergodic_add_left_of_denseRange_zsmul _ angularMeasure
  apply AddCircle.denseRange_zsmul_coe_iff.mpr
  convert triangleAngle_ratio_irrational using 1
  field_simp

name: equal_triangleAngle_positive
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hs : Measurable s) (hflip : ∀ᵐ t∂angularMeasure, s (t+(Real.pi/3 : ℝ))= !(s t)) : 0<angularMeasure {t | s t=s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles))}
body:
:= by
  by_contra hz
  have hz' : angularMeasure {t | s t=s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles))}=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hz) bot_le
  have hf : ∀ᵐ t∂angularMeasure, s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles))= !(s t) := by
    filter_upwards [(measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz')] with t ht
    change ¬s t=s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles)) at ht
    cases h₁ : s t <;> cases h₂ : s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles)) <;> simp_all
  have hf₂ := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (triangleAngle : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hf
  have hinv : (fun t : Angles => s (((2*triangleAngle : ℝ) : Angles)+t))=ᵐ[angularMeasure] s := by
    filter_upwards [hf,hf₂] with t ht ht'
    have he : ((2*triangleAngle : ℝ) : Angles)+t=(t+(triangleAngle : Angles))+(triangleAngle : Angles) := by
      have hh : ((2*triangleAngle : ℝ) : Angles)=(triangleAngle : Angles)+(triangleAngle : Angles) := by
        calc ((2*triangleAngle : ℝ) : Angles) = ((triangleAngle+triangleAngle : ℝ) : Angles) := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : Angles)) (two_mul triangleAngle)
          _ = _ := AddCircle.coe_add _ _ _
      rw [hh]
      abel
    rw [he,ht',ht,Bool.not_not]
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := triangle_rotation_ergodic.ae_eq_const_of_ae_eq_comp₀ hs.nullMeasurable hinv
  have hb' := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure ((Real.pi/3:ℝ) : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hb
  have hfalse : ∀ᵐ t∂angularMeasure, False := by
    filter_upwards [hflip,hb,hb'] with t ht ht' ht''
    change s t=b at ht'
    change s (t+((Real.pi/3:ℝ):Angles))=b at ht''
    rw [ht',ht''] at ht
    cases b <;> cases ht
  have hh : (1:ENNReal)=0 := by simpa using (ae_iff.mp hfalse)
  exact one_ne_zero hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: circle_exp_sub_norm_sq
stmt: (a b : ℝ) : ‖(Circle.exp a : ℂ)-(Circle.exp b : ℂ)‖^2=2-2*Real.cos (a-b)
body:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  simp [Complex.normSq_apply,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,← Complex.ofReal_cos,← Complex.ofReal_sin]
  rw [Real.cos_sub]
  nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq a,Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq b]
def sourceTriangle (x : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) : ℂ :=
  angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3),t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle))

name: sourceTriangle_eq
stmt: (x : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) : sourceTriangle x t j=x+(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*(Circle.exp (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)* (1-(Circle.exp triangleAngle : ℂ))
body:
:= by
  simp only [sourceTriangle,angularSum,angleChart,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,direction_real,
    Circle.exp_add,Circle.coe_mul]
  have hpi : (Circle.exp Real.pi : ℂ)= -1 := by
    simp [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I]
  rw [hpi]
  ring

name: sourceTriangle_pair
stmt: (x : ℂ) (t : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (hne : i≠j) : ‖sourceTriangle x t i-sourceTriangle x t j‖=1
body:
:= by
  have hγ : ‖(1:ℂ)-(Circle.exp triangleAngle : ℂ)‖^2=1/3 := by
    have hh := circle_exp_sub_norm_sq 0 triangleAngle
    norm_num only [Circle.exp_zero,Circle.coe_one,zero_sub,Real.cos_neg,triangleAngle_cos] at hh ⊢
    exact hh
  have hc₂ : Real.cos (2*(Real.pi/3))= -1/2 := by
    rw [Real.cos_two_mul,Real.cos_pi_div_three]; norm_num
  have hc₄ : Real.cos (4*(Real.pi/3))= -1/2 := by
    rw [show 4*(Real.pi/3)=2*(2*(Real.pi/3)) by ring,Real.cos_two_mul,hc₂]; norm_num
  have hd : ‖(Circle.exp (2*(i:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)-(Circle.exp (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)‖^2=3 := by
    rw [circle_exp_sub_norm_sq]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> try contradiction
    all_goals norm_num only [Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_one,Fin.val_two,Nat.cast_zero,Nat.cast_one,Nat.cast_ofNat,mul_zero,mul_one,zero_mul,sub_zero,zero_sub]
    all_goals
      simp only [show 2*(Real.pi/3)-4*(Real.pi/3)= -(2*(Real.pi/3)) by ring,
        show 4*(Real.pi/3)-2*(Real.pi/3)=2*(Real.pi/3) by ring,Real.cos_neg,hc₂,hc₄]
      norm_num
  have he : sourceTriangle x t i-sourceTriangle x t j=
      (Circle.exp t : ℂ)*((Circle.exp (2*(i:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)-
        (Circle.exp (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ))*(1-(Circle.exp triangleAngle : ℂ)) := by
    rw [sourceTriangle_eq,sourceTriangle_eq]; ring
  rw [he,norm_mul,norm_mul,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  have hn := norm_nonneg ((Circle.exp (2*(i:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)-(Circle.exp (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ))
  have hm := norm_nonneg ((1:ℂ)-(Circle.exp triangleAngle : ℂ))
  have heq : (‖(Circle.exp (2*(i:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)-(Circle.exp (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) : ℂ)‖ *
      ‖(1:ℂ)-(Circle.exp triangleAngle : ℂ)‖)^2=1 := by
    rw [mul_pow,hd,hγ]; norm_num
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hn hm]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: color_memLp
stmt: (i : Fin k) : MemLp (colorValue k i) 2 (measure k ω)
body:
:= by
  refine MemLp.of_bound ?_ 1 ?_
  · apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    apply Measurable.ite _ measurable_const measurable_const
    exact (measurableSet_singleton i).preimage (show Measurable (fun η : Space k => η.val 0) from
      ((continuous_apply (0 : E)).comp continuous_subtype_val).measurable)
  · exact .of_forall fun η => by dsimp [colorValue]; split_ifs <;> simp
abbrev colorVector (i : Fin k) : Hilbert k ω := (color_memLp k ω i).toLp (colorValue k i)

name: color_ae
stmt: (i : Fin k) : colorVector k ω i =ᵐ[measure k ω] colorValue k i
body: := (color_memLp k ω i).coeFn_toLp

name: color_rotation_fixed
stmt: (i : Fin k) (b : K) : (rotation k ω b : Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) (colorVector k ω i) = colorVector k ω i
body:
:= by
  rw [rotation_apply]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving (colorVector k ω i) (rotate_preserving k ω b),
    (rotate_preserving k ω b).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (color_ae k ω i),color_ae k ω i] with η h1 h2 h3
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,h1,h2,h3,colorValue,rotate_apply,mul_zero]

name: color_unit_correlation
stmt: (i : Fin k) (b : K) : ⟪colorVector k ω i,op (representation k ω) (kCoeff b) (colorVector k ω i)⟫_ℂ = 0
body:
:= by
  rw [op_apply,L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  filter_upwards [color_ae k ω i,Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving (colorVector k ω i) (trans_preserving k ω (kCoeff b)),
    (trans_preserving k ω (kCoeff b)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (color_ae k ω i)] with η h1 h2 h3
  simp only [h1,h2,Function.comp_apply,h3,colorValue,trans_apply,zero_add]
  have hp : η.val 0 ≠ η.val (kCoeff b) := η.property 0 (kCoeff b) (by
    change ‖(0 : ℂ)-(b.val:ℂ)‖ = 1
    rw [zero_sub,norm_neg]
    exact Circle.norm_coe b.val)
  by_cases hi : η.val 0 = i
  · have hj : η.val (kCoeff b) ≠ i := fun h => hp (hi.trans h.symm)
    simp [hi,hj]
  · simp [hi]
instance continuous_complete : CompleteSpace (space (A := E) (representation k ω)) :=
  (isClosed_space (A := E) (representation k ω)).completeSpace_coe
def projected (i : Fin k) : Hilbert k ω := (space (A := E) (representation k ω)).starProjection (colorVector k ω i)

name: projected_range
stmt: (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ η ∂measure k ω, ((projected k ω i) η).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ ((projected k ω i) η).re ∧ ((projected k ω i) η).re ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  apply projection_range (measure k ω) (representation k ω) (trans k) (trans_preserving k ω) (op_apply k ω)
  filter_upwards [color_ae k ω i] with η h
  rw [h]
  dsimp [colorValue]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: projected_rotation_fixed
stmt: (i : Fin k) (b : K) : (rotation k ω b : Hilbert k ω →L[ℂ] Hilbert k ω) (projected k ω i) = projected k ω i
body:
:= by
  exact projection_covariance_fixed (representation k ω) (rotation k ω b)
    (Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ (kCoeff b) (kCoeff_ne_zero b)) (mul_zero _)
    (rotation_covariance k ω b) _ (color_rotation_fixed k ω i b)

name: projected_unit_correlation
stmt: (i : Fin k) (b : K) : ⟪projected k ω i,op (representation k ω) (kCoeff b) (projected k ω i)⟫_ℂ = 0
body:
:= by
  have hb := residual_fourier (representation k ω) (rotation k ω) (rotation_covariance k ω)
    (colorVector k ω i-projected k ω i)
    ((space (A := E) (representation k ω)).sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal (colorVector k ω i))
    (fun b => by rw [map_sub,color_rotation_fixed,projected_rotation_fixed]) (kCoeff b) (kCoeff_ne_zero b)
  exact (projection_coefficient (representation k ω) (colorVector k ω i) (kCoeff b) hb).trans (color_unit_correlation k ω i b)
end PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel

name: one_ae
stmt: : oneVector k ω =ᵐ[measure k ω] fun _ => (1 : ℂ)
body: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: one_fixed
stmt: (a : E) : op (representation k ω) a (oneVector k ω) = oneVector k ω
body:
:= by

  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving (oneVector k ω) (trans_preserving k ω a),
    (trans_preserving k ω a).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (one_ae k ω),one_ae k ω] with η h1 h2 h3

name: one_continuous
stmt: : oneVector k ω ∈ space (A := E) (representation k ω)

:= by

  simpa only [one_fixed] using (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : E => oneVector k ω) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (oneVector k ω)))

name: color_sum
stmt: : ∑ i : Fin k, colorVector k ω i = oneVector k ω
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum (Finset.univ) (colorVector k ω),ae_all_iff.mpr (color_ae k ω),one_ae k ω] with η h1 h2 h3
  rw [h1,h3]
  simp_rw [h2,colorValue]

name: projected_sum
stmt: : ∑ i : Fin k, projected k ω i = oneVector k ω

:= by

  rw [← map_sum,color_sum]

open Filter Topology
open scoped ComplexConjugate
namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

name: dense_E
stmt: : Dense (E : Set ℂ)
body:
:= by
  intro z
  have hh : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I ∈ closure (E : Set ℂ) := by
    intro x y
    refine (Rat.denseRange_cast : DenseRange ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)).induction_on₂
      (p := fun x y : ℝ => (x : ℂ)+(y : ℂ)*Complex.I ∈ closure (E : Set ℂ)) ?_ ?_ x y
    · exact isClosed_closure.preimage ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul_const Complex.I))
    · intro q r
      apply subset_closure
      apply mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr
      have hq : IsAlgebraic ℚ ((q : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simpa using isAlgebraic_ratCast ℚ (A := ℂ) q
      have hr : IsAlgebraic ℚ ((r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simpa using isAlgebraic_ratCast ℚ (A := ℂ) r
      exact hq.add (hr.mul (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp imagUnit.property))
  simpa only [Complex.re_add_im] using hh z.re z.im

name: algebraic_norm
stmt: (z : E) : IsAlgebraic ℚ (‖(z:ℂ)‖ : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  have hz : IsAlgebraic ℚ (z : ℂ) := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp z.property
  have hc : IsAlgebraic ℚ (conj (z : ℂ)) := hz.algHom (Complex.conjAe.restrictScalars ℚ).toAlgHom
  apply IsAlgebraic.of_pow (n := 2) (by norm_num)
  simpa only [Complex.mul_conj,Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,Complex.ofReal_pow] using hz.mul hc
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

open Filter Topology
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  (U : DiscreteE →* unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))

name: orbit_uniformContinuous
stmt: {v : H} (hv : v ∈ space (A := E) U) : UniformContinuous (fun a : E => op U a v)
body:
:= by
  apply Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,h⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (orbit_continuous U hv).continuousAt ε hε
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun a b hab => ?_⟩
  have ht : dist (op U (a-b) v) v < ε := by
    have hh := h (show dist (a-b) 0 < δ by simpa only [dist_zero_right,dist_eq_norm,sub_zero] using hab)
    simpa only [op_zero (A := E) U] using hh
  calc
    _ = dist (op U b (op U (a-b) v)) (op U b v) := by
      rw [← op_add (A := E) U]
      congr 2
      abel_nf
    _ = dist (op U (a-b) v) v := dist_op U b _ _
    _ < ε := ht
def orbitExtension (v : H) : ℂ → H := dense_E.extend (fun a : E => op U a v)

name: orbitExtension_continuous
stmt: {v : H} (hv : v ∈ space (A := E) U) : Continuous (orbitExtension U v)
body:
:=
  (dense_E.uniformContinuous_extend (orbit_uniformContinuous U hv)).continuous

name: orbitExtension_eq
stmt: {v : H} (hv : v ∈ space (A := E) U) (a : E) : orbitExtension U v (a : ℂ) = op U a v
body:
:=
  dense_E.extend_eq (orbit_continuous U hv) a

name: orbitExtension_inner
stmt: {v w : H} (hv : v ∈ space (A := E) U) (hw : w ∈ space (A := E) U) (x y : ℂ) : ⟪orbitExtension U v x,orbitExtension U w (x+y)⟫_ℂ = ⟪v,orbitExtension U w y⟫_ℂ
body:
:= by
  have hc := orbitExtension_continuous U hv
  have hd := orbitExtension_continuous U hw
  refine dense_E.denseRange_val.induction_on₂
    (p := fun x y : ℂ => ⟪orbitExtension U v x,orbitExtension U w (x+y)⟫_ℂ = ⟪v,orbitExtension U w y⟫_ℂ) ?_ ?_ x y
  · exact isClosed_eq ((hc.comp continuous_fst).inner (hd.comp (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd)))
      (continuous_const.inner (hd.comp continuous_snd))
  · intro a b
    change ⟪orbitExtension U v (a : ℂ),orbitExtension U w ((a+b : E) : ℂ)⟫_ℂ = _
    rw [orbitExtension_eq U hv,orbitExtension_eq U hw,orbitExtension_eq U hw,op_add (A := E) U]
    exact Unitary.inner_map_map (U (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)) v (op U b w)
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

open Filter Topology
namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

name: normalized_algebraic
body:
:= by
  have hn : ‖(z:ℂ)‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hz)
  have hb : ‖(z:ℂ) / (‖(z:ℂ)‖ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_div,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _),div_self hn]
  have hzalg : IsAlgebraic ℚ (z : ℂ) := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp z.property
  exact ⟨⟨⟨_,mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hb⟩,
    by
      change IsAlgebraic ℚ ((z : ℂ)/(‖(z:ℂ)‖ : ℂ))
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hzalg.mul (algebraic_norm z).inv⟩,rfl⟩

name: circle_closed_induction
stmt: {p : ℂ → Prop} (hp : IsClosed {z | p z}) (halg : ∀ b : K, p (b.val : ℂ)) (u : Circle) : p (u : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,ht⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp (dense_E (u : ℂ))
  have hne : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, s n ≠ 0 := ht.eventually (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds (Circle.coe_ne_zero u))
  have hnorm : Tendsto (fun n => s n / (‖s n‖ : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (u : ℂ)) := by
    have h := ht.div (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht.norm)
      (show (‖(u:ℂ)‖ : ℂ) ≠ 0 by simp [Circle.norm_coe])
    have he : (u : ℂ) / (‖(u:ℂ)‖ : ℂ) = (u : ℂ) := by simp only [Circle.norm_coe,Complex.ofReal_one,div_one]
    rw [he] at h
    convert h using 1
    rfl
  apply hp.mem_of_tendsto hnorm
  filter_upwards [hne] with n hn
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := normalized_algebraic ⟨s n,hs n⟩ (fun h => hn (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  rw [← hb]
  exact halg b
end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel
open Spectral EuclideanFiveColor EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
variable (k : ℕ) (ω : Space k)

name: projected_continuous
stmt: (i : Fin k) : projected k ω i ∈ space (A := E) (representation k ω)
body:
:=
  (space (A := E) (representation k ω)).starProjection_apply_mem _
def fieldVector (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) : Hilbert k ω := orbitExtension (representation k ω) (projected k ω i) x

name: fieldVector_continuous
stmt: (i : Fin k) : Continuous (fieldVector k ω i)
body:
:=
  orbitExtension_continuous _ (projected_continuous k ω i)

name: fieldVector_algebraic
stmt: (i : Fin k) (a : E) : fieldVector k ω i (a : ℂ) = op (representation k ω) a (projected k ω i)
body:
:=
  orbitExtension_eq _ (projected_continuous k ω i) a

name: fieldVector_sum
stmt: (x : ℂ) : ∑ i : Fin k, fieldVector k ω i x = oneVector k ω
body:
:= by
  refine dense_E.denseRange_val.induction_on x (isClosed_eq (continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => fieldVector_continuous k ω i)) continuous_const) ?_
  intro a
  simp only [fieldVector_algebraic,← map_sum,projected_sum,one_fixed]

name: fieldVector_range
stmt: (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐ η ∂measure k ω, (fieldVector k ω i x η).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (fieldVector k ω i x η).re ∧ (fieldVector k ω i x η).re ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  have he : clamp_lipschitz.compLp clamp_zero (fieldVector k ω i x) = fieldVector k ω i x := by
    refine dense_E.denseRange_val.induction_on x (isClosed_eq
      ((clamp_lipschitz.continuous_compLp clamp_zero).comp (fieldVector_continuous k ω i)) (fieldVector_continuous k ω i)) ?_
    intro a
    rw [fieldVector_algebraic,op_apply]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [clamp_lipschitz.coeFn_compLp clamp_zero (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (trans k a) (trans_preserving k ω a) (projected k ω i)),
      Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving (projected k ω i) (trans_preserving k ω a),
      (trans_preserving k ω a).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (projected_range k ω i)] with η h1 h2 h3
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
    rw [h1,h2]
    exact clamp_eq h3
  have ha := clamp_lipschitz.coeFn_compLp clamp_zero (fieldVector k ω i x)
  rw [he] at ha
  filter_upwards [ha] with η hη
  exact hη.symm ▸ clamp_range _

name: fieldVector_unit_correlation
stmt: (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (u : Circle) : ⟪fieldVector k ω i x,fieldVector k ω i (x+u)⟫_ℂ = 0
body:
:= by
  rw [show ⟪fieldVector k ω i x,fieldVector k ω i (x+u)⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪projected k ω i,fieldVector k ω i u⟫_ℂ from
    orbitExtension_inner _ (projected_continuous k ω i) (projected_continuous k ω i) x u]
  apply circle_closed_induction (isClosed_eq (continuous_const.inner (fieldVector_continuous k ω i)) continuous_const) _ u
  intro b
  change ⟪projected k ω i,fieldVector k ω i ((kCoeff b : E) : ℂ)⟫_ℂ = 0
  rw [fieldVector_algebraic]
  exact projected_unit_correlation k ω i b
end PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {T X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] [SeparableSpace T] [Nonempty T]
  [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T] [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)
  (f : T → Lp ℂ 2 μ) (hf : Continuous f)
include hf
omit [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T] in

name: dense_approx
stmt: (t : T) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ n, dist (f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq T n)) (f t) < ε
body:
:= by
  have h := mem_closure_image hf.continuousAt (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq T t)
  rw [← Set.range_comp] at h
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_range_iff.mp h ε hε
  exact ⟨n,by simpa only [Function.comp_apply,dist_comm] using hn⟩
def approxIndex (n : ℕ) (t : T) : ℕ := Nat.find (dense_approx μ f hf t ((1/2:ℝ)^n) (by positivity))

name: index_measurable
stmt: (n : ℕ) : Measurable (approxIndex μ f hf n)
body:
:= by
  apply measurable_find
  intro j
  exact isOpen_lt (continuous_const.dist hf) continuous_const |>.measurableSet
omit [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T] in

name: index_bound
stmt: (n : ℕ) (t : T) : dist (f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq T (approxIndex μ f hf n t))) (f t) < (1/2:ℝ)^n
body:
:= by
  unfold approxIndex
  exact Nat.find_spec (dense_approx μ f hf t ((1/2:ℝ)^n) (by positivity))
def approxField (n : ℕ) (p : T × X) : ℂ :=
  f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq T (approxIndex μ f hf n p.1)) p.2

name: approxField_measurable
stmt: (n : ℕ) : Measurable (approxField μ f hf n)
body:
:= by
  have h : Measurable (fun p : ℕ × X => f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq T p.1) p.2) :=
    measurable_from_prod_countable_right fun j => (Lp.stronglyMeasurable (f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq T j))).measurable
  exact h.comp (((index_measurable μ f hf n).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
omit [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T] in

name: approxField_tendsto
stmt: (t : T) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => approxField μ f hf n (t,x)) atTop (𝓝 (f t x))
body:
:= by
  let g : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 μ := fun n => f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq T (approxIndex μ f hf n t))-f t
  have hs : Summable (fun n => ‖g n‖) := summable_geometric_two.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => by simpa only [g,dist_eq_norm] using (index_bound μ f hf n t).le)
  have ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Summable (fun n => ‖g n x‖) := by
    apply summable_norm_of_tsum_eLpNorm_ne_top (by norm_num : (1:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
    simpa only [← Lp.enorm_def] using (tsum_enorm_ne_top_iff_summable_norm.mpr hs)
  have he : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ n, g n x = approxField μ f hf n (t,x)-f t x :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun n => Lp.coeFn_sub _ _
  filter_upwards [ha,he] with x hx he
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [he] using hx.tendsto_atTop_zero
def measurableField (p : T × X) : ℂ :=
  ⟨limsup (fun n => (approxField μ f hf n p).re) atTop,
   limsup (fun n => (approxField μ f hf n p).im) atTop⟩

name: measurableField_measurable
stmt: : Measurable (measurableField μ f hf)
body:
:= by
  have hr := Measurable.limsup fun n => Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp (approxField_measurable μ f hf n)
  have hi := Measurable.limsup fun n => Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp (approxField_measurable μ f hf n)
  have hh := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hr).add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hi).mul_const Complex.I)
  convert hh using 1
  funext p
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [measurableField]

name: exists_measurable_field
stmt: : ∃ F : T × X → ℂ, Measurable F ∧ ∀ t, (fun x => F (t,x)) =ᵐ[μ] f t
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurableField μ f hf,?_,?_⟩
  · exact measurableField_measurable μ f hf
  · intro t
    filter_upwards [approxField_tendsto μ f hf t] with x hx
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact (Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx).limsup_eq
    · exact (Complex.continuous_im.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx).limsup_eq
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ComplexConjugate
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)

name: positive_orthogonal
stmt: (v w : Lp ℂ 2 μ) (hv : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (v x).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (v x).re) (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (w x).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (w x).re) (ho : ⟪v,w⟫_ℂ = 0) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (v x).re * (w x).re = 0
body:
:= by
  have hi := L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) v w
  have he : (fun x => (⟪v x,w x⟫_ℂ).re) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => (v x).re * (w x).re) := by
    filter_upwards [hv,hw] with x hx hy
    simp [RCLike.inner_apply,Complex.mul_re,hx.1,hy.1,mul_comm]
  have hh : Integrable (fun x => (v x).re * (w x).re) μ := hi.re.congr he
  apply (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae _ hh).mp
  · rw [← integral_congr_ae he]
    change (∫ x, RCLike.re (⟪v x,w x⟫_ℂ) ∂μ) = 0
    rw [integral_re hi,← L2.inner_def,ho]
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [hv,hw] with x hx hy
    exact mul_nonneg hx.2 hy.2
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
namespace PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel
open Spectral EuclideanFiveColor EuclideanFiveColor.ContinuousVectors
variable (k : ℕ) (ω : Space k)

name: exists_label_field
stmt: : ∃ H : Fin k → ℂ × Space k → ℝ, (∀ i, Measurable (H i)) ∧ (∀ x : ℂ, ∀ᵐ η ∂measure k ω, ∑ i, H i (x,η) = 1) ∧ (∀ x : ℂ, ∀ u : Circle, ∀ᵐ η ∂measure k ω, ∀ i, H i (x,η)*H i (x+u,η) = 0)
body:
:= by
  have hex (i : Fin k) := exists_measurable_field (measure k ω) (fieldVector k ω i) (fieldVector_continuous k ω i)
  choose F hm hae using hex
  refine ⟨fun i p => (F i p).re,fun i => Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp (hm i),?_,?_⟩
  · intro x
    have hs := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin k => fieldVector k ω i x)
    rw [fieldVector_sum] at hs
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => hae i x),hs,one_ae k ω] with η he hs h1
    have hc : ∑ i : Fin k, F i (x,η) = 1 := by
      simp_rw [he]
      exact hs.symm.trans h1
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re hc
    simpa only [map_sum,Complex.re_sum,Complex.one_re] using hr
  · intro x u
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    have hz := positive_orthogonal (measure k ω) (fieldVector k ω i x) (fieldVector k ω i (x+u))
      ((fieldVector_range k ω i x).mono fun _ h => ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩)
      ((fieldVector_range k ω i (x+u)).mono fun _ h => ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩)
      (fieldVector_unit_correlation k ω i x u)
    filter_upwards [hae i x,hae i (x+u),hz] with η h1 h2 h3
    simpa only [h1,h2] using h3
end PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel

variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {k : ℕ} [NeZero k]
def positiveSupport (f : Fin k → X → ℝ) (x : X) : Finset (Fin k) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < f i x
omit [NeZero k] in

name: positiveSupport_measurable
stmt: (f : Fin k → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) : Measurable (positiveSupport f)
body:
:= by
  apply measurable_finset_iff.mpr
  intro i
  simp only [positiveSupport,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
  exact measurableSet_setOfPred.mp (measurableSet_lt measurable_const (hf i))
private def pickSupport (s : Finset (Fin k)) : Fin k := if h : s.Nonempty then h.choose else 0
def positiveSelect (f : Fin k → X → ℝ) (x : X) : Fin k := pickSupport (positiveSupport f x)

name: positiveSelect_measurable
stmt: (f : Fin k → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) : Measurable (positiveSelect f)
body:
:=
  (measurable_of_countable pickSupport).comp (positiveSupport_measurable f hf)
omit [MeasurableSpace X] in

name: positiveSelect_pos
stmt: (f : Fin k → X → ℝ) (x : X) (hs : ∑ i, f i x = 1) : 0 < f (positiveSelect f x) x
body:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ i, 0 < f i x := by
    by_contra! h
    have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => h i)
    linarith
  have hn : (positiveSupport f x).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hex
    exact ⟨i,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hi⟩⟩
  have hmem : positiveSelect f x ∈ positiveSupport f x := by
    simp only [positiveSelect,pickSupport,dite_eq_left hn]
    exact hn.choose_spec
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {Ω S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace S]
  (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ν : Measure S) [SFinite ν]
  (d : S → ℂ) (hd : Measurable d) {k : ℕ} [NeZero k]
include hd

name: sample_field
stmt: (H : Fin k → ℂ × Ω → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (H i)) (hp : ∀ x : ℂ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∑ i, H i (x,ω) = 1) (ho : ∀ x : ℂ, ∀ s : S, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ i, H i (x,ω)*H i (x+d s,ω) = 0) : ∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, Measurable c ∧ ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume : Measure ℂ).prod ν, c p.1 ≠ c (p.1+d p.2)
body:
:= by
  let c : ℂ × Ω → Fin k := positiveSelect H
  have hc : Measurable c := positiveSelect_measurable H hm
  have ha (p : ℂ × S) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, c (p.1,ω) ≠ c (p.1+d p.2,ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hp p.1,hp (p.1+d p.2),ho p.1 p.2] with ω h1 h2 h3
    intro he
    have hpos1 := positiveSelect_pos H (p.1,ω) h1
    have hpos2 := positiveSelect_pos H (p.1+d p.2,ω) h2
    change 0 < H (c (p.1,ω)) (p.1,ω) at hpos1
    change 0 < H (c (p.1+d p.2,ω)) (p.1+d p.2,ω) at hpos2
    rw [← he] at hpos2
    exact (mul_pos hpos1 hpos2).ne' (h3 _)
  have hm1 : Measurable (fun q : (ℂ × S) × Ω => c (q.1.1,q.2)) :=
    hc.comp ((measurable_fst.fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hm2 : Measurable (fun q : (ℂ × S) × Ω => c (q.1.1+d q.1.2,q.2)) :=
    hc.comp (((measurable_fst.fst).add (hd.comp measurable_fst.snd)).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hh : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume : Measure ℂ).prod ν, c (p.1,ω) ≠ c (p.1+d p.2,ω) :=
    (Measure.ae_ae_comm (measurableSet_eq_fun hm1 hm2).compl).mp (.of_forall ha)
  obtain ⟨ω,hω⟩ := hh.exists
  exact ⟨fun x => c (x,ω),hc.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const),hω⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory

name: proper_to_borel_weak_algebraic
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {c : PlaneFiveColor.Spectral.E → Fin k} (hc : PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.Proper k c) : ∃ d : ℂ → Fin k, Measurable d ∧ WeakColoring k d

:= by
  let ω : PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.Space k := ⟨c,hc⟩
  obtain ⟨H,hm,hp,ho⟩ := PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.exists_label_field k ω
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hunit⟩ := sample_field (PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.measure k ω) angularMeasure
    direction direction_continuous.measurable
    H hm hp (fun x t => ho x (AddCircle.toCircle t))

name: proper_to_borel_weak
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : ProperColoring k c) : ∃ d : ℂ → Fin k, Measurable d ∧ WeakColoring k d

:=

name: proper_to_weak
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : ProperColoring k c) : ∃ d : ℂ → Fin k, WeakColoring k d

name: support_good_sequence
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {P : ℝ → Prop} {a : ℝ} (ha : a∈(volume.restrict A).support) (hP : ∀ᵐt∂volume,t∈A → P t) : ∃t : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 a) ∧ ∀n,P (t n)
body:
:= by
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃t,dist t a<1/((n:ℝ)+1) ∧ P t := by
    have hp : 0<volume (Metric.ball a (1/((n:ℝ)+1))∩A) := by
      simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball] using
        (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall a).mp ha _ (Metric.ball_mem_nhds a (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hpt⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hp.ne').and_eventually hP).exists
    exact ⟨t,ht.1,hpt ht.2⟩
  choose t hd hpt using hex
  refine ⟨t,?_,hpt⟩
  rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
  exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun n => (hd n).le) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: state_support_avoiding_trace
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {A : Set ℝ} {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hA : RealState hc x A J) {a : ℝ} (ha : a∈(volume.restrict A).support) : ∃b : TraceVector k,IsTrace c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) b ∧ ∀i∈J,traceValue b i=0
body:
:= by
  have he := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_circle_palette_exclusion c hc hw x)
  have ht := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_circle_typicalSampling c hc x)
  have hp : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈A → TypicalSampling c (x+direction (t : Angles)) 1 ∧
      ∀i∈J,sample c hc (x+direction (t : Angles)) 1 i=0 := by
    filter_upwards [he,ht,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (fun hi : i∈J => hA.2 i hi))] with t he ht hJ hta
    refine ⟨ht,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (x+direction (t : Angles)) 1 i,he,Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure] with v hv he hz
    rw [hz,hv]
    have hne : c (x+direction (t : Angles)+direction v)≠i := by
      intro hh
      apply he
      rw [hh]
      exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mpr (hJ i hi hta)
    simp only [sampleFn,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,ite_eq_right hne,Pi.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hp⟩ := support_good_sequence ha hp
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (TraceVector k))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => Set.mem_univ (sampleCode c hc (x+direction (t n : Angles)) 1)))
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => x+direction (t n : Angles)) atTop (𝓝 (x+direction (a : Angles))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.add (direction_continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ((AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi)).continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht))
  refine ⟨b,trace_of_realization c hc (fun n => (hp (φ n)).1) (hlim.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) tendsto_const_nhds hb,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hh := traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp hb i (traceValue b i)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,traceValue_sampleCode,(hp _).2 i hi,inner_zero_left] at hh
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp (tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hh).symm

name: avoiding_trace_palette
stmt: {x : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc x b) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hJ : ∀i∈J,traceValue b i=0) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,¬palette c hc x t⊆J
body:
:= by
  have hs : (fun t => ∑i,traceValue b i t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure](fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue b)
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc hb).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  have hz (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,i∈J → traceValue b i t=0 := by
    by_cases hi : i∈J
    · rw [hJ i hi]
      exact (Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure).mono fun _ hh _ => hh
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ hh => (hi hh).elim
  filter_upwards [hs,ae_all_iff.mpr hz,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x i ⟨b,hb⟩)] with t hs hz hp hsub
  have hn : ∀i : Fin k,traceValue b i t≤0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra! hpos
    have hm := hsub ((mem_palette c hc x t i).mpr (hp i hpos))
    linarith [hz i hm]
  have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hn i)
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: sample_region_ae
stmt: (r : ℝ) {W : Set ℂ} {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J) : ∀ᵐy : ℂ∂volume,∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,y+(r : ℂ)*direction t∈W → c (y+(r : ℂ)*direction t)∈J
body:
:= by
  have hq : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun p : ℂ × Angles => p.1+(r : ℂ)*direction p.2)
      ((volume : Measure ℂ).prod angularMeasure) volume :=
    QuasiMeasurePreserving.prod_of_left
      (measurable_fst.add (measurable_const.mul (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd)))
      (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℂ)
        ((r : ℂ)*direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving)
  exact Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (hq.ae hW)
include hc in

name: sampling_near_region
stmt: {x : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) {K : Set Angles} (hK : IsCompact K) {W : Set ℂ} (ho : IsOpen W) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J) (hmem : ∀t∈K,x+(r : ℂ)*direction t∈W) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) : ∃y : ℂ,dist y x<δ ∧ TypicalSampling c y r ∧ ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈K → c (y+(r : ℂ)*direction t)∈J
body:
:= by
  let U : Set (ℂ × Angles) := {p | p.1+(r : ℂ)*direction p.2∈W}
  have hU : IsOpen U := ho.preimage (continuous_fst.add (continuous_const.mul (direction_continuous.comp continuous_snd)))
  obtain ⟨V,T,hV,_,hxV,hKT,hVT⟩ := generalized_tube_lemma (isCompact_singleton (x := x)) hK hU
    (by rintro ⟨y,t⟩ ⟨hy,ht⟩; change y=x at hy; subst y; exact hmem t ht)
  have hv : x∈V := hxV (mem_singleton x)
  have hpos : 0<volume (V∩Metric.ball x δ) := (hV.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).measure_pos volume
    ⟨x,hv,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyp,hyW⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hpos.ne').and_eventually
    ((ae_typicalSampling c hc hr).and (sample_region_ae c r hW))).exists
  refine ⟨y,hy.2,hyp,hyW.mono fun t ht htK => ht ?_⟩
  exact hVT (show (y,t)∈V×ˢT from ⟨hy.1,hKT htK⟩)

name: weak_limit_zero_on
stmt: {f : ℕ → RealL2 angularMeasure} {b : RealL2 angularMeasure} {K : Set Angles} (hK : MeasurableSet K) (ht : ∀v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b,v⟫)) (hb : 0≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] b) (hf : ∀n,∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈K → f n t=0) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈K → b t=0
body:
:= by
  have ht' := ht (indicatorConstLp 2 hK (measure_ne_top angularMeasure K) 1)
  have he (v : RealL2 angularMeasure) :
      ⟪v,indicatorConstLp 2 hK (measure_ne_top angularMeasure K) 1⟫=∫t in K,v t∂angularMeasure := by
    rw [real_inner_comm,L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one]
  simp only [he] at ht'
  have hf0 (n) : ∫t in K,f n t∂angularMeasure=0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    exact (ae_restrict_iff' hK).mpr (hf n)
  simp only [hf0] at ht'
  have hzero : ∫t in K,b t∂angularMeasure=0 := (tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds ht').symm
  have hz := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hb)
    ((Lp.memLp b).integrable (by norm_num)).integrableOn).mp hzero
  exact (ae_restrict_iff' hK).mp hz

name: trace_region_palette
stmt: {x : ℂ} {K : Set Angles} (hK : IsCompact K) {W : Set ℂ} (ho : IsOpen W) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J) {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : ∀n,0<r n) (hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hmem : ∀n,∀t∈K,x+(r n : ℂ)*direction t∈W) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈K → (palette c hc x t∩J).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  have hex (n : ℕ) := sampling_near_region c hc (hr n) hK ho hW (hmem n)
    (δ := 1/((n:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity)
  choose y hy hyt hyJ using hex
  have hyl : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun n => (hy n).le) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (TraceVector k))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => Set.mem_univ (sampleCode c hc (y n) (r n))))
  have htrace := trace_of_realization c hc (fun n => hyt (φ n)) (hyl.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    (hrt.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hb
  have hz (i : Fin k) (hi : i∉J) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈K → traceValue b i t=0 := by
    apply weak_limit_zero_on hK.measurableSet
      (by simpa only [traceValue_sampleCode] using traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp hb i)
      ((trace_bounds c hc htrace).1 i)
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hyJ (φ n),sample_ae c hc (y (φ n)) (r (φ n)) i] with t ht he htK
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,traceValue_sampleCode]
    rw [he]
    unfold sampleFn
    split_ifs with htcol
    · exact (hi (htcol ▸ ht htK)).elim
    · rfl
  have hs : (fun t => ∑i,traceValue b i t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure](fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue b)
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc htrace).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  filter_upwards [hs,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (hz i)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x i ⟨b,htrace⟩)] with t hs hz hp htK
  by_contra! hn
  have hn' : ∀i,traceValue b i t≤0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra! hpos
    have hi : i∈palette c hc x t := (mem_palette c hc x t i).mpr (hp i hpos)
    by_cases hiJ : i∈J
    · have hh := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi,hiJ⟩
      rw [hn] at hh
      exact Finset.notMem_empty i hh
    · linarith [hz i hiJ htK]
  have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hn' i)
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: outer_strip_trace
stmt: {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) {W : Set ℂ} (ho : IsOpen W) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J) (hstrip : ∀u : Angles,dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 1<r → r<1+δ → x+(r : ℂ)*direction u∈W) : ∃U : Set Angles,IsOpen U ∧ t∈U ∧ ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈U → (palette c hc x u∩J).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  let K : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)≤δ/2}
  let U : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2}
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isClosed_le (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).isCompact
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1+(δ/2)/(n+1)
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul,mul_zero,add_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).add
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (δ/2))
  have hh := trace_region_palette c hc hK ho hW hr hrt (fun n u hu => by
    apply hstrip u (by dsimp [K] at hu; linarith)
    · dsimp [r]
      have : 0<(δ/2)/((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith
    · have hn : (1:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)+1 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
      have hb := div_le_self (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤δ/2) hn
      dsimp [r]
      linarith)
  refine ⟨U,isOpen_lt (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const,?_,?_⟩
  · change dist (direction t) (direction t)<δ/2
    simp only [dist_self]; positivity
  · exact hh.mono fun u hu hU => hu (show u∈K from (show dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2 from hU).le)

name: inner_strip_trace
stmt: {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) {W : Set ℂ} (ho : IsOpen W) {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J) (hstrip : ∀u : Angles,dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → 1-δ<r → r<1 → x+(r : ℂ)*direction u∈W) : ∃U : Set Angles,IsOpen U ∧ t∈U ∧ ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈U → (palette c hc x u∩J).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  let K : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)≤δ/2}
  let U : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2}
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isClosed_le (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).isCompact
  let ε := min δ (1/2)
  have he : 0<ε := lt_min hδ (by norm_num)
  have heδ : ε≤δ := min_le_left _ _
  have he1 : ε≤1/2 := min_le_right _ _
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1-(ε/2)/(n+1)
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (ε/2)/(n+1)≤ε/2 := div_le_self (by positivity) (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := by dsimp [r]; linarith [hb n]
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul,mul_zero,sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).sub
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (ε/2))
  have hh := trace_region_palette c hc hK ho hW hr hrt (fun n u hu => by
    apply hstrip u (by dsimp [K] at hu; linarith) (r n) (hr n)
    · dsimp [r]; linarith [hb n]
    · dsimp [r]
      have : 0<(ε/2)/((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith)
  refine ⟨U,isOpen_lt (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const,?_,?_⟩
  · change dist (direction t) (direction t)<δ/2
    simp only [dist_self]; positivity
  · exact hh.mono fun u hu hU => hu (show u∈K from (show dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2 from hU).le)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
