name: binary_strip_rigidity
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {a b : Fin k} {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hUc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈U → c q=a ∨ c q=b) (hVc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈V → c q=a ∨ c q=b) {x e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (bu bv : Bool) (hstripU : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bu then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈U) (hstripV : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (e*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ))<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bv then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈V) : ∃i : Fin k,(i=a ∨ i=b) ∧ ∃η>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<η → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<η → (if bu then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈essentialLocalSet c i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hpv⟩ := radial_unit_contact he hδ bv hstripV
  obtain ⟨w,hpw,hw',hd⟩ := open_two_unit_directions hV hv hpv
  let W : Set ℂ := {p | p+v∈V ∧ p+w∈V}
  have hW : IsOpen W := (hV.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).inter
    (hV.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hbox⟩ := polarBox_small hδ hW ⟨hpv,hpw⟩ hstripU he
  obtain ⟨i,hi,_⟩ := connected_local_ae_constant (polarBox_connected x e bu hε) (fun p hp => by
    have hp' := hbox hp
    obtain ⟨r,hr,j,hj⟩ := binary_open_local_rigidity hc hw hU hV hUc hVc hp'.1 hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2 hv hw' hd
    exact ⟨j,Metric.ball p r,Metric.isOpen_ball,Metric.mem_ball_self hr,hj⟩)
  have hab : i=a ∨ i=b := by
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := (polarBox_connected x e bu hε).nonempty
    have hpos := (hU.inter (essentialLocalSet_open c i)).measure_pos (volume : Measure ℂ)
      ⟨p,(hbox hp).1,hi hp⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hqa⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne'
      (ae_restrict_of_ae (hUc.and (essentialLocalSet_ae c i)))
    simpa only [hqa.2 hq.2] using hqa.1 hq.1
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hh⟩ := polarBox_contains_strip he bu hε
  exact ⟨i,hab,η,hη,fun e' he' hh' r _ hr hside => hi (hh e' he' hh' r hr hside)⟩

name: binary_strip_palette_rigidity
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {a b : Fin k} {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hUc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈U → c q=a ∨ c q=b) (hVc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈V → c q=a ∨ c q=b) {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (bu bv : Bool) (hstripU : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (direction t)<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bu then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈U) (hstripV : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ))<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bv then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈V) : ∃i : Fin k,(i=a ∨ i=b) ∧ ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧ ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → i∈palette c hc x u
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,η,hη,hs⟩ := binary_strip_rigidity hc hw hU hV hUc hVc (direction_norm t) hδ bu bv hstripU hstripV
  have hmono : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈essentialLocalSet c i → c q∈({i} : Finset (Fin k)) :=
    (essentialLocalSet_ae c i).mono fun q hq hqi => by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using hq hqi
  have hex : ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → (palette c hc x u∩{i}).Nonempty := by
    cases bu
    · apply inner_strip_trace c hc hη (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hmono
      intro u hu r hr hrη hr1
      apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r hr _ hr1
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    · apply outer_strip_trace c hc hη (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hmono
      intro u hu r hr1 hrη
      apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r (by linarith) _ hr1
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨A,hA,ht,hae⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨i,hi,A,hA,ht,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hu hAu
  rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hj with ⟨hjp,hji⟩
  simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hji] using hjp
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: unit_antipodes_of_no_positive
stmt: {v w : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) (hw : ‖w‖=1) (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,¬(0<⟪direction t,v⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,w⟫)) : w= -v
body:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hsum : v+w≠0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hne
    apply eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using hz
  have hvv : ⟪v,v⟫=(1:ℝ) := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,hv]; norm_num
  have hww : ⟪w,w⟫=(1:ℝ) := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,hw]; norm_num
  have hs : 0<⟪v+w,v+w⟫ := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)
  have hc := real_inner_comm v w
  simp only [inner_add_left,inner_add_right,hvv,hww] at hs
  have hvpos : 0<⟪v+w,v⟫ := by rw [inner_add_left,hvv]; linarith
  have hwpos : 0<⟪v+w,w⟫ := by rw [inner_add_left,hww]; linarith
  let e : ℂ := ‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w)
  have he : ‖e‖=1 := by
    simp only [e,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_inv,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg (v+w))]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hsum)
  have hev : 0<⟪e,v⟫ := by
    change 0<⟪‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w),_⟫
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)) hvpos
  have hew : 0<⟪e,w⟫ := by
    change 0<⟪‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w),_⟫
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)) hwpos
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists he
  let U : Set Angles := {t | 0<⟪direction t,v⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,w⟫}
  have hUv : IsOpen {t : Angles | 0<⟪direction t,v⟫} := isOpen_lt continuous_const (direction_continuous.inner continuous_const)
  have hUw : IsOpen {t : Angles | 0<⟪direction t,w⟫} := isOpen_lt continuous_const (direction_continuous.inner continuous_const)
  have hU : IsOpen U := hUv.inter hUw
  have htU : t∈U := by change _∧_; rw [ht]; exact ⟨hev,hew⟩
  have hpos := hU.measure_pos angularMeasure ⟨t,htU⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hu'⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  exact hu' hu

name: four_split_antipodes
stmt: (v : Fin 4 → ℂ) (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hsplit : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,∀i,¬(0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,v (i+2)⟫)) : ∀i,v (i+2)= -v i
body:
:= by
  intro i
  exact unit_antipodes_of_no_positive (hv i) (hv (i+2)) (hsplit.mono fun _ ht => ht i)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

name: toPlane_zero
stmt: (z : ℂ) : toPlane z 0 = z.re
body: := rfl

name: toPlane_one
stmt: (z : ℂ) : toPlane z 1 = z.im
body: := rfl

name: ofPlane_re
stmt: (p : Plane) : (ofPlane p).re = p 0
body: := rfl

name: ofPlane_im
stmt: (p : Plane) : (ofPlane p).im = p 1
body: := rfl

name: toPlane_sub
stmt: (z w : ℂ) : toPlane (z - w) = toPlane z - toPlane w
body:
:= by
  ext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [toPlane]

name: sq_norm_toPlane
stmt: (z : ℂ) : ‖toPlane z‖ ^ 2 = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2
body:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, toPlane_zero, toPlane_one]

name: sq_norm_complex
body:
:= by
  rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; ring

name: norm_toPlane
stmt: (z : ℂ) : ‖toPlane z‖ = ‖z‖
body:
:= by
  have h : ‖toPlane z‖ ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by rw [sq_norm_toPlane, sq_norm_complex]
  calc ‖toPlane z‖ = Real.sqrt (‖toPlane z‖ ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)).symm
    _ = Real.sqrt (‖z‖ ^ 2) := by rw [h]
    _ = ‖z‖ := Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)

name: dist_toPlane
stmt: (z w : ℂ) : dist (toPlane z) (toPlane w) = dist z w
body:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← toPlane_sub, norm_toPlane]

name: dist_ofPlane
stmt: (x y : Plane) : dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) = dist x y
body:
:= by
  have h1 : dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, sq_norm_complex]
    simp [ofPlane]
  have h2 : dist x y ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, PiLp.sub_apply]
  have h : dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 := by rw [h1, h2]
  calc dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y)
      = Real.sqrt (dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) ^ 2) :=
        (Real.sqrt_sq (dist_nonneg)).symm
    _ = Real.sqrt (dist x y ^ 2) := by rw [h]
    _ = dist x y := Real.sqrt_sq (dist_nonneg)

name: properColoring_of_plane
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : Plane → Fin k} (hc : ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y) : EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring k (fun z => c (toPlane z))
body:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  refine hc _ _ ?_
  rw [dist_toPlane, dist_eq_norm]
  exact hxy

name: plane_of_properColoring
stmt: {k : ℕ} {d : ℂ → Fin k} (hd : EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring k d) : ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → (fun p => d (ofPlane p)) x ≠ (fun p => d (ofPlane p)) y
body:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  refine hd _ _ ?_
  rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_ofPlane]
  exact hxy

name: planeProperColoring_iff
stmt: {k : ℕ} : ProperColoring k ↔ ∃ d : ℂ → Fin k, EuclideanFiveColor.ProperColoring k d
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨fun z => c (toPlane z), properColoring_of_plane hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
    exact ⟨fun p => d (ofPlane p), plane_of_properColoring hd⟩

name: properColoring_mono
stmt: {k m : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (h : ProperColoring k) : ProperColoring m
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun p => Fin.castLE hkm (c p), ?_⟩
  intro x y hxy hcontra
  exact hc x y hxy (Fin.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val hcontra))

name: not_properColoring_five
stmt: : ¬ ProperColoring 5
body:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := planeProperColoring_iff.mp h
  exact EuclideanFiveColor.no_proper_five_coloring ⟨d, hd⟩

name: not_properColoring_of_le
stmt: {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 5) : ¬ ProperColoring k
body:
:= fun h =>
  not_properColoring_five (properColoring_mono hk h)

name: six_le_planeChromaticNumber
stmt: : 6 ≤ planeChromaticNumber
body:
:= by
  rw [planeChromaticNumber]
  refine le_csInf ⟨(7:ℕ), properColoring_seven⟩ ?_
  intro k hk
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  exact not_properColoring_of_le (by omega) hk

name: planeChromaticNumber_le_seven
stmt: : planeChromaticNumber ≤ 7
body:
:= by
  rw [planeChromaticNumber]
  exact Nat.sInf_le properColoring_seven

name: chromaticNumber_bounds
stmt: : 6 ≤ planeChromaticNumber ∧ planeChromaticNumber ≤ 7
body:
:=
  ⟨six_le_planeChromaticNumber, planeChromaticNumber_le_seven⟩

end
end Problem160
end OAI

#print axioms OAI.Problem160.chromaticNumber_bounds
#print axioms OAI.Problem160.six_le_planeChromaticNumber
#print axioms OAI.Problem160.not_properColoring_five

name: circleSum_strict
stmt: (r : ℝ) (p : RealPlane) : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum r) (circleSumDeriv r p) p
body:
:= by
  have hc1 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos p.1).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hc2 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos p.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs1 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin p.1).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs2 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin p.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  exact ((hc1.const_smul r).add hc2).prodMk ((hs1.const_smul r).add hs2)

name: circleSum_continuous
stmt: (r : ℝ) : Continuous (circleSum r)
body:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun p => (circleSum_strict r p).continuousAt

name: circleSumDeriv_injective
stmt: {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (circleSumDeriv r p)
body:
:= by
  apply (circleSumDeriv r p).toLinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro q hq
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hq
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hq
  change r * (-Real.sin p.1 * q.1) + -Real.sin p.2 * q.2 = 0 at h1
  change r * (Real.cos p.1 * q.1) + Real.cos p.2 * q.2 = 0 at h2
  have ha : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1)*q.1=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination Real.cos p.2*h1+Real.sin p.2*h2
  have hb : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1)*q.2=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination -(r*Real.cos p.1)*h1-(r*Real.sin p.1)*h2
  exact Prod.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp ha).resolve_left h) ((mul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left h)
def circleSumDerivEquiv {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) :
    RealPlane ≃L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective (circleSumDeriv r p)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (circleSumDeriv_injective h))
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr ((LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank rfl).mp
      (circleSumDeriv_injective h)))

name: circleSum_local_antilipschitz
stmt: {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) : ∃ s : Set RealPlane, IsOpen s ∧ p ∈ s ∧ ∃ K : ℝ≥0, AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict (circleSum r))
body:
:= by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv h
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum r) (L : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane) p := circleSum_strict r p
  obtain ⟨s,hp,hs,ha⟩ := hd.approximates_deriv_on_open_nhds
  refine ⟨s,hs,hp,_,ha.antilipschitz ?_⟩
  right
  have hpos := L.subsingleton_or_nnnorm_symm_pos.resolve_left (not_subsingleton RealPlane)
  exact half_lt_self (inv_pos.mpr hpos)

name: realDirection_lipschitz
stmt: : LipschitzWith 1 (fun t : ℝ => (Real.cos t,Real.sin t))
body:
:= by
  simpa using Real.lipschitzWith_cos.prodMk Real.lipschitzWith_sin
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
def circleInverseHomeo : OpenPartialHomeomorph RealPlane RealPlane :=
  (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
    (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
    (t,u) from circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).toOpenPartialHomeomorph (circleSum 1)
def circleInverse : RealPlane → RealPlane := by
  classical
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).target.piecewise (circleInverseHomeo h).symm (fun _ => 0)

name: circleInverse_measurable
stmt: : Measurable (circleInverse h)
body:
:= by
  classical
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).continuousOn_invFun.measurable_piecewise continuous_const.continuousOn
    (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.measurableSet

name: circleInverse_eq
stmt: {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) : circleInverse h q=(circleInverseHomeo h).symm q
body: := by simp [circleInverse,hq]

name: circleInverse_at
stmt: : circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))=(t,u)
body:
:= by
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (t,u) := circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)
  rw [circleInverse_eq h hd.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target]
  exact hd.localInverse_apply_image

name: circleInverse_continuousAt
stmt: {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) : ContinuousAt (circleInverse h) q
body:
:= by
  apply ((circleInverseHomeo h).continuousAt_symm hq).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hq] with y hy
  exact circleInverse_eq h hy

name: circleInverse_strict
stmt: : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleInverse h) ((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane) (circleSum 1 (t,u))
body:
:= by
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (t,u) := circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)
  apply hd.to_localInverse.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hd.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target] with q hq
  exact (circleInverse_eq h hq).symm

name: circleInverse_right
stmt: {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) : circleSum 1 (circleInverse h q)=q
body:
:= by
  rw [circleInverse_eq h hq]
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).right_inv hq

name: circleInverse_regular
stmt: : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (circleSum 1 (t,u)), Real.sin ((circleInverse h q).2-(circleInverse h q).1) ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  have hc := (Real.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
    ((circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.snd.sub (circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.fst))
  have hh : Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))).2-(circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))).1) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [circleInverse_at h]
  exact hc.eventually_ne hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
omit [CompleteSpace E] in

name: triangular_injective
stmt: (L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hc : L (0,1) ≠ 0) : Function.Injective ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L)
body:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  change (a.1,L a)=(b.1,L b) at hab
  have hab₁ := congrArg (fun q : E × ℝ => q.1) hab
  have hab₂ := congrArg (fun q : E × ℝ => q.2) hab
  dsimp only at hab₁ hab₂
  have he : a-b=(0,a.2-b.2) := Prod.ext (by simp [hab₁]) rfl
  have hz : L (0,a.2-b.2)=0 := by rw [← he,map_sub,hab₂,sub_self]
  have hm : L (0,a.2-b.2)=(a.2-b.2)*L (0,1) := by
    have h : (0,a.2-b.2)=(a.2-b.2) • ((0,1) : E × ℝ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [h,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hm] at hz
  exact Prod.ext hab₁ (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hc))
omit [CompleteSpace E] in

name: triangular_surjective
stmt: (L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hc : L (0,1) ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L)
body:
:= by
  intro b
  refine ⟨(b.1,(b.2-L (b.1,0))/L (0,1)),Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
  change L (b.1,(b.2-L (b.1,0))/L (0,1))=b.2
  have h (r : ℝ) : L (b.1,r)=L (b.1,0)+r*L (0,1) := by
    have he : (b.1,r)=(b.1,0)+r • ((0,1) : E × ℝ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [he,map_add,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h,div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc]
  ring

name: strict_fiber_uniform_antilipschitz
stmt: {S : E × ℝ → ℝ} {L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ} {p : E} {t : ℝ} (hS : HasStrictFDerivAt S L (p,t)) (hc : L (0,1) ≠ 0) : ∃ P : Set E, ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen P ∧ p ∈ P ∧ IsOpen I ∧ t ∈ I ∧ ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun u => S (q,u)))
body:
:= by
  let T := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L
  let H : E × ℝ → E × ℝ := fun q => (q.1,S q)
  let Q : (E × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (E × ℝ) := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective T
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (triangular_injective L hc))
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (triangular_surjective L hc))
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt H (Q : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] E × ℝ) (p,t) :=
    hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.prodMk hS
  obtain ⟨V,hpt,hVo,hA⟩ := hd.approximates_deriv_on_open_nhds
  have hK := hA.antilipschitz (Or.inr (half_lt_self (inv_pos.mpr
    (Q.subsingleton_or_nnnorm_symm_pos.resolve_left (not_subsingleton (E × ℝ))))))
  obtain ⟨P,hP,I,hI,hsub⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (hVo.mem_nhds hpt)
  obtain ⟨P',hP'P,hP'o,hp⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨I',hI'I,hI'o,ht⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hI
  refine ⟨P',I',hP'o,hp,hI'o,ht,(‖(Q.symm : (E × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ))‖₊⁻¹ - ‖(Q.symm : (E × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ))‖₊⁻¹ / 2)⁻¹,?_⟩
  intro q hq
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro a b
  have ha : (q,a.1) ∈ V := hsub ⟨hP'P hq,hI'I a.2⟩
  have hb : (q,b.1) ∈ V := hsub ⟨hP'P hq,hI'I b.2⟩
  have h := hK.le_mul_dist ⟨(q,a.1),ha⟩ ⟨(q,b.1),hb⟩
  simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq,domRestrict,H,Prod.dist_eq,dist_self,max_eq_right (dist_nonneg)] using h
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
abbrev CircleParameter := RealPlane × ℝ
abbrev CircleJet := CircleParameter × ℝ
def jetCenter : CircleJet →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ RealPlane ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ CircleParameter ℝ)
def jetRadius : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ RealPlane ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ CircleParameter ℝ)
def jetAngle : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ CircleParameter ℝ
def circleTarget (q : CircleJet) : RealPlane := q.1.1+q.1.2 • (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2)
def circleTargetDeriv (q : CircleJet) : CircleJet →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  jetCenter + (q.1.2 • (((-Real.sin q.2) • jetAngle).prod (Real.cos q.2 • jetAngle)) +
    jetRadius.smulRight (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2))

name: circleTarget_strict
stmt: (q : CircleJet) : HasStrictFDerivAt circleTarget (circleTargetDeriv q) q
body:
:= by
  have hc := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos q.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt q jetAngle.hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin q.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt q jetAngle.hasStrictFDerivAt
  exact jetCenter.hasStrictFDerivAt.add (jetRadius.hasStrictFDerivAt.smul (hc.prodMk hs))

name: circleTarget_continuous
stmt: : Continuous circleTarget
body:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun q => (circleTarget_strict q).continuousAt
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
def circleEndpoint (q : CircleJet) : ℝ := (circleInverse h (circleTarget q)).1
def circleEndpointDeriv (q : CircleJet) : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp
    (((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane).comp
      (circleTargetDeriv q))

name: circleEndpoint_measurable
stmt: : Measurable (circleEndpoint h)
body:
:=
  measurable_fst.comp ((circleInverse_measurable h).comp circleTarget_continuous.measurable)

name: circleEndpoint_strict
stmt: {q : CircleJet} (he : circleTarget q=circleSum 1 (t,u)) : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleEndpoint h) (circleEndpointDeriv h q) q
body:
:= by
  have hi := circleInverse_strict h
  rw [← he] at hi
  exact hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.comp q (hi.comp q (circleTarget_strict q))

name: inverse_tangent_first_ne
stmt: {a : ℝ} (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) : ((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a)).1 ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let q := L.symm (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a)
  intro hq
  have he : circleSumDeriv 1 (t,u) q=(-Real.sin a,Real.cos a) := L.apply_symm_apply _
  have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd he
  change q.1=0 at hq
  change 1*(-Real.sin t*q.1) + -Real.sin u*q.2 = -Real.sin a at h₁
  change 1*(Real.cos t*q.1) + Real.cos u*q.2 = Real.cos a at h₂
  simp only [hq,mul_zero,zero_add] at h₁ h₂
  apply ha
  rw [Real.sin_sub]
  linear_combination (Real.cos u)*h₁+(Real.sin u)*h₂

name: circleEndpoint_fiber_ne
stmt: {q : CircleJet} (hr : q.1.2=1) (ha : Real.sin (q.2-u) ≠ 0) : circleEndpointDeriv h q (0,1) ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  have he : circleTargetDeriv q (0,1)=(-Real.sin q.2,Real.cos q.2) := by
    simp [circleTargetDeriv,jetCenter,jetRadius,jetAngle,hr]
  change (((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm
    (circleTargetDeriv q (0,1))).1) ≠ 0
  rw [he]
  exact inverse_tangent_first_ne h ha

name: circleEndpoint_uniform
stmt: {p : CircleParameter} {a : ℝ} (he : circleTarget (p,a)=circleSum 1 (t,u)) (hr : p.2=1) (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) : ∃ P : Set CircleParameter, ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen P ∧ p ∈ P ∧ IsOpen I ∧ a ∈ I ∧ ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun v => circleEndpoint h (q,v)))
body:
:=
  strict_fiber_uniform_antilipschitz (circleEndpoint_strict h he) (circleEndpoint_fiber_ne h hr ha)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)

name: circleEndpoint_good_neighborhood
stmt: {p : CircleParameter} {a : ℝ} (he : circleTarget (p,a)=circleSum 1 (t,u)) (hr : p.2=1) (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) : ∃ P : Set CircleParameter, ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen P ∧ p ∈ P ∧ IsOpen I ∧ a ∈ I ∧ I ⊆ Ioc (a-Real.pi) (a-Real.pi+2*Real.pi) ∧ ∃ K : ℝ≥0, (∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun v => circleEndpoint h (q,v)))) ∧ ∀ q ∈ P, ∀ v ∈ I, circleTarget (q,v) ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧ Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleTarget (q,v))).2-(circleInverse h (circleTarget (q,v))).1) ≠ 0 ∧ circleEndpoint h (q,v) ∈ Metric.closedBall t 1
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₀,I₀,hP₀,hp₀,hI₀,ha₀,K,hK⟩ := circleEndpoint_uniform h he hr ha
  have hc : ContinuousAt circleTarget (p,a) := circleTarget_continuous.continuousAt
  have hi := (circleEndpoint_strict h he).continuousAt
  have hs : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), circleEndpoint h w ∈ Metric.ball t 1 := by
    have hb : Metric.ball t 1 ∈ 𝓝 (circleEndpoint h (p,a)) := by
      have ht : circleEndpoint h (p,a)=t := by simp [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_at]
      rw [ht]
      exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num)
    exact hi hb
  have ht : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), circleTarget w ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target := by
    apply hc
    rw [he]
    exact (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds
      ((show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
        (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
        (t,u) from circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target)
  have hn : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleTarget w)).2-(circleInverse h (circleTarget w)).1) ≠ 0 := by
    exact hc.eventually (by simpa only [he] using circleInverse_regular h)
  obtain ⟨P₁,hP₁,I₁,hI₁,hsub⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (ht.and (hn.and hs))
  obtain ⟨P₂,hP₂,hP₂o,hp₂⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP₁
  obtain ⟨I₂,hI₂,hI₂o,ha₂⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hI₁
  let P := P₀ ∩ P₂
  let I := I₀ ∩ I₂ ∩ Ioo (a-Real.pi) (a+Real.pi)
  refine ⟨P,I,hP₀.inter hP₂o,⟨hp₀,hp₂⟩,(hI₀.inter hI₂o).inter isOpen_Ioo,
    ⟨⟨ha₀,ha₂⟩,by constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩,?_,K,?_,?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact ⟨hv.2.1,by linarith [hv.2.2]⟩
  · intro q hq
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro v w
    exact (hK q hq.1).le_mul_dist ⟨v.1,v.2.1.1⟩ ⟨w.1,w.2.1.1⟩
  · intro q hq v hv
    have hh := hsub (show (q,v) ∈ P₁ ×ˢ I₁ from ⟨hP₂ hq.2,hI₂ hv.1.2⟩)
    exact ⟨hh.1,hh.2.1,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hh.2.2⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def angleChart (p : RealPlane) : Angles × Angles := ((p.1 : Angles),(p.2 : Angles))
def angleChartMeasure : Measure RealPlane :=
  volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2*Real.pi) ×ˢ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2*Real.pi))

name: angleChartMeas_le
stmt: : angleChartMeasure ≤ volume
body:
:= Measure.restrict_le_self
instance : IsFiniteMeasure angleChartMeasure := by
  change IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict _)
  apply isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
  apply ne_of_lt
  apply (measure_mono (Set.prod_mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self Ioc_subset_Icc_self)).trans_lt
  exact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).measure_lt_top

name: angleChart_preserving
stmt: : MeasurePreserving angleChart angleChartMeasure ((volume : Measure Angles).prod volume)
body:
:= by
  have h := (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).prod
    (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0)
  convert h using 1
  · rfl
  · simp only [angleChartMeasure,zero_add,Measure.prod_restrict,← Measure.volume_eq_prod]

name: angleChart_measure
stmt: : (angleChartMeasure.map angleChart) = (ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi))^2 • angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  rw [angleChart_preserving.map_eq,AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,
    Measure.prod_smul_left,Measure.prod_smul_right,smul_smul,pow_two]
  rfl

name: integral_angular_eq_chart
stmt: {f : Angles × Angles → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) : (∫ p, f p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) = ((2*Real.pi)^2)⁻¹ * ∫ q, f (angleChart q) ∂angleChartMeasure
body:
:= by
  have h := integral_map (μ := angleChartMeasure) angleChart_preserving.measurable.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [angleChart_measure,integral_smul_measure,ENNReal.toReal_pow,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*Real.pi),smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [← h]
  field_simp

name: direction_realPlane
stmt: (t : ℝ) : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (direction (t : Angles)) = (Real.cos t,Real.sin t)
body:
:= by
  rw [direction_real,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I]
  ext <;> simp [Complex.cos_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_re]

name: circleSum_chart
stmt: (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x+(r : ℂ)*direction (angleChart q).1+direction (angleChart q).2) = Complex.equivRealProdCLM x+circleSum r q
body:
:= by
  change Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x+(r : ℂ)*direction (q.1 : Angles)+direction (q.2 : Angles)) = _
  rw [map_add,map_add]
  have h : (r : ℂ)*direction (q.1 : Angles) = r • direction (q.1 : Angles) := by simp
  rw [h,map_smul,direction_realPlane,direction_realPlane]
  ext <;> simp [circleSum,add_assoc]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: volume_preimage_bound
stmt: {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {K : ℝ≥0} (hF : AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (A : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) : volume (F ⁻¹' A ∩ s) ≤ (K : ENNReal)^2 * volume A
body:
:= by
  have he : Subtype.val '' ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A) = F ⁻¹' A ∩ s := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩; exact ⟨hq,q.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨hp,hs⟩; exact ⟨⟨p,hs⟩,hp,rfl⟩
  have hi := (isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : s → ℝ × ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image
    (Or.inl (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2)) ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A)
  have ha := hF.hausdorffMeasure_preimage_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2) A
  rw [he,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real] at hi
  rw [← hi,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real,ENNReal.rpow_two] at ha
  exact ha

name: map_restrict_volume_le
stmt: {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} (hm : Measurable F) {s B : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (_hB : MeasurableSet B) {K : ℝ≥0} (hF : AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (himage : MapsTo F s B) : (volume.restrict s).map F ≤ ((K^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • volume.restrict B
body:
:= by
  apply Measure.le_iff.mpr
  intro A hA
  rw [Measure.map_apply hm hA,Measure.restrict_apply (hm hA),Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.restrict_apply hA,smul_eq_mul,ENNReal.coe_pow]
  have he : F ⁻¹' A ∩ s = F ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) ∩ s := by
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨⟨hx.1,himage hx.2⟩,hx.2⟩,fun hx => ⟨hx.1.1,hx.2⟩⟩
  rw [he]
  exact volume_preimage_bound hF (A ∩ B)

name: antilipschitz_small_perturbation
stmt: {E X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [PseudoMetricSpace X] {F G : X → E} {K L : ℝ≥0} (hf : AntilipschitzWith K F) (hg : LipschitzWith L G) {a : ℝ} (ha : (K : ℝ)*‖a‖*(L : ℝ) ≤ 1/2) : AntilipschitzWith (2*K) (fun x => F x+a • G x)
body:
:= by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro x y
  have h1 := hf.le_mul_dist x y
  have h2 := hg.dist_le_mul x y
  have h3 : dist (F x) (F y) ≤ dist (F x+a • G x) (F y+a • G y) + ‖a‖*dist (G x) (G y) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right,dist_smul₀] using
      dist_sub_sub_le (F x+a • G x) (a • G x) (F y+a • G y) (a • G y)
  have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg a)
  have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h3.trans (add_le_add_right h4 _)) K.2
  have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y))
  simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat]
  nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: realDirection_norm_le
stmt: (t : ℝ) : ‖(Real.cos t,Real.sin t)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
body:
:= by
  rw [Prod.norm_def,max_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one t,
    by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_sin_le_one t⟩

name: circleSum_decompose
stmt: (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) : circleSum r q = r • (Real.cos q.1,Real.sin q.1) + (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2)
body: := rfl

name: circleSum_norm_le
stmt: (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) : ‖circleSum r q‖ ≤ |r|+1
body:
:= by
  rw [circleSum_decompose]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖r • (Real.cos q.1,Real.sin q.1)‖+‖(Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ |r| * 1+1 := by rw [norm_smul]; exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (realDirection_norm_le _) (norm_nonneg r)) (realDirection_norm_le _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: circleSum_perturb_identity
stmt: (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) : circleSum r q = circleSum 1 q + (r-1) • (Real.cos q.1,Real.sin q.1)
body:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change r*Real.cos q.1+Real.cos q.2 = 1*Real.cos q.1+Real.cos q.2+(r-1)*Real.cos q.1
    ring
  · change r*Real.sin q.1+Real.sin q.2 = 1*Real.sin q.1+Real.sin q.2+(r-1)*Real.sin q.1
    ring

name: circleSum_parameter_tendsto
stmt: {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (q : RealPlane) : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum (r n) q) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 q))
body:
:= by
  exact (hr.mul_const (Real.cos q.1) |>.add_const (Real.cos q.2)).prodMk_nhds
    (hr.mul_const (Real.sin q.1) |>.add_const (Real.sin q.2))

name: circleSum_eventual_image
stmt: {r : ℕ → ℝ} {y : ℕ → RealPlane} {x : RealPlane} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x)) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ q, y n+circleSum (r n) q ∈ Metric.closedBall x 4
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hr.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (1 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1)),
    hy.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1))] with n hn hyn
  intro q
  have hh := circleSum_norm_le (r n) q
  have hb : |r n| ≤ 2 := by
    have ht := norm_le_norm_sub_add (r n) (1 : ℝ)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_one] at ht
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hn
    linarith
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
  calc
    _ ≤ dist (y n+circleSum (r n) q) (y n)+dist (y n) x := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ = ‖circleSum (r n) q‖+dist (y n) x := by rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left]
    _ ≤ 4 := by linarith

name: circleSum_limit_image
stmt: (x q : RealPlane) : x+circleSum 1 q ∈ Metric.closedBall x 4
body:
:= by
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hh := circleSum_norm_le 1 q
  norm_num at hh
  linarith

name: circleSum_eventual_antilipschitz
stmt: {V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (circleSum 1))) {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (y : ℕ → RealPlane) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, AntilipschitzWith (2*K) (V.domRestrict (fun q => y n+circleSum (r n) q))
body:
:= by
  have hD : LipschitzWith 1 (fun q : V => (Real.cos q.1.1,Real.sin q.1.1)) := by
    have hf : LipschitzWith 1 (fun q : V => q.1.1) := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun q p => by
      simp only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul]
      exact le_max_left _ _)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,one_mul] using realDirection_lipschitz.comp hf
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => (K : ℝ)*‖r n-1‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh : Tendsto (fun n => r n-1) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using hr.sub_const 1
    simpa using hh.norm.const_mul (K : ℝ)
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2))] with n hn
  have ha := antilipschitz_small_perturbation hK hD (a := r n-1) (by simpa using le_of_lt hn)
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro q p
  have hh := ha.le_mul_dist q p
  simpa only [Set.domRestrict_apply,dist_add_left,← circleSum_perturb_identity] using hh

name: circleSum_limit_antilipschitz
stmt: {V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (circleSum 1))) (x : RealPlane) : AntilipschitzWith (2*K) (V.domRestrict (fun q => x+circleSum 1 q))
body:
:= by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro q p
  have hh := hK.le_mul_dist q p
  simpa only [Set.domRestrict_apply,dist_add_left] using hh.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat]; linarith [K.2] : (K : ℝ)≤ ((2*K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) dist_nonneg)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: measure_null_of_locally_null_on_conull
stmt: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [HereditarilyLindelofSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {R A : Set X} (hR : μ Rᶜ = 0) (h : ∀ x ∈ R, ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ μ (A ∩ V) = 0) : μ A = 0
body:
:= by
  classical
  choose V hVo hxV hV0 using (fun x : R => h x.1 x.2)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hcov⟩ := (HereditarilyLindelofSpace.isLindelof R).elim_countable_subcover V hVo
    (fun x hx => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hxV ⟨x,hx⟩⟩)
  have hu : μ (⋃ i ∈ t, A ∩ V i) = 0 := (measure_biUnion_null_iff ht).mpr (fun i _ => hV0 i)
  apply measure_mono_null (t := Rᶜ ∪ ⋃ i ∈ t, A ∩ V i) _ (measure_union_null hR hu)
  intro x hx
  by_cases hr : x ∈ R
  · obtain ⟨i,hi,hxi⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov hr)
    exact Or.inr (mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i,hi,hx,hxi⟩)
  · exact Or.inl hr

name: circleSum_regular_ae
stmt: : ∀ᵐ p : RealPlane ∂volume, Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
  apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae ?_).mpr
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      have hs : {s : ℝ | Real.sin (s-t)=0} ⊆ Set.range (fun n : ℤ => t+n*Real.pi) := by
        intro s h
        obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp h
        exact ⟨n,by linarith⟩
      change volume {s : ℝ | ¬ Real.sin (s-t) ≠ 0} = 0
      simpa only [not_not] using measure_mono_null hs ((countable_range _).measure_zero volume)
  · exact (measurableSet_eq_fun (Real.measurable_sin.comp (measurable_snd.sub measurable_fst)) measurable_const).compl

name: circleSum_preimage_null
stmt: {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) {A : Set RealPlane} (hA : volume A=0) : volume (circleSum r ⁻¹' A)=0
body:
:= by
  apply measure_null_of_locally_null_on_conull (μ := (volume : Measure RealPlane))
    (R := {p : RealPlane | Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0}) (A := circleSum r ⁻¹' A) circleSum_regular_ae
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨s,hso,hps,K,hK⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (mul_ne_zero hr hp)
  refine ⟨s,hso,hps,?_⟩
  have hh := volume_preimage_bound hK A
  rw [hA,mul_zero] at hh
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp hh

name: circleSum_quasiMeasurePreserving
stmt: {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (circleSum r) volume volume
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨(circleSum_continuous r).measurable,Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun A hA hz => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply (circleSum_continuous r).measurable hA]
  exact circleSum_preimage_null hr hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

name: tendsto_integral_of_local_cover
stmt: {X I : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ] {F : ℕ → X → ℝ} (hF : ∀ n, Integrable (F n) μ) (hb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ F n x ∧ F n x ≤ 1) (V : I → Set X) (hVo : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hfull : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ⋃ i, V i) (hlocal : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  classical
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨K,hKU,hK,hμK⟩ := (isOpen_iUnion hVo).measurableSet.exists_isCompact_sdiff_lt
    (measure_ne_top μ _) (by exact ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (half_pos hε)))
  have hδ : μ Kᶜ < ENNReal.ofReal (ε/2) := by
    have he : (Kᶜ : Set X) =ᵐ[μ] ((⋃ i, V i) \ K : Set X) := by
      filter_upwards [hfull] with x hx
      exact propext ⟨fun h => ⟨hx,h⟩,fun h => h.2⟩
    exact (measure_congr he).trans_lt hμK
  have hδr : μ.real Kᶜ < ε/2 := by
    have hh := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _) (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).mpr hδ
    simpa only [Measure.real,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (le_of_lt (half_pos hε))] using hh
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover V hVo hKU
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_finsetSum J (fun i _ => hlocal i)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim (ε/2) (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hmaj : (∫ x, F n x ∂μ) ≤ (∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) + μ.real Kᶜ := by
    have hJJ : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i ∈ J, (V i).indicator (F n) x) μ :=
      integrable_finsetSum J (fun i _ => (hF n).indicator (hVo i).measurableSet)
    have hCC : Integrable (Kᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) μ :=
      (integrable_const _).indicator hK.measurableSet.compl
    have hi := integral_mono (hF n) (hJJ.add hCC) (fun x => by
      have hs (i : I) : 0 ≤ (V i).indicator (F n) x := indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => (hb n y).1) x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ K
      · obtain ⟨i,hi,hxi⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hJ hx)
        have hsum := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hs j) hi
        simp only [Pi.add_apply,indicator_of_notMem (show x ∉ Kᶜ from not_not.mpr hx),add_zero]
        exact (by simpa only [indicator_of_mem hxi] using hsum)

name: bounded_difference_integrable
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f g : X → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) (hfb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) (hgb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ 1) : Integrable (fun x => ‖f x-g x‖) μ
body:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound ((hf.sub hg).norm.aestronglyMeasurable) 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    rw [norm_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
    change -1 ≤ f x-g x ∧ f x-g x ≤ 1
    constructor <;> linarith [(hfb x).1,(hfb x).2,(hgb x).1,(hgb x).2]

name: circleSum_tendsto_L1
stmt: {μ : Measure RealPlane} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [μ.InnerRegularCompactLTTop] (hμ : μ ≤ volume) {r : ℕ → ℝ} {y : ℕ → RealPlane} {x : RealPlane} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x)) {f : RealPlane → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfb : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z ∧ f z ≤ 1) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ q, ‖f (y n+circleSum (r n) q)-f (x+circleSum 1 q)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let T : ℕ → RealPlane → RealPlane := fun n q => y n+circleSum (r n) q
  let S : RealPlane → RealPlane := fun q => x+circleSum 1 q
  have hT (n : ℕ) : Measurable (T n) := (continuous_const.add (circleSum_continuous _)).measurable
  have hS : Measurable S := (continuous_const.add (circleSum_continuous _)).measurable
  let R : Set RealPlane := {p | Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0}
  have hex : ∀ p : R, ∃ V : Set RealPlane, IsOpen V ∧ p.1 ∈ V ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (circleSum 1)) := by
    intro p
    exact circleSum_local_antilipschitz (by simpa only [one_mul] using (show Real.sin (p.1.2-p.1.1) ≠ 0 from p.2))
  choose V hVo hpV K hK using hex
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ q ∂μ, q ∈ ⋃ p : R, V p := by
    filter_upwards [circleSum_regular_ae.filter_mono (ae_mono hμ)] with q hq
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q,hq⟩,hpV ⟨q,hq⟩⟩
  apply tendsto_integral_of_local_cover (μ := μ)
    (fun n => bounded_difference_integrable (hf.comp (hT n)) (hf.comp hS)
      (fun q => hfb (T n q)) (fun q => hfb (S q)))
    (fun n q => ⟨norm_nonneg _,by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
      change -1 ≤ f (T n q)-f (S q) ∧ f (T n q)-f (S q) ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hfb (T n q)).1,(hfb (T n q)).2,(hfb (S q)).1,(hfb (S q)).2]⟩)
    V hVo hfull
  intro p
  let B := Metric.closedBall x (4 : ℝ)
  let ν : Measure RealPlane := volume.restrict B
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := measurableSet_closedBall
  let : IsFiniteMeasure ν := ⟨by simpa [ν] using (isCompact_closedBall x 4).measure_lt_top⟩
  have hfi : Integrable f ν := Integrable.of_bound hf.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun z => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hfb z).1]; exact (hfb z).2)
  have hmapT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ((μ.restrict (V p)).map (T n)) ≤
      (((2*K p)^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • ν := by
    filter_upwards [circleSum_eventual_image hr hy,circleSum_eventual_antilipschitz (hK p) hr y] with n hn ha
    apply (Measure.map_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure hμ (V p)) (hT n)).trans
    exact map_restrict_volume_le (hT n) hB ha (fun q _ => hn q)
  have hmapS : ((μ.restrict (V p)).map S) ≤ (((2*K p)^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • ν := by
    apply (Measure.map_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure hμ (V p)) hS).trans
    exact map_restrict_volume_le hS hB (circleSum_limit_antilipschitz (hK p) x)
      (fun q _ => circleSum_limit_image x q)
  apply tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub_eventual hT hS hmapT hmapS _ hfi
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => hy.add (circleSum_parameter_tendsto hr q)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: angularSum_quasiMeasurePreserving
stmt: (x : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (angularSum x r) (angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) volume

:= by

      (fun q => Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm (Complex.equivRealProdCLM x+circleSum r q)) volume volume :=
    (Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm).quasiMeasurePreserving.comp
      ((measurePreserving_add_left volume (Complex.equivRealProdCLM x)).quasiMeasurePreserving.comp

    apply (angleChartMeas_le _).trans
    have hz' := hreal.preimage_null hz
    simpa [preimage_preimage,Function.comp_def,angularSum_chart] using le_of_eq hz'
  have hz' : (ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi))^2 *
      (angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) (angularSum x r ⁻¹' A)=0 := by
    rw [← smul_eq_mul,← Measure.smul_apply,← angleChart_measure,
      Measure.map_apply angleChart_preserving.measurable ((angularSum_measurable x r) hA)]

name: angularSum_tendsto_L1
stmt: {r : ℕ → ℝ} {y : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x)) {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfb : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z ∧ f z ≤ 1) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, ‖f (angularSum (y n) (r n) p)-f (angularSum x 1 p)‖ ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 0)

def binaryPhi (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := t+Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))
def binaryBeta (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.arccos (Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)
def binaryTarget (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := -binaryCircleMap d (-t)+Real.pi/3
def binaryOther (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := binaryCircleMap d t+2*(Real.pi/3)

name: binaryTarget_eq
stmt: (d t : ℝ) : binaryTarget d t=binaryPhi d t+binaryBeta d t
body:
:= by
  simp only [binaryTarget,binaryCircleMap,binaryPhi,binaryBeta,binaryQ,Real.sin_neg,Real.cos_neg,
    mul_neg,neg_div,Real.arctan_neg]
  ring

name: binaryOther_eq
stmt: (d t : ℝ) : binaryOther d t=binaryPhi d t+Real.pi-binaryBeta d t
body:
:= by
  dsimp [binaryOther,binaryCircleMap,binaryPhi,binaryBeta]
  ring

name: binaryPhi_trig
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) : Real.cos (binaryPhi d t)=(Real.cos t-d)/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) ∧ Real.sin (binaryPhi d t)=Real.sin t/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)
body:
:= by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hq.1
  have hi := binary_arctan_identity d t
  have he : 1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2=binaryQ d t/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2 := by
    field_simp [hq.2.2.ne']
    nlinarith [hi]
  have hs : Real.sqrt (1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)=Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/(1-d*Real.cos t) := by
    rw [he,Real.sqrt_div hq.1.le,Real.sqrt_sq hq.2.2.le]
  have hcθ : Real.cos (Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)))=(1-d*Real.cos t)/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
    rw [Real.cos_arctan,hs]
    field_simp
  have hsθ : Real.sin (Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)))=d*Real.sin t/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
    rw [Real.sin_arctan,hs]
    field_simp [hq.2.2.ne']
  dsimp [binaryPhi]
  simp only [Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,hcθ,hsθ]
  constructor
  · field_simp [hq.2.2.ne',hsq]
    linear_combination -d*(Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)
  · field_simp [hq.2.2.ne',hsq]
    ring

name: binaryBeta_trig
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) : Real.cos (binaryBeta d t)=Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ∧ Real.sin (binaryBeta d t)=Real.sqrt (1-binaryQ d t/4)
body:
:= by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (binaryQ d t)]
  constructor
  · exact Real.cos_arccos (by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (binaryQ d t)]) hs'
  · dsimp [binaryBeta]
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    congr 1
    nlinarith

name: binary_geometry
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) : d+Real.cos (binaryTarget d t)=Real.cos t+Real.cos (binaryOther d t) ∧ Real.sin (binaryTarget d t)=Real.sin t+Real.sin (binaryOther d t)
body:
:= by
  have hp := binaryPhi_trig hd t
  have hb := binaryBeta_trig hd t
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hs : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hq.1
  rw [binaryTarget_eq,binaryOther_eq,
    show binaryPhi d t+Real.pi-binaryBeta d t=(binaryPhi d t-binaryBeta d t)+Real.pi by ring,
    Real.cos_add_pi,Real.sin_add_pi,Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,Real.cos_sub,Real.sin_sub,hp.1,hp.2,hb.1,hb.2]
  constructor <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: binaryTarget_hasDeriv
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (binaryTarget d) (1+d*binaryB d (-t)) t
body:
:= by
  convert ((binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd (-t)).comp t (hasDerivAt_neg t)).neg.add_const (Real.pi/3) using 1 <;>
    first | rfl | ring

name: binaryOther_hasDeriv
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (binaryOther d) (1+d*binaryB d t) t
body:
:= by
  exact (binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd t).add_const (2*(Real.pi/3))
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: binary_nonparallel
stmt: {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) : Real.sin (binaryOther d t-t) ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := binaryQ_range (show |-d|<1/2 by simpa only [abs_neg] using hd) (binaryTarget d t)
  have hg := binary_geometry hd t
  have hs := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (binaryOther d t-t)

  have hi : binaryQ (-d) (binaryTarget d t)=2+2*Real.cos (binaryOther d t-t) := by
    have hc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
    have hh := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (binaryOther d t)
    have ht := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (binaryTarget d t)

  rw [hi] at hq

stmt: {x z : ℂ} {d φ : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (hxr : (z-x).re=d*Real.cos φ) (hxi : (z-x).im=d*Real.sin φ) (t : ℝ) : circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,binaryTarget d t+φ)= circleSum 1 (t+φ,binaryOther d t+φ)

    rw [hxr,Real.cos_add,Real.cos_add,Real.cos_add]
    linear_combination Real.cos φ*hg.1-Real.sin φ*hg.2
  · change (z-x).im+Real.sin (binaryTarget d t+φ)=Real.sin (t+φ)+Real.sin (binaryOther d t+φ)

name: deriv_lower_surjective
stmt: {f D : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (D x) x) (hp : ∀ x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D x) : Function.Surjective f
body:
:= by

  have h₁ := mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)

  obtain ⟨x,_,hx⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith : -R ≤ R)

  exact ⟨x,hx⟩

name: exists_finite_weak_subseq
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (f : ℕ → ι → E) (C : ℝ) (hf : ∀ n i, ‖f n i‖ ≤ C) : ∃ b : ι → E, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ i v, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f (φ n) i,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b i,v⟫)
body:
:= by
  let K : Set (WeakDual ℝ E) := WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall 0 C
  have hK : IsCompact K := WeakDual.isCompact_closedBall 0 C
  let : CompactSpace K := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK
  let : TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace K := WeakDual.metrizable_of_isCompact ℝ E K hK
  let u : ℕ → ι → K := fun n i => ⟨weakHilbert (f n i), by

      StrongDual.toStrongDual_toWeakDual,LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using hf n i⟩
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (ι → K))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Filter.Eventually.frequently (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Set.mem_univ (u n))))
  refine ⟨fun i => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm (WeakDual.toStrongDual (b i).1),φ,hφ,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map,K,Set.mem_preimage,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using (b i).2
  · intro i v
    have ht := ((WeakDual.eval_continuous v).comp continuous_subtype_val).tendsto (b i)
      |>.comp ((continuous_apply i).tendsto b |>.comp hb)
    change Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f (φ n) i,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ((b i).1 v)) at ht

    (hμs := measure_ne_top μ Set.univ) (c := (1 : ℝ)))

name: weak_limit_nonneg
stmt: {f : ℕ → RealL2 μ} {b : RealL2 μ} (ht : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b,v⟫)) (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f n) : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] b
body:
:= by
  apply ae_nonneg_of_forall_setIntegral_nonneg (MemLp.integrable (by norm_num) (Lp.memLp b))
  intro s hs hμs
  have h := ht (indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs.ne 1)
  have he (v : RealL2 μ) : ⟪v,indicatorConstLp 2 hs hμs.ne 1⟫ = ∫ x in s, v x ∂μ := by
    rw [real_inner_comm,L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one]
  simp_rw [he] at h
  exact ge_of_tendsto h (Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_nonneg_of_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (hf n)))

name: weak_limit_le_one
stmt: {f : ℕ → RealL2 μ} {b : RealL2 μ} (ht : ∀ v, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b,v⟫)) (hf : ∀ n, f n ≤ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) : b ≤ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
body:
:= by
  have hh : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] (oneL2 μ-b) := weak_limit_nonneg μ
    (f := fun n => oneL2 μ-f n) (fun v => by simpa only [inner_sub_left] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub (ht v)) (fun n => by
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (oneL2 μ) (f n),oneL2_ae μ,hf n] with x hx h1 hn
      simpa only [hx,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,h1,sub_nonneg] using hn)
  filter_upwards [hh,Lp.coeFn_sub (oneL2 μ) b,oneL2_ae μ] with x hx he h1
  simpa only [he,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,h1,sub_nonneg] using hx

name: weak_limit_sum
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {f : ℕ → ι → RealL2 μ} {b : ι → RealL2 μ} (ht : ∀ i v, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n i,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b i,v⟫)) (hf : ∀ n, ∑ i, f n i = oneL2 μ) : ∑ i, b i = oneL2 μ
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro v
  have hh := tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => ht i v)
  simp_rw [← sum_inner,hf] at hh
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hh tendsto_const_nhds
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure Filter Topology
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k)
def Typical (z : ℂ) : Prop := DensityOne {w | c w=c z} z
def TypicalSampling (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧ ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, Typical c (y+(r : ℂ)*direction t)

name: ae_typicalSampling
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), TypicalSampling c y r
body:
:= by
  have hq : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun p : ℂ × Angles => p.1+(r : ℂ)*direction p.2)
      ((volume : Measure ℂ).prod angularMeasure) volume :=
    QuasiMeasurePreserving.prod_of_left
      (measurable_fst.add (measurable_const.mul (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd)))
      (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℂ)
        ((r : ℂ)*direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving)
  have hh : ∀ᵐ p ∂((volume : Measure ℂ).prod angularMeasure), Typical c (p.1+(r : ℂ)*direction p.2) :=
    hq.ae (ae_density_actual c hc)
  exact (Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hh).mono fun y hy => ⟨hr,hy⟩
def sampleFn (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (t : Angles) : ℝ :=
  if c (y+(r : ℂ)*direction t)=i then 1 else 0

name: sampleFn_measurable
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) : Measurable (sampleFn c y r i)
body:
:= by
  exact measurable_one.piecewise (measurableSet_eq_fun
    (hc.comp (measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul direction_continuous.measurable))) measurable_const) measurable_zero

name: sampleFn_nonneg
stmt: (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (t : Angles) : 0 ≤ sampleFn c y r i t
body:
:= by
  simp only [sampleFn]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: sampleFn_le_one
stmt: (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (t : Angles) : sampleFn c y r i t ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  simp only [sampleFn]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: sampleFn_memLp
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) : MemLp (sampleFn c y r i) 2 angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  apply MemLp.of_bound (sampleFn_measurable c hc y r i).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (sampleFn_nonneg c y r i t)]; exact sampleFn_le_one c y r i t
def sample (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) : RealL2 angularMeasure :=
  (sampleFn_memLp c hc y r i).toLp _

name: sample_ae
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) : sample c hc y r i =ᵐ[angularMeasure] sampleFn c y r i
body: := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: sample_norm_le
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) : ‖sample c hc y r i‖ ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ‖sample c hc y r i t‖ ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc y r i] with t ht
    rw [ht,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (sampleFn_nonneg c y r i t)]
    exact sampleFn_le_one c y r i t
  simpa [measureUnivNNReal] using Lp.norm_le_of_ae_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hh

name: sample_sum
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : ∑ i, sample c hc y r i = oneL2 angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i => sample c hc y r i),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (sample_ae c hc y r),oneL2_ae angularMeasure] with t ht ha h1
  rw [ht,h1]
  simp only [ha,sampleFn]
  simp

name: sampling_weak_compact
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (y : ℕ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) : ∃ b : Fin k → RealL2 angularMeasure, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] b i) ∧ (∀ i, b i ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) ∧ (∑ i, b i = oneL2 angularMeasure) ∧ ∀ i v, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪sample c hc (y (φ n)) (r (φ n)) i,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b i,v⟫)
body:
:= by
  let : Fact ((2 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨b,φ,hφ,_,hb⟩ := exists_finite_weak_subseq
    (fun n i => sample c hc (y n) (r n) i) 1 (fun n i => sample_norm_le c hc (y n) (r n) i)
  refine ⟨b,φ,hφ,?_,?_,?_,hb⟩
  · intro i
    apply weak_limit_nonneg angularMeasure (hb i)
    intro n
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (y (φ n)) (r (φ n)) i] with t ht
    simpa only [ht,Pi.zero_apply] using sampleFn_nonneg c _ _ i t
  · intro i
    apply weak_limit_le_one angularMeasure (hb i)
    intro n
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (y (φ n)) (r (φ n)) i] with t ht
    simpa only [ht] using sampleFn_le_one c _ _ i t
  · exact weak_limit_sum angularMeasure hb (fun n => sample_sum c hc (y (φ n)) (r (φ n)))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Filter Topology

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.WeakBall
variable (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

abbrev Space := {v : WeakDual ℝ E // WeakDual.toStrongDual v ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 1}
instance : CompactSpace (Space E) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (WeakDual.isCompact_closedBall 0 1)
instance : TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace (Space E) :=
  WeakDual.metrizable_of_isCompact ℝ E _ (WeakDual.isCompact_closedBall 0 1)
def value (a : Space E) : E := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm (WeakDual.toStrongDual a.1)
omit [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E] in

name: value_norm
stmt: (a : Space E) : ‖value E a‖ ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  simpa only [value,LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using a.2
omit [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E] in

name: value_eval
stmt: (a : Space E) (v : E) : ⟪value E a,v⟫ = a.1 v
body:
:= by
  simp only [value,InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply,WeakDual.toStrongDual_apply]
def ofNorm (v : E) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) : Space E := ⟨weakHilbert v,by
  simpa only [weakHilbert,StrongDual.toStrongDual_toWeakDual,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using hv⟩
omit [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E] in

name: value_ofNorm
stmt: (v : E) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) : value E (ofNorm E v hv) = v

:= by

omit [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E] in

name: continuous_eval
stmt: (v : E) : Continuous (fun a : Space E => ⟪value E a,v⟫)

:= by
  simp_rw [value_eval]
  exact (WeakDual.eval_continuous v).comp continuous_subtype_val
omit [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace E] in

name: tendsto_iff
stmt: {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {f : I → Space E} {b : Space E} : Tendsto f l (𝓝 b) ↔ ∀ v : E, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪value E (f n),v⟫) l (𝓝 ⟪value E b,v⟫)
body:
:= by
  simp only [value_eval]
  rw [tendsto_subtype_rng, tendsto_iff_forall_eval_tendsto_topDualPairing]
  rfl

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

name: bounded_test_error
stmt: {f v g : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hfb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (hv : Integrable v μ) (hg : Integrable g μ) : dist (∫ x, f x*v x ∂μ) (∫ x, f x*g x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, ‖v x-g x‖ ∂μ
body:
:= by
  have hft : MemLp f ⊤ μ := MemLp.of_bound hf 1 hfb
  have hiv : Integrable (fun x => f x*v x) μ := hv.mul_of_top_right hft
  have hig : Integrable (fun x => f x*g x) μ := hg.mul_of_top_right hft
  rw [dist_eq_norm,← integral_sub hiv hig]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x*v x-f x*g x‖ ∂μ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖v x-g x‖ ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono_ae ((hv.mul_of_top_right hft).sub (hg.mul_of_top_right hft)).norm (hv.sub hg).norm
      filter_upwards [hfb] with x hx
      change ‖f x * v x - f x * g x‖ ≤ ‖v x - g x‖
      rw [← mul_sub,norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hx

name: weak_L2_to_weakStar
stmt: {f : ℕ → Lp ℝ 2 μ} {b : Lp ℝ 2 μ} (hf : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f n x‖ ≤ 1) (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ 1) (ht : ∀ v : Lp ℝ 2 μ, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b,v⟫)) {v : X → ℝ} (hv : Integrable v μ) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, f n x*v x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, b x*v x ∂μ))
body:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgm⟩ := (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr hv).exists_simpleFunc_eLpNorm_sub_lt (by simp : (1 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤)
    (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by positivity : 0 < ε/3))
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := g.exists_forall_norm_le
  have hg2 : MemLp g 2 μ := MemLp.of_bound g.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable C (Eventually.of_forall hC)
  have hgi : Integrable (fun x => g x) μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hgm
  have herr : (∫ x, ‖v x-g x‖ ∂μ) < ε/3 := by
    change (∫ x, ‖(v - (fun x => g x)) x‖ ∂μ) < ε/3
    rw [integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (hv.sub hgi).aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm (hv.sub hgi).aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (ne_top_of_lt hg) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hg |>.trans_eq (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity))
  have he (w : Lp ℝ 2 μ) : ⟪w,hg2.toLp g⟫ = ∫ x, w x*g x ∂μ := by
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hg2.coeFn_toLp] with x hx
    simp [hx, mul_comm]
  have htt := ht (hg2.toLp g)
  simp_rw [he] at htt
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp htt (ε/3) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 := bounded_test_error (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable (f n)) (hf n) hv hgi
  have h2 := bounded_test_error (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable b) hb hv hgi
  calc
    _ ≤ dist (∫ x, f n x*v x ∂μ) (∫ x, f n x*g x ∂μ) +
        dist (∫ x, f n x*g x ∂μ) (∫ x, b x*g x ∂μ) +
        dist (∫ x, b x*g x ∂μ) (∫ x, b x*v x ∂μ) := by
      exact dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
    _ < ε := by rw [dist_comm (∫ x, b x*g x ∂μ)]; linarith [hN n hn]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
private instance : Fact ((2 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
abbrev TraceVector (k : ℕ) := Fin k → WeakBall.Space (RealL2 angularMeasure)
def traceValue {k : ℕ} (b : TraceVector k) (i : Fin k) : RealL2 angularMeasure :=
  WeakBall.value _ (b i)
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
def sampleCode (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : TraceVector k :=
  fun i => WeakBall.ofNorm _ (sample c hc y r i) (sample_norm_le c hc y r i)

name: traceValue_sampleCode
stmt: (y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (i : Fin k) : traceValue (sampleCode c hc y r) i = sample c hc y r i

name: trace_realization
stmt: {x : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc x b) : ∃ y : ℕ → ℂ, ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, TypicalSampling c (y n) (r n)) ∧ Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) ∧ Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun n => sampleCode c hc (y n) (r n)) atTop (𝓝 b)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,ht⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp hb
  simp only [nhds_prod_eq] at ht
  refine ⟨fun n => (p n).1,fun n => (p n).2.1,fun n => (hp n).1,ht.fst,ht.snd.fst,?_⟩
  simpa only [show (fun n => (p n).2.2) = (fun n => sampleCode c hc (p n).1 (p n).2.1) from
    funext fun n => (hp n).2] using ht.snd.snd

name: trace_of_realization
stmt: {x : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} {y : ℕ → ℂ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} (htr : ∀ n, TypicalSampling c (y n) (r n)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x)) (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hb : Tendsto (fun n => sampleCode c hc (y n) (r n)) atTop (𝓝 b)) : IsTrace c hc x b
body:
:= by
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto (hy.prodMk_nhds (hr.prodMk_nhds hb))
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => show (y n,r n,sampleCode c hc (y n) (r n)) ∈ sampleSet c hc from ⟨htr n,rfl⟩)

name: exists_trace
stmt: (x : ℂ) : ∃ b : TraceVector k, IsTrace c hc x b
body:
:= by
  have hd : Dense {y : ℂ | TypicalSampling c y 1} := Measure.dense_of_ae
    (ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1))
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyt⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp (hd x)
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (TraceVector k))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => Set.mem_univ (sampleCode c hc (y n) 1)))
  exact ⟨b,trace_of_realization c hc (fun n => hy (φ n)) (hyt.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) tendsto_const_nhds hb⟩

name: isClosed_traceGraph
stmt: : IsClosed {p : ℂ × TraceVector k | IsTrace c hc p.1 p.2}
body:
:= by
  exact isClosed_closure.preimage (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd))

name: isCompact_traces
stmt: (x : ℂ) : IsCompact {b : TraceVector k | IsTrace c hc x b}
body:
:= by
  apply IsClosed.isCompact
  exact isClosed_closure.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))

name: trace_limit
stmt: {x : ℕ → ℂ} {b : ℕ → TraceVector k} {y : ℂ} {a : TraceVector k} (h : ∀ n, IsTrace c hc (x n) (b n)) (hx : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 a)) : IsTrace c hc y a
body:
:=
  (isClosed_traceGraph c hc).mem_of_tendsto (hx.prodMk_nhds hb) (Eventually.of_forall h)

name: traceCode_tendsto_iff
stmt: {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} {f : I → TraceVector k} {b : TraceVector k} : Tendsto f l (𝓝 b) ↔ ∀ i v, Tendsto (fun n => ⟪traceValue (f n) i,v⟫) l (𝓝 ⟪traceValue b i,v⟫)
body:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
  exact forall_congr' fun i => WeakBall.tendsto_iff _

name: trace_bounds
stmt: {x : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc x b) : (∀ i, 0 ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] traceValue b i) ∧ (∀ i, traceValue b i ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∑ i, traceValue b i = oneL2 angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y,r,_,_,_,ht⟩ := trace_realization c hc hb
  have hw := traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp ht
  simp only [traceValue_sampleCode] at hw
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply weak_limit_nonneg angularMeasure (hw i)
    intro n
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (y n) (r n) i] with t he
    simpa only [he,Pi.zero_apply] using sampleFn_nonneg c (y n) (r n) i t
  · intro i
    apply weak_limit_le_one angularMeasure (hw i)
    intro n
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (y n) (r n) i] with t he
    simpa only [he] using sampleFn_le_one c (y n) (r n) i t
  · exact weak_limit_sum angularMeasure hw (fun n => sample_sum c hc (y n) (r n))

name: trace_realization_weakStar
stmt: {x : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc x b) : ∃ y : ℕ → ℂ, ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, TypicalSampling c (y n) (r n)) ∧ Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) ∧ Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) ∧ ∀ i (v : Angles → ℝ), Integrable v angularMeasure → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, sampleFn c (y n) (r n) i t*v t ∂angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t, traceValue b i t*v t ∂angularMeasure))
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y,r,hy,hyt,hrt,hbt⟩ := trace_realization c hc hb
  refine ⟨y,r,hy,hyt,hrt,fun i v hv => ?_⟩
  have hbounds := trace_bounds c hc hb
  have hbn : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ‖traceValue b i t‖ ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hbounds.1 i,hbounds.2.1 i] with t ht1 ht2
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ht1]
  have hsn (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ‖sample c hc (y n) (r n) i t‖ ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (y n) (r n) i] with t ht
    rw [ht,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (sampleFn_nonneg c _ _ _ t)]
    exact sampleFn_le_one c _ _ _ t
  have hw := weak_L2_to_weakStar hsn hbn
    (by simpa only [traceValue_sampleCode] using (traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp hbt) i) hv
  convert hw using 1
  ext n
  exact (integral_congr_ae ((sample_ae c hc (y n) (r n) i).mono fun t ht => congrArg (fun a => a*v t) ht)).symm
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Topology Filter Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {X I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

name: exists_countable_essential_union
stmt: (A : I → Set X) (hm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) : ∃ J : Set I, J.Countable ∧ ∀ i, A i ≤ᵐ[μ] (⋃ j ∈ J, A j)
body:
:= by
  let S : Set ENNReal := {m | ∃ J : Set I, J.Countable ∧ μ (⋃ j ∈ J, A j)=m}
  have hs : S.Nonempty := ⟨0,∅,Set.countable_empty,by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨f,_,ht,hf⟩ := exists_seq_tendsto_sSup hs (OrderTop.bddAbove S)
  choose J hJ he using hf
  let K : Set I := ⋃ n, J n
  have hK : K.Countable := Set.countable_iUnion hJ
  let D : Set X := ⋃ j ∈ K, A j
  have hD : MeasurableSet D := MeasurableSet.biUnion hK (fun j _ => hm j)
  have hS : μ D ∈ S := ⟨K,hK,rfl⟩
  have hmax : μ D = sSup S := le_antisymm (le_sSup hS) (le_of_tendsto ht (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by
    rw [← he n]
    apply measure_mono
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx with ⟨j,hj,hx⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨j,Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n,hj⟩,hx⟩)))
  refine ⟨K,hK,fun i => ?_⟩
  have hun : μ (D ∪ A i) ≤ μ D := by
    rw [hmax]
    apply le_sSup
    refine ⟨insert i K,hK.insert i,?_⟩
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion,Set.mem_insert_iff,Set.mem_union,D]
    aesop
  have heq : μ (D ∪ A i) = μ D := le_antisymm hun (measure_mono Set.subset_union_left)
  have hzero : μ ((D ∪ A i) \ D)=0 := by
    rw [measure_sdiff Set.subset_union_left hD.nullMeasurableSet (measure_ne_top μ D),heq,tsub_self]
  have hz : μ (A i \ D)=0 := measure_mono_null (by intro x hx; exact ⟨Or.inr hx.1,hx.2⟩) hzero
  simpa only [ae_le_set] using hz
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: diam_le_one_of_preconnected_unitFree
stmt: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {C : Set E} (hC : IsPreconnected C) (h : ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, ‖x - y‖ ≠ 1) : ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, ‖x - y‖ ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) (C ×ˢ C) :=
    (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd).norm.continuousOn
  have hpre : IsPreconnected ((fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C)) :=
    (hC.prod hC).image _ hcont
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C) :=
    ⟨(x, x), ⟨hx, hx⟩, by simp⟩
  have hd : ‖x - y‖ ∈ (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C) :=
    ⟨(x, y), ⟨hx, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ∈ (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C) :=
    hpre.Icc_subset h0 hd ⟨by norm_num, le_of_lt hcon⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩ := hone
  exact h p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2 hpp

name: not_straddle_of_isPreconnected
stmt: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {C : Set E} (hC : IsPreconnected C) {z : E} (h : ∀ q ∈ C, ‖z - q‖ ≠ 1) : ¬ ((∃ q ∈ C, ‖z - q‖ < 1) ∧ ∃ q ∈ C, 1 < ‖z - q‖)
body:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨q₁, hq₁, h₁⟩, q₂, hq₂, h₂⟩
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) C :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).norm.continuousOn
  have hpre : IsPreconnected ((fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C) := hC.image _ hcont
  have ha : ‖z - q₁‖ ∈ (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C := ⟨q₁, hq₁, rfl⟩
  have hb : ‖z - q₂‖ ∈ (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C := ⟨q₂, hq₂, rfl⟩
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ∈ (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C :=
    hpre.Icc_subset ha hb ⟨le_of_lt h₁, le_of_lt h₂⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1⟩ := hone
  exact h q hq hq1

name: diam_le_one_connectedComponentIn_of_properColoring
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : ∀ x y : ℂ, ‖x - y‖ = 1 → c x ≠ c y) {i : Fin k} {s : Set ℂ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, c x = i) (z : ℂ) : ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn s z, ∀ y ∈ connectedComponentIn s z, ‖x - y‖ ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  apply diam_le_one_of_preconnected_unitFree isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  have hx' : c x = i := hs x (connectedComponentIn_subset s z hx)
  have hy' : c y = i := hs y (connectedComponentIn_subset s z hy)
  exact hc x y hxy (by rw [hx', hy'])

end EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_frequently_notMem_of_measure_tendsto_zero
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {E : ℕ → Set X} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => μ (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, ∃ᶠ n in atTop, z ∉ E n
body:
:= by
  let T : ℕ → Set X := fun N => ⋂ n ≥ N, E n
  have hT : ∀ N, μ (T N) = 0 := by
    intro N
    apply le_antisymm _ (by positivity)
    apply ge_of_tendsto hE
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
    exact measure_mono (fun z hz => (mem_iInter.mp (mem_iInter.mp hz n)) hn)
  have hn : μ (⋃ N, T N) = 0 := measure_iUnion_null hT
  filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hn] with z hz
  rw [← not_eventually]
  intro he
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp he
  exact hz (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨N,mem_iInter.mpr fun n => mem_iInter.mpr (hN n)⟩)

name: ae_ne_one_of_eventual_bound
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {p : ℕ → X → ℝ} {f : X → ℝ} {E : ℕ → Set X} {U : Set X} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hp : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => p n z) atTop (𝓝 (f z))) (hE : Tendsto (fun n => μ (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hb : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, z ∉ E n → p n z ≤ 1-α) : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, z ∈ U → f z ≠ 1
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hp,ae_frequently_notMem_of_measure_tendsto_zero hE] with z hz hgood hzU hf
  have hgt : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1-α < p n z :=
    hz.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by rw [hf]; linarith))
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hbnd,hlarge⟩ := (hgood.and_eventually ((hb z hzU).and hgt)).exists
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbnd hn)) hlarge
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: colorFn_locallyIntegrable
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) : LocallyIntegrable (colorFn c i) (volume : Measure ℂ)
body:
:=
  (continuous_const.locallyIntegrable (f := fun _ : ℂ => (1:ℝ))).mono
    (colorFn_measurable hc i).aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun z => by

name: diskAverage_eq_average_ball
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (ε : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : diskAverage c ε i q = ⨍ z in Metric.ball q ε, colorFn c i z ∂volume

:= by
  have he : (fun v : ℂ => q+v) ⁻¹' Metric.ball q ε = Metric.ball 0 ε := by
    ext v
    simp [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm]
  have hi := (measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℂ) q).setIntegral_preimage_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.addLeft q).measurableEmbedding (colorFn c i) (Metric.ball q ε)
  rw [he] at hi

name: complex_ball_ae_closedBall
stmt: (q : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) : Metric.ball q ε =ᵐ[volume] Metric.closedBall q ε
body:
:=

    (by rw [Complex.volume_closedBall,Complex.volume_ball])
    measurableSet_ball.nullMeasurableSet ((isCompact_closedBall q ε).measure_ne_top)

name: diskAverage_ae_tendsto
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀ n,0<ε n) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ z : ℂ ∂volume, Tendsto (fun n => diskAverage c (ε n) i z) atTop (𝓝 (colorFn c i z))
body:
:= by
  have hε' : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝[>] 0) := tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    ⟨hε,Eventually.of_forall hpos⟩
  filter_upwards [IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_average volume
    (colorFn_locallyIntegrable hc i) 1] with z hz
  have h := hz (fun _ : ℕ => z) ε hε' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => by
    simp only [one_mul,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_self]; exact (hpos n).le)
  convert h using 1
  ext n
  rw [diskAverage_eq_average_ball]
  exact setAverage_congr (complex_ball_ae_closedBall z (ε n))

name: support_disjoint_open_of_ae
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (i : Fin k) (h : ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ),z∈U → c z≠i) : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) U
body:
:= by
  have he : Uᶜ ∈ ae (volume.restrict {z | c z=i}) := by
    change ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict {z | c z=i},z∈Uᶜ
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)]
    filter_upwards [h] with z hz hczi hzU
    exact hz hzU hczi
  have hs := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed hU.isClosed_compl he
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun z hz hzU => hs hz hzU

name: diskAverage_support_exclusion
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀ n,0<ε n) {E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (i : Fin k) (hb : ∀ z∈U,∀ᶠ n in atTop,z∉E n → diskAverage c (ε n) i z≤1-α) : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) U
body:
:= by
  apply support_disjoint_open_of_ae hc hU i
  filter_upwards [ae_ne_one_of_eventual_bound hα (diskAverage_ae_tendsto hc hε hpos i) hE hb]
    with z hz hzU hczi
  exact hz hzU (by simp [colorFn,hczi])

name: nonemptyCompacts_preconnected_limit
stmt: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [NormalSpace X] {ι : Type v} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l] {K : ι → NonemptyCompacts X} {L : NonemptyCompacts X} (hlim : Tendsto K l (𝓝 L)) (hc : ∀ᶠn in l,IsPreconnected (K n : Set X)) : IsPreconnected (L : Set X)
body:
:= by
  apply (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed L.isCompact.isClosed).mpr
  intro A B hA hB hcov hd
  by_contra hh
  push Not at hh
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hh.1
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyB⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hh.2
  have hxB := (hcov hx).resolve_left hxA
  have hyA := (hcov hy).resolve_right hyB
  obtain ⟨U,V,hU,hV,hAU,hBV,hUV⟩ := normal_separation hA hB hd
  have hL : (L : Set X)⊆U∪V := hcov.trans (union_subset_union hAU hBV)
  have hs : ∀ᶠn in l,(K n : Set X)⊆U∪V := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen (hU.union hV)).mem_nhds hL)
  have hu : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩U).Nonempty := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hU).mem_nhds ⟨y,hy,hAU hyA⟩)
  have hv : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩V).Nonempty := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hV).mem_nhds ⟨x,hx,hBV hxB⟩)
  obtain ⟨n,hnc,hns,hnu,hnv⟩ := (hc.and (hs.and (hu.and hv))).exists
  obtain ⟨z,_,hzU,hzV⟩ := hnc U V hU hV hns hnu hnv
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hUV hzU hzV

name: nonemptyCompacts_mem_limit
stmt: {X : Type u} [MetricSpace X] {ι : Type v} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l] {K : ι → NonemptyCompacts X} {L : NonemptyCompacts X} {x : ι → X} {y : X} (hK : Tendsto K l (𝓝 L)) (hx : Tendsto x l (𝓝 y)) (hm : ∀ᶠn in l,x n∈K n) : y∈L
body:
:= by
  have hh := (NonemptyCompacts.lipschitz_infDist.continuous.tendsto (y,L)).comp (hx.prodMk_nhds hK)
  have h0 : (fun n => Metric.infDist (x n) (K n : Set X)) =ᶠ[l] fun _ => 0 :=
    hm.mono fun n hn => Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem hn
  have he : Metric.infDist y (L : Set X)=0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hh
    (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' h0.symm)
  exact (L.isCompact.isClosed.mem_iff_infDist_zero L.nonempty).mpr he

name: nonemptyCompacts_inter_closed_limit
stmt: {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type v} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l] {K : ι → NonemptyCompacts X} {L : NonemptyCompacts X} {F : Set X} (hF : IsClosed F) (hK : Tendsto K l (𝓝 L)) (hm : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩F).Nonempty) : ((L : Set X)∩F).Nonempty
body:
:=
  (NonemptyCompacts.isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed hF).mem_of_tendsto hK hm

name: finite_continuum_subsequence
stmt: {X : Type u} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {J : Type v} [Finite J] (K : ℕ → J → NonemptyCompacts X) (hc : ∀n j,IsPreconnected (K n j : Set X)) : ∃L : J → NonemptyCompacts X, ∃φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ (∀j,Tendsto (fun n => K (φ n) j) atTop (𝓝 (L j))) ∧ (∀j,IsPreconnected (L j : Set X))
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L,_,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (J → NonemptyCompacts X))).tendsto_subseq (fun n => Set.mem_univ (K n))
  refine ⟨L,φ,hφ,?_,?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact (continuous_apply j).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim
  · intro j
    exact nonemptyCompacts_preconnected_limit
      ((continuous_apply j).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun n => hc (φ n) j)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
