name: straddle_eventually_of_compact_limit
stmt: {K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts ℂ} {L : NonemptyCompacts ℂ} (hlim : Tendsto K atTop (𝓝 L)) {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈Straddle (L : Set ℂ)) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,z∈Straddle (K n : Set ℂ)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,q,hq,hp1,hq1⟩ := hz
  have ha : ∀ᶠn in atTop,((K n : Set ℂ)∩{p : ℂ | dist z p<1}).Nonempty :=
    hlim.eventually ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.dist continuous_id) continuous_const)).mem_nhds ⟨p,hp,hp1⟩)
  have hb : ∀ᶠn in atTop,((K n : Set ℂ)∩{q : ℂ | 1<dist z q}).Nonempty :=
    hlim.eventually ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.dist continuous_id))).mem_nhds ⟨q,hq,hq1⟩)
  filter_upwards [ha,hb] with n hn hm
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hp1⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hq1⟩ := hm
  exact ⟨p,hp,q,hq,hp1,hq1⟩

name: continuum_limit_support_exclusion
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts ℂ} {L : NonemptyCompacts ℂ} (hlim : Tendsto K atTop (𝓝 L)) (hconn : ∀n,IsPreconnected (K n : Set ℂ)) {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n) {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (i : Fin k) (hprob : ∀n q,q∈K n → q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) i q) : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle (L : Set ℂ))
body:
:= by
  apply diskAverage_support_exclusion hc hε hpos hE hα (straddle_isOpen _) i
  intro z hz
  filter_upwards [straddle_eventually_of_compact_limit hlim hz] with n hn hzE
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hunit⟩ := straddle_connected_unit (hconn n) hn
  have hqH : q∉H n := fun hh => hzE (hnear n z q hh hunit)
  have hb := hprob n q hq hqH
  have hu : ‖q-z‖=1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hunit
  have hh := diskAverage_unit_pair hc hw (hpos n) hu i
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

def CommonInterface (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (x : ℂ) (i j : Fin 5) : Prop :=
  ∃K : Set ℂ, ∃v : ℂ, ‖v‖=1 ∧ Nonempty (ApproachingContinuum x K v) ∧
    Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle K) ∧ Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle K)

name: CommonInterface.symm
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {x : ℂ} {i j : Fin 5} (h : CommonInterface c x i j) : CommonInterface c x j i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hi,hj⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hj,hi⟩

name: spatialSupport_perm
stmt: (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i : Fin 5) : spatialSupport (e.symm ∘ c) i=spatialSupport c (e i)
body:
:= by
  have he : {z : ℂ | (e.symm ∘ c) z=i}={z : ℂ | c z=e i} := by
    ext z
    exact e.symm_apply_eq
  simp only [spatialSupport,he]

name: CommonInterface.perm
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {x : ℂ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) {i j : Fin 5} (h : CommonInterface c x (e i) (e j)) : CommonInterface (e.symm ∘ c) x i j
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hi,hj⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,hK,by rwa [spatialSupport_perm],by rwa [spatialSupport_perm]⟩

name: commonInterface_of_continuum
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {x y : ℂ} {i j : Fin 5} {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K) (hx : x∈K) (hy : y∈K) (hne : y≠x) (hi : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle K)) (hj : Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle K)) : CommonInterface c x i j
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,ha⟩ := continuum_has_approach hK hx hy hne
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,ha,hi,hj⟩

name: no_triangle_commonInterface
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (h01 : CommonInterface c x 0 1) (h12 : CommonInterface c x 1 2) (h20 : CommonInterface c x 2 0) : False
body:
:= by
  let a : Fin 3 → Fin 5 := ![0,1,2]
  let b : Fin 3 → Fin 5 := ![1,2,0]
  have h (i : Fin 3) : CommonInterface c x (a i) (b i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h20
  choose K v hv hK hA hB using h
  apply no_triangle_interfaces hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i))
  intro i j hj
  have he : triangleEdge i={a i,b i} := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rw [he] at hj
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
  · exact hA i
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact hB i

name: no_four_commonInterface
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (h01 : CommonInterface c x 0 1) (h12 : CommonInterface c x 1 2) (h23 : CommonInterface c x 2 3) (h30 : CommonInterface c x 3 0) : False
body:
:= by
  let a : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0,1,2,3]
  let b : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![1,2,3,0]
  have h (i : Fin 4) : CommonInterface c x (a i) (b i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h23
    · exact h30
  choose K v hv hK hA hB using h
  apply no_four_interfaces hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i))
  intro i j hj
  have he : fourEdge i={a i,b i} := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rw [he] at hj
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
  · exact hA i
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact hB i

name: no_five_commonInterface

stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0<ρ) (K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts ℂ) (hsub : ∀n,(K n : Set ℂ)⊆Metric.closedBall x ρ) (hconn : ∀n,IsPreconnected (K n : Set ℂ)) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : ∀n,a n∈K n) (halim : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 x)) (hout : ∀n,((K n : Set ℂ)∩Metric.sphere x ρ).Nonempty) {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n) {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (i j : Fin 5) (hi : ∀n q,q∈K n → q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) i q) (hj : ∀n q,q∈K n → q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) j q) : CommonInterface c x i j

name: finite_config_proper
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (z : ι → ℂ) : ∃ q : ℂ, ∀ v w : ι, ‖z v - z w‖ = 1 → c (q + z v) ≠ c (q + z w)
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hone : ∀ v : ι, DensityOne (Set.univ : Set ℂ) (z v) := by
    intro v
    have hb : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ),
        volume ((Set.univ : Set ℂ) ∩ Metric.closedBall (z v) r) /
          volume (Metric.closedBall (z v) r) = 1 := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
      rw [Set.univ_inter,
        ENNReal.div_self (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume (z v) hr).ne'
          (isCompact_closedBall (z v) r).measure_ne_top]
    exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' (hb.mono fun r hr => hr.symm) tendsto_const_nhds
  obtain ⟨q, -, hq⟩ := finite_density_realization (k := k) (c := c) hc hw z
    (fun _ => Finset.univ) (fun v => by simpa using hone v)
  exact ⟨q, fun v w h => hq v w h⟩

name: exists_properColoring_of_finset
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] (h : ∀ F : Finset ℂ, ∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, ∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, ‖x - y‖ = 1 → c x ≠ c y) : ∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, ProperColoring k c
body:
:= by
  classical
  letI : CompactSpace (ℂ → Fin k) := Pi.compactSpace
  let t : ℂ × ℂ → Set (ℂ → Fin k) := fun p =>
    {c | c p.1 ≠ c p.2} ∪ {c | ¬ ‖p.1 - p.2‖ = 1}
  have ht : ∀ p, IsClosed (t p) := by
    intro p
    apply IsClosed.union
    · have hcont : Continuous (fun c : ℂ → Fin k => (c p.1, c p.2)) :=
        (continuous_apply p.1).prodMk (continuous_apply p.2)
      exact (isClosed_discrete {q : Fin k × Fin k | q.1 ≠ q.2}).preimage hcont
    · by_cases hd : ‖p.1 - p.2‖ = 1 <;> simp [hd]
  have hfip : ∀ u : Finset (ℂ × ℂ), (⋂ p ∈ u, t p).Nonempty := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h (u.image Prod.fst ∪ u.image Prod.snd)
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    simp only [mem_iInter, t]
    intro p hp
    have h1 : p.1 ∈ u.image Prod.fst ∪ u.image Prod.snd :=
      Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
    have h2 : p.2 ∈ u.image Prod.fst ∪ u.image Prod.snd :=
      Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
    by_cases hd : ‖p.1 - p.2‖ = 1
    · left
      exact hc p.1 h1 p.2 h2 hd
    · right; exact hd
  have hcomp : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (ℂ → Fin k)) := isCompact_univ
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := hcomp.inter_iInter_nonempty t ht (fun u => by simpa using hfip u)
  refine ⟨c, fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hc
  have h1 : c ∈ t (x, y) := hc (x, y)
  simp only [t, mem_union] at h1
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1
  · exact h1
  · exact absurd hxy h1

name: properColoring_of_weak
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) : ∃ d : ℂ → Fin k, ProperColoring k d
body:
:= by
  classical
  apply exists_properColoring_of_finset
  intro F
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := finite_config_proper (k := k) hc hw (fun x : F => (x : ℂ))
  exact ⟨fun x => c (q + x), fun x hx y hy hxy =>
    hq ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ (by simpa using hxy)⟩

end EuclideanFiveColor

name: triangular_wedge_bound
body:
:= by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 - x) - s * y := by linarith
  have hplus : 0 ≤ (1 - x) + s * y := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hs) hy0]
  have hprod := mul_nonneg hnonneg hplus
  have hxprod := mul_nonneg hx0 (show 0 ≤ 1 / 2 - x by linarith)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s * y), sq_nonneg y]

name: triangular_rectangle_cover
body:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ≤ 1 / 2
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ 1 - x
    · exact Or.inl (triangular_wedge_bound s x y hs hsq hx0 hx hy0 hxy)
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 / 2 - x) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ x
    · right; left
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 - x) y hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hy0 (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (x - 1 / 2) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith

name: triangular_lattice_cover
body:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt 3
  have hs : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
  have hsq : s ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  let n : ℤ := ⌊2 * y / s⌋
  let m : ℤ := ⌊x - (n : ℝ) / 2⌋
  let u : ℝ := x - ((m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2)
  let v : ℝ := y - s * (n : ℝ) / 2
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y / s := Int.floor_le _
  have hn1 : 2 * y / s < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≤ x - (n : ℝ) / 2 := Int.floor_le _
  have hm1 : x - (n : ℝ) / 2 < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp hn0
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  have hv1 : v ≤ s / 2 := by
    have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp hn1
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  rcases triangular_rectangle_cover s u v hs hsq hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1 with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨m, n, h⟩
  · refine ⟨m + 1, n, ?_⟩
    have hu : x - (((m + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2) = u - 1 := by
      dsimp [u]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hu]
    exact h
  · refine ⟨m, n + 1, ?_⟩
    have hu : x - ((m : ℝ) + ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2) = u - 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [u]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hv : y - Real.sqrt 3 * ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2 = v - s / 2 := by
      dsimp [v, s]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hu, hv]
    exact h

end Problem160

name: chord_angles_sum
stmt: {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖≤2) : Complex.exp (((z.arg-Real.arccos (‖z‖/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)+ Complex.exp (((z.arg+Real.arccos (‖z‖/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)=z
body:
:= by
  have hc := Real.cos_arccos (x := ‖z‖/2) (by have := norm_nonneg z; linarith) (by linarith)
  have hre := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have him := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  rw [Complex.exp_mul_I,Complex.exp_mul_I]
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.cos_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_im,mul_zero,
      sub_zero,mul_one]
    rw [Real.cos_sub,Real.cos_add,hc]
    nlinarith
  · simp only [Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.cos_ofReal_im,Complex.sin_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_im,mul_zero,
      zero_add,add_zero,mul_one]
    rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add,hc]
    nlinarith

name: chord_angles_nonparallel
stmt: {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (hr2 : r<2) : Real.sin ((t+Real.arccos (r/2))-(t-Real.arccos (r/2)))≠0
body:
:= by
  have ha := Real.arccos_pos.mpr (show r/2<1 by linarith)
  have hb := Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr (show 0<r/2 by linarith)
  exact (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)).ne'

name: chord_sequence_lifts
stmt: {z : ℕ → ℂ} (hz : Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 0)) (hne : ∀n,z n≠0) (hsmall : ∀n,‖z n‖<2) : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ t : ℝ,∃ a b : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 (t-Real.pi/2)) ∧ Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 (t+Real.pi/2)) ∧ (∀n,Complex.exp ((a n : ℂ)*Complex.I)+Complex.exp ((b n : ℂ)*Complex.I)=z (φ n)) ∧ ∀n,Real.sin (b n-a n)≠0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,_ht,φ,hφ,harg⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi)).tendsto_subseq
    (fun n => ⟨(Complex.neg_pi_lt_arg (z n)).le,Complex.arg_le_pi (z n)⟩)
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n => ‖z (φ n)‖/2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,norm_zero,zero_div] using ((hz.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop).norm.div_const 2)
  have hac : Tendsto (fun n => Real.arccos (‖z (φ n)‖/2)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi/2)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,Real.arccos_zero] using Real.continuous_arccos.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hn
  refine ⟨φ,hφ,t,(fun n => (z (φ n)).arg-Real.arccos (‖z (φ n)‖/2)),
    (fun n => (z (φ n)).arg+Real.arccos (‖z (φ n)‖/2)),harg.sub hac,harg.add hac,?_,?_⟩
  · exact fun n => chord_angles_sum (hsmall (φ n)).le
  · exact fun n => chord_angles_nonparallel (norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne (φ n))) (hsmall (φ n))
end EuclideanFiveColor

stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FiveCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FiveCenter c x) (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) (hne : ∀n,yn n≠x) (hsmall : ∀n,‖yn n-x‖<2) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,t,a,b,ha,hb,hs,hab⟩ := chord_sequence_lifts
    (by simpa only [sub_self] using hy.sub_const x) (fun n => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hne n)) hsmall
  have hcSum (n : ℕ) : x+direction (a n : Angles)+direction (b n : Angles)=yn (φ n) := by

  obtain ⟨i,hi,hi'⟩ := five_limit_contact c hc ha haC
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hj'⟩ := five_limit_contact c hc hb hbC

name: cycle_standard_permutation
stmt: {G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)} {v : Fin 5} {p : G.Walk v v} (hp : p.IsCycle) : ∃e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), (G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) ∧ G.Adj (e 0) (e 2) ∧ G.Adj (e 1) (e 2)) ∨ (G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) ∧ G.Adj (e 1) (e 2) ∧ G.Adj (e 2) (e 3) ∧ G.Adj (e 3) (e 0)) ∨ (∀i : Fin 5,G.Adj (e i) (e (i+1)))
body:
:= by
  have hl := hp.three_le_length
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin p.length => p.getVert i) := by
    intro i j h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hp.getVert_injOn' (by change i.val≤p.length-1; omega)
      (by change j.val≤p.length-1; omega) h
  have hle : p.length≤5 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair (Fin.castLE hle)
    (fun i : Fin p.length => p.getVert i) (Fin.castLE_injective hle) hinj
  have hem (n : ℕ) (hn : n<p.length) : e ⟨n,lt_of_lt_of_le hn hle⟩=p.getVert n := he ⟨n,hn⟩
  have h0 : e 0=p.getVert 0 := hem 0 (by omega)
  have h1 : e 1=p.getVert 1 := hem 1 (by omega)
  have h2 : e 2=p.getVert 2 := hem 2 (by omega)
  have h01 : G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) := by rw [h0,h1]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
  have h12 : G.Adj (e 1) (e 2) := by rw [h1,h2]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
  refine ⟨e,?_⟩
  rcases (by omega : p.length=3 ∨ p.length=4 ∨ p.length=5) with hL|hL|hL
  · left
    refine ⟨h01,?_,h12⟩
    have h20 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 2) (by omega)
    have hlast : p.getVert 3=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
    rw [hlast,← h2,← h0] at h20
    exact h20.symm
  · right; left
    have h3 : e 3=p.getVert 3 := hem 3 (by omega)
    refine ⟨h01,h12,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [h2,h3]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    · have h30 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 3) (by omega)
      have hlast : p.getVert 4=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
      rwa [hlast,← h3,← h0] at h30
  · right; right
    have h3 : e 3=p.getVert 3 := hem 3 (by omega)
    have h4 : e 4=p.getVert 4 := hem 4 (by omega)
    have h23 : G.Adj (e 2) (e 3) := by rw [h2,h3]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    have h34 : G.Adj (e 3) (e 4) := by rw [h3,h4]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    have h40 : G.Adj (e 4) (e 0) := by
      have h40 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 4) (by omega)
      have hlast : p.getVert 5=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
      rwa [hlast,← h4,← h0] at h40
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h23
    · exact h34
    · exact h40
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def transitionGraph (x : ℂ) : SimpleGraph (Fin 5) where
  Adj i j := TransitionEdge c i j x
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ h => transitionEdge_symm c h⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩

def CyclicCore : Set ℂ := {x | ¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic}
def StandardCore (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : Set ℂ :=
  {x | ThreeCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FourCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FiveCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x}

name: transitionEdge_unlabel
stmt: (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i j : Fin 5) (x : ℂ) : TransitionEdge (e.symm ∘ c) i j x ↔ TransitionEdge c (e i) (e j) x
body:
:= by
  simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using transitionEdge_relabel c e.symm (e i) (e j) x

name: cyclicCore_subset_standard
stmt: : CyclicCore c ⊆ ⋃e,StandardCore c e
body:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change ¬∀v (p : (transitionGraph c x).Walk v v),¬p.IsCycle at hx
  push Not at hx
  obtain ⟨v,p,hp⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := cycle_standard_permutation hp
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,?_⟩
  change ThreeCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FourCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FiveCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x
  simp only [ThreeCenter,FourCenter,FiveCenter,transitionEdge_unlabel]
  exact he

name: cyclicCore_closed
stmt: : IsClosed (CyclicCore c)
body:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  intro x hx
  have hx' : (transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic := not_not.mp hx
  have he : ∀i j : Fin 5,∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,
      TransitionEdge c i j y → TransitionEdge c i j x := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : TransitionEdge c i j x
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ => hij
    · have ho := (transitionEdge_closed c i j).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hij
      exact Filter.Eventually.mono ho fun _ hy h => False.elim (hy h)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,∀i j : Fin 5,
      TransitionEdge c i j y → TransitionEdge c i j x :=
    (Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => Filter.eventually_all.mpr (he i))
  filter_upwards [hall] with y hy
  change ¬¬(transitionGraph c y).IsAcyclic
  exact not_not.mpr (hx'.anti (fun {i j} h => hy i j h))

name: standardCore_closed
stmt: (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : IsClosed (StandardCore c e)
body:
:=
  (threeCenter_closed (e.symm ∘ c)).union
    ((fourCenter_closed (e.symm ∘ c)).union (fiveCenter_closed (e.symm ∘ c)))
include hc in

name: standardCore_compact_finite
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : (K∩StandardCore c e).Finite
body:
:= by
  have hc' : Measurable (e.symm ∘ c) := (measurable_of_finite e.symm).comp hc
  have hw' := weak_relabel c e.symm hw
  exact ((threeCenter_compact_finite _ hc' hw' hK).union
    ((fourCenter_compact_finite _ hc' hw' hK).union
      (fiveCenter_compact_finite _ hc' hw' hK))).subset (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx.2 with h|h|h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1,h⟩
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hx.1,h⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hx.1,h⟩))
include hc in

name: cyclicCore_compact_finite
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) : (K∩CyclicCore c).Finite
body:
:= by
  have hf : (⋃e,K∩StandardCore c e).Finite := finite_iUnion fun e =>
    standardCore_compact_finite c hc hw hK e
  apply hf.subset
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (cyclicCore_subset_standard c hx.2)
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,hx.1,he⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

name: diskLaw_absolutelyContinuous
stmt: (ε : ℝ) : diskLaw ε ≪ volume
body:
:=
  (Measure.restrict_le_self (s := Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε)).absolutelyContinuous.smul_left _

name: diskLaw_probability
stmt: {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : IsProbabilityMeasure (diskLaw ε)
body:
:= by
  constructor
  simp only [diskLaw,Measure.smul_apply,Measure.restrict_apply_univ,smul_eq_mul]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume 0 hε).ne'
    ((measure_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall).trans_lt (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) ε).measure_lt_top).ne
def colorFn {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℝ := if c z=i then 1 else 0

name: colorFn_measurable
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) : Measurable (colorFn c i)
body:
:=
  measurable_one.piecewise (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const) measurable_zero

name: colorFn_nonneg
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : 0≤colorFn c i z
body:
:= by
  simp only [colorFn]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: colorFn_le_one
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : colorFn c i z≤1
body:
:= by
  simp only [colorFn]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: colorFn_integrable
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) {μ : Measure ℂ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (q : ℂ) : Integrable (fun v => colorFn c i (q+v)) μ
body:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_bound ((colorFn_measurable hc i).comp (measurable_const.add measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun v => by
    change ‖colorFn c i (q+v)‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (colorFn_nonneg c i (q+v))]
    exact colorFn_le_one c i (q+v)
def diskAverage {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (ε : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ v, colorFn c i (q+v) ∂diskLaw ε

name: diskAverage_nonneg
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (ε : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : 0≤diskAverage c ε i q
body: := integral_nonneg (fun v => colorFn_nonneg c i (q+v))

name: diskAverage_le_one
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : diskAverage c ε i q≤1
body:
:= by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  simpa only [diskAverage,integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul] using integral_mono (colorFn_integrable (μ := diskLaw ε) hc i q) (integrable_const (1:ℝ))
    (fun v => colorFn_le_one c i (q+v))

name: diskAverage_sum
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (q : ℂ) : ∑ i,diskAverage c ε i q=1
body:
:= by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  simp only [diskAverage]
  rw [← integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => colorFn_integrable (μ := diskLaw ε) hc i q)]
  simp [colorFn]

name: colorFn_unit_pair
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {q z : ℂ} (hunit : ‖q-z‖=1) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), colorFn c i (q+v)+colorFn c i (z+v)≤1
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists (u := z-q) (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hunit)
  have ha := (measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℂ) q).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (weak_all_directions c hc hw t)
  filter_upwards [ha] with v hv
  have hne : c (q+v)≠c (z+v) := by
    convert hv using 1
    rw [ht]
    congr 1
    ring
  simp only [colorFn]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h2 <;> try norm_num
  exact False.elim (hne (h1.trans h2.symm))

name: diskAverage_unit_pair
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) {q z : ℂ} (hunit : ‖q-z‖=1) (i : Fin k) : diskAverage c ε i q+diskAverage c ε i z≤1
body:
:= by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  rw [diskAverage,diskAverage,← integral_add (colorFn_integrable (μ := diskLaw ε) hc i q) (colorFn_integrable (μ := diskLaw ε) hc i z)]
  simpa using integral_mono_ae ((colorFn_integrable (μ := diskLaw ε) hc i q).add (colorFn_integrable (μ := diskLaw ε) hc i z))
    (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) ((diskLaw_absolutelyContinuous ε).ae_le (colorFn_unit_pair hc hw hunit i))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open scoped Classical symmDiff
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: volumeReal_ball
stmt: (q : ℂ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0≤ε) : volume.real (Metric.ball q ε)=Real.pi*ε^2
body:
:= by
  simp [Measure.real,Complex.volume_ball,ENNReal.toReal_mul,ENNReal.toReal_pow,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hε,mul_comm]

name: diskAverage_area
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (ε : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : diskAverage c ε i q= volume.real (Metric.ball q ε ∩ {z | c z=i})/volume.real (Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε)
body:
:= by
  have he : (fun v : ℂ => q+v) ⁻¹' Metric.ball q ε = Metric.ball 0 ε := by
    ext v
    simp [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm]
  have hi := (measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℂ) q).setIntegral_preimage_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.addLeft q).measurableEmbedding (colorFn c i) (Metric.ball q ε)
  rw [he] at hi
  unfold diskAverage diskLaw
  rw [integral_smul_measure,ENNReal.toReal_inv,hi]
  have hid : colorFn c i=({z | c z=i} : Set ℂ).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    funext v
    simp [colorFn,Set.indicator]
  rw [hid]
  rw [setIntegral_indicator (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)]
  simp only [integral_const,Measure.real,Measure.restrict_apply_univ,smul_eq_mul,mul_one,div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: ball_ne_top
stmt: (q : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : volume (Metric.ball q r) ≠ ⊤
body:
:=
  ((measure_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall).trans_lt (isCompact_closedBall q r).measure_lt_top).ne

name: symmDiff_balls_subset_annulus
stmt: (q z : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) : Metric.ball q ε ∆ Metric.ball z ε ⊆ Metric.ball q (ε+dist q z) \ Metric.ball q (ε-dist q z)
body:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have h1 := dist_triangle v q z
  have h2 := dist_triangle v z q
  rw [dist_comm z q] at h2
  rcases hv with h|h
  · refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · change dist v q < ε+dist q z
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (show dist v q<ε from h.1) (by linarith [dist_nonneg (x := q) (y := z)])
    · intro hh
      have hz : ε≤dist v z := not_lt.mp h.2
      have hh' : dist v q<ε-dist q z := hh
      linarith
  · refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt h2 (by have hh : dist v z<ε := h.1; linarith)
    · intro hh
      have hz : ε≤dist v q := not_lt.mp h.2
      have hh' : dist v q<ε-dist q z := hh
      linarith [dist_nonneg (x := q) (y := z)]

name: measure_inter_ball_difference
stmt: (A : Set ℂ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (q z : ℂ) {ε : ℝ} (hd : dist q z≤ε) : |volume.real (Metric.ball q ε ∩ A)-volume.real (Metric.ball z ε ∩ A)|≤ 4*Real.pi*ε*dist q z
body:
:= by
  have hsub : (Metric.ball q ε ∩ A) ∆ (Metric.ball z ε ∩ A) ⊆
      Metric.ball q ε ∆ Metric.ball z ε := by
    intro v hv
    rcases hv with h|h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1.1,fun hvz => h.2 ⟨hvz,h.1.2⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1.1,fun hvz => h.2 ⟨hvz,h.1.2⟩⟩
  have hi := abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff' (Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.inter hA).nullMeasurableSet
    (Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.inter hA).nullMeasurableSet
    (measure_ne_top_of_subset inter_subset_left (ball_ne_top q ε))
    (measure_ne_top_of_subset inter_subset_left (ball_ne_top z ε))
  have hm := measureReal_mono (hsub.trans (symmDiff_balls_subset_annulus q z ε))
    (measure_ne_top_of_subset sdiff_subset (ball_ne_top q (ε+dist q z)))
  apply hi.trans (hm.trans_eq ?_)
  rw [measureReal_sdiff (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [dist_nonneg (x := q) (y := z)]))
    measurableSet_ball (ball_ne_top q (ε+dist q z)),volumeReal_ball q (by linarith [dist_nonneg (x := q) (y := z)]),
    volumeReal_ball q (sub_nonneg.mpr hd)]
  ring

name: diskAverage_lipschitz
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (i : Fin k) : LipschitzWith ⟨4/ε,by positivity⟩ (diskAverage c ε i)
body:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro q z
  change |diskAverage c ε i q-diskAverage c ε i z|≤(4/ε)*dist q z
  by_cases hd : dist q z≤ε
  · rw [diskAverage_area hc,diskAverage_area hc,← sub_div,abs_div,
      volumeReal_ball 0 hε.le,abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0<Real.pi*ε^2)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<Real.pi*ε^2)).mpr
    have hh := measure_inter_ball_difference {v | c v=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const) q z hd
    apply hh.trans_eq
    field_simp
  · have hb : |diskAverage c ε i q-diskAverage c ε i z|≤1 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q,diskAverage_nonneg c ε i z,
        diskAverage_le_one hc hε i q,diskAverage_le_one hc hε i z]
    apply hb.trans
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div,le_div_iff₀ hε]
    linarith [not_le.mp hd]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k}

name: colorFn_norm_le_one
stmt: (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ‖colorFn c i z‖≤1
body:
:= by
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (colorFn_nonneg c i z)]
  exact colorFn_le_one c i z

name: diskAverage_product
stmt: {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (i j : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q = ∫ (h : ℂ × ℂ), colorFn c i (q+h.1)*colorFn c j (q+h.2) ∂(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε)
body:
:= by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  exact (integral_prod_mul _ _).symm

name: disk_overlap_swap
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q) = ∫ (h : ℂ × ℂ), (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h.1)*colorFn c j (q+h.2)) ∂(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε)
body:
:= by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := ⟨by
    simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using (ball_ne_top x r).lt_top⟩
  simp_rw [diskAverage_product hε]
  apply integral_integral_swap
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (((colorFn_measurable hc i).comp (measurable_fst.add measurable_snd.fst)).mul
      ((colorFn_measurable hc j).comp (measurable_fst.add measurable_snd.snd))).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    change ‖colorFn c i _*colorFn c j _‖≤1
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul (colorFn_norm_le_one i _) (colorFn_norm_le_one j _) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul _)

name: root_overlap_bound
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) (h₁ h₂ : ℂ) (hr : r+‖h₁‖≤R) : (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂))≤ volume.real (transitionSet c i j x R (h₂-h₁))
body:
:= by
  let T := transitionSet c i j x R (h₂-h₁)
  have hT : MeasurableSet T := transitionSet_measurable c hc i j x R (h₂-h₁)
  have hTf : volume T≠⊤ := (transitionSet_finite c i j x R (h₂-h₁)).ne
  have hI : Integrable (fun q : ℂ => T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁)) volume := by
    exact ((integrable_indicator_iff hT).mpr (integrableOn_const (C := (1:ℝ)) hTf)).comp_add_right h₁
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := ⟨by
    simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using (ball_ne_top x r).lt_top⟩
  have hF : Integrable (fun q : ℂ => colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂))
      (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (((colorFn_measurable hc i).comp (measurable_id.add_const h₁)).mul
      ((colorFn_measurable hc j).comp (measurable_id.add_const h₂))).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      change ‖colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂)‖≤1
      rw [norm_mul]
      simpa using mul_le_mul (colorFn_norm_le_one i (q+h₁)) (colorFn_norm_le_one j (q+h₂)) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
  have hle : (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂))≤
      ∫ q in Metric.ball x r, T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁) := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hF hI.restrict
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with q hq
    by_cases h1 : c (q+h₁)=i
    · by_cases h2 : c (q+h₂)=j
      · have hmem : q+h₁∈T := by
          refine ⟨?_,Or.inl ⟨h1,?_⟩⟩
          · change dist (q+h₁) x<R
            have he : q+h₁-x=(q-x)+h₁ := by ring
            rw [dist_eq_norm,he]
            have hq' : ‖q-x‖<r := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hq
            exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
          · convert h2 using 1; congr 1; ring
        simp [colorFn,h1,h2,Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      · simp only [colorFn,ite_eq_left h1,ite_eq_right h2,mul_zero]; exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
    · simp only [colorFn,ite_eq_right h1,zero_mul]; exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
  apply hle.trans
  calc
    (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁)) ≤
      ∫ q, T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁) :=
        integral_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self (Eventually.of_forall fun q => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _) hI
    _ = volume.real T := by
      rw [(measurePreserving_add_right volume h₁).integral_comp
        (MeasurableEquiv.addRight h₁).measurableEmbedding]
      rw [integral_indicator hT]
      simp

name: root_overlap_zero
stmt: (i j : Fin k) (hne : i≠j) (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (h : ℂ) : (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h)*colorFn c j (q+h))=0
body:
:= by
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
    simp only [colorFn]
    split_ifs with hi hj hj <;> try norm_num
    exact False.elim (hne (hi.symm.trans hj))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: missing_edge_uniform
stmt: {i j : Fin k} (hne : i≠j) {x : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (ht : Tendsto (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) (𝓝 0)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) : ∃ δ>0, ∀ h : ℂ, ‖h‖<δ → volume.real (transitionSet c i j x R h)≤η*‖h‖
body:
:= by
  have hev : ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ), transitionRatio c i j x R h<ENNReal.ofReal η :=
    ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hη))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hev
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun h hh => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : h=0
  · subst h
    have he : transitionSet c i j x R 0=∅ := by
      ext q
      simp only [transitionSet,mem_ofPred_eq,add_zero,mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false]
      rintro ⟨_,hh|hh⟩
      · exact hne (hh.1.symm.trans hh.2)
      · exact hne (hh.2.symm.trans hh.1)
    simp [he]
  · have hr : transitionRatio c i j x R h ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η :=
      le_of_lt (hd ⟨by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh,hz⟩)
    have hm := (ENNReal.div_le_iff (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz)).ne'
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp hr
    have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top) hm
    simpa only [Measure.real,ENNReal.toReal_mul,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hη.le,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (norm_nonneg h)] using hreal

name: diskLaw_mem_ball
stmt: {ε : ℝ} (_hε : 0<ε) : ∀ᵐ h ∂diskLaw ε, h∈Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε
body:
:= by
  rw [diskLaw,Measure.ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (ball_ne_top 0 ε))]
  exact ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball

name: disk_overlap_bound
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {i j : Fin k} (hne : i≠j) (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) {ε δ η : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hη : 0≤η) (hr : r+ε≤R) (hδ : 2*ε≤δ) (hd : ∀ h : ℂ, ‖h‖<δ → volume.real (transitionSet c i j x R h)≤η*‖h‖) : (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q)≤2*η*ε
body:
:= by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  rw [disk_overlap_swap hc hε]
  have hab : ∀ᵐ h ∂(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε), h.1∈Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε ∧ h.2∈Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε := by
    apply (ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_ball.prod measurableSet_ball)).mpr
    filter_upwards [diskLaw_mem_ball hε] with h₁ hh₁
    filter_upwards [diskLaw_mem_ball hε] with h₂ hh₂
    exact ⟨hh₁,hh₂⟩
  have hh : ∀ᵐ h ∂(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε),
      (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h.1)*colorFn c j (q+h.2))≤2*η*ε := by
    filter_upwards [hab] with h hh
    have ha : ‖h.1‖<ε := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh.1
    have hb : ‖h.2‖<ε := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh.2
    by_cases he : h.1=h.2
    · rw [he,root_overlap_zero i j hne]
      positivity
    · have hn : ‖h.2-h.1‖ < 2*ε := (norm_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
      apply (root_overlap_bound hc i j x r R h.1 h.2 (by linarith)).trans
      apply (hd _ (hn.trans_le hδ)).trans
      nlinarith
  have hn : 0≤ᵐ[(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε)]
      fun h => ∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h.1)*colorFn c j (q+h.2) :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun h => integral_nonneg fun q => mul_nonneg (colorFn_nonneg c i _) (colorFn_nonneg c j _)
  simpa using integral_mono_of_nonneg hn (integrable_const (2*η*ε)) hh

name: missing_edge_overlap
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {i j : Fin k} (hne : i≠j) {x : ℂ} (he : ¬TransitionEdge c i j x) : ∃ R>0, ∀ r<R, Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q)/ε) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,ht⟩ := missing_edge_lim c i j hne he
  refine ⟨R,hR,fun r hr => ?_⟩
  apply tendsto_order.2
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    exact ha.trans_le (div_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun q => mul_nonneg (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q)
      (diskAverage_nonneg c ε j q)) (le_of_lt hε))
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := missing_edge_uniform hne ht (show 0<b/4 by linarith)
    have hv : ∀ᶠ ε : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ε < min (R-r) (δ/2) :=
      (eventually_lt_nhds (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,hv] with ε hε hv
    have hh := disk_overlap_bound hc hne x r R (show 0<ε from hε) (show 0≤b/4 by linarith)
      (by have := (lt_min_iff.mp hv).1; linarith) (by have := (lt_min_iff.mp hv).2; linarith) hd
    apply (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh (le_of_lt hε)).trans_lt
    have hz : ε≠0 := ne_of_gt hε
    field_simp
    linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: merge
stmt: {a b : MarkedDisk} {L : Set ℂ} (ha : a.Valid L) (hb : b.Valid L) (hab : ¬Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) : ∃d : MarkedDisk, d.Valid L ∧ a.closedBall⊆d.ball ∧ b.closedBall⊆d.ball ∧ d.radius≤a.radius+b.radius+η ∧ d.noncoreCost≤a.noncoreCost+b.noncoreCost+η ∧ d.core=(a.core || b.core)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z,hza,hzb⟩ := Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp hab
  have hd : dist a.center b.center≤a.radius+b.radius :=
    (dist_triangle a.center z b.center).trans (add_le_add (by simpa [closedBall,dist_comm] using hza) hzb)
  let t : ℝ := b.radius/(a.radius+b.radius)
  have hrs : 0<a.radius+b.radius := add_pos ha.1 hb.1
  have ht0 : 0≤t := (div_pos hb.1 hrs).le
  have ht1 : t≤1 := (div_le_one hrs).mpr (by linarith [ha.1])
  let c := AffineMap.lineMap a.center b.center t
  have hca : dist a.center c≤b.radius := by
    rw [dist_left_lineMap,Real.norm_of_nonneg ht0]
    calc t*dist a.center b.center ≤ t*(a.radius+b.radius) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd ht0
         _ = b.radius := by dsimp [t]; field_simp
  have hcb : dist b.center c≤a.radius := by
    rw [dist_right_lineMap,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)]
    calc (1-t)*dist a.center b.center ≤ (1-t)*(a.radius+b.radius) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)
         _ = a.radius := by dsimp [t]; field_simp; ring
  let d : MarkedDisk := ⟨c,a.radius+b.radius+η,a.core || b.core⟩
  have hA : a.closedBall⊆d.ball := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : dist q a.center≤a.radius := hq
    change dist q c<a.radius+b.radius+η
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle q a.center c) (by linarith)
  have hB : b.closedBall⊆d.ball := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : dist q b.center≤b.radius := hq
    change dist q c<a.radius+b.radius+η
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle q b.center c) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨d,⟨by dsimp [d]; linarith,?_⟩,hA,hB,le_refl _,?_,rfl⟩
  · intro hc
    have hc' : a.core=true ∨ b.core=true := by cases hca : a.core <;> cases hcb : b.core <;> simp_all [d]
    rcases hc' with hh|hh
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,hxa⟩ := ha.2 hh
      exact ⟨x,hx,hA (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxa)⟩
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,hxb⟩ := hb.2 hh
      exact ⟨x,hx,hB (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxb)⟩
  · dsimp [noncoreCost,d]
    cases a.core <;> cases b.core <;> simp <;> linarith [ha.1,hb.1]
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: erased_pair_sum
stmt: {D : Type*} [DecidableEq D] (S : Finset D) {a b : D} (ha : a∈S) (hb : b∈S) (hab : a≠b) (f : D → ℝ) : (∑x∈(S.erase a).erase b,f x)+f a+f b=∑x∈S,f x
body:
:= by
  have h1 := Finset.sum_erase_add S f ha
  have h2 := Finset.sum_erase_add (S.erase a) f (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm,hb⟩)
  linarith

name: merge_sum_bound
stmt: {D : Type*} [DecidableEq D] (S : Finset D) {a b d : D} (ha : a∈S) (hb : b∈S) (hab : a≠b) (f : D → ℝ) {η : ℝ} (hd0 : 0≤f d) (hd : f d≤f a+f b+η) : (∑x∈insert d ((S.erase a).erase b),f x)≤(∑x∈S,f x)+η
body:
:= by
  have hs := erased_pair_sum S ha hb hab f
  by_cases hmem : d∈(S.erase a).erase b
  · rw [Finset.insert_eq_of_mem hmem]
    linarith
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert hmem]
    linarith

name: separate
stmt: (S : Finset MarkedDisk) {L : Set ℂ} (hS : ∀d∈S,d.Valid L) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) : ∃T : Finset MarkedDisk, (∀d∈T,d.Valid L) ∧ (T : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧ (∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) ∧ (∑d∈T,d.radius)<(∑d∈S,d.radius)+η ∧ (∑d∈T,d.noncoreCost)<(∑d∈S,d.noncoreCost)+η
body:
:= by
  suffices hh : ∀n : ℕ, ∀S : Finset MarkedDisk, S.card=n →
      (∀d∈S,d.Valid L) → ∀η : ℝ,0<η → ∃T : Finset MarkedDisk,
      (∀d∈T,d.Valid L) ∧ (T : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧
      (∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.radius)<(∑d∈S,d.radius)+η ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.noncoreCost)<(∑d∈S,d.noncoreCost)+η from hh _ S rfl hS η hη
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro S hn hS η hη
    by_cases hp : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
    · exact ⟨S,hS,hp,fun d hd => ⟨d,hd,Subset.rfl,fun h => h⟩,
        lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη,lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη⟩
    · simp only [Set.Pairwise,Finset.mem_coe] at hp
      push Not at hp
      obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hab,hd⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨d,hdv,hda,hdb,hdr,hdc,hdcore⟩ := merge (hS a ha) (hS b hb) hd (half_pos hη)
      let R := (S.erase a).erase b
      let S' := insert d R
      have hR : ∀e∈R,e∈S := by intro e he; exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp he).2).2
      have hS' : ∀e∈S',e.Valid L := by
        intro e he
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp he with rfl|he
        · exact hdv
        · exact hS e (hR e he)
      have hcard : S'.card<n := by
        have hc₁ := Finset.card_erase_add_one ha
        have hc₂ := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm,hb⟩)
        have hc₃ := Finset.card_insert_le d R
        change R.card+1=(S.erase a).card at hc₂
        dsimp only [S']
        omega
      obtain ⟨T,hT,hdis,hcov,hr,hc⟩ := ih S'.card hcard S' rfl hS' (η/2) (half_pos hη)
      refine ⟨T,hT,hdis,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · intro e he
        have he' : ∃f∈S',e.ball⊆f.ball ∧ (e.core=true → f.core=true) := by
          by_cases hea : e=a
          · subst e
            refine ⟨d,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,fun _ hq => hda (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq),?_⟩
            intro ha
            rw [hdcore,ha]
            simp
          · by_cases heb : e=b
            · subst e
              refine ⟨d,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,fun _ hq => hdb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq),?_⟩
              intro hb
              rw [hdcore,hb]
              simp
            · exact ⟨e,Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (by simp [R,he,hea,heb]),Subset.rfl,fun h => h⟩
        obtain ⟨f,hf,hef,hcore⟩ := he'
        obtain ⟨g,hg,hfg,hcore'⟩ := hcov f hf
        exact ⟨g,hg,hef.trans hfg,fun hec => hcore' (hcore hec)⟩
      · have hb' := merge_sum_bound S ha hb hab radius hdv.1.le hdr
        change (∑x∈S',x.radius)≤(∑x∈S,x.radius)+η/2 at hb'
        linarith
      · have hdc0 : 0≤d.noncoreCost := by unfold noncoreCost; split_ifs <;> linarith [hdv.1]
        have hb' := merge_sum_bound S ha hb hab noncoreCost hdc0 hdc
        change (∑x∈S',x.noncoreCost)≤(∑x∈S,x.noncoreCost)+η/2 at hb'
        linarith
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: cone_dist
stmt: (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (z : Metric.sphere c r) (t : unitInterval) : dist ((1-t.val) • (z.val-c)+c) c=(1-t.val)*r
body:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr t.property.2)]
  rw [←dist_eq_norm,z.property]
def diskCone (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) :
    C(unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r, Metric.closedBall c r) where
  toFun p := ⟨(1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c,by
    change dist ((1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c) c≤r
    rw [cone_dist]
    nlinarith [p.1.property.1]⟩
  continuous_toFun := (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const)).add continuous_const).subtype_mk _

name: diskCone_surjective
stmt: (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) : Function.Surjective (diskCone c hr)
body:
:= by
  intro q
  by_cases hq : q.val=c
  · obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty (x:=c)).mpr hr.le
    refine ⟨(1,⟨z,hz⟩),?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [diskCone] using hq.symm
  · let d := dist q.val c
    have hd : 0<d := dist_pos.mpr hq
    have hdr : d≤r := q.property
    let t : unitInterval := ⟨1-d/r,⟨by rw [sub_nonneg,div_le_one hr]; exact hdr,
      by linarith [div_nonneg hd.le hr.le]⟩⟩
    have hz : (r/d) • (q.val-c)+c∈Metric.sphere c r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_pos hr hd).le]
      rw [←dist_eq_norm]
      change r/d*d=r
      field_simp
    refine ⟨(t,⟨(r/d) • (q.val-c)+c,hz⟩),?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1-(1-d/r)) • (((r/d) • (q.val-c)+c)-c)+c=q.val
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right,smul_smul]
    have he : (1-(1-d/r))*(r/d)=1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [he,one_smul,sub_add_cancel]

name: diskCone_fiber
stmt: (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) {p q : unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r} (he : diskCone c hr p=diskCone c hr q) : p=q ∨ (p.1=1 ∧ q.1=1)
body:
:= by
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val he
  have hd := congrArg (fun x : Metric.closedBall c r => dist x.val c) he
  change dist ((1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c) c=dist ((1-q.1.val) • (q.2.val-c)+c) c at hd
  rw [cone_dist,cone_dist] at hd
  have ht : p.1=q.1 := Subtype.ext (by nlinarith)
  by_cases h1 : p.1=1
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h1,ht.symm.trans h1⟩
  · left
    apply Prod.ext ht
    have hneq : 1-p.1.val≠0 := by
      intro hh
      apply h1
      apply Subtype.ext
      change p.1.val=1
      linarith
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c=(1-q.1.val) • (q.2.val-c)+c at hv
    rw [←ht] at hv
    have hsub : p.2.val-c=q.2.val-c := (smul_right_injective ℂ hneq (add_right_cancel hv))
    exact sub_left_injective hsub

name: contractible_disk_extension
stmt: {Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Y] [ContractibleSpace Y] (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (f : C(Metric.sphere c r,Y)) : ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall c r,Y), ∀z : Metric.sphere c r, g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f z
body:
:= by
  let : CompactSpace (Metric.sphere c r) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_sphere c r)
  obtain ⟨a,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Y
  let F : C(unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r,Y) := H.toContinuousMap.comp
    (ContinuousMap.prodMk ContinuousMap.fst (f.comp ContinuousMap.snd))
  have hf : Function.FactorsThrough F (diskCone c hr) := by
    intro p q he
    rcases diskCone_fiber c hr he with rfl|⟨hp,hq⟩
    · rfl
    · change H (p.1,f p.2)=H (q.1,f q.2)
      rw [hp,hq]
      exact (H.map_one_left (f p.2)).trans (H.map_one_left (f q.2)).symm
  have hquot := IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous (diskCone_surjective c hr) (diskCone c hr).continuous
  refine ⟨hquot.lift F hf,?_⟩
  intro z
  have he : diskCone c hr (0,z)=⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [diskCone]
  rw [←he]
  have hh := DFunLike.congr_fun (hquot.lift_comp F hf) (0,z)
  change (hquot.lift F hf) (diskCone c hr (0,z))=H (0,f z) at hh
  exact hh.trans (H.map_zero_left _)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def graphLeafMove {V : Type u} (v w : V) (t : ℝ) (p : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  p+(t*p v) • (graphVertex w-graphVertex v)

name: continuous_graphLeafMove
stmt: {V : Type u} (v w : V) : Continuous (fun tp : ℝ × (V → ℝ) => graphLeafMove v w tp.1 tp.2)
body:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  change Continuous (fun tp : ℝ × (V → ℝ) => tp.2 i + (tp.1 * tp.2 v) * (graphVertex w i-graphVertex v i))
  fun_prop

name: graphLeafMove_zero
stmt: {V : Type u} (v w : V) (p : V → ℝ) : graphLeafMove v w 0 p=p
body:
:= by
  simp [graphLeafMove]

name: graphLeafMove_of_zero
stmt: {V : Type u} (v w : V) (p : V → ℝ) (hp : p v=0) (t : ℝ) : graphLeafMove v w t p=p
body: := by simp [graphLeafMove,hp]

name: graphLeafMove_edge
stmt: {V : Type u} {v w : V} (hvw : v≠w) (t s : ℝ) : graphLeafMove v w t (graphEdgePoint v w s)=graphEdgePoint v w (s+t*(1-s))
body:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLeafMove,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hvw]; ring
  · by_cases hj : i=w
    · subst i; simp [graphLeafMove,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hvw,Ne.symm hvw]
    · simp [graphLeafMove,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hi,hj,hvw]

name: graphLeafMove_vertex
stmt: {V : Type u} {v w : V} (hvw : v≠w) (t : ℝ) : graphLeafMove v w t (graphVertex v)=graphEdgePoint v w t
body:
:= by
  simpa using graphLeafMove_edge hvw t 0

name: graphLeafMove_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V} (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : graphLeafMove v w t p∈graphRealization G
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,s,hs,rfl⟩ := hp
  by_cases ha : a=v
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      rw [graphEdgePoint_self,graphLeafMove_vertex hvw.ne]
      exact graphEdgePoint_mem (.inr hvw) ht
    · have : b=w := hleaf b (hab.resolve_left (Ne.symm hb))
      subst b
      rw [graphLeafMove_edge hvw.ne]
      apply graphEdgePoint_mem (.inr hvw)
      constructor
      · nlinarith [hs.1,hs.2,ht.1,ht.2]
      · nlinarith [hs.1,hs.2,ht.1,ht.2]
  · by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      have haw : a=w := hleaf a ((hab.resolve_left ha).symm)
      subst a
      rw [graphEdgePoint_swap,graphLeafMove_edge hvw.ne]
      apply graphEdgePoint_mem (.inr hvw)
      constructor <;> nlinarith [hs.1,hs.2,ht.1,ht.2]
    · rw [graphLeafMove_of_zero v w _ (by simp [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm ha,Ne.symm hb])]
      exact graphEdgePoint_mem hab hs

name: graphLeafMove_one_at
stmt: {V : Type u} {v w : V} (hvw : v≠w) (p : V → ℝ) : graphLeafMove v w 1 p v=0
body:
:= by
  simp [graphLeafMove,graphVertex,hvw]

def graphDrop {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : V → ℝ) : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ := fun i => p i

def graphLift {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  fun i => if hi : i≠v then p ⟨i,hi⟩ else 0

name: continuous_graphDrop
stmt: {V : Type u} (v : V) : Continuous (graphDrop v)
body:
:=
  continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply i.val

name: continuous_graphLift
stmt: {V : Type u} (v : V) : Continuous (graphLift v)
body:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i≠v
  · simpa [graphLift,hi] using (continuous_apply (⟨i,hi⟩ : {i : V // i≠v}))
  · simpa [graphLift,hi] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ({i : V // i≠v} → ℝ) => (0:ℝ)))

name: graphLift_drop
stmt: {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : V → ℝ) (hp : p v=0) : graphLift v (graphDrop v p)=p
body:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLift,hp]
  · simp [graphLift,graphDrop,hi]

name: graphDrop_lift
stmt: {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ) : graphDrop v (graphLift v p)=p
body:
:= by
  ext i; simp [graphDrop,graphLift,i.property]

name: graphDrop_vertex
stmt: {V : Type u} {v a : V} (ha : a≠v) : graphDrop v (graphVertex a)=graphVertex (⟨a,ha⟩ : {i : V // i≠v})
body:
:= by
  ext i; simp [graphDrop,graphVertex,Subtype.ext_iff]

name: graphDrop_edge
stmt: {V : Type u} {v a b : V} (ha : a≠v) (hb : b≠v) (t : ℝ) : graphDrop v (graphEdgePoint a b t)=graphEdgePoint (⟨a,ha⟩ : {i : V // i≠v}) ⟨b,hb⟩ t
body:
:= by
  ext i; simp [graphDrop,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Subtype.ext_iff]

name: graphLift_vertex
stmt: {V : Type u} (v : V) (a : {i : V // i≠v}) : graphLift v (graphVertex a)=graphVertex a.val
body:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLift,graphVertex,Ne.symm a.property]
  · simp [graphLift,graphVertex,hi,Subtype.ext_iff]

name: graphLift_edge
stmt: {V : Type u} (v : V) (a b : {i : V // i≠v}) (t : ℝ) : graphLift v (graphEdgePoint a b t)=graphEdgePoint a.val b.val t
body:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLift,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm a.property,Ne.symm b.property]
  · simp [graphLift,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hi,Subtype.ext_iff]

name: graphLift_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (v : V) {p : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization (G.induce {i | i≠v})) : graphLift v p∈graphRealization G
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  rw [graphLift_edge]
  exact graphEdgePoint_mem (hab.imp (congrArg Subtype.val) id) ht

name: graphDrop_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (v : V) {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) (hz : p v=0) : graphDrop v p∈graphRealization (G.induce {i | i≠v})
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  by_cases ha : a=v
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      simp [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex] at hz
    · have he : t=1 := by
        have : 1-t=0 := by simpa [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm hb] using hz
        linarith
      subst t
      rw [graphEdgePoint_one,graphDrop_vertex hb]
      exact graphVertex_mem _ _
  · by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      have he : t=0 := by simpa [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm ha] using hz
      subst t
      rw [graphEdgePoint_zero,graphDrop_vertex ha]
      exact graphVertex_mem _ _
    · rw [graphDrop_edge ha hb]
      exact graphEdgePoint_mem (hab.imp (fun h => Subtype.ext h) id) ht
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def graphLeafRetraction {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) :
    C(GraphSpace G, GraphSpace (G.induce {i | i≠v})) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphDrop v (graphLeafMove v w 1 p.val),
    graphDrop_mem v (graphLeafMove_mem hvw hleaf p.property (by norm_num))
      (graphLeafMove_one_at hvw.ne p.val)⟩
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_graphDrop v |>.comp
    ((continuous_graphLeafMove v w).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val))).subtype_mk _

def graphLeafInclusion {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) :
    C(GraphSpace (G.induce {i | i≠v}), GraphSpace G) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphLift v p.val,graphLift_mem v p.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := ((continuous_graphLift v).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

def graphLeafHomotopy {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) :
    (ContinuousMap.id (GraphSpace G)).Homotopy
      ((graphLeafInclusion G v).comp (graphLeafRetraction hvw hleaf)) where
  toFun tp := ⟨graphLeafMove v w tp.1.val tp.2.val,
    graphLeafMove_mem hvw hleaf tp.2.property tp.1.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := ((continuous_graphLeafMove v w).comp
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))).subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; exact graphLeafMove_zero v w p.val
  map_one_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (graphLift_drop v _ (graphLeafMove_one_at hvw.ne p.val)).symm

name: graphTree_contractible_aux
stmt: (n : ℕ) : ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), Fintype.card V=n → G.IsTree → ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G)
body:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro V inst G hcard hG
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial V with hSS|hNT
    · let := hSS
      obtain ⟨a⟩ := hG.nonempty
      let : Nonempty (GraphSpace G) := ⟨⟨graphVertex a,graphVertex_mem G a⟩⟩
      let : Subsingleton (GraphSpace G) := ⟨fun p q => Subtype.ext (by
        have hp := p.property
        have hq := q.property
        simp only [graphRealization_singleton G a,mem_singleton_iff] at hp hq
        exact hp.trans hq.symm)⟩
      infer_instance
    · let := hNT
      obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hG.exists_vert_degree_one_of_nontrivial
      obtain ⟨w,hvw,hleaf⟩ := SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.mp hv
      let W := {i : V // i≠v}
      let G' : SimpleGraph W := G.induce {i | i≠v}
      have hs : ({v}ᶜ : Set V)={i | i≠v} := by ext i; simp
      have hconn : G'.Connected := by
        have hh := hG.connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hv
        rwa [hs] at hh
      have hac : G'.IsAcyclic := hG.isAcyclic.induce _
      have hlt : Fintype.card W<n := by
        rw [←hcard]
        apply Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective (Subtype.val : W → V) Subtype.val_injective
        intro hh
        obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hh v
        exact i.property hi
      let : ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G') := ih _ hlt W G' rfl ⟨hconn,hac⟩
      have hn := ((id_nullhomotopic (GraphSpace G')).comp_left
        (graphLeafRetraction hvw hleaf)).comp_right (graphLeafInclusion G v)
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hn
      apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
      refine ⟨a,ContinuousMap.Homotopic.trans ⟨graphLeafHomotopy hvw hleaf⟩ ?_⟩
      simpa only [ContinuousMap.id_comp] using ha

name: graphTree_contractible
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.IsTree) : ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G)
body:
:= graphTree_contractible_aux _ V G rfl hG
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: forest_disk_extension
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (f : C(Metric.sphere c r,V → ℝ)) {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.IsAcyclic) (hf : ∀z,f z∈graphRealization G) : ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall c r,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)), ∀z : Metric.sphere c r, (g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩).val=f z
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T,hGT,_,hT⟩ := SimpleGraph.connected_top.exists_isTree_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic
    (show G≤⊤ from le_top) hG
  let : ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace T) := graphTree_contractible hT
  let F : C(Metric.sphere c r,GraphSpace T) := ⟨fun z => ⟨f z,graphRealization_mono hGT (hf z)⟩,
    f.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := contractible_disk_extension c hr F
  let g' : C(Metric.closedBall c r,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => ⟨(g z).val,graphRealization_mono le_top (g z).property⟩,
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp g.continuous).subtype_mk _⟩
  exact ⟨g',fun z => congrArg Subtype.val (hg z)⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def closedCoverMap {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Finite ι]
    (S : ι → Set X) (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) (hc : ⋃i,S i=univ)
    (f : ∀i,C(S i,Y))
    (hf : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j), f i ⟨x,hi⟩=f j ⟨x,hj⟩) : C(X,Y) where
  toFun := Set.liftCover S (fun i => f i) hf hc
  continuous_toFun := (locallyFinite_of_finite S).continuous hc hS (fun i => by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    simpa +unfoldPartialApp only [Set.domRestrict,Set.liftCover_coe] using (f i).continuous)

name: closedCoverMap_apply
stmt: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {ι : Type w} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Finite ι] (S : ι → Set X) (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) (hc : ⋃i,S i=univ) (f : ∀i,C(S i,Y)) (hf : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j), f i ⟨x,hi⟩=f j ⟨x,hj⟩) {i : ι} (x : S i) : closedCoverMap S hS hc f hf x=f i x
body:
:= by
  change Set.liftCover S (fun i => f i) hf hc x=f i x
  exact Set.liftCover_coe x
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

universe u

def diskHoles (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,d.ball
def coreHoles (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,⋃(_ : d.core=true),d.ball

name: diskHoles_open
stmt: (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : IsOpen (diskHoles S)
body:
:=
  isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball

name: coreHoles_open
stmt: (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : IsOpen (coreHoles S)
body:
:=
  isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball

name: mem_diskHoles
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {z : ℂ} : z∈diskHoles S ↔ ∃d∈S,z∈d.ball
body:
:= by
  simp [diskHoles]

name: mem_coreHoles
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {z : ℂ} : z∈coreHoles S ↔ ∃d∈S,d.core=true ∧ z∈d.ball
body:
:= by
  simp only [coreHoles,mem_iUnion]
  aesop

name: fill_noncore_disks
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (Q : Set ℂ) (S : Finset MarkedDisk) (hr : ∀d∈S,0<d.radius) (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)) (f : C(ℂ,V → ℝ)) (hg : ∀z∈Q,z∉diskHoles S → f z∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) (hb : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → (d.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty → ∃G : SimpleGraph V,G.IsAcyclic ∧ ∀z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius,f z∈graphRealization G) : ∃g : C(↥(Q \ coreHoles S),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)), ∀z : ↥(Q \ coreHoles S),z.val∉diskHoles S → (g z).val=f z.val
body:
:= by
  let D : Finset MarkedDisk := S.filter fun d => d.core=false ∧ (d.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty
  have hD (d : D) : d.val∈S ∧ d.val.core=false ∧ (d.val.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mp d.property
  have hex (d : D) : ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall d.val.center d.val.radius,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,
        (g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩).val=f z.val := by
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hf⟩ := hb d.val (hD d).1 (hD d).2.1 (hD d).2.2
    exact forest_disk_extension d.val.center (hr _ (hD d).1) (f.restrict _) hG (fun z => hf z.val z.property)
  choose g hg' using hex
  let X := Q \ coreHoles S
  let Z : Option D → Set X := fun i => match i with
    | none => {z | z.val∉diskHoles S}
    | some d => {z | z.val∈d.val.closedBall}
  have hZ : ∀i,IsClosed (Z i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact (diskHoles_open S).isClosed_compl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some d => exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hcov : ⋃i,Z i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z.val∈diskHoles S
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
      have hdf : d.core=false := by
        cases he : d.core
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (z.property.2 (mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨d,hd,he,hzd⟩))
      let d' : D := ⟨d,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd,hdf,⟨z.val,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd,z.property.1⟩⟩⟩
      exact ⟨some d',Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hz⟩
  let f₀ : C(Z none,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => ⟨f z.val.val,hg z.val.val z.val.property.1 z.property⟩,
      (f.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val)).subtype_mk _⟩
  let ψ (d : D) : C(Z (some d),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => g d ⟨z.val.val,z.property⟩,
      (g d).continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(Z i,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := fun i => match i with
    | none => f₀
    | some d => ψ d
  have hbd (d : D) (z : X) (h0 : z∈Z none) (h1 : z∈Z (some d)) :
      f₀ ⟨z,h0⟩=ψ d ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    have hn : z.val∉d.val.ball := fun hz => h0 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨d.val,(hD d).1,hz⟩)
    have hs : z.val∈Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius := by
      change dist z.val d.val.center=d.val.radius
      exact le_antisymm h1 (le_of_not_gt hn)
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hg' d ⟨z.val,hs⟩).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some d => exact hbd d z hi hj
    | some d =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hbd d z hj hi).symm
      | some e =>
        by_cases hde : d=e
        · subst e; rfl
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis (hD d).1 (hD e).1
            (fun he => hde (Subtype.ext he))) hi hj)
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  change (closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ z).val=f z.val
  rw [closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=none) ⟨z,hz⟩]
  rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def sideAllowed (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 5) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => s (i-1)≠b ∧ s i≠b
                                                             
def SideCompatible (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Prop :=
  p.card≤2 ∧ (p∩sideAllowed s true).Nonempty ∧ (p∩sideAllowed s false).Nonempty
instance (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Decidable (SideCompatible s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_∧_∧_))

name: side_compatible_diagonal
stmt: : ∀s : Fin 5 → Bool,∀p : Finset (Fin 5), SideCompatible s p → p=fiveDiag (fiveCanonical p)
body: := by decide

name: side_compatible_options
stmt: : ∀s : Fin 5 → Bool,∀i j : Fin 5, SideCompatible s (fiveDiag i) → SideCompatible s (fiveDiag j) → j=i ∨ j=i+2 ∨ j=i-2
body: := by decide

name: side_allowed_not
stmt: (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) : sideAllowed (fun i => !(s i)) b=sideAllowed s (!b)
body:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [sideAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
  cases hb : b <;> cases h0 : s (i-1) <;> cases h1 : s i <;> decide

name: side_compatible_not
stmt: (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : SideCompatible (fun i => !(s i)) p ↔ SideCompatible s p
body:
:= by
  simp only [SideCompatible,side_allowed_not,Bool.not_true,Bool.not_false]
  tauto

name: five_triple_forced
stmt: : ∀a b c d : Fin 5, fiveAdj a b → fiveAdj b c → fiveAdj c d → (d=a ∨ d=a+2 ∨ d=a-2) → b=a+1 ∧ c=b+1 ∧ d=c+1 ∨ a=b+1 ∧ b=c+1 ∧ c=d+1
body: := by decide

name: five_six_constant_steps_impossible
body: := by decide

name: five_word_impossible
stmt: (p : Fin 6 → Fin 5) (ha : ∀j,fiveAdj (p j) (p (j+1))) (ho : ∀j,p (j+3)=p j ∨ p (j+3)=p j+2 ∨ p (j+3)=p j-2) : False
body:
:= by
  have h0 := five_triple_forced (p 0) (p 1) (p 2) (p 3) (ha 0) (ha 1) (ha 2) (ho 0)
  have h3 := five_triple_forced (p 3) (p 4) (p 5) (p 0) (ha 3) (ha 4) (ha 5) (ho 3)
  have h1 := five_triple_forced (p 1) (p 2) (p 3) (p 4) (ha 1) (ha 2) (ha 3) (ho 1)
  exact five_six_constant_steps_impossible _ _ _ _ _ _ h0 h3 h1

name: five_strip_orbit_impossible
stmt: (s : Fin 6 → Fin 5 → Bool) (P : Fin 6 → Finset (Fin 5)) (hp : ∀j,SideCompatible (s j) (P j)) (hopp : ∀j i,s (j+3) i= !(s j i)) (hdis : ∀j,Disjoint (P j) (P (j+1))) : False
body:
:= by
  let p : Fin 6 → Fin 5 := fun j => fiveCanonical (P j)
  have he (j) : P j=fiveDiag (p j) := side_compatible_diagonal (s j) (P j) (hp j)
  apply five_word_impossible p
  · intro j
    exact (five_diag_disjoint _ _).mp (by rw [← he,← he]; exact hdis j)
  · intro j
    apply side_compatible_options (s j)
    · rw [← he]; exact hp j
    · have ho : s (j+3)=(fun i => !(s j i)) := funext (hopp j)
      have hh := hp (j+3)
      rw [ho,side_compatible_not,he] at hh
      exact hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def angularSign (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) (t : Angles) (i : Fin 5) : Bool := decide (0<⟪direction t,v i⟫)

name: angularSign_opposite
stmt: {v : Fin 5 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (h : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) : ∀i,angularSign v (t+(Real.pi : Angles)) i= !(angularSign v t i)
body:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [angularSign,direction_add_pi,inner_neg_left]
  by_cases hi : 0<⟪direction t,v i⟫
  · simp only [hi,show ¬0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_true]
  · have hn : ⟪direction t,v i⟫<0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hi) (h i)
    simp only [hi,show 0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_false]
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)

name: five_sides_compatible
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 5 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 5 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle (K i)) ∧ Disjoint (spatialSupport c (i+1)) (Straddle (K i))) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,SideCompatible (angularSign v t) (palette c hc x t)
body:
:= by
  let E (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 5) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex := finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K (fun i => {i,i+1})
    (fun i j hj => by
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
      · exact (hH _).1
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact (hH _).2)
  have hJ (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) :
      ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E s b,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈sideAllowed s b := by
    filter_upwards [hex] with z hz hzE
    simp only [sideAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    constructor
    · intro he
      have hmem : c z-1∈E s b := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,he⟩
      apply hz (c z-1) (hzE _ hmem)
      simp
    · intro he
      have hmem : c z∈E s b := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,he⟩
      exact hz (c z) (hzE _ hmem) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hout (s : Fin 5 → Bool) := continuum_outer_restriction c hc (E s true) hK (hJ s true)
  have hin (s : Fin 5 → Bool) := continuum_inner_restriction c hc (E s false) hK (hJ s false)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hout,ae_all_iff.mpr hin,palette_cardinality c hc hw x,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))] with t ho hi hp hn
  refine ⟨hp.2,ho (angularSign v t) ?_,hi (angularSign v t) ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hh : angularSign v t i=true := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    exact of_decide_eq_true hh
  · intro i hi
    have hh : angularSign v t i=false := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hn' : ¬0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ := of_decide_eq_false hh
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hn') (hn i)
include hc in

name: no_five_exclusion_continua
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 5 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 5 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle (K i)) ∧ Disjoint (spatialSupport c (i+1)) (Straddle (K i))) : False
body:
:= by
  have hh := (five_sides_compatible c hc hw hv hK hH).and
    ((palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x).and (ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))))
  have hshift (j : Fin 6) := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixAngle j)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hh
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := (ae_all_iff.mpr hshift).exists
  apply five_strip_orbit_impossible
    (fun j => angularSign v (t+sixAngle j)) (fun j => palette c hc x (t+sixAngle j))
  · intro j; exact (ht j).1
  · intro j i
    rw [sixAngle_half,← add_assoc]
    exact angularSign_opposite (ht j).2.2 i
  · intro j
    rw [sixAngle_step,← add_assoc]
    exact (ht j).2.1
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: positive_log_difference_bound
stmt: {u v m C : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hu : m ≤ u) (hv : m ≤ v) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hd : |u-v| ≤ C) : |Real.log u-Real.log v| ≤ C/m
body:
:= by
  have hu' : 0 < u := hm.trans_le hu
  have hv' : 0 < v := hm.trans_le hv
  have haux : ∀ a b : ℝ, m ≤ a → m ≤ b → a-b ≤ C → Real.log a-Real.log b ≤ C/m := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    have ha' := hm.trans_le ha
    have hb' := hm.trans_le hb
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos ha' hb')
    rw [Real.log_div ha'.ne' hb'.ne'] at h
    have he : a/b-1=(a-b)/b := by field_simp
    rw [he] at h
    exact h.trans ((div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hab hb'.le).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC hm hb))
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by have h := haux v u hv hu (by linarith [neg_le_abs (u-v)]); linarith,
    haux u v hu hv (le_trans (le_abs_self _) hd)⟩

name: controlled_interval_derivative
stmt: {f' : ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {a b e : ℝ} (hlip : LipschitzWith K f') (_hab : a ≤ b) (he : (K : ℝ)*(b-a) ≤ e) (hmid : 1+e ≤ f' ((a+b)/2)) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc a b) : 1+e/2 ≤ f' t
body:
:= by
  have hdist : |t-(a+b)/2| ≤ (b-a)/2 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1,ht.2]
  have h := hlip.dist_le_mul t ((a+b)/2)
  rw [Real.dist_eq,Real.dist_eq] at h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist K.2
  have hn := neg_le_abs (f' t-f' ((a+b)/2))
  nlinarith

name: controlled_interval_expands
stmt: {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {a b e : ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hlip : LipschitzWith K f') (hab : a ≤ b) (he : (K : ℝ)*(b-a) ≤ e) (hmid : 1+e ≤ f' ((a+b)/2)) : (1+e/2)*(b-a) ≤ f b-f a
body:
:= by
  apply (convex_Icc a b).mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv
    (fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun x _ => (hd x).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) _ a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩ b ⟨hab,le_rfl⟩ hab
  intro t ht
  rw [(hd t).deriv]
  exact controlled_interval_derivative hlip hab he hmid (interior_subset ht)

name: geometric_partial_sum
stmt: {l : ℕ → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (_hq : 1 < q) (h0 : 0 ≤ l 0) (hstep : ∀ n, q*l n ≤ l (n+1)) (N : ℕ) : (q-1)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ l N
body:
:= by
  have h : (q-1)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ l N-l 0 := by
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ,mul_add]
      nlinarith [hstep n]
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def iterComposition (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0 => id
  | n+1 => fun x => f n (iterComposition f n x)
def iterDerivative (f D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0 => fun _ => 1
  | n+1 => fun x => D n (iterComposition f n x)*iterDerivative f D n x
variable {f D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}

name: iterComposition_hasDeriv
stmt: (hd : ∀ n x, HasDerivAt (f n) (D n x) x) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (iterComposition f n) (iterDerivative f D n x) x
body:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hasDerivAt_id x
  | succ n ih => exact (hd n _).comp x ih

name: iterDerivative_pos
stmt: (hD : ∀ n x, 0 < D n x) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : 0 < iterDerivative f D n x
body:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [iterDerivative]
  | succ n ih => exact mul_pos (hD n _) ih

name: iterComposition_strictMono
stmt: (hd : ∀ n x, HasDerivAt (f n) (D n x) x) (hD : ∀ n x, 0 < D n x) (n : ℕ) : StrictMono (iterComposition f n)
body:
:= by
  apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
  intro x
  rw [(iterComposition_hasDeriv hd n x).deriv]
  exact iterDerivative_pos hD n x

name: iterDerivative_log_oscillation
stmt: (hd : ∀ n x, HasDerivAt (f n) (D n x) x) (hD : ∀ n x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D n x) {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : ∀ n, LipschitzWith K (D n)) {a b x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hy : y ∈ Icc a b) (N : ℕ) : |Real.log (iterDerivative f D N x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D N y)| ≤ 2*(K : ℝ)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a))
body:
:= by
  rcases K with ⟨K,hKpos⟩
  change |Real.log (iterDerivative f D N x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D N y)| ≤
    2*K*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a))
  have hp : ∀ n t, 0 < D n t := fun n t => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hD n t)
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [iterDerivative]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hm := (iterComposition_strictMono hd hp n).monotone
    have hu := hm hx.1
    have hv := hm hx.2
    have hu' := hm hy.1
    have hv' := hm hy.2
    have hab : 0 ≤ iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a := by linarith
    have hdist : |iterComposition f n x-iterComposition f n y| ≤
        iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hkd := (hK n).dist_le_mul (iterComposition f n x) (iterComposition f n y)
    change |D n (iterComposition f n x)-D n (iterComposition f n y)| ≤
      K*|iterComposition f n x-iterComposition f n y| at hkd
    have hC := mul_nonneg hKpos hab
    have hh := positive_log_difference_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2)
      (hD n (iterComposition f n x)) (hD n (iterComposition f n y)) hC
      (hkd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist hKpos))
    simp only [iterDerivative,Real.log_mul (hp n _).ne' (iterDerivative_pos hp n _).ne',
      Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have ht := abs_add_le (Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n x))-Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n y)))
      (Real.log (iterDerivative f D n x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D n y))
    have he : Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n x)) + Real.log (iterDerivative f D n x) -
      (Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n y)) + Real.log (iterDerivative f D n y)) =
      (Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n x))-Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n y)))+
      (Real.log (iterDerivative f D n x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D n y)) := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact ht.trans ((add_le_add hh ih).trans_eq (by ring))

name: iterDerivative_ratio_bound
stmt: (hd : ∀ n x, HasDerivAt (f n) (D n x) x) (hD : ∀ n x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D n x) {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : ∀ n, LipschitzWith K (D n)) {a b x y M : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hy : y ∈ Icc a b) (N : ℕ) (hM : 2*(K : ℝ)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a)) ≤ M) : iterDerivative f D N x ≤ Real.exp M * iterDerivative f D N y
body:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ n t, 0 < D n t := fun n t => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hD n t)
  have h := (le_abs_self _).trans ((iterDerivative_log_oscillation hd hD hK hx hy N).trans hM)
  have hex := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h
  rw [Real.exp_sub,Real.exp_log (iterDerivative_pos hp N x),Real.exp_log (iterDerivative_pos hp N y)] at hex
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (iterDerivative_pos hp N y)).mp hex
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
