name: eventually_reaches_threshold
stmt: {l : ℕ → ℝ} {q L : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) (h0 : 0 < l 0) (hstep : ∀ n, l n < L → q*l n ≤ l (n+1)) : ∃ N, L ≤ l N
body:
:= by
  by_contra hex
  have hlt : ∀ n, l n < L := fun n => lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hex ⟨n,h⟩)
  have hp : ∀ n, 0 < l n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact h0
    | succ n ih => exact (mul_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq) ih).trans_le (hstep n (hlt n))
  have hm : Monotone l := monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => by nlinarith [hstep n (hlt n),hp n]
  have hg : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ)*((q-1)*l 0) ≤ l n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using h0.le
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
      have hl := hm (Nat.zero_le n)
      have h := hstep n (hlt n)
      have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (sub_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
      nlinarith
  have hc : 0 < (q-1)*l 0 := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq) h0
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (L/((q-1)*l 0))
  have hn : L < (N : ℝ)*((q-1)*l 0) := (div_lt_iff₀ hc).mp hN
  exact (hlt N).not_ge (hn.le.trans (hg N))

name: first_expansion_threshold
stmt: {l : ℕ → ℝ} {q U L : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) (h0 : 0 < l 0) (hsmall : l 0 < L) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hstep : ∀ n, l n < L → q*l n ≤ l (n+1)) (hupper : ∀ n, l (n+1) ≤ U*l n) : ∃ N, L ≤ l N ∧ l N ≤ U*L ∧ (∀ n < N, l n < L) ∧ (q-1)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ l N
body:
:= by
  have hex := eventually_reaches_threshold hq h0 hstep
  let N := Nat.find hex
  have hN : L ≤ l N := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hbefore : ∀ n < N, l n < L := fun n hn => lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min hex hn)
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    by_contra h
    have hzero : N=0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
    rw [hzero] at hN
    exact hsmall.not_ge hN
  have hup : l N ≤ U*L := by
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hNpos)
    rw [hn]
    exact (hupper n).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbefore n (by omega)).le hU)
  have hsum : ∀ n ≤ N, (q-1)*(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, l i) ≤ l n-l 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      have hi := ih (by omega)
      have hs := hstep n (hbefore n (by omega))
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ,mul_add]
      nlinarith
  exact ⟨N,hN,hup,hbefore,(hsum N le_rfl).trans (by linarith)⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: exists_expanding_word
stmt: {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L a b : ℝ} (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x) (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U) (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x) (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hab : a < b) (hsmall : b-a < L) : ∃ w : ℕ → ι, ∃ N : ℕ, L ≤ iterComposition (fun n => F (w n)) N b-iterComposition (fun n => F (w n)) N a ∧ iterComposition (fun n => F (w n)) N b-iterComposition (fun n => F (w n)) N a ≤ U*L ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc a b, iterDerivative (fun n => F (w n)) (fun n => D (w n)) N x ≤ Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*iterDerivative (fun n => F (w n)) (fun n => D (w n)) N y
body:
:= by
  choose j hj using hlarge
  let A : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ := fun n => Nat.rec (a,b)
    (fun _ p => (F (j ((p.1+p.2)/2)) p.1,F (j ((p.1+p.2)/2)) p.2)) n
  let w : ℕ → ι := fun n => j (((A n).1+(A n).2)/2)
  let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n => F (w n)
  let d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n => D (w n)
  have hd' : ∀ n x, HasDerivAt (f n) (d n x) x := fun n x => hd (w n) x
  have hp' : ∀ n x, 0 < d n x := fun n x => (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2).trans_le (hp (w n) x)
  have hends : ∀ n, (A n).1=iterComposition f n a ∧ (A n).2=iterComposition f n b := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      change f n (A n).1=iterComposition f (n+1) a ∧ f n (A n).2=iterComposition f (n+1) b
      rw [ih.1,ih.2]
      exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  let l : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a
  have hpos : ∀ n, 0 < l n := fun n => sub_pos.mpr (iterComposition_strictMono hd' hp' n hab)
  have hstep : ∀ n, l n < L → (1+e/2)*l n ≤ l (n+1) := by
    intro n hln
    apply controlled_interval_expands (hd' n) (hK (w n))
      (iterComposition_strictMono hd' hp' n hab).le
    · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hln.le K.2).trans hKL
    · simpa only [d,w,(hends n).1,(hends n).2] using hj (((A n).1+(A n).2)/2)
  have hupper : ∀ n, l (n+1) ≤ U*l n := by
    intro n
    exact image_sub_le_mul_sub_of_deriv_le (fun x => (hd' n x).differentiableAt)
      (fun x => by rw [(hd' n x).deriv]; exact hup (w n) x)
      (iterComposition_strictMono hd' hp' n hab).le
  obtain ⟨N,hN,hNu,_,hsum⟩ := first_expansion_threshold (by linarith : 1 < 1+e/2)
    (hpos 0) hsmall hU hstep hupper
  refine ⟨w,N,hN,hNu,fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
  apply iterDerivative_ratio_bound hd' (fun n x => hp (w n) x) (fun n => hK (w n)) hx hy N
  change 2*(K : ℝ)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ 4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e
  apply (le_div_iff₀ he).mpr
  have hsum' : e/2*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ U*L := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hsum.trans hNu
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum' (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)≤4*(K : ℝ))
  nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set

name: line_lipschitzOn_image_bound
stmt: {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzOnWith K f s) : volume (f '' s) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞)*volume s
body:
:= by
  have h := hf.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤1)
  simpa only [hausdorffMeasure_real,ENNReal.rpow_one] using h

name: interval_defect_image_bound
stmt: {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {A : Set ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hm : MonotoneOn f (Icc a b)) (hK : LipschitzOnWith K f (Icc a b)) (hA : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ f x ∈ A) : volume (Icc (f a) (f b) \ A) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞)*volume (Icc a b \ A)
body:
:= by
  let E : Set ℝ := {x ∈ Icc a b | ¬(x ∈ A ↔ f x ∈ A)}
  have hE : volume E=0 := measure_mono_null (fun _ h => h.2) (ae_iff.mp hA)
  have hEi : volume (f '' E)=0 := by
    have h := line_lipschitzOn_image_bound (hK.mono (show E ⊆ Icc a b from fun _ h => h.1))
    rw [hE,mul_zero] at h
    exact le_antisymm h bot_le
  have hsub : Icc (f a) (f b) \ A ⊆ f '' (Icc a b \ A) ∪ f '' E := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hxy⟩ := (hc.image_Icc_of_monotoneOn hab hm ▸ hy.1 : y ∈ f '' Icc a b)
    by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
    · right
      exact ⟨x,⟨hx,fun h => hy.2 (hxy ▸ h.mp hxA)⟩,hxy⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x,⟨hx,hxA⟩,hxy⟩
  calc
    volume (Icc (f a) (f b) \ A) ≤ volume (f '' (Icc a b \ A) ∪ f '' E) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ volume (f '' (Icc a b \ A))+volume (f '' E) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ = volume (f '' (Icc a b \ A)) := by rw [hEi,add_zero]
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞)*volume (Icc a b \ A) := line_lipschitzOn_image_bound (hK.mono sdiff_subset)

name: derivative_ratio_lipschitzOn
stmt: {f D : ℝ → ℝ} {a b R : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (D x) x) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < D x) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hratio : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc a b, D x ≤ R*D y) : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal (R*((f b-f a)/(b-a)))) f (Icc a b)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,he⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f D hab
    (fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun x _ => hd x)
  apply (convex_Icc a b).lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le
    (fun x _ => (hd x).differentiableAt)
  intro x hx
  rw [(hd x).deriv]
  apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by rw [← he]; exact mul_nonneg hR (hp z).le),coe_nnnorm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hp x)]
  rw [← he]
  exact hratio x hx z ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.le⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: line_volume_preimage_bound
stmt: {F : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ)} {K : ℝ≥0} (hF : AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (A : Set (ℝ)) : volume (F ⁻¹' A ∩ s) ≤ (K : ENNReal) * volume A
body:
:= by
  have he : Subtype.val '' ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A) = F ⁻¹' A ∩ s := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩; exact ⟨hq,q.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨hp,hs⟩; exact ⟨⟨p,hs⟩,hp,rfl⟩
  have hi := (isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : s → ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image
    (Or.inl (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤1)) ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A)
  have ha := hF.hausdorffMeasure_preimage_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤1) A
  rw [he,hausdorffMeasure_real] at hi
  rw [← hi,hausdorffMeasure_real,ENNReal.rpow_one] at ha
  exact ha

name: line_map_restrict_volume_le
stmt: {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hm : Measurable F) {s B : Set (ℝ)} (_hB : MeasurableSet B) {K : ℝ≥0} (hF : AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (himage : MapsTo F s B) : (volume.restrict s).map F ≤ (K : ENNReal) • volume.restrict B
body:
:= by
  apply Measure.le_iff.mpr
  intro A hA
  rw [Measure.map_apply hm hA,Measure.restrict_apply (hm hA),Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.restrict_apply hA,smul_eq_mul]
  have he : F ⁻¹' A ∩ s = F ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) ∩ s := by
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨⟨hx.1,himage hx.2⟩,hx.2⟩,fun hx => ⟨hx.1.1,hx.2⟩⟩
  rw [he]
  exact line_volume_preimage_bound hF (A ∩ B)
end EuclideanFiveColor

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y}
omit [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] in

name: integrable_comp_of_map_le
stmt: {T : X → Y} (hT : Measurable T) {C : ℝ≥0} (hmap : μ.map T ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) {f : Y → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : Integrable (fun x => f (T x)) μ
body:
:= by
  have hh := (hf.smul_measure (by simp : (C : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤)).mono_measure hmap
  exact (integrable_map_measure hh.aestronglyMeasurable hT.aemeasurable).mp hh
omit [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] in

name: integral_norm_comp_le
stmt: {T : X → Y} (hT : Measurable T) {C : ℝ≥0} (hmap : μ.map T ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) {f : Y → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : (∫ x, ‖f (T x)‖ ∂μ) ≤ (C : ℝ)*(∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂ν)
body:
:= by
  have hh := (hf.smul_measure (by simp : (C : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤)).mono_measure hmap
  rw [← integral_map hT.aemeasurable hh.norm.aestronglyMeasurable]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂((C : ENNReal) • ν) :=
      integral_mono_measure hmap (Eventually.of_forall fun y => norm_nonneg _) (hf.norm.smul_measure (by simp))
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_smul_measure]; simp

name: tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub
stmt: [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [ν.WeaklyRegular] {T : ℕ → X → Y} {S : X → Y} {C : ℝ≥0} (hT : ∀ n, Measurable (T n)) (hS : Measurable S) (hmT : ∀ n, μ.map (T n) ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) (hmS : μ.map S ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => T n x) atTop (𝓝 (S x))) {f : Y → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  let δ := ε/(3*((C : ℝ)+1))
  have hδ : 0<δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgi⟩ := hf.exists_boundedContinuous_integral_sub_le hδ
  have hgT (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => g (T n x)) μ :=
    integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) (hmT n) hgi
  have hgS : Integrable (fun x => g (S x)) μ := integrable_comp_of_map_le hS hmS hgi
  have hfT (n : ℕ) := integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) (hmT n) hf
  have hfS := integrable_comp_of_map_le hS hmS hf
  have hmid : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖g (T n x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hp := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := μ) (fun _ => 2*‖g‖)
      (fun n => ((hgT n).sub hgS).norm.aestronglyMeasurable) (integrable_const _)
      (fun n => Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
        rw [norm_norm]
        exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [g.norm_coe_le_norm (T n x),g.norm_coe_le_norm (S x)]))
      (ht.mono fun x hx => by
        have hh := (g.continuous.tendsto (S x)).comp hx
        simpa using (hh.sub tendsto_const_nhds).norm)
    simpa using hp
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hmid (ε/3) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 : (∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-g (T n x)‖ ∂μ) ≤ (C : ℝ)*δ :=
    (integral_norm_comp_le (hT n) (hmT n) (hf.sub hgi)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg C.2)
  have h2 : (∫ x, ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) ≤ (C : ℝ)*δ :=
    (integral_norm_comp_le hS hmS (hf.sub hgi)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg C.2)
  have htri : (∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) ≤
      (∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-g (T n x)‖ ∂μ) + (∫ x, ‖g (T n x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) +
      (∫ x, ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) := by
    have ha : Integrable (fun x => ‖f (T n x)-g (T n x)‖) μ := ((hfT n).sub (hgT n)).norm
    have hb : Integrable (fun x => ‖g (T n x)-g (S x)‖) μ := ((hgT n).sub hgS).norm
    have hc : Integrable (fun x => ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖) μ := (hfS.sub hgS).norm
    have hi := integral_mono ((hfT n).sub hfS).norm ((ha.add hb).add hc) (fun x => by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.sub_apply,← dist_eq_norm,dist_comm (g (S x))] using
        dist_triangle4 (f (T n x)) (g (T n x)) (g (S x)) (f (S x)))
    apply hi.trans_eq
    exact (integral_add (ha.add hb) hc).trans (congrArg (fun t => t + ∫ x, ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) (integral_add ha hb))
  have hδv : (C : ℝ)*δ ≤ ε/3 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<3*((C : ℝ)+1))).mpr
    nlinarith [C.2]
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg _)]
  have hm := hN n hn
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg _)] at hm
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology

name: tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub_eventual
stmt: {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [ν.WeaklyRegular] {T : ℕ → X → Y} {S : X → Y} {C : ℝ≥0} (hT : ∀ n, Measurable (T n)) (hS : Measurable S) (hmT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, μ.map (T n) ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) (hmS : μ.map S ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => T n x) atTop (𝓝 (S x))) {f : Y → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hmT
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mp
  apply tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub (T := fun n => T (n+N)) (C := C)
    (fun n => hT (n+N)) hS (fun n => hN _ (Nat.le_add_left N n)) hmS
  · exact ht.mono fun x hx => (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mpr hx
  · exact hf
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter Topology
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: line_antilipschitz_qmp
stmt: {S : ℝ → ℝ} (hS : Measurable S) {I : Set ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hA : AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict S)) : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving S (volume.restrict I) volume
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨hS,?_⟩
  have hle := line_map_restrict_volume_le hS MeasurableSet.univ hA (mapsTo_univ S I)
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at hle
  exact Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le_smul hle

name: line_indicator_pullback_L1
stmt: {T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {S : ℝ → ℝ} {I B D : Set ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} [IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict I)] [IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict B)] (hT : ∀ n, Measurable (T n)) (hS : Measurable S) (hB : IsCompact B) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hAT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (T n))) (hAS : AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict S)) (hBT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, MapsTo (T n) I B) (hBS : MapsTo S I B) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict I, Tendsto (fun n => T n x) atTop (𝓝 (S x))) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in I, ‖D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (T n x)- D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (S x)‖) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  have : (volume.restrict B).WeaklyRegular := Measure.WeaklyRegular.restrict_of_measure_ne_top hB.measure_lt_top.ne
  apply tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub_eventual (ν := volume.restrict B) (C := K) hT hS
  · filter_upwards [hAT,hBT] with n ha hb
    exact line_map_restrict_volume_le (hT n) hB.measurableSet ha hb
  · exact line_map_restrict_volume_le hS hB.measurableSet hAS hBS
  · exact ht
  · exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator hD
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: deriv_lower_antilipschitz
stmt: {f D : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (D x) x) (hp : ∀ x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D x) : AntilipschitzWith 2 f
body:
:= by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro x y
  wlog hxy : x ≤ y generalizing x y
  · simpa only [dist_comm] using this y x (le_of_not_ge hxy)
  have hm := mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)
    (fun x => by rw [(hd x).deriv]; exact hp x) hxy
  have hmono : f x ≤ f y := le_of_sub_nonneg (by nlinarith)
  rw [Real.dist_eq,Real.dist_eq,abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hxy),
    abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hmono)]
  norm_num
  linarith

name: deriv_lower_qmp
stmt: {f D : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (D x) x) (hp : ∀ x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D x) : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving f volume volume
body:
:= by
  have hA := (deriv_lower_antilipschitz hd hp).comp
    ((isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : {x : ℝ // x ∈ (univ : Set ℝ)} → ℝ)).antilipschitzWith)
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_univ] using
    (line_antilipschitz_qmp (I := univ) (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hd x).continuousAt)).measurable hA)

name: iterComposition_invariant
stmt: {f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hq : ∀ n, Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (f n) volume volume) (hA : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ f n x ∈ A) (N : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ iterComposition f N x ∈ A
body:
:= by
  have hq' : ∀ n, Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (iterComposition f n) volume volume := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving.id _
    | succ n ih => exact (hq n).comp ih
  induction N with
  | zero => exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => Iff.rfl)
  | succ N ih =>
    filter_upwards [ih,(hq' N).ae (hA N)] with x hx hxx
    exact hx.trans hxx

name: expanding_interval_defect
stmt: {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L a b : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x) (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U) (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x) (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A) (hab : a < b) (hsmall : b-a < L) : ∃ a' b' : ℝ, L ≤ b'-a' ∧ b'-a' ≤ U*L ∧ volume (Icc a' b' \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*U*L/(b-a))* volume (Icc a b \ A)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w,N,hN,hNu,hr⟩ := exists_expanding_word hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hab hsmall
  let f := fun n => F (w n)
  let G := iterComposition f N
  have hd' := iterComposition_hasDeriv (fun n x => hd (w n) x) N
  have hp' := iterDerivative_pos (f := f) (fun n x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp (w n) x)) N
  have hm := iterComposition_strictMono (fun n x => hd (w n) x)
    (fun n x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp (w n) x)) N
  have hLip := derivative_ratio_lipschitzOn hab hd' hp' (Real.exp_pos _).le hr
  have hAi := iterComposition_invariant (fun n => deriv_lower_qmp (hd (w n)) (hp (w n)))
    (fun n => hinv (w n)) N
  refine ⟨G a,G b,hN,hNu,?_⟩
  apply (interval_defect_image_bound hab.le
    (fun x _ => (hd' x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (hm.monotone.monotoneOn _) hLip hAi).trans
  gcongr
  change ENNReal.ofReal _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal _
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNu (Real.exp_pos (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)).le
  calc
    Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*((G b-G a)/(b-a)) =
      (Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*(G b-G a))/(b-a) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*U*L/(b-a) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sub_pos.mpr hab).le
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using this
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: periodic_interval_defect
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {P : ℝ} (hper : ∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*P ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) (n : ℤ) (a b : ℝ) : volume (Icc (a-(n : ℝ)*P) (b-(n : ℝ)*P) \ A) = volume (Icc a b \ A)
body:
:= by
  have he : Icc (a-(n : ℝ)*P) (b-(n : ℝ)*P) \ A =
      (fun x : ℝ => x+(n : ℝ)*P) ⁻¹' (Icc a b \ A) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage,Set.mem_sdiff,mem_Icc,hper]
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨⟨h₁,h₂⟩,h₃⟩ <;> exact ⟨⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,h₃⟩
  rw [he,measure_preimage_add_right]

name: periodic_interval_normalize
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (hper : ∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*P ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) (a b : ℝ) : ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a' ∈ Icc 0 P ∧ b'-a'=b-a ∧ volume (Icc a' b' \ A)=volume (Icc a b \ A)
body:
:= by
  let n : ℤ := ⌊a/P⌋
  refine ⟨a-(n : ℝ)*P,b-(n : ℝ)*P,?_,by ring,periodic_interval_defect hper n a b⟩
  have h := Int.fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico P a hP
  have he : Int.fract (a/P)*P=a-(n : ℝ)*P := by
    change (a/P-(⌊a/P⌋ : ℝ))*P=a-(⌊a/P⌋ : ℝ)*P
    field_simp
  rw [he] at h
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2.le⟩

name: compact_almost_conull_interval
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {P L : ℝ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (ha : ∀ n, a n ∈ Icc 0 P) (hl : ∀ n, L ≤ b n-a n) (hdef : Tendsto (fun n => volume (Icc (a n) (b n) \ A)) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∃ x y : ℝ, y-x=L/2 ∧ volume (Icc x y \ A)=0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,φ,hφ,hzlim⟩ := isCompact_Icc.tendsto_subseq ha
  have he : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Icc (z+L/4) (z+3*L/4) ⊆ Icc (a (φ n)) (b (φ n)) := by
    have hdist := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hzlim) (L/4) (by positivity)
    filter_upwards [hdist] with n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_lt] at hn
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hn
    intro x hx
    have hh := hl (φ n)
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]
  have hle : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, volume (Icc (z+L/4) (z+3*L/4) \ A) ≤
      volume (Icc (a (φ n)) (b (φ n)) \ A) := he.mono (fun _ h => measure_mono (sdiff_subset_sdiff_left h))
  refine ⟨z+L/4,z+3*L/4,by ring,?_⟩
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto (hdef.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hle) bot_le

name: exists_density_interval
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hpos : volume A ≠ 0) {L ε : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ a b : ℝ, a < b ∧ b-a < L ∧ volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε*ENNReal.ofReal (b-a)
body:
:= by
  have h := Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet (volume : Measure ℝ) hA.compl
  obtain ⟨x,hx,ht⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  have hx' : x ∉ Aᶜ := by simpa using hx
  simp only [indicator_of_notMem hx'] at ht
  have he : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hε
  have hev := ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds he)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, r < L/2 :=
    (eventually_lt_nhds (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)<L/2)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hev' : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      0 < r ∧ r < L/2 ∧ volume (Aᶜ ∩ Metric.closedBall x r)/volume (Metric.closedBall x r)<ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,hev,hsmall] with r hr hh hs
    exact ⟨hr,hs,hh⟩
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hs,hh⟩ := hev'.exists
  refine ⟨x-r,x+r,by linarith,by linarith,?_⟩
  rw [Real.closedBall_eq_Icc] at hh
  have heq : Aᶜ ∩ Icc (x-r) (x+r)=Icc (x-r) (x+r) \ A := by ext; simp [and_comm]
  rw [heq,Real.volume_Icc] at hh
  exact (ENNReal.div_le_iff (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith))) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp hh.le
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: expansion_almost_conull
stmt: {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x) (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U) (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x) (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 < U) (hL : 0 < L) (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hpos : volume A ≠ 0) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ a b : ℝ, L ≤ b-a ∧ volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
body:
:= by
  let C := Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*U*L
  have hC : 0 < C := mul_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hU) hL
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,hsmall,hdef⟩ := exists_density_interval hA hpos hL (div_pos hε hC)
  obtain ⟨a',b',hl,_,hbound⟩ := expanding_interval_defect hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU.le hinv hab hsmall
  refine ⟨a',b',hl,hbound.trans ?_⟩
  change ENNReal.ofReal (C/(b-a))*volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C/(b-a))*(ENNReal.ofReal (ε/C)*ENNReal.ofReal (b-a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_right hdef _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((C/(b-a))*((ε/C)*(b-a))) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_pos hε hC).le,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_pos hC (sub_pos.mpr hab)).le]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ε := by congr 1; field_simp [hC.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hab).ne']

name: expansion_conull_interval
stmt: {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L P : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x) (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U) (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x) (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 < U) (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P) (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hpos : volume A ≠ 0) (hper : ∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*P ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) : ∃ a b : ℝ, b-a=L/2 ∧ volume (Icc a b \ A)=0
body:
:= by
  have hex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℝ, a ∈ Icc 0 P ∧ L ≤ b-a ∧
      volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/((n : ℝ)+1)) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨a,b,hl,hdef⟩ := expansion_almost_conull hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hL hinv hA hpos
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)<1/((n : ℝ)+1))
    obtain ⟨a',b',ha',hlen,hdef'⟩ := periodic_interval_normalize hP hper a b
    exact ⟨a',b',ha',by rwa [hlen],hdef'.trans_le hdef⟩
  choose a b ha hl hdef using hex
  apply compact_almost_conull_interval hL ha hl
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)/((n : ℝ)+1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
    (by simpa only [Function.comp_def,ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht)
    (fun _ => zero_le) hdef
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: conull_extend_intervals
stmt: {ι : Type*} {F : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {U : ℝ≥0} {e B a b : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ} (hLip : ∀ j, LipschitzWith U (F j)) (hmono : ∀ j, Monotone (F j)) (hadvance : ∀ x, ∃ j, x+e ≤ F j x) (hdispl : ∀ j x, F j x ≤ x+B) (he : 0 < e) (hab : a ≤ b) (hB : B ≤ b-a) (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A) (hnull : volume (Icc a b \ A)=0) (n : ℕ) : ∃ b' : ℝ, b+(n : ℝ)*e ≤ b' ∧ volume (Icc a b' \ A)=0
body:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨b,by simp,hnull⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b',hb',hnull'⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hadvance b'
    have hb : b ≤ b' := le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) he.le)) hb'
    have hfa : F j a ≤ b' := (hdispl j a).trans (by linarith)
    have himage : volume (Icc (F j a) (F j b') \ A)=0 := by
      apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
      exact (interval_defect_image_bound (hab.trans hb) (hLip j).continuous.continuousOn
        ((hmono j).monotoneOn _) (hLip j).lipschitzOnWith (hinv j)).trans (by simp [hnull'])
    refine ⟨F j b',?_,?_⟩
    · push_cast
      nlinarith
    · apply measure_mono_null (t := (Icc a b' \ A) ∪ (Icc (F j a) (F j b') \ A))
      · intro x hx
        by_cases hxb : x ≤ b'
        · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hx.1.1,hxb⟩,hx.2⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨le_trans hfa (le_of_not_ge hxb),hx.1.2⟩,hx.2⟩
      · exact le_antisymm ((measure_union_le _ _).trans (by rw [hnull',himage,add_zero])) bot_le

name: conull_interval_alternation_false
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {a b κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hab : κ < b-a) (hnull : volume (Icc a b \ A)=0) (halt : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+κ ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) : False
body:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Icc a b → x ∈ A := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    exact measure_mono_null (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Classical.not_imp] at hx
      exact hx) hnull
  have hmem' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hmem
  have hbad : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∉ Icc a (b-κ) := by
    filter_upwards [hmem,hmem',halt] with x hx hx' ha hxin
    have hxa : x ∈ A := hx ⟨hxin.1,by linarith [hxin.2]⟩
    have hxka : x+κ ∈ A := hx' ⟨by linarith [hxin.1],by linarith [hxin.2]⟩
    exact (ha.mp hxka) hxa
  have hz : volume (Icc a (b-κ))=0 := by
    have hh := ae_iff.mp hbad
    convert hh using 2
    ext x
    simp only [mem_Icc,mem_ofPred_eq,not_not]
  rw [Real.volume_Icc,ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at hz
  linarith

name: graph_map_small_mesh_impossible
stmt: (F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))) (hmesh : ∀(i : Fin 5) (K : Set ℂ),IsPreconnected K → K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 → (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<(F z).val i) → ∀x∈K,∀y∈K,dist x y≤2) : False
body:
:= by
  let Q := Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5
  have : LocallyPathConnectedSpace Q := (convex_closedBall (0:ℂ) (5:ℝ)).locallyPathConnectedSpace
  let U : Fin 5 → Set Q := fun i => {z | 0<(F z).val i}
  have hU (i : Fin 5) : IsOpen (U i) :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const ((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp F.continuous))
  let I := {p : Fin 5 × Set Q // ∃x : Q,p.2=connectedComponentIn (U p.1) x}
  let W : I → Set Q := fun p => p.val.2
  have hW (p : I) : IsOpen (W p) := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    change IsOpen p.val.2
    rw [hx]
    exact (hU _).connectedComponentIn
  have hpos {p : I} {z : Q} (hz : z∈W p) : 0<(F z).val p.val.1 := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    change z∈p.val.2 at hz
    rw [hx] at hz
    exact connectedComponentIn_subset (U p.val.1) x hz
  have heq {p q : I} {z : Q} (hpq : p.val.1=q.val.1) (hp : z∈W p) (hq : z∈W q) : p=q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext hpq
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := q.property
    change z∈p.val.2 at hp
    change z∈q.val.2 at hq
    rw [hx,hpq] at hp
    rw [hy] at hq
    rw [hx,hy,hpq,connectedComponentIn_eq hp,connectedComponentIn_eq hq]
  apply PlanarCover.compact_open_cover_impossible Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) W hW ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro z
    have he : ∃i,0<(F z).val i := by
      by_contra! hh
      have hsum := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5))) (fun i _ => hh i)
      rw [graphRealization_sum (F z).property] at hsum
      norm_num at hsum
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := he
    exact ⟨⟨(i,connectedComponentIn (U i) z),⟨z,rfl⟩⟩,mem_connectedComponentIn hi⟩
  · intro z p q r hp hq hr
    rcases graphRealization_positive_three (F z).property (hpos hp) (hpos hq) (hpos hr) with h|h|h
    · exact Or.inl (heq h hp hq)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (heq h hp hr))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (heq h hq hr))
  · intro p x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := p.property
    let K : Set ℂ := Subtype.val '' W p
    have hK : IsPreconnected K := by
      apply IsPreconnected.image _ _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
      change IsPreconnected p.val.2
      rw [hz]
      exact isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
    have hsub : K⊆Q := by rintro a ⟨b,_,rfl⟩; exact b.property
    have hprob : ∀z : Q,z.val∈K → 0<(F z).val p.val.1 := by
      rintro z ⟨b,hb,he⟩
      have hh : b=z := Subtype.ext he
      subst b
      exact hpos hb
    have hh := hmesh p.val.1 K hK hsub hprob x.val ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ y.val ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: stateSupport_nonempty_measure
stmt: {f : ℝ → ι} {i : ι} {a : ℝ} (ha : a∈stateSupport f i) : 0<volume {t | f t=i}
body:
:= by
  have h := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall a).mp ha univ (univ_mem)
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using h
end EuclideanFiveColor

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fiveRealState (x : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : Set ℝ := {t | fiveState c hc x (t : Angles)=i}
def fiveSupport (x : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict (fiveRealState c hc x i)).support

name: five_realState_measurable
stmt: (x : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : MeasurableSet (fiveRealState c hc x i)
body:
:=
  measurableSet_eq_fun ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const

name: five_support_trace
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5} (ha : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : ∃b : TraceVector 5,IsTrace c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) b ∧ ∀j∈fiveDiag i,traceValue b j=0
body:
:=
  state_support_avoiding_trace c hc hw (fiveState_represents c hc hw hx i) ha

name: five_support_step_ban
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i j : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hj : a∈fiveSupport c hc x j) (hij : fiveAdj i j) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,¬(fiveState c hc x t=i ∧ fiveState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))=j) ∧ ¬(fiveState c hc x t=j ∧ fiveState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))=i)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bi,hbi,hzi⟩ := five_support_trace c hc hw hx hi
  obtain ⟨bj,hbj,hzj⟩ := five_support_trace c hc hw hx hj
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := five_adj_four i j hij
  have hji : fiveAdj j i := hij.symm
  have hv : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fiveState c hc x t=i ∨ fiveState c hc x t=j →
      X∈palette c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) t := by
    filter_upwards [avoiding_trace_palette c hc hbi hzi,avoiding_trace_palette c hc hbj hzj,
      palette_neighbor_disjoint c hc hw x a,fiveState_diag c hc hw hx] with t hni hnj hd he hs
    rw [he] at hd
    rcases hs with hi|hj
    · rw [hi] at hd
      exact five_forced_label i j X hij hX _ hd hnj
    · rw [hj] at hd
      exact five_forced_label j i X hji (by simpa only [Finset.union_comm] using hX) _ hd hni
  filter_upwards [hv,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hv,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw (x+direction (a : Angles))] with t ht hu hd
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi,hj⟩
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht (Or.inl hi)) (hu (Or.inr hj))
  · rintro ⟨hj,hi⟩
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht (Or.inr hj)) (hu (Or.inl hi))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)

name: five_support_cover
stmt: (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) : ∃i,a∈fiveSupport c hc x i
body:
:=
  stateSupport_cover ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) a

name: five_support_next
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : ∃j,fiveAdj i j ∧ a+sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x j
body:
:= by
  apply stateSupport_shift_relation ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) _ hi
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,AddCircle.coe_add] using angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fiveState_adj c hc hw hx)

name: five_support_prev
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : ∃j,fiveAdj i j ∧ a-sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x j
body:
:= by
  apply stateSupport_shift_relation ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) (d := -sixty) _ hi
  have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fiveState_adj c hc hw hx)
  have hh' := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) (-sixty)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hh
  filter_upwards [hh'] with t ht
  have he : ((t+-sixty : ℝ) : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)=(t : Angles) := by
    rw [← AddCircle.coe_add,neg_add_cancel_right]
  rw [he] at ht
  exact ht.symm

name: five_support_no_sixty
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : a+sixty∉fiveSupport c hc x i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hsj⟩ := five_support_next c hc hw hx hi
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := five_adj_four j i hj.symm
  have hp : 0<volume (fiveRealState c hc x j) := stateSupport_nonempty_measure hsj
  intro hs
  exact strict_state_no_unit_support hc hw hX (fiveState_represents c hc hw hx j)
    (fiveState_represents c hc hw hx i) hp hi hs (direction_sixty_unit_real a)
end EuclideanFiveColor

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.FiveComb

def Adj (i j : Fin 5) : Prop := i+1=j ∨ j+1=i
instance (i j : Fin 5) : Decidable (Adj i j) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_∨_))

name: contact_neighbors
stmt: : ∀i : Fin 5,∀L : Finset (Fin 5), i∉L → i+1∉L → (∃j∈L,Adj i j) → (∃j∈L,Adj (i+1) j) → i-1∈L ∧ i+2∈L
body: := by decide

name: opposite_contacts
stmt: : ∀i j : Fin 5, Disjoint ({i-1,i+2} : Finset (Fin 5)) {j-1,j+2} → j=i+1 ∨ j+1=i
body: := by decide

name: adjacent_oriented
stmt: : ∀I : Finset (Fin 5), (∃i∈I,∃j∈I,Adj i j) → ∃i,i∈I ∧ i+1∈I
body: := by decide

name: neighbors
stmt: : ∀i j : Fin 5, Adj i j → j=i-1 ∨ j=i+1
body: := by decide

name: two_bans
body:
:= by decide

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fiveSupportList (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) : Finset (Fin 5) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a∈fiveSupport c hc x i)

name: mem_fiveSupportList
stmt: (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (i : Fin 5) : i∈fiveSupportList c hc x a ↔ a∈fiveSupport c hc x i
body: := by simp only [fiveSupportList,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]

name: five_contact_next
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hi' : a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1)) : i-1∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a+sixty) ∧ i+2∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a+sixty)
body:
:= by
  apply FiveComb.contact_neighbors
  · exact fun h => five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hi ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
  · exact fun h => five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hi' ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_next c hc hw hx hi
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_next c hc hw hx hi'
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩

name: five_contact_prev
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hi' : a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1)) : i-1∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a-sixty) ∧ i+2∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a-sixty)
body:
:= by
  apply FiveComb.contact_neighbors
  · intro h
    have hh := five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
    exact hh (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hi)
  · intro h
    have hh := five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
    exact hh (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hi')
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_prev c hc hw hx hi
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_prev c hc hw hx hi'
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩

name: five_opposite_contacts_false
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a b : ℝ} (hab : b=a+3*sixty) {i j : Fin 5} (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hi' : a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1)) (hj : b∈fiveSupport c hc x j) (hj' : b∈fiveSupport c hc x (j+1)) : False
body:
:= by
  have hn := five_contact_next c hc hw hx hi hi'
  have hp := five_contact_prev c hc hw hx hj hj'
  have hdis : Disjoint ({i-1,i+2} : Finset (Fin 5)) {j-1,j+2} := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro k hk hl
    have hiK : a+sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x k := by
      apply (mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
      rcases hk with rfl|rfl <;> tauto
    have hjK : b-sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x k := by
      apply (mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hl
      rcases hl with rfl|rfl <;> tauto
    exact five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hiK (by convert hjK using 1; rw [hab]; ring)
  have hji := FiveComb.opposite_contacts i j hdis
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_hst,hban⟩ := FiveComb.two_bans i j hji
  have hss : a∈fiveSupport c hc x s := by rcases hs with rfl|rfl <;> assumption
  have hbanI := five_support_step_ban c hc hw hx hi hi' (Or.inl rfl)
  have hbanJ := five_support_step_ban c hc hw hx hj hj' (Or.inl rfl)
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fiveState c hc x t≠s := by
    filter_upwards [hbanI,hbanJ,fiveState_adj c hc hw hx] with t hbI hbJ ha he
    rw [he] at ha
    rcases hban _ ha with h|h
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl,ht⟩|⟨rfl,ht⟩
      · exact hbI.1 ⟨he,ht⟩
      · exact hbI.2 ⟨he,ht⟩
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl,ht⟩|⟨rfl,ht⟩
      · exact hbJ.1 ⟨he,ht⟩
      · exact hbJ.2 ⟨he,ht⟩
  have hz : volume (fiveRealState c hc x s)=0 := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot)
  exact (stateSupport_nonempty_measure hss).ne' hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

name: plane_lipschitz_image_null
stmt: {F : RealPlane → RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith K F) {A : Set RealPlane} (ha : volume A=0) : volume (F '' A)=0
body:
:= by
  have h := hf.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2) A
  rw [hausdorffMeasure_prod_real,ha,mul_zero] at h
  exact bot_unique h
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)

name: palette_open_exclusion
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i : Fin k} {a b : ℝ} (hab : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) {V : Set ℝ} (hV : IsOpen V) (ha : a∈V) (hpal : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈V → (t : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x i) : ∃U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ x+direction (a : Angles)+direction (b : Angles)∈U ∧ volume (U∩{z | c z=i})=0
body:
:= by
  let e := circleInverseHomeo hab
  let W : Set RealPlane := e.source ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' V
  have hW : IsOpen W := e.open_source.inter (hV.preimage continuous_fst)
  have haW : (a,b)∈W := by
    refine ⟨?_,ha⟩
    exact (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa using hab) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (a,b) from circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hO : IsOpen (circleSum 1 '' W) := e.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hW inter_subset_left
  let g : RealPlane → ℂ := fun q => x+Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm q
  have hgs (q : RealPlane) : g (circleSum 1 q)=angularSum x 1 (angleChart q) := by
    rw [angularSum_chart]
    simp only [g,map_add,ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hgc : IsOpenMap g := (Homeomorph.addLeft x).isOpenMap.comp Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap
  have hex := anglePair_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i)
  have hp : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.1∈V → (q.1 : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x i :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hpal
  have hnull : volume (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})=0 := by
    apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
    filter_upwards [hex,hp] with q hq hp hmem
    apply hq (hp hmem.1.2)
    change c (angularSum x 1 (angleChart q))=i
    rw [← hgs]
    exact hmem.2
  have himage := plane_lipschitz_image_null circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport hnull
  have hnullg : volume (g '' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})))=0 := by
    rw [show g '' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i}))=
      (fun z => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x)) ⁻¹' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})) by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
          simpa only [Set.mem_preimage,g,add_sub_cancel_left,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hp
        · intro hz
          refine ⟨Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x),hz,?_⟩
          change x+Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x))=z
          rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
          abel]
    exact ((Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.comp (measurePreserving_sub_right volume x)).quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null himage)
  refine ⟨g '' (circleSum 1 '' W),hgc _ hO,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨circleSum 1 (a,b),⟨(a,b),haW,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simpa only [angularSum,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,angleChart] using hgs (a,b)
  · exact measure_mono_null (by rintro z ⟨⟨q,⟨p,hp,rfl⟩,rfl⟩,hz⟩; exact ⟨_,⟨p,⟨hp,hz⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩) hnullg
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k)

name: transitionEdge_no_open_exclusion
stmt: {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x∈U) (hz : volume (U∩{z | c z=i})=0) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hB⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
  have hae : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈U → c z≠i := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with z hz hu he
    exact hz ⟨hu,he⟩
  have hratio : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0, transitionRatio c i j x (r/2) h=0 := by
    have hh : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,‖h‖<r/2 := by
      have hb : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,h∈Metric.ball 0 (r/2) :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (show 0<r/2 by linarith))
      filter_upwards [hb] with h hh
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh
    filter_upwards [hh] with h hh
    have hap := (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hae
    have hzT : volume (transitionSet c i j x (r/2) h)=0 := by
      apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      filter_upwards [hae,hap] with q hq hqh ht
      have hqU : q∈U := hB (Metric.ball_subset_ball (show r/2≤r by linarith) ht.1)
      have hqhU : q+h∈U := by
        apply hB
        have hd := dist_triangle (q+h) q x
        have hdist : dist (q+h) q=‖h‖ := by simp [dist_eq_norm]
        rw [hdist] at hd
        exact hd.trans_lt (by have hqx : dist q x<r/2 := ht.1; linarith)
      rcases ht.2 with ht|ht
      · exact hq hqU ht.1
      · exact hqh hqhU ht.2
    simp only [transitionRatio,hzT,ENNReal.zero_div]
  have hh : limsup (transitionRatio c i j x (r/2)) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ))=0 := by
    rw [limsup_congr hratio]
    exact limsup_const 0
  have hp := he.2 (r/2) (by linarith)
  rw [hh] at hp
  exact lt_irrefl _ hp
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {ι X : Type*} [Finite ι] [TopologicalSpace X]

name: finite_closed_family_locally_subset
stmt: {S : ι → Set X} (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) (a : X) : ∃V,IsOpen V ∧ a∈V ∧ ∀v∈V,∀i,v∈S i → a∈S i
body:
:= by
  let V := ⋂i∈({i | a∉S i} : Set ι),(S i)ᶜ
  have hop : IsOpen V := (Set.toFinite _).isOpen_biInter (fun i _ => (hS i).isOpen_compl)
  refine ⟨V,hop,?_,?_⟩
  · exact mem_iInter₂.mpr (fun _ hi => hi)
  · intro v hv i hi
    by_contra hn
    exact mem_iInter₂.mp hv i hn hi

name: finite_closed_family_no_common_limit
stmt: {S : ι → Set X} (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) {P : ι → Prop} {a : X} {an : ℕ → X} (ha : Tendsto an atTop (𝓝 a)) (hn : ∀n,∃i,an n∈S i ∧ P i) : ∃i,a∈S i ∧ P i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,haV,hsub⟩ := finite_closed_family_locally_subset hS a
  have hev : ∀ᶠn in atTop,an n∈V := ha (hV.mem_nhds haV)
  obtain ⟨n,hnV⟩ := hev.exists
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hP⟩ := hn n
  exact ⟨i,hsub _ hnV i hi,hP⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: stateSupport_local_pred
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] {f : ℝ → ι} (hf : Measurable f) {P : ι → Prop} {a : ℝ} (ha : ∀i,a∈stateSupport f i → P i) : ∃V,IsOpen V ∧ a∈V ∧ ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈V → P (f t)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,haV,hsub⟩ := finite_closed_family_locally_subset
    (S := stateSupport f) (fun _ => Measure.isClosed_support) a
  refine ⟨V,hV,haV,?_⟩
  exact (ae_state_support hf).mono fun t ht hv => ha _ (hsub t hv _ ht)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: four_avoiding_traces
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) : ∃ b : Fin 4 → TraceVector 5, (∀e,IsTrace c hc x (b e)) ∧ ∀e,∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue (b e) i=0
body:
:= by
  have hh (i j : Fin 5) (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) :
      ∃ b : TraceVector 5, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ ∀a∈({i,j} : Finset (Fin 5)),traceValue b a=0 := by
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hi,hj⟩ := transition_avoiding_trace c hc hw he
    refine ⟨b,hb,?_⟩
    intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
    rcases ha with rfl|rfl <;> assumption
  have he (e : Fin 4) : ∃ b : TraceVector 5, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ ∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue b i=0 := by
    fin_cases e
    · exact hh 0 1 hx.1
    · exact hh 1 2 hx.2.1
    · exact hh 2 3 hx.2.2.1
    · exact hh 3 0 hx.2.2.2
  choose b hb hz using he
  exact ⟨b,hb,hz⟩

name: four_state_trace_domination
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) (b : Fin 4 → TraceVector 5) (hb : ∀e,IsTrace c hc x (b e)) (hz : ∀e,∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue (b e) i=0) (s : Fin 3) {i : Fin 5} (hi : i∈fourGroup s) : {t | fourState c hc x t=s}.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun t => ∑e,traceValue (b e) i t)
body:
:= by
  have hs (e : Fin 4) : (fun t => ∑a,traceValue (b e) a t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue (b e))
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc (hb e)).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  have hzero (e : Fin 4) (a : Fin 5) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,a∈fourEdge e → traceValue (b e) a t=0 := by
    by_cases ha : a∈fourEdge e
    · rw [hz e a ha]
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure] with t ht
      exact fun _ => ht
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => fun h => (ha h).elim
  filter_upwards [four_palette_admissible c hc hw hx,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun a => (trace_bounds c hc (hb e)).1 a),
    ae_all_iff.mpr hs,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr (hzero e)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun a => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x a ⟨b e,hb e⟩)]
    with t hadm hnon hsum hzero hpal
  by_cases hts : fourState c hc x t=s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t∈{t | fourState c hc x t=s} from hts)]
    obtain ⟨e,_,hep⟩ := four_trace_edge (palette c hc x t) hadm i (by simpa only [← hts, fourState] using hi)
    have hj (a : Fin 5) (ha : a≠i) : traceValue (b e) a t=0 := by
      by_cases he : a∈fourEdge e
      · exact hzero e a he
      · apply le_antisymm _ (hnon e a)
        by_contra! hpos
        have hp := (mem_palette c hc x t a).mpr (hpal e a hpos)
        exact he (hep (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hp,by simpa using ha⟩))
    have heq : traceValue (b e) i t=1 := by
      rw [← hsum e,Finset.sum_eq_single i _ (by simp)]
      intro a _ hai
      exact hj a hai
    rw [← heq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnon j i) (Finset.mem_univ e)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t∉{t | fourState c hc x t=s} from hts)]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => hnon e i)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure Y} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
def indL2 (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : RealL2 μ :=
  indicatorConstLp 2 hA (measure_ne_top μ A) 1

name: indL2_ae
stmt: (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : indL2 (μ := μ) A hA =ᵐ[μ] A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
body: := indicatorConstLp_coeFn

name: indL2_nonneg
stmt: (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : 0≤ᵐ[μ] indL2 (μ := μ) A hA
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht
  rw [ht]
  exact indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _

name: indL2_le_one
stmt: (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : indL2 (μ := μ) A hA≤ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht
  rw [ht]
  exact indicator_le_self' (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _

name: indL2_norm
stmt: (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ‖indL2 (μ := μ) A hA‖≤1
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂μ,‖indL2 (μ := μ) A hA t‖≤1 := by
    filter_upwards [indL2_nonneg (μ := μ) A hA,indL2_le_one (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht hu
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ht]
  simpa [measureUnivNNReal] using Lp.norm_le_of_ae_bound (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1) hh

name: indL2_sum
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] {s : Y → ι} (hs : Measurable s) : ∑ i, indL2 (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)=oneL2 μ
body:
:= by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i => indL2 (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => indL2_ae (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)),oneL2_ae μ] with t ht ha hu
  rw [ht,hu]
  simp only [ha,Set.indicator_apply,mem_ofPred_eq]
  simp

name: weak_limit_le
stmt: {f g : ℕ → RealL2 μ} {a b : RealL2 μ} (hf : ∀v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪a,v⟫)) (hg : ∀v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪g n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b,v⟫)) (hle : ∀n,f n≤ᵐ[μ] g n) : a≤ᵐ[μ] b
body:
:= by
  have hh : 0≤ᵐ[μ] b-a := weak_limit_nonneg μ (f := fun n => g n-f n)
    (fun v => by simpa only [inner_sub_left] using (hg v).sub (hf v)) (fun n => by
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (g n) (f n),hle n] with t ht hh
      simpa only [ht,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,sub_nonneg] using hh)
  filter_upwards [hh,Lp.coeFn_sub b a] with t ht he
  simpa only [he,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,sub_nonneg] using ht

name: indL2_weak_L1
stmt: {A : ℕ → Set Y} (hA : ∀n,MeasurableSet (A n)) {B : Set Y} (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hw : ∀v : RealL2 μ,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪indL2 (A n) (hA n),v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪indL2 B hB,v⟫)) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫t,‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-B.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  have hone (w : RealL2 μ) : ⟪w,oneL2 μ⟫=∫t,w t ∂μ := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    simpa only [oneL2,setIntegral_univ] using
      L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one MeasurableSet.univ (measure_ne_top μ univ) w
  have hBB : ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,indL2 B hB⟫=⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫ := by
    rw [hone,L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) B hB] with t ht
    rw [ht]
    by_cases hb : t∈B <;> simp [hb]
  have he (n : ℕ) : (∫t,‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-B.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂μ) =
      ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),oneL2 μ⟫+⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫-
      2*⟪indL2 (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),indL2 (μ := μ) B hB⟫ := by
    rw [hone,hone,L2.inner_def,← integral_const_mul,← integral_add,
      ← integral_sub]
    · apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),indL2_ae (μ := μ) B hB] with t ht hu
      rw [ht,hu]
      by_cases ha : t∈A n <;> by_cases hb : t∈B <;> norm_num [ha,hb]
    · exact ((Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)).add ((Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num))
    · exact (L2.integrable_inner _ _).const_mul 2
    · exact (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
    · exact (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
  simp_rw [he]
  have ht := ((hw (oneL2 μ)).add_const ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫).sub
    ((hw (indL2 (μ := μ) B hB)).const_mul 2)
  rw [hBB,show ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB, oneL2 μ⟫+⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫-
    2*⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫=0 by ring] at ht
  exact ht
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourStateL2 (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : RealL2 angularMeasure :=
  indL2 {t | fourState c hc x t=s} (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const)

name: four_weak_limit_identify
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y) (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) {f : Fin 3 → RealL2 angularMeasure} (hf : ∀s v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪f s,v⟫)) (b : ℕ → Fin 4 → TraceVector 5) (a : Fin 4 → TraceVector 5) (hb : ∀n e,IsTrace c hc (x n) (b n e)) (hz : ∀n e,∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue (b n e) i=0) (ht : ∀e,Tendsto (fun n => b n e) atTop (𝓝 (a e))) : ∀s,f s=fourStateL2 c hc y s
body:
:= by
  have hat (e : Fin 4) : IsTrace c hc y (a e) := trace_limit c hc (fun n => hb n e) hxt (ht e)
  have hdom (s : Fin 3) (i : Fin 5) (hi : i∈fourGroup s) :
      f s≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] (∑e,traceValue (a e) i : RealL2 angularMeasure) := by
    apply weak_limit_le (hf s) (f := fun n => fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s)
      (g := fun n => ∑e,traceValue (b n e) i)
      (fun v => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
    · simpa only [sum_inner] using tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ
        (fun e _ => traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp (ht e) i v)
    · filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc (x n) t=s}
        (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)) measurable_const),
        Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun e => traceValue (b n e) i),
        four_state_trace_domination c hc hw (hx n) (b n) (hb n) (hz n) s hi] with t h₁ h₂ h₃
      simpa only [fourStateL2,h₁,h₂] using h₃
  have hnon (s : Fin 3) : 0≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] f s :=
    weak_limit_nonneg angularMeasure (hf s) (fun n => indL2_nonneg _ _)
  have hsumf : ∑s,f s=oneL2 angularMeasure :=
    weak_limit_sum angularMeasure hf (fun n => indL2_sum (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)))
  have hsupport (s : Fin 3) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,0<f s t → fourGroup s⊆palette c hc y t := by
    have hdom' (i : Fin 5) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,i∈fourGroup s → f s t≤∑e,traceValue (a e) i t := by
      by_cases hi : i∈fourGroup s
      · filter_upwards [hdom s i hi,Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun e => traceValue (a e) i)] with t ht he
        exact fun _ => by simpa only [he] using ht
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h => (hi h).elim
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hdom',
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc y i ⟨a e,hat e⟩)] with t hdom hpal hp i hi
    have hsum : 0<∑e,traceValue (a e) i t := hp.trans_le (hdom i hi)
    have hex : ∃e,0<traceValue (a e) i t := by
      by_contra! hh
      exact hsum.not_ge (Finset.sum_nonpos fun e _ => hh e)
    obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := hex
    exact (mem_palette c hc y t i).mpr (hpal e i he)
  intro s
  apply Lp.ext
  have hsumae : (fun t => ∑s,f s t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ f
    rw [hsumf] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hnon,ae_all_iff.mpr hsupport,hsumae,
    four_palette_admissible c hc hw hy,
    indL2_ae (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc y t=s}
      (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const)] with t hn hp hsum hadm hi
  change f s t=indL2 (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc y t=s} _ t
  rw [hi]
  have hz (v : Fin 3) (hv : v≠fourState c hc y t) : f v t=0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (hn v)
    by_contra! hh
    have he := (four_admissible_character (palette c hc y t) hadm v).mp (hp v hh)
    exact hv he.symm
  by_cases he : fourState c hc y t=s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t∈{t | fourState c hc y t=s} from he)]
    rw [← hsum,Finset.sum_eq_single s _ (by simp)]
    intro v _ hvs
    exact hz v (by simpa only [he] using hvs)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t∉{t | fourState c hc y t=s} from he)]
    exact hz s (Ne.symm he)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourStateDistance (x y : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  ∫t,‖{t | fourState c hc x t=s}.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-
    {t | fourState c hc y t=s}.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂angularMeasure

name: four_state_subseq_continuity
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y) (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) : ∃φ : ℕ → ℕ,StrictMono φ ∧ ∀s,Tendsto (fun n => fourStateDistance c hc (x (φ n)) y s) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,φ,hφ,_,hf⟩ := exists_finite_weak_subseq (fun n s => fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s) 1
    (fun _ _ => indL2_norm _ _)
  choose b hb hz using fun n => four_avoiding_traces c hc hw (hx (φ n))
  obtain ⟨a,_,ψ,hψ,ha⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (univ : Set (Fin 4 → TraceVector 5))).isSeqCompact
    (fun n => mem_univ (b n))
  have hid := four_weak_limit_identify c hc hw (fun n => hx (φ (ψ n))) hy
    (hxt.comp (hφ.tendsto_atTop.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop))
    (fun s v => (hf s v).comp hψ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => b (ψ n)) a
    (fun n => hb (ψ n)) (fun n => hz (ψ n))
    (fun e => (continuous_apply e).tendsto a |>.comp ha)
  refine ⟨φ∘ψ,hφ.comp hψ,?_⟩
  intro s
  apply indL2_weak_L1 (fun n => measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x (φ (ψ n)))) measurable_const)
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const)
  intro v
  have hh := (hf s v).comp hψ.tendsto_atTop
  rw [hid s] at hh
  exact hh

name: four_state_continuity
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y) (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) (s : Fin 3) : Tendsto (fun n => fourStateDistance c hc (x n) y s) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hn
  push Not at hn
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,he⟩ := hn
  choose m hm using he
  have hmt : Tendsto m atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => (hm n).1) tendsto_id
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,ht⟩ := four_state_subseq_continuity c hc hw (fun n => hx (m n)) hy (hxt.comp hmt)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (ht s) ε hε
  exact (hm (φ N)).2.not_gt (hN N le_rfl)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: angleMk_compact_bound
stmt: {E : Set ℝ} (hE : IsCompact E) : ∃ C : ℝ≥0, (volume.restrict E).map ((↑) : ℝ → Angles)≤(C:ENNReal) • angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := hE.elim_finite_subcover (fun a : ℝ => Ioo (a-Real.pi) (a+Real.pi))
    (fun _ => isOpen_Ioo) (fun a _ => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a,by constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩)
  let C : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(F.card:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi),by positivity⟩
  refine ⟨C,Measure.le_iff.mpr (fun A hA => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hA,
    Measure.restrict_apply (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hA),Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  have hsub : ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩E ⊆
      ⋃a∈F,((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨a,ha,h₁,h₂⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hF ht.2)
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a,ha,ht.1,h₁,by linarith⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ volume (⋃a∈F,((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi)) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑a∈F,volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi)) := measure_biUnion_finset_le F _
    _ = ∑_a∈F,(volume : Measure Angles) A := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      exact (AddCircle.add_projection_respects_measure (2*Real.pi) (a-Real.pi) hA).symm
    _ = (C:ENNReal)*angularMeasure A := by
      rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle]
      simp only [Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]
      change (F.card:ENNReal)*(ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi)*angularMeasure A)=_
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [show (C:ENNReal)=ENNReal.ofReal ((F.card:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)) from ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal.symm]
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0≤(F.card:ℝ)),ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]

name: angular_compact_L1
stmt: {f : ℕ → Angles → ℝ} {g : Angles → ℝ} (hf : ∀n,Integrable (f n) angularMeasure) (hg : Integrable g angularMeasure) (ht : Tendsto (fun n => ∫t,‖f n t-g t‖ ∂angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 0)) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : IsCompact E) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫t in E,‖f n (t : Angles)-g (t : Angles)‖) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := angleMk_compact_bound hE
  apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    (fun n => integral_norm_comp_le angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hC ((hf n).sub hg))
  simpa only [mul_zero,Pi.sub_apply] using ht.const_mul (C:ℝ)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: support_lower_semicontinuity
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {B : ℕ → Set ℝ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : ∀n,MeasurableSet (B n)) (ht : ∀E : Set ℝ,IsCompact E → Tendsto (fun n => ∫t in E,‖(B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0)) {b : ℝ} (hb : b∈(volume.restrict A).support) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : ∀ᶠn in atTop,∃v∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support,dist v b<ε
body:
:= by
  let E := Metric.closedBall b (ε/2)
  have hp : 0<(volume.restrict E) A := by
    have hh := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall b).mp hb (Metric.ball b (ε/2))
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds b (by positivity))
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball] at hh
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply hA]
    apply hh.trans_le (measure_mono _)
    exact fun t ht => ⟨ht.2,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall ht.1⟩
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict E) := ⟨by simpa [E] using (isCompact_closedBall b (ε/2)).measure_lt_top (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ))⟩
  have hpos := indicator_inter_positive (μ := volume.restrict E) hA hB (fun _ => hA) hp
    (ht E (isCompact_closedBall _ _)) (by simp)
  filter_upwards [hpos] with n hn
  have hpB : (volume.restrict (B n)) E≠0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_closedBall]
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply ((hB n).inter hA)] at hn
    exact hn.trans_le (measure_mono (fun t ht => ⟨ht.2,ht.1.1⟩))
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hs⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpB (ae_restrict_of_ae (volume.restrict (B n)).support_mem_ae)
  exact ⟨v,hs,(show dist v b≤ε/2 from hv).trans_lt (by linarith)⟩

name: support_sequence_continuity
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {B : ℕ → Set ℝ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : ∀n,MeasurableSet (B n)) (hpB : ∀n,0<volume (B n)) (ht : ∀E : Set ℝ,IsCompact E → Tendsto (fun n => ∫t in E,‖(B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0)) {b : ℝ} (hb : b∈(volume.restrict A).support) : ∃v : ℕ → ℝ,(∀n,v n∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support) ∧ Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 b)
body:
:= by
  have hne (n : ℕ) : (volume.restrict (B n)).support.Nonempty := by
    apply Measure.nonempty_support
    intro he
    have hz := congrArg (fun μ : Measure ℝ => μ univ) he
    exact (hpB n).ne' (by simpa using hz)
  choose v hv hd using fun n => (volume.restrict (B n)).isClosed_support.exists_infDist_eq_dist (hne n) b
  refine ⟨v,hv,Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (support_lower_semicontinuity hA hB ht hb hε)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w,hw,hwb⟩ := hN n hn
  rw [dist_comm,← hd n]
  exact (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hw).trans_lt (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hwb)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: strict_state_uniform_on_compact
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℕ → ℂ) (J K : Finset (Fin k)) (X : Fin k) (hlabels : ∀i, i∉J∪K ↔ i=X) (A B : ℕ → Set ℝ) (D : Set ℝ) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hp : 0<volume D) (hA : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (A n) J) (hB : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (B n) K) (hL1 : ∀ E : Set ℝ, IsCompact E → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ v in E, ‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v-D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v‖) atTop (𝓝 0)) {C : Set ℝ} (hC : IsCompact C) : ∃ ε>0, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀b∈C, ∀d∈C, b∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support → d∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support → ε≤|‖direction (b : Angles)-direction (d : Angles)‖-1|
body:
:= by
  by_contra! hbad
  have hex (N : ℕ) : ∃ n≥N, ∃ b∈C, ∃ d∈C,
      b∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support ∧ d∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support ∧
      |‖direction (b : Angles)-direction (d : Angles)‖-1|<1/(N+1) := by
    have hh := hbad (1/((N:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity)
    simpa only [and_assoc] using (frequently_atTop.mp hh) N
  choose f hf b hb d hd hbs hds hsmall using hex
  have hft : Tendsto f atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono hf tendsto_id
  obtain ⟨q,_hq,φ,hφ,hqt⟩ := (hC.prod hC).isSeqCompact
    (fun n => show (b n,d n)∈C×ˢC from ⟨hb n,hd n⟩)
  have hqb : Tendsto (b∘φ) atTop (𝓝 q.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto q).comp hqt
  have hqd : Tendsto (d∘φ) atTop (𝓝 q.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto q).comp hqt
  have hdir : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => direction (v : Angles)) :=
    direction_continuous.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi))
  have he : ‖direction (q.1 : Angles)-direction (q.2 : Angles)‖=1 := by
    have hn : Tendsto (fun N => |‖direction (b N : Angles)-direction (d N : Angles)‖-1|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun N => (hsmall N).le)
        tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have hl := (((hdir.tendsto q.1).comp hqb).sub ((hdir.tendsto q.2).comp hqd)).norm.sub_const 1 |>.abs
    have he := tendsto_nhds_unique hl (hn.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp he)
  apply strict_state_sequence_false hc hw (fun n => x (f (φ n))) J K X hlabels
    (fun n => A (f (φ n))) (fun n => B (f (φ n))) D hD hp
    (fun n => hA (f (φ n))) (fun n => hB (f (φ n)))
    (b∘φ) (d∘φ) q.1 q.2 hqb hqd (fun n => hbs (φ n)) (fun n => hds (φ n)) he
  intro E hE
  exact (hL1 E hE).comp (hft.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: angle_preimage_positive
stmt: {A : Set Angles} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hp : 0<angularMeasure A) : 0<volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A)
body:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  have hz := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∉A := ae_angular_of_ae_line hA.compl hz
  exact hp.ne' (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr ha)
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourRealState (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set ℝ := {t | fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s}

name: four_realState_measurable
stmt: (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : MeasurableSet (fourRealState c hc x s)

name: four_realState_continuity
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y) (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) (s : Fin 3) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : IsCompact E) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫t in E,‖(fourRealState c hc (x n) s).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t- (fourRealState c hc y s).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  exact angular_compact_L1
    (fun n => (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)) measurable_const))
    ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const))
    (four_state_continuity c hc hw hx hy hxt s) hE

name: four_support_continuity
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y) (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {b : ℝ} (hb : b∈fourSupport c hc y s) : ∃v : ℕ → ℝ,(∀n,v n∈fourSupport c hc (x n) s) ∧ Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 b)
body:
:=
  support_sequence_continuity (four_realState_measurable c hc y s)
    (fun n => four_realState_measurable c hc (x n) s)
    (fun n => four_realState_positive c hc hw (hx n) hs)
    (fun _ hE => four_realState_continuity c hc hw hx hy hxt s hE) hb

name: four_support_sequence_no_unit
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y) (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {b d : ℕ → ℝ} {b₀ d₀ : ℝ} (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 b₀)) (hd : Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 d₀)) (hbs : ∀n,b n∈fourSupport c hc (x n) s) (hds : ∀n,d n∈fourSupport c hc (x n) s) : ‖direction (b₀ : Angles)-direction (d₀ : Angles)‖≠1
body:
:= by
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 := by dsimp [r]; split <;> decide
  have hl : ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup r∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1)∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 from by decide) s hs
  intro hu
  exact strict_state_sequence_false hc hw x (fourGroup r) (fourGroup s) 4 hl
    (fun n => fourRealState c hc (x n) r) (fun n => fourRealState c hc (x n) s)
    (fourRealState c hc y r) (four_realState_measurable c hc y r)
    (four_realState_positive c hc hw hy hr)
    (fun n => fourState_represents c hc hw (hx n) r) (fun n => fourState_represents c hc hw (hx n) s)
    b d b₀ d₀ hb hd hbs hds hu (fun _ hE => four_realState_continuity c hc hw hx hy hxt r hE)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: plane_antilipschitz_qmp
stmt: {F : RealPlane → RealPlane} (hF : Measurable F) {V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict F)) : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving F (volume.restrict V) volume
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨hF,?_⟩
  have hh := map_restrict_volume_le hF MeasurableSet.univ hK (mapsTo_univ F V)
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at hh
  exact Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le_smul hh

name: support_prod_real
stmt: {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] {a b : ℝ} (ha : a∈μ.support) (hb : b∈ν.support) : (a,b)∈(μ.prod ν).support
body:
:= by
  apply (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨I,hI,J,hJ,hIJ⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hS
  apply (ENNReal.mul_pos ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mp ha I hI).ne'
    ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mp hb J hJ).ne').trans_le
  rw [← Measure.prod_prod]
  exact measure_mono hIJ

name: continuousAt_maps_support_closed
stmt: {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {F : X → Y} {C : Set Y} {p : X} (hp : p∈μ.support) (hF : ContinuousAt F p) (hC : IsClosed C) (hae : ∀ᵐq∂μ,F q∈C) : F p∈C
body:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hh : {q | F q∉C}∈𝓝 p := hF (hC.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hnot)
  exact ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mp hp _ hh).ne' hae

name: state_support_transport
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x y : ℂ} {A B C : Set ℝ} {J K : Finset (Fin k)} {X : Fin k} (hA : RealState hc x A J) (hB : RealState hc x B K) (hC : RealState hc y C {X}) (hlabels : ∀i,i∉J∪K ↔ i=X) {a b : ℝ} (ha : a∈(volume.restrict A).support) (hb : b∈(volume.restrict B).support) {F : RealPlane → RealPlane} (hF : Measurable F) (hFc : ContinuousAt F (a,b)) {V : Set RealPlane} (hV : IsOpen V) (hab : (a,b)∈V) {L : ℝ≥0} (hL : AntilipschitzWith L (V.domRestrict F)) (hi : ∀q∈V,Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0) (ho : ∀q∈V,Real.sin ((F q).2-(F q).1)≠0) (heq : ∀q∈V,angularSum x 1 (angleChart q)=angularSum y 1 (angleChart (F q))) : F (a,b)∈(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support ×ˢ (volume.restrict Cᶜ).support
body:
:= by
  have hdA : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.1∈A → LineDensityZero Aᶜ q.1 := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae (ae_lineDensityZero_compl hA.1)
  have hdB : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.2∈B → LineDensityZero Bᶜ q.2 := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae (ae_lineDensityZero_compl hB.1)
  have hdC : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∉(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support → LineDensityZero Cᶜ t := by
    have hs : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈Cᶜ → t∈(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support := by
      exact (ae_restrict_iff' hC.1.compl).mp (volume.restrict Cᶜ).support_mem_ae
    filter_upwards [hs,ae_lineDensityZero_compl hC.1] with t ht hd hn
    apply hd
    by_contra htC
    exact hn (ht htC)
  have hdpair : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,
      (q.1∉(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support → LineDensityZero Cᶜ q.1) ∧
      (q.2∉(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support → LineDensityZero Cᶜ q.2) := by
    have h₁ := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae hdC
    have h₂ := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae hdC
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using h₁.and h₂
  have hforced : ∀ᵐq∂volume.restrict V,q∈A×ˢB →
      F q∈(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support ×ˢ (volume.restrict Cᶜ).support := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae hdA,ae_restrict_of_ae hdB,
      (plane_antilipschitz_qmp hF hL).ae hdpair,ae_restrict_mem hV.measurableSet] with q hqa hqb hqc hq hAB
    have hOne : DensityOne {z | c z=X} (angularSum x 1 (angleChart q)) := by
      simpa only [hlabels] using states_densityOne hc hw hA hB (hqa hAB.1) (hqb hAB.2) (hi q hq)
    have hnot (hZero : DensityZero {z | c z=X} (angularSum y 1 (angleChart (F q)))) : False := by
      rw [heq q hq] at hOne
      have hh := tendsto_nhds_unique hOne hZero
      exact one_ne_zero hh
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      exact hnot (state_densityZero hc hw hC (hqc.1 hn) (ho q hq) (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
    · by_contra hn
      apply hnot
      rw [← angularSum_swap y (F q).1 (F q).2]
      apply state_densityZero hc hw hC (hqc.2 hn) _ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
      simpa only [← neg_sub (F q).2 (F q).1,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero] using ho q hq
  have hp : (a,b)∈(volume.restrict (A×ˢB)).support := by
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod,← Measure.prod_restrict]
    exact support_prod_real ha hb
  have hpV : (a,b)∈((volume.restrict (A×ˢB)).restrict V).support :=
    Measure.interior_inter_support ⟨hV.interior_eq.symm ▸ hab,hp⟩
  apply continuousAt_maps_support_closed hpV hFc
    ((volume.restrict Cᶜ).isClosed_support.prod (volume.restrict Cᶜ).isClosed_support)
  filter_upwards [hforced.filter_mono (ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self V)),
    ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem (hA.1.prod hB.1))] with q hq hAB
  exact hq hAB
end EuclideanFiveColor
