name: circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport
stmt: : LipschitzWith 2 (circleSum 1)
body:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro p q
  have hh (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g) :
      dist (g p.1+g p.2) (g q.1+g q.2)≤2*max (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2) := by
    have h1 := hg.dist_le_mul p.1 q.1
    have h2 := hg.dist_le_mul p.2 q.2
    norm_num only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul] at h1 h2
    have h3 := dist_add_add_le (g p.1) (g p.2) (g q.1) (g q.2)
    have h4 := le_max_left (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2)
    have h5 := le_max_right (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2)
    linarith
  simpa only [circleSum,one_mul,Prod.dist_eq,NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
    max_le (hh _ Real.lipschitzWith_cos) (hh _ Real.lipschitzWith_sin)

def sumTransport {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) (q : RealPlane) :=
  circleInverse h (circleSum 1 q-H)

name: sumTransport_measurable
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) : Measurable (sumTransport h H)
body:
:=
  (circleInverse_measurable h).comp ((circleSum_continuous 1).sub continuous_const).measurable

name: sumTransport_neighborhood
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) : ∃P V : Set RealPlane,IsOpen P ∧ 0∈P ∧ IsOpen V ∧ (a,b)∈V ∧ ∃K : ℝ≥0,∀H∈P, (∀q∈V,ContinuousAt (sumTransport h H) q) ∧ AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (sumTransport h H)) ∧ (∀q∈V,Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0) ∧ (∀q∈V,Real.sin ((sumTransport h H q).2-(sumTransport h H q).1)≠0) ∧ ∀q∈V,circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)=circleSum 1 q-H
body:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : RealPlane×RealPlane => circleSum 1 z.2-z.1) :=
    ((circleSum_continuous 1).comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_fst
  have hbtarget : circleSum 1 (a,b)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target :=
    (circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
  have ht : ∀ᶠ z : RealPlane×RealPlane in 𝓝 (0,(a,b)),
      circleSum 1 z.2-z.1∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧
      Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)).2-(circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)).1)≠0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun z : RealPlane×RealPlane => circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)
        (𝓝 (0,(a,b))) (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by simpa only [sub_zero] using hc.tendsto (0,(a,b))
    have htt : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b)),q∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target :=
      (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hbtarget
    exact hlim.eventually (htt.and (circleInverse_regular h))
  obtain ⟨P,hP,W,hW,hPW⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp ht
  obtain ⟨P₀,hP₀,hPsub,hPmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨W₀,hW₀,hWsub,hWmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hW
  obtain ⟨V₀,hV₀,hv₀,L,hL⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let V := W₀∩V₀∩{q : RealPlane | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0}
  have hV : IsOpen V := (hWsub.inter hV₀).inter ((Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst)).isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_ne)
  refine ⟨P₀,V,hPsub,hPmem,hV,⟨⟨hWmem,hv₀⟩,h⟩,L*2,?_⟩
  intro H hH
  have htarget (q : RealPlane) (hq : q∈V) := hPW (a := (H,q)) ⟨hP₀ hH,hW₀ hq.1.1⟩
  have heq (q : RealPlane) (hq : q∈V) : circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)=circleSum 1 q-H :=
    circleInverse_right h (htarget q hq).1
  refine ⟨?_,?_,fun _ hq => hq.2,fun q hq => (htarget q hq).2,heq⟩
  · intro q hq
    change ContinuousAt (fun z : RealPlane => circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z-H)) q
    exact (circleInverse_continuousAt h (htarget q hq).1).comp (x := q)
      (((circleSum_continuous 1).sub (continuous_const (y := H))).continuousAt)
  · apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro q r
    have hh := hL.le_mul_dist ⟨q,q.2.1.2⟩ ⟨r,r.2.1.2⟩
    have hd : dist (circleSum 1 q) (circleSum 1 r)=dist (circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)) (circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H r)) := by
      rw [heq q q.2,heq r r.2,dist_sub_right]
    change dist (q : RealPlane) (r : RealPlane) ≤ L*dist (circleSum 1 q) (circleSum 1 r) at hh
    rw [hd] at hh
    have hl := circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport.dist_le_mul (sumTransport h H q) (sumTransport h H r)
    apply hh.trans
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl L.2
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat,Set.domRestrict_apply] at *
    nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourNonSingleton (x : ℂ) : Set ℝ := fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2

name: four_complement_support
stmt: (x : ℂ) : (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 0)ᶜ).support=fourNonSingleton c hc x
body:
:= by
  have he : (fourRealState c hc x 0)ᶜ=fourRealState c hc x 1∪fourRealState c hc x 2 := by
    ext t
    change (fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠0) ↔
      fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=1 ∨ fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=2
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 ↔ s=1 ∨ s=2 from by decide) _
  have hd : Disjoint (fourRealState c hc x 1) (fourRealState c hc x 2) := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro t h1 h2
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 3)≠2) (h1.symm.trans h2)
  rw [he,Measure.restrict_union hd (four_realState_measurable c hc x 2),Measure.support_add]
  rfl

name: four_support_transport
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x y : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) (hy : FourCenter c y) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {a b : ℝ} (ha : a∈fourSupport c hc x s) (hb : b∈fourSupport c hc x (if s=1 then 2 else 1)) (hab : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) {P V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : IsOpen V) (habV : (a,b)∈V) (hbranch : ∀H∈P, (∀q∈V,ContinuousAt (sumTransport hab H) q) ∧ AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (sumTransport hab H)) ∧ (∀q∈V,Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0) ∧ (∀q∈V,Real.sin ((sumTransport hab H q).2-(sumTransport hab H q).1)≠0) ∧ ∀q∈V,circleSum 1 (sumTransport hab H q)=circleSum 1 q-H) (hxy : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (y-x)∈P) : sumTransport hab (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (y-x)) (a,b)∈ fourNonSingleton c hc y×ˢfourNonSingleton c hc y
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hct,hL,hi,ho,heq⟩ := hbranch _ hxy
  rw [← four_complement_support c hc y]
  apply state_support_transport hc hw
    (fourState_represents c hc hw hx s)
    (fourState_represents c hc hw hx (if s=1 then 2 else 1))
    (fourState_represents c hc hw hy 0)
    ((show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup s∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1) ↔ i=4 from by decide) s hs)
    ha hb (sumTransport_measurable hab _) (hct _ habV) hV habV hL hi ho
  intro q hq
  rw [angularSum_chart,angularSum_chart,heq q hq,map_sub]
  congr 1
  abel
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: two_closed_shift_separated_not_cover
stmt: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [PreconnectedSpace X] {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (ha : A.Nonempty) (hb : B.Nonempty) (R : X → X) (hRA : ∀x∈A,R x∉A) (hRB : ∀x∈B,R x∉B) : A∪B≠univ
body:
:= by
  intro hcov
  obtain ⟨x,_,hxA,hxB⟩ := isPreconnected_closed_iff.mp isPreconnected_univ A B hA hB
    (by rw [hcov]) (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using hb)
  have hm : R x∈A∪B := hcov.symm ▸ mem_univ _
  exact hm.elim (hRA x hxA) (hRB x hxB)

name: closed_gap
stmt: {N : Set ℝ} (hN : IsClosed N) {z l r : ℝ} (hz : z∉N) (hl : l∈N) (hr : r∈N) (hlz : l<z) (hzr : z<r) : ∃a b : ℝ,a∈N ∧ b∈N ∧ a<z ∧ z<b ∧ Ioo a b⊆Nᶜ
body:
:= by
  have hLC : IsCompact (N∩Icc l z) := isCompact_Icc.inter_left hN
  have hRC : IsCompact (N∩Icc z r) := isCompact_Icc.inter_left hN
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ham⟩ := hLC.exists_isMaxOn (f := id) ⟨l,hl,le_rfl,hlz.le⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbm⟩ := hRC.exists_isMinOn (f := id) ⟨r,hr,hzr.le,le_rfl⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  have haz : a<z := lt_of_le_of_ne ha.2.2 (fun he => hz (he ▸ ha.1))
  have hzb : z<b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.1 (fun he => hz (he.symm ▸ hb.1))
  refine ⟨a,b,ha.1,hb.1,haz,hzb,?_⟩
  intro t ht hn
  by_cases htz : t≤z
  · have hta : t≤a := ham ⟨hn,ha.2.1.trans ht.1.le,htz⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hta) ht.1
  · have hbt : b≤t := hbm ⟨hn,(not_le.mp htz).le,ht.2.le.trans hb.2.2⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbt) ht.2

name: positive_normalized_increment_enters_gap
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (hab : a<b) {u δ : ℕ → ℝ} {v : ℝ} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hv : 0<v) (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a)) (hs : Tendsto (fun n => (u n-a)/δ n) atTop (𝓝 v)) : ∀ᶠn in atTop,u n∈Ioo a b
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hu.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hab),hs.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hv)] with n hn hp
  exact ⟨sub_pos.mp ((div_pos_iff.mp hp).resolve_right (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge (hδ n).le) h.2)).1,hn⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: direction_sixty_unit_real
stmt: (a : ℝ) : ‖direction (a : Angles)-direction ((a+sixty : ℝ) : Angles)‖=1
body:
:= by
  have he : direction (a : Angles)=direction ((a+sixty : ℝ) : Angles)+direction ((a-sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
    apply Complex.equivRealProdCLM.injective
    simpa only [map_add,direction_realPlane,circleTarget,samplingParameter,sub_self,map_zero,one_smul,zero_add,circleSum,one_mul,Prod.mk_add_mk] using sixty_sum (0:ℂ) a
  rw [he,add_sub_cancel_left,direction_norm]
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)

name: four_support_nonempty
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) : (fourSupport c hc x s).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  apply Measure.nonempty_support
  intro hz
  have hh := congrArg (fun μ : Measure ℝ => μ univ) hz
  simp only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ,Measure.coe_zero,Pi.zero_apply] at hh
  exact (four_realState_positive c hc hw hx hs).ne' hh

name: four_support_no_sixty
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {a : ℝ} (ha : a∈fourSupport c hc x s) : a+sixty∉fourSupport c hc x s
body:
:= by
  intro hb
  exact four_support_sequence_no_unit c hc hw (fun _ => hx) hx tendsto_const_nhds hs
    tendsto_const_nhds tendsto_const_nhds (fun _ => ha) (fun _ => hb) (direction_sixty_unit_real a)

name: four_support_union_proper
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) : fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2≠univ
body:
:=
  two_closed_shift_separated_not_cover Measure.isClosed_support Measure.isClosed_support
    (four_support_nonempty c hc hw hx (by decide)) (four_support_nonempty c hc hw hx (by decide))
    (fun a => a+sixty) (fun _ ha => four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx (by decide) ha)
    (fun _ ha => four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx (by decide) ha)

name: four_outside_support_state
stmt: (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∉fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 → fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0
body:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈fourRealState c hc x 1 → t∈fourSupport c hc x 1 :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x 1)).mp (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 1)).support_mem_ae
  have h2 : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈fourRealState c hc x 2 → t∈fourSupport c hc x 2 :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x 2)).mp (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 2)).support_mem_ae
  filter_upwards [h1,h2] with t ht1 ht2 hn
  have hn1 : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠1 := fun he => hn (Or.inl (ht1 he))
  have hn2 : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠2 := fun he => hn (Or.inr (ht2 he))
  exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠1 → s≠2 → s=0 from by decide) _ hn1 hn2

name: four_gap_length
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) {a b : ℝ} (hgap : Ioo a b⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ) : b-a ≤ sixty
body:
:= by
  by_contra! hab
  have hp : 0<volume (Ioo a (b-sixty)) := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have h0 := four_outside_support_state c hc x
  have hshift := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) sixty).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h0
  have hneq := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_changes c hc hw hx)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,ht0,hts,htn⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hp.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae (h0.and (hshift.and hneq)))
  have hκ : 0<sixty := by dsimp [sixty]; positivity
  have he0 := ht0 (hgap ⟨ht.1,by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
  have he1 := hts (hgap ⟨by linarith [ht.1],by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
  apply htn
  simpa only [sixty,AddCircle.coe_add,he0] using he1.symm

name: four_gap_exists
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) : ∃a b : ℝ,a∈fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 ∧ b∈fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 ∧ a<b ∧ b-a ≤ sixty ∧ Ioo a b⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ
body:
:= by
  let N := fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2
  have hN : IsClosed N := Measure.isClosed_support.union Measure.isClosed_support
  have hex : ∃z : ℝ,z∉N := by
    by_contra! h
    exact four_support_union_proper c hc hw hx (Set.eq_univ_of_forall h)
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hex
  have hκ : 0<sixty := by dsimp [sixty]; positivity
  have hn (a b : ℝ) (hab : sixty<b-a) : ∃t∈Ioo a b,t∈N := by
    by_contra! hbad
    have hle := four_gap_length c hc hw hx hbad
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hab
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hlN⟩ := hn (z-sixty-1) z (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hrN⟩ := hn z (z+sixty+1) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,haz,hzb,hgap⟩ := closed_gap hN hz hlN hrN hl.2 hr.1
  exact ⟨a,b,ha,hb,haz.trans hzb,four_gap_length c hc hw hx hgap,hgap⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: open_subset_closed_of_ae
stmt: {U N : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hN : IsClosed N) (h : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈U → t∈N) : U⊆N
body:
:= by
  apply Set.sdiff_eq_empty.mp
  apply (hU.sdiff hN).eq_empty_of_measure_zero (μ := volume)
  apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht htn
  exact htn.2 (ht htn.1)
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)

name: four_gap_shift_subset
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a<b) (hgap : Ioo a b⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ) : Icc (a+sixty) (b+sixty)⊆fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2
body:
:= by
  have hN : IsClosed (fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2) :=
    Measure.isClosed_support.union Measure.isClosed_support
  have hs : Ioo (a+sixty) (b+sixty)⊆fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 := by
    apply open_subset_closed_of_ae isOpen_Ioo hN
    have h0 := four_outside_support_state c hc x
    have hneq : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠fourState c hc x ((t+sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
      simpa only [AddCircle.coe_add,sixty] using angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_changes c hc hw hx)
    have hm := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) (-sixty)).quasiMeasurePreserving
    filter_upwards [h0,hm.ae h0,hm.ae hneq] with t ht htm htn htI
    by_contra hn
    have he0 := ht hn
    have hem := htm (hgap ⟨by linarith [htI.1],by linarith [htI.2]⟩)
    apply htn
    simp only [neg_add_cancel_right,he0,hem]
  have hz := closure_minimal hs hN
  rwa [closure_Ioo (by linarith : a+sixty≠b+sixty)] at hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: strict_increment_limit
stmt: {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {L : E →L[ℝ] F} {p : E} (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f L p) {u v : ℕ → E} {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {w : E} (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 p)) (hv : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 p)) (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hw : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹ • (u n-v n)) atTop (𝓝 w)) : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹ • (f (u n)-f (v n))) atTop (𝓝 (L w))
body:
:= by
  have hb : (fun n => u n-v n) =O[atTop] δ := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound (‖w‖+1)
    filter_upwards [hw.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (lt_add_one ‖w‖))] with n hn
    rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_inv,abs_of_pos (hδ n)] at hn
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hδ n)]
    exact ((inv_mul_lt_iff₀ (hδ n)).mp hn).le.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  have ho : (fun n => f (u n)-f (v n)-L (u n-v n)) =o[atTop] δ :=
    (hf.isLittleO.comp_tendsto (hu.prodMk_nhds hv)).trans_isBigO hb
  have hz := ho.tendsto_inv_smul_nhds_zero
  have hl := L.continuous.tendsto w |>.comp hw
  have hh := hz.add hl
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,map_smul,smul_sub,map_sub,sub_add_cancel,zero_add] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def transportVelocity (H : RealPlane) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b)/Real.sin (b-a)

name: circleInverseDeriv_fst
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) : ((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm (-H)).1= transportVelocity H a b
body:
:= by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let q := L.symm (-H)
  have he : circleSumDeriv 1 (a,b) q = -H := L.apply_symm_apply (-H)
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd he
  change 1*(-Real.sin a*q.1)+(-Real.sin b)*q.2= -H.1 at h1
  change 1*(Real.cos a*q.1)+Real.cos b*q.2= -H.2 at h2
  change q.1= -(H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b)/Real.sin (b-a)
  apply (eq_div_iff h).mpr
  rw [Real.sin_sub]
  linear_combination Real.cos b*h1+Real.sin b*h2

name: sumTransport_increment_limit
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) {Hn q : ℕ → RealPlane} {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane} (hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0)) (hq : Tendsto q atTop (𝓝 (a,b))) (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Hn n) atTop (𝓝 H)) : Tendsto (fun n => ((sumTransport h (Hn n) (q n)).1-(q n).1)/δ n) atTop (𝓝 (transportVelocity H a b))
body:
:= by
  have hv : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) :=
    ((circleSum_continuous 1).tendsto (a,b)).comp hq
  have hu : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hv.sub hH
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•((circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n)-circleSum 1 (q n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (-H)) := by
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel_left,smul_neg] using hdir.neg
  have hh := strict_increment_limit (circleInverse_strict h) hu hv hδ hdiff
  have hid : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (q n))=q n := by
    have hb : (a,b)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).source :=
      (circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    filter_upwards [hq.eventually ((circleInverseHomeo h).open_source.mem_nhds hb)] with n hn
    have ht : circleSum 1 (q n)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target := (circleInverseHomeo h).map_source hn
    rw [circleInverse_eq h ht]
    exact (circleInverseHomeo h).left_inv hn
  have hf := hh.fst_nhds
  simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hf
  rw [circleInverseDeriv_fst h H] at hf
  apply hf.congr'
  filter_upwards [hid] with n hn
  simp only [hn,div_eq_inv_mul,sumTransport]
  rfl

name: sumTransport_tendsto
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) {Hn q : ℕ → RealPlane} (hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0)) (hq : Tendsto q atTop (𝓝 (a,b))) : Tendsto (fun n => sumTransport h (Hn n) (q n)) atTop (𝓝 (a,b))
body:
:= by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero,Function.comp_def] using (((circleSum_continuous 1).tendsto (a,b)).comp hq).sub hH
  have hi := (circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  simpa only [sub_zero,circleInverse_at,sumTransport,Function.comp_def] using hi

name: transportVelocity_neg
stmt: (H : RealPlane) (a b : ℝ) : transportVelocity (-H) a b= -transportVelocity H a b
body:
:= by
  simp only [transportVelocity,Prod.fst_neg,Prod.snd_neg]
  ring

name: sumTransport_double_increment
stmt: {a b b' : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (h' : Real.sin (b'-a)≠0) {Hn : ℕ → RealPlane} {δ bn : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane} (hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0)) (hb : Tendsto bn atTop (𝓝 b')) (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Hn n) atTop (𝓝 H)) : Tendsto (fun n => ((sumTransport h' (-Hn n) ((sumTransport h (Hn n) (a,b)).1,bn n)).1-a)/δ n) atTop (𝓝 (transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b'))
body:
:= by
  have hct := sumTransport_tendsto h hH tendsto_const_nhds
  have hf := sumTransport_increment_limit h hH tendsto_const_nhds hδ hdir
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n => -Hn n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hH.neg
  have hnd : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•(-Hn n)) atTop (𝓝 (-H)) := by
    simpa only [smul_neg] using hdir.neg
  have hr := sumTransport_increment_limit h' hn (hct.fst_nhds.prodMk_nhds hb) hδ hnd
  have hh := hr.add hf
  rw [transportVelocity_neg] at hh
  convert hh using 1
  · funext n
    dsimp
    ring
  · ring_nf
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_angular_nonparallel
stmt: (a : ℝ) : ∀ᵐb : ℝ∂volume,Real.sin (b-a)≠0
body:
:= by
  have hs : {b : ℝ | Real.sin (b-a)=0}⊆Set.range (fun n : ℤ => a+n*Real.pi) := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hb
    exact ⟨n,by linarith⟩
  rw [ae_iff]
  simpa only [not_not] using measure_mono_null hs ((countable_range _).measure_zero volume)

name: transportVelocity_ne
stmt: {H : RealPlane} {a b b' : ℝ} (ha : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0) (hb : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (hb' : Real.sin (b'-a)≠0) (hbb : Real.sin (b'-b)≠0) : transportVelocity H a b≠transportVelocity H a b'
body:
:= by
  intro he
  have hq := (div_eq_div_iff hb hb').mp he
  have hz : (H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a)*Real.sin (b'-b)=0 := by
    simp only [Real.sin_sub] at hq ⊢
    linear_combination -hq
  exact mul_ne_zero ha hbb hz

name: exists_transportVelocity_lt
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} (hA : 0<volume A) {H : RealPlane} {a : ℝ} (ha : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0) : ∃b∈A,∃b'∈A,Real.sin (b-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (b'-a)≠0 ∧ transportVelocity H a b<transportVelocity H a b'
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hba⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hA.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_angular_nonparallel a))
  obtain ⟨b',hb',hba',hbb⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hA.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae ((ae_angular_nonparallel a).and (ae_angular_nonparallel b)))
  rcases (transportVelocity_ne ha hba hba' hbb).lt_or_gt with hlt | hgt
  · exact ⟨b,hb,b',hb',hba,hba',hlt⟩
  · exact ⟨b',hb',b,hb,hba',hba,hgt⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: eventually_forest_of_bridges
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0<ρ) (D : ℕ → SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) {r ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n) {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hbridge : ∀n i j,(D n).Adj i j → ∃K : NonemptyCompacts ℂ, (K : Set ℂ)⊆Metric.closedBall x ρ ∧ IsPreconnected (K : Set ℂ) ∧ (∃a∈K,dist a x≤r n) ∧ ((K : Set ℂ)∩Metric.sphere x ρ).Nonempty ∧ (∀q∈K,q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) i q) ∧ (∀q∈K,q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) j q)) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(D n).IsAcyclic
body:
:= by
  have he : ∀i j : Fin 5,∀ᶠ n in atTop,(D n).Adj i j → CommonInterface c x i j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hcommon : CommonInterface c x i j
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ => hcommon
    · have hn : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,¬(D n).Adj i j := by
        by_contra hnot
        have hfreq : ∃ᶠ n in atTop,(D n).Adj i j := hnot
        obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hφD⟩ := subseq_forall_of_frequently (x:=fun n : ℕ => n) (p:=fun n => (D n).Adj i j) tendsto_id hfreq
        choose K hK hconn ha hout hi hj using fun n => hbridge (φ n) i j (hφD n)
        choose a haK har using ha
        have halim : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 x) := by
          rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
          exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) har (hr.comp hφ)
        exact hcommon (commonInterface_of_compact_sequence hc hw hρ K hK hconn a haK halim hout
          (hε.comp hφ) (fun n => hpos (φ n)) (hE.comp hφ) (fun n => hnear (φ n)) hα i j hi hj)
      exact hn.mono fun _ hn hd => False.elim (hn hd)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,∀i j : Fin 5,(D n).Adj i j → CommonInterface c x i j :=
    eventually_all.mpr fun i => eventually_all.mpr (he i)
  filter_upwards [hall] with n hn
  exact commonInterface_graph_acyclic hc hw x (D n) hn
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: midpoint_threshold_labels
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) {q : ℂ} {i j : Fin 5} (hij : i≠j) (he : thresholdMap c ε α q=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2)) : α<diskAverage c ε i q ∧ α<diskAverage c ε j q
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply (thresholdMap_pos hc hε hα q i).mp
    rw [he]
    norm_num [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hij,hij.symm]
  · apply (thresholdMap_pos hc hε hα q j).mp
    rw [he]
    norm_num [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hij,hij.symm]

name: annulus_maps_eventually_forest
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0<R) {r ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n) {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (f : ∀n,C(planeAnnulus x (r n) R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))) (hf : ∀n z,z.val∉H n → (f n z).val=thresholdMap c (ε n) α z.val) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(crossingGraph (fun z => (f n z).val) (annulusInner x (r n) R) (annulusOuter x (r n) R)).IsAcyclic
body:
:= by
  apply eventually_forest_of_bridges hc hw hR _ hr hε hpos hE hnear hα
  intro n i j hij
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hconn,hval,hin,hout⟩ := hij.2
  let L : NonemptyCompacts ℂ := ⟨⟨Subtype.val '' K,hK.image continuous_subtype_val⟩,
    hconn.nonempty.image _⟩
  have hsub : (L : Set ℂ)⊆Metric.closedBall x R := by
    rintro q ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩
    exact z.property.1
  have hpre : IsPreconnected (L : Set ℂ) :=
    hconn.isPreconnected.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
  have hanc : ∃a∈L,dist a x≤r n := by
    obtain ⟨a,ha,har⟩ := hin
    exact ⟨a.val,⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,har.le⟩
  have hout' : ((L : Set ℂ)∩Metric.sphere x R).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a,ha,haR⟩ := hout
    exact ⟨a.val,⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,haR⟩
  refine ⟨L,hsub,hpre,hanc,hout',?_,?_⟩
  · rintro q ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ hzH
    have he : thresholdMap c (ε n) α z.val=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := (hf n z hzH).symm.trans (hval hz)
    exact (midpoint_threshold_labels hc (hpos n) hα' hij.1 he).1
  · rintro q ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ hzH
    have he : thresholdMap c (ε n) α z.val=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := (hf n z hzH).symm.trans (hval hz)
    exact (midpoint_threshold_labels hc (hpos n) hα' hij.1 he).2
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: finite_disk_paste
stmt: {Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Y] (Q : Set ℂ) (S : Finset MarkedDisk) (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)) (f : C(↥(Q \ diskHoles S),Y)) (g : ∀d : S,C(d.val.closedBall,Y)) (hb : ∀d : S,∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,∀hzQ : z.val∈Q, ∀hzS : z.val∉diskHoles S, g d ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f ⟨z.val,hzQ,hzS⟩) : ∃F : C(Q,Y),∀z : Q,∀hz : z.val∉diskHoles S,F z=f ⟨z.val,z.property,hz⟩
body:
:= by
  let Z : Option S → Set Q := fun i => match i with
    | none => {z | z.val∉diskHoles S}
    | some d => {z | z.val∈d.val.closedBall}
  have hZ : ∀i,IsClosed (Z i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact (diskHoles_open S).isClosed_compl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some d => exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hcov : ⋃i,Z i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z.val∈diskHoles S
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
      exact ⟨some ⟨d,hd⟩,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hz⟩
  let φ₀ : C(Z none,Y) := ⟨fun z => f ⟨z.val.val,z.val.property,z.property⟩,
    f.continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ₁ (d : S) : C(Z (some d),Y) := ⟨fun z => g d ⟨z.val.val,z.property⟩,
    (g d).continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(Z i,Y) := fun i => match i with | none => φ₀ | some d => φ₁ d
  have hbd (d : S) (z : Q) (h0 : z∈Z none) (h1 : z∈Z (some d)) :
      φ none ⟨z,h0⟩=φ (some d) ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    have hn : z.val∉d.val.ball := fun hz => h0 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨d.val,d.property,hz⟩)
    have hs : z.val∈Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius :=
      le_antisymm h1 (le_of_not_gt hn)
    exact (hb d ⟨z.val,hs⟩ z.property h0).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some d => exact hbd d z hi hj
    | some d =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hbd d z hj hi).symm
      | some e =>
        by_cases hde : d=e
        · subst e; rfl
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis d.property e.property
            (fun he => hde (Subtype.ext he))) hi hj)
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  exact closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=none) ⟨z,hz⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def annulusMap {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R)
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) {x : ℂ} (hx : x∈activeCenters L) :
    C(planeAnnulus x (2*t) R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))) :=
  ⟨fun z => a.map ⟨z.val,a.annulus_in_domain hR htR hsep hx z.property⟩,

name: fill_cores
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R) (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) (hforest : ∀x (hx : x∈activeCenters L), (crossingGraph (fun z => (a.annulusMap hR htR hsep hx z).val) (annulusInner x (2*t) R) (annulusOuter x (2*t) R)).IsAcyclic) : ∃F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))), ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles a.disks → z.val∉diskHoles (centerDisks (activeCenters L) R) → (F z).val=thresholdMap c a.ε α z.val
body:
:= by
  let D := centerDisks (activeCenters L) R
  have hdis : (D : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) :=
    centerDisks_disjoint fun x hx y hy hxy => hsep x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1 y (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1 hxy
  let f : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 \ diskHoles D),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))) :=
    ⟨fun z => a.map ⟨z.val,a.outside_centers_in_domain htR (htR.trans hR) z.property⟩,
      a.map.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)⟩
  have hex (d : D) : ∃g : C(d.val.closedBall,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,∀hzQ : z.val∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,
        ∀hzD : z.val∉diskHoles D,
        g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f ⟨z.val,hzQ,hzD⟩ := by
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := d
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := annulus_forest_extension htR (a.annulusMap hR htR hsep hx) (hforest x hx)
    exact ⟨g,fun z _ _ => hg z⟩
  choose g hg using hex
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := finite_disk_paste (Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) D hdis f g hg
  refine ⟨F,fun z hzS hzD => ?_⟩
  rw [hF z hzD]
  exact a.agrees _ hzS

name: eventually_fill_cores
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {α R : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) (hR0 : 0<R) (hR : R<1) (htR : ∀n,2*t n<R) (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,∃F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))), ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles (a n).disks → z.val∉diskHoles (centerDisks (activeCenters L) R) → (F z).val=thresholdMap c (a n).ε α z.val
body:
:= by
  have hrad : Tendsto (fun n => 2*t n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using ht.const_mul 2
  have h (x : activeCenters L) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      (crossingGraph (fun z => ((a n).annulusMap hR (htR n) hsep x.property z).val)
        (annulusInner x.val (2*t n) R) (annulusOuter x.val (2*t n) R)).IsAcyclic := by
    apply annulus_maps_eventually_forest hc hw hR0 hrad (ε_tendsto a ht)
      (fun n => (a n).ε_pos) (annuli_tendsto a ht)
      (fun _ _ _ => unit_from_hole_mem_annuli) hα hα'
      (fun n => (a n).annulusMap hR (htR n) hsep x.property)
    intro n z hz
    exact (a n).agrees _ hz
  have hall := eventually_all.mpr h
  filter_upwards [hall] with n hn
  exact (a n).fill_cores hR (htR n) hsep (fun x hx => hn ⟨x,hx⟩)
end HoleApprox

structure FullApprox (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (α t : ℝ) where
  ε : ℝ
  ε_pos : 0<ε
  ε_lt : ε<t
  disks : Finset MarkedDisk
  positive : ∀d∈disks,0<d.radius
  disjoint : (disks : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
  sum_lt : (∑d∈disks,d.radius)<t
  map : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))
  agrees : ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles disks →
    (map z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val

name: fullApprox_exists_of_finite_core
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (L : Finset ℂ) (hL : ∀x∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8,¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic → x∈L) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) : Nonempty (FullApprox c α t)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsep⟩ := finite_centers_separation L
  let A := activeCenters L
  let R := min (s/4) (min (1/2) (t/(4*((A.card:ℝ)+1))))
  have hR0 : 0<R := lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos ht (by positivity)))
  have hRs : R ≤ s/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hRhalf : R≤1/2 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hRt : R≤t/(4*((A.card:ℝ)+1)) := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hR1 : R<1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hRhalf (by norm_num)
  have hRsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hh := hsep x hx y hy hxy
    linarith
  have hRbudget : (A.card:ℝ)*R<t/4 := by
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<4*((A.card:ℝ)+1))).mp hRt
    nlinarith
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (R/4) (min (t/4) (1/((n:ℝ)+1)))
  have hu : ∀n,0<u n := fun n => lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have huR : ∀n,2*u n<R := by
    intro n
    have hh : u n≤R/4 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have hut : ∀n,u n<t := by
    intro n
    have hh : u n≤t/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have hult : ∀n,u n<1/2 := by
    intro n
    have hh := huR n
    linarith
  have hulim : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => (hu n).le) (fun n => (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  let a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (u n) := fun n => Classical.choice (holeApprox_exists hc hα hα' L hL (hu n) (hult n))
  obtain ⟨n,F,hF⟩ := ((HoleApprox.eventually_fill_cores hc hw hα hα' a hulim hR0 hR1 huR hRsep).exists)
  let D := centerDisks A R
  have hD : ∀d∈D,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    exact ⟨hR0,by simp⟩
  have hU : ∀d∈(a n).disks∪D,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
    intro d hd
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hd with hh|hh
    · exact (a n).valid d hh
    · exact hD d hh
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hcov,hsum,_⟩ := MarkedDisk.separate ((a n).disks∪D) hU (show 0<t/4 by positivity)
  have htS : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t := by
    have hh := disk_radius_sum_union_le (a n).disks D (fun d hd => (hU d hd).1.le)
    have hDbudget : (∑d∈D,d.radius)<t/4 := by rw [centerDisks_sum]; exact hRbudget
    have hun : u n≤t/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith [(a n).sum_lt]
  refine ⟨⟨(a n).ε,(a n).ε_pos,(a n).ε_lt.trans (hut n),S,
    fun d hd => (hS d hd).1,hdis,htS,F,?_⟩⟩
  intro z hz
  have hn : z.val∉diskHoles ((a n).disks∪D) := fun hh => hz ((MarkedDisk.holes_subset_of_cover hcov).1 hh)
  rw [diskHoles_union] at hn
  exact hF z (fun hh => hn (Or.inl hh)) (fun hh => hn (Or.inr hh))

name: fullApprox_exists
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) : Nonempty (FullApprox c α t)

name: graphEdgePoint_index
stmt: {V : Type u} {i j k : V} {t : ℝ} (h : graphEdgePoint i j t k ≠ 0) : k=i ∨ k=j
body:
:= by
  by_contra hh
  simp only [not_or] at hh
  exact h (by simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hh.1,hh.2])

name: graphRealization_positive_adj
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {i j : V} (hne : i≠j) (hi : 0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  have ha := graphEdgePoint_index (ne_of_gt hi)
  have hb := graphEdgePoint_index (ne_of_gt hj)
  rcases ha with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl|rfl
  · exact (hne rfl).elim
  · exact hab.resolve_left hne
  · exact (hab.resolve_left hne.symm).symm
  · exact (hne rfl).elim

name: graphRealization_pair_le
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {i j : V} (hne : i≠j) : p i+p j≤1
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  simp only [graphEdgePoint_apply]
  split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> first | contradiction | nlinarith [ht.1,ht.2]

def graphCutRealization {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) : Set (V → ℝ) :=
  {p | p∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V) ∧ ∀ i j, i≠j → ¬T.Adj i j →
    p≠graphEdgePoint i j (1/2)}
abbrev GraphCutSpace {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) := ↥(graphCutRealization T)

name: graphRealization_subset_cut
stmt: {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) : graphRealization T⊆graphCutRealization T
body:
:= by
  intro p hp
  refine ⟨graphRealization_mono le_top hp,?_⟩
  intro i j hne hn he
  apply hn
  apply graphRealization_positive_adj hp hne
  · rw [he]; norm_num [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne,hne.symm]
  · rw [he]; norm_num [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne,hne.symm]

name: graphCut_dominant
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphCutRealization T) (hn : p∉graphRealization T) : ∃i,1/2
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,he⟩ := hp.1
  have hne : i≠j := by
    intro h; apply hn; exact ⟨i,j,Or.inl h,t,ht,he⟩
  have hadj : ¬T.Adj i j := by
    intro h; apply hn; exact ⟨i,j,Or.inr h,t,ht,he⟩
  have htm : t≠1/2 := by intro h; exact hp.2 i j hne hadj (he.trans (by rw [h]))
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne htm with hl|hr
  · refine ⟨i,?_⟩; rw [he]; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]; linarith
  · refine ⟨j,?_⟩; rw [he]; simpa [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne.symm] using hr

name: graphCut_dominant_unique
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphCutRealization T) {i j : V} (hi : 1/2
body:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hh := graphRealization_pair_le hp.1 hne
  linarith

def graphCutRetract {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (p : GraphCutSpace T) : V → ℝ :=
  if h : p.val∈graphRealization T then p.val else graphVertex (graphCut_dominant p.property h).choose

name: graphCutRetract_tree
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (p : GraphCutSpace T) (hp : p.val∈graphRealization T) : graphCutRetract T p=p.val
body:
:= by
  simp [graphCutRetract,hp]

name: graphCutRetract_dominant
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (p : GraphCutSpace T) (hp : p.val∉graphRealization T) {i : V} (hi : 1/2<p.val i) : graphCutRetract T p=graphVertex i
body:
:= by
  rw [graphCutRetract,dite_eq_right hp]
  congr 1
  exact graphCut_dominant_unique p.property (graphCut_dominant p.property hp).choose_spec hi

name: graphCutRetract_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (p : GraphCutSpace T) : graphCutRetract T p∈graphRealization T
body:
:= by
  unfold graphCutRetract
  split
  · assumption
  · exact graphVertex_mem _ _
                                                                      
def graphCutStub {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (i j : V) : Set (GraphCutSpace T) :=
  {p | i≠j ∧ ¬T.Adj i j ∧ p.val∈graphEdgePoint i j '' Icc (0:ℝ) (1/2)}

name: graphCutStub_retract
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {i j : V} {p : GraphCutSpace T} (hp : p∈graphCutStub T i j) : graphCutRetract T p=graphVertex i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne,hadj,t,ht,he⟩ := hp
  have he' := he.symm
  have htm : t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 (by
    intro h; exact p.property.2 i j hne hadj (he'.trans (by rw [h])))
  by_cases hT : p.val∈graphRealization T
  · rw [graphCutRetract_tree p hT]
    have ht0 : t=0 := by
      by_contra hh
      have hp1 : 0<p.val i := by rw [he']; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]; linarith
      have hp2 : 0<p.val j := by rw [he']; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne.symm]; exact lt_of_le_of_ne ht.1 (Ne.symm hh)
      exact hadj (graphRealization_positive_adj hT hne hp1 hp2)
    rw [he',ht0,graphEdgePoint_zero]
  · apply graphCutRetract_dominant p hT
    rw [he']; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]; linarith

name: graphCut_cover
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (p : GraphCutSpace T) : p.val∈graphRealization T ∨ ∃i j,p∈graphCutStub T i j
body:
:= by
  by_cases h : p.val∈graphRealization T
  · exact Or.inl h
  right
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,he⟩ := p.property.1
  have hne : i≠j := by intro hh; exact h ⟨i,j,Or.inl hh,t,ht,he⟩
  have hadj : ¬T.Adj i j := by intro hh; exact h ⟨i,j,Or.inr hh,t,ht,he⟩
  by_cases ht' : t≤1/2
  · exact ⟨i,j,hne,hadj,t,⟨ht.1,ht'⟩,he.symm⟩
  · refine ⟨j,i,hne.symm,fun hh => hadj hh.symm,1-t,⟨by linarith [ht.2],by linarith⟩,?_⟩
    exact (graphEdgePoint_swap i j t).symm.trans he.symm
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: graphCutStub_closed
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (i j : V) : IsClosed (graphCutStub T i j)
body:
:= by
  change IsClosed ({p : GraphCutSpace T | i≠j} ∩
    ({p : GraphCutSpace T | ¬T.Adj i j} ∩ Subtype.val ⁻¹' (graphEdgePoint i j '' Icc (0:ℝ) (1/2))))
  exact isClosed_const.inter (isClosed_const.inter ((isCompact_Icc.image (continuous_graphEdgePoint i j)).isClosed.preimage
    continuous_subtype_val))

name: continuous_graphCutRetract
stmt: {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) : Continuous (graphCutRetract T)
body:
:= by
  let S : Option (V × V) → Set (GraphCutSpace T) := fun a => match a with
    | none => Subtype.val ⁻¹' graphRealization T
    | some (i,j) => graphCutStub T i j
  have hcov : ⋃a,S a=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro p
    rcases graphCut_cover p with hp|⟨i,j,hp⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hp⟩
    · exact ⟨some (i,j),hp⟩
  apply (locallyFinite_of_finite S).continuous hcov
  · intro a
    cases a with
    | none => exact (graphRealization_closed T).preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some a => exact graphCutStub_closed a.1 a.2
  · intro a
    cases a with
    | none => exact continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn.congr (fun p hp => graphCutRetract_tree p hp)
    | some a => exact continuous_const.continuousOn.congr (fun p hp => graphCutStub_retract hp)

name: graphMidpoint_coord_le
stmt: {V : Type u} {i j : V} (hne : i≠j) (k : V) : graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) k ≤ 1/2
body:

  simp only [graphEdgePoint_apply]
  split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> first | contradiction | norm_num

name: graph_dominant_mem_cut
stmt: {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) {i : V} (hi : 1/2
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
  intro j k hjk _ he
  have hh := graphMidpoint_coord_le hjk i
  rw [←he] at hh
  linarith

name: graphEdgePoint_lerp_vertex
stmt: {V : Type u} (i j : V) (t s : ℝ) : (1-s) • graphEdgePoint i j t+s • graphVertex i=graphEdgePoint i j ((1-s)*t)
body:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [graphEdgePoint,Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: graphCut_lerp_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (p : GraphCutSpace T) {s : ℝ} (hs : s∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : (1-s) • p.val+s • graphCutRetract T p∈graphCutRealization T
body:
:= by
  rcases graphCut_cover p with hp|⟨i,j,hp⟩
  · rw [graphCutRetract_tree p hp,←add_smul]
    simp
  · have hr := graphCutStub_retract hp
    obtain ⟨hne,hadj,t,ht,he⟩ := hp
    have htm : t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 (by
      intro h; exact p.property.2 i j hne hadj (he.symm.trans (by rw [h])))
    rw [hr,←he,graphEdgePoint_lerp_vertex]
    have hu0 : 0≤(1-s)*t := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hs.2]) ht.1
    have hu1 : (1-s)*t≤t := mul_le_of_le_one_left ht.1 (by linarith [hs.1])
    have hu : (1-s)*t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu1 htm
    apply graph_dominant_mem_cut (graphEdgePoint_mem (Or.inr (show (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).Adj i j from hne)) ⟨hu0,by linarith⟩) (i := i)
    simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]
    linarith

def graphCutRetraction {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    C(GraphCutSpace T,GraphSpace T) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphCutRetract T p,graphCutRetract_mem T p⟩
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_graphCutRetract T).subtype_mk _
def graphCutInclusion {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) : C(GraphSpace T,GraphCutSpace T) where
  toFun p := ⟨p.val,graphRealization_subset_cut T p.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
def graphCutHomotopy {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    (ContinuousMap.id (GraphCutSpace T)).Homotopy
      ((graphCutInclusion T).comp (graphCutRetraction T)) where
  toFun sp := ⟨(1-sp.1.val) • sp.2.val+sp.1.val • graphCutRetract T sp.2,
    graphCut_lerp_mem T sp.2 sp.1.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).add
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
      ((continuous_graphCutRetract T).comp continuous_snd))).subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
  map_one_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp [graphCutInclusion,graphCutRetraction]

name: graphCut_contractible
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {T : SimpleGraph V} (hT : T.IsTree) : ContractibleSpace (GraphCutSpace T)
body:
:= by
  let := graphTree_contractible hT
  have hn := ((id_nullhomotopic (GraphSpace T)).comp_left
    (graphCutRetraction T)).comp_right (graphCutInclusion T)
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hn
  apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
  refine ⟨a,ContinuousMap.Homotopic.trans ⟨graphCutHomotopy T⟩ ?_⟩
  simpa only [ContinuousMap.id_comp] using ha
end EuclideanFiveColor

def FiberCrosses {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → Y) (A B : Set X) (b : Y) : Prop :=
  ∃K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K⊆f ⁻¹' {b} ∧
    (K∩A).Nonempty ∧ (K∩B).Nonempty

name: fiberCrosses_symm
stmt: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → Y} {A B : Set X} {b : Y} (h : FiberCrosses f A B b) : FiberCrosses f B A b
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hC,hf,hA,hB⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,hK,hC,hf,hB,hA⟩

name: compact_fiber_partition
stmt: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [T1Space Y] (f : C(X,Y)) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (b : Y) (hn : ¬FiberCrosses f A B b) : ∃K₀ K₁ : Set X, IsCompact K₀ ∧ IsCompact K₁ ∧ Disjoint K₀ K₁ ∧ K₀∪K₁=f ⁻¹' {b} ∧ Disjoint K₀ B ∧ Disjoint K₁ A
body:
:= by
  let F : Set X := f ⁻¹' {b}
  have hF : IsClosed F := isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous
  let : CompactSpace F := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hF.isCompact
  let I : Set F := Subtype.val ⁻¹' A
  let O : Set F := Subtype.val ⁻¹' B
  have hI : IsCompact I := (hA.preimage continuous_subtype_val).isCompact
  have hO : IsCompact O := (hB.preimage continuous_subtype_val).isCompact
  have hno : ∀x∈I,Disjoint (connectedComponent x) O := by
    intro x hx
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro y hy hOy
    apply hn
    refine ⟨Subtype.val '' connectedComponent x,
      isClosed_connectedComponent.isCompact.image continuous_subtype_val,
      isConnected_connectedComponent.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rintro z ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩; exact w.property
    · exact ⟨x.val,⟨⟨x,mem_connectedComponent,rfl⟩,hx⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨y.val,⟨⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,hOy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨Z₀,Z₁,hZ₀,hZ₁,hd,hcov,hIZ,hOZ⟩ := compact_component_partition hI hO hno
  refine ⟨Subtype.val '' Z₀,Subtype.val '' Z₁,hZ₀.image continuous_subtype_val,
    hZ₁.image continuous_subtype_val,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro x ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ ⟨z,hz,he⟩
    have hh : z=y := Subtype.ext he
    subst z
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd hy hz
  · rw [←image_union,hcov]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,_,rfl⟩; exact y.property
    · intro hx; exact ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,mem_univ _,rfl⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ hz
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd hx (hOZ hz)
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ hz
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd (hIZ hz) hx

name: finite_fiber_separation
stmt: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [T1Space Y] (f : C(X,Y)) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (hd : Disjoint A B) (S : Finset Y) (hn : ∀b∈S,¬FiberCrosses f A B b) : ∃C₀ C₁ : Set X, IsCompact C₀ ∧ IsCompact C₁ ∧ Disjoint C₀ C₁ ∧ A⊆C₀ ∧ B⊆C₁ ∧ f ⁻¹' (↑S : Set Y)⊆C₀∪C₁
body:
:= by
  choose K₀ K₁ hK using (fun b : S => compact_fiber_partition f hA hB b.val (hn b.val b.property))
  let Z₀ : Set X := ⋃b : S,K₀ b
  let Z₁ : Set X := ⋃b : S,K₁ b
  have hz₀ : IsCompact Z₀ := isCompact_iUnion fun b => (hK b).1
  have hz₁ : IsCompact Z₁ := isCompact_iUnion fun b => (hK b).2.1
  have hsub₀ (b : S) : K₀ b⊆f ⁻¹' {b.val} := by
    rw [←(hK b).2.2.2.1]; exact subset_union_left
  have hsub₁ (b : S) : K₁ b⊆f ⁻¹' {b.val} := by
    rw [←(hK b).2.2.2.1]; exact subset_union_right
  have h01 : Disjoint Z₀ Z₁ := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    have he : b=c := Subtype.ext ((hsub₀ b hb).symm.trans (hsub₁ c hc))
    subst c
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.1 hb hc
  have h0B : Disjoint Z₀ B := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hB
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.2.2.1 hb hB
  have h1A : Disjoint Z₁ A := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hA
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.2.2.2 hb hA
  refine ⟨A∪Z₀,B∪Z₁,hA.isCompact.union hz₀,hB.isCompact.union hz₁,?_,subset_union_left,subset_union_left,?_⟩
  · exact disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd,h1A.symm⟩,
      disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨h0B,h01⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    let b : S := ⟨f x,hx⟩
    have hh : x∈K₀ b∪K₁ b := by rw [(hK b).2.2.2.1]; rfl
    rcases hh with hh|hh
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,hh⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,hh⟩))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: contractible_patch
stmt: {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace X] (D : Set Y) [ContractibleSpace D] (f : C(X,Y)) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (hd : Disjoint A B) (hg : ∀x,x∉A → x∉B → f x∈D) : ∃a : D, ∃g : C(X,Y), EqOn g (fun _ => a.val) A ∧ EqOn g f B ∧ ∀x,g x=f x ∨ g x∈D
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,htB,htA,ht⟩ := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isClosed hB hA hd.symm
  obtain ⟨a,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic D
  let S : Fin 3 → Set X := ![{x | t x≤1/3},{x | 1/3≤t x ∧ t x≤2/3},{x | 2/3≤t x}]
  have hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact isClosed_le t.continuous continuous_const
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const t.continuous).inter
        (isClosed_le t.continuous continuous_const)
    · exact isClosed_le continuous_const t.continuous
  have hc : ⋃i,S i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro x
    by_cases h0 : t x≤1/3
    · exact ⟨0,h0⟩
    by_cases h1 : t x≤2/3
    · exact ⟨1,⟨(not_le.mp h0).le,h1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨2,(not_le.mp h1).le⟩
  have hgood (x : S 1) : f x.val∈D := by
    apply hg
    · intro hx
      have he : t x.val=1 := htA hx
      have hh : t x.val≤2/3 := x.property.2
      linarith
    · intro hx
      have he : t x.val=0 := htB hx
      have hh : 1/3≤t x.val := x.property.1
      linarith
  have hτmem (x : S 1) : 3*t x.val-1∈unitInterval := by
    constructor
    · linarith [x.property.1]
    · linarith [x.property.2]
  let τ : C(S 1,unitInterval) := ⟨fun x => ⟨3*t x.val-1,hτmem x⟩,
    ((continuous_const.mul (t.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)).sub continuous_const).subtype_mk hτmem⟩
  let φ₁ : C(S 1,Y) := ⟨fun x => (H (τ x,⟨f x.val,hgood x⟩)).val,
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (H.continuous.comp (τ.continuous.prodMk
      ((f.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk hgood)))⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(S i,Y) := fun i => Fin.cases (f.restrict (S 0))
    (fun j => Fin.cases φ₁ (fun j => ContinuousMap.const (S j.succ.succ) a.val) j) i
  have h01 (x : X) (h0 : x∈S 0) (h1 : x∈S 1) : φ 0 ⟨x,h0⟩=φ 1 ⟨x,h1⟩ := by
    have he : t x=1/3 := le_antisymm h0 h1.1
    have hτ : τ ⟨x,h1⟩=0 := by apply Subtype.ext; change 3*t x-1=0; rw [he]; norm_num
    change f x=(H (τ ⟨x,h1⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)).val
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.map_zero_left ⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩) |>.symm
  have h12 (x : X) (h1 : x∈S 1) (h2 : x∈S 2) : φ 1 ⟨x,h1⟩=φ 2 ⟨x,h2⟩ := by
    have he : t x=2/3 := le_antisymm h1.2 h2
    have hτ : τ ⟨x,h1⟩=1 := by apply Subtype.ext; change 3*t x-1=1; rw [he]; norm_num
    change (H (τ ⟨x,h1⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)).val=a.val
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.map_one_left ⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)
  have hφ : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j),φ i ⟨x,hi⟩=φ j ⟨x,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j x hi hj
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · exact h01 x hi hj
    · have h0 : t x≤1/3 := hi; have h2 : 2/3≤t x := hj; linarith
    · exact (h01 x hj hi).symm
    · rfl
    · exact h12 x hi hj
    · have h0 : t x≤1/3 := hj; have h2 : 2/3≤t x := hi; linarith
    · exact (h12 x hj hi).symm
    · rfl
  refine ⟨a,closedCoverMap S hS hc φ hφ,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx2 : x∈S 2 := by change 2/3≤t x; rw [htA hx]; norm_num
    exact closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hx2⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx0 : x∈S 0 := by change t x≤1/3; rw [htB hx]; norm_num
    exact closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hx0⟩
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mp hc x
    rw [closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hi⟩]
    fin_cases i
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (H (τ ⟨x,hi⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,hi⟩⟩)).property
    · exact Or.inr a.property
end EuclideanFiveColor

def crossingGraph {X : Type u} {V : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → V → ℝ) (A B : Set X) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj i j := i≠j ∧ FiberCrosses f A B (graphEdgePoint i j (1/2))
  symm := ⟨by
    intro i j h
    refine ⟨h.1.symm,?_⟩
    have he : graphEdgePoint j i (1/2)=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := by
      convert graphEdgePoint_swap j i (1/2) using 1; norm_num
    rw [he]; exact h.2⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro i h; exact h.1 rfl⟩

name: graph_forest_patch
stmt: {X : Type u} {V : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (f : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V))) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (hd : Disjoint A B) (hforest : (crossingGraph (fun x => (f x).val) A B).IsAcyclic) : ∃a : GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V), ∃g : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)), EqOn g (fun _ => a) A ∧ EqOn g f B
body:
:= by
  let G := crossingGraph (fun x => (f x).val) A B
  obtain ⟨T,hGT,_,hT⟩ := SimpleGraph.connected_top.exists_isTree_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic
    (show G≤⊤ from le_top) hforest
  let f₀ : C(X,V → ℝ) := ⟨fun x => (f x).val,continuous_subtype_val.comp f.continuous⟩
  let S : Finset (V → ℝ) := ((Finset.univ : Finset (V×V)).filter
    (fun a => a.1≠a.2 ∧ ¬T.Adj a.1 a.2)).image (fun a => graphEdgePoint a.1 a.2 (1/2))
  have hn : ∀b∈S,¬FiberCrosses f₀ A B b := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨⟨i,j⟩,hij,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hij
    intro hh
    exact hij.2 (hGT ⟨hij.1,hh⟩)
  obtain ⟨C₀,C₁,hC₀,hC₁,hCd,hAC,hBC,hSC⟩ := finite_fiber_separation f₀ hA hB hd S hn
  let : ContractibleSpace (GraphCutSpace T) := graphCut_contractible hT
  have hg : ∀x,x∉C₀ → x∉C₁ → f₀ x∈graphCutRealization T := by
    intro x hx₀ hx₁
    refine ⟨(f x).property,?_⟩
    intro i j hij hTij he
    have hm : f₀ x∈S := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i,j),by simp [hij,hTij],he.symm⟩
    rcases hSC hm with hh|hh
    · exact hx₀ hh
    · exact hx₁ hh
  obtain ⟨a,g,hgA,hgB,hgR⟩ := contractible_patch (graphCutRealization T) f₀ hC₀.isClosed hC₁.isClosed hCd hg
  have hgr (x : X) : g x∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V) := by
    rcases hgR x with hh|hh
    · rw [hh]; exact (f x).property
    · exact hh.1
  let g' : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := ⟨fun x => ⟨g x,hgr x⟩,g.continuous.subtype_mk hgr⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a.val,a.property.1⟩,g',?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgA (hAC hx)
  · intro x hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgB (hBC hx)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def planeAnnulus (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall x R \ Metric.ball x r

name: planeAnnulus_compact
stmt: (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : IsCompact (planeAnnulus x r R)
body:
:=
  (isCompact_closedBall x R).diff Metric.isOpen_ball

name: mem_planeAnnulus
stmt: {x z : ℂ} {r R : ℝ} : z∈planeAnnulus x r R ↔ dist z x≤R ∧ r≤dist z x

name: sphere_mem_annulus
stmt: {x z : ℂ} {r R : ℝ} (hrR : r≤R) (hz : z∈Metric.sphere x R) : z∈planeAnnulus x r R
body:
:= by
  apply mem_planeAnnulus.mpr
  have hz' : dist z x=R := hz
  rw [hz']
  exact ⟨le_rfl,hrR⟩

name: annulus_forest_extension
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] {x : ℂ} {r R : ℝ} (hrR : r<R) (f : C(planeAnnulus x r R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V))) (hforest : (crossingGraph (fun z => (f z).val) (annulusInner x r R) (annulusOuter x r R)).IsAcyclic) : ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall x R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)), ∀z : Metric.sphere x R,g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩= f ⟨z.val,sphere_mem_annulus hrR.le z.property⟩
body:
:= by
  let : CompactSpace (planeAnnulus x r R) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (planeAnnulus_compact x r R)
  have hA : IsClosed (annulusInner x r R) := isClosed_eq (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
  have hB : IsClosed (annulusOuter x r R) := isClosed_eq (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
  have hd : Disjoint (annulusInner x r R) (annulusOuter x r R) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz hz'
    exact hrR.ne (hz.symm.trans hz')
  obtain ⟨a,g,hgA,hgB⟩ := graph_forest_patch f hA hB hd hforest
  let X := Metric.closedBall x R
  let Z : Bool → Set X := fun b => if b then {z | r≤dist z.val x} else {z | dist z.val x≤r}
  have hZ : ∀b,IsClosed (Z b) := by
    intro b
    cases b
    · exact isClosed_le (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
    · exact isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const)
  have hcov : ⋃b,Z b=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    rcases le_total (dist z.val x) r with hh|hh
    · exact ⟨false,hh⟩
    · exact ⟨true,hh⟩
  let g₁ : C(Z true,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => g ⟨z.val.val,mem_planeAnnulus.mpr ⟨z.val.property,z.property⟩⟩,
      g.continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀b,C(Z b,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := fun b => Bool.casesOn b (ContinuousMap.const _ a) g₁
  have heq (z : X) (h0 : z∈Z false) (h1 : z∈Z true) : φ false ⟨z,h0⟩=φ true ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    exact (hgA (show (⟨z.val,mem_planeAnnulus.mpr ⟨z.property,h1⟩⟩ : planeAnnulus x r R)∈annulusInner x r R from
      le_antisymm h0 h1)).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i <;> cases j
    · rfl
    · exact heq z hi hj
    · exact (heq z hj hi).symm
    · rfl
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,fun z => ?_⟩
  have hz : (⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩ : X)∈Z true := by
    change r≤dist z.val x
    rw [show dist z.val x=R from z.property]
    exact hrR.le
  rw [closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=true) ⟨⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩,hz⟩]
  exact hgB z.property
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: finite_centers_separation
stmt: (L : Finset ℂ) : ∃s>0,∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → s<dist x y
body:
:= by
  let P := {p : L×L // p.1≠p.2}
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsp⟩ := finite_pos_lt (fun p : P => dist p.val.1.val p.val.2.val)
    (fun p => dist_pos.mpr (fun he => p.property (Subtype.ext he)))
  refine ⟨s,hs,fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_⟩
  exact hsp ⟨(⟨x,hx⟩,⟨y,hy⟩),fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
def centerDisks (L : Finset ℂ) (R : ℝ) : Finset MarkedDisk := L.image fun x => ⟨x,R,false⟩

name: mem_centerDisks
stmt: {L : Finset ℂ} {R : ℝ} {d : MarkedDisk} : d∈centerDisks L R ↔ ∃x∈L,d=⟨x,R,false⟩
body: := by simp [centerDisks,eq_comm]

name: centerDisks_sum
stmt: (L : Finset ℂ) (R : ℝ) : (∑d∈centerDisks L R,d.radius)=(L.card:ℝ)*R
body:
:= by
  rw [centerDisks,Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => congrArg MarkedDisk.center h)]
  simp

name: centerDisks_disjoint
stmt: {L : Finset ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) : (centerDisks L R : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
body:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp ha
  obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hb
  have hxy : x≠y := by intro he; subst y; exact hab rfl
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hz hz'
  have h1 : dist x z≤R := by simpa only [MarkedDisk.closedBall,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_comm] using hz
  have h2 : dist z y≤R := hz'
  have hh := dist_triangle x z y
  have hh' := hsep x hx y hy hxy
  linarith

name: mem_center_holes
stmt: {L : Finset ℂ} {R : ℝ} {z : ℂ} : z∈diskHoles (centerDisks L R) ↔ ∃x∈L,dist z x<R
body:
:= by
  rw [mem_diskHoles]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    exact ⟨x,hx,hzd⟩
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,hzx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x,R,false⟩,mem_centerDisks.mpr ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩,hzx⟩
def activeCenters (L : Finset ℂ) : Finset ℂ := L.filter (fun x => dist x 0≤6)
namespace HoleApprox

name: annulus_in_domain
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R) (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) {x : ℂ} (hx : x∈activeCenters L) : planeAnnulus x (2*t) R⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles a.disks
body:
:= by
  have hx' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
  intro z hz
  have hz' := mem_planeAnnulus.mp hz
  constructor
  · change dist z 0≤7
    exact (dist_triangle z x 0).trans (by linarith [hx'.2])
  · intro hh
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (a.cores_near hh)
    obtain ⟨hyL,hzy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    change dist z y<2*t at hzy
    by_cases he : x=y
    · subst y; linarith [hz'.2]
    · have hh' := hsep x hx'.1 y hyL he
      have htri := dist_triangle x z y
      rw [dist_comm x z] at htri
      linarith [hz'.1]

name: outside_centers_in_domain
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (htR : 2*t<R) (ht1 : 2*t<1) : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 \ diskHoles (centerDisks (activeCenters L) R)⊆ Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles a.disks
body:
:= by
  intro z hz
  refine ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by norm_num) hz.1,?_⟩
  intro hh
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (a.cores_near hh)
  obtain ⟨hyL,hzy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
  change dist z y<2*t at hzy
  have hy0 : dist y 0≤6 := calc
    dist y 0≤dist y z+dist z 0 := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ 6 := by rw [dist_comm y z]; have hz0 : dist z 0≤5 := hz.1; linarith
  exact hz.2 (mem_center_holes.mpr ⟨y,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hyL,hy0⟩,hzy.trans htR⟩)
end HoleApprox

name: continuum_has_approach
stmt: {x y : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K) (hx : x∈K) (hy : y∈K) (hne : y≠x) : ∃v : ℂ, ‖v‖=1 ∧ Nonempty (ApproachingContinuum x K v)
body:
:= by
  let ρ : ℝ := dist y x
  have hρ : 0<ρ := dist_pos.mpr hne
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ρ/(n+1)
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := div_pos hρ (by positivity)
  have hrle (n) : r n≤ρ := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<(n:ℝ)+1)).mpr (by
    have hn : 0≤(n:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    nlinarith)
  have hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_zero,one_mul] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=ρ)).mul (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜:=ℝ))
  have hq (n) : ∃q∈K,dist q x=r n := by
    have hI := hK.intermediate_value (f:=fun z : ℂ => dist z x) hx hy (continuous_id.dist continuous_const).continuousOn
    apply hI
    exact ⟨by simpa using (hr n).le,hrle n⟩
  choose q hqK hqr using hq
  let w : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (q n-x)/(r n : ℂ)
  have hwn (n) : ‖w n‖=1 := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [norm_div,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hr n),←dist_eq_norm,hqr]
    exact div_self (ne_of_gt (hr n))
  have hwm (n) : w n∈Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using hwn n
  obtain ⟨v,hv,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) 1).tendsto_subseq hwm
  refine ⟨v,by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using hv,?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨hx,r∘φ,w∘φ,fun n => hr (φ n),hr0.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop,
    fun n => hwn (φ n),hlim,?_⟩⟩
  intro n
  have he : x+(r (φ n) : ℂ)*w (φ n)=q (φ n) := by
    dsimp [w]
    have hn : (r (φ n) : ℂ)≠0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hr _))
    field_simp
    ring
  exact he ▸ hqK (φ n)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: compact_component_partition
stmt: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] {I O : Set X} (hI : IsCompact I) (hO : IsCompact O) (hno : ∀x∈I, Disjoint (connectedComponent x) O) : ∃Z₁ Z₂ : Set X, IsCompact Z₁ ∧ IsCompact Z₂ ∧ Disjoint Z₁ Z₂ ∧ Z₁∪Z₂=univ ∧ I⊆Z₁ ∧ O⊆Z₂
body:
:= by
  let q : X → ConnectedComponents X := ConnectedComponents.mk
  have hq : Continuous q := ConnectedComponents.continuous_coe
  have hid : Disjoint (q '' I) (q '' O) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ ⟨y,hy,he⟩
    have hxy : y∈connectedComponent x := ConnectedComponents.coe_eq_coe'.mp he
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hno x hx) hxy hy
  have hsub : q '' I⊆(q '' O)ᶜ := Set.disjoint_left.mp hid
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hIC,hCO⟩ := exists_clopen_of_closed_subset_open
    (hI.image hq).isClosed (hO.image hq).isClosed.isOpen_compl hsub
  refine ⟨q ⁻¹' C,q ⁻¹' Cᶜ,(hC.isClosed.preimage hq).isCompact,
    (hC.compl.isClosed.preimage hq).isCompact,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact disjoint_compl_right.preimage q
  · simp only [←preimage_union,union_compl_self,preimage_univ]
  · intro x hx
    exact hIC ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  · intro x hx hxc
    exact hCO hxc ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

open scoped Classical

universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
                                                                                            
def graphVertex {V : Type u} (i : V) : V → ℝ := fun j => if j=i then 1 else 0
                                                                      
def graphEdgePoint {V : Type u} (i j : V) (t : ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (1-t) • graphVertex i + t • graphVertex j
                                                                           
                                                        
def graphRealization {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Set (V → ℝ) :=
  {p | ∃ i j, (i=j ∨ G.Adj i j) ∧ ∃ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, p=graphEdgePoint i j t}
abbrev GraphSpace {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) := ↥(graphRealization G)

name: graphEdgePoint_apply
stmt: {V : Type u} (i j k : V) (t : ℝ) : graphEdgePoint i j t k = (1-t)*(if k=i then 1 else 0)+t*(if k=j then 1 else 0)
body: := rfl

name: graphEdgePoint_zero
stmt: {V : Type u} (i j : V) : graphEdgePoint i j 0=graphVertex i
body:
:= by
  simp [graphEdgePoint]

name: graphEdgePoint_one
stmt: {V : Type u} (i j : V) : graphEdgePoint i j 1=graphVertex j
body:
:= by
  simp [graphEdgePoint]

name: graphEdgePoint_self
stmt: {V : Type u} (i : V) (t : ℝ) : graphEdgePoint i i t=graphVertex i
body:
:= by
  rw [graphEdgePoint,←add_smul]; simp

name: graphEdgePoint_swap
stmt: {V : Type u} (i j : V) (t : ℝ) : graphEdgePoint i j t=graphEdgePoint j i (1-t)
body:
:= by
  simp [graphEdgePoint,add_comm]

name: continuous_graphEdgePoint
stmt: {V : Type u} (i j : V) : Continuous (graphEdgePoint i j)
body:
:= by
  exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).smul continuous_const).add
    (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)

name: graphVertex_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : V) : graphVertex i∈graphRealization G
body:
:=
  ⟨i,i,Or.inl rfl,0,by norm_num,by simp⟩

name: graphEdgePoint_mem
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {i j : V} (hij : i=j ∨ G.Adj i j) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : graphEdgePoint i j t∈graphRealization G
body:
:=
  ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,rfl⟩

name: graphRealization_mono
stmt: {V : Type u} {G H : SimpleGraph V} (h : G≤H) : graphRealization G⊆graphRealization H
body:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨i,j,hij.imp id (fun hh => h hh),t,ht,rfl⟩

name: graphRealization_nonneg
stmt: {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) (i : V) : 0≤p i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,_,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  rw [graphEdgePoint_apply]
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith [ht.1,ht.2]

name: graphRealization_sum
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) : ∑ i,p i=1
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,_,t,_,rfl⟩ := hp
  simp [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: graphRealization_compact
stmt: {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : IsCompact (graphRealization G)
body:
:= by
  have he : graphRealization G = ⋃ (i : V) (j : V) (_ : i=j ∨ G.Adj i j),
      graphEdgePoint i j '' Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    ext p
    simp only [mem_iUnion,mem_image,graphRealization,mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,rfl⟩; exact ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,rfl⟩; exact ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,rfl⟩
  rw [he]
  exact isCompact_iUnion fun i => isCompact_iUnion fun j => isCompact_iUnion fun _ =>
    isCompact_Icc.image (continuous_graphEdgePoint i j)

name: graphRealization_closed
stmt: {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : IsClosed (graphRealization G)
body:
:= (graphRealization_compact G).isClosed
instance graphSpace_compact {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : CompactSpace (GraphSpace G) :=
  isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (graphRealization_compact G)

name: graphRealization_singleton
stmt: {V : Type u} [Subsingleton V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (a : V) : graphRealization G={graphVertex a}
body:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i,j,_,t,_,rfl⟩
    simp [Subsingleton.elim i a,Subsingleton.elim j a]
  · rintro rfl
    exact graphVertex_mem G a

name: graphRealization_of_two_support
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ} (hn : ∀i,0≤p i) (hs : ∑i,p i=1) {a b : V} (hab : a=b ∨ G.Adj a b) (hsupp : ∀j,j≠a → j≠b → p j=0) : p∈graphRealization G
body:
:= by
  by_cases he : a=b
  · subst b
    have ha : p a=1 := by
      have hh : ∑i,p i=p a := Finset.sum_eq_single a (fun i _ hi => hsupp i hi hi) (by simp)
      linarith
    have hp : p=graphVertex a := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i=a
      · subst i; simp [graphVertex,ha]
      · simp [graphVertex,hi,hsupp i hi hi]
    rw [hp]; exact graphVertex_mem _ _
  · have he' : b≠a := Ne.symm he
    have hs' : p a+p b=1 := by
      have hh : ∑i∈({a,b} : Finset V),p i=∑i,p i := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
        intro i _ hi
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] at hi
        exact hsupp i hi.1 hi.2
      simpa [he] using hh.trans hs
    refine ⟨a,b,hab,p b,⟨hn _,by linarith [hn a]⟩,?_⟩
    funext i
    rw [graphEdgePoint_apply]
    by_cases hi : i=a
    · subst i; simp [he]; linarith
    · by_cases hj : i=b
      · subst i; simp [he']
      · simp [hi,hj,hsupp i hi hj]

name: simplex_mem_forest
stmt: {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {p : V → ℝ} (hn : ∀i,0≤p i) (hs : ∑i,p i=1) (hcl : ∀i j,i≠j → 0
body: := by let S : Finset V := Finset.univ.filter fun i => p i≠0 have hmem (i : V) : i∈S ↔ 0

name: thresholdTotal_pos
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) (q : ℂ) : 0<thresholdTotal c ε α q
body:
:= by
  have hs := diskAverage_sum hc hε q
  have hh : 1-5*α ≤ thresholdTotal c ε α q := by
    have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5)))
      (fun i _ => le_max_left (diskAverage c ε i q-α) 0)
    simpa [thresholdTotal,thresholdWeight,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hs] using hh
  linarith

name: thresholdMap_nonneg
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) (q : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : 0≤thresholdMap c ε α q i
body:
:=
  div_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) (thresholdTotal_pos hc hε hα q).le

name: thresholdMap_sum
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) (q : ℂ) : ∑i,thresholdMap c ε α q i=1
body:
:= by
  unfold thresholdMap
  rw [←Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self (thresholdTotal_pos hc hε hα q).ne'

name: thresholdMap_pos
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) (q : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : 0<thresholdMap c ε α q i ↔ α<diskAverage c ε i q
body:
:= by
  rw [thresholdMap,div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (thresholdTotal_pos hc hε hα q)]
  simp [thresholdWeight]

name: continuous_thresholdMap
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) : Continuous (thresholdMap c ε α)
body:
:= by
  have hw (i : Fin 5) : Continuous (fun q => thresholdWeight c ε α q i) :=
    ((diskAverage_lipschitz hc hε i).continuous.sub continuous_const).max continuous_const
  have ht : Continuous (thresholdTotal c ε α) := continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hw i)
  exact continuous_pi fun i => (hw i).div ht (fun q => (thresholdTotal_pos hc hε hα q).ne')

name: thresholdMap_mem_forest
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) (q : ℂ) {G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)} (hG : G.IsAcyclic) (hb : ∀i j,i≠j → α<diskAverage c ε i q → α<diskAverage c ε j q → G.Adj i j) : thresholdMap c ε α q∈graphRealization G
body:
:= by
  apply simplex_mem_forest hG (thresholdMap_nonneg hc hε hα q) (thresholdMap_sum hc hε hα q)
  intro i j hij hi hj
  exact hb i j hij ((thresholdMap_pos hc hε hα q i).mp hi) ((thresholdMap_pos hc hε hα q j).mp hj)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: finite_pos_lt
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (R : ι → ℝ) (hR : ∀i,0<R i) : ∃s : ℝ,0<s ∧ ∀i,s<R i
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝 0,∀i,s<R i := Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => gt_mem_nhds (hR i)
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hh
  refine ⟨δ/2,half_pos hδ,hd ?_⟩
  change dist (δ/2) (0:ℝ)<δ
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_pos (half_pos hδ)]
  exact half_lt_self hδ

name: finite_small_scale
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (P : ι → ℝ → Prop) (h : ∀i,∃δ>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<δ → P i ε) : ∃δ>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<δ → ∀i,P i ε
body:
:= by
  choose δ hδ hd using h
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsi⟩ := finite_pos_lt δ hδ
  exact ⟨s,hs,fun ε hε hεs i => hd i ε hε (hεs.trans (hsi i))⟩

name: forest_chart
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (x : ℂ) (hf : (transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic) : ∃s>0,∀η>0,∃δ>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<δ → ∃C : Finset ℂ, (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4)<η ∧ ∀q∈Metric.ball x s, q∉⋃z∈C,Metric.ball z (α*ε/4) → thresholdMap c ε α q∈graphRealization (transitionGraph c x)
body:
:= by
  have hall : ∀p : Fin 5 × Fin 5,∃R>0, p.1≠p.2 → ¬TransitionEdge c p.1 p.2 x →
      ∀s<R,∀η>0,∃δ>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<δ → ∃C : Finset ℂ,
        (∀q∈Metric.ball x s,α<diskAverage c ε p.1 q → α<diskAverage c ε p.2 q →
          ∃z∈C,q∈Metric.ball z (α*ε/4)) ∧ (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4)<η := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p.1≠p.2 ∧ ¬TransitionEdge c p.1 p.2 x
    · obtain ⟨R,hR,hcov⟩ := missing_edge_disk_cover hc hp.1 hp.2
      exact ⟨R,hR,fun _ _ s hs η hη => hcov s hs α hα η hη⟩
    · exact ⟨1,by norm_num,fun h₁ h₂ => False.elim (hp ⟨h₁,h₂⟩)⟩
  choose R hR hcov using hall
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsR⟩ := finite_pos_lt R hR
  refine ⟨s,hs,fun η hη => ?_⟩
  let P (p : Fin 5 × Fin 5) (ε : ℝ) : Prop := ∃C : Finset ℂ,
    (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4)<η/25 ∧ (p.1≠p.2 → ¬TransitionEdge c p.1 p.2 x →
      ∀q∈Metric.ball x s,α<diskAverage c ε p.1 q → α<diskAverage c ε p.2 q →
        ∃z∈C,q∈Metric.ball z (α*ε/4))
  have hP : ∀p,∃δ>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<δ → P p ε := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p.1≠p.2 ∧ ¬TransitionEdge c p.1 p.2 x
    · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := hcov p hp.1 hp.2 s (hsR p) (η/25) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun ε hε hεδ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨C,hC,hCr⟩ := hd ε hε hεδ
      exact ⟨C,hCr,fun _ _ => hC⟩
    · refine ⟨1,by norm_num,fun ε _ _ => ⟨∅,by simpa using (show 0<η/25 by positivity),?_⟩⟩
      exact fun h₁ h₂ => False.elim (hp ⟨h₁,h₂⟩)
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := finite_small_scale P hP
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun ε hε hεδ => ?_⟩
  choose C hCr hC using hd ε hε hεδ
  let T := Finset.univ.biUnion C
  have hr : 0≤α*ε/4 := by positivity
  refine ⟨T,?_,?_⟩
  · have hcard : (T.card:ℝ)≤∑p : Fin 5 × Fin 5,((C p).card:ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_biUnion_le (s := Finset.univ) (t := C))
    have hsum : (∑p : Fin 5 × Fin 5,((C p).card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4))<∑_p : Fin 5 × Fin 5,η/25 :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty (fun p _ => hCr p)
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hr
    rw [Finset.sum_mul] at hb
    have hsum' : (∑p : Fin 5 × Fin 5,((C p).card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4))<25*(η/25) := by simpa using hsum
    exact hb.trans_lt (by linarith [hsum'])
  · intro q hq hqT
    apply thresholdMap_mem_forest hc hε hα' q hf
    intro i j hij hi hj
    by_contra he
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hqz⟩ := hC (i,j) hij he q hq hi hj
    apply hqT
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨z,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(i,j),Finset.mem_univ _,hz⟩,hqz⟩⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: compact_forest_charts
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (M : Set ℂ) (hM : IsCompact M) (hf : ∀x∈M,(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic) : ∃l>0,∀η>0,∃δ>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<δ → ∃C : Finset ℂ, (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4)<η ∧ ∀a∈M,∃G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5),G.IsAcyclic ∧ ∀q∈Metric.ball a l,q∉⋃z∈C,Metric.ball z (α*ε/4) → thresholdMap c ε α q∈graphRealization G
body:
:= by
  choose s hs hchart using fun x : M => forest_chart hc hα hα' x.val (hf x.val x.property)
  have hcover : M⊆⋃x : M,Metric.ball x.val (s x) := by
    intro x hx
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,Metric.mem_ball_self (hs _)⟩
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := hM.elim_finite_subcover (fun x : M => Metric.ball x.val (s x))
    (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcover
  have hS' : M⊆⋃x : S,Metric.ball x.val.val (s x.val) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (hS hx)
    obtain ⟨haS,hxa⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp ha
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨a,haS⟩,hxa⟩
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hleb⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric hM (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hS'
  refine ⟨l,hl,fun η hη => ?_⟩
  let β := η/((S.card:ℝ)+1)
  have hβ : 0<β := div_pos hη (by positivity)
  let P (x : S) (ε : ℝ) : Prop := ∃C : Finset ℂ,
    (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4)<β ∧ ∀q∈Metric.ball x.val.val (s x.val),
      q∉⋃z∈C,Metric.ball z (α*ε/4) → thresholdMap c ε α q∈graphRealization (transitionGraph c x.val.val)
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := finite_small_scale P (fun x => hchart x.val β hβ)
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun ε hε hεδ => ?_⟩
  choose C hCr hC using hd ε hε hεδ
  let T := Finset.univ.biUnion C
  refine ⟨T,?_,?_⟩
  · have hcard : (T.card:ℝ)≤∑p : S,((C p).card:ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_biUnion_le (s := Finset.univ) (t := C))
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (show 0≤α*ε/4 by positivity)
    rw [Finset.sum_mul] at hb
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=(Finset.univ : Finset S)) (fun p _ => (hCr p).le)
    have hsum' : (∑p:S,((C p).card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4))≤(S.card:ℝ)*β := by simpa using hsum
    have hβeq : β*((S.card:ℝ)+1)=η := div_mul_cancel₀ η (by positivity)
    exact hb.trans hsum' |>.trans_lt (by nlinarith)
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hleb a ha
    refine ⟨transitionGraph c x.val.val,hf x.val.val x.val.property,fun q hq hqT => ?_⟩
    apply hC x q (hx hq)
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hzC,hqz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact hqT (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨z,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x,Finset.mem_univ _,hzC⟩,hqz⟩⟩)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
