name: radius_le_sum
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius) {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d∈S) : d.radius≤∑e∈S,e.radius
body: := Finset.single_le_sum hS hd

name: noncoreCost_nonneg
stmt: {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : 0≤d.radius) : 0≤d.noncoreCost
body:
:= by
  unfold noncoreCost
  split <;> positivity

name: noncore_radius_le_sum
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius) {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d∈S) (hc : d.core=false) : d.radius≤∑e∈S,e.noncoreCost
body:
:= by
  have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun e he => noncoreCost_nonneg (hS e he)) hd
  simpa [noncoreCost,hc] using hh

name: sphere_avoids_holes
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)) {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d∈S) {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : z∉diskHoles S
body:
:= by
  rintro hh
  obtain ⟨e,he,hze⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hh
  by_cases hde : d=e
  · subst e
    have hh' : dist z d.center<d.radius := hze
    have hz' : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
    linarith
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis hd he hde) (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
      (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hze)

name: closedBall_near_core
stmt: {L : Set ℂ} {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d.Valid L) (hc : d.core=true) : ∃x∈L,d.closedBall⊆Metric.ball x (2*d.radius)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxd⟩ := hd.2 hc
  refine ⟨x,hx,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hx' : dist d.center x<d.radius := by simpa only [ball,Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using hxd
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle z d.center x) (by dsimp [closedBall] at hz; change dist z d.center≤d.radius at hz; linarith)

name: sphere_norm_bound
stmt: {d : MarkedDisk} {R : ℝ} (hmeet : (d.closedBall∩Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) R).Nonempty) {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : dist z 0≤2*d.radius+R
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,haR⟩ := hmeet
  have hza : dist z a≤2*d.radius := calc
    dist z a≤dist z d.center+dist d.center a := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ 2*d.radius := by
      have hh : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
      have ha' : dist d.center a≤d.radius := by simpa only [closedBall,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_comm] using ha
      linarith
  exact (dist_triangle z a 0).trans (by change dist a 0≤R at haR; linarith)

def initialDisks (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) : Finset MarkedDisk :=
  L.image (fun x => ⟨x,δ,true⟩) ∪ C.image (fun x => ⟨x,u,false⟩)

name: mem_initialDisks
stmt: {L C : Finset ℂ} {δ u : ℝ} {d : MarkedDisk} : d∈initialDisks L C δ u ↔ (∃x∈L,d=⟨x,δ,true⟩) ∨ (∃x∈C,d=⟨x,u,false⟩)
body:
:= by
  simp [initialDisks,eq_comm]

name: initialDisks_valid
stmt: (L C : Finset ℂ) {δ u : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hu : 0<u) : ∀d∈initialDisks L C δ u,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ)
body:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rcases mem_initialDisks.mp hd with ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩|⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨hδ,fun _ => ⟨x,hx,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨hu,by simp⟩

name: initialDisks_sum
stmt: (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) : (∑d∈initialDisks L C δ u,d.radius)=(L.card:ℝ)*δ+(C.card:ℝ)*u ∧ (∑d∈initialDisks L C δ u,d.noncoreCost)=(C.card:ℝ)*u
body:
:= by
  have hd : Disjoint (L.image (fun x => (⟨x,δ,true⟩ : MarkedDisk)))
      (C.image (fun x => (⟨x,u,false⟩ : MarkedDisk))) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro d hd he
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hxd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hyd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    have hh := congrArg MarkedDisk.core (hxd.trans hyd.symm)
    exact Bool.noConfusion hh
  have hi (r : ℝ) (b : Bool) : Function.Injective (fun x : ℂ => (⟨x,r,b⟩ : MarkedDisk)) := by
    intro x y h; exact congrArg MarkedDisk.center h
  simp only [initialDisks,Finset.sum_union hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi δ true h),Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi u false h),
      Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi δ true h),Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi u false h)]
  simp [noncoreCost]

name: initial_core_cover
stmt: (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) {x z : ℂ} (hx : x∈L) (hz : z∈Metric.ball x δ) : z∈coreHoles (initialDisks L C δ u)
body:
:= by
  exact mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,δ,true⟩,mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inl ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩),rfl,hz⟩

name: initial_marked_cover
stmt: (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) {x z : ℂ} (hx : x∈C) (hz : z∈Metric.ball x u) : z∈diskHoles (initialDisks L C δ u)
body:
:= by
  exact mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,u,false⟩,mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inr ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩),hz⟩

name: holes_subset_of_cover
stmt: {S T : Finset MarkedDisk} (hcov : ∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) : diskHoles S⊆diskHoles T ∧ coreHoles S⊆coreHoles T
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hde,_⟩ := hcov d hd
    exact mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨e,he,hde hzd⟩
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨d,hd,hcd,hzd⟩ := mem_coreHoles.mp hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hde,hc⟩ := hcov d hd
    exact mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨e,he,hc hcd,hde hzd⟩
end MarkedDisk

name: small_hole_map
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (L : Finset ℂ) (hL : ∀x∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8,¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic → x∈L) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht' : t<1/2) : ∃e>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<e → ∃S : Finset MarkedDisk, (∀d∈S,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ)) ∧ (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧ (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t ∧ ∃g : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles S),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))), ∀z : ↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles S),z.val∉diskHoles S → (g z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val
body:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ := t/(4*((L.card:ℝ)+1))
  have hδ : 0<δ := div_pos ht (by positivity)
  have hδeq : δ*(4*((L.card:ℝ)+1))=t := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
  have hδbudget : (L.card:ℝ)*δ<t/4 := by nlinarith
  let M := Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8 \ ⋃x∈L,Metric.ball x δ
  have hM : IsCompact M := (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 8).diff
    (isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have hf : ∀x∈M,(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    exact hx.2 (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hL x hx.1 hn,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩⟩)
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hcharts⟩ := compact_forest_charts hc hα hα' M hM hf
  let κ := min (t/4) (l/6)
  have hκ : 0<κ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hκt : κ≤t/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hκl : κ≤l/6 := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨e,he,hC⟩ := hcharts κ hκ
  refine ⟨e,he,fun ε hε hεe => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hCr,hCv⟩ := hC ε hε hεe
  let u := α*ε/4
  have hu : 0<u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hcov,hsum,hcost⟩ := MarkedDisk.separate
    (initialDisks L C δ u) (initialDisks_valid L C hδ hu) hκ
  have htot : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t := by
    rw [(initialDisks_sum L C δ u).1] at hsum
    change (C.card:ℝ)*u<κ at hCr
    linarith
  have hnrad : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → 2*d.radius<l := by
    rw [(initialDisks_sum L C δ u).2] at hcost
    intro d hd hdf
    have hd' := noncore_radius_le_sum (fun a ha => (hS a ha).1.le) hd hdf
    change (C.card:ℝ)*u<κ at hCr
    linarith
  have hcover := holes_subset_of_cover hcov
  have hMof (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8) (hzS : z∉diskHoles S) : z∈M := by
    refine ⟨hz,?_⟩
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hxL,hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact hzS (hcover.1 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,δ,true⟩,
      mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inl ⟨x,hxL,rfl⟩),hzx⟩))
  have hmarked (z : ℂ) (hz : z∉diskHoles S) : z∉⋃x∈C,Metric.ball x u := by
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hxC,hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact hz (hcover.1 (initial_marked_cover L C δ u hxC hzx))
  let f : C(ℂ,Fin 5 → ℝ) := ⟨thresholdMap c ε α,continuous_thresholdMap hc hε hα'⟩
  have hg : ∀z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7,z∉diskHoles S →
      f z∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) := by
    intro z hz hzS
    have hzM := hMof z (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by norm_num) hz) hzS
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hq⟩ := hCv z hzM
    exact graphRealization_mono le_top (hq z (Metric.mem_ball_self hl) (hmarked z hzS))
  have hb : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → (d.closedBall∩Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7).Nonempty →
      ∃G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5),G.IsAcyclic ∧ ∀z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius,
        f z∈graphRealization G := by
    intro d hd hdf hmeet
    have hr := (hS d hd).1
    have hsph (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8 := by
      have hzr := sphere_norm_bound hmeet hz
      have hd' := radius_le_sum (fun a ha => (hS a ha).1.le) hd
      change dist z 0≤8
      linarith
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty (x:=d.center)).mpr hr.le
    have haM := hMof a (hsph a ha) (sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd ha)
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hq⟩ := hCv a haM
    refine ⟨G,hG,fun z hz => hq z ?_ (hmarked z (sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd hz))⟩
    have hza : dist z a≤2*d.radius := calc
      dist z a≤dist z d.center+dist d.center a := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = 2*d.radius := by
        have hz' : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
        have ha' : dist d.center a=d.radius := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_comm] using ha
        rw [hz',ha']; ring
    exact hza.trans_lt (hnrad d hd hdf)
  obtain ⟨g,hg'⟩ := fill_noncore_disks (Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7) S
    (fun d hd => (hS d hd).1) hdis f hg hb
  exact ⟨S,hS,hdis,htot,g,hg'⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open scoped Classical ENNReal
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
                                                                             
def diskAnnulus (d : MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.closedBall d.center (1+d.radius) \ Metric.ball d.center (1-d.radius)
def holeAnnuli (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,diskAnnulus d

name: diskAnnulus_measurable
stmt: (d : MarkedDisk) : MeasurableSet (diskAnnulus d)
body:
:=
  Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet.diff Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet

name: unit_from_disk_mem_annulus
stmt: {d : MarkedDisk} {z q : ℂ} (hq : q∈d.closedBall) (hzq : dist z q=1) : z∈diskAnnulus d
body:
:= by
  have hq' : dist q d.center≤d.radius := hq
  constructor
  · change dist z d.center≤1+d.radius
    exact (dist_triangle z q d.center).trans (by linarith)
  · change ¬ dist z d.center<1-d.radius
    have hh := dist_triangle z d.center q
    rw [dist_comm d.center q,hzq] at hh
    linarith

name: volume_diskAnnulus
stmt: {d : MarkedDisk} (h0 : 0≤d.radius) (h1 : d.radius≤1) : volume (diskAnnulus d)=ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*d.radius)
body:
:= by
  have hsub : Metric.ball d.center (1-d.radius)⊆Metric.closedBall d.center (1+d.radius) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))
  have hvol (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) : ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal (r^2*Real.pi) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg r),ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr]
    congr 1
    rw [←NNReal.coe_real_pi,ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  rw [diskAnnulus,measure_sdiff hsub Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet (by finiteness),
    Complex.volume_closedBall,Complex.volume_ball,hvol _ (by linarith),hvol _ (by linarith),
    ←ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by positivity : 0≤(1-d.radius)^2*Real.pi)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: volume_holeAnnuli_le
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius ∧ d.radius≤1) : volume (holeAnnuli S)≤ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S,d.radius))
body:
:= by
  calc
    volume (holeAnnuli S)≤∑d∈S,volume (diskAnnulus d) := measure_biUnion_finset_le S _
    _ = ∑d∈S,ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      exact volume_diskAnnulus (hS d hd).1 (hS d hd).2
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑d∈S,4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun d hd => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hS d hd).1)]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S,d.radius)) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: unit_from_hole_mem_annuli
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {z q : ℂ} (hq : q∈diskHoles S) (hzq : dist z q=1) : z∈holeAnnuli S
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hqd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hq
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨d,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hd,unit_from_disk_mem_annulus (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hqd) hzq⟩⟩

name: holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero
stmt: (S : ℕ → Finset MarkedDisk) (hS : ∀n d,d∈S n → 0≤d.radius) (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑d∈S n,d.radius) atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n => volume (holeAnnuli (S n))) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(∑d∈S n,d.radius)≤1 :=
    hlim.eventually (eventually_le_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,volume (holeAnnuli (S n))≤ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S n,d.radius)) := by
    filter_upwards [hsmall] with n hn
    apply volume_holeAnnuli_le
    exact fun d hd => ⟨hS n d hd,(MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum (hS n) hd).trans hn⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S n,d.radius))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hlim.const_mul (4*Real.pi))
  apply ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.mpr
  intro a ha
  filter_upwards [hbound,ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.mp ht a ha] with n hn hn'
  exact hn.trans hn'
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
                                                         
structure HoleApprox (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (α : ℝ) (L : Finset ℂ) (t : ℝ) where
  ε : ℝ
  ε_pos : 0<ε
  ε_lt : ε<t
  disks : Finset MarkedDisk
  valid : ∀d∈disks,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ)
  disjoint : (disks : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
  sum_lt : (∑d∈disks,d.radius)<t
  map : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles disks),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))
  agrees : ∀z : ↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles disks),z.val∉diskHoles disks →
    (map z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val

name: holeApprox_exists
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (L : Finset ℂ) (hL : ∀x∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8,¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic → x∈L) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht' : t<1/2) : Nonempty (HoleApprox c α L t)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e,he,h⟩ := small_hole_map hc hα hα' L hL ht ht'
  let ε := min (e/2) (t/2)
  have hε : 0<ε := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hεe : ε<e := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  have hεt : ε<t := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hsum,g,hg⟩ := h ε hε hεe
  exact ⟨⟨ε,hε,hεt,S,hS,hdis,hsum,g,hg⟩⟩
namespace HoleApprox

name: cores_near
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} (a : HoleApprox c α L t) : coreHoles a.disks⊆⋃x∈L,Metric.ball x (2*t)
body:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hcd,hzd⟩ := mem_coreHoles.mp hz
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hsub⟩ := MarkedDisk.closedBall_near_core (a.valid d hd) hcd
  have hrad := MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum (fun e he => (a.valid e he).1.le) hd
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hx,
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [a.sum_lt]) (hsub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd))⟩⟩
lemma ε_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (a n).ε) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero (fun n => (a n).ε_pos.le) (fun n => (a n).ε_lt.le) ht

name: sum_tendsto
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n => ∑d∈(a n).disks,d.radius) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:=
  squeeze_zero (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd => ((a n).valid d hd).1.le)
    (fun n => (a n).sum_lt.le) ht

name: annuli_tendsto
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n => volume (holeAnnuli (a n).disks)) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:=
  holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero _ (fun n d hd => ((a n).valid d hd).1.le) (sum_tendsto a ht)
end HoleApprox
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: interface_four_not_edge
stmt: : ∀s : Fin 4 → Bool, ∀p : Finset (Fin 5), InterfaceFourCompatible s p → ∀i, ¬p⊆interfaceFourEdge i

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def fourInterfaceSign (v : Fin 4 → ℂ) (t : Angles) (i : Fin 4) : Bool :=
  decide (0<⟪direction t,v i⟫)

name: interfaceFourEdge_eq
stmt: (i : Fin 4) : interfaceFourEdge i=fourEdge i
body: := rfl

name: fourInterfaceSign_opposite
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) : fourInterfaceSign v (t+(Real.pi : Angles))=fun i => !(fourInterfaceSign v t i)
body:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [fourInterfaceSign,direction_add_pi,inner_neg_left]
  by_cases hi : 0<⟪direction t,v i⟫
  · simp only [hi,show ¬0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_true]
  · have hneg : ⟪direction t,v i⟫<0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hi) (hn i)
    simp only [hi,show 0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_false]
variable {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)

name: four_interface_compatible
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 4 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈fourEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let E (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 4) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex := finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K fourEdge hH
  have hJ (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) :
      ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E s b,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈interfaceFourAllowed s b := by
    filter_upwards [hex] with z hz hzE
    simp only [interfaceFourAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    intro i hi
    exact hz i (hzE i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hi⟩))
  have hout (s : Fin 4 → Bool) := continuum_outer_restriction c hc (E s true) hK (hJ s true)
  have hin (s : Fin 4 → Bool) := continuum_inner_restriction c hc (E s false) hK (hJ s false)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hout,ae_all_iff.mpr hin,palette_nonempty c hc x,
    palette_cardinality c hc hw x,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))]
    with t ho hi hp hcard hn
  refine ⟨hp,hcard.2,ho (fourInterfaceSign v t) ?_,hi (fourInterfaceSign v t) ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact of_decide_eq_true (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  · intro i hi
    have hn' : ¬0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ := of_decide_eq_false (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hn') (hn i)

name: four_interface_admissible
stmt: {x : ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,FourAdmissible (palette c hc x t)
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht
  exact ⟨ht.1,ht.2.1,interface_four_not_edge _ _ ht⟩

name: four_state_group_of_admissible
stmt: {x : ℂ} (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,FourAdmissible (palette c hc x t)) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t
body:
:=
  h.mono fun _ ht => four_admissible_group _ ht

name: four_state_represents_of_group
stmt: {x : ℂ} (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) (s : Fin 3) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s} (fourGroup s)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun ((fourState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg] with t ht hts
  change fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s at hts
  exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp (ht (by simpa only [hts] using hi))

name: four_state_changes_of_group
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠fourState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hg,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x] with t ht hu hd he
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := fourGroup_nonempty (fourState c hc x t)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht hi) (hu (by simpa only [he] using hi))

name: four_state_diagonal_positive_of_group
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) (s : Fin 3) (hs : s≠0) : 0<angularMeasure {t | fourState c hc x t=s}
body:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠s :=
    measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 ∧ r≠s ∧ ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=r := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠0 ∧ (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠s ∧
      ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=(if s=1 then 2 else 1) from by decide) s hs
  let f : Angles → Bool := fun t => if fourState c hc x t=0 then false else true
  have hf : Measurable f := Measurable.ite
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hrep (v : Bool) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | f (t : Angles)=v} (if v then fourGroup r else fourGroup 0) := by
    refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun (hf.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg,angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot]
      with t ht htn htv
    change f (t : Angles)=v at htv
    apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp
    apply ht
    cases v
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0 := by simpa [f] using htv
      simpa only [hz,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] using hi
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=r := hr.2.2 _ (by simpa [f] using htv) htn
      simpa only [hz,ite_true] using hi
  have hcard : (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup r)).card≤2 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1))).card≤2 from by decide) s hs
  apply two_state_impossible hc hw x (fourGroup 0) (fourGroup r) hcard f hf (hrep false) (hrep true)
  filter_upwards [hnot,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot,
      four_state_changes_of_group hc hw hg] with t ht hu hne
  exact three_exclude_flip _ _ s hs ht hu hne

name: four_interface_state_rule
stmt: {x : ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠0 → InterfaceFourSplit (fourInterfaceSign v t) ∧ fourState c hc x t=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht hn
  have ho : 4∉palette c hc x t := by
    intro ho
    exact hn (by simp only [fourState,fourCanonical,ho,ite_true])
  exact interface_four_split _ _ ht ho
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: angle_state_preimage_positive
stmt: {A : Set Angles} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hp : 0<angularMeasure A) : 0<volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A)
body:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  have hz := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∉A := ae_angular_of_ae_line hA.compl hz
  exact hp.ne' (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr ha)

name: angle_support_lift
stmt: {A : Set Angles} (hA : MeasurableSet A) {t : Angles} (ht : t∈(angularMeasure.restrict A).support) : ∃b : ℝ,(b : Angles)=t ∧ b∈(volume.restrict (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A)).support
body:
:= by
  let B : Set ℝ := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A
  let S : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict B).support∩Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)
  let F : Set Angles := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) '' S
  have hm : Continuous ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) := AddCircle.continuous_mk' _
  have hS : IsCompact S := isCompact_Icc.inter_left Measure.isClosed_support
  have hF : IsClosed F := (hS.image hm).isClosed
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂((volume : Measure Angles).restrict A),t∈F := by
    rw [← (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).map_eq,
      Measure.restrict_map hm.measurable hA]
    apply (ae_map_iff hm.measurable.aemeasurable hF.measurableSet).mpr
    have hs : ∀ᵐb∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi))).restrict B),b∈(volume.restrict B).support := by
      apply ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self B)
      exact Measure.support_mem_ae
    have hi : ∀ᵐb∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi))).restrict B),b∈Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi) :=
      ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc)
    filter_upwards [hs,hi] with b hb hib
    exact ⟨b,⟨hb,hib.1.le,by simpa only [zero_add] using hib.2⟩,rfl⟩
  have ha' : ∀ᵐt∂(angularMeasure.restrict A),t∈F := by
    rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,Measure.restrict_smul] at ha
    exact (Measure.ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff (by positivity : ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi)≠0)).mp ha
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbt⟩ := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed hF ha' ht
  exact ⟨b,hbt,hb.1⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: direction_inner_real
stmt: (t : ℝ) (v : ℂ) : ⟪direction (t : Angles),v⟫=Real.cos t*v.re+Real.sin t*v.im
body:
:= by
  rw [Complex.inner,direction_real,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.conj_re,Complex.conj_im,Complex.add_re,
    Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im]
  ring

name: three_direction_moment
stmt: (t : Angles) (v w : ℂ) : ⟪direction t,v⟫*⟪direction t,w⟫+ ⟪direction (t+(sixty : Angles)),v⟫*⟪direction (t+(sixty : Angles)),w⟫+ ⟪direction (t+2•(sixty : Angles)),v⟫*⟪direction (t+2•(sixty : Angles)),w⟫= (3/2:ℝ)*⟪v,w⟫
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_nsmul,← AddCircle.coe_add,← AddCircle.coe_add]
  simp only [direction_inner_real,nsmul_eq_mul,sixty,Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,
    Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [show 2*(Real.pi/3)=Real.pi/3+Real.pi/3 by ring]
  simp only [Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.sin_pi_div_three,
    Complex.inner,Complex.mul_re,Complex.conj_re,Complex.conj_im]
  have hs : Real.sqrt 3^2=3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a
  ring_nf
  have hs3 : Real.sqrt 3^3=3*Real.sqrt 3 := by rw [pow_succ,hs]
  have hs4 : Real.sqrt 3^4=9 := by rw [show 4=2*2 from rfl,pow_mul,hs]; norm_num
  simp only [hs,hs3,hs4]
  linear_combination (3/2:ℝ)*(v.re*w.re+v.im*w.im)*hc
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: direction_sixty_unit
stmt: (t : Angles) : ‖direction t-direction (t+(sixty : Angles))‖=1
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_add,direction_real,direction_real]
  have he : (Circle.exp a : ℂ)-(Circle.exp (a+sixty) : ℂ)=(Circle.exp (a-sixty) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,
      Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Real.cos_add,Real.cos_sub,Real.sin_add,Real.sin_sub,sixty,Real.cos_pi_div_three] <;> ring
  rw [he]
  exact Circle.norm_coe _

name: compact_no_unit_margin
stmt: {F : Set Angles} (hF : IsCompact F) (hu : ∀t∈F,∀u∈F,‖direction t-direction u‖≠1) : ∃ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀t∈F,∀u,dist t u<ε → u+(sixty : Angles)∉F ∧ u-(sixty : Angles)∉F
body:
:= by
  let T : Set Angles := {u | u+(sixty : Angles)∉F ∧ u-(sixty : Angles)∉F}
  have ho : IsOpen T := (hF.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage (continuous_id.add_const _)).inter
    (hF.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
  have hs : F⊆T := by
    intro t ht
    refine ⟨fun hh => hu t ht _ hh (direction_sixty_unit t),fun hh => ?_⟩
    apply hu (t-(sixty : Angles)) hh t ht
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using direction_sixty_unit (t-(sixty : Angles))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hsub⟩ := hF.exists_thickening_subset_open ho hs
  exact ⟨ε,hε,fun t ht u htu => hsub (Metric.mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨t,ht,by simpa only [dist_comm] using htu⟩)⟩

variable {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
def interfaceStateSet (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set Angles := {t | fourState c hc x t=s}
def interfaceStateSupport (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set Angles :=
  (angularMeasure.restrict (interfaceStateSet hc x s)).support

name: interfaceStateSet_measurable
stmt: (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : MeasurableSet (interfaceStateSet hc x s)
body:
:=
  measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const

name: interfaceStateSupport_ae
stmt: (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,∀s : Fin 3,fourState c hc x t=s → t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s
body:
:= by
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro s
  exact (ae_restrict_iff' (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x s)).mp Measure.support_mem_ae

name: interfaceStateSupport_no_unit
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {t u : Angles} (ht : t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s) (hu : u∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s) : ‖direction t-direction u‖≠1
body:
:= by
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 := by dsimp [r]; split <;> decide
  have hl : ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup r∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1)∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 from by decide) s hs
  obtain ⟨b,rfl,hb⟩ := angle_support_lift (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x s) ht
  obtain ⟨d,rfl,hd⟩ := angle_support_lift (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x s) hu
  exact strict_state_no_unit_support hc hw hl (four_state_represents_of_group hc hg r)
    (four_state_represents_of_group hc hg s)
    (angle_state_preimage_positive (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x r)
      (four_state_diagonal_positive_of_group hc hw hg r hr)) hb hd

name: interfaceStateSupport_margin
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) : ∃ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s,∀u,dist t u<ε → u+(sixty : Angles)∉interfaceStateSupport hc x s ∧ u-(sixty : Angles)∉interfaceStateSupport hc x s
body:
:= by
  have h (s : Fin 3) (hs : s≠0) := compact_no_unit_margin
    (show IsCompact (interfaceStateSupport hc x s) from Measure.isClosed_support.isCompact)
    (fun t ht u hu => interfaceStateSupport_no_unit hc hw hg hs ht hu)
  obtain ⟨ε₁,hε₁,h₁⟩ := h 1 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨ε₂,hε₂,h₂⟩ := h 2 (by decide)
  refine ⟨min ε₁ ε₂,lt_min hε₁ hε₂,?_⟩
  intro s hs t ht u htu
  fin_cases s
  · exact (hs rfl).elim
  · exact h₁ t ht u (htu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  · exact h₂ t ht u (htu.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: four_diagonal_product_neg
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) (hd : interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)=1) : ⟪direction t,v 0⟫*⟪direction t,v 1⟫<0
body:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : 0<⟪direction t,v 0⟫ <;> by_cases h1 : 0<⟪direction t,v 1⟫
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  · exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h0 (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h1) (hn 1))
  · exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h0) (hn 0)) h1
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1] at hd
    norm_num at hd

name: four_diagonal_product_pos
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) (hd : interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)=2) : 0<⟪direction t,v 0⟫*⟪direction t,v 1⟫
body:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : 0<⟪direction t,v 0⟫ <;> by_cases h1 : 0<⟪direction t,v 1⟫
  · exact mul_pos h0 h1
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1,decide_true,decide_false] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1,decide_true,decide_false] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  · exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h0) (hn 0))
      (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h1) (hn 1))

name: four_diagonal_orbit_half
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} {j : Fin 6} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) : interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle (j+3)))= interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))
body:
:= by
  rw [sixAngle_half,← add_assoc,fourInterfaceSign_opposite hn,interface_four_diagonal_neg]

name: four_diagonal_uniform_of_parity
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} {a : Fin 3} {p : Fin 2} (hn : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hd : ∀j : Fin 6,j.val%2≠p.val → interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=a) : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=a
body:
:= by
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j.val%2≠p.val
  · exact hd j hj
  have hh : (j+3).val%2≠p.val := by
    have h : ∀p : Fin 2,∀j : Fin 6,¬j.val%2≠p.val → (j+3).val%2≠p.val := by decide
    exact h p j hj
  rw [← four_diagonal_orbit_half (hn j)]
  exact hd (j+3) hh

name: four_uniform_diagonal_one
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (hn : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hd : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=1) : ⟪v 0,v 1⟫<0
body:
:= by
  have h0 := four_diagonal_product_neg (hn 0) (hd 0)
  have h1 := four_diagonal_product_neg (hn 1) (hd 1)
  have h2 := four_diagonal_product_neg (hn 2) (hd 2)
  norm_num only [sixAngle,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_one,Fin.val_two,zero_nsmul,one_nsmul,add_zero] at h0 h1 h2
  have hm := three_direction_moment t (v 0) (v 1)
  linarith

name: four_uniform_diagonal_two
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (hn : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hd : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=2) : 0<⟪v 0,v 1⟫
body:
:= by
  have h0 := four_diagonal_product_pos (hn 0) (hd 0)
  have h1 := four_diagonal_product_pos (hn 1) (hd 1)
  have h2 := four_diagonal_product_pos (hn 2) (hd 2)
  norm_num only [sixAngle,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_one,Fin.val_two,zero_nsmul,one_nsmul,add_zero] at h0 h1 h2
  have hm := three_direction_moment t (v 0) (v 1)
  linarith

name: four_opposite_uniform_diagonals_false
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t u : Angles} (hnt : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hnu : ∀j i,⟪direction (u+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) {a b : Fin 3} (ha : a≠0) (hb : b≠0) (hab : a≠b) (hdt : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=a) (hdu : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (u+sixAngle j))=b) : False
body:
:= by
  have hab' : (a=1 ∧ b=2) ∨ (a=2 ∧ b=1) :=
    (show ∀a b : Fin 3,a≠0 → b≠0 → a≠b → (a=1 ∧ b=2) ∨ (a=2 ∧ b=1) from by decide) a b ha hb hab
  rcases hab' with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  · exact (four_uniform_diagonal_one hnt hdt).not_gt (four_uniform_diagonal_two hnu hdu)
  · exact (four_uniform_diagonal_one hnu hdu).not_gt (four_uniform_diagonal_two hnt hdt)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: sixAngle_prev
stmt: (j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (j-1)=sixAngle j-(sixty : Angles)
body:
:= by
  have h := sixAngle_step (j-1)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr h.symm
variable {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
def fourInterfaceWord (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) (j : Fin 6) : Fin 3 :=
  fourState c hc x (t+sixAngle j)

name: fourInterfaceWord_shift
stmt: (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) (j : Fin 6) : fourInterfaceWord hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) j=fourInterfaceWord hc x t (j+1)
body:
:= by
  simp only [fourInterfaceWord,sixAngle_step]
  congr 1
  abel

name: four_interface_word_data
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hcompat : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)) : ∃G : Set Angles,Dense G ∧ (∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G) ∧ (∀t∈G,∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) ∧ (∀t∈G,∀j,fourInterfaceWord hc x t j≠0 → fourInterfaceWord hc x t j= interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))) ∧ (∀t∈G,FourWordValid (fourInterfaceWord hc x t)) ∧ ∃ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀t∈G,∀u∈G,dist t u<ε → FourWordCross (fourInterfaceWord hc x t) (fourInterfaceWord hc x u)
body:
:= by
  have hg := four_state_group_of_admissible hc (four_interface_admissible hc hcompat)
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hmargin⟩ := interfaceStateSupport_margin hc hw hg
  let Q (t : Angles) : Prop := (∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) ∧
    (fourState c hc x t≠0 → fourState c hc x t=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)) ∧
    fourState c hc x t≠fourState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) ∧
    ∀s : Fin 3,fourState c hc x t=s → t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s
  have hQ : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,Q t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i)),
      four_interface_state_rule hc hcompat,four_state_changes_of_group hc hw hg,
      interfaceStateSupport_ae hc x] with t hn hr hs hF
    exact ⟨hn,fun h => (hr h).2,hs,hF⟩
  let G : Set Angles := {t | ∀j : Fin 6,Q (t+sixAngle j)}
  have hGae : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈G := ae_all_iff.mpr fun j =>
    (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixAngle j)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hQ
  have hGshift : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G := by
    intro t ht j
    have he : t+(sixty : Angles)+sixAngle j=t+sixAngle (j+1) := by
      rw [sixAngle_step]
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact ht (j+1)
  refine ⟨G,Measure.dense_of_ae hGae,hGshift,fun t ht j => (ht j).1,fun t ht j => (ht j).2.1,?_,ε,hε,?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro j
      simpa only [fourInterfaceWord,sixAngle_step,← add_assoc] using (ht j).2.2.1
    · intro j hj hj3
      dsimp only [fourInterfaceWord]
      rw [(ht (j+3)).2.1 hj3,(ht j).2.1 hj]
      exact four_diagonal_orbit_half (ht j).1
  · intro t ht u hu htu j hj
    have hm := hmargin (fourInterfaceWord hc x t j) hj (t+sixAngle j)
      ((ht j).2.2.2 _ rfl) (u+sixAngle j) (by simpa only [dist_add_right] using htu)
    constructor
    · intro he
      apply hm.1
      have hh := (hu (j+1)).2.2.2 _ he
      simpa only [sixAngle_step,← add_assoc] using hh
    · intro he
      apply hm.2
      have hh := (hu (j-1)).2.2.2 _ he
      simpa only [sixAngle_prev,add_sub_assoc] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: four_word_opposite_geometry_false
stmt: {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t u : Angles} {w z : Fin 6 → Fin 3} (hw : FourWordValid w) (hz : FourWordValid z) (hzero : ∀j,w j=0 → j.val%2=0) (hzero' : ∀j,z j=0 → j.val%2=1) (hcross : FourWordCross w z) (hnt : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hnu : ∀j i,⟪direction (u+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hdt : ∀j,w j≠0 → w j=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))) (hdu : ∀j,z j≠0 → z j=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (u+sixAngle j))) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hab,hwa,hzb⟩ := four_word_opposite_parity w hw hzero z hz hzero' hcross
  apply four_opposite_uniform_diagonals_false hnt hnu ha hb hab
  · apply four_diagonal_uniform_of_parity (p:=0) hnt
    intro j hj
    have hh := hwa j (by norm_num only [Fin.val_zero] at hj; omega)
    exact (hdt j (fun h => ha (hh.symm.trans h))).symm.trans hh
  · apply four_diagonal_uniform_of_parity (p:=1) hnu
    intro j hj
    have hh := hzb j (by norm_num only [Fin.val_one] at hj; omega)
    exact (hdu j (fun h => hb (hh.symm.trans h))).symm.trans hh

name: no_four_word_geometry
stmt: (v : Fin 4 → ℂ) (G : Set Angles) (hG : Dense G) (w : Angles → Fin 6 → Fin 3) (hw : ∀t∈G,FourWordValid (w t)) (hshiftG : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G) (hshift : ∀t∈G,∀j,w (t+(sixty : Angles)) j=w t (j+1)) (hn : ∀t∈G,∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) (hd : ∀t∈G,∀j,w t j≠0 → w t j=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hcross : ∀t∈G,∀u∈G,dist t u<ε → FourWordCross (w t) (w u)) : False
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hnomix := four_words_no_mixed G hG w hw hshiftG hshift hε hcross
  have hpar (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) := four_word_parity (w t) (hw t ht) (hnomix t ht)
  let p : Angles → Fin 2 := fun t => if ht : t∈G then (hpar t ht).choose else 0
  have hp (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) : ∀j,w t j=0 → j.val%2=(p t).val := by
    simpa only [p,dite_eq_left ht] using (hpar t ht).choose_spec
  have hclose (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) (u : Angles) (hu : u∈G) (htu : dist t u<ε) : p t=p u := by
    by_contra hne
    have hcases : (p t=0 ∧ p u=1) ∨ (p t=1 ∧ p u=0) :=
      (show ∀a b : Fin 2,a≠b → (a=0 ∧ b=1) ∨ (a=1 ∧ b=0) from by decide) _ _ hne
    rcases hcases with ⟨hpt,hpu⟩|⟨hpt,hpu⟩
    · exact four_word_opposite_geometry_false (hw t ht) (hw u hu)
        (by simpa only [hpt,Fin.val_zero] using hp t ht)
        (by simpa only [hpu,Fin.val_one] using hp u hu)
        (hcross t ht u hu htu) (hn t ht) (hn u hu) (hd t ht) (hd u hu)
    · exact four_word_opposite_geometry_false (hw u hu) (hw t ht)
        (by simpa only [hpu,Fin.val_zero] using hp u hu)
        (by simpa only [hpt,Fin.val_one] using hp t ht)
        (hcross u hu t ht (by simpa only [dist_comm] using htu))
        (hn u hu) (hn t ht) (hd u hu) (hd t ht)
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hG.nonempty
  have hconst : ∀u∈G,p u=p t := by
    apply dense_isolated_value_constant hG p hε ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
    intro u hu hut z hz huz
    exact (hclose u hu z hz huz).symm.trans hut
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := four_word_has_outsider (w (t+(sixty : Angles))) (hw _ (hshiftG t ht))
  have hh := four_word_shift_parity (w t) (p t) (hp t ht) j
    (by simpa only [hshift t ht j] using hj)
  have hh' := hp _ (hshiftG t ht) j hj
  rw [hconst _ (hshiftG t ht)] at hh'
  have he : (p t).val=(p t+1).val := hh'.symm.trans hh
  exact (show ∀a : Fin 2,a.val≠(a+1).val from by decide) (p t) he

name: no_four_interfaces
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 4 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈fourEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hshiftG,hn,hd,hw',ε,hε,hcross⟩ := four_interface_word_data hc hw hv
    (four_interface_compatible hc hw hv hK hH)
  exact no_four_word_geometry v G hG (fourInterfaceWord hc x) hw' hshiftG
    (fun t _ j => fourInterfaceWord_shift hc x t j) hn hd hε hcross
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: normSq_nonneg
stmt: (a b : ℤ) : 0 ≤ normSq a b
body:
:= by
  unfold normSq
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a + b), sq_nonneg b]

name: normSq_pos
stmt: {a b : ℤ} (h : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) : 0 < normSq a b
body:
:= by
  unfold normSq
  rcases h with ha | hb
  · have ha' : 0 < a ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + 2 * b)]
  · have hb' : 0 < b ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a + b)]

name: seven_dvd_normSq
stmt: {a b : ℤ} (h : 7 ∣ a + 3 * b) : 7 ∣ normSq a b
body:
:= by
  have hi : normSq a b = (a + 3 * b) * (a - 2 * b) + 7 * b ^ 2 := by
    unfold normSq
    ring
  rw [hi]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h _) (dvd_mul_right _ _)

name: normSq_ge_seven
stmt: {a b : ℤ} (h : 7 ∣ a + 3 * b) (hn : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) : 7 ≤ normSq a b
body:
:= by
  exact Int.le_of_dvd (normSq_pos hn) (seven_dvd_normSq h)

name: color_eq_iff_dvd
stmt: {a b c d : ℤ} : color a b = color c d ↔ 7 ∣ (a - c) + 3 * (b - d)
body:
:= by
  have hd := ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd ((a - c) + 3 * (b - d)) 7
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hd
  rw [← hd]
  change color a b = color c d ↔ (((a - c) + 3 * (b - d) : ℤ) : ZMod 7) = 0
  simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_ofNat]
  unfold color
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

name: same_color_separation
stmt: {a b c d : ℤ} (hc : color a b = color c d) (hne : (a, b) ≠ (c, d)) : 7 ≤ normSq (a - c) (b - d)
body:
:= by
  apply normSq_ge_seven (color_eq_iff_dvd.mp hc)
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hne
  apply Prod.ext <;> omega

                                                                           
def colorFin (a b : ℤ) : Fin 7 := color a b

name: colorFin_injective_value
stmt: {a b c d : ℤ} (h : colorFin a b = colorFin c d) : color a b = color c d
body:
:= h

name: exists_measurable_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
stmt: {X I : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [Countable I] [Nonempty I] {k : ℕ} (center : I → X) (color : I → Fin k) (r : ℝ) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : I, dist x (center i) ≤ r) (hdiam : 2 * r < 1) (hsep : ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → color i = color j → 1 + 2 * r < dist (center i) (center j)) : ∃ c : X → Fin k, Measurable c ∧ ∀ x y : X, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_surjective_nat I
  have hcoverNat : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ, dist x (center (e n)) ≤ r := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover x
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := he i
    exact ⟨n, hi⟩
  let pick : X → ℕ := fun x => Nat.find (hcoverNat x)
  have hpick : Measurable pick := by
    apply measurable_find hcoverNat
    intro n
    exact (isClosed_le (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).measurableSet
  let cell : X → I := fun x => e (pick x)
  have hcell (x : X) : dist x (center (cell x)) ≤ r := Nat.find_spec (hcoverNat x)
  refine ⟨fun x => color (cell x), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (measurable_of_countable (fun n => color (e n))).comp hpick
  · intro x y hdist hcolor
    by_cases hsame : cell x = cell y
    · have htriangle := dist_triangle x (center (cell x)) y
      have hx := hcell x
      have hy := hcell y
      rw [← hsame] at hy
      rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) y] at htriangle
      linarith
    · have hfar := hsep (cell x) (cell y) hsame hcolor
      have htriangle₁ := dist_triangle (center (cell x)) x (center (cell y))
      have htriangle₂ := dist_triangle x y (center (cell y))
      have hx := hcell x
      have hy := hcell y
      rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) x] at htriangle₁
      linarith

end Problem160

end

stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : Plane → Fin k) (hc : AEMeasurable c volume) (hproper : ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y) : WeakMeasurableColoring k

name: connected_escape_holes
stmt: {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {t : ℝ} (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius) (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)) (hsum : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K) {a b : ℂ} (ha : a∈K) (hb : b∈K) (hab : 2*t<dist a b) : ∃a'∈K,a'∉diskHoles S ∧ dist a a'≤2*t
body:
:= by
  have ht : 0<t := (Finset.sum_nonneg hS).trans_lt hsum
  by_cases haS : a∈diskHoles S
  · obtain ⟨d,hd,had⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp haS
    have hrad : d.radius<t := (MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum hS hd).trans_lt hsum
    have had' : dist a d.center<d.radius := had
    have hbd : d.radius<dist b d.center := by
      by_contra! hh
      have htri := dist_triangle a d.center b
      rw [dist_comm d.center b] at htri
      linarith
    obtain ⟨p,hp,hpd⟩ := hK.intermediate_value ha hb
      (continuous_id.dist continuous_const).continuousOn ⟨had'.le,hbd.le⟩
    refine ⟨p,hp,MarkedDisk.sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd hpd,?_⟩
    change dist p d.center=d.radius at hpd
    have htri := dist_triangle a d.center p
    rw [dist_comm d.center p,hpd] at htri
    linarith
  · exact ⟨a,ha,haS,by simpa using (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) ht).le⟩

name: support_of_positive_diskAverage_limit
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) {a : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 x)) (i : Fin k) (hp : ∀n,0<diskAverage c (ε n) i (a n)) : x∈spatialSupport c i
body:
:= by
  apply (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall x).mpr
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hrU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,dist (a n) x<r/2 := ha.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by positivity))
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,ε n<r/2 := hε.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<r/2))
  obtain ⟨n,han,hεn⟩ := (hnear.and hsmall).exists
  have hsub : Metric.ball (a n) (ε n)⊆U := by
    intro z hz
    apply hrU
    have hh : dist z (a n)<ε n := hz
    have htri := dist_triangle z (a n) x
    change dist z x<r
    linarith
  have hpos := hp n
  rw [diskAverage_area hc] at hpos
  apply pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hzero
  have hzero' : volume (U∩{z | c z=i})=0 := by
    simpa only [spatialSupport,Measure.restrict_apply' (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)] using hzero
  have hball : volume (Metric.ball (a n) (ε n)∩{z | c z=i})=0 :=
    measure_mono_null (inter_subset_inter_left _ hsub) hzero'
  simp only [Measure.real,hball,ENNReal.toReal_zero,zero_div,lt_self_iff_false] at hpos
end EuclideanFiveColor

open scoped Classical

lemma ε_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (a n).ε) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero (fun n => (a n).ε_pos.le) (fun n => (a n).ε_lt.le) ht

name: annuli_tendsto
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} (a : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n => volume (holeAnnuli (a n).disks)) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  apply holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero _ (fun n d hd => ((a n).positive d hd).le)
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd => ((a n).positive d hd).le)
    (fun n => (a n).sum_lt.le) ht

name: positive_average
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α t : ℝ} (hα : α<1/5) (a : FullApprox c α t) (i : Fin 5) (q : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) (hq : q.val∉diskHoles a.disks) (hp : 0<(a.map q).val i) : α<diskAverage c a.ε i q.val
body:
:= by
  rw [a.agrees q hq] at hp
  exact (thresholdMap_pos hc a.ε_pos hα q.val i).mp hp

name: no_large_positive_sequence
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {t : ℕ → ℝ} (F : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (htlim : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) (htsmall : ∀n,t n≤1/16) (i : Fin 5) (hbad : ∀n,∃K : Set ℂ, IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧ (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<((F n).map z).val i) ∧ ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y) : False
body:
:= by
  choose K hK hsub hprob x hx y hy hxy using hbad
  have hxy' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (x n) (y n) := by linarith [htsmall n,hxy n]
  have hyx' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (y n) (x n) := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hxy' n
  choose a haK haH hax using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hx n) (hy n) (hxy' n)
  choose b hbK hbH hby using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hy n) (hx n) (hyx' n)
  have hab (n : ℕ) : 3/2≤dist (a n) (b n) := by
    have h1 := dist_triangle (x n) (a n) (y n)
    have h2 := dist_triangle (a n) (b n) (y n)
    rw [dist_comm (b n) (y n)] at h2
    linarith [hxy n,hax n,hby n,htsmall n]
  obtain ⟨p,hp,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5).prod
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5)).tendsto_subseq (x := fun n => (a n,b n)) (fun n => ⟨hsub n (haK n),hsub n (hbK n)⟩)
  have halim : Tendsto (fun n => a (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hblim : Tendsto (fun n => b (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hpdist : 3/2≤dist p.1 p.2 := ge_of_tendsto (halim.dist hblim) (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hab (φ n)))
  have hεlim := (ε_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hE := (annuli_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hasup : p.1∈spatialSupport c i := support_of_positive_diskAverage_limit hc hεlim halim i
    (fun n => hα.trans (positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨a (φ n),hsub _ (haK _)⟩
      (haH _) (hprob _ _ (haK _))))
  have hexc : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Metric.ball p.1 (1/8)) := by
    apply diskAverage_support_exclusion hc hεlim (fun n => (F (φ n)).ε_pos) hE hα Metric.isOpen_ball i
    intro z hz
    have hane : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (a (φ n)) p.1<1/8 :=
      halim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    have hbne : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (b (φ n)) p.2<1/8 :=
      hblim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    filter_upwards [hane,hbne] with n han hbn hzE
    have hza : dist z (a (φ n))<1 := by
      have hh := dist_triangle z p.1 (a (φ n))
      rw [dist_comm p.1 (a (φ n))] at hh
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    have hzb : 1<dist z (b (φ n)) := by
      have h1 := dist_triangle p.1 z p.2
      have h2 := dist_triangle z (b (φ n)) p.2
      rw [dist_comm p.1 z] at h1
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hunit⟩ := straddle_connected_unit (hK (φ n))
      ⟨a (φ n),haK _,b (φ n),hbK _,hza,hzb⟩
    have hqH : q∉diskHoles (F (φ n)).disks := fun hh => hzE (unit_from_hole_mem_annuli hh hunit)
    have hqprob := positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨q,hsub _ hq⟩ hqH (hprob _ _ hq)
    have hu : ‖q-z‖=1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hunit
    have hh := diskAverage_unit_pair hc hw (F (φ n)).ε_pos hu i
    change diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i z≤1-α
    change α<diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i q at hqprob
    linarith
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hexc hasup (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num))
end FullApprox

name: triangularLattice_zero

name: triangularLattice_norm_sq

name: triangularLattice_dist_sq
stmt: (a b c d : ℤ) : dist (triangularLattice a b) (triangularLattice c d) ^ 2 = (16 / 25 : ℝ) * (((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 + ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)*(b-d : ℤ) + ((b-d : ℤ) : ℝ)^2)

name: triangularLattice_dist_gt_two
stmt: (a b c d : ℤ) (h : 7 ≤ (a-c)^2 + (a-c)*(b-d) + (b-d)^2) : (2 : ℝ) < dist (triangularLattice a b) (triangularLattice c d)

:= by
  have hr : (7 : ℝ) ≤ ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 +
      ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)*(b-d : ℤ) + ((b-d : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 := by
    exact_mod_cast h

  have hd := dist_nonneg (x := triangularLattice a b) (y := triangularLattice c d)

name: square_coordinate_bounds
body:
:= by
  have hu : |x|≤|c|+h := by
    calc |x|=|c+(x-c)| := by congr 1; ring
         _≤|c|+|x-c| := abs_add_le _ _
         _≤|c|+h := by linarith
  have hl : |c|-h≤|x| := by
    have ht : |c|≤|x|+|x-c| := by
      calc |c|=|x-(x-c)| := by congr 1; ring
           _≤|x|+|x-c| := abs_sub _ _
    linarith
  constructor
  · simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr hc) hl 2
  · simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hu 2

name: region_of_rational_bounds
stmt: {x y a b Y H d : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) (hb : b<4) (hY : 0≤Y) (_hH : 0≤H) (hd : 0≤d) (hl : a≤x^2+y^2) (hu : x^2+y^2≤b) (hy : y^2≤Y) (habs : |3*x^2-y^2|≤H) (hg : d≤|x^2+y^2-1|) (hnum : Y*H^2<a^3*(1-b/4)*d^2) : ThreeLabelRegion x y
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hl,lt_of_le_of_lt hu hb,?_⟩
  calc y^2*(3*x^2-y^2)^2 ≤ Y*H^2 := by
         have hpow : (3*x^2-y^2)^2≤H^2 := by
           simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) habs 2
         exact mul_le_mul hy hpow (sq_nonneg _) hY
       _ < a^3*(1-b/4)*d^2 := hnum
       _ ≤ (x^2+y^2)^3*(1-(x^2+y^2)/4)*(x^2+y^2-1)^2 := by
         have hnonneg : 0≤1-b/4 := by linarith
         have hgap : d^2≤(x^2+y^2-1)^2 := by
           simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ hd hg 2
         have hpos : 0≤(x^2+y^2)^3*(1-(x^2+y^2)/4) :=
           mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_trans ha.le hl) _) (by linarith)
         gcongr

name: abs_le_of_bounds
stmt: {x l u c h : ℝ} (hl : l≤x) (hu : x≤u) (hc1 : c-h≤l) (hc2 : u≤c+h) : |x-c|≤h
body:
:= by
  rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith

name: sin_sub_add_product
stmt: (a b : ℝ) : Real.sin (a-b)*Real.sin (a+b)=Real.sin a^2-Real.sin b^2
body:
:= by
  rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add]
  have ha : Real.cos a^2=1-Real.sin a^2 := by linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a]
  have hb : Real.cos b^2=1-Real.sin b^2 := by linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq b]
  calc _ = Real.sin a^2*Real.cos b^2-Real.cos a^2*Real.sin b^2 := by ring
       _ = _ := by rw [ha,hb]; ring

name: sin_three_using_cos
stmt: (a : ℝ) : Real.sin (3*a)=Real.sin a*(4*Real.cos a^2-1)
body:
:= by
  rw [Real.sin_three_mul]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin a*x) (Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a)]

name: polynomial_region_angles
stmt: {z : ℂ} (hz : ThreeLabelRegion z.re z.im) : ∃ t u : ℝ, (Circle.exp t : ℂ)+(Circle.exp u : ℂ)=z ∧ Real.sin (u-t)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (3*t)*Real.sin (3*u)<0
body:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  let p : ℝ := z.arg
  let d : ℝ := Real.arccos (r/2)
  have hr2 : r^2=z.re^2+z.im^2 := by
    change ‖z‖^2=_
    rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  have hr0 : 0<r := by
    have hn : 0≤r := norm_nonneg z
    nlinarith [hz.1]
  have hrlt : r<2 := by nlinarith [hz.2.1]
  have hdcos : Real.cos d=r/2 := Real.cos_arccos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hd0 : 0<d := Real.arccos_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hdlt : d<Real.pi/2 := Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr (by positivity)
  have hdsin : 0<Real.sin d := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hd0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hdsq : Real.sin d^2=1-r^2/4 := by
    have hh := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq d
    rw [hdcos] at hh
    nlinarith
  have hdp : Real.sin (3*d)=Real.sin d*(r^2-1) := by
    rw [sin_three_using_cos,hdcos]; ring
  have hpysin : r*Real.sin p=z.im := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  have hpxcos : r*Real.cos p=z.re := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have hpy : r^3*Real.sin (3*p)=z.im*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2) := by
    rw [Real.sin_three_mul]
    calc _ = 3*r^2*(r*Real.sin p)-4*(r*Real.sin p)^3 := by ring
         _ = _ := by rw [hr2,hpysin]; ring
  have hP : z.im^2*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2)^2=r^6*Real.sin (3*p)^2 := by
    calc _ = (z.im*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2))^2 := by ring
         _ = (r^3*Real.sin (3*p))^2 := by rw [hpy]
         _ = _ := by ring
  have hP' : (z.re^2+z.im^2)^3*(1-(z.re^2+z.im^2)/4)*(z.re^2+z.im^2-1)^2=
      r^6*Real.sin (3*d)^2 := by
    rw [←hr2,hdp]
    rw [show 1-r^2/4=Real.sin d^2 from hdsq.symm]
    ring
  have hlt : Real.sin (3*p)^2<Real.sin (3*d)^2 := by
    have hh := hz.2.2
    rw [hP,hP'] at hh
    exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (pow_pos hr0 6)).mp hh
  refine ⟨p-d,p+d,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Complex.add_re,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,
        ←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,
        sub_zero,zero_mul,add_zero]
      rw [Real.cos_sub,Real.cos_add,hdcos]
      nlinarith
    · simp only [Complex.add_im,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,
        ←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,
        mul_one,add_zero,zero_add]
      rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add,hdcos]
      nlinarith
  · rw [show p+d-(p-d)=2*d by ring,Real.sin_two_mul,hdcos]
    exact ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  · rw [mul_sub,mul_add,sin_sub_add_product]
    linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

    (hf 1 2 (by decide)) (hf 0 1 (by decide)) (hf 0 2 (by decide))
    (hf 3 1 (by decide)) (hf 3 2 (by decide))

    (hf 4 5 (by decide)) (hf 0 4 (by decide)) (hf 0 5 (by decide))
    (hf 6 4 (by decide)) (hf 6 5 (by decide))
  exact hf 3 6 (by decide) (h03.symm.trans h06)

name: not_proper_five_coloring_compl_null
stmt: {Z : Set ℂ} (hZ : volume Z = 0) : ¬ ∃ c : ℂ → Fin 5, ∀ x ∉ Z, ∀ y ∉ Z, ‖x - y‖ = 1 → c x ≠ c y
body:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hsingle : ∀ x : ℂ, volume ((fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z) = 0 := by
    intro x
    have heq : (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z = (fun w : ℂ => w + x) ⁻¹' Z := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; simpa using hz
      · intro h; exact ⟨w + x, h, by ring⟩
    rw [heq, measure_preimage_add_right]
    exact hZ
  have hfin : ∀ F : Finset ℂ, ∃ d : ℂ → Fin 5,
      ∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, ‖x - y‖ = 1 → d x ≠ d y := by
    intro F
    have hbad : volume (⋃ x ∈ (F : Set ℂ), (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z) = 0 := by
      induction F using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | insert a s ha ih =>
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert]
        exact measure_union_null (hsingle a) ih
    have hne : (⋃ x ∈ (F : Set ℂ), (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z) ≠ Set.univ := by
      intro hall
      have hzero : volume (Set.univ : Set ℂ) = 0 := by rw [← hall]; exact hbad
      have hpos : 0 < volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := Metric.measure_ball_pos volume 0 zero_lt_one
      have hle : volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) ≤ volume (Set.univ : Set ℂ) :=
        measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)
      rw [hzero] at hle
      exact hpos.ne' (le_antisymm hle (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, v ∉ ⋃ x ∈ (F : Set ℂ), (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z := by
      by_contra h
      exact hne (Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun v => by by_contra hv; exact h ⟨v, hv⟩)
    refine ⟨fun x => c (x + v), ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxZ : x + v ∉ Z := by
      intro hmem
      exact hv (Set.mem_biUnion hx ⟨x + v, hmem, by ring⟩)
    have hyZ : y + v ∉ Z := by
      intro hmem
      exact hv (Set.mem_biUnion hy ⟨y + v, hmem, by ring⟩)
    exact hc (x + v) hxZ (y + v) hyZ (by simpa only [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hxy)
  exact no_proper_five_coloring (exists_properColoring_of_finset hfin)

end EuclideanFiveColor

name: weak_strong_disjoint
stmt: {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {F : ℕ → X → ℝ} {b : X → ℝ} {G : ℕ → X × Y → ℝ} {g : X × Y → ℝ} (hF : ∀ n, Measurable (F n)) (hb : Measurable b) (hG : ∀ n, Measurable (G n)) (hg : Measurable g) (hFb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ F n x ∧ F n x ≤ 1) (hbb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1) (hGb : ∀ n p, 0 ≤ G n p ∧ G n p ≤ 1) (hgb : ∀ p, 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p ≤ 1) (hw : ∀ v : X → ℝ, Integrable v μ → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, F n x*v x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, b x*v x ∂μ))) (hs : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, ‖G n p-g p‖ ∂μ.prod ν) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hz : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ p ∂μ.prod ν, F n p.1*G n p=0) : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ.prod ν, b p.1*g p=0
body:
:= by
  have hgi : Integrable g (μ.prod ν) := Integrable.of_bound hg.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hgb p).1]; exact (hgb p).2)
  have hFi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p : X × Y => F n p.1*g p) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (((hF n).comp measurable_fst).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      change ‖F n p.1*g p‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hFb n p.1).1 (hgb p).1)]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 (hFb n p.1).2).trans (hgb p).2
  have hbi : Integrable (fun p : X × Y => b p.1*g p) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hb.comp measurable_fst).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hbb] with p hp
    change ‖b p.1*g p‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1)]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 hp.2).trans (hgb p).2
  have herr (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p => ‖G n p-g p‖) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hG n).sub hg).norm.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [norm_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
      change -1 ≤ G n p-g p ∧ G n p-g p ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hGb n p).1,(hGb n p).2,(hgb p).1,(hgb p).2]
  have hi0 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, F n p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg fun p => mul_nonneg (hFb n p.1).1 (hgb p).1) _ hs
    intro n
    apply integral_mono_ae (hFi n) (herr n)
    filter_upwards [hz n] with p hp
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      F n p.1*g p = F n p.1*(g p-G n p) := by rw [mul_sub,hp,sub_zero]
      _ ≤ |g p-G n p| := by
        calc
          _ ≤ F n p.1*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) (hFb n p.1).1
          _ ≤ 1*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hFb n p.1).2 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := one_mul _
      _ = |G n p-g p| := abs_sub_comm _ _
  let v : X → ℝ := fun x => ∫ y, g (x,y) ∂ν
  have hvi : Integrable v μ := hgi.integral_prod_left
  have hlim := hw v hvi
  have hconvert (f : X → ℝ) (hi : Integrable (fun p : X × Y => f p.1*g p) (μ.prod ν)) :
      (∫ p, f p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν) = ∫ x, f x*v x ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_prod _ hi]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      exact integral_const_mul (f x) (fun y => g (x,y))
  have he0 : (∫ p, b p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν)=0 := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, F n p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ p, b p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν)) := by
      simpa only [hconvert b hbi,hconvert (F _) (hFi _)] using hlim
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht hi0
  exact (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
    ((Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hbb).mono fun p hp => mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1) hbi).mp he0
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
def colorIndicator (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℝ := if c z=i then 1 else 0
include hc in

name: colorIndicator_measurable
stmt: (i : Fin k) : Measurable (colorIndicator c i)
body:
:=
  measurable_one.piecewise (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const) measurable_zero

name: colorIndicator_bounds
stmt: (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ colorIndicator c i z ∧ colorIndicator c i z ≤ 1
body:
:= by
  simp only [colorIndicator]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
include hc in

name: sample_pair_disjoint
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {y : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hy : TypicalSampling c y r) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, sampleFn c y r i p.1*colorIndicator c i (angularSum y r p)=0
body:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, Typical c (y+(r : ℂ)*direction p.1) :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hy.2
  have h2 := (angularSum_quasiMeasurePreserving y hy.1.ne').ae (ae_density_actual c hc)
  filter_upwards [h1,h2] with p hp1 hp2
  by_cases ha : c (y+(r : ℂ)*direction p.1)=i
  · have hb : c (angularSum y r p) ≠ i := by
      intro hb
      have hdist : ‖(y+(r : ℂ)*direction p.1)-angularSum y r p‖=1 := by
        simp [angularSum]
      apply weak_density_proper c hc hw i hdist
      · simpa only [Typical,ha] using hp1
      · simpa only [hb] using hp2
    simp [sampleFn,colorIndicator,ha,hb]
  · simp [sampleFn,ha]

name: trace_pair_disjoint
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc x b) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, traceValue b i p.1*colorIndicator c i (angularSum x 1 p)=0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y,r,ht,hy,hr,hweak⟩ := trace_realization_weakStar c hc hb
  have hbnd := trace_bounds c hc hb
  apply weak_strong_disjoint (F := fun n => sampleFn c (y n) (r n) i)
    (G := fun n p => colorIndicator c i (angularSum (y n) (r n) p))
    (fun n => sampleFn_measurable c hc (y n) (r n) i) (Lp.stronglyMeasurable _).measurable
    (fun n => (colorIndicator_measurable c hc i).comp (angularSum_measurable _ _))
    ((colorIndicator_measurable c hc i).comp (angularSum_measurable _ _))
    (fun n t => ⟨sampleFn_nonneg c _ _ _ t,sampleFn_le_one c _ _ _ t⟩)
    (Eventually.and (hbnd.1 i) (hbnd.2.1 i))
    (fun n p => colorIndicator_bounds c i _) (fun p => colorIndicator_bounds c i _)
    (hweak i) (angularSum_tendsto_L1 hr hy (colorIndicator_measurable c hc i) (colorIndicator_bounds c i))
    (fun n => sample_pair_disjoint c hc hw (ht n) i)

name: palette_first_exclusion
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, p.1 ∈ paletteSet c hc x i → c (angularSum x 1 p) ≠ i
body:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, ∀ b ∈ paletteGenerators c hc x i,
      traceValue b.1 i p.1*colorIndicator c i (angularSum x 1 p)=0 :=
    (ae_ball_iff (paletteGenerators_countable c hc x i)).mpr
      (fun b _ => trace_pair_disjoint c hc hw b.2 i)
  filter_upwards [hall] with p hp
  intro hm he
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hpos⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hm
  have hzero := hp b hb
  have hval : colorIndicator c i (angularSum x 1 p)=1 := by simp [colorIndicator,he]
  rw [hval,mul_one] at hzero
  exact (show 0 < traceValue b.1 i p.1 from hpos).ne' hzero

name: palette_second_exclusion
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, p.2 ∈ paletteSet c hc x i → c (angularSum x 1 p) ≠ i
body:
:= by
  have h := (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := angularMeasure) (ν := angularMeasure)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i)
  simp only [Prod.swap,angularSum,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] at h ⊢
  filter_upwards [h] with p hp
  convert hp using 1; rw [add_right_comm]

name: palette_transfer_pair
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐ p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure, c (angularSum x 1 p) ∉ palette c hc x p.1 ∪ palette c hc x p.2
body:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i).and
    (palette_second_exclusion c hc hw x i))] with p hp
  simpa only [Finset.mem_union,mem_palette,not_or] using
    And.intro (fun h => (hp _).1 h rfl) (fun h => (hp _).2 h rfl)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving
stmt: : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) volume angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) := (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).measurable
  refine ⟨hm,Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun A hA hz => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply hm hA]
  have hzv : (volume : Measure Angles) A=0 := by
    rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,Measure.smul_apply]
    change ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi) * angularMeasure A=0
    rw [hz,mul_zero]
  have hh (n : ℤ) : volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A ∩
      Ioc (n • (2*Real.pi)) ((n+1) • (2*Real.pi)))=0 := by
    have h := (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) (n • (2*Real.pi))).quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null hzv
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply' measurableSet_Ioc] at h
    simpa only [add_zsmul,one_zsmul] using h
  have hcov := iUnion_Ioc_zsmul (by positivity : 0 < 2*Real.pi)
  have he : ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A = ⋃ n : ℤ,
      ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A ∩ Ioc (n • (2*Real.pi)) ((n+1) • (2*Real.pi)) := by
    rw [← inter_iUnion,hcov,inter_univ]
  rw [he]
  exact measure_iUnion_null hh

    angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving using 1; rfl

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def FlatDensityZero (A : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume.real (A ∩ Metric.closedBall p r)/r^2) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
def LineDensityZero (D : Set ℝ) (t : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume.real (D ∩ Metric.closedBall t r)/r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)

name: volume_image_bound
stmt: {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {K : ℝ≥0} (hF : LipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (A : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hA : A ⊆ s) : volume (F '' A) ≤ (K : ENNReal)^2 * volume A
body:
:= by
  let B : Set s := Subtype.val ⁻¹' A
  have he1 : (s.domRestrict F) '' B = F '' A := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩; exact ⟨z.1,hz,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨z,hA hz⟩,hz,rfl⟩
  have he2 : Subtype.val '' B = A := by
    ext z
    exact ⟨fun ⟨q,hq,he⟩ => he ▸ hq,fun hz => ⟨⟨z,hA hz⟩,hz,rfl⟩⟩
  have hi := (isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : s → ℝ × ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image
    (Or.inl (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2)) B
  have ha := hF.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2) B
  rw [he1,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real,ENNReal.rpow_two] at ha
  rw [he2,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real] at hi
  rwa [← hi] at ha

name: FlatDensityZero.mono_ae
stmt: {A B : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hb : FlatDensityZero B p) (hAB : A ≤ᵐ[volume] B) : FlatDensityZero A p
body:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero (fun r => div_nonneg (measureReal_nonneg) (sq_nonneg r)) _ hb
  intro r
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg r)
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono
  · exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall p r).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  · exact measure_mono_ae (hAB.mono fun z hz h => ⟨hz h.1,h.2⟩)

name: flatDensityZero_prod
stmt: {D : Set ℝ} {t u : ℝ} (hD : LineDensityZero D t) : FlatDensityZero (D ×ˢ univ) (t,u)
body:
:= by
  have h := hD.const_mul 2
  simp only [mul_zero] at h
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  have hp : 0 < r := hr
  rw [← closedBall_prod_same,prod_inter_prod,univ_inter,Measure.volume_eq_prod]
  simp only [Measure.real,Measure.prod_prod,ENNReal.toReal_mul,Real.volume_closedBall,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*r)]
  change 2*(volume.real (D ∩ Metric.closedBall t r)/r) =
    volume.real (D ∩ Metric.closedBall t r)*(2*r)/r^2
  field_simp [hp.ne']

name: tendsto_pos_mul_nhdsWithin
stmt: {a : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => a*r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[>] 0)
body:
:= by
  apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)))
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    exact mul_pos ha hr

name: FlatDensityZero.image
stmt: {D s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {p : ℝ × ℝ} {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} {K L : ℝ≥0} (hD : FlatDensityZero D p) (hps : p ∈ s) (hF : LipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (hA : AntilipschitzWith L (s.domRestrict F)) (hL : 0 < L) : FlatDensityZero (F '' (D ∩ s)) (F p)
body:
:= by
  have h := (hD.comp (tendsto_pos_mul_nhdsWithin (show 0 < (L : ℝ) from hL))).const_mul
    ((K : ℝ)^2*(L : ℝ)^2)
  simp only [mul_zero] at h
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun r => div_nonneg measureReal_nonneg (sq_nonneg r)) _ h
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  have hp : 0 < r := hr
  let E : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := D ∩ s ∩ Metric.closedBall p ((L : ℝ)*r)
  have he : F '' (D ∩ s) ∩ Metric.closedBall (F p) r ⊆ F '' E := by
    rintro z ⟨⟨q,hq,rfl⟩,hz⟩
    refine ⟨q,⟨hq,?_⟩,rfl⟩
    exact (hA.le_mul_dist ⟨q,hq.2⟩ ⟨p,hps⟩).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz L.2)
  have hm := (measure_mono he).trans (volume_image_bound hF E (fun q hq => hq.1.2))
  have hsub : E ⊆ D ∩ Metric.closedBall p ((L : ℝ)*r) := fun q hq => ⟨hq.1.1,hq.2⟩
  have hfin : volume (D ∩ Metric.closedBall p ((L : ℝ)*r)) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall _ _).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  have hm' := hm.trans (mul_le_mul (le_refl _) (measure_mono hsub) bot_le bot_le)
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by finiteness) hfin) hm'
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul,ENNReal.toReal_pow,ENNReal.coe_toReal] at hreal
  calc
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ)^2*volume.real (D ∩ Metric.closedBall p ((L : ℝ)*r))/r^2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hreal (sq_nonneg r)
    _ = _ := by
      change _ = ((K : ℝ)^2*(L : ℝ)^2)*
        (volume.real (D ∩ Metric.closedBall p ((L : ℝ)*r))/((L : ℝ)*r)^2)
      have hLr : (L : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hL
      field_simp [hp.ne',hLr]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: FlatDensityZero.of_locally_le
stmt: {A B s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hb : FlatDensityZero B p) (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 p) (hAB : (A ∩ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ≤ᵐ[volume] B) : FlatDensityZero A p
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsδ⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hs
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun r => div_nonneg measureReal_nonneg (sq_nonneg r)) _ hb
  filter_upwards [(eventually_lt_nhds hδ).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with r hr
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg r)
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono
  · exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall p r).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  · apply measure_mono_ae
    filter_upwards [hAB] with q hq
    intro hqa
    exact ⟨hq ⟨hqa.1,hsδ (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr hqa.2)⟩,hqa.2⟩

name: FlatDensityZero.transport
stmt: {A D s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {p : ℝ × ℝ} {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} {K L : ℝ≥0} (hD : FlatDensityZero D p) (hps : p ∈ s) (hs : F '' s ∈ 𝓝 (F p)) (hF : LipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (hA : AntilipschitzWith L (s.domRestrict F)) (hL : 0 < L) (hAD : (F ⁻¹' A ∩ s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ≤ᵐ[volume] D) : FlatDensityZero A (F p)
body:
:= by
  let N := (F ⁻¹' A ∩ s) \ D
  have hN : volume N=0 := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (hAD.mono fun q hq h => h.2 (hq h.1))
  have himg : volume (F '' N)=0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (zero_le : (0 : ENNReal) ≤ volume (F '' N))
    simpa only [hN,mul_zero] using volume_image_bound hF N (fun q hq => hq.1.2)
  apply (hD.image hps hF hA hL).of_locally_le hs
  filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp himg] with q hq
  rintro ⟨hqa,⟨t,ht,rfl⟩⟩
  by_cases hd : t ∈ D
  · exact ⟨t,⟨hd,ht⟩,rfl⟩
  · exact (hq ⟨t,⟨⟨hqa,ht⟩,hd⟩,rfl⟩).elim
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: circleSum_one_lipschitz
stmt: : LipschitzWith 2 (circleSum 1)
body:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro a b
  have h₁ := realDirection_lipschitz.dist_le_mul a.1 b.1
  have h₂ := realDirection_lipschitz.dist_le_mul a.2 b.2
  have h := dist_add_add_le (Real.cos a.1,Real.sin a.1) (Real.cos a.2,Real.sin a.2)
    (Real.cos b.1,Real.sin b.1) (Real.cos b.2,Real.sin b.2)
  have he (p : RealPlane) : circleSum 1 p =
      (Real.cos p.1,Real.sin p.1)+(Real.cos p.2,Real.sin p.2) := by simp [circleSum]
  rw [he a,he b]
  norm_num only [NNReal.coe_ofNat,NNReal.coe_one,one_mul] at *
  have ha : dist a.1 b.1 ≤ dist a b := by rw [Prod.dist_eq]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hb : dist a.2 b.2 ≤ dist a b := by rw [Prod.dist_eq]; exact le_max_right _ _
  linarith

name: circleSum_densityZero
stmt: {D : Set ℝ} {A : Set RealPlane} {t u : ℝ} (x : RealPlane) (hD : LineDensityZero D t) (hu : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) (hAD : ∀ᵐ q : RealPlane ∂volume, x+circleSum 1 q ∈ A → q.1 ∈ D) : FlatDensityZero A (x+circleSum 1 (t,u))
body:
:= by
  let F : RealPlane → RealPlane := fun q => x+circleSum 1 q
  have hreg : (1 : ℝ)*Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [one_mul] using hu
  obtain ⟨s,hso,hps,K,hK⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) hreg
  have ha : AntilipschitzWith (K+1) (s.domRestrict F) := by
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro a b
    have h := hK.le_mul_dist a b
    simp only [domRestrict] at h
    simp only [domRestrict,F,dist_add_left,NNReal.coe_add,NNReal.coe_one]
    nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := circleSum 1 a.1) (y := circleSum 1 b.1)]
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) hreg
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt F (L : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane) (t,u) :=
    (circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).const_add x
  have him : F '' s ∈ 𝓝 (F (t,u)) := by
    rw [← hd.map_nhds_eq_of_equiv]
    exact image_mem_map (hso.mem_nhds hps)
  have hl : LipschitzWith 2 F := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun a b => by
    simpa only [F,dist_add_left] using circleSum_one_lipschitz.dist_le_mul a b
  apply (flatDensityZero_prod hD).transport hps him
    (show LipschitzWith 2 (s.domRestrict F) from fun a b => hl a.1 b.1) ha (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hAD] with q hq
  rintro ⟨hm,_⟩
  exact ⟨hq hm,mem_univ _⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
