name: complex_ball_flat_ball
stmt: {z w : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (h : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z r) : Complex.equivRealProdCLM w ∈ Metric.closedBall (Complex.equivRealProdCLM z) r
body:
:= by
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm] at h ⊢
  change max ‖w.re-z.re‖ ‖w.im-z.im‖ ≤ r
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im] using
    max_le ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w-z)).trans h) ((Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w-z)).trans h)

name: flat_to_complex_densityZero
stmt: {A : Set ℂ} {z : ℂ} (h : FlatDensityZero (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm ⁻¹' A) (Complex.equivRealProdCLM z)) : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z r)/volume (Metric.closedBall z r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ENNReal))
body:
:= by
  have ht := h.const_mul (Real.pi)⁻¹
  simp only [mul_zero] at ht
  have he := ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] at he
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds he
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => zero_le) ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  have hp : 0 < r := hr
  let B := Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm ⁻¹' A ∩ Metric.closedBall (Complex.equivRealProdCLM z) r
  have hm : volume (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z r) ≤ (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) B := by
    apply (measure_mono (t := Complex.equivRealProdCLM ⁻¹' B) ?_).trans
      (Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage_le B)
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨by simpa only [Set.mem_preimage,ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hw.1,complex_ball_flat_ball hw.2⟩
  have hfin : (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) B ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall _ _).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  have hfinA : volume (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z r) ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall z r).measure_ne_top
    (measure_mono (s := A ∩ Metric.closedBall z r) inter_subset_right)
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (ENNReal.div_ne_top hfinA
    (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume z hp).ne') ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_div,Complex.volume_closedBall,ENNReal.toReal_mul,ENNReal.toReal_pow,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le,ENNReal.coe_toReal,NNReal.coe_real_pi,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
  calc
    _ ≤ volume.real B/(r^2*Real.pi) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin hm) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by dsimp [B]; ring

name: flat_density_not_one
stmt: {A : Set ℂ} {z : ℂ} (h : FlatDensityZero (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm ⁻¹' A) (Complex.equivRealProdCLM z)) : ¬ DensityOne A z
body:
:= by
  intro hd
  have he := tendsto_nhds_unique (flat_to_complex_densityZero h) hd
  exact zero_ne_one he
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_lineDensityZero_compl
stmt: {D : Set ℝ} (hD : MeasurableSet D) : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, t ∈ D → LineDensityZero Dᶜ t
body:
:= by
  have hh := Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet volume hD.compl
  filter_upwards [hh] with t ht htd
  rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Dᶜ from by simpa only [mem_compl_iff,not_not] using htd)] at ht
  have hreal := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (by simp : (0 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤)).comp ht
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_zero,Function.comp_def,ENNReal.toReal_div] at hreal
  have h := hreal.const_mul 2
  simp only [mul_zero] at h
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  have hp : 0 < r := hr
  rw [Real.volume_closedBall,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*r)]
  change 2*(volume.real (Dᶜ ∩ Metric.closedBall t r)/(2*r)) = _
  field_simp
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: palette_spatial_densityZero
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i : Fin k} {t u : ℝ} (ht : LineDensityZero (liftPalette c hc x i)ᶜ t) (hu : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume ({z | c z=i} ∩ Metric.closedBall (angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t,u))) r)/ volume (Metric.closedBall (angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t,u))) r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ENNReal))
body:
:= by

  have he := anglePair_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i)
  have hAD : ∀ᵐ q : RealPlane ∂volume, Complex.equivRealProdCLM x+circleSum 1 q ∈

name: palette_spatial_not_densityOne
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i : Fin k} {t u : ℝ} (ht : LineDensityZero (liftPalette c hc x i)ᶜ t) (hu : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) : ¬ DensityOne {z | c z=i} (angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t,u)))

name: palette_sample_branch_exclusion
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x y : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hy : TypicalSampling c y r) (i : Fin k) {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) {s t : ℝ → ℝ} (hq : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving s (volume.restrict I) volume) (hn : ∀ f ∈ I, Real.sin (t f-s f) ≠ 0) (he : ∀ f ∈ I, y+(r : ℂ)*direction (f : Angles)=angularSum x 1 (angleChart (s f,t f))) : ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict I, sampleFn c y r i (f : Angles)*(liftPalette c hc x i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (s f)=0

  have ht := ae_restrict_of_ae (s := I) (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hy.2)

name: angleRep_preserving
stmt: (a : ℝ) : MeasurePreserving (fun t : Angles => (AddCircle.equivIoc (2*Real.pi) a t : ℝ)) volume (volume.restrict (Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi)))
body:
:=
  (measurePreserving_subtype_coe measurableSet_Ioc).comp (AddCircle.measurePreserving_equivIoc _)

name: weak_lift_Ioc
stmt: {F : ℕ → Angles → ℝ} {b : Angles → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v : Angles → ℝ, Integrable v angularMeasure → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, F n t*v t ∂angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t, b t*v t ∂angularMeasure))) (a : ℝ) (v : ℝ → ℝ) (hv : Integrable v (volume.restrict (Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi)))) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t in Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi), F n (t : Angles)*v t) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t in Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi), b (t : Angles)*v t))
body:
:= by
  let V : Angles → ℝ := AddCircle.liftIoc (2*Real.pi) a v
  have hvi : Integrable V (volume : Measure Angles) := (angleRep_preserving a).integrable_comp_of_integrable hv
  have hva : Integrable V angularMeasure := by
    rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle] at hvi
    exact (integrable_smul_measure (by positivity : ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi) ≠ 0) (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).mp hvi
  have h := (hw V hva).const_mul (2*Real.pi)
  have he (f : Angles → ℝ) : (∫ t in Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi), f (t : Angles)*v t) =
      (2*Real.pi)*(∫ t, f t*V t ∂angularMeasure) := by
    have hpre := AddCircle.integral_preimage (2*Real.pi) a (fun t => f t*V t)
    have hi : (∫ t in Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi), f (t : Angles)*v t) =
        ∫ t in Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi), f (t : Angles)*V (t : Angles) := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc
      intro t ht
      change f (t : Angles)*v t=f (t : Angles)*V (t : Angles)
      rw [show V (t : Angles)=v t from AddCircle.liftIoc_coe_apply ht]
    rw [hi,hpre,AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,integral_smul_measure,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*Real.pi),smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  simpa only [← he] using h

name: weak_restrict
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {F : ℕ → X → ℝ} {b : X → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v : X → ℝ, Integrable v μ → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, F n t*v t ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t, b t*v t ∂μ))) {I : Set X} (hI : MeasurableSet I) : ∀ v : X → ℝ, Integrable v (μ.restrict I) → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, F n t*v t ∂μ.restrict I) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t, b t*v t ∂μ.restrict I))
body:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hvi : Integrable (I.indicator v) μ := (integrable_indicator_iff hI).mpr hv
  have h := hw (I.indicator v) hvi
  have he (f : X → ℝ) : (fun t => f t*I.indicator v t)=I.indicator (fun t => f t*v t) := by
    funext t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ I <;> simp [ht]
  simpa only [he,integral_indicator hI] using h

name: weak_lift_set
stmt: {F : ℕ → Angles → ℝ} {b : Angles → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v : Angles → ℝ, Integrable v angularMeasure → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, F n t*v t ∂angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t, b t*v t ∂angularMeasure))) {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) {a : ℝ} (hIa : I ⊆ Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi)) : ∀ v : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable v (volume.restrict I) → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t in I, F n (t : Angles)*v t) atTop (𝓝 (∫ t in I, b (t : Angles)*v t))
body:
:= by
  have h := weak_restrict (weak_lift_Ioc hw a) hI
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_restrict hI,inter_eq_left.mpr hIa] using h

name: weak_strong_disjoint_single
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {F : ℕ → X → ℝ} {b : X → ℝ} {G : ℕ → X → ℝ} {g : X → ℝ} (hF : ∀ n, Measurable (F n)) (hb : Measurable b) (hG : ∀ n, Measurable (G n)) (hg : Measurable g) (hFb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ F n x ∧ F n x ≤ 1) (hbb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1) (hGb : ∀ n p, 0 ≤ G n p ∧ G n p ≤ 1) (hgb : ∀ p, 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p ≤ 1) (hw : ∀ v : X → ℝ, Integrable v μ → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, F n x*v x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, b x*v x ∂μ))) (hs : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, ‖G n p-g p‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hz : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, F n p*G n p=0) : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, b p*g p=0
body:
:= by
  have hgi : Integrable g (μ) := Integrable.of_bound hg.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hgb p).1]; exact (hgb p).2)
  have hFi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p : X => F n p*g p) (μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hF n).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      change ‖F n p*g p‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hFb n p).1 (hgb p).1)]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 (hFb n p).2).trans (hgb p).2
  have hbi : Integrable (fun p : X => b p*g p) (μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hb.mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [hbb] with p hp
    change ‖b p*g p‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1)]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 hp.2).trans (hgb p).2
  have herr (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p => ‖G n p-g p‖) (μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hG n).sub hg).norm.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [norm_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
      change -1 ≤ G n p-g p ∧ G n p-g p ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hGb n p).1,(hGb n p).2,(hgb p).1,(hgb p).2]
  have hi0 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, F n p*g p ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg fun p => mul_nonneg (hFb n p).1 (hgb p).1) _ hs
    intro n
    apply integral_mono_ae (hFi n) (herr n)
    filter_upwards [hz n] with p hp
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      F n p*g p = F n p*(g p-G n p) := by rw [mul_sub,hp,sub_zero]
      _ ≤ |g p-G n p| := by
        calc
          _ ≤ F n p*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) (hFb n p).1
          _ ≤ 1*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hFb n p).2 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := one_mul _
      _ = |G n p-g p| := abs_sub_comm _ _
  have he0 : (∫ p, b p*g p ∂μ)=0 := tendsto_nhds_unique (hw g hgi) hi0
  exact (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
    (hbb.mono fun p hp => mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1) hbi).mp he0

name: weak_strong_disjoint_single_eventual
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {F : ℕ → X → ℝ} {b : X → ℝ} {G : ℕ → X → ℝ} {g : X → ℝ} (hF : ∀ n, Measurable (F n)) (hb : Measurable b) (hG : ∀ n, Measurable (G n)) (hg : Measurable g) (hFb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ F n x ∧ F n x ≤ 1) (hbb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1) (hGb : ∀ n p, 0 ≤ G n p ∧ G n p ≤ 1) (hgb : ∀ p, 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p ≤ 1) (hw : ∀ v : X → ℝ, Integrable v μ → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, F n x*v x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, b x*v x ∂μ))) (hs : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, ‖G n p-g p‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hz : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, F n p*G n p=0) : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, b p*g p=0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hz
  exact weak_strong_disjoint_single (fun n => hF (n+N)) hb (fun n => hG (n+N)) hg
    (fun n => hFb (n+N)) hbb (fun n => hGb (n+N)) hgb
    (fun v hv => (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mpr (hw v hv))
    ((tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mpr hs) (fun n => hN _ (Nat.le_add_left N n))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)

name: palette_trace_branch
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x z : ℂ} {t u a : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) {P : Set CircleParameter} {I : Set ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hP : P ∈ 𝓝 (samplingParameter x z 1)) (hI : MeasurableSet I) (hIa : I ⊆ Ioc a (a+2*Real.pi)) (hA : ∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun v => circleEndpoint h (q,v)))) (hB : ∀ q ∈ P, ∀ v ∈ I, circleTarget (q,v) ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧ Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleTarget (q,v))).2-(circleInverse h (circleTarget (q,v))).1) ≠ 0 ∧ circleEndpoint h (q,v) ∈ Metric.closedBall t 1) {b : TraceVector k} (hb : IsTrace c hc z b) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict I, traceValue b i (f : Angles)* (liftPalette c hc x i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter x z 1,f))=0
body:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict I) := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
    (ne_of_lt ((measure_mono (hIa.trans Ioc_subset_Icc_self)).trans_lt isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top))
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall t 1)) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr (isCompact_closedBall t 1).measure_lt_top.ne
  have hp : samplingParameter x z 1 ∈ P := mem_of_mem_nhds hP
  obtain ⟨y,r,hy,hyt,hrt,hwt⟩ := trace_realization_weakStar c hc hb
  let p : ℕ → CircleParameter := fun n => samplingParameter x (y n) (r n)
  let p₀ := samplingParameter x z 1
  let T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n f => circleEndpoint h (p n,f)
  let S : ℝ → ℝ := fun f => circleEndpoint h (p₀,f)
  have hpt : Tendsto p atTop (𝓝 p₀) := samplingParameter_tendsto hyt hrt
  have hpn : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, p n ∈ P := hpt hP
  have hTm (n : ℕ) : Measurable (T n) :=
    (circleEndpoint_measurable h).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have hSm : Measurable S := (circleEndpoint_measurable h).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  let D := liftPalette c hc x i
  have hDm : MeasurableSet D := liftPalette_measurable c hc x i
  have hDind : Measurable (D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) := measurable_const.indicator hDm
  have hs : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ f in I, ‖D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (T n f)-
      D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (S f)‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply line_indicator_pullback_L1 hTm hSm (isCompact_closedBall t 1) hDm
    · exact hpn.mono fun n hn => hA (p n) hn
    · exact hA p₀ hp
    · exact hpn.mono fun n hn f hf => (hB (p n) hn f hf).2.2
    · exact fun f hf => (hB p₀ hp f hf).2.2
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hI] with f hf
      exact ((circleInverse_continuousAt h (hB p₀ hp f hf).1).fst.comp
        circleTarget_continuous.continuousAt).tendsto.comp (hpt.prodMk_nhds tendsto_const_nhds)
  have hz : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict I,
      sampleFn c (y n) (r n) i (f : Angles)*D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (T n f)=0 := by
    filter_upwards [hpn] with n hn
    exact palette_sample_branch_exclusion c hc hw (hy n) i hI
      (line_antilipschitz_qmp (hTm n) (hA (p n) hn))
      (fun f hf => (hB (p n) hn f hf).2.1)
      (fun f hf => circleInverse_sampling h (hB (p n) hn f hf).1)
  have hbb : ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict I, 0 ≤ traceValue b i (f : Angles) ∧ traceValue b i (f : Angles) ≤ 1 :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (((trace_bounds c hc hb).1 i).and ((trace_bounds c hc hb).2.1 i)))
  have hgi (f : ℝ) : 0 ≤ D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) f ∧ D.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) f ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hf : f ∈ D <;> simp [hf]
  exact weak_strong_disjoint_single_eventual
    (fun n => (sampleFn_measurable c hc (y n) (r n) i).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable)
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable (traceValue b i)).measurable.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable)
    (fun n => hDind.comp (hTm n)) (hDind.comp hSm)
    (fun n f => ⟨sampleFn_nonneg c _ _ _ _,sampleFn_le_one c _ _ _ _⟩) hbb
    (fun n f => hgi (T n f)) (fun f => hgi (S f))
    (weak_lift_set (hwt i) hI hIa) hs hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: palette_branch_local
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x z : ℂ} {t u a : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) (he : circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,a)=circleSum 1 (t,u)) (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) : ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen I ∧ a ∈ I ∧ ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict I, f ∈ liftPalette c hc z i → circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter x z 1,f) ∉ liftPalette c hc x i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,I,hP,hp,hI,haI,hIa,K,hA,hB⟩ := circleEndpoint_good_neighborhood h he rfl ha
  refine ⟨I,hI,haI,fun i => ?_⟩
  have ht : ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict I, ∀ b ∈ paletteGenerators c hc z i,
      traceValue b.1 i (f : Angles)*(liftPalette c hc x i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
        (circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter x z 1,f))=0 := by
    apply (ae_ball_iff (paletteGenerators_countable c hc z i)).mpr
    intro b _
    exact palette_trace_branch c hc hw h (hP.mem_nhds hp) hI.measurableSet hIa hA hB b.2 i
  filter_upwards [ht] with f hf hfm hxs
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbf⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (show (f : Angles) ∈ paletteSet c hc z i from hfm)
  have hz := hf b hb
  rw [indicator_of_mem hxs,mul_one] at hz
  exact (ne_of_gt hbf) hz
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: circleInverse_left
stmt: {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).source) : circleInverse h (circleSum 1 q)=q
body:
:= by
  have ht : circleSum 1 q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target := (circleInverseHomeo h).map_source hq
  rw [circleInverse_eq h ht]
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).left_inv hq

name: circleEndpoint_eventuallyEq
stmt: {x z : ℂ} {a : ℝ} {s t : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : ContinuousAt s a) (ht : ContinuousAt t a) (h : Real.sin (t a-s a) ≠ 0) (he : ∀ᶠ f in 𝓝 a, circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,f)=circleSum 1 (s f,t f)) : ∀ᶠ f in 𝓝 a, circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter x z 1,f)=s f
body:
:= by
  have hp : (s a,t a) ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).source :=
    (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (s a,t a)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (s a,t a) from circleSum_strict 1 (s a,t a)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hf := (hs.prodMk ht) ((circleInverseHomeo h).open_source.mem_nhds hp)
  filter_upwards [hf,he] with f hf he
  simp only [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_left h hf]
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_of_locally_ae
stmt: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) {S : Set X} {P : X → Prop} (h : ∀x∈S,∃U : Set X,IsOpen U ∧ x∈U ∧ ∀ᵐy∂μ,y∈U → P y) : ∀ᵐx∂μ,x∈S → P x
body:
:= by
  choose U ho hm ha using fun x : S => h x x.2
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hcov⟩ := (HereditarilyLindelofSpace.isLindelof S).elim_countable_subcover U ho
    (by intro x hx; exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hm ⟨x,hx⟩⟩)
  have hh : ∀ᵐy∂μ,∀x∈T,y∈U x → P y := (ae_ball_iff hT).mpr (fun x _ => ha x)
  filter_upwards [hh] with y hy hs
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hyU⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov hs)
  exact hy x hx hyU

name: ae_restrict_of_locally_ae
stmt: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {S : Set X} {P : X → Prop} (hS : MeasurableSet S) (h : ∀x∈S,∃U : Set X,IsOpen U ∧ x∈U ∧ ∀ᵐy∂μ.restrict U,P y) : ∀ᵐx∂μ.restrict S,P x
body:
:= by
  apply (ae_restrict_iff' hS).mpr
  apply ae_of_locally_ae μ
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U,hU,hxU,ha⟩ := h x hx
  exact ⟨U,hU,hxU,(ae_restrict_iff' hU.measurableSet).mp ha⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: palette_transport_real
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x z : ℂ} {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) {s t : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : ContinuousOn s U) (ht : ContinuousOn t U) (hnp : ∀ a ∈ U, Real.sin (t a-s a) ≠ 0) (hss : ∀ a ∈ U, Real.sin (a-t a) ≠ 0) (he : ∀ a ∈ U, circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,a)=circleSum 1 (s a,t a)) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict U, f ∈ liftPalette c hc z i → s f ∉ liftPalette c hc x i
body:
:= by
  apply ae_restrict_of_locally_ae hU.measurableSet
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨I,hI,haI,hb⟩ := palette_branch_local c hc hw (hnp a ha) (he a ha) (hss a ha)
  have heq := circleEndpoint_eventuallyEq (hs.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds ha))
    (ht.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds ha)) (hnp a ha)
    ((show ∀ᶠ f in 𝓝 a, f ∈ U from hU.mem_nhds ha).mono fun f hf => he f hf)
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hVo,haV⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp heq
  refine ⟨I ∩ V,hI.inter hVo,⟨haI,haV⟩,?_⟩
  have hb' := ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset (s := I ∩ V) (t := I) inter_subset_left (hb i)
  filter_upwards [hb',ae_restrict_mem (hI.inter hVo).measurableSet] with f hf hfI
  rw [hV hfI.2] at hf
  exact hf
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: endpoint_fiber_nonzero
stmt: {x z : ℂ} {a ds dt : ℝ} {s t : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : HasDerivAt s ds a) (ht : HasDerivAt t dt a) (hds : ds ≠ 0) (hn : Real.sin (t a-s a) ≠ 0) (he : ∀ᶠ f in 𝓝 a, circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,f)=circleSum 1 (s f,t f)) : Real.sin (a-t a) ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  have hv : HasDerivAt (fun f => circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,f))
      (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a) a := by
    simpa only [circleTarget,samplingParameter,one_smul] using
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos a).prodMk (Real.hasDerivAt_sin a)).const_add (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x))
  have hc₁ := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (s a)).comp a hs
  have hc₂ := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (t a)).comp a ht
  have hs₁ := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (s a)).comp a hs
  have hs₂ := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (t a)).comp a ht
  have hw : HasDerivAt (fun f => circleSum 1 (s f,t f))
      (-Real.sin (s a)*ds+-Real.sin (t a)*dt,Real.cos (s a)*ds+Real.cos (t a)*dt) a := by
    have h := (hc₁.add hc₂).prodMk (hs₁.add hs₂)
    convert h using 1; simp [circleSum,Function.comp_def]
  have hd := (hv.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm he)).unique hw
  have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst hd
  have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd hd
  dsimp only at h₁ h₂
  have hid : Real.sin (a-t a)=ds*Real.sin (s a-t a) := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination -(Real.cos (t a))*h₁-(Real.sin (t a))*h₂
  rw [hid]
  apply mul_ne_zero hds
  rw [show s a-t a=-(t a-s a) by ring,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
  exact hn
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: palette_smooth_transport
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x z : ℂ} {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) {s t ds dt : ℝ → ℝ} (hs : ∀ a ∈ U, HasDerivAt s (ds a) a) (ht : ∀ a ∈ U, HasDerivAt t (dt a) a) (hds : ∀ a ∈ U, ds a ≠ 0) (hnp : ∀ a ∈ U, Real.sin (t a-s a) ≠ 0) (he : ∀ a ∈ U, circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,a)=circleSum 1 (s a,t a)) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ f : ℝ ∂volume.restrict U, f ∈ liftPalette c hc z i → s f ∉ liftPalette c hc x i

  apply palette_transport_real c hc hw hU (fun a ha => (hs a ha).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun a ha => (ht a ha).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) hnp ?_ he i

name: palette_transport_param
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x z : ℂ} {a s t Da Ds Dt : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ r, HasDerivAt a (Da r) r) (hpos : ∀ r, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ Da r) (hs : ∀ r, HasDerivAt s (Ds r) r) (ht : ∀ r, HasDerivAt t (Dt r) r) (hDs : ∀ r, Ds r ≠ 0) (hnp : ∀ r, Real.sin (t r-s r) ≠ 0) (he : ∀ r, circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,a r)=circleSum 1 (s r,t r)) (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ r : ℝ ∂volume, a r ∈ liftPalette c hc z i → s r ∉ liftPalette c hc x i
body:
:= by
  let e := derivLowerOrderIso ha hpos
  have heq : ∀ r, e r=a r := fun _ => rfl
  have hinv : ∀ y, HasDerivAt e.symm (Da (e.symm y))⁻¹ y := by
    intro y
    apply HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse e.symm.continuous.continuousAt (ha (e.symm y))
      (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hpos _)))
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun r => by rw [← heq,e.apply_symm_apply]
  have h := palette_smooth_transport c hc hw (x := x) (z := z) isOpen_univ
    (s := s ∘ e.symm) (t := t ∘ e.symm)
    (fun y _ => (hs _).comp y (hinv y)) (fun y _ => (ht _).comp y (hinv y))
    (fun y _ => mul_ne_zero (hDs _) (inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hpos _)))))
    (fun y _ => hnp _) (fun y _ => by simpa only [Function.comp_apply,← heq,e.apply_symm_apply] using he (e.symm y)) i
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at h
  have h' := (deriv_lower_qmp ha hpos).ae h
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply,← heq,e.symm_apply_apply] using h'
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_angular_of_ae_line
stmt: {p : Angles → Prop} (hp : MeasurableSet {t | p t}) (h : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂volume, p (t : Angles)) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, p t
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure Angles), p t := by
    rw [← (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).map_eq]
    exact (ae_map_iff (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).measurable.aemeasurable hp).mpr
      (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle] at hh
  exact (Measure.ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff (by positivity : ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi) ≠ 0)).mp hh

name: ae_sin_sub_ne_zero
stmt: (t : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ a : ℝ ∂volume, Real.sin (a-t) ≠ 0
body:
:= by
  have hs : {a : ℝ | Real.sin (a-t)=0} ⊆ range (fun n : ℤ => t+n*Real.pi) := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp ha
    exact ⟨n,by linarith⟩
  change volume {a : ℝ | ¬Real.sin (a-t) ≠ 0}=0
  simpa only [not_not] using measure_mono_null hs ((countable_range _).measure_zero volume)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: tracePositive_measurable
stmt: (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (b : Traces c hc x) : MeasurableSet (tracePositive c hc x i b)
body:
:=
  measurableSet_lt measurable_const (Lp.stronglyMeasurable _).measurable
def paletteGenerators (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : Set (Traces c hc x) :=
  (exists_countable_essential_union angularMeasure (tracePositive c hc x i) (tracePositive_measurable c hc x i)).choose

name: paletteGenerators_countable
stmt: (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : (paletteGenerators c hc x i).Countable
body:
:=
  (exists_countable_essential_union angularMeasure (tracePositive c hc x i) (tracePositive_measurable c hc x i)).choose_spec.1
def paletteSet (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : Set Angles :=
  ⋃ b ∈ paletteGenerators c hc x i, tracePositive c hc x i b

name: paletteSet_measurable
stmt: (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MeasurableSet (paletteSet c hc x i)
body:
:=
  MeasurableSet.biUnion (paletteGenerators_countable c hc x i) (fun b _ => tracePositive_measurable c hc x i b)

name: tracePositive_le_palette
stmt: (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (b : Traces c hc x) : tracePositive c hc x i b ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] paletteSet c hc x i
body:
:=
  (exists_countable_essential_union angularMeasure (tracePositive c hc x i) (tracePositive_measurable c hc x i)).choose_spec.2 b

name: paletteSet_minimal
stmt: (x : ℂ) (i : Fin k) {A : Set Angles} (hA : ∀ b : Traces c hc x, tracePositive c hc x i b ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] A) : paletteSet c hc x i ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] A
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ∀ b ∈ paletteGenerators c hc x i, t ∈ tracePositive c hc x i b → t ∈ A :=
    (ae_ball_iff (paletteGenerators_countable c hc x i)).mpr (fun b _ => hA b)
  filter_upwards [hh] with t ht
  intro hm
  rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hm with ⟨b,hb,hbt⟩
  exact ht b hb hbt
def palette (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Finset (Fin k) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun i => t ∈ paletteSet c hc x i)

name: mem_palette
stmt: (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) (i : Fin k) : i ∈ palette c hc x t ↔ t ∈ paletteSet c hc x i
body: := by simp [palette]

name: palette_nonempty
stmt: (x : ℂ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, (palette c hc x t).Nonempty
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := exists_trace c hc x
  let B : Traces c hc x := ⟨b,hb⟩
  have hsum := (trace_bounds c hc hb).2.2
  have hs : (fun t => ∑ i, traceValue b i t) =ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue b)
    rw [hsum] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  filter_upwards [hs,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x i B)] with t ht hP
  have he : ∃ i : Fin k, 0 < traceValue b i t := by
    by_contra! hh
    have hz : (∑ i, traceValue b i t) ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun i _ => hh i)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := he
  exact ⟨i,(mem_palette c hc x t i).mpr ((hP i) hi)⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: inner_oneL2_integral
stmt: (f : RealL2 angularMeasure) : ⟪f,oneL2 angularMeasure⟫ = ∫ t, f t ∂angularMeasure
body:
:= by
  rw [real_inner_comm]
  exact (L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one MeasurableSet.univ (measure_ne_top angularMeasure Set.univ) f).trans
    (by simp)

name: sample_inner_one
stmt: (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) : ⟪sample c hc q 1 i,oneL2 angularMeasure⟫ = colorMass c i q
body:

  rw [inner_oneL2_integral]

name: transition_avoiding_trace
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) : ∃ b : TraceVector k, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ traceValue b i=0 ∧ traceValue b j=0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := Classical.axiomOfChoice (fun n : ℕ => transition_small_mass c hc hw he
    (R := 1/((n:ℝ)+1)) (ε := 1/((n:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have hqt : Tendsto q atTop (𝓝 x) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    apply squeeze_zero (fun n => dist_nonneg)
      (fun n => (hq n).1.le)
    exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (TraceVector k))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => Set.mem_univ (sampleCode c hc (q n) 1)))
  have htrace : IsTrace c hc x b := trace_of_realization c hc
    (fun n => (hq (φ n)).2.1) (hqt.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) tendsto_const_nhds hb
  have hmass (a : Fin k) (ha : a=i ∨ a=j) : ∫ t, traceValue b a t ∂angularMeasure = 0 := by
    have ht := (traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp hb) a (oneL2 angularMeasure)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,traceValue_sampleCode,sample_inner_one] at ht
    rw [inner_oneL2_integral] at ht
    have ht' : Tendsto (fun n => colorMass c a (q n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      apply squeeze_zero (fun n => colorMass_nonneg c a (q n)) (fun n => ?_)
        tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right (colorMass_nonneg c j (q n))).trans (hq n).2.2.le
      · exact (le_add_of_nonneg_left (colorMass_nonneg c i (q n))).trans (hq n).2.2.le
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht (ht'.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
  have hzero (a : Fin k) (ha : a=i ∨ a=j) : traceValue b a=0 := by
    apply Lp.ext
    have hi : Integrable (traceValue b a) angularMeasure := (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
    have hz := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae ((trace_bounds c hc htrace).1 a) hi).mp (hmass a ha)
    exact hz.trans (Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure).symm
  exact ⟨b,htrace,hzero i (Or.inl rfl),hzero j (Or.inr rfl)⟩

name: edge_palette_not_pair
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ¬ palette c hc x t ⊆ {i,j}
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hi,hj⟩ := transition_avoiding_trace c hc hw he
  have hs : (fun t => ∑ a, traceValue b a t) =ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue b)
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc hb).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  have hzi : traceValue b i =ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by rw [hi]; exact Lp.coeFn_zero _ _ _
  have hzj : traceValue b j =ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by rw [hj]; exact Lp.coeFn_zero _ _ _
  filter_upwards [hs,hzi,hzj,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun a => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x a ⟨b,hb⟩)] with t ht hi0 hj0 hp hsub
  have hnon : ∀ a : Fin k, traceValue b a t ≤ 0 := by
    intro a
    by_contra! ha
    have ham := hsub ((mem_palette c hc x t a).mpr (hp a ha))
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at ham
    rcases ham with rfl | rfl <;> linarith
  have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => hnon a)
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: finite_packed_cover
stmt: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] {A : Set X} (hA : TotallyBounded A) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0<ρ) : ∃ C : Finset X, (↑C : Set X)⊆A ∧ (∀ x∈A, ∃ c∈C, dist x c≤ρ) ∧ (↑C : Set X).Pairwise (fun x y => ρ<dist x y)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ℝ≥0 := ⟨ρ,hρ.le⟩
  obtain ⟨D,_,hD,hcover⟩ := Metric.exists_finite_isCover_of_totallyBounded
    (s := A) (ε := e/2) (by exact div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (show (0 : ℝ≥0)<e from hρ)) (by norm_num) : e/2≠0) hA
  have hp : Metric.packingNumber e A≠⊤ := by
    have hh := (Metric.packingNumber_two_mul_le_externalCoveringNumber (e/2) A).trans
      hcover.externalCoveringNumber_le_encard
    have he : 2*(e/2)=e := by ring
    rw [he] at hh
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hD.encard_lt_top.ne hh
  let C := Metric.maximalSeparatedSet e A
  have hCf : C.Finite := Set.encard_ne_top_iff.mp (by
    change (Metric.maximalSeparatedSet e A).encard≠⊤
    rwa [Metric.encard_maximalSeparatedSet hp])
  refine ⟨hCf.toFinset,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using (Metric.maximalSeparatedSet_subset (ε := e) (A := A))
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c,hc,hd⟩ := Metric.isCover_maximalSeparatedSet hp hx
    refine ⟨c,hCf.mem_toFinset.mpr hc,?_⟩
    change edist x c≤(e : ℝ≥0∞) at hd
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe (b := e)).mp (by simpa only [edist_dist] using hd)
  · intro x hx y hy hne
    have hd := Metric.isSeparated_maximalSeparatedSet (ε := e) (A := A)
      (hCf.mem_toFinset.mp hx) (hCf.mem_toFinset.mp hy) hne
    exact (ENNReal.coe_lt_ofReal (a := e)).mp (by simpa only [edist_dist] using hd)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory Function
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: diskAverage_product_integrable
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (fun q => diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q) (Metric.ball x r)
body:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := ⟨by simpa using (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (ball_ne_top x r))⟩
  apply Integrable.of_bound (((diskAverage_lipschitz hc hε i).continuous.mul
    (diskAverage_lipschitz hc hε j).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable) 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
    change ‖diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q‖≤1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q) (diskAverage_nonneg c ε j q))]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (diskAverage_nonneg c ε j q)
      (diskAverage_le_one hc hε i q)).trans (diskAverage_le_one hc hε j q)

name: finite_disk_overlap_cover
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hα : 0<α) (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) {s r : ℝ} (hr : s+α*ε/16≤r) : ∃ C : Finset ℂ, (∀ q∈Metric.ball x s, α<diskAverage c ε i q → α<diskAverage c ε j q → ∃ z∈C, q∈Metric.ball z (α*ε/4)) ∧ (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4) ≤ (256/(Real.pi*α^3))* ((∫ q in Metric.ball x r, diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q)/ε)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let ρ := α*ε/8
  have hρ : 0<ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
  let A := {q | q∈Metric.ball x s ∧ α<diskAverage c ε i q ∧ α<diskAverage c ε j q}
  obtain ⟨C,hCA,hcover,hsep⟩ := finite_packed_cover
    (A := A) ((isCompact_closedBall x s).totallyBounded.subset
      (fun _ hq => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq.1)) hρ
  have hsub : ∀ z∈C, Metric.ball z (ρ/2)⊆Metric.ball x r := by
    intro z hz q hq
    have hz' := (hCA hz).1
    have hq' : dist q z<ρ/2 := hq
    have hz'' : dist z x<s := hz'
    have hd := dist_triangle q z x
    change dist q x<r
    dsimp [ρ] at hq'
    linarith
  have hlow : ∀ z∈C, ∀ q∈Metric.ball z (ρ/2),
      α^2/4 ≤ diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
    intro z hz q hq
    have hp (a : Fin k) (ha : α<diskAverage c ε a z) : α/2≤diskAverage c ε a q := by
      have hh := (diskAverage_lipschitz hc hε a).dist_le_mul q z
      change |diskAverage c ε a q-diskAverage c ε a z|≤(4/ε)*dist q z at hh
      have hh' := (abs_le.mp hh).1
      have hd : dist q z<ρ/2 := hq
      have hmul : (4/ε)*dist q z<α/2 := by
        calc (4/ε)*dist q z < (4/ε)*(ρ/2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd (by positivity)
          _ = α/4 := by dsimp [ρ]; field_simp; ring
          _ < α/2 := by linarith
      linarith
    have hi := hp i (hCA hz).2.1
    have hj := hp j (hCA hz).2.2
    calc α^2/4 = (α/2)*(α/2) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hi hj (by positivity) (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q)
  have hdj : (↑C : Set ℂ).Pairwise (Disjoint on fun z => Metric.ball z (ρ/2)) := by
    intro z hz w hw hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro q hq hq'
    have hh := dist_triangle z q w
    have h₁ : dist q z<ρ/2 := hq
    have h₂ : dist q w<ρ/2 := hq'
    rw [dist_comm z q] at hh
    linarith [hsep hz hw hne]
  have hint : (C.card:ℝ)*(Real.pi*(ρ/2)^2*(α^2/4)) ≤
      ∫ q in Metric.ball x r, diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
    calc (C.card:ℝ)*(Real.pi*(ρ/2)^2*(α^2/4)) =
        ∑ z∈C, ∫ _q in Metric.ball z (ρ/2), (α^2/4) := by
          simp only [setIntegral_const,smul_eq_mul,volumeReal_ball _ (by positivity : 0≤ρ/2)]
          simp
      _ ≤ ∑ z∈C, ∫ q in Metric.ball z (ρ/2), diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro z hz
        apply setIntegral_mono_on (integrableOn_const (ball_ne_top z (ρ/2)))
          (diskAverage_product_integrable hc hε i j z (ρ/2)) measurableSet_ball
        exact hlow z hz
      _ = ∫ q in ⋃ z∈C, Metric.ball z (ρ/2), diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
        exact (integral_biUnion_finset C (fun _ _ => measurableSet_ball) hdj
          (fun z _ => diskAverage_product_integrable hc hε i j z (ρ/2))).symm
      _ ≤ _ := setIntegral_mono_set (diskAverage_product_integrable hc hε i j x r)
        (Eventually.of_forall fun q => mul_nonneg (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q) (diskAverage_nonneg c ε j q))
        (Eventually.of_forall (fun q hq => by
          obtain ⟨z,hz,hq⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hq
          exact hsub z hz hq))
  refine ⟨C,?_,?_⟩
  · intro q hq hi hj
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hd⟩ := hcover q ⟨hq,hi,hj⟩
    refine ⟨z,hz,?_⟩
    change dist q z<α*ε/4
    dsimp [ρ] at hd
    nlinarith [mul_pos hα hε]
  · have hconst : 0<Real.pi*α^3 := by positivity
    rw [← mul_div_assoc (256/(Real.pi*α^3)) _ ε]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).mpr
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hconst).mpr
    dsimp [ρ] at hint
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: missing_edge_disk_cover
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) {i j : Fin k} (hne : i≠j) {x : ℂ} (he : ¬TransitionEdge c i j x) : ∃ R>0, ∀ s<R, ∀ α>0, ∀ η>0, ∃ δ>0, ∀ ε, 0<ε → ε<δ → ∃ C : Finset ℂ, (∀ q∈Metric.ball x s, α<diskAverage c ε i q → α<diskAverage c ε j q → ∃ z∈C, q∈Metric.ball z (α*ε/4)) ∧ (C.card:ℝ)*(α*ε/4)<η
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,ht⟩ := missing_edge_overlap hc hne he
  refine ⟨R,hR,fun s hs α hα η hη => ?_⟩
  let r := (s+R)/2
  have hsr : s<r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hrR : r<R := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hlim := (ht r hrR).const_mul (256/(Real.pi*α^3))
  rw [mul_zero] at hlim
  have he₁ := hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hη)
  have he₂ : ∀ᶠ ε : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, s+α*ε/16<r := by
    have ht' : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => s+α*ε/16) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 s) := by
      have hid : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := s)).add ((hid.const_mul α).div_const 16)
    exact ht'.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hsr)
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp (he₁.and he₂)
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun ε hε hεδ => ?_⟩
  have hε' := hd (show ε∈Metric.ball 0 δ∩Ioi 0 from ⟨by simpa [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_pos hε] using hεδ,hε⟩)
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hb⟩ := finite_disk_overlap_cover hc hε hα i j x hε'.2.le
  exact ⟨C,hC,hb.trans_lt hε'.1⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology

name: ball_simplyConnected
stmt: (y : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : IsSimplyConnected (Metric.ball y r)
body:
:= by
  let := (convex_ball y r).contractibleSpace (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr)
  change SimplyConnectedSpace (Metric.ball y r)

name: hit_center
stmt: {F : ℂ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hc : ContinuousOn F (Metric.ball y 4)) (hb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y 4, ‖F z-z‖ ≤ 2) : y ∈ F '' Metric.ball y 4
body:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hzero : 0 ∉ (fun z => F z-y) '' Metric.ball y 4 := by
    rintro ⟨z,hz,he⟩
    apply hn
    exact ⟨z,hz,sub_eq_zero.mp he⟩
  obtain ⟨L,hLc,hL⟩ := Complex.exists_continuousOn_eqOn_exp_comp
    (ball_simplyConnected y (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4)) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (hc.sub continuousOn_const) hzero
  let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (t*Complex.I)
  have ec : Continuous e := by fun_prop
  have en (t : ℝ) : ‖e t‖ = 1 := by simp [e,Complex.norm_exp]
  let γ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => y+3*e t
  have γc : Continuous γ := by fun_prop
  have γmem (t : ℝ) : γ t ∈ Metric.ball y 4 := by
    norm_num [γ,Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm,en]
  let H : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (F (γ t)-y) / e t
  have Hc : Continuous H := (hc.comp_continuous γc γmem).sub continuous_const |>.div ec (fun t => Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  have Hnear (t : ℝ) : ‖H t-3‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have he : e t ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have h : H t-3 = (F (γ t)-γ t)/e t := by dsimp [H,γ]; field_simp; ring
    rw [h,norm_div,en,div_one]
    exact hb _ (γmem t)
  have Hpos (t : ℝ) : 0 < (H t).re := by
    have : |(H t-3).re| ≤ 2 := (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (H t-3)).trans (Hnear t)
    have := (abs_le.mp this).1
    norm_num at this
    linarith
  have Hslit (t : ℝ) : H t ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Or.inl (Hpos t)
  have logHc : Continuous (fun t => Complex.log (H t)) :=
    Hc.clog Hslit
  let d : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => L (γ t) - Complex.log (H t) - t*Complex.I
  have dc : Continuous d := ((hLc.comp_continuous γc γmem).sub logHc).sub (by fun_prop)
  have de (t : ℝ) : Complex.exp (d t) = 1 := by
    have hH : H t ≠ 0 := fun hz => by have := Hpos t; simp [hz] at this
    have hLe : Complex.exp (L (γ t)) = F (γ t)-y := hL (γmem t)
    simp only [d,Complex.exp_sub,Complex.exp_log hH,hLe]
    change (F (γ t)-y) / ((F (γ t)-y)/e t) / e t = 1
    have hF : F (γ t)-y ≠ 0 := fun hz => hzero ⟨_,γmem t,hz⟩
    have he : e t ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    field_simp
  have hconst : d 0 = d (2*Real.pi) :=
    Complex.isCoveringMap_exp.constOn_of_comp isPreconnected_univ dc.continuousOn
      (fun a _ b _ => Subtype.ext ((de a).trans (de b).symm)) (mem_univ _) (mem_univ _)
  have e0 : e 0 = 1 := by simp [e]
  have e2 : e (2*Real.pi) = 1 := by simp [e,Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I]
  have γeq : γ (2*Real.pi) = γ 0 := by dsimp [γ]; rw [e0,e2]
  have Heq : H (2*Real.pi) = H 0 := by dsimp [H]; rw [γeq,e0,e2]
  dsimp [d] at hconst
  rw [γeq,Heq] at hconst
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im hconst
  norm_num at hi
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
end PlanarCover
end

name: affinePair_null
stmt: (a b : ℂ) : volume (affineSpan ℝ ({a,b} : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ)=0
body:
:= by
  apply addHaar_affineSubspace volume
  intro he
  have hd : Submodule.span ℝ ({a-b} : Set ℂ)=⊤ := by
    change Submodule.span ℝ ({a -ᵥ b} : Set ℂ)=⊤
    rw [← vectorSpan_pair ℝ a b,← direction_affineSpan,he]
    exact AffineSubspace.direction_top _ _ _
  have hf := finrank_span_le_card (R := ℝ) ({a-b} : Set ℂ)
  rw [hd,finrank_top,Complex.finrank_real_complex] at hf
  norm_num at hf

name: hit_center_subtype
stmt: {Q : Set ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hQ : Metric.ball y 4 ⊆ Q) {F : Q → ℂ} (hc : Continuous F) (hb : ∀ z, ‖F z-z.val‖ ≤ 2) : y ∈ Set.range F
body:
:= by
  classical
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => if hz:z∈Q then F ⟨z,hz⟩ else 0
  have ge (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Q) : g z=F ⟨z,hz⟩ := dite_eq_left hz
  have hgc : ContinuousOn g (Metric.ball y 4) := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    have hh := hc.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk (fun z : Metric.ball y 4 => hQ z.property))
    convert hh using 1
    ext z
    exact ge _ (hQ z.property)
  obtain ⟨z,hz,he⟩ := hit_center hgc (fun z hz => by rw [ge _ (hQ hz)]; exact hb _)
  exact ⟨⟨z,hQ hz⟩,by rwa [ge _ (hQ hz)] at he⟩

name: small_support_pair
stmt: {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hc : s.card≤2) : ∃ a b, s ⊆ {a,b}
body:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : s.card=1
  · obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp h1
    exact ⟨a,a,by simp⟩
  · have h2 : s.card=2 := by have := hs.card_pos; omega
    obtain ⟨a,b,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp h2
    exact ⟨a,b,Finset.Subset.refl _⟩

name: barycenter_two
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℂ) (w : ι → ℝ) (hn : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hs : ∑ i,w i=1) (hcard : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => w i≠0)).card≤2) : ∑ i,w i • p i ∈ ⋃ a, ⋃ b, (affineSpan ℝ ({p a,p b} : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => w i≠0)
  have hsw : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = ∑ i, w i := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    intro i _ hi
    simpa [s] using hi
  have hsv : ∑ i∈s,w i=1 := hsw.trans hs
  have hne : s.Nonempty := by
    by_contra he
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he,Finset.sum_empty] at hsv
    exact zero_ne_one hsv
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab⟩ := small_support_pair hne hcard
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,?_⟩⟩
  have hm := (affineSpan ℝ ({p a,p b} : Set ℂ)).convex.sum_mem
    (z := p) (fun i _ => hn i) hsv (fun i hi => mem_affineSpan ℝ (by
      have hh := hab hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hh
      rcases hh with rfl|rfl <;> simp))
  have hh : ∑ i ∈ s, w i • p i = ∑ i, w i • p i := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    intro i _ hi
    have hi0 : w i = 0 := by simpa [s] using hi
    simp [hi0]
  rwa [hh] at hm

name: finite_partition_impossible
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {Q : Set ℂ} (hQ : Metric.ball (0:ℂ) 5 ⊆ Q) (p : ι → ℂ) (w : ι → C(Q,ℝ)) (hn : ∀ i z,0≤w i z) (hs : ∀ z,∑ i,w i z=1) (hm : ∀ z,(Finset.univ.filter (fun i => w i z≠0)).card≤2) (hd : ∀ i z, w i z≠0 → ‖p i-z.val‖≤2) : False
body:
:= by
  classical
  let F : Q → ℂ := fun z => ∑ i,w i z • p i
  have Fc : Continuous F := by fun_prop
  have Fb (z : Q) : ‖F z-z.val‖≤2 := by
    have he : F z-z.val=∑ i,w i z • (p i-z.val) := by
      simp only [smul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_smul,hs,one_smul,F]
    rw [he]
    calc
      ‖∑ i,w i z • (p i-z.val)‖ ≤ ∑ i,‖w i z • (p i-z.val)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i,w i z*2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        by_cases hi : w i z=0
        · simp [hi]
        · rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hn i z)]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hd i z hi) (hn i z)
      _ = 2 := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul,hs]; ring
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0:ℂ) 1 ⊆ Set.range F := by
    intro y hy
    apply hit_center_subtype (F := F) ?_ Fc Fb
    intro z hz
    apply hQ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] at hy ⊢
    have hh := norm_add_le (z-y) y
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at hh
    have hz' : ‖z-y‖<4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hz
    exact hh.trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hnull : volume (⋃ a, ⋃ b, (affineSpan ℝ ({p a,p b} : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ))=0 :=
    measure_iUnion_null fun a => measure_iUnion_null fun b => affinePair_null _ _
  have hfsub : Set.range F ⊆ ⋃ a, ⋃ b, (affineSpan ℝ ({p a,p b} : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ) := by
    rintro _ ⟨z,rfl⟩
    exact barycenter_two p (fun i => w i z) (fun i => hn i z) (hs z) (hm z)
  have hz := measure_mono_null (hsub.trans hfsub) hnull
  exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos volume (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))).ne' hz
end PlanarCover
end

name: finite_open_cover_impossible
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {Q : Set ℂ} (hQ : Metric.ball (0:ℂ) 5 ⊆ Q) (U : ι → Set Q) (ho : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ∀ z : Q, ∃ i, z∈U i) (hm : ∀ z : Q, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => z∈U i)).card≤2) (hd : ∀ i, ∀ x∈U i, ∀ y∈U i, ‖x.val-y.val‖≤2) : False
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := PartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate isClosed_univ U ho (by
    intro z _
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr (hcov z))
  have hz0 : (0:ℂ)∈Q := hQ (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num))
  let p : ι → Q := fun i => if h : (U i).Nonempty then h.choose else ⟨0,hz0⟩
  apply finite_partition_impossible hQ (fun i => (p i).val) w (w.nonneg) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro z
    simpa only [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] using w.sum_eq_one (mem_univ z)
  · intro z
    apply le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) (hm z)
    intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hi ⊢
    exact hw i (subset_closure hi)
  · intro i z hz
    have hzu : z∈U i := hw i (subset_closure hz)
    have hp : p i∈U i := by
      dsimp [p]
      rw [dite_eq_left ⟨z,hzu⟩]
      exact Classical.choose_spec _
    exact hd i _ hp z hzu

name: compact_open_cover_impossible
stmt: {ι : Type*} {Q : Set ℂ} (hQ : Metric.ball (0:ℂ) 5 ⊆ Q) (hQc : IsCompact Q) (U : ι → Set Q) (ho : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcov : ∀ z : Q, ∃ i, z∈U i) (hm : ∀ z : Q, ∀ i j l, z∈U i → z∈U j → z∈U l → i=j ∨ i=l ∨ j=l) (hd : ∀ i, ∀ x∈U i, ∀ y∈U i, ‖x.val-y.val‖≤2) : False
body:
:= by
  classical
  have : CompactSpace Q := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hQc
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover U ho (by
    intro z _
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr (hcov z))
  apply finite_open_cover_impossible hQ (fun i : s => U i.val) (fun i => ho i.val) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro z
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp (hs (mem_univ z)) with ⟨i,hi⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hi with ⟨his,hiz⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i,his⟩,hiz⟩
  · intro z
    by_contra! hcard
    obtain ⟨i,hi,j,hj,l,hl,hij,hil,hjl⟩ := Finset.two_lt_card.mp hcard
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hi hj hl
    rcases hm z i.val j.val l.val hi hj hl with h|h|h
    · exact hij (Subtype.ext h)
    · exact hil (Subtype.ext h)
    · exact hjl (Subtype.ext h)
  · intro i
    exact hd i.val
end PlanarCover
end

name: norm_even_wing
stmt: {t : ℝ} (ht : |t|<2) : ‖(Real.sqrt (1-t^2/4) : ℂ)+((t/2 : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I‖=1
body:
:= by
  have ht2 : t^2≤4 := by
    have hh := mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg t) ht.le
    nlinarith [sq_abs t]
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0≤1-t^2/4 by linarith)
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num : 0≤(1:ℝ))).mp
  rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
  norm_num only [Complex.add_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.mul_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,mul_zero,zero_mul,sub_zero,
    add_zero,zero_add,mul_one]
  nlinarith

name: evenOffset_distances
stmt: {v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) {t : ℝ} (ht : |t|<2) : ‖evenOffset v t‖=1 ∧ ‖evenOffset v t-(t:ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)‖=1
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [evenOffset,norm_mul,norm_even_wing ht,hv,mul_one]
  · have he : evenOffset v t-(t:ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)=evenOffset v (-t) := by
      simp only [evenOffset,neg_sq,neg_div,Complex.ofReal_neg,Complex.ofReal_div,Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
      ring
    rw [he,evenOffset,norm_mul,norm_even_wing (by simpa only [abs_neg] using ht),hv,mul_one]

name: continuous_evenOffset
stmt: (v : ℂ) : Continuous (evenOffset v)
body:
:= by
  unfold evenOffset
  fun_prop

name: evenOffset_zero
stmt: (v : ℂ) : evenOffset v 0=v

name: transverse_decompose
stmt: {v w : ℂ} (hd : transverseDet v w≠0) (h : ℂ) : (transverseFirst v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)+ (transverseSecond v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*w)=h
body:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,zero_mul,sub_zero,add_zero,
      transverseFirst,transverseSecond] <;>
    field_simp <;> dsimp [transverseDet] <;>
    simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,zero_mul,one_mul,zero_sub,zero_add] <;> ring

name: continuous_transverseFirst
stmt: (v w : ℂ) : Continuous (transverseFirst v w)
body:
:= by
  unfold transverseFirst
  fun_prop

name: continuous_transverseSecond
stmt: (v w : ℂ) : Continuous (transverseSecond v w)
body:
:= by
  unfold transverseSecond
  fun_prop

name: transverseFirst_zero
stmt: (v w : ℂ) : transverseFirst v w 0=0
body: := by simp [transverseFirst]

name: transverseSecond_zero
stmt: (v w : ℂ) : transverseSecond v w 0=0
body:
:= by simp [transverseSecond]
def evenPath (v w h : ℂ) : Fin 5 → ℂ := ![0,
  evenOffset v (transverseFirst v w h),
  (transverseFirst v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*v),
  (transverseFirst v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)+evenOffset w (transverseSecond v w h),h]

name: evenPath_edges
stmt: {v w h : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) (hw : ‖w‖=1) (hd : transverseDet v w≠0) (h₁ : |transverseFirst v w h|<2) (h₂ : |transverseSecond v w h|<2) : ∀i : Fin 4, ‖evenPath v w h i.castSucc-evenPath v w h i.succ‖=1
body:
:= by
  have he₁ := evenOffset_distances hv h₁
  have he₂ := evenOffset_distances hw h₂
  have hdec := transverse_decompose hd h
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change ‖0-evenOffset v (transverseFirst v w h)‖=1
    simpa only [zero_sub,norm_neg] using he₁.1
  · exact he₁.2
  · change ‖(transverseFirst v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)-
        ((transverseFirst v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)+evenOffset w (transverseSecond v w h))‖=1
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel_left,norm_neg] using he₂.1
  · change ‖(transverseFirst v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*v)+evenOffset w (transverseSecond v w h)-h‖=1
    calc
      _ = ‖evenOffset w (transverseSecond v w h)-(transverseSecond v w h : ℂ)*(Complex.I*w)‖ :=
        congrArg norm (by linear_combination hdec)
      _ = 1 := he₂.2

name: evenPath_local
stmt: {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) {p v w : ℂ} (hp : p∈U) (hpv : p+v∈V) (hpw : p+w∈V) : ∃r>0,∃δ>0,∀q h : ℂ,q∈Metric.ball p r → ‖h‖<δ → |transverseFirst v w h|<2 ∧ |transverseSecond v w h|<2 ∧ (∀i : Fin 5,(q+evenPath v w h i)∈if i.val%2=0 then U else V)
body:
:= by
  let P : ℂ × ℂ → Prop := fun z => |transverseFirst v w z.2|<2 ∧
    |transverseSecond v w z.2|<2 ∧
    (∀i : Fin 5,(z.1+evenPath v w z.2 i)∈if i.val%2=0 then U else V)
  have hm : ∀ᶠz in 𝓝 (p,(0:ℂ)),P z := by
    have ha : ∀ᶠz : ℂ × ℂ in 𝓝 (p,(0:ℂ)), |transverseFirst v w z.2|<2 := by
      apply ((continuous_transverseFirst v w).comp continuous_snd).abs.continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const
      simp [transverseFirst_zero]
    have hb : ∀ᶠz : ℂ × ℂ in 𝓝 (p,(0:ℂ)), |transverseSecond v w z.2|<2 := by
      apply ((continuous_transverseSecond v w).comp continuous_snd).abs.continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const
      simp [transverseSecond_zero]
    have hc (i : Fin 5) : ∀ᶠz : ℂ × ℂ in 𝓝 (p,(0:ℂ)),
        (z.1+evenPath v w z.2 i)∈if i.val%2=0 then U else V := by
      have hco : Continuous (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => z.1+evenPath v w z.2 i) := by
        fin_cases i <;> dsimp [evenPath] <;> fun_prop
      apply hco.continuousAt.eventually
      fin_cases i <;> norm_num [evenPath,transverseFirst_zero,transverseSecond_zero,evenOffset_zero]
      · exact hU.mem_nhds hp
      · exact hV.mem_nhds hpv
      · exact hU.mem_nhds hp
      · exact hV.mem_nhds hpw
      · exact hU.mem_nhds hp
    exact ha.and (hb.and (eventually_all.mpr hc))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hb⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hm
  refine ⟨ε,hε,ε,hε,?_⟩
  intro q h hq hh
  exact hb (show (q,h)∈Metric.ball (p,(0:ℂ)) ε by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,dist_zero_right,max_lt_iff] using And.intro hq hh)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: local_ae_translation_constant
stmt: {ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] [Countable ι] (c : ℂ → ι) (hc : Measurable c) {p : ℂ} {r δ : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (hδ : 0<δ) (hshift : ∀h : ℂ,‖h‖<δ → ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈Metric.ball p r → c (q+h)=c q) : ∃s>0,s≤r ∧ ∃i,∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈Metric.ball p s → c q=i
body:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := min r δ/4
  have hs : 0<s := by dsimp [s]; positivity
  have hsr : s≤r := by dsimp [s]; linarith [min_le_left r δ,lt_min hr hδ]
  have hsd : 2*s<δ := by dsimp [s]; linarith [min_le_right r δ,lt_min hr hδ]
  have hpair : ∀ᵐz : ℂ × ℂ∂volume.prod volume,
      ‖z.1‖<δ → z.2∈Metric.ball p r → c (z.2+z.1)=c z.2 := by
    apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae ?_).mpr
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun h => by
        by_cases hh : ‖h‖<δ
        · exact (hshift h hh).mono fun q hq _ => hq
        · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ hh' => (hh hh').elim
    · have hx : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × ℂ | ‖z.1‖<δ} := measurableSet_lt measurable_fst.norm measurable_const
      have hy : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × ℂ | z.2∈Metric.ball p r} := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.preimage measurable_snd
      have hz : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × ℂ | c (z.2+z.1)=c z.2} :=
        measurableSet_eq_fun (hc.comp (measurable_snd.add measurable_fst)) (hc.comp measurable_snd)
      exact hx.imp (hy.imp hz)
  have hd := (measurePreserving_sub_prod (volume : Measure ℂ) volume).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpair
  have he : ∀ᵐz : ℂ × ℂ∂volume.prod volume,
      z.1∈Metric.ball p s → z.2∈Metric.ball p s → c z.1=c z.2 := by
    filter_upwards [hd] with z hz h1 h2
    have hdist : ‖z.1-z.2‖<δ := by
      rw [←dist_eq_norm]
      have h := dist_triangle z.1 p z.2
      have h2' : dist p z.2<s := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using h2
      have h1' : dist z.1 p<s := h1
      linarith
    have hh := hz hdist (Metric.ball_subset_ball hsr h2)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hh
  have hae := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod he
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqae⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae
    (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume p hs).ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae hae)
  refine ⟨s,hs,hsr,c q,?_⟩
  exact hqae.mono fun z hz hzs => (hz hq hzs).symm
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: binary_two_edges
stmt: {ι : Type*} {a b u v w : ι} (hu : u=a ∨ u=b) (hv : v=a ∨ v=b) (hw : w=a ∨ w=b) (huv : u≠v) (hvw : v≠w) : u=w
body:
:= by
  rcases hu with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hv with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hw with rfl|rfl <;> tauto

name: ae_translated_unit_pair
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {a b : ℂ} (hab : ‖a-b‖=1) : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,c (q+a)≠c (q+b)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists (u:=b-a) (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hab)
  have hh := (measurePreserving_add_right volume a).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (weak_all_directions c hc hw t)
  filter_upwards [hh] with q hq
  simpa only [ht,show q+a+(b-a)=q+b by ring] using hq

name: binary_open_local_rigidity
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {a b : Fin k} {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hUc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈U → c q=a ∨ c q=b) (hVc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈V → c q=a ∨ c q=b) {p v w : ℂ} (hp : p∈U) (hpv : p+v∈V) (hpw : p+w∈V) (hv : ‖v‖=1) (hw' : ‖w‖=1) (hd : transverseDet v w≠0) : ∃r>0,∃i : Fin k,∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈Metric.ball p r → c q=i
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,δ,hδ,hinside⟩ := evenPath_local hU hV hp hpv hpw
  have hshift (h : ℂ) (hh : ‖h‖<δ) :
      ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈Metric.ball p r → c (q+h)=c q := by
    have hsmall := hinside p h (Metric.mem_ball_self hr) hh
    have hedges := evenPath_edges hv hw' hd hsmall.1 hsmall.2.1
    have hcm (i : Fin 5) := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (evenPath v w h i)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hUc.and hVc)
    have hne (i : Fin 4) := ae_translated_unit_pair hc hw (hedges i)
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hcm,ae_all_iff.mpr hne] with q hqc hqp hq
    have hi := (hinside q h hq hh).2.2
    have hcol (i : Fin 5) : c (q+evenPath v w h i)=a ∨ c (q+evenPath v w h i)=b := by
      have hii := hi i
      by_cases he : i.val%2=0
      · exact (hqc i).1 (by simpa only [he,ite_true] using hii)
      · exact (hqc i).2 (by simpa only [he,ite_false] using hii)
    have he02 := binary_two_edges (hcol 0) (hcol 1) (hcol 2) (hqp 0) (hqp 1)
    have he24 := binary_two_edges (hcol 2) (hcol 3) (hcol 4) (hqp 2) (hqp 3)
    change c (q+0)=c (q+evenPath v w h 2) at he02
    change c (q+evenPath v w h 2)=c (q+h) at he24
    simpa only [add_zero] using (he02.trans he24).symm
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_,i,hi⟩ := local_ae_translation_constant c hc hr hδ hshift
  exact ⟨s,hs,i,hi⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: transverseDet_mul_unit
stmt: {v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) (z : ℂ) : transverseDet v (z*v)=z.im
body:
:= by
  have hh : v.re^2+v.im^2=1 := by
    calc
      v.re^2+v.im^2 = ‖v‖^2 := by rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]; ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hv]; norm_num
  calc
    transverseDet v (z*v) = (v.re^2+v.im^2)*z.im := by
      simp only [transverseDet,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im]
      ring
    _ = z.im := by rw [hh,one_mul]

name: open_two_unit_directions
stmt: {V : Set ℂ} (hV : IsOpen V) {p v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) (hpv : p+v∈V) : ∃w : ℂ,p+w∈V ∧ ‖w‖=1 ∧ transverseDet v w≠0
body:
:= by
  have ht : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => p+(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*v) := by fun_prop
  have hm : (fun t : ℝ => p+(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*v) ⁻¹' V∈𝓝 0 := by
    apply ht.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    simpa only [Circle.exp_zero,Circle.coe_one,one_mul] using hV.mem_nhds hpv
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hm
  let t : ℝ := min δ Real.pi/2
  have hp := Real.pi_pos
  have hmin : 0 < min δ Real.pi := lt_min hδ hp
  have htp : 0<t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have htd : t<δ := by dsimp [t]; linarith [min_le_left δ Real.pi]
  have htπ : t<Real.pi := by dsimp [t]; linarith [min_le_right δ Real.pi]
  refine ⟨(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*v,hd ?_,by rw [norm_mul,Circle.norm_coe,hv,one_mul],?_⟩
  · simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos htp] using htd
  · rw [transverseDet_mul_unit hv]
    simpa [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin] using
      (ne_of_gt (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi htp htπ))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: double_cos_circle
stmt: (t : ℝ) : (2*Real.cos t : ℂ)*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)-1=(Circle.exp (2*t) : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,
      Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.sub_re,
      Complex.sub_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.one_re,Complex.one_im,Complex.re_ofNat,Complex.im_ofNat,
      Real.cos_two_mul,Real.sin_two_mul] <;> ring

name: radial_unit_contact
stmt: {x e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) {V : Set ℂ} (b : Bool) (hstrip : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (e*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ))<δ → ∀r : ℝ,0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈V) : ∃v : ℂ,‖v‖=1 ∧ (x+e)+v∈V
body:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := Real.pi/3
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2*Real.cos t
  let E : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)
  have hr : Continuous r := by fun_prop
  have hE : Continuous E := by fun_prop
  have hra : r a=1 := by norm_num [r,a,Real.cos_pi_div_three]
  have ha : 0<a ∧ a<Real.pi := by dsimp [a]; constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hn : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,0<r t ∧ |r t-1|<δ ∧ dist (E t) (E a)<δ ∧ 0<t ∧ t<Real.pi := by
    have h₁ : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,0<r t := continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hr.continuousAt (by rw [hra]; norm_num)
    have h₂ : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,|r t-1|<δ :=
      (hr.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa only [Pi.sub_apply,hra,sub_self,abs_zero] using hδ)
    have h₃ : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,dist (E t) (E a)<δ :=
      (hE.dist continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa only [dist_self] using hδ)
    exact h₁.and (h₂.and (h₃.and ((eventually_gt_nhds ha.1).and (eventually_lt_nhds ha.2))))
  have hex : ∃t,(0<r t ∧ |r t-1|<δ ∧ dist (E t) (E a)<δ) ∧ (if b then 1<r t else r t<1) := by
    cases b
    · obtain ⟨t,ht,hat⟩ := ((hn.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and
          (self_mem_nhdsWithin : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝[>] a,t∈Ioi a)).exists
      refine ⟨t,⟨ht.1,ht.2.1,ht.2.2.1⟩,?_⟩
      have hc := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ha.1.le ht.2.2.2.2.le hat
      dsimp [r]
      have hh : 2*Real.cos a=1 := hra
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨t,ht,hta⟩ := ((hn.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and
          (self_mem_nhdsWithin : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝[<] a,t∈Iio a)).exists
      refine ⟨t,⟨ht.1,ht.2.1,ht.2.2.1⟩,?_⟩
      have hc := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht.2.2.2.1.le ha.2.le hta
      dsimp [r]
      have hh : 2*Real.cos a=1 := hra
      linarith
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hside⟩ := hex
  have hEt : ‖E t‖=1 := by
    change ‖e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)‖=1
    rw [norm_mul,he,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  have hmem := hstrip (E t) hEt ht.2.2 (r t) ht.1 ht.2.1 hside
  let v : ℂ := (r t:ℂ)*E t-e
  have hve : v=e*(Circle.exp (2*t) : ℂ) := by
    change ((2*Real.cos t : ℝ):ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ))-e=e*(Circle.exp (2*t) : ℂ)
    calc
      _ = e*((2*Real.cos t : ℂ)*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)-1) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [double_cos_circle]
  refine ⟨v,by rw [hve,norm_mul,he,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul],?_⟩
  have hvq : (x+e)+v=x+(r t:ℂ)*E t := by dsimp [v]; ring
  exact hvq ▸ hmem
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def radialSide (b : Bool) (ε : ℝ) : Set ℝ := if b then Ioo 1 (1+ε) else Ioo (1-ε) 1
def polarBox (x e : ℂ) (b : Bool) (ε : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  (fun rt : ℝ × ℝ => x+(rt.1:ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp rt.2 : ℂ))) ''
    (radialSide b ε ×ˢ Ioo (-ε) ε)

name: radialSide_connected
stmt: (b : Bool) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : IsConnected (radialSide b ε)
body:
:= by
  cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] <;> apply isConnected_Ioo <;> linarith

name: radialSide_abs
stmt: {b : Bool} {ε r : ℝ} (hr : r∈radialSide b ε) : |r-1|<ε
body:
:= by
  cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] at hr
  all_goals rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hr.1,hr.2]

name: mem_radialSide
stmt: {b : Bool} {ε r : ℝ} (hr : |r-1|<ε) (hb : if b then 1<r else r<1) : r∈radialSide b ε
body:
:= by
  rw [abs_lt] at hr
  cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] at * <;> constructor <;> linarith [hr.1,hr.2]

name: polarBox_connected
stmt: (x e : ℂ) (b : Bool) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : IsConnected (polarBox x e b ε)
body:
:= by
  apply ((radialSide_connected b hε).prod (isConnected_Ioo (by linarith : -ε<ε))).image
  fun_prop

name: polarBox_small
stmt: {x e : ℂ} {b : Bool} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) {U W : Set ℂ} (hW : IsOpen W) (hp : x+e∈W) (hstrip : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈U) (he : ‖e‖=1) : ∃ε>0,polarBox x e b ε⊆U∩W
body:
:= by
  let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun rt => x+(rt.1:ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp rt.2 : ℂ))
  let E : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun rt => e*(Circle.exp rt.2 : ℂ)
  have hF : Continuous F := by fun_prop
  have hE : Continuous E := by fun_prop
  have hF0 : F (1,0)=x+e := by simp [F]
  have hE0 : E (1,0)=e := by simp [E]
  have hn : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),F rt∈W ∧ dist (E rt) e<δ ∧ 0<rt.1 ∧ |rt.1-1|<δ := by
    have h₁ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),F rt∈W := hF.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hW.mem_nhds (hF0 ▸ hp))
    have h₂ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),dist (E rt) e<δ :=
      (hE.dist continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa [hE0] using hδ)
    have h₃ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),0<rt.1 :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt continuous_fst.continuousAt (by norm_num)
    have h₄ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),|rt.1-1|<δ :=
      (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa using hδ)
    exact h₁.and (h₂.and (h₃.and h₄))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hh⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨ε,hε,?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨⟨r,t⟩,⟨hr,ht⟩,rfl⟩
  have hrt : (r,t)∈Metric.ball ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ) ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using radialSide_abs hr,by simpa [Real.dist_eq,abs_lt] using ht⟩
  have hz := hh hrt
  refine ⟨hstrip (E (r,t)) ?_ hz.2.1 r hz.2.2.1 hz.2.2.2 ?_,hz.1⟩
  · change ‖e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)‖=1
    rw [norm_mul,he,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  · cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] at hr ⊢
    · exact hr.2
    · exact hr.1

name: polarBox_contains_strip
stmt: {x e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) (b : Bool) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ, |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈polarBox x e b ε
body:
:= by
  have he0 : e≠0 := by intro h; simp [h] at he
  have ha : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.arg (z/e)) e := by
    have hh : ContinuousAt Complex.arg (e/e) := Complex.continuousAt_arg (by
      simpa only [div_self he0] using Complex.one_mem_slitPlane)
    exact hh.comp (f := fun z : ℂ => z/e) (by fun_prop)
  have hn : ∀ᶠz in 𝓝 e,|Complex.arg (z/e)|<ε :=
    ha.abs.eventually_lt_const (by simpa [div_self he0] using hε)
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hh⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨min δ ε,lt_min hδ hε,?_⟩
  intro e' he' hdist r hr hb
  let t : ℝ := Complex.arg (e'/e)
  have ht : -ε<t ∧ t<ε := abs_lt.mp (hh (hdist.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))
  have heq : e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)=e' := by
    have hnorm : ‖e'/e‖=1 := by rw [norm_div,he',he,div_one]
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (e'/e)
    rw [hnorm,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] at h
    change e*Complex.exp ((t:ℂ)*Complex.I)=e'
    rw [show Complex.exp ((t:ℂ)*Complex.I)=e'/e from h]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨(r,t),⟨mem_radialSide (hr.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) hb,ht⟩,?_⟩
  change x+(r:ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ))=x+(r:ℂ)*e'
  rw [heq]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
                                                                          
def essentialLocalSet {ι : Type*} (c : ℂ → ι) (i : ι) : Set ℂ :=
  {p | ∃U : Set ℂ,IsOpen U ∧ p∈U ∧ ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈U → c q=i}

name: essentialLocalSet_open
stmt: {ι : Type*} (c : ℂ → ι) (i : ι) : IsOpen (essentialLocalSet c i)
body:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
  rintro p ⟨U,hU,hp,hae⟩
  exact ⟨U,fun q hq => ⟨U,hU,hq,hae⟩,hU,hp⟩

name: essentialLocalSet_disjoint
stmt: {ι : Type*} (c : ℂ → ι) {i j : ι} (hne : i≠j) : Disjoint (essentialLocalSet c i) (essentialLocalSet c j)
body:
:= by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro p ⟨U,hU,hp,hu⟩ ⟨V,hV,hp',hv⟩
  have hpos := (hU.inter hV).measure_pos (volume : Measure ℂ) ⟨p,hp,hp'⟩
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqa⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae (hu.and hv))
  exact hne ((hqa.1 hq.1).symm.trans (hqa.2 hq.2))

name: essentialLocalSet_ae
stmt: {ι : Type*} (c : ℂ → ι) (i : ι) : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈essentialLocalSet c i → c q=i
body:
:=
  ae_of_locally_ae volume (fun _ h => h)

name: connected_local_ae_constant
stmt: {ι : Type*} {c : ℂ → ι} {S : Set ℂ} (hS : IsConnected S) (hl : ∀p∈S,∃i,p∈essentialLocalSet c i) : ∃i,S⊆essentialLocalSet c i ∧ (∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈S → c q=i)
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hS.nonempty
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hl p hp
  let V : Set ℂ := ⋃j≠i,essentialLocalSet c j
  have hv : IsOpen V := isOpen_iUnion fun j => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => essentialLocalSet_open c j
  have hd : Disjoint (essentialLocalSet c i) V := by
    apply disjoint_iUnion_right.mpr
    intro j
    apply disjoint_iUnion_right.mpr
    intro hji
    exact essentialLocalSet_disjoint c (Ne.symm hji)
  have hsuv : S⊆essentialLocalSet c i∪V := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hl q hq
    by_cases hji : j=i
    · exact Or.inl (hji ▸ hj)
    · exact Or.inr (mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨j,hji,hj⟩)
  have hs := hS.isPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hv hd hsuv ⟨p,hp,hi⟩
  exact ⟨i,hs,(essentialLocalSet_ae c i).mono fun q hq hs' => hq (hs hs')⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: triangle_majority_cover
stmt: : ∀s : Fin 3 → Bool,∃b : Bool, ∀j∈({0,1,2} : Finset (Fin 5)),∃i : Fin 3,s i=b ∧ j∈triangleEdge i
body: := by decide

name: triangle_outsider
stmt: : ∀s : Fin 3 → Bool,∀b : Bool, (∀j∈({0,1,2} : Finset (Fin 5)),∃i : Fin 3,s i=b ∧ j∈triangleEdge i) → ∀j : Fin 5,(∀i : Fin 3,s i=b → j∉triangleEdge i) → j=3 ∨ j=4
body: := by decide

name: ApproachingContinuum.side_strip
stmt: {x : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} {v e : ℂ} (h : ApproachingContinuum x K v) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hn : ⟪e,v⟫≠0) (b : Bool) (hs : decide (0<⟪e,v⟫)=b) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K
body:
:= by
  cases b
  · have hneg : ⟪e,v⟫<0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt (of_decide_eq_false hs)) hn
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hh⟩ := h.inner_strip he hneg
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' hd r hr hab hr1 => hh e' he' hd r hr ?_ hr1⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp hab).1
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hh⟩ := h.outer_strip he (of_decide_eq_true hs)
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' hd r _ hab hr1 => hh e' he' hd r hr1 ?_⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp hab).2
    linarith

name: triangle_outsider_strip
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) {e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) (hn : ∀i,⟪e,v i⟫≠0) : ∃b : Bool,∃δ>0,∃W : Set ℂ,IsOpen W ∧ (∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z=3 ∨ c z=4) ∧ ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ, 0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈W
body:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Fin 3 → Bool := fun i => decide (0<⟪e,v i⟫)
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := triangle_majority_cover s
  let E : Finset (Fin 3) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex (i : E) := (hK i).side_strip he (hn i) b ((Finset.mem_filter.mp i.2).2)
  choose d hd hs using hex
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,_,hδd⟩ := finite_positive_lower_bound Finset.univ d (fun i _ => hd i)
  let W : Set ℂ := ⋂i : E,Straddle (K i)
  refine ⟨b,δ,hδ,W,isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun i => straddle_isOpen (K i)),?_,?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K triangleEdge hH] with z hz hzW
    apply triangle_outsider s b hb (c z)
    intro i hi
    exact hz i (mem_iInter.mp hzW ⟨i,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hi⟩⟩)
  · intro e' he' heδ r hr hrδ hside
    apply mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    exact hs i e' he' (heδ.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) r hr
      (hrδ.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) hside

name: triangle_palette_local
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) (hnR : ∀i,⟪direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ),v i⟫≠0) : ∃i : Fin 5,(i=3 ∨ i=4) ∧ ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧ ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → i∈palette c hc x u
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bu,δu,hδu,U,hU,hUc,hsU⟩ := triangle_outsider_strip hc hK hH (direction_norm t) hn
  have hunit : ‖direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ)‖=1 := by
    rw [norm_mul,direction_norm,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  obtain ⟨bv,δv,hδv,V,hV,hVc,hsV⟩ := triangle_outsider_strip hc hK hH hunit hnR
  apply binary_strip_palette_rigidity c hc hw hU hV hUc hVc (lt_min hδu hδv) bu bv
  · intro e' he' hd r hr hrd hb
    exact hsU e' he' (hd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) r hr (hrd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) hb
  · intro e' he' hd r hr hrd hb
    exact hsV e' he' (hd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) r hr (hrd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) hb
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: triangle_binary_from_continua
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : BinaryCenter c hc x 3 4
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,(∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) →
      t∈paletteSet c hc x 3 ∨ t∈paletteSet c hc x 4 := by
    apply ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨b,δ,hδ,W,hW,hWc,hs⟩ := triangle_outsider_strip hc hK hH (direction_norm t) ht
    have hcols : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈({3,4} : Finset (Fin 5)) :=
      hWc.mono fun z hz hzw => by simpa only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] using hz hzw
    have hex : ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
        ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → (palette c hc x u∩{3,4}).Nonempty := by
      cases b
      · apply inner_strip_trace c hc hδ hW hcols
        intro u hu r hr hrδ hr1
        apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r hr _ hr1
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
      · apply outer_strip_trace c hc hδ hW hcols
        intro u hu r hr1 hrδ
        apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r (by linarith) _ hr1
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨A,hA,htA,hae⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨A,hA,htA,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hu hAu
    rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hi with ⟨hip,hi⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl|hi
    · exact Or.inl ((mem_palette c hc x u 3).mp hip)
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
      subst i
      exact Or.inr ((mem_palette c hc x u 4).mp hip)
  filter_upwards [hh,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))] with t ht hn
  exact ht hn
def triangleState (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact if t∈paletteSet c hc x 3 then false else true

name: triangleState_measurable
stmt: (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (x : ℂ) : Measurable (triangleState c hc x)
body: := Measurable.ite (paletteSet_measurable c hc x 3) measurable_const measurable_const

name: triangleState_flip
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x 3 4) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,triangleState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(triangleState c hc x t)
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [binary_alternation c hc hw hb] with t ht
  by_cases hp : t∈paletteSet c hc x 3
  · have hn : t+(sixty : Angles)∉paletteSet c hc x 3 := fun h => (ht.1.mp h) hp
    simp only [triangleState,hp,hn,ite_true,ite_false,Bool.not_false]
  · have hn : t+(sixty : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x 3 := ht.1.mpr hp
    simp only [triangleState,hp,hn,ite_true,ite_false,Bool.not_true]

name: triangleState_local
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) (hnR : ∀i,⟪direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ),v i⟫≠0) : ∃b,t∈angleEssential (triangleState c hc x) b
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,A,hA,htA,hae⟩ := triangle_palette_local hc hw hK hH hn hnR
  have hb := binary_alternation c hc hw (triangle_binary_from_continua hc hv hK hH)
  rcases hi with rfl|rfl
  · refine ⟨false,A,hA,htA,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
    have hp := (mem_palette c hc x u 3).mp (hu hAu)
    simp only [triangleState,hp,ite_true]
  · refine ⟨true,A,hA,htA,?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hae,hb] with u hu hu' hAu
    have hp := hu'.2.mp ((mem_palette c hc x u 4).mp (hu hAu))
    simp only [triangleState,hp,ite_false]

name: direction_injective
stmt: : Function.Injective direction
body:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  AddCircle.injective_toCircle (by positivity : (2*Real.pi:ℝ)≠0) (Subtype.ext h)

name: direction_plus_sixty
stmt: (t : Angles) : direction (t+(sixty : Angles))=direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [←AddCircle.coe_add,direction_real,direction_real,Circle.exp_add]
  rfl

name: triple_orthogonal_cover
stmt: (v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) : ∃B : Finset Angles,B.card≤6 ∧ (∀t,t+(Real.pi : Angles)∈B ↔ t∈B) ∧ ∀t,t∉B → ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0
body:
:= by
  classical
  have hex (i : Fin 3) : ∃t : Angles,direction t=Complex.I*v i := direction_exists
    (by rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_I,hv,one_mul])
  choose a ha using hex
  let B : Finset Angles := Finset.univ.biUnion fun i : Fin 3 => {a i,a i+(Real.pi : Angles)}
  have hmem (t : Angles) : t∈B ↔ ∃i : Fin 3,t=a i ∨ t=a i+(Real.pi : Angles) := by
    simp only [B,Finset.mem_biUnion,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton]
  have hdouble (t : Angles) : t+(Real.pi : Angles)+(Real.pi : Angles)=t := by
    apply direction_injective
    simp only [direction_add_pi,neg_neg]
  refine ⟨B,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · calc B.card ≤ ∑i : Fin 3,({a i,a i+(Real.pi : Angles)} : Finset Angles).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
         _ ≤ ∑_i : Fin 3,2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => by simpa using (Finset.card_insert_le (a _) ({a _+(Real.pi : Angles)} : Finset Angles))
         _ = 6 := by norm_num
  · intro t
    rw [hmem,hmem]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,hi|hi⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inr (by rw [←hi,hdouble])⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (add_right_cancel hi)⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl|rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inr rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (hdouble _)⟩
  · intro t ht i hinner
    apply ht
    rw [hmem]
    rcases complex_unit_orthogonal (direction_norm t) (hv i) hinner with he|he
    · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (direction_injective (he.trans (ha i).symm))⟩
    · refine ⟨i,Or.inr (direction_injective ?_)⟩
      rw [direction_add_pi,ha,he]
      ring

name: triangle_boundary_one_orbit
stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : ∃t,angleBoundary (triangleState c hc x)={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=t+sixAngle j}
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,ha,hn⟩ := triple_orthogonal_cover v hv
  apply angleBoundary_one_orbit (triangleState_flip hc hw (triangle_binary_from_continua hc hv hK hH)) B hB ha
  intro t ht htR
  apply triangleState_local hc hw hv hK hH (hn t ht)
  simpa only [direction_plus_sixty] using hn (t+(sixty : Angles)) htR
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
