name: angleEssential_connected
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} {U : Set Angles} (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hne : U.Nonempty) (hbound : Disjoint U (angleBoundary s)) : ∃b,U⊆angleEssential s b
body:
:= by
  have hcov : U⊆angleEssential s false∪angleEssential s true := by
    intro t ht
    have hn := disjoint_left.mp hbound ht
    simp only [angleBoundary,mem_compl_iff,not_not,mem_iUnion] at hn
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hn
    cases b
    · exact Or.inl hb
    · exact Or.inr hb
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hne
  rcases hcov ht with hb|hb
  · exact ⟨false,hU.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s false) (angleEssential_open s true)
      (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide)) hcov ⟨t,ht,hb⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨true,hU.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s true) (angleEssential_open s false)
      (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide)) (by simpa only [union_comm] using hcov) ⟨t,ht,hb⟩⟩

name: one_orbit_first_arc
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} {φ : ℝ} (hboundary : angleBoundary s={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=(φ : Angles)+sixAngle j}) : ∃b,∀t∈Ioo φ (φ+Real.pi/3),(t : Angles)∈angleEssential s b
body:
:= by
  let U : Set Angles := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) '' Ioo φ (φ+Real.pi/3)
  have hU : IsPreconnected U := isPreconnected_Ioo.image _ continuous_quotient_mk'.continuousOn
  have hne : U.Nonempty := (nonempty_Ioo.mpr (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : φ<φ+Real.pi/3)).image _
  have hd : Disjoint U (angleBoundary s) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro q ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ hq
    rw [hboundary] at hq
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hq
    have he : (t : Angles)=((φ+(j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) := by
      have hx : sixAngle j=((j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) := by
        rw [sixAngle,←AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul,sixty]
      simpa only [hx,AddCircle.coe_add] using hj
    have htI : t∈Ico φ (φ+2*Real.pi) := ⟨ht.1.le,by linarith [Real.pi_pos,ht.2]⟩
    have hjI : φ+(j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)∈Ico φ (φ+2*Real.pi) := by
      have hj0 : 0≤(j.val:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hj6 : (j.val:ℝ)<6 := by exact_mod_cast j.isLt
      constructor
      · nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      · nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hv := (AddCircle.coe_eq_coe_iff_of_mem_Ico htI hjI).mp he
    by_cases hz : j.val=0
    · simp only [hz,Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] at hv
      linarith [ht.1]
    · have hj1 : (1:ℝ)≤j.val := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz
      nlinarith [ht.2,Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := angleEssential_connected hU hne hd
  exact ⟨b,fun t ht => hb ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩⟩

name: angleEssential_real_periodic
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (b : Bool) : Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s b) (2*(Real.pi/3))
body:
:= by
  intro t
  apply propext
  have hh := angleEssential_shift hf ((t : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)) (!b)
  rw [Bool.not_not] at hh
  have hh' := angleEssential_shift hf (t : Angles) b
  have he : ((t+2*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) = (t : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)+(sixty : Angles) := by
    calc ((t+2*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) = ((t+sixty+sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
           congr 1
           dsimp [sixty]
           ring
         _ = _ := by rw [AddCircle.coe_add,AddCircle.coe_add]
  dsimp only
  rw [he]
  exact hh.trans hh'

name: one_orbit_sectors
stmt: {s : Angles → Bool} {φ : ℝ} (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (hboundary : angleBoundary s={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=(φ : Angles)+sixAngle j}) : ∃b,(∀t,0<Real.sin (3*(t-φ)) → (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s b) ∧ (∀t,Real.sin (3*(t-φ))<0 → (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b))
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := one_orbit_first_arc hboundary
  have hb' (t : ℝ) (ht : t∈Ioo (φ+Real.pi/3) (φ+2*(Real.pi/3))) :
      (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b) := by
    have hh := (angleEssential_shift hf ((t-Real.pi/3 : ℝ) : Angles) b).mpr
      (hb (t-Real.pi/3) ⟨by linarith [ht.1],by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
    simpa only [sixty,←AddCircle.coe_add,sub_add_cancel] using hh
  have hreduce (t : ℝ) : ∃r : ℝ,∃n : ℤ,0≤r ∧ r<2*(Real.pi/3) ∧
      t=φ+r+n*(2*(Real.pi/3)) ∧ Real.sin (3*(t-φ))=Real.sin (3*r) := by
    let n : ℤ := ⌊(t-φ)/(2*(Real.pi/3))⌋
    let r : ℝ := (t-φ)-n*(2*(Real.pi/3))
    have he : t=φ+r+n*(2*(Real.pi/3)) := by dsimp [r]; ring
    refine ⟨r,n,Int.sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg _ (by positivity),Int.sub_floor_div_mul_lt _ (by positivity),he,?_⟩
    have he' : 3*(t-φ)=3*r+(n:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) := by rw [he]; ring
    rw [he',Real.sin_add_int_mul_two_pi]
  refine ⟨b,?_,?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r,n,hr0,hrP,he,hsin⟩ := hreduce t
    rw [hsin] at ht
    have hrpos : 0<r := by
      by_contra hn
      have hr : r=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) hr0
      simp only [hr,mul_zero,Real.sin_zero,lt_self_iff_false] at ht
    have hra : r<Real.pi/3 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := Real.sin_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_neg_pi_le
        (by linarith : 3*r-2*Real.pi≤0) (by linarith : -Real.pi≤3*r-2*Real.pi)
      rw [Real.sin_sub_two_pi] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) ht
    have hy := hb (φ+r) ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (angleEssential_real_periodic hf b).int_mul n (φ+r) ▸ hy
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r,n,hr0,hrP,he,hsin⟩ := hreduce t
    rw [hsin] at ht
    have hra : Real.pi/3<r := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith : 0≤3*r) (by linarith : 3*r≤Real.pi)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) ht
    have hy := hb' (φ+r) ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (angleEssential_real_periodic hf (!b)).int_mul n (φ+r) ▸ hy
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: moser_density_impossible
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x v : ℂ) (hv : ‖v‖=1) (J : Finset (Fin k)) (hJ : J.card≤3) : ¬(∀ i, DensityOne {q | c q∈J} (x+v*placedMoser i))
body:
:= by
  intro hD
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hp⟩ := finite_density_realization hc hw (fun i => x+v*placedMoser i)
    (fun _ => J) hD
  have hh : Fintype.card J≤Fintype.card (Fin 3) := by simpa using hJ
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hh
  apply moser_not_three_colorable (fun i => f ⟨c (q+(x+v*placedMoser i)),hq i⟩)
  intro i j hij he
  have hd : ‖(x+v*placedMoser i)-(x+v*placedMoser j)‖=1 := by
    rw [show (x+v*placedMoser i)-(x+v*placedMoser j)=v*(placedMoser i-placedMoser j) by ring,
      norm_mul,hv,placedMoser_edge_unit hij,one_mul]
  exact hp i j hd (congrArg Subtype.val (f.injective he))
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds
stmt: {A : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hA : A∈𝓝 t) : LineDensityZero Aᶜ t
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hA
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [(eventually_lt_nhds hε).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with r hr
  have hempty : Aᶜ∩Metric.closedBall t r=∅ := by
    ext q
    simp only [mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false]
    rintro ⟨hq,hqr⟩
    exact hq (hsub (lt_of_le_of_lt hqr hr))
  simp [hempty]
def positiveSector (φ : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {t | 0<Real.sin (3*(t-φ))}
def negativeSector (φ : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {t | Real.sin (3*(t-φ))<0}

name: positiveSector_open
stmt: (φ : ℝ) : IsOpen (positiveSector φ)
body:
:= by
  apply isOpen_lt <;> fun_prop

name: negativeSector_open
stmt: (φ : ℝ) : IsOpen (negativeSector φ)
body:
:= by
  apply isOpen_lt <;> fun_prop
variable {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)

name: polynomial_region_density
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {a b : Fin k} {φ : ℝ} (hpos : RealState hc x (positiveSector φ) {a}) (hneg : RealState hc x (negativeSector φ) {b}) {z : ℂ} (hz : ThreeLabelRegion z.re z.im) : DensityOne {q | c q∉({a,b} : Finset (Fin k))} (x+(Circle.exp φ:ℂ)*z)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,u,hs,hn,ht⟩ := polynomial_region_angles hz
  have hpoint : angularSum x 1 (angleChart (φ+t,φ+u))=x+(Circle.exp φ:ℂ)*z := by
    simp only [angularSum,angleChart,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,direction_real,Circle.exp_add,Circle.coe_mul]
    rw [add_assoc,←mul_add,hs]
  have hnon : Real.sin ((φ+u)-(φ+t))≠0 := by
    simpa only [show φ+u-(φ+t)=u-t by ring] using hn
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp ht with ⟨ht,hu⟩|⟨ht,hu⟩
  · have htm : φ+t∈positiveSector φ := by simpa [positiveSector] using ht
    have hum : φ+u∈negativeSector φ := by simpa [negativeSector] using hu
    have hd := states_densityOne hc hw hpos hneg
      (lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds ((positiveSector_open φ).mem_nhds htm))
      (lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds ((negativeSector_open φ).mem_nhds hum)) hnon
    rw [hpoint] at hd
    simpa only [Finset.singleton_union] using hd
  · have htm : φ+t∈negativeSector φ := by simpa [negativeSector] using ht

stmt: {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i)) (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : False

  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := triangle_boundary_one_orbit hc hw hv hK hH
  obtain ⟨φ,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective q
  obtain ⟨b,hpos,hneg⟩ := one_orbit_sectors (triangleState_flip hc hw hbinary) hq
  have hstate (d : Bool) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
      (hAd : ∀t∈A,(t : Angles)∈angleEssential (triangleState c hc x) d) :

name: LineDensityZero.mono_ae
stmt: {A B : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hB : LineDensityZero B t) (hAB : A≤ᵐ[volume] B) : LineDensityZero A t
body:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ hB
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    exact div_nonneg measureReal_nonneg (le_of_lt hr)
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt hr)
    apply ENNReal.toReal_mono
    · exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall t r).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
    · exact measure_mono_ae (hAB.mono fun _ hz h => ⟨hz h.1,h.2⟩)
def DensityZero (A : Set ℂ) (x : ℂ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume (A∩Metric.closedBall x r)/volume (Metric.closedBall x r))
    (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (0:ENNReal))

name: DensityZero.mono
stmt: {A B : Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hB : DensityZero B x) (hAB : A⊆B) : DensityZero A x
body:
:= by
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hB (fun _ => zero_le)
  intro r
  exact ENNReal.div_le_div_right (measure_mono (inter_subset_inter_left _ hAB)) _

name: DensityZero.union
stmt: {A B : Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hA : DensityZero A x) (hB : DensityZero B x) : DensityZero (A∪B) x
body:
:= by
  have hh := hA.add hB
  rw [add_zero] at hh
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hh (fun _ => zero_le)
  intro r
  dsimp only
  rw [← ENNReal.add_div,union_inter_distrib_right]
  exact ENNReal.div_le_div_right (measure_union_le _ _) _

name: DensityZero.biUnion_finset
stmt: {ι : Type*} (J : Finset ι) {A : ι → Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hA : ∀ i∈J,DensityZero (A i) x) : DensityZero (⋃ i∈J,A i) x
body:
:= by
  classical
  induction J using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using densityZero_empty x
  | @insert i J hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
    exact (hA i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).union
      (ih (fun j hj => hA j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: DensityZero.compl
stmt: {A : Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hz : DensityZero A x) : DensityOne Aᶜ x
body:
:= by
  have ht := ENNReal.Tendsto.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ENNReal))) hz (Or.inl (by finiteness))
  rw [tsub_zero] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  have hfin : volume (A∩Metric.closedBall x r)≠⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall x r).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  have hp := (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume x hr).ne'
  have he : Aᶜ∩Metric.closedBall x r=Metric.closedBall x r\(A∩Metric.closedBall x r) := by
    ext z; simp; tauto
  rw [he,measure_sdiff inter_subset_right (hA.inter measurableSet_closedBall).nullMeasurableSet hfin,
    ENNReal.sub_div (fun _ _ => hp),ENNReal.div_self hp (isCompact_closedBall x r).measure_ne_top]
variable {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)
def RealState (x : ℂ) (A : Set ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin k)) : Prop :=
  MeasurableSet A ∧ ∀ i∈J, A≤ᵐ[volume] liftPalette c hc x i

stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {A : Set ℝ} {J : Finset (Fin k)} (hA : RealState hc x A J) {t u : ℝ} (ht : LineDensityZero Aᶜ t) (hu : Real.sin (u-t)≠0) {i : Fin k} (hi : i∈J) : DensityZero {z | c z=i} (angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t,u)))
body:
:= by

  apply ht.mono_ae
  filter_upwards [hA.2 i hi] with v hv
  exact mt hv

name: states_densityOne
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {A B : Set ℝ} {J K : Finset (Fin k)} (hA : RealState hc x A J) (hB : RealState hc x B K) {t u : ℝ} (ht : LineDensityZero Aᶜ t) (hu : LineDensityZero Bᶜ u) (hne : Real.sin (u-t)≠0) : DensityOne {z | c z∉J∪K} (angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t,u)))
body:
:= by
  have hz : DensityZero (⋃ i∈J∪K, {z | c z=i}) (angularSum x 1 (angleChart (t,u))) := by
    apply DensityZero.biUnion_finset
    intro i hi
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hi with hi|hi
    · exact state_densityZero hc hw hA ht hne hi
    · rw [← angularSum_swap x t u]
      apply state_densityZero hc hw hB hu _ hi
      rwa [← neg_sub u t,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
  have hm : MeasurableSet (⋃ i∈J∪K, {z | c z=i}) :=
    (J∪K).measurableSet_biUnion fun _ _ => measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const
  convert hz.compl hm using 1
  ext z
  simp only [mem_compl_iff,mem_iUnion,mem_ofPred_eq]
  aesop
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: DensityOne.compl
stmt: {A : Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (h : DensityOne A x) : DensityZero Aᶜ x

  have hp := (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume x hr).ne'

name: DensityOne.measure_ne_zero
stmt: {A : Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (h : DensityOne A x) : volume A≠0
body:
:= by

  have hzero : (fun r => volume (A∩Metric.closedBall x r)/volume (Metric.closedBall x r))=fun _ : ℝ => (0:ENNReal) := by
    funext r
    rw [measure_mono_null inter_subset_left hz,ENNReal.zero_div]

name: DensityOne.iInter
stmt: {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {A : ι → Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hm : ∀i,MeasurableSet (A i)) (h : ∀i,DensityOne (A i) x) : DensityOne (⋂i,A i) x
body:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hh (J : Finset ι) : DensityOne (⋂i∈J,A i) x := by
    induction J using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa using densityOne_univ x
    | @insert i J hi ih =>
      simp only [Finset.set_biInter_insert]
      exact (h i).inter (hm i) (J.measurableSet_biInter fun j _ => hm j) ih
  simpa using hh Finset.univ
variable {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k}

name: finite_density_realization
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (z : ι → ℂ) (J : ι → Finset (Fin k)) (hz : ∀v,DensityOne {q | c q∈J v} (z v)) : ∃q : ℂ, (∀v,c (q+z v)∈J v) ∧ ∀v w, ‖z v-z w‖=1 → c (q+z v)≠c (q+z w)
body:
:= by
  have hmem : DensityOne (⋂v,{q | c (q+z v)∈J v}) 0 := by
    apply DensityOne.iInter
    · intro v
      exact (J v).finite_toSet.measurableSet.preimage (hc.comp (measurable_id.add_const _))
    · intro v
      simpa only [zero_add,preimage_ofPred_eq] using (densityOne_translate (A := {q | c q∈J v}) (x := 0) (u := z v)).mpr (by simpa using hz v)
  have hproper : ∀ᵐ q : ℂ ∂volume, ∀v w, ‖z v-z w‖=1 → c (q+z v)≠c (q+z w) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro v
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro w
    by_cases hh : ‖z v-z w‖=1
    · obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists (u := z w-z v) (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hh)
      have hd := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (z v)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
        (weak_all_directions c hc hw t)
      filter_upwards [hd] with q hq _
      simpa only [ht,show q+z v+(z w-z v)=q+z w by ring] using hq
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => fun h => (hh h).elim
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqp⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hmem.measure_ne_zero (ae_restrict_of_ae hproper)
  exact ⟨q,fun v => mem_iInter.mp hq v,hqp⟩

name: two_label_triangle_impossible
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (z : Fin 3 → ℂ) (J : Finset (Fin k)) (hJ : J.card≤2) (hd : ∀v w,v≠w → ‖z v-z w‖=1) : ¬(∀v,DensityOne {q | c q∈J} (z v))

name: bool_flip_two
stmt: {s : ℝ → Bool} {κ : ℝ} (h : ∀ᵐt∂volume,s (t+κ)= !(s t)) : ∀ᵐt∂volume,s (t+2*κ)=s t

name: bool_flip_even
stmt: {s : ℝ → Bool} {κ : ℝ} (h : ∀ᵐt∂volume,s (t+κ)= !(s t)) (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐt∂volume,s (t+2*n*κ)=s t

    filter_upwards [ih,h'] with t ht ht'

name: two_state_impossible
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) (J K : Finset (Fin k)) (hcard : (Finset.univ\(J∪K)).card≤2) (s : Angles → Bool) (hs : Measurable s) (hJ : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | s (t : Angles)=false} J) (hK : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | s (t : Angles)=true} K) (hflip : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(Real.pi/3 : ℝ))= !(s t)) : False
body:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → Bool := fun t => s (t : Angles)
  have hf : Measurable f := hs.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable
  have hflip' : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, f (t+Real.pi/3)= !(f t) := by
    have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hflip
    simpa only [← AddCircle.coe_add] using hh
  have heven (n : ℕ) := bool_flip_even hflip' n
  have hπ : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, f (t+Real.pi)= !(f t) := by
    simpa only [show 3*(Real.pi/3)=Real.pi by ring] using bool_flip_three hflip'
  have hden : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, ∀b : Bool, f t=b → LineDensityZero {a : ℝ | f a≠b} t := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro b
    exact ae_lineDensityZero_compl (measurableSet_eq_fun hf measurable_const)
  have hgood : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, ∀j : Fin 3,
      f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=f t ∧
      f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)= !(f (t+triangleAngle)) ∧
      (∀b : Bool,f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=b →
        LineDensityZero {a : ℝ | f a≠b} (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) ∧
      (∀b : Bool,f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)=b →
        LineDensityZero {a : ℝ | f a≠b} (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro j
    have h₁ := heven j.val
    have h₂ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume triangleAngle).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (heven j.val)
    have h₃ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hπ
    have h₄ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hden
    have h₅ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hden
    filter_upwards [h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,h₅] with t ht₁ ht₂ ht₃ ht₄ ht₅
    refine ⟨ht₁,?_,ht₄,?_⟩
    · change f (t+(triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))+Real.pi)= !(f (t+(triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))) at ht₃
      rw [show t+(triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=t+triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) by ring,ht₂] at ht₃
      simpa only [show t+triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi = t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle by ring] using ht₃
    · simpa only [show t+(2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)=t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle by ring] using ht₅
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠt : ℝ in ae volume, f t=f (t+triangleAngle) := by
    by_contra hh
    have hn : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, f t≠f (t+triangleAngle) := not_frequently.mp hh
    have ha : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s t≠s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles)) := by
      apply ae_angular_of_ae_line
      · exact (measurableSet_eq_fun hs (hs.comp (measurable_id.add_const _))).compl
      · simpa only [f,← AddCircle.coe_add] using hn
    exact (ne_of_gt (equal_triangleAngle_positive hs hflip))
      (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr ha)
  obtain ⟨t,hteq,htgood⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually hgood).exists
  apply two_label_triangle_impossible hc hw (sourceTriangle x t) (Finset.univ\(J∪K)) hcard
    (sourceTriangle_pair x t)
  intro j
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩ := htgood j
  rw [← hteq] at h₂
  have hne : Real.sin ((t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)-(t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))≠0 := by
    rw [show (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)-(t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=Real.pi+triangleAngle by ring]
    exact triangleAngle_nonparallel
  have hd : DensityOne {q | c q∉J∪K} (sourceTriangle x t j) := by
    cases hb : f t
    · have ha := h₃ false (h₁.trans hb)
      have hb' := h₄ true (by simpa [hb] using h₂)
      exact states_densityOne hc hw hJ hK ha hb' hne
    · have ha := h₃ true (h₁.trans hb)
      have hb' := h₄ false (by simpa [hb] using h₂)
      simpa only [Finset.union_comm,sourceTriangle] using states_densityOne hc hw hK hJ ha hb' hne
  simpa only [Finset.mem_sdiff,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using hd
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def FourCenter (x : ℂ) : Prop :=
  TransitionEdge c 0 1 x ∧ TransitionEdge c 1 2 x ∧ TransitionEdge c 2 3 x ∧ TransitionEdge c 3 0 x

name: four_palette_admissible
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) : ∀ᵐ t∂angularMeasure, FourAdmissible (palette c hc x t)
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [palette_nonempty c hc x,palette_cardinality c hc hw x,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.1,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.2.1,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.2.2.1,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.2.2.2] with t ht hcard h01 h12 h23 h30
  refine ⟨ht,hcard.2,?_⟩
  intro e
  fin_cases e <;> simp only [fourEdge] <;> assumption
def fourState (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Fin 3 := fourCanonical (palette c hc x t)

name: fourState_measurable
stmt: (x : ℂ) : Measurable (fourState c hc x)
body:
:= by
  change Measurable (fun t => if 4∈palette c hc x t then (0:Fin 3) else if 0∈palette c hc x t then 1 else 2)
  exact Measurable.ite (by simpa only [mem_palette,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using paletteSet_measurable c hc x 4) measurable_const
    (Measurable.ite (by simpa only [mem_palette,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using paletteSet_measurable c hc x 0) measurable_const measurable_const)

name: fourState_group
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) : ∀ᵐ t∂angularMeasure, fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t
body:
:=
  (four_palette_admissible c hc hw hx).mono fun _ ht => four_admissible_group _ ht

name: fourState_represents
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) (s : Fin 3) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s} (fourGroup s)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun ((fourState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_group c hc hw hx)
  filter_upwards [hh] with t ht hts
  change fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s at hts
  exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp (ht (by simpa only [hts] using hi))

name: fourState_changes
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) : ∀ᵐ t∂angularMeasure, fourState c hc x t≠fourState c hc x (t+(Real.pi/3 : ℝ))
body:
:= by
  have hgp := fourState_group c hc hw hx
  filter_upwards [hgp,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hgp,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x] with t ht hu hd he
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := fourGroup_nonempty (fourState c hc x t)
  have hi' : i∈palette c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) := hu (by simpa only [sixty,he] using hi)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht hi) hi'

name: three_exclude_flip
stmt: : ∀ (s t o : Fin 3), o≠0 → s≠o → t≠o → s≠t → (if t=0 then false else true) = !(if s=0 then false else true)
body: := by decide

name: fourState_diagonal_positive
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) (s : Fin 3) (hs : s≠0) : 0<angularMeasure {t | fourState c hc x t=s}
body:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure, fourState c hc x t≠s :=
    measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 ∧ r≠s ∧ ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=r := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠0 ∧ (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠s ∧
      ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=(if s=1 then 2 else 1) from by decide) s hs
  let f : Angles → Bool := fun t => if fourState c hc x t=0 then false else true
  have hf : Measurable f := Measurable.ite
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hrep (v : Bool) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | f (t : Angles)=v} (if v then fourGroup r else fourGroup 0) := by
    refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun (hf.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_group c hc hw hx),
      angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot] with t ht htn htv
    change f (t : Angles)=v at htv
    apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp
    apply ht
    cases v
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0 := by simpa [f] using htv
      simpa only [hz,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] using hi
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=r := hr.2.2 _ (by simpa [f] using htv) htn
      simpa only [hz,ite_true] using hi
  have hcard : (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup r)).card≤2 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1))).card≤2 from by decide) s hs
  apply two_state_impossible hc hw x (fourGroup 0) (fourGroup r) hcard f hf (hrep false) (hrep true)
  filter_upwards [hnot,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (Real.pi/3 : ℝ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot,
      fourState_changes c hc hw hx] with t ht hu hne
  exact three_exclude_flip _ _ s hs ht hu hne
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: varying_pullback_L1
stmt: {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [ν.WeaklyRegular] {T : ℕ → X → Y} {S : X → Y} {C : ℝ≥0} (hT : ∀ n, Measurable (T n)) (hS : Measurable S) (hmT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, μ.map (T n) ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) (hmS : μ.map S ≤ (C : ENNReal) • ν) (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => T n x) atTop (𝓝 (S x))) {f : Y → ℝ} {g : ℕ → Y → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f ν) (hg : ∀ n, Integrable (g n) ν) (hgf : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, ‖g n y-f y‖ ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖g n (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
body:
:= by
  have hfixed := tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub_eventual hT hS hmT hmS ht hf
  have hbound : Tendsto (fun n => (C : ℝ)*(∫ y, ‖g n y-f y‖ ∂ν)+
      ∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero] using (hgf.const_mul (C : ℝ)).add hfixed
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hbound
  filter_upwards [hmT] with n hn
  have hgT := integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) hn (hg n)
  have hfT := integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) hn hf
  have hfS := integrable_comp_of_map_le hS hmS hf
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖g n (T n x)-f (T n x)‖+‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ :=
      integral_mono (hgT.sub hfS).norm ((hgT.sub hfT).norm.add (hfT.sub hfS).norm)
        (fun x => norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _)
    _ = (∫ x, ‖g n (T n x)-f (T n x)‖ ∂μ)+(∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) :=
      integral_add (hgT.sub hfT).norm (hfT.sub hfS).norm
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (integral_norm_comp_le (hT n) hn ((hg n).sub hf)) le_rfl

name: indicator_inter_positive
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {A : Set X} {B D : ℕ → Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : ∀ n,MeasurableSet (B n)) (hD : ∀ n,MeasurableSet (D n)) (hp : 0<μ A) (hBA : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖(B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x-A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) (hDA : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖(D n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x-A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0<μ (B n∩D n)
body:
:= by
  have hpos : 0<(μ A).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hp.ne' (measure_ne_top _ _)
  have ht := hBA.add hDA
  rw [add_zero] at ht
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hpos)] with n hn
  by_contra hh
  have hz : μ (B n∩D n)=0 := nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (le_of_not_gt hh)
  have hiA : Integrable (A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) μ := (integrable_const _).indicator hA
  have hiB : Integrable ((B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) μ := (integrable_const _).indicator (hB n)
  have hiD : Integrable ((D n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) μ := (integrable_const _).indicator (hD n)
  have hi := integral_mono_ae hiA ((hiB.sub hiA).norm.add (hiD.sub hiA).norm) ?_
  · simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
    rw [integral_add (hiB.sub hiA).norm (hiD.sub hiA).norm,integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) hA,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hi
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hi) hn
  · filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with x hx
    by_cases ha : x∈A
    · by_cases hb : x∈B n
      · have hd : x∉D n := fun hd => hx ⟨hb,hd⟩
        simp [ha,hb,hd]
      · by_cases hd : x∈D n <;> simp [ha,hb,hd]
    · simp only [Pi.add_apply,Set.indicator_of_notMem ha]
      positivity
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: circleEndpoint_identity_neighborhood
stmt: {a u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-a)≠0) : ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen I ∧ a∈I ∧ ∀ v∈I, circleTarget (samplingParameter 0 (direction (u : Angles)) 1,v)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧ circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter 0 (direction (u : Angles)) 1,v)=v
body:
:= by
  let V := (circleInverseHomeo h).source
  have ha : (a,u)∈V := (circleSum_strict 1 (a,u)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  let I := (fun v : ℝ => (v,u)) ⁻¹' V
  refine ⟨I,(circleInverseHomeo h).open_source.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const),ha,?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have he : circleTarget (samplingParameter 0 (direction (u : Angles)) 1,v)=circleSum 1 (v,u) := by
    simp [circleTarget,samplingParameter,circleSum,add_comm]
  have hv' : (v,u)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).source := hv
  have ht : circleSum 1 (v,u)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target := (circleInverseHomeo h).map_source hv'
  refine ⟨he ▸ ht,?_⟩
  rw [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_eq h ht]
  exact congrArg Prod.fst ((circleInverseHomeo h).left_inv hv')

name: near_identity_circle_in
stmt: {a u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-a)≠0) {w : ℕ → ℂ} (hw : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 (direction (u : Angles)))) {V : Set ℝ} (hV : IsOpen V) (haV : a∈V) : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ≤1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ≥0, 1≤C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ n,Measurable (T n)) ∧ (∀ v∈Metric.ball a δ,Tendsto (fun n => T n v) atTop (𝓝 v)) ∧ (∀ᶠ n in atTop, AntilipschitzWith C ((Metric.ball a δ).domRestrict (T n)) ∧ MapsTo (T n) (Metric.ball a δ) (Metric.closedBall a 1) ∧ MapsTo (T n) (Metric.ball a δ) V ∧ ∀ v∈Metric.ball a δ, ‖w n+direction (v : Angles)-direction (T n v : Angles)‖=1)
body:
:= by
  let p := samplingParameter 0 (direction (u : Angles)) 1
  have he : circleTarget (p,a)=circleSum 1 (a,u) := by
    simp [p,circleTarget,samplingParameter,circleSum,add_comm]
  have ha : Real.sin (a-u)≠0 := by rwa [← neg_sub u a,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
  obtain ⟨P,I,hP,hp,hI,hai,hIp,K,hK,hctrl⟩ := circleEndpoint_good_neighborhood h he rfl ha
  obtain ⟨J,hJ,haj,hid⟩ := circleEndpoint_identity_neighborhood h
  have hcv : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p,a),circleEndpoint h q∈V := by
    apply (circleEndpoint_strict h he).continuousAt
    simpa only [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_at] using hV.mem_nhds haV
  obtain ⟨P₁,hP₁,I₁,hI₁,hsubV⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hcv
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
    (inter_mem ((hI.inter hJ).mem_nhds ⟨hai,haj⟩) hI₁)
  let ε := min δ 1
  have hε : 0<ε := lt_min hδ (by norm_num)
  let T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n v => circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter 0 (w n) 1,v)
  have hparam := samplingParameter_tendsto (x := 0) hw tendsto_const_nhds
  have hT (n : ℕ) : Measurable (T n) :=
    (circleEndpoint_measurable h).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  refine ⟨ε,hε,min_le_right _ _,max K 1,le_max_right _ _,T,hT,?_,?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have hvI := (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).1
    have hh := (circleInverse_continuousAt h (hid v hvI.2).1).fst.tendsto.comp
      (circleTarget_continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hparam.prodMk_nhds tendsto_const_nhds))
    have hid' := (hid v hvI.2).2
    change Tendsto (fun n => T n v) atTop (𝓝 (circleEndpoint h (p,v))) at hh
    simpa only [p,hid'] using hh
  · filter_upwards [hparam.eventually (hP.mem_nhds hp),hparam.eventually hP₁] with n hn hnV
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
      intro v z
      have hv := (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) v.2)).1.1
      have hz := (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) z.2)).1.1
      exact ((hK _ hn).le_mul_dist ⟨v,hv⟩ ⟨z,hz⟩).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left K 1) dist_nonneg)
    · intro v hv
      exact (hctrl _ hn v (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).1.1).2.2
    · intro v hv
      exact hsubV ⟨hnV,(hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).2⟩
    · intro v hv
      have ht := (hctrl _ hn v (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).1.1).1
      have hh := circleInverse_sampling h ht
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,angularSum,zero_add,angleChart] at hh
      change w n+direction (v : Angles)=direction (T n v : Angles)+
        direction (((circleInverse h (circleTarget (samplingParameter 0 (w n) 1,v))).2) : Angles) at hh
      rw [hh,add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact Circle.norm_coe _
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: nonparallel_neighborhood
stmt: {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) {s : ℕ → ℝ} (hs : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 b)) : ∃ V : Set ℝ, IsOpen V ∧ a∈V ∧ ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ v∈V, Real.sin (s n-v)≠0
body:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun q : ℝ×ℝ => Real.sin (q.2-q.1)) :=
    Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst)
  have ho : IsOpen {q : ℝ×ℝ | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0} :=
    isOpen_compl_singleton.preimage hf
  have hh : {q : ℝ×ℝ | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0}∈𝓝 (a,b) := ho.mem_nhds h
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hh
  refine ⟨Metric.ball a ε,Metric.isOpen_ball,Metric.mem_ball_self hε,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hs.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds b hε)] with n hn
  intro v hv
  exact @hsub (v,s n) (show max (dist v a) (dist (s n) b)<ε from max_lt hv hn)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: strict_state_sequence_local_false
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℕ → ℂ) (J K : Finset (Fin k)) (X : Fin k) (hlabels : ∀i, i∉J∪K ↔ i=X) (A B : ℕ → Set ℝ) (D : Set ℝ) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hA : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (A n) J) (hB : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (B n) K) (b d : ℕ → ℝ) (b₀ d₀ a u : ℝ) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 b₀)) (hd : Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 d₀)) (hbden : ∀n,LineDensityZero (B n)ᶜ (b n)) (hdden : ∀n,LineDensityZero (B n)ᶜ (d n)) (hu : direction (u : Angles)=direction (b₀ : Angles)-direction (d₀ : Angles)) (hab : Real.sin (b₀-a)≠0) (had : Real.sin (d₀-a)≠0) (hau : Real.sin (u-a)≠0) (hpos : ∀ε>0,0<volume (D∩Metric.ball a ε)) (hL1 : ∀ E : Set ℝ, IsCompact E → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ v in E, ‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v-D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v‖) atTop (𝓝 0)) : False
body:
:= by
  let w : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => direction (b n : Angles)-direction (d n : Angles)
  have hdir : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => direction (v : Angles)) := direction_continuous.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi))
  have hwt : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 (direction (u : Angles))) := by
    rw [hu]
    exact (hdir.tendsto b₀ |>.comp hb).sub (hdir.tendsto d₀ |>.comp hd)
  obtain ⟨V,hV,haV,hparb⟩ := nonparallel_neighborhood hab hb
  obtain ⟨W,hW,haW,hpard⟩ := nonparallel_neighborhood had hd
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδ1,C,hC,T,hT,hTlim,hctrl⟩ := near_identity_circle_in hau hwt hW haW
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hηV⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hV.mem_nhds haV)
  let ε := min δ η
  have hε : 0<ε := lt_min hδ hη
  let I := Metric.ball a ε
  let E := Metric.closedBall a 1
  have hIE : I⊆E := (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_left δ η).trans hδ1)).trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hIδ : I⊆Metric.ball a δ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ η)
  have hIV : I⊆V := (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right δ η)).trans hηV
  let μ := volume.restrict I
  let ν := volume.restrict E
  have hEc : IsCompact E := isCompact_closedBall a 1
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ν := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hEc.measure_ne_top
  have : IsFiniteMeasure μ := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hEc.measure_ne_top (measure_mono hIE))
  have : ν.WeaklyRegular := Measure.WeaklyRegular.restrict_of_measure_ne_top hEc.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hS : AntilipschitzWith C (I.domRestrict id) := by
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro v z
    change dist v.1 z.1≤(C:ℝ)*dist v.1 z.1
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (1:ℝ)≤C by exact_mod_cast hC) (dist_nonneg (x := v.1) (y := z.1))
  have hmS : μ.map id≤(C:ENNReal) •ν := line_map_restrict_volume_le measurable_id hEc.measurableSet hS hIE
  have hmT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, μ.map (T n)≤(C:ENNReal) •ν := by
    filter_upwards [hctrl] with n hn
    apply line_map_restrict_volume_le (hT n) hEc.measurableSet
      (AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist fun v z => hn.1.le_mul_dist ⟨v,hIδ v.2⟩ ⟨z,hIδ z.2⟩)
    exact hn.2.1.mono_left hIδ
  have hiD : Integrable (D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) ν := (integrable_const _).indicator hD
  have hiA (n : ℕ) : Integrable ((A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) ν := (integrable_const _).indicator (hA n).1
  have hlimT : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ,Tendsto (fun n => T n v) atTop (𝓝 (id v)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with v hv
    exact hTlim v (hIδ hv)
  have hcomp := varying_pullback_L1 hT measurable_id hmT hmS hlimT hiD hiA (hL1 E hEc)
  have hdirect : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ v, ‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v-D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v‖ ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_nonneg fun v => norm_nonneg _) _
      (by simpa only [mul_zero] using (hL1 E hEc).const_mul (C:ℝ))
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_norm_comp_le measurable_id hmS ((hiA n).sub hiD)
  have hpre (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (T n ⁻¹' A n) := (hA n).1.preimage (hT n)
  have hcompeq (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ) : (T n ⁻¹' A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v =
      (A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (T n v) := by
    by_cases hv : T n v∈A n <;> simp [hv]
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,0<μ (A n∩T n ⁻¹' A n) := by
    apply indicator_inter_positive hD (fun n => (hA n).1) hpre ?_ hdirect
    · simpa only [hcompeq,id_eq] using hcomp
    · simpa only [μ,Measure.restrict_apply hD,I] using hpos ε hε
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hbp,hdp,hp⟩ := (hctrl.and (hparb.and (hpard.and hpositive))).exists
  have hqmp : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (T n) μ volume :=
    line_antilipschitz_qmp (hT n)
      (AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist fun v z => hn.1.le_mul_dist ⟨v,hIδ v.2⟩ ⟨z,hIδ z.2⟩)
  have hden := ae_lineDensityZero_compl (hA n).1
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ,v∈I ∧ (v∈A n → LineDensityZero (A n)ᶜ v) ∧
      (T n v∈A n → LineDensityZero (A n)ᶜ (T n v)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball,ae_restrict_of_ae hden,hqmp.ae hden] with v hv hd₁ hd₂
    exact ⟨hv,hd₁,hd₂⟩
  obtain ⟨v,hvA,hvI,hvden,hTvden⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hp.ne').and_eventually hgood).exists
  have h₁ := states_densityOne hc hw (hA n) (hB n) (hvden hvA.1) (hbden n) (hbp v (hIV hvI))
  have h₂ := states_densityOne hc hw (hA n) (hB n) (hTvden hvA.2) (hdden n)
    (hdp (T n v) (hn.2.2.1 (hIδ hvI)))
  have he : {z | c z∉J∪K}={z | c z=X} := by ext z; exact hlabels (c z)
  rw [he] at h₁ h₂
  apply weak_density_proper c hc hw X _ h₁ h₂
  have hdist := hn.2.2.2 v (hIδ hvI)
  convert hdist using 1
  congr 1
  simp only [angularSum,angleChart,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,w]
  ring
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: positive_state_support_point
stmt: {D : Set ℝ} (_hD : MeasurableSet D) (hp : 0<volume D) (b d u : ℝ) : ∃ a : ℝ, Real.sin (b-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (d-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (u-a)≠0 ∧ ∀ ε>0,0<volume (D∩Metric.ball a ε)
body:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ᵐ a ∂volume.restrict D, a∈(volume.restrict D).support ∧
      Real.sin (a-b)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (a-d)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (a-u)≠0 := by
    filter_upwards [(volume.restrict D).support_mem_ae,
      ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_sin_sub_ne_zero b),ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_sin_sub_ne_zero d),
      ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_sin_sub_ne_zero u)] with a ha hb hd hu
    exact ⟨ha,hb,hd,hu⟩
  obtain ⟨a,_,ha,hb,hd,hu⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hp.ne' hs
  have hneg (v : ℝ) (hv : Real.sin (a-v)≠0) : Real.sin (v-a)≠0 := by
    rwa [← neg_sub a v,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨a,hneg b hb,hneg d hd,hneg u hu,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  have hh := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall a).mp ha (Metric.ball a ε) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds a hε)
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball,inter_comm] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: support_density_direction
stmt: {B : Set ℝ} (hB : MeasurableSet B) {b : ℝ} (hb : b∈(volume.restrict B).support) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : ∃ t∈B, dist t b<ε ∧ LineDensityZero Bᶜ t
body:
:= by
  have hp : 0<volume (B∩Metric.ball b ε) := by
    have hh := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall b).mp hb (Metric.ball b ε) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds b hε)
    simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball,inter_comm] using hh
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hd⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hp.ne').and_eventually (ae_lineDensityZero_compl hB)).exists
  exact ⟨t,ht.1,ht.2,hd ht.1⟩

name: support_density_sequence
stmt: {B : ℕ → Set ℝ} (hB : ∀n,MeasurableSet (B n)) {b : ℕ → ℝ} {b₀ : ℝ} (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 b₀)) (hs : ∀n,b n∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support) : ∃ d : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 b₀) ∧ ∀n,LineDensityZero (B n)ᶜ (d n)
body:
:= by
  have hp (n : ℕ) : 0<(1:ℝ)/(n+1) := by positivity
  choose d _hmem hdist hden using fun n => support_density_direction (hB n) (hs n) (hp n)
  refine ⟨d,?_,hden⟩
  apply hb.congr_dist
  simp only [dist_comm (b _) (d _)]
  apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun n => (hdist n).le)
  exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: strict_state_sequence_false
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℕ → ℂ) (J K : Finset (Fin k)) (X : Fin k) (hlabels : ∀i, i∉J∪K ↔ i=X) (A B : ℕ → Set ℝ) (D : Set ℝ) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hp : 0<volume D) (hA : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (A n) J) (hB : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (B n) K) (b d : ℕ → ℝ) (b₀ d₀ : ℝ) (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 b₀)) (hd : Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 d₀)) (hbs : ∀n,b n∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support) (hds : ∀n,d n∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support) (hu : ‖direction (b₀ : Angles)-direction (d₀ : Angles)‖=1) (hL1 : ∀ E : Set ℝ, IsCompact E → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ v in E, ‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v-D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v‖) atTop (𝓝 0)) : False
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b',hb',hbden⟩ := support_density_sequence (fun n => (hB n).1) hb hbs
  obtain ⟨d',hd',hdden⟩ := support_density_sequence (fun n => (hB n).1) hd hds
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := direction_exists hu
  obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective u
  obtain ⟨a,hab,had,hau,hpos⟩ := positive_state_support_point hD hp b₀ d₀ u
  exact strict_state_sequence_local_false hc hw x J K X hlabels A B D hD hA hB
    b' d' b₀ d₀ a u hb' hd' hbden hdden hu hab had hau hpos hL1

name: strict_state_no_unit_support
stmt: {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {J K : Finset (Fin k)} {X : Fin k} (hlabels : ∀i, i∉J∪K ↔ i=X) {A B : Set ℝ} (hA : RealState hc x A J) (hB : RealState hc x B K) (hp : 0<volume A) {b d : ℝ} (hb : b∈(volume.restrict B).support) (hd : d∈(volume.restrict B).support) : ‖direction (b : Angles)-direction (d : Angles)‖≠1
body:
:= by
  intro hu
  apply strict_state_sequence_false hc hw (fun _ => x) J K X hlabels (fun _ => A) (fun _ => B)
    A hA.1 hp (fun _ => hA) (fun _ => hB) (fun _ => b) (fun _ => d) b d tendsto_const_nhds
    tendsto_const_nhds (fun _ => hb) (fun _ => hd) hu
  intro E _
  simp only [sub_self,norm_zero,integral_zero]
  exact tendsto_const_nhds
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

name: complex_unit_orthogonal
stmt: {e v : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : ‖v‖=1) (h : ⟪e,v⟫=0) : e=Complex.I*v ∨ e= -Complex.I*v
body:
:= by
  have hr : (e*star v).re=0 := by
    rw [real_inner_comm,Complex.inner] at h
    exact h
  have hn : ‖e*star v‖=1 := by rw [norm_mul,norm_star,he,hv,one_mul]
  have hs : (e*star v).im^2=1 := by
    have hh := Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq (e*star v)
    rw [hn] at hh
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply,hr,zero_mul,zero_add,one_pow] at hh
    nlinarith
  have him : (e*star v).im=1 ∨ (e*star v).im= -1 := by
    exact sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp (by simpa only [one_pow] using hs)
  have hmul : star v*v=1 := by
    change (starRingEnd ℂ) v*v=1
    rw [Complex.conj_mul']
    simp only [hv,one_pow,Complex.ofReal_one]
  rcases him with him|him
  · left
    have hz : e*star v=Complex.I := Complex.ext (by simpa using hr) (by simpa using him)
    calc e = (e*star v)*v := by rw [mul_assoc,hmul,mul_one]
         _ = Complex.I*v := congrArg (·*v) hz
  · right
    have hz : e*star v= -Complex.I := Complex.ext (by simpa using hr) (by simpa using him)
    calc e = (e*star v)*v := by rw [mul_assoc,hmul,mul_one]
         _ = -Complex.I*v := congrArg (·*v) hz

name: ae_direction_nonorthogonal
stmt: {v : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,⟪direction t,v⟫≠0
body:
:= by
  have hd : Function.Injective direction := fun _ _ h =>
    AddCircle.injective_toCircle (by positivity : (2*Real.pi:ℝ)≠0) (Subtype.ext h)
  have hf : {t | ⟪direction t,v⟫=0}.Finite := by
    apply ((Set.toFinite {Complex.I*v,-Complex.I*v}).preimage (f := direction) hd.injOn).subset
    intro t ht
    rcases complex_unit_orthogonal (direction_norm t) hv ht with ht|ht <;> simp [ht]
  exact measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (hf.measure_zero angularMeasure)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: proper_iff_weak
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] : (∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, ProperColoring k c) ↔ (∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, Measurable c ∧ WeakColoring k c)
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hw⟩ := proper_to_borel_weak hc
    exact ⟨d, hd, hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hw⟩
    exact properColoring_of_weak hc hw

name: algebraic_colorable_iff
stmt: {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] : (∃ c : PlaneFiveColor.Spectral.E → Fin k, PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.Proper k c) ↔ (∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, ProperColoring k c)
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hw⟩ := proper_to_borel_weak_algebraic hc
    exact properColoring_of_weak hd hw
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨fun x => c x, fun x y h => hc x y h⟩

end EuclideanFiveColor

name: transitionSet_measurable
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ℂ) : MeasurableSet (transitionSet c i j x R h)
body:
:= by
  exact measurableSet_ball.inter (((measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const).inter
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (hc.comp (measurable_id.add_const h)) measurable_const)).union
    ((measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const).inter
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (hc.comp (measurable_id.add_const h)) measurable_const)))

name: transitionSet_finite
stmt: (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ℂ) : volume (transitionSet c i j x R h) < ⊤
body:
:=
  (measure_mono (fun _ hq => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq.1)).trans_lt
    (isCompact_closedBall x R).measure_lt_top
def transitionRatio (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ℂ) : ENNReal :=
  volume (transitionSet c i j x R h) / ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖
def TransitionEdge (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) : Prop :=
  i ≠ j ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0<R → 0 < limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ))

name: transition_abundance
stmt: {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0<R) : ∃ a : ℝ, 0<a ∧ ∃ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ), a*‖h‖ < volume.real (transitionSet c i j x R h)
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,_,ha,hal⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp (he.2 R hR)
  have ha0 : 0<a := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp ha
  refine ⟨a,ha0,?_⟩
  have hf := frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup (h := hal)
  refine (hf.and_eventually self_mem_nhdsWithin).mono ?_
  intro h hh
  have hne : h≠0 := hh.2
  have hn : ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖≠0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hne)).ne'
  have hm : ENNReal.ofReal a*ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ < volume (transitionSet c i j x R h) :=
    (ENNReal.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (Or.inl hn) (Or.inl ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).mp hh.1
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul ha0.le] at hm
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal (mul_nonneg ha0.le (norm_nonneg h)) (transitionSet_finite c i j x R h).ne).mp hm

name: colorMass_own_zero
stmt: (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {q : ℂ} (hq : Typical c q) (hs : TypicalSampling c q 1) : colorMass c (c q) q=0
body:
:= by
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  filter_upwards [hs.2] with t ht
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] at ht
  have hn : c (q+direction t)≠c q := by
    intro he
    have hd : ‖q-(q+direction t)‖=1 := by
      simp only [sub_add_cancel_left,norm_neg]
      exact Circle.norm_coe _
    exact weak_density_proper c hc hw (c q) hd hq (by simpa only [Typical,he] using ht)
  simp only [sampleFn,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,ite_eq_right hn,Pi.zero_apply]

name: exists_energy_small
stmt: {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) {T : Set X} (hT : MeasurableSet T) (hfin : μ T < ⊤) {E : X → ℝ} (hE : Integrable E μ) (hn : ∀ᵐ q ∂μ, 0≤E q) {P : X → Prop} (hP : ∀ᵐ q ∂μ, P q) {d : ℝ} (hi : (∫ q, E q ∂μ) < d*μ.real T) : ∃ q ∈ T, P q ∧ E q<d
body:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict T) := ⟨by simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using hfin⟩
  have hge : ∀ᵐ q ∂μ.restrict T, d≤E q := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hT,ae_restrict_of_ae hP] with q hq hp
    exact h q hq hp
  have hl := integral_mono_ae (integrable_const d) hE.restrict hge
  have hr := integral_mono_measure (μ.restrict_le_self (s := T)) hn hE
  have he : (∫ _q in T, d ∂μ)=d*μ.real T := by simp [mul_comm]
  rw [he] at hl
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hl.trans hr)) hi
end EuclideanFiveColor

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
def colorError (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ℂ) : ComplexPlaneL2 :=
  let g := (colorCutoff_memLp c hc i x R).toLp (colorCutoff c i x R)
  circleOperator (g-planeTranslate h g)

name: colorError_ae
stmt: (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) {h : ℂ} (hh : ‖h‖<1) : ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), q ∈ Metric.ball x R → colorError c hc i x R h q = ((colorMass c i q-colorMass c i (q+h) : ℝ) : ℂ)
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [circleOperator_difference_ae (colorCutoff_memLp c hc i x R) h] with q hq hB
  exact hq.trans (colorCutoff_circleDifference c hc i x q h R hB hh)

name: colorError_smoothing
stmt: (i : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun h : ℂ => ‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2 / ‖h‖) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
body:
:=
  circle_smoothing_L2 _

name: transition_mass_energy
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) {h : ℂ} (hh : ‖h‖<1) : ∀ᵐ q ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), q ∈ transitionSet c i j x R h → (colorMass c i q+colorMass c j q)^2 ≤ ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [colorError_ae c hc i x R hh,colorError_ae c hc j x R hh,
    ae_density_actual c hc,ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1),
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_density_actual c hc),
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))] with q hi hj hq hqs hqh hqhs hT
  have he_i : ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2=(colorMass c i q-colorMass c i (q+h))^2 := by
    rw [hi hT.1,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  have he_j : ‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2=(colorMass c j q-colorMass c j (q+h))^2 := by
    rw [hj hT.1,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  rw [he_i,he_j]
  have h0 := colorMass_own_zero c hc hw hq hqs
  have h1 := colorMass_own_zero c hc hw hqh hqhs
  rcases hT.2 with ⟨hqi,hqj⟩ | ⟨hqj,hqi⟩
  · rw [hqi] at h0
    rw [hqj] at h1
    rw [h0,h1]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (colorMass c i (q+h))]
  · rw [hqj] at h0
    rw [hqi] at h1
    rw [h0,h1]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (colorMass c j (q+h))]
include hc in

name: transition_small_mass
stmt: (hw : WeakColoring k c) {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) {R ε : ℝ} (hR : 0<R) (hε : 0<ε) : ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball x R, TypicalSampling c q 1 ∧ colorMass c i q+colorMass c j q<ε
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hfreq⟩ := transition_abundance c he hR
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun h : ℂ =>
      (‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h‖^2)/‖h‖) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simp only [add_div]
    simpa only [add_zero] using (colorError_smoothing c hc i x R).add (colorError_smoothing c hc j x R)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ),
      (‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h‖^2)/‖h‖<ε^2*a :=
    (hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity))).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hnorm : ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ), ‖h‖<1 :=
    (continuous_norm.tendsto (0:ℂ)).eventually (by simpa using (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)))
      |>.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  obtain ⟨h,hab,hsm,hhn,hne⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually (hsmall.and (hnorm.and self_mem_nhdsWithin))).exists
  have hnpos : 0<‖h‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  let E : ℂ → ℝ := fun q => ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2
  have hEi : Integrable (fun q => ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2) volume :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable _)).mp (Lp.memLp _)
  have hEj : Integrable (fun q => ‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2) volume :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable _)).mp (Lp.memLp _)
  have hInt : (∫ q, E q ∂volume) < ε^2*volume.real (transitionSet c i j x R h) := by
    rw [show (∫ q, E q ∂volume) = ‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h‖^2 by
      dsimp only [E]
      rw [integral_add hEi hEj,← planeL2_norm_sq,← planeL2_norm_sq]]
    have hs := (div_lt_iff₀ hnpos).mp hsm
    have hab' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqs,henergy⟩ := exists_energy_small volume (transitionSet_measurable c hc i j x R h)
    (transitionSet_finite c i j x R h) (hEi.add hEj)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun q => add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
    ((ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)).and (transition_mass_energy c hc hw i j x R hhn)) hInt
  refine ⟨q,hq.1,hqs.1,?_⟩
  have hm := hqs.2 hq
  change E q<ε^2 at henergy
  change (colorMass c i q+colorMass c j q)^2≤E q at hm
  nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

name: shiftL2_ae
stmt: (z : ℂ) (f : PlaneL2) : shiftL2 z f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => f (x+z)
body:
:=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f _

name: shiftL2_continuous
stmt: (f : PlaneL2) : Continuous (fun z => shiftL2 z f)
body:
:= by
  let g : C(ℂ,C(ℂ,ℂ)) := (ContinuousMap.mk (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2+p.1) (by fun_prop)).curry
  exact continuous_const.compMeasurePreservingLp g.continuous (fun z => measurePreserving_add_right volume z) (by simp)

name: correlation_continuous
stmt: (f : PlaneL2) : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ⟪f,shiftL2 (Circle.exp t : ℂ) f⟫)
body:
:= by
  exact continuous_const.inner ((shiftL2_continuous f).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp Circle.exp.continuous))

name: product_zero_of_inner_zero
stmt: (f g : PlaneL2) (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ g x) (h : ⟪f,g⟫ = 0) : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, f x*g x=0
body:
:= by
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : ℂ => f x*g x) volume := by
    simpa [RCLike.inner_apply,mul_comm] using (L2.integrable_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) f g)
  have hn : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ f x*g x := by
    filter_upwards [hf,hg] with x hx hy
    exact mul_nonneg hx hy
  rw [L2.inner_def] at h
  apply (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hn hi).mp
  simpa [RCLike.inner_apply,mul_comm] using h

name: all_parameters_product_zero
stmt: {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] [MeasurableSpace T] (μ : Measure T) [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure] (d : T → ℂ) (hd : Continuous d) (f : PlaneL2) (hf : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ f x) (ho : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), f x*f (x+d t)=0) : ∀ t : T, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), f x*f (x+d t)=0
body:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : T => ⟪f,shiftL2 (d t) f⟫) :=
    continuous_const.inner ((shiftL2_continuous f).comp hd)
  have hz : (fun t : T => ⟪f,shiftL2 (d t) f⟫) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ho] with t ht
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [shiftL2_ae (d t) f,ht] with x hx hh
    simpa [RCLike.inner_apply,mul_comm,hx] using hh
  have he := (hc.ae_eq_iff_eq μ continuous_const).mp hz
  intro t
  have hg : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, 0 ≤ shiftL2 (d t) f x := by
    filter_upwards [shiftL2_ae (d t) f,
      (measurePreserving_add_right volume (d t)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hf] with x hx hh
    simpa only [hx] using hh
  have h0 := product_zero_of_inner_zero f (shiftL2 (d t) f) hf hg (congrFun he t)
  filter_upwards [h0,shiftL2_ae (d t) f] with x hx hh
  simpa only [hh] using hx
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
def truncatedClass (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : Set ℂ := {z | c z=i} ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 n
include hc

name: truncatedClass_measurable
stmt: (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (truncatedClass c i n)
body:
:=
  (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const).inter measurableSet_closedBall
omit hc in

name: truncatedClass_finite
stmt: (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : volume (truncatedClass c i n) ≠ ⊤
body:
:= by
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (n : ℝ)).measure_ne_top)
    (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
def truncatedVector (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : PlaneL2 :=
  (memLp_indicator_const 2 (truncatedClass_measurable c hc i n) (1 : ℝ) (Or.inr (truncatedClass_finite c i n))).toLp _

name: truncatedVector_ae
stmt: (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : truncatedVector c hc i n =ᵐ[volume] (truncatedClass c i n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
body:
:=
  MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

name: weak_all_directions
stmt: (hweak : WeakColoring k c) : ∀ t : Angles, ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), c z ≠ c (z+direction t)
body:
:= by
  have ho : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), c z ≠ c (z+direction t) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_ae_comm ?_).mp (Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hweak.2)
    exact (measurableSet_eq_fun (hc.comp measurable_fst)
      (hc.comp (measurable_fst.add (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd)))).compl
  have hz (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : ∀ t : Angles, ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ),
      truncatedVector c hc i n z*truncatedVector c hc i n (z+direction t)=0 := by
    apply all_parameters_product_zero angularMeasure direction direction_continuous
    · filter_upwards [truncatedVector_ae c hc i n] with z hz
      rw [hz]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
    · filter_upwards [ho] with t ht
      filter_upwards [ht,truncatedVector_ae c hc i n,
        (measurePreserving_add_right volume (direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (truncatedVector_ae c hc i n)] with z hne h1 h2
      rw [h1,h2]
      by_cases h : z ∈ truncatedClass c i n
      · have hh : z+direction t ∉ truncatedClass c i n := fun hh => hne (h.1.trans hh.1.symm)
        simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hh]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
  intro t
  have hi : ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((truncatedClass c i n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z)*
      ((truncatedClass c i n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (z+direction t))=0 := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hz i n t,truncatedVector_ae c hc i n,
      (measurePreserving_add_right volume (direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (truncatedVector_ae c hc i n)] with z h0 h1 h2
    simpa only [h1,h2] using h0
  filter_upwards [hi] with z hz
  intro he
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ‖z‖ ‖z+direction t‖)
  have h1 : z ∈ truncatedClass c (c z) n := ⟨rfl,by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn).le⟩
  have h2 : z+direction t ∈ truncatedClass c (c z) n := ⟨he.symm,by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn).le⟩
  have h0 := hz (c z) n
  simp [Set.indicator_of_mem h1,Set.indicator_of_mem h2] at h0
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def DensityOne (A : Set ℂ) (x : ℂ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume (A ∩ Metric.closedBall x r) / volume (Metric.closedBall x r))
    (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (1 : ENNReal))

name: densityOne_disjoint
stmt: {A B : Set ℂ} (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hd : AEDisjoint volume A B) {x : ℂ} (hA : DensityOne A x) : ¬ DensityOne B x
body:
:= by
  intro hb
  have hh := hA.add hb
  have hle : (1 : ENNReal)+1 ≤ 1 := le_of_tendsto hh (by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    rw [← ENNReal.add_div,← measure_union₀ (hB.inter measurableSet_closedBall).nullMeasurableSet
      (hd.mono inter_subset_left inter_subset_left)]
    apply (ENNReal.div_le_iff (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume x hr).ne'
      ((isCompact_closedBall x r).measure_ne_top)).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul] using measure_mono (union_subset inter_subset_right inter_subset_right))
  norm_num at hle

name: densityOne_translate
stmt: {A : Set ℂ} {x u : ℂ} : DensityOne ((fun z : ℂ => z+u) ⁻¹' A) x ↔ DensityOne A (x+u)
body:
:= by
  have he (r : ℝ) : (fun z : ℂ => z+u) ⁻¹' (Metric.closedBall (x+u) r) = Metric.closedBall x r := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm,add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  have h1 (r : ℝ) : volume (((fun z : ℂ => z+u) ⁻¹' A) ∩ Metric.closedBall x r) =
      volume (A ∩ Metric.closedBall (x+u) r) := by
    rw [← he,← Set.preimage_inter,measure_preimage_add_right]
  have h2 (r : ℝ) : volume (Metric.closedBall x r) = volume (Metric.closedBall (x+u) r) := by
    rw [← he,measure_preimage_add_right]
  simp only [DensityOne,h1,h2]

name: direction_exists
stmt: {u : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖=1) : ∃ t, direction t=u
body:
:= by
  let v : Circle := ⟨u,mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hu⟩
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := Circle.exp_surjective v
  exact ⟨(t : Angles),by simpa only [direction_real] using congrArg Subtype.val ht⟩

name: weak_density_proper
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (i : Fin k) {x y : ℂ} (hxy : ‖x-y‖=1) (hx : DensityOne {z | c z=i} x) : ¬ DensityOne {z | c z=i} y
body:
:= by
  let u := y-x
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists (u := u) (by simpa only [u,norm_sub_rev] using hxy)
  have hd : AEDisjoint volume {z | c z=i} ((fun z : ℂ => z+u) ⁻¹' {z | c z=i}) := by
    apply (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem).mpr
    filter_upwards [weak_all_directions c hc hw t] with z hz
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    exact hz (by simpa only [ht] using h1.trans h2.symm)
  have hh := densityOne_disjoint ((measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const).preimage
    (measurable_id.add_const u)) hd hx
  simp only [id_eq] at hh
  rw [densityOne_translate] at hh
  simpa only [u,add_sub_cancel] using hh

name: ae_density_actual
stmt: {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), DensityOne {z | c z=c x} x
body:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), ∀ i : Fin k,
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume ({z | c z=i} ∩ Metric.closedBall x r) / volume (Metric.closedBall x r))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (({z | c z=i} : Set ℂ).indicator (1 : ℂ → ENNReal) x)) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet volume
      (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)
  filter_upwards [hh] with x hx
  simpa only [DensityOne,Set.indicator_of_mem (show x ∈ {z | c z=c x} from rfl),Pi.one_apply] using hx (c x)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

name: covariance_sub_left
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v v' w : Func X) : covariance μ q φ (v-v') w = covariance μ q φ v w - covariance μ q φ v' w
body:
:= by
  have h := covariance_add_left μ q φ (v-v') v' w
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  rw [h]
  ext g y
  simp only [Family.sub_apply, Family.add_apply, sub_apply, add_apply]
  ring
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: covariance_sub_right
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w w' : Func X) : covariance μ q φ v (w-w') = covariance μ q φ v w - covariance μ q φ v w'
body:
:= by
  have h := covariance_add_right μ q φ v (w-w') w'
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  rw [h]
  ext g y
  simp only [Family.sub_apply, Family.add_apply, sub_apply, add_apply]
  ring

omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in
include hq in

name: covariance_norm_left
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (covariance μ q φ v w g)‖ ≤ (2*(bound w : ℝ))*‖l2 μ v‖
body:
:= by
  have hp := conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq v
  have h1 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ ≤ (bound w : ℝ)*‖l2 μ v‖ :=
    (conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq _).trans (l2_mul_norm_le μ v (act (φ g) w)
      (fun x => norm_le_bound w _))
  have h2 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ ≤
      (bound w : ℝ)*‖l2 μ v‖ := by
    have h := l2_norm_mul_le (μ.map q) (act (φ g) (conditional μ q w)) (conditional μ q v)
      (fun y => expect_bound _ w (norm_le_bound w) (φ g +ᵥ y))
    rw [mul_comm (act _ _) _] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (bound w).coe_nonneg)
  rw [covariance_apply, map_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ +
        ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

variable [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in
include hq hqcov in

name: covariance_norm_right
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (covariance μ q φ v w g)‖ ≤ (2*(bound v : ℝ))*‖l2 μ w‖
body:
:= by
  have hn : ‖l2 μ (act (φ g) w)‖ = ‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    rw [l2_act]
    exact (Amenable.Koopman.action μ (φ g)).norm_map _
  have h1 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ ≤ (bound v : ℝ)*‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    have h := (conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq (v*act (φ g) w)).trans
      (l2_norm_mul_le μ v _ (norm_le_bound v))
    rwa [hn] at h
  have hp : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ ≤ ‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    have he := (l2_eq_iff (μ.map q) _ _).mpr (conditional_act μ q hq hqcov (φ g) w)
    rw [← he, ← hn]
    exact conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq _
  have h2 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ ≤
      (bound v : ℝ)*‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    exact (l2_norm_mul_le (μ.map q) _ _ (expect_bound _ v (norm_le_bound v))).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (bound v).coe_nonneg)
  rw [covariance_apply, map_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ +
        ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]

name: meanNorm_zero_of_dense
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (S : Set (Func X)) (hd : ∀ f : Func X, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ h∈S, ‖l2 μ (f-h)‖ < ε) (T : Func X → Family G Y) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : ∀ f h : Func X, ∀ g, ‖l2 ν (T f g-T h g)‖ ≤ C*‖l2 μ (f-h)‖) (hS : ∀ f∈S, Family.meanNorm ν M (T f) = 0) (f : Func X) : Family.meanNorm ν M (T f) = 0
body:
:= by
  apply Family.meanNorm_eq_zero_of_approx
  intro ε hε
  have hden : 0 < C+1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨h,hh,hdist⟩ := hd f (ε/(C+1)) (div_pos hε hden)
  refine ⟨T h, hS h hh, fun g => ?_⟩
  have he : ε/(C+1)*(C+1) = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ ε/(C+1) := (div_pos hε hden).le
  calc
    _ ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (f-h)‖ := hT f h g
    _ ≤ C*(ε/(C+1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist.le hC
    _ ≤ ε := by nlinarith

variable [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in
include hq hqcov in

name: covariance_zero_of_dense
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (S : Set (Func X)) (hd : ∀ f : Func X, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ h∈S, ‖l2 μ (f-h)‖ < ε) (φ : G →+ G) (hS : ∀ v∈S, ∀ w∈S, Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0) (v w : Func X) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0
body:
:= by
  have hw (v : Func X) (hv : v∈S) (w : Func X) :
      Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0 := by
    apply meanNorm_zero_of_dense μ (μ.map q) M S hd (covariance μ q φ v)
      (C := 2*(bound v : ℝ)) (by positivity) _ (hS v hv) w
    intro w w' g
    have he : covariance μ q φ v w g - covariance μ q φ v w' g = covariance μ q φ v (w-w') g :=
      congrArg (fun F : Family G Y => F g) (covariance_sub_right μ q φ v w w').symm
    rw [he]
    exact covariance_norm_right μ q hq hqcov φ v (w-w') g
  apply meanNorm_zero_of_dense μ (μ.map q) M S hd (fun v => covariance μ q φ v w)
    (C := 2*(bound w : ℝ)) (by positivity) _ (fun v hv => hw v hv w) v
  intro v v' g
  have he : covariance μ q φ v w g - covariance μ q φ v' w g = covariance μ q φ (v-v') w g :=
    congrArg (fun F : Family G Y => F g) (covariance_sub_left μ q φ v v' w).symm
  rw [he]
  exact covariance_norm_left μ q hq φ (v-v') w g
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]

name: graph_mixture
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hf : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∀ᵐ x ∂κ y, q x = y) : (κ ∘ₘ ν).map (fun x => (q x,x)) = ν ⊗ₘ κ
body:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.map_apply (show Measurable (fun x => (q x,x)) from hq.prodMk measurable_id) hs,
    Measure.bind_apply (hs.preimage (show Measurable (fun x => (q x,x)) from hq.prodMk measurable_id)) (Kernel.measurable κ).aemeasurable,
    Measure.compProd_apply hs]
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hf] with y hy
  apply measure_congr
  filter_upwards [hy] with x hx
  change ((q x,x) ∈ s) = ((y,x) ∈ s)
  rw [hx]

name: map_mixture
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν] (κ : Kernel Y X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) (hf : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∀ᵐ x ∂κ y, q x = y) : (κ ∘ₘ ν).map q = ν
body:
:= by
  have he := congrArg Measure.fst (graph_mixture ν κ q hq hf)
  change ((κ ∘ₘ ν).map (fun x => (q x,id x))).fst = (ν ⊗ₘ κ).fst at he
  simpa only [Measure.fst_map_prodMk hq measurable_id, Measure.fst_compProd] using he

variable [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

include hq in

name: square_fiber
stmt: : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map q, ∀ᵐ z ∂((condDistrib id q μ).prod (condDistrib id q μ)) y, q z.1 = y
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ConditionalFiber.ae_in_own_fiber μ q hq] with y hy
  rw [Kernel.prod_apply]
  exact (measurePreserving_fst (μ := condDistrib id q μ y)
    (ν := condDistrib id q μ y)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hy

name: law_map_base
stmt: : (law μ q hq).map (q ∘ Prod.fst) = μ.map q
body:
:= by
  rw [law_eq_mixture]
  exact map_mixture (μ.map q) _ _ (hq.comp measurable_fst) (square_fiber μ q hq)

name: conditional_square
stmt: : condDistrib id (q ∘ Prod.fst) (law μ q hq) =ᵐ[μ.map q] (condDistrib id q μ).prod (condDistrib id q μ)
body:
:= by
  have he := graph_mixture (μ.map q) ((condDistrib id q μ).prod (condDistrib id q μ))
    (q ∘ Prod.fst) (hq.comp measurable_fst) (square_fiber μ q hq)
  rw [← law_eq_mixture μ q hq] at he
  have hc := condDistrib_ae_eq_of_measure_eq_compProd_of_measurable
    (hq.comp measurable_fst) measurable_id (he.trans (by rw [law_map_base]))
  rwa [law_map_base] at hc

end EuclideanFiveColor.RelativeProduct
