open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

omit [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] in

name: conditional_tensor
stmt: (v w : Func X) : conditional (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) (tensor v w) =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q v * conditional μ q w
body:
:= by
  filter_upwards [RelativeProduct.conditional_square μ q hq] with y hy
  change (∫ z, tensor v w z ∂condDistrib id (q ∘ Prod.fst) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) y) = _
  rw [hy, Kernel.prod_apply]
  exact integral_prod_mul v w

variable [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] in
include hq hqcov in

name: factor_preserving
stmt: (g : G) : MeasurePreserving (fun y : Y => g +ᵥ y) (μ.map q) (μ.map q)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurable_const_vadd g, ?_⟩
  rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_const_vadd g) hq]
  calc
    _ = μ.map (q ∘ (fun x => g +ᵥ x)) := Measure.map_congr (hqcov g).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [← Measure.map_map hq (measurable_const_vadd g), (measurePreserving_vadd g μ).map_eq]

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] in
include hqcov in

name: covariance_tensor
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : Func X) (g : G) : covariance (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) φ (tensor a₁ a₂) (tensor b₁ b₂) g =ᵐ[μ.map q] ((Family.conditional μ q (Family.const a₁ * Family.orbit φ b₁)) * (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const a₂ * Family.orbit φ b₂)) - (Family.const (conditional μ q a₁) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q b₁)) * (Family.const (conditional μ q a₂) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q b₂)) : Family G Y) g
body:
:= by
  have ht : tensor a₁ a₂ * act (φ g) (tensor b₁ b₂) = tensor (a₁*act (φ g) b₁) (a₂*act (φ g) b₂) := by
    rw [← tensor_act, tensor_mul]
  have h₁ := conditional_tensor μ q hq a₁ a₂
  have h₂ := (factor_preserving μ q hq hqcov (φ g)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (conditional_tensor μ q hq b₁ b₂)
  have h₃ := conditional_tensor μ q hq (a₁*act (φ g) b₁) (a₂*act (φ g) b₂)
  filter_upwards [h₁,h₂,h₃] with y hy₁ hy₂ hy₃
  change conditional _ _ (tensor a₁ a₂ * act (φ g) (tensor b₁ b₂)) y -
    conditional _ _ (tensor a₁ a₂) y * conditional _ _ (tensor b₁ b₂) (φ g +ᵥ y) = _
  rw [ht, hy₁, hy₂, hy₃]
  dsimp only [Family.mul_apply, Family.sub_apply, Family.conditional_apply,
    Family.const_apply, Family.orbit_apply, mul_apply, sub_apply, act_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
  ring

variable [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
include hqcov in

name: covariance_tensor_mean_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : Func X) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) φ (tensor a₁ a₂) (tensor b₁ b₂)) = 0
body:
:= by
  let A₁ := Family.conditional μ q (Family.const a₁ * Family.orbit φ b₁)
  let A₂ := Family.conditional μ q (Family.const a₂ * Family.orbit φ b₂)
  let B₁ := Family.const (conditional μ q a₁) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q b₁)
  let B₂ := Family.const (conditional μ q a₂) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q b₂)
  have h₁ : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (A₁-B₁) = 0 := covariance_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs a₁ b₁
  have h₂ : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (A₂-B₂) = 0 := covariance_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs a₂ b₂
  rw [Family.meanNorm_congr (μ.map q) M (covariance_tensor μ q hq hqcov φ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂)]
  change Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (A₁*A₂-B₁*B₂) = 0
  have he : A₁*A₂-B₁*B₂ = (A₁-B₁)*A₂ + (A₂-B₂)*B₁ := by ring
  rw [he]
  exact Family.meanNorm_add_zero _ _ (Family.meanNorm_mul_zero _ _ h₁) (Family.meanNorm_mul_zero _ _ h₂)
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
inductive FiniteTensor : Func (X×Y) → Prop
  | tensor (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) : FiniteTensor (tensor f g)
  | add {f g : Func (X×Y)} : FiniteTensor f → FiniteTensor g → FiniteTensor (f+g)

name: FiniteTensor.zero
stmt: : FiniteTensor (0 : Func (X×Y))
body:
:= by
  have he : BoundedMeasurable.tensor (0 : Func X) (0 : Func Y) = 0 := by ext z; simp
  rw [← he]
  exact .tensor _ _

name: FiniteTensor.sum
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func (X×Y)) (hf : ∀ i∈s, FiniteTensor (f i)) : FiniteTensor (∑ i∈s, f i)
body:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using FiniteTensor.zero (X := X) (Y := Y)
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact .add (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) (ih (fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: func_sum_apply
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) (x : X) : (∑ i∈s, f i) x = ∑ i∈s, f i x
body:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, ih]

variable [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated X] [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Y]
open RectangleDensity

def codeCell (n : ℕ) (c : Code n) : Func X := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x => if code X n x = c then (1:ℂ) else 0, ?_, 1, ?_⟩
  · exact measurable_const.piecewise ((measurable_code n) (measurableSet_singleton c)) measurable_const
  · intro x; dsimp only; split_ifs <;> simp

name: tensor_code_finite
stmt: (n : ℕ) (a : Code n × Code n → ℂ) (F : Func (X×Y)) (he : ∀ z, F z = a (pairCode n z)) : FiniteTensor F
body:
:= by
  classical
  let T : Code n × Code n → Func (X×Y) := fun c =>
    tensor (a c • codeCell (X := X) n c.1) (codeCell (X := Y) n c.2)
  have hsum : F = ∑ c, T c := by
    ext z
    rw [he, func_sum_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (pairCode n z)]
    · simp [T, tensor_apply, codeCell, pairCode]
    · intro c _ hc
      have hn : code X n z.1 ≠ c.1 ∨ code Y n z.2 ≠ c.2 := by
        contrapose! hc
        exact Prod.ext hc.1.symm hc.2.symm
      rcases hn with hn | hn <;> simp [T, tensor_apply, codeCell, hn]
    · simp
  rw [hsum]
  exact FiniteTensor.sum _ _ (fun _ _ => .tensor _ _)

name: finiteTensor_dense
stmt: (ν : Measure (X×Y)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (f : Func (X×Y)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ h : Func (X×Y), FiniteTensor h ∧ ‖l2 ν (f-h)‖ < ε
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,a,ha,_,he⟩ := bounded_rectangles ν f (measurable f) (bound f)
    (bound f).coe_nonneg (norm_le_bound f) ε hε
  let h : Func (X×Y) := ⟨fun z => a (pairCode n z),
    (measurable_of_countable a).comp (measurable_pairCode n), 2*bound f,
    fun z => by simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using ha (pairCode n z)⟩
  refine ⟨h, tensor_code_finite n a h (fun _ => rfl), ?_⟩
  have hh : ‖l2 ν (f-h)‖^2 < ε^2 := by
    rw [norm_l2_sq]
    exact he
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (l2 ν (f-h))]
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

section
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
include hqcov in

name: pairVanishing_of_covariance
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hc : ∀ (φ : G →+ G), Function.Surjective φ → ∀ v w : Func X, Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0) : PairVanishing μ q hq M
body:
:= by
  intro φ hs v w hw
  have he0 : l2 μ (project μ q hq w) = l2 μ 0 := hw.trans (map_zero _).symm
  have hp : project μ q hq w =ᵐ[μ] (0 : Func X) := (l2_eq_iff μ _ _).mp he0
  have he (g : G) : covariance μ q φ v w g =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) := by
    apply (covariance_center μ q hq hqcov φ v w g).trans
    apply conditional_congr μ q hq
    filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_vadd (φ g) μ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hp] with x hx
    change v x * (w (φ g +ᵥ x) - project μ q hq w (φ g +ᵥ x)) = v x*w (φ g +ᵥ x)
    change project μ q hq w (φ g +ᵥ x) = 0 at hx
    rw [hx, sub_zero]
  have hmean := hc φ hs v w
  have hnorm : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) =
      Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ w)) :=
    Family.meanNorm_congr _ _ he
  rw [hnorm] at hmean
  have hseq : Family.toL2 (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ w)) =
      pairSequence μ q hq φ v w := by ext g; rfl
  unfold Family.meanNorm at hmean
  rwa [hseq] at hmean
end

variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y] in
include hqcov in

name: square_equivariant
stmt: (g : G) : (fun z => (q ∘ Prod.fst) (g +ᵥ z)) =ᵐ[RelativeProduct.law μ q hq] (fun z => g +ᵥ (q ∘ Prod.fst) z)
body:
:= by
  have hp : MeasurePreserving Prod.fst (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) μ :=
    ⟨measurable_fst, Measure.fst_compProd μ ((condDistrib id q μ).comap q hq)⟩
  exact hp.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hqcov g)

variable [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
include hqcov in

name: covariance_finiteTensor_mean_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v w : Func (X×X)) (hv : FiniteTensor v) (hw : FiniteTensor w) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) φ v w) = 0
body:
:= by
  induction hv with
  | tensor a₁ a₂ =>
    induction hw with
    | tensor b₁ b₂ => exact covariance_tensor_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂
    | add _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      rw [covariance_add_right]
      exact Family.meanNorm_add_zero _ _ ih₁ ih₂
  | add _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [covariance_add_left]
    exact Family.meanNorm_add_zero _ _ ih₁ ih₂

include hqcov in

name: square_pairVanishing
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) : PairVanishing (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) (hq.comp measurable_fst) M
body:
:= by
  have : VAddInvariantMeasure G (X×X) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) :=
    RelativeProduct.law_invariant_add μ q hq (fun g => measurePreserving_vadd g μ) hqcov
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ((RelativeProduct.law μ q hq).map (q ∘ Prod.fst)) := by
    rw [RelativeProduct.law_map_base μ q hq]
    infer_instance
  apply pairVanishing_of_covariance (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst)
    (hq.comp measurable_fst) (square_equivariant μ q hq hqcov) M
  intro φ hs v w
  apply covariance_zero_of_dense (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst)
    (hq.comp measurable_fst) (square_equivariant μ q hq hqcov) M
    {f | FiniteTensor f} (fun f ε hε => finiteTensor_dense _ f ε hε) φ _ v w
  intro v hv w hw
  simpa only [RelativeProduct.law_map_base μ q hq] using
    covariance_finiteTensor_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs v w hv hw
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

omit [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] in

name: square_tensor_centered
stmt: (f : Func X) (hf : l2 μ (project μ q hq f) = 0) : l2 (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (project (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) (hq.comp measurable_fst) (tensor f (bmConj f))) = 0
body:
:= by
  have he : l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q f) = 0 := by
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← norm_project_l2 μ q hq, hf, norm_zero]
  have hz : conditional μ q f =ᵐ[μ.map q] (0 : Func Y) := by
    apply (l2_eq_iff _ _ _).mp
    rw [he, map_zero]
  have ht : conditional (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) (tensor f (bmConj f))
      =ᵐ[μ.map q] (0 : Func Y) := by
    filter_upwards [conditional_tensor μ q hq f (bmConj f), hz] with y hy hz
    rw [hy]
    change conditional μ q f y * _ = 0
    rw [hz, zero_apply, zero_mul]
  rw [← map_zero (l2 (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq))]
  apply (l2_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  have ht' : conditional (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (q ∘ Prod.fst) (tensor f (bmConj f)) =ᵐ[(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq).map (q ∘ Prod.fst)] (0 : Func Y) := by
    simpa only [RelativeProduct.law_map_base μ q hq] using ht
  exact (ae_of_ae_map (hq.comp measurable_fst).aemeasurable ht').mono (fun z hz => hz)

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
omit [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [StandardBorelSpace X]
  [Nonempty X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: tensor_prod
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f h : ι → Func X) : tensor (∏ i∈s, f i) (∏ i∈s, h i) = ∏ i∈s, tensor (f i) (h i)
body:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => ext z; simp [tensor_apply]
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi, tensor_mul, ih]

variable [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
variable [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
include hqcov in

name: centered_conditional_mean_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (θ : G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (ha : Admissible s (fun i => θ + φ i)) (hc : ∃ j∈s, l2 μ (project μ q hq (f j)) = 0) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))) = 0
body:
:= by
  let ρ := RelativeProduct.law μ q hq
  have : VAddInvariantMeasure G (X×X) ρ :=
    RelativeProduct.law_invariant_add μ q hq (fun g => measurePreserving_vadd g μ) hqcov
  let t : ι → Func (X×X) := fun i => tensor (f i) (bmConj (f i))
  let F : Family G (X×X) := ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (θ+φ i) (t i)
  have htc : ∃ j∈s, l2 ρ (project ρ (q ∘ Prod.fst) (hq.comp measurable_fst) (t j)) = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨j,hj,hf⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨j,hj,square_tensor_centered μ q hq (f j) hf⟩
  have hv : Family.avg ρ M F = 0 := avg_product_zero_of_pair ρ (q ∘ Prod.fst)
    (hq.comp measurable_fst) (square_equivariant μ q hq hqcov) M
    (square_pairVanishing μ q hq hqcov M hp) s (fun i => θ+φ i) t ha htc
  unfold Family.meanNorm
  apply M.norm_mean_zero_of_square
  have he : Amenable.Mean.squareNorm (Family.toL2 (μ.map q)
      (Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)))) =
      Amenable.Mean.pairing (Family.toL2 ρ F) (l2 ρ (1 : Func (X×X))) := by
    ext g
    simp only [Amenable.Mean.squareNorm_apply, Amenable.Mean.pairing_apply,
      Family.toL2_apply, Family.conditional_apply, Family.prod_apply, Family.orbit_apply]
    change ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (f i)))‖^2 =
      inner ℝ (l2 ρ (F g)) (l2 ρ (1 : Func (X×X)))
    have hF : F g = act (θ g) (tensor (∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (f i))
        (bmConj (∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (f i)))) := by
      dsimp only [F]
      rw [Family.prod_apply, conj_prod, tensor_prod, act_prod]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [← act_conj, tensor_act, ← act_add]
      rfl
    have hc1 : bmConj (1 : Func (X×X)) = 1 := by ext z; simp
    rw [hF, real_inner_comm, l2_inner, hc1, one_mul, integral_act,
      integral_tensor_self μ q hq]
    rfl
  rw [he, ← Family.avg_pair, hv, inner_zero_left]
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.AlgebraReplacement
variable {ι A : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [CommRing A]

name: prod_sub_prod
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → A) : (∏ i∈s, f i) - (∏ i∈s, g i) = ∑ t∈s.powerset.erase ∅, (∏ i∈t, (f i-g i)) * ∏ i∈s\t, g i
body:
:= by
  have he := Finset.prod_add (fun i => f i-g i) g s
  simp only [sub_add_cancel] at he
  rw [he]
  have hs := Finset.sum_erase_add s.powerset
    (fun t => (∏ i∈t, (f i-g i)) * ∏ i∈s\t, g i) (Finset.empty_mem_powerset s)
  simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sdiff_empty, one_mul] at hs
  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr hs.symm
end EuclideanFiveColor.AlgebraReplacement
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
omit [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: Family.conditional_sum
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Family G X) : Family.conditional μ q (∑ i∈s, f i) = ∑ i∈s, Family.conditional μ q (f i)
body:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => ext g y; simp [Family.conditional, conditional, expect]
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi, Family.conditional_add, ih]

variable [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
variable [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
include hqcov in

name: conditional_multiple_mean_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (θ : G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (ha : Admissible s (fun i => θ + φ i)) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)) - ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (conditional μ q (f i))) = 0
body:
:= by
  let a : ι → Family G X := fun i => Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)
  let b : ι → Family G X := fun i => Family.orbit (φ i) (project μ q hq (f i))
  have hb (g : G) : conditional μ q ((∏ i∈s, b i) g) =ᵐ[μ.map q]
      (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (conditional μ q (f i))) g := by
    simp only [Family.prod_apply, Family.orbit_apply]
    apply (conditional_congr μ q hq (f := ∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (project μ q hq (f i)))
      (g := comp (∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (conditional μ q (f i))) q hq) ?_).trans
      (conditional_lift μ q hq _)
    filter_upwards [prod_act_project_lift μ q hq hqcov s φ f g] with x hx
    simpa only [func_prod_apply, Finset.prod_apply] using hx
  have hrep : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q
      ((∏ i∈s, a i) - ∏ i∈s, b i)) = 0 := by
    rw [AlgebraReplacement.prod_sub_prod s a b, Family.conditional_sum]
    apply Family.meanNorm_sum_zero
    intro t ht
    have hts : t ⊆ s := Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ht)
    have htn : t.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ht)
    rw [AlgebraReplacement.mixed_prod s t hts]
    let w : ι → Func X := fun i => if i∈t then f i-project μ q hq (f i) else project μ q hq (f i)
    have he : (∏ i∈s, if i∈t then a i-b i else b i) = ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (w i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      by_cases hit : i∈t
      · simp only [hit, ↓reduceIte, w, a, b]
        apply Family.ext
        intro g
        exact (act_sub _ _ _).symm
      · simp only [hit, ↓reduceIte, w, b]
    rw [he]
    apply centered_conditional_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp s φ θ w ha
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := htn
    refine ⟨j,hts hj,?_⟩
    simp only [w, hj, ↓reduceIte]
    exact center_project_l2 μ q hq (f j)
  rw [Family.conditional_sub] at hrep
  rw [Family.meanNorm_congr (μ.map q) M (F := Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, a i) -
      Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, b i)) (H := Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, a i) -
      ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (conditional μ q (f i))) (fun g => by
        filter_upwards [hb g] with y hy
        simp only [Family.sub_apply, sub_apply, Family.conditional_apply]
        rw [hy])] at hrep
  exact hrep
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
def scaleHom (n : ℤ) : G →+ G := n • AddMonoidHom.id G

name: scaleHom_apply
stmt: (n : ℤ) (g : G) : scaleHom n g = n • g
body: := rfl

name: scaleHom_add
stmt: (n m : ℤ) : scaleHom (G := G) (n+m) = scaleHom n + scaleHom m
body: := add_smul _ _ _

name: scaleHom_sub
stmt: (n m : ℤ) : scaleHom (G := G) (n-m) = scaleHom n - scaleHom m
body:
:= sub_smul _ _ _
variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
omit [DecidableEq ι] in

name: shifted_admissible
stmt: (hdiv : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (scaleHom (G := G) n)) (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (hn : Set.InjOn n s) : ∃ m : ℤ, Admissible s (fun i => scaleHom (G := G) m + scaleHom (n i))
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (s.image (fun i => -n i))
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    dsimp only
    rw [← scaleHom_add]
    apply hdiv
    intro hz
    have he : m = -n i := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz
    exact hm (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i,hi,he.symm⟩)
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    have he : (scaleHom m + scaleHom (n i)) - (scaleHom m + scaleHom (n j)) =
        scaleHom (G := G) (n i-n j) := by rw [scaleHom_sub]; abel
    rw [he]
    apply hdiv
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hij (hn hi hj h))
variable {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
variable [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
include hqcov in

name: conditional_integer_multiple_mean_zero
stmt: (hdiv : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (scaleHom (G := G) n)) (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (s : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) (f : ι → Func X) (hn : Set.InjOn n s) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (scaleHom (n i)) (f i)) - ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (scaleHom (n i)) (conditional μ q (f i))) = 0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := shifted_admissible hdiv s n hn
  exact conditional_multiple_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp s (fun i => scaleHom (n i)) (scaleHom m) f hm
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

name: shift_apply
stmt: {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] (g x : G) (f : G →ᵇ E) : shift G g f x = f (x+g)
body:
:= rfl

                                                                   
structure Mean where
  map : (G →ᵇ ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ
  map_const : ∀ c, map (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G c) = c
  positive : ∀ f, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → 0 ≤ map f
  invariant : ∀ g f, map (shift G g f) = map f

variable {G}
namespace Mean
variable (M : Mean G)

name: mono
stmt: (f h : G →ᵇ ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x ≤ h x) : M.map f ≤ M.map h
body:
:= by
  have hm := M.positive (h-f) (fun x => sub_nonneg.mpr (hf x))
  simpa only [map_sub, sub_nonneg] using hm

name: abs_le
stmt: (f h : G →ᵇ ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ h x) : |M.map f| ≤ M.map h
body:
:= by
  rw [_root_.abs_le]
  constructor
  · have := M.mono (-h) f (fun x => (_root_.abs_le.mp (hf x)).1)
    simpa only [map_neg] using this
  · exact M.mono f h fun x => (_root_.abs_le.mp (hf x)).2

name: exists_lt
stmt: {f : G →ᵇ ℝ} {ε : ℝ} (h : M.map f < ε) : ∃ g, f g < ε
body:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have := M.mono (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G ε) f hn
  rw [M.map_const] at this
  exact (not_lt_of_ge this) h

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def normFn (V : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun x => ‖V x‖)
    (continuous_norm.comp V.continuous) ‖V‖ (fun x => by simpa using V.norm_coe_le_norm x)
omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: normFn_apply
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (x : G) : normFn V x = ‖V x‖
body:
:= rfl

def pairing (V : G →ᵇ H) (v : H) : G →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun x => inner ℝ (V x) v)
    (V.continuous.inner continuous_const) (‖V‖ * ‖v‖)
    (fun x => (norm_inner_le_norm _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (V.norm_coe_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg v)))
omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: pairing_apply
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (v : H) (x : G) : pairing V v x = inner ℝ (V x) v
body:
:= rfl

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: pairing_bound
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (v : H) : |M.map (pairing V v)| ≤ M.map (normFn V) * ‖v‖
body:
:= by
  have he : M.map (‖v‖ • normFn V) = M.map (normFn V) * ‖v‖ := by
    rw [map_smul]; simp [mul_comm]
  rw [← he]
  apply M.abs_le
  intro x
  simpa [mul_comm] using (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) (V x) v)

def pairingMap (V : G →ᵇ H) : H →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    { toFun := fun v => M.map (pairing V v)
      map_add' := by
        intro v w
        have he : pairing V (v+w) = pairing V v + pairing V w := by ext; simp [inner_add_right]
        rw [he, map_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c v
        have he : pairing V (c • v) = c • pairing V v := by ext; simp [inner_smul_right]
        rw [he, map_smul]; rfl }
    (M.map (normFn V)) (fun v => M.pairing_bound V v)

def vector (V : G →ᵇ H) : H := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm (M.pairingMap V)

name: vector_pair
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (v : H) : inner ℝ (M.vector V) v = M.map (pairing V v)
body: := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply

name: vector_norm_le
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) : ‖M.vector V‖ ≤ M.map (normFn V)
body:
:= by
  rw [vector, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  apply (M.pairingMap V).opNorm_le_bound (M.positive _ (fun x => by simp))
  exact M.pairing_bound V

name: vector_add
stmt: (V W : G →ᵇ H) : M.vector (V+W) = M.vector V + M.vector W
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [inner_add_left, M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair]
  have he : pairing (V+W) v = pairing V v + pairing W v := by ext; simp [inner_add_left]
  rw [he, map_add]

name: vector_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (V : G →ᵇ H) : M.vector (c • V) = c • M.vector V
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [real_inner_smul_left, M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair]
  have he : pairing (c • V) v = c • pairing V v := by ext; simp [real_inner_smul_left]
  rw [he, map_smul]; rfl

name: vector_shift
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (g : G) : M.vector (shift G g V) = M.vector V
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair]
  exact M.invariant g (pairing V v)

name: vector_map
stmt: {J : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup J] [InnerProductSpace ℝ J] [CompleteSpace J] (L : H →L[ℝ] J) (V : G →ᵇ H) : M.vector (L.compLeftContinuousBounded G V) = L (M.vector V)
body:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [M.vector_pair, ← L.adjoint_inner_right, M.vector_pair]
  congr 1; ext x
  exact (L.adjoint_inner_right (V x) v).symm

def squareNorm (V : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ := normFn V * normFn V
omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: squareNorm_apply
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (x : G) : squareNorm V x = ‖V x‖^2
body:
:= by
  simp [squareNorm, pow_two]

name: jensen
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) : ‖M.vector V‖^2 ≤ M.map (squareNorm V)
body:
:= by
  let c := M.vector V
  have he : squareNorm (V - BoundedContinuousFunction.const G c) =
      squareNorm V - (2 : ℝ) • pairing V c + BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (‖c‖^2) := by
    ext x
    simp only [squareNorm_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.const_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, pairing_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
  have hp := M.positive (squareNorm (V - BoundedContinuousFunction.const G c)) (fun x => by
    rw [squareNorm_apply]; positivity)
  rw [he, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, M.map_const, ← M.vector_pair] at hp
  change 0 ≤ M.map (squareNorm V) - 2 * inner ℝ c c + ‖c‖^2 at hp
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hp
  dsimp [c] at hp
  linarith
end Mean
end EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Mean

section
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
variable (M : Mean G)
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def cross (V W : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun x => inner ℝ (V x) (W x))
    (V.continuous.inner W.continuous) (‖V‖ * ‖W‖) (fun x => by
      exact (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul (V.norm_coe_le_norm x) (W.norm_coe_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))

omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: cross_apply
stmt: (V W : G →ᵇ H) (x : G) : cross V W x = inner ℝ (V x) (W x)
body:
:= rfl

omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: cross_comm
stmt: (V W : G →ᵇ H) : cross V W = cross W V
body:
:= by
  ext x; exact real_inner_comm _ _

omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: squareNorm_add
stmt: (V W : G →ᵇ H) : squareNorm (V+W) = squareNorm V + squareNorm W + (2 : ℝ) • cross V W
body:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [squareNorm_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, cross_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [norm_add_sq_real]; ring

omit [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: squareNorm_shift
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (g : G) : M.map (squareNorm (shift G g V)) = M.map (squareNorm V)
body:
:=
  M.invariant g (squareNorm V)

def correlation (V W : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
    (fun g => M.map (cross (shift G g V) W)) continuous_of_discreteTopology
    (‖V‖ * ‖W‖) (fun g => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← M.map_const (‖V‖ * ‖W‖)]
      apply M.abs_le
      intro x
      exact (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul (V.norm_coe_le_norm (x+g)) (W.norm_coe_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_apply
stmt: (V W : G →ᵇ H) (g : G) : M.correlation V W g = M.map (cross (shift G g V) W)
body:
:= rfl

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_add
stmt: (V W Z : G →ᵇ H) : M.correlation V (W+Z) = M.correlation V W + M.correlation V Z
body:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [correlation_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1; ext x
  simp only [cross_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, inner_add_right]

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_zero
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) : M.correlation V 0 = 0
body:
:= by
  ext g
  change M.map (cross (shift G g V) (0 : G →ᵇ H)) = 0
  have he : cross (shift G g V) (0 : G →ᵇ H) = 0 := by ext; simp
  rw [he, map_zero]

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_shift
stmt: (V W : G →ᵇ H) (g : G) : M.correlation V (shift G g W) = shift G (-g) (M.correlation V W)
body:
:= by
  ext h
  change M.map (cross (shift G h V) (shift G g W)) =
    M.map (cross (shift G (h+-g) V) W)
  rw [← M.invariant (-g) (cross (shift G h V) (shift G g W))]
  congr 1; ext x
  simp only [shift_apply, cross_apply]
  congr 2 <;> abel

name: vector_eq_zero_of_correlation_nonpos
stmt: (V : G →ᵇ H) (hc : M.map (M.correlation V V) ≤ 0) : M.vector V = 0
body:
:= by
  classical
  let C : ℝ := M.map (squareNorm V) + 2
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    have := M.positive (squareNorm V) (fun x => by rw [squareNorm_apply]; positivity)
    dsimp [C]; linarith
  have hW (n : ℕ) : ∃ W : G →ᵇ H, M.vector W = (n : ℝ) • M.vector V ∧
      M.map (M.correlation V W) ≤ 0 ∧ M.map (squareNorm W) ≤ (n : ℝ)*C := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have he : M.vector (0 : G →ᵇ H) = 0 := by
          apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
          rw [M.vector_pair, inner_zero_left]
          have he : pairing (0 : G →ᵇ H) v = 0 := by ext; simp
          rw [he, map_zero]
        simpa using he
      · simp [M.correlation_zero]
      · have he : squareNorm (0 : G →ᵇ H) = 0 := by ext; simp
        simp [he]
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨W, hv, hwc, hwe⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := M.exists_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hwc zero_lt_one)
      refine ⟨W+shift G g V, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [M.vector_add, M.vector_shift, hv]
        simp [Nat.cast_add, add_smul]
      · rw [M.correlation_add, map_add, M.correlation_shift, M.invariant]
        linarith
      · rw [squareNorm_add, map_add, map_add, map_smul, M.squareNorm_shift,
          cross_comm W _, ← M.correlation_apply V W g]
        have hn : ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ)+1 := by simp
        rw [hn]
        dsimp [C] at *
        change M.map (squareNorm W) + M.map (squareNorm V) + 2 * M.correlation V W g ≤
          ((n : ℝ)+1) * (M.map (squareNorm V) + 2)
        change M.correlation V W g < 1 at hg
        nlinarith
  have hn (n : ℕ) (hp : 0 < n) : (n : ℝ) * ‖M.vector V‖^2 ≤ C := by
    obtain ⟨W, hw, _, he⟩ := hW n
    have hj := (M.jensen W).trans he
    rw [hw, norm_smul, Real.norm_natCast] at hj
    have hnr : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hnr).mp
    nlinarith
  by_contra hv
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖M.vector V‖^2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hv)
  obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 0 (C / ‖M.vector V‖^2))
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn')
  have hratio := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn'
  have hbad := (div_lt_iff₀ hnorm).mp hratio
  have hgood := hn n hn0
  linarith

end

open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
variable (M : Mean G)
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def orbit (U : G → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] H) (v : H) : G →ᵇ H :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun g => U g v)
    continuous_of_discreteTopology ‖v‖ (fun g => le_of_eq ((U g).norm_map v))

omit [AddCommGroup G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: orbit_apply
stmt: (U : G → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] H) (v : H) (g : G) : orbit U v g = U g v
body: := rfl

name: vector_orbit_invariant
stmt: (U : G → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] H) (hU : ∀ g h v, U (g+h) v = U g (U h v)) (v : H) (g : G) : U g (M.vector (orbit U v)) = M.vector (orbit U v)
body:
:= by
  change (U g).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap (M.vector (orbit U v)) = _
  rw [← M.vector_map (U g).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap]
  have he : (U g).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.compLeftContinuousBounded G (orbit U v) =
      shift G g (orbit U v) := by
    ext h
    change U g (U h v) = U (h+g) v
    rw [add_comm h g, hU]
  rw [he, M.vector_shift]

name: vector_orbit_pair_fixed
stmt: (U : G → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] H) (v w : H) (hw : ∀ g, U g w = w) : inner ℝ (M.vector (orbit U v)) w = inner ℝ v w
body:
:= by
  rw [M.vector_pair]
  have he : pairing (orbit U v) w = BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (inner ℝ v w) := by
    ext g
    change inner ℝ (U g v) w = inner ℝ v w
    calc
      inner ℝ (U g v) w = inner ℝ (U g v) (U g w) := by rw [hw g]
      _ = inner ℝ v w := (U g).inner_map_map v w
  rw [he, M.map_const]

name: vector_orbit_eq_zero
stmt: (U : G → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] H) (hU : ∀ g h v, U (g+h) v = U g (U h v)) (v : H) (hv : ∀ w, (∀ g, U g w = w) → inner ℝ v w = 0) : M.vector (orbit U v) = 0
body:
:= by
  have hf := M.vector_orbit_invariant U hU v
  have hi := M.vector_orbit_pair_fixed U v (M.vector (orbit U v)) hf
  rw [hv _ hf] at hi
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp hi

end EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Mean

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Koopman
open MeasureTheory Filter
section Action
variable {G X E : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace X]
  [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] (μ : Measure X)
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

def linear (g : G) : Lp E 2 μ →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ :=
  Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ (fun x => g +ᵥ x) (measurePreserving_vadd g μ)

name: linear_add
stmt: (g h : G) (f : Lp E 2 μ) : linear μ (g+h) f = linear μ g (linear μ h f)
body:
:= by
  change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => (g+h) +ᵥ x) _ f =
    Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => g +ᵥ x) _
      (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => h +ᵥ x) _ f)
  have he : (fun x : X => (g+h) +ᵥ x) =
      (fun x => h +ᵥ x) ∘ (fun x => g +ᵥ x) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← add_vadd, add_comm]
  simpa only [he] using Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply f
    (measurePreserving_vadd h μ) (measurePreserving_vadd g μ)

name: linear_zero
stmt: (f : Lp E 2 μ) : linear μ (0 : G) f = f
body:
:= by
  change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => (0 : G) +ᵥ x) _ f = f
  have he : (fun x : X => (0 : G) +ᵥ x) = id := funext (fun x => zero_vadd G x)
  simpa only [he] using Lp.compMeasurePreserving_id_apply f

def action (g : G) : Lp E 2 μ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective (linear μ g) (fun f =>
    ⟨linear μ (-g) f, by rw [← linear_add, add_neg_cancel, linear_zero]⟩)

name: action_apply
stmt: (g : G) (f : Lp E 2 μ) : action μ g f = linear μ g f
body: := rfl

name: action_add
stmt: (g h : G) (f : Lp E 2 μ) : action μ (g+h) f = action μ g (action μ h f)
body: := linear_add μ g h f

name: coe_action
stmt: (g : G) (f : Lp E 2 μ) : action μ g f =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => f (g +ᵥ x))
body:
:=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (measurePreserving_vadd g μ)

end Action

variable {G X E : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace X]
  [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] (μ : Measure X)
  [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated E]

omit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [CompleteSpace E] in

name: ae_eq_const_of_fixed
stmt: (f : Lp E 2 μ) (hf : ∀ g : G, action μ g f = f) : ∃ c : E, f =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => c
body:
:= by
  apply exists_eventuallyEq_const_of_forall_separating MeasurableSet
  intro A hA
  have := ErgodicVAdd.aeconst_of_forall_preimage_vadd_ae_eq (G := G)
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).measurable hA) (fun g => by
      have ha := coe_action μ g f
      rw [hf g] at ha
      exact ha.symm.mono (fun x hx =>
        propext (show f (g +ᵥ x) ∈ A ↔ f x ∈ A by change f (g +ᵥ x) = f x at hx; rw [hx])))
  exact eventuallyEmptyOrUniv_iff.mp this

name: inner_fixed_zero
stmt: (v : Lp E 2 μ) (hv : ∫ x, v x ∂μ = 0) (w : Lp E 2 μ) (hw : ∀ g : G, action μ g w = w) : inner ℝ v w = 0
body:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ae_eq_const_of_fixed (G := G) μ w hw
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    (∫ x, inner ℝ (v x) (w x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, inner ℝ c (v x) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (hc.mono (fun x hx => by dsimp only at hx ⊢; rw [hx, real_inner_comm]))
    _ = inner ℝ c (∫ x, v x ∂μ) := integral_inner ((Lp.memLp v).integrable (by norm_num)) c
    _ = 0 := by rw [hv, inner_zero_right]

variable [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]

name: vector_orbit_zero
stmt: (M : Mean G) (v : Lp E 2 μ) (hv : ∫ x, v x ∂μ = 0) : M.vector (H := Lp E 2 μ) (Mean.orbit (action (G := G) (E := E) μ) v) = 0
body:
:=
by
  apply M.vector_orbit_eq_zero (H := Lp E 2 μ) (action (G := G) (E := E) μ)
    (action_add (G := G) (E := E) μ) v
  exact inner_fixed_zero (G := G) (E := E) μ v hv

end EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Koopman

name: list_of_uniform_atoms
stmt: (κ : Measure G) (S : Finset G) (a : ℝ≥0∞) (hmass : ∀ d ∈ S, κ {d} = a) (hsupp : ∀ᵐ d ∂κ, d ∈ S) (hc : (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)*a=1) : ∃ g : Fin S.card → G, κ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let e := S.equivFin
  let g : Fin S.card → G := fun i => (e.symm i).val
  have heq := Measure.ae_mem_finset_iff.mp hsupp
  have ha : a = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    have hn : (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at hc; exact zero_ne_one hc
    calc
      a = 1*a := by simp
      _ = ((S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * S.card)*a := by rw [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hn (by simp)]
      _ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, hc, mul_one]
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  calc
    κ = ∑ d ∈ S, κ {d} • Measure.dirac d := heq
    _ = ∑ d ∈ S, (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.dirac d :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d hd => by rw [hmass d hd, ha])
    _ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ d ∈ S, Measure.dirac d := Finset.smul_sum.symm
    _ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort S (fun d => Measure.dirac d)]
      exact (Equiv.sum_comp e.symm (fun d : S => Measure.dirac d.val)).symm

name: constant_uniform_lists
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (a : ℝ≥0∞) (ha : 0 < a) (hf : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∃ S : Finset G, S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ d ∈ S, κ y {d} = a) ∧ (∀ᵐ d ∂κ y, d ∈ S) ∧ (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)*a=1) : ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ ∃ g : Y → Fin m → G, ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, κ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g y i)
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y₀, S₀, hS₀, _, _, hc₀⟩ := hf.exists
  let m := S₀.card
  have hm : 0 < m := Finset.card_pos.mpr hS₀
  have haT : a ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [h, ENNReal.mul_top (by exact_mod_cast hm.ne')] at hc₀
    exact ENNReal.top_ne_one hc₀
  have hlist : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∃ g : Fin m → G,
      κ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i) := by
    filter_upwards [hf] with y hy
    obtain ⟨S, _hS, hSa, hSupp, hc⟩ := hy
    have hcard : S.card = m := by
      have hh : (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) = (m : ℝ≥0∞) :=
        (ENNReal.mul_right_inj ha.ne' haT).mp (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hc.trans hc₀.symm)
      exact_mod_cast hh
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := list_of_uniform_atoms (κ y) S a hSa hSupp hc
    have hh : (∑ j : Fin S.card, Measure.dirac (g j)) =
        ∑ i : Fin m, Measure.dirac (g (Fin.cast hcard.symm i)) :=
      (Equiv.sum_comp (finCongr hcard.symm) (fun j => Measure.dirac (g j))).symm
    refine ⟨fun i => g (Fin.cast hcard.symm i), ?_⟩
    calc
      κ y = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin m, Measure.dirac (g (Fin.cast hcard.symm i)) := hg.trans (congrArg ((S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ·) hh)
      _ = _ := by congr 2; exact_mod_cast hcard
  let g : Y → Fin m → G := fun y => if h : ∃ g : Fin m → G,
      κ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i) then h.choose else fun _ => Classical.choice inferInstance
  refine ⟨m, hm, g, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hlist] with y hy
  simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hy] using hy.choose_spec

end EuclideanFiveColor.UniformEnumeration

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.DifferenceInvariant
variable {G Y : Type*} [CommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace G]
  [MeasurableMul₂ G] [MeasurableInv G] [MeasurableSpace Y]

noncomputable def differenceLaw (ν : Measure Y) (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : Measure G :=
  ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2)

name: invariant
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (R : Y → Y) (hR : MeasurePreserving R ν ν) (T : G →* G) (hT : Measurable T) (he : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, κ (R y) = (κ y).map T) : MeasurePreserving T (differenceLaw ν κ) (differenceLaw ν κ)
body:
:= by
  have hprod : (((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (Prod.map T T)) = ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν) := by
    ext s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply (hT.prodMap hT) hs,
      Measure.bind_apply ((hT.prodMap hT) hs) (κ ×ₖ κ).aemeasurable,
      Measure.bind_apply hs (κ ×ₖ κ).aemeasurable]
    calc
      (∫⁻ y, (κ ×ₖ κ) y ((Prod.map T T) ⁻¹' s) ∂ν) =
          ∫⁻ y, (κ ×ₖ κ) (R y) s ∂ν := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [he] with y hy
        rw [Kernel.prod_apply, Kernel.prod_apply, hy,
          Measure.map_prod_map _ _ hT hT, Measure.map_apply (hT.prodMap hT) hs]
      _ = ∫⁻ y, (κ ×ₖ κ) y s ∂ν := hR.lintegral_comp (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs)
  have hdiv : Measurable (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) := measurable_fst.div measurable_snd
  refine ⟨hT, ?_⟩
  rw [differenceLaw, Measure.map_map hT hdiv]
  calc
    (((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (T ∘ (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2))) =
        ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map ((fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) ∘ Prod.map T T) := by
      congr 1
      funext p
      exact map_div T p.1 p.2
    _ = (((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (Prod.map T T)).map (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) :=
      (Measure.map_map hdiv (hT.prodMap hT)).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [hprod]

end EuclideanFiveColor.DifferenceInvariant

                                                                         
                                                                                   
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K Y W : Type*} [SMul K Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace W]

def Scalar (ν : Measure Y) (q : Y → W) : Prop :=
  ∀ H : Y → ℂ, Measurable H → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ C) →
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
      (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2

def Vector (ν : Measure Y) (q : Y → W) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (H : Y → Fin m → ℂ), Measurable H →
  (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ C) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
  ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → Fin m → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
      (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2

name: pi_dist_sq_le_sum
stmt: {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (a b : I → ℂ) : dist a b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2
body:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ ∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hn : dist a b ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    intro i
    change ‖a i - b i‖ ≤ _
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    apply (Real.le_sqrt (dist_nonneg) hs).mpr
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (dist (a j) (b j))) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hs, Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2), dist_nonneg (x := a) (y := b)]

name: vector_of_scalar
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (q : Y → W) (hq : Measurable q) [MeasurableConstSMul K Y] (hs : Scalar (K := K) ν q) : Vector (K := K) ν q
body:
:= by
  classical
  intro m H hH hHb ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (m+1)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε (by positivity)
  have hcoord (j : Fin m) : ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → ℂ),
      0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
        Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y) j) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
        (∫ y, dist (H (k • y) j) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < δ^2 := by
    apply hs (fun y => H y j) ((measurable_pi_iff.mp hH) j) _ δ hδ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hHb
    exact ⟨C, fun y => (norm_le_pi_norm (H y) j).trans (hC y)⟩
  choose r B C Hf hB hC hHm hHb hA using hcoord
  let I := (j : Fin m) × Fin (r j)
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card I) ≃ I := (Fintype.equivFin I).symm
  let V : I → Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun s y => Pi.single s.1 (Hf s.1 s.2 y)
  have hV (s : I) : Measurable (V s) := by
    apply Measurable.of_eval
    intro j
    by_cases h : s.1 = j
    · subst j
      simpa [V] using hHm s.1 s.2
    · simp only [V, Pi.single_apply, Ne.symm h, ite_false]
      exact measurable_const
  have hVnorm (s : I) (y : Y) : ‖V s y‖ ≤ ‖Hf s.1 s.2 y‖ := by
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    intro j
    by_cases h : s.1 = j
    · subst j; simp [V]
    · simp [V, h]
  refine ⟨Fintype.card I, ∑ j, B j, ∑ j, C j, fun i => V (e i),
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hB j), Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hC j),
    fun i => hV (e i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    change (∑ i, (fun s : I => ‖V s y‖) (e i)) ≤ _
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp e (fun s : I => ‖V s y‖)]
    calc
      ∑ s : I, ‖V s y‖ ≤ ∑ s : I, ‖Hf s.1 s.2 y‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun s _ => hVnorm s y)
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, ‖Hf j i y‖ := Fintype.sum_sigma _
      _ ≤ ∑ j, C j := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hHb j y)
  · intro k
    choose a ham hab hai hae using fun j => hA j k
    let a' : W → I → ℂ := fun w s => a s.1 w s.2
    have hap (w : W) : ‖fun i => a' w (e i)‖ ≤ ∑ j, B j := by
      rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hB j))]
      intro i
      exact ((norm_le_pi_norm (a (e i).1 w) (e i).2).trans (hab (e i).1 w)).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hB j) (Finset.mem_univ _))
    have ham' : Measurable (fun w i => a' w (e i)) := by
      apply Measurable.of_eval
      intro i
      exact (measurable_pi_iff.mp (ham (e i).1)) (e i).2
    let A : Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun y => ∑ s : I, a' (q y) s • V s y
    have hAeq (y : Y) (j : Fin m) : A y j = ∑ i, a j (q y) i * Hf j i y := by
      change (∑ s : I, a' (q y) s • V s y) j = _
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
      rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
      simp [a', V, Pi.single_apply]
    have hAm : Measurable A := by
      apply Measurable.of_eval
      intro j
      simp_rw [hAeq]
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ((measurable_pi_iff.mp (ham j)) i |>.comp hq).mul (hHm j i))
    have hem : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2) ν :=
      ((hH.comp (measurable_const_smul k)).dist hAm |>.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hsint : Integrable (fun y => ∑ j, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2) ν := by
      apply integrable_finsetSum
      intro j _
      simpa only [hAeq] using hai j
    have hbound (y : Y) : dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2 ≤ ∑ j, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2 :=
      pi_dist_sq_le_sum _ _
    have hint : Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2) ν :=
      hsint.mono' hem (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (dist (H (k • y)) (A y)))] using hbound y))
    have hbudget : (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ y, ∑ j, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2 ∂ν := integral_mono hint hsint hbound
        _ = ∑ j, ∫ y, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2 ∂ν := integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => by simpa only [hAeq] using hai j)
        _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin m, δ^2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by simpa only [hAeq] using (hae j).le)
        _ = (m : ℝ) * δ^2 := by simp
        _ < ε^2 := by
          dsimp [δ]
          have hm : (0 : ℝ) < m+1 := by positivity
          rw [div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hm)]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m : ℝ), sq_pos_of_pos hε]
    have hAe (y : Y) : (∑ i, a' (q y) (e i) • V (e i) y) = A y :=
      Equiv.sum_comp e (fun s => a' (q y) s • V s y)
    refine ⟨fun w i => a' w (e i), ham', hap, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hAe] using hint
    · simpa only [hAe] using hbudget

end EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.KernelSupport
open MeasureTheory
variable {K X Y : Type*} [Group K] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
  [MulAction K X] [MulAction K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K X] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]

name: factor_smul_preserving
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] (p : X → Y) (hp : Measurable p) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (k : K) : MeasurePreserving (fun y : Y => k • y) (μ.map p) (μ.map p)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurable_const_smul k, ?_⟩
  rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_const_smul k) hp]
  calc
    μ.map ((fun y : Y => k • y) ∘ p) = μ.map (p ∘ (fun x : X => k • x)) :=
      Measure.map_congr ((hpe k).mono fun _ hx => hx.symm)
    _ = (μ.map (fun x : X => k • x)).map p :=
      (Measure.map_map hp (measurable_const_smul k)).symm
    _ = μ.map p := by rw [measurePreserving_smul k μ |>.map_eq]
end EuclideanFiveColor.KernelSupport

namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
variable {X Y W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace W]
  [MulAction K X] [MulAction K Y]
  [MeasurableConstSMul K X] [MeasurableConstSMul K Y]

name: relative_difference_invariant
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] (b : X → D) (p : X → Y) (hb : Measurable b) (hp : Measurable p) (hbe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, b (k • x) = k • b x) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (k : K) : MeasurePreserving (fun d : D => k • d) (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ)) (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ))
body:
:= by
  have he := KernelSupport.condDistrib_equivariant μ b p hb hp
    (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (fun d : D => k • d)
    (measurable_const_smul k) (measurePreserving_smul k μ) (hpe k) (hbe k)
  exact DifferenceInvariant.invariant (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ)
    (fun y : Y => k • y) (KernelSupport.factor_smul_preserving μ p hp hpe k)
    (scalarHom (kCoeff k)) (measurable_const_smul k) he

name: finite_encoding_approximation_of_compact
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [StandardBorelSpace W] [Nonempty W] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure K X μ] (p : X → Y) (q : Y → W) (b : X → D) (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q) (hb : Measurable b) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (hbe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, b (k • x) = k • b x) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (g : Y → Fin m → D) (hg : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, condDistrib b p μ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g y i)) (hc : CompactApproximation.Scalar (K := K) (μ.map p) q) : FiniteEncodingApproximation μ p q b m
body:
:= by
  classical
  let H₀ : Y → Fin m → ℂ := PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ)
    (fun d => (eval 1 d : ℂ)) m
  have hH₀ : Measurable H₀ :=
    PhaseEncoding.measurable_kernelEncoding _ _ (measurable_eval_coe 1) m
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := PhaseEncoding.exists_encoding_bound m
  have hHB : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ‖H₀ y‖ ≤ max A 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hg] with y hy
    have he := PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding_eq_encoding (condDistrib b p μ) (eval 1) m hm y (g y) hy
    change ‖PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ) (fun d => (eval 1 d : ℂ)) m y‖ ≤ max A 0
    rw [he]
    exact (hA (fun i => eval 1 (g y i))).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  let H : Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun y => if ‖H₀ y‖ ≤ max A 0 then H₀ y else 0
  have hH : Measurable H := hH₀.piecewise (measurableSet_le hH₀.norm measurable_const) measurable_const
  have hHbound : ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ max A 0 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : ‖H₀ y‖ ≤ max A 0
    · simpa only [H, ite_eq_left hy] using hy
    · simp only [H, ite_eq_right hy, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  have hHeq : H =ᵐ[μ.map p] H₀ := hHB.mono fun y hy => ite_eq_left hy
  have hv := CompactApproximation.vector_of_scalar (μ.map p) q hq hc
  intro γ hγ
  obtain ⟨r, B, C, Hf, hB, hC, _hHm, hHf, ha⟩ := hv m H hH ⟨max A 0, hHbound⟩ γ hγ
  refine ⟨r, B, C, Hf, hB, hC, hHf, ?_⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨a, _ham, hab, hai, hae⟩ := ha k
  have hker := KernelSupport.condDistrib_equivariant μ b p hb hp
    (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (fun d : D => k • d)
    (measurable_const_smul k) (measurePreserving_smul k μ) (hpe k) (hbe k)
  have hcov := PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding_covariance (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ)
    (fun y : Y => k • y) (fun d : D => k • d) (measurable_const_smul k)
    (fun d => (eval 1 d : ℂ)) (measurable_eval_coe 1) m hker
  have heq : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, H (k • y) =
      PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ) (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m y := by
    filter_upwards [(KernelSupport.factor_smul_preserving μ p hp hpe k).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hHeq,
      hcov] with y hy hc'
    exact hy.trans (by simpa only [Function.comp_def, eval_smul_one] using hc')
  have he : (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) =ᵐ[μ.map p]
      (fun y => dist (PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ)
        (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m y) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) := by
    filter_upwards [heq] with y hy
    rw [hy]
  have hai' := hai.congr he
  refine ⟨a, hab, hai'.comp_measurable hp, ?_⟩
  rw [← integral_map hp.aemeasurable hai'.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← integral_congr_ae he]
  exact hae

name: relative_singularity_successor
stmt: [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [StandardBorelSpace W] [Nonempty W] [MulAction K W] [MeasurableConstSMul K W] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] (d : X → D) (p : X → Y) (q : Y → W) (hd : Measurable d) (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q) (hde : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, d (k • x) = k • d x) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) (hqe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, q (k • y) = k • q y) (hwild : IsWild (μ.map d)) (hc : CompactApproximation.Scalar (K := K) (μ.map p) q) (hprev : ∀ b : X → D, Measurable b → (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, b (k • x) = k • b x) → IsWild (μ.map b) → DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map (q ∘ p)) (condDistrib b (q ∘ p) μ) C = 0) : DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) C = 0
body:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hpos : 0 < RelativeCenters.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) C :=
    pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbe, hbw, a, ha, hf⟩ := exact_finite_center_reduction μ d p hd hp hde hpe hwild hpos
  obtain ⟨m, hm, g, hg⟩ := UniformEnumeration.constant_uniform_lists (μ.map p)
    (condDistrib b p μ) a ha (hf.mono fun y ⟨S, hS, hSa, hSupp, hcS, _⟩ =>
      ⟨S, hS, hSa, hSupp, hcS⟩)
  have hcomp : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (q ∘ p) (k • x) = k • (q ∘ p) x := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hpe k, ae_of_ae_map hp.aemeasurable (hqe k)] with x hx hy
    simp only [Function.comp_def, hx, hy]
  have hpwild : IsWild (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map (q ∘ p)) (condDistrib b (q ∘ p) μ)) :=
    ⟨relative_difference_invariant μ b (q ∘ p) hb (hq.comp hp) hbe hcomp,
      hprev b hb hbe hbw⟩
  exact finite_uniform_successor_contradiction μ p q b hp hq hb m hm g hg hpwild
    (finite_encoding_approximation_of_compact μ p q b hp hq hb hpe hbe m hm g hg hc)

end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K Y Z W : Type*} [SMul K Y] [SMul K Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace W]

def At (ν : Measure Y) (q : Y → W) (m : ℕ) (H : Y → Fin m → ℂ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → Fin m → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
      (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2

name: lift_at
stmt: (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (p : Y → Z) (q : Z → W) (hp : Measurable p) (hq : Measurable q) [MeasurableConstSMul K Y] [MeasurableConstSMul K Z] (hpres : ∀ k : K, MeasurePreserving (fun y : Y => k • y) ν ν) (hpe : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, p (k • y) = k • p y) (m : ℕ) (H : Y → Fin m → ℂ) (H₀ : Z → Fin m → ℂ) (hH : Measurable H) (hH₀ : Measurable H₀) (hB₀ : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, ‖H₀ z‖ ≤ C) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hi : Integrable (fun y => dist (H y) (H₀ (p y))^2) ν) (he : (∫ y, dist (H y) (H₀ (p y))^2 ∂ν) < (ε/2)^2) (hc : Vector (K := K) (ν.map p) q) : At (K := K) ν (q ∘ p) m H ε
body:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, B, C, Hf, hB, hC, hHm, hHf, ha⟩ := hc m H₀ hH₀ hB₀ (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨r, B, C, fun i => Hf i ∘ p, hB, hC, fun i => (hHm i).comp hp,
    fun y => hHf (p y), ?_⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨a, ham, hab, hai, hae⟩ := ha k
  let F : Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun y => ∑ i, a (q (p y)) i • Hf i (p y)
  have hFm : Measurable F := by
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      (((measurable_pi_iff.mp ham) i).comp (hq.comp hp)).smul ((hHm i).comp hp))
  let e₁ : Y → ℝ := fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (H₀ (k • p y))^2
  let e₂ : Y → ℝ := fun y => dist (H₀ (k • p y)) (F y)^2
  have heq : (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (H₀ (p (k • y)))^2) =ᵐ[ν] e₁ :=
    (hpe k).mono fun y hy => by simp only [e₁, hy]
  have hi₁ : Integrable e₁ ν := ((hpres k).integrable_comp hi.aestronglyMeasurable |>.mpr hi).congr heq
  have he₁ : (∫ y, e₁ y ∂ν) < (ε/2)^2 := by
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => dist (H y) (H₀ (p y))^2)
        (ν.map (fun y : Y => k • y)) := by
      rw [(hpres k).map_eq]
      exact hi.aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [← integral_congr_ae heq, ← integral_map (hpres k).measurable.aemeasurable hm,
      (hpres k).map_eq]
    exact he
  have hi₂ : Integrable e₂ ν := hai.comp_measurable hp
  have he₂ : (∫ y, e₂ y ∂ν) < (ε/2)^2 := by
    change (∫ y, dist (H₀ (k • p y)) (∑ i, a (q (p y)) i • Hf i (p y))^2 ∂ν) < _
    rw [← integral_map hp.aemeasurable hai.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact hae
  have hmajor (y : Y) : dist (H (k • y)) (F y)^2 ≤ 2*(e₁ y + e₂ y) := by
    have ht := dist_triangle (H (k • y)) (H₀ (k • p y)) (F y)
    have hx := dist_nonneg (x := H (k • y)) (y := H₀ (k • p y))
    have hy := dist_nonneg (x := H₀ (k • p y)) (y := F y)
    have hz := dist_nonneg (x := H (k • y)) (y := F y)
    dsimp [e₁, e₂]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist (H (k • y)) (H₀ (k • p y)) - dist (H₀ (k • p y)) (F y))]
  have himaj : Integrable (fun y => 2*(e₁ y + e₂ y)) ν := (hi₁.add hi₂).const_mul 2
  have hint : Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (F y)^2) ν :=
    himaj.mono' (((hH.comp (measurable_const_smul k)).dist hFm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq] using hmajor y)
  refine ⟨a, ham, hab, hint, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (F y)^2 ∂ν) ≤ ∫ y, 2*(e₁ y + e₂ y) ∂ν :=
      integral_mono hint himaj hmajor
    _ = 2*((∫ y, e₁ y ∂ν) + ∫ y, e₂ y ∂ν) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hi₁ hi₂]
    _ < ε^2 := by nlinarith

end EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation
