namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]

def tensor (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) : Func (X×Y) :=
  comp f Prod.fst measurable_fst * comp g Prod.snd measurable_snd

name: tensor_apply
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) (z : X×Y) : tensor f g z = f z.1 * g z.2
body: := rfl

name: tensor_mul
stmt: (f h : Func X) (g k : Func Y) : tensor (f*h) (g*k) = tensor f g * tensor h k
body:
:= by
  ext z; simp only [tensor_apply, mul_apply]; ring

name: tensor_conj
stmt: (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) : tensor (bmConj f) (bmConj g) = bmConj (tensor f g)
body:
:= by
  ext z; simp only [tensor_apply, conj_apply, star_mul']

variable [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

name: integral_law
stmt: (f : Func (X×X)) : ∫ z, f z ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) = ∫ y, (∫ z, f z ∂(condDistrib id q μ y).prod (condDistrib id q μ y)) ∂μ.map q
body:
:= by
  have hi := integrable (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) f
  rw [RelativeProduct.law_eq_mixture, Measure.comp_eq_comp_const_apply] at hi
  have he := Kernel.integral_comp hi
  simpa only [Kernel.const_apply, Kernel.prod_apply, ← Measure.comp_eq_comp_const_apply,
    ← RelativeProduct.law_eq_mixture μ q hq] using he

name: integral_tensor
stmt: (f g : Func X) : ∫ z, tensor f g z ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) = ∫ y, conditional μ q f y * conditional μ q g y ∂μ.map q
body:
:= by
  rw [integral_law]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => integral_prod_mul f g)

name: integral_tensor_self
stmt: (f : Func X) : ∫ z, tensor f (bmConj f) z ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) = (‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q f)‖^2 : ℝ)
body:
:= by
  rw [integral_tensor, norm_l2_sq]
  simp only [conditional, expect_conj, conj_apply]
  change (∫ y, conditional μ q f y * star (conditional μ q f y) ∂μ.map q) = _
  calc
    _ = ∫ y, ((‖conditional μ q f y‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∂μ.map q := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (Complex.mul_conj _).trans
        (congrArg Complex.ofReal (Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq _))
    _ = _ := integral_complex_ofReal

name: inner_tensor
stmt: (v w : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (tensor w (bmConj w))) (l2 (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq) (tensor (bmConj v) v)) = ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*w))‖^2
body:
:= by
  rw [real_inner_comm, inner_l2]
  have he : (fun z : X×X => inner ℝ (tensor (bmConj v) v z) (tensor w (bmConj w) z)) =
      (fun z => (tensor (v*w) (bmConj (v*w)) z).re) := by
    funext z
    simp only [Complex.inner, tensor_apply, conj_apply, mul_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_mul', star_star]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  change (∫ z, RCLike.re (tensor (v*w) (bmConj (v*w)) z) ∂(RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)) = _
  rw [integral_re (integrable _ (tensor (v*w) (bmConj (v*w)))), integral_tensor_self]
  rfl

end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal RealInnerProductSpace NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Koopman
variable {G X E : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X]
  (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated E]

name: vector_orbit_hom_zero
stmt: (M : Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v : Lp E 2 μ) (hv : ∫ x, v x ∂μ = 0) : M.vector (Mean.orbit (fun g => action (E := E) μ (φ g)) v) = 0
body:
:= by
  apply M.vector_orbit_eq_zero _ (fun g h v => by rw [map_add, action_add]) v
  intro w hw
  apply inner_fixed_zero (G := G) (E := E) μ v hv w
  intro g
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hs g
  exact hw h
end EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Koopman
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X]
instance product_measurable_vadd : MeasurableConstVAdd G (X×X) where
  measurable_const_vadd g := (measurable_const_vadd (α := X) g).prodMap (measurable_const_vadd g)
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

def pairSequence (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) : G →ᵇ Lp ℂ 2 (μ.map q) :=
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hq.aemeasurable).mpr inferInstance
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
    (fun g => l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v * act (φ g) w)))
    continuous_of_discreteTopology (bound v * bound w) (fun g => by
      apply l2_norm_le
      intro y
      apply expect_bound
      intro x
      dsimp only [mul_apply, act_apply]
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (norm_le_bound v x) (norm_le_bound w _) (norm_nonneg _) (bound v).coe_nonneg)

omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: pairSequence_apply
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : pairSequence μ q hq φ v w g = l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))
body:
:= rfl

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] in

name: tensor_act
stmt: (g : G) (v w : Func X) : tensor (act g v) (act g w) = act g (tensor v w)
body:
:= rfl

variable [ErgodicVAdd G (X×X) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)]

include hq in

name: pair_mean_sq_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v w : Func X) (hw : l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q w) = 0) : M.map (Amenable.Mean.squareNorm (pairSequence μ q hq φ v w)) = 0
body:
:= by
  let ρ := RelativeProduct.law μ q hq
  let t := tensor w (bmConj w)
  have iw : ∫ z, l2 ρ t z ∂ρ = 0 := by
    rw [integral_l2, integral_tensor_self, hw]
    simp
  let U := fun g : G => Amenable.Koopman.action (E := ℂ) ρ (φ g)
  have hv := Amenable.Koopman.vector_orbit_hom_zero ρ M φ hs (l2 ρ t) iw
  let a := l2 ρ (tensor (bmConj v) v)
  have he : Amenable.Mean.squareNorm (pairSequence μ q hq φ v w) =
      Amenable.Mean.pairing (Amenable.Mean.orbit U (l2 ρ t)) a := by
    ext g
    rw [Amenable.Mean.squareNorm_apply]
    change ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖^2 =
      inner ℝ (Amenable.Koopman.action ρ (φ g) (l2 ρ t)) a
    dsimp only [t, a]
    rw [← l2_act, ← tensor_act, act_conj]
    exact (inner_tensor μ q hq v (act (φ g) w)).symm
  rw [he, ← M.vector_pair]
  change inner ℝ (M.vector (Amenable.Mean.orbit U (l2 ρ t))) a = 0
  rw [hv, inner_zero_left]

end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.AlgebraReplacement

section
variable {ι R A H : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Semiring R] [CommRing A]
  [Module R A] [AddCommMonoid H] [Module R H]

name: mixed_prod
stmt: (s t : Finset ι) (ht : t ⊆ s) (f g : ι → A) : (∏ i ∈ t, f i) * (∏ i ∈ s\t, g i) = ∏ i ∈ s, if i∈t then f i else g i
body:
:= by
  have he : s.filter (fun i => i ∈ t) = t := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨And.right, fun h => ⟨ht h,h⟩⟩
  have hn : s.filter (fun i => ¬ i∈t) = s\t := by ext i; simp
  rw [Finset.prod_ite, he, hn]

name: linear_prod_replace
stmt: (L : A →ₗ[R] H) (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → A) (h : ∀ t ∈ s.powerset, t ≠ ∅ → L ((∏ i ∈ t, (f i - g i)) * ∏ i ∈ s\t, g i) = 0) : L (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = L (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
body:
:= by
  have he := Finset.prod_add (fun i => f i - g i) g s
  simp only [sub_add_cancel] at he
  rw [he, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ∅]
  · simp
  · intro t ht hn
    exact h t ht hn
  · simp
end
variable {ι A H : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [CommRing A] [AddCommMonoid H]

name: add_prod_replace
stmt: (L : A →+ H) (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → A) (h : ∀ t ∈ s.powerset, t ≠ ∅ → L ((∏ i ∈ t, (f i - g i)) * ∏ i ∈ s\t, g i) = 0) : L (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = L (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
body:
:= by
  have he := Finset.prod_add (fun i => f i - g i) g s
  simp only [sub_add_cancel] at he
  rw [he, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ∅]
  · simp
  · intro t ht hn
    exact h t ht hn
  · simp
end EuclideanFiveColor.AlgebraReplacement

name: vector_real
stmt: (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : M.vector f = M.map f
body:
:= by
  have h := M.vector_pair f 1
  have he : pairing f 1 = f := by ext g; simp [pairing_apply]
  simpa only [Real.inner_apply, mul_one, he] using h

name: norm_mean_zero_of_square
stmt: {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] (V : G →ᵇ H) (h : M.map (squareNorm V) = 0) : M.map (normFn V) = 0
body:
:= by
  have he : squareNorm (normFn V) = squareNorm V := by
    ext g
    simp only [squareNorm_apply, normFn_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  have hj := M.jensen (normFn V)
  rw [M.vector_real, he, h] at hj
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hj
  have : (M.map (normFn V))^2 = 0 := le_antisymm hj (sq_nonneg _)
  exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
end EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Mean

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]

name: l2_inner
stmt: (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ h) = (∫ x, (bmConj f * h) x ∂μ).re
body:
:= by
  rw [inner_l2]
  simp only [Complex.inner, starRingEnd_apply, mul_comm (h _)]
  change (∫ x, RCLike.re ((bmConj f * h) x) ∂μ) = _
  exact integral_re (integrable μ (bmConj f * h))

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] in

name: inner_act
stmt: (g : G) (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ (act g f)) (l2 μ (act g h)) = inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ h)
body:
:= by
  rw [l2_act, l2_act]
  exact (Amenable.Koopman.action (E := ℂ) μ g).inner_map_map _ _

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] in

name: integral_act
stmt: (g : G) (f : Func X) : ∫ x, act g f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
body:
:=
  (measurePreserving_vadd g μ).integral_comp (MeasurableEquiv.vadd g).measurableEmbedding (f : X → ℂ)

name: l2_mul_norm_le
stmt: (f h : Func X) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖h x‖ ≤ C) : ‖l2 μ (f*h)‖ ≤ C * ‖l2 μ f‖
body:
:= by
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have : Nonempty X := MeasureTheory.nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
    exact (norm_nonneg (h (Classical.choice this))).trans (hC _)
  have hi : ‖l2 μ (f*h)‖^2 ≤ C^2 * ‖l2 μ f‖^2 := by
    rw [norm_l2_sq, norm_l2_sq, ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono (integrable_norm_sq μ (f*h)) ((integrable_norm_sq μ f).const_mul _)
    intro x
    change ‖f x * h x‖^2 ≤ C^2 * ‖f x‖^2
    rw [norm_mul, mul_pow]
    have hh : ‖h x‖^2 ≤ C^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hC x) 2
    simpa [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (sq_nonneg ‖f x‖)
  have hn := norm_nonneg (l2 μ (f*h))
  have hm := norm_nonneg (l2 μ f)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hC0 hm]

end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

section
variable {ι G X : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace X]
  [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X]

name: func_prod_apply
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) (x : X) : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) x = ∏ i ∈ s, f i x
body:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, ih]

name: conj_conj
stmt: (f : Func X) : bmConj (bmConj f) = f
body: := by ext x; simp

name: conj_mul
stmt: (f h : Func X) : bmConj (f*h) = bmConj f * bmConj h
body: := by ext x; simp

name: conj_prod
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) : bmConj (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, bmConj (f i)
body:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: comp_prod
stmt: {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func Y) (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) : comp (∏ i ∈ s, f i) q hq = ∏ i ∈ s, comp (f i) q hq
body:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: act_prod
stmt: (g : G) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Func X) : act g (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, act g (f i)
body: := by ext x; simp

name: act_zero
stmt: (f : Func X) : act (0 : G) f = f
body: := by ext x; simp

name: prod_orbit_correlation
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u h : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i (u+h)) (f i)) * bmConj (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)) = ∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i))
body:
:= by
  rw [conj_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_add, act_add, act_mul, act_conj]

name: prod_shift_erase
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (hj : j∈s) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)) = act (φ j u) (f j * ∏ i ∈ s.erase j, act ((φ i - φ j) u) (f i))
body:
:= by
  rw [act_mul, act_prod]
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase s (fun i => act (φ i u) (f i)) hj]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← act_add]
  congr 1
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply]
  abel

variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
omit [DecidableEq ι] in

name: l2_inner_mul
stmt: (f h : Func X) : inner ℝ (l2 μ f) (l2 μ (bmConj h)) = (∫ x, (f*h) x ∂μ).re
body:
:= by
  rw [real_inner_comm, l2_inner, conj_conj]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_comm h f]

variable [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]

name: correlation_product
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (hj : j∈s) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (h : G) : M.correlation (Family.toL2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))) (Family.toL2 μ (∏ i ∈ s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))) h = inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M (∏ i ∈ s.erase j, Family.orbit (φ i - φ j) (act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i)))) (l2 μ (bmConj (act (φ j h) (f j) * bmConj (f j))))
body:
:= by
  rw [Family.avg_pair, Amenable.Mean.correlation_apply]
  congr 1
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro u
  simp only [Amenable.Mean.cross_apply, Amenable.shift_apply, Family.toL2_apply,
    Family.prod_apply, Family.orbit_apply, Amenable.Mean.pairing_apply]
  rw [← conj_conj (∏ i ∈ s, act (φ i u) (f i)), l2_inner_mul]
  rw [prod_orbit_correlation, prod_shift_erase s j hj, integral_act, l2_inner_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_comm]

end

section

variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
  [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

omit [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: norm_l2_conj
stmt: (f : Func X) : ‖l2 μ (bmConj f)‖ = ‖l2 μ f‖
body:
:= by
  have he : ‖l2 μ (bmConj f)‖^2 = ‖l2 μ f‖^2 := by simp only [norm_l2_sq, conj_apply, norm_star]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (l2 μ (bmConj f)), norm_nonneg (l2 μ f)]

name: inner_replace_project
stmt: (w h : Func X) (b : Func Y) (hw : w =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq) : inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj h)) = inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj (project μ q hq h)))
body:
:= by
  rw [l2_inner_mul, l2_inner_mul]
  congr 1
  calc
    (∫ x, (w*h) x ∂μ) = ∫ x, (h*comp b q hq) x ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hw] with x hx
      simp only [mul_apply, hx, mul_comm]
    _ = ∫ x, (project μ q hq h * comp b q hq) x ∂μ := integral_mul_lift μ q hq h b
    _ = ∫ x, (w * project μ q hq h) x ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hw] with x hx
      simp only [mul_apply, hx, mul_comm]

name: inner_project_bound
stmt: (w h : Func X) (b : Func Y) (hw : w =ᵐ[μ] comp b q hq) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ C) : |inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj h))| ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖
body:
:= by
  rw [inner_replace_project μ q hq w h b hw]
  calc
    |inner ℝ (l2 μ w) (l2 μ (bmConj (project μ q hq h)))| ≤
        ‖l2 μ w‖ * ‖l2 μ (bmConj (project μ q hq h))‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖ := by
      rw [norm_l2_conj]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (l2_norm_le μ w hC) (norm_nonneg _)

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]

name: avg_project_bound
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (W : Family G X) (h : Func X) (b : G → Func Y) (hw : ∀ g, W g =ᵐ[μ] comp (b g) q hq) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ g x, ‖W g x‖ ≤ C) : |inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M W) (l2 μ (bmConj h))| ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖
body:
:= by
  rw [Family.avg_pair, ← M.map_const (C * ‖l2 μ (project μ q hq h)‖)]
  apply M.abs_le
  intro g
  exact inner_project_bound μ q hq (W g) h (b g) (hw g) (hC g)

variable [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ] in
include hqcov in

name: prod_act_project_lift
stmt: (s : Finset ι) (ψ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (u : G) : (∏ i ∈ s, act (ψ i u) (project μ q hq (f i))) =ᵐ[μ] comp (∏ i ∈ s, act (ψ i u) (conditional μ q (f i))) q hq
body:
:= by
  rw [comp_prod]
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact .of_forall (fun _ => by simp)
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi]
    filter_upwards [act_lift μ q hq hqcov (ψ i u) (conditional μ q (f i)), ih] with x hx hy
    exact congrArg₂ (·*·) hx hy

end

variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)

def PairVanishing (M : Amenable.Mean G) : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ : G →+ G), Function.Surjective φ → ∀ v w : Func X,
    l2 μ (project μ q hq w) = 0 →
    M.map (Amenable.Mean.normFn (pairSequence μ q hq φ v w)) = 0

omit [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ] in

name: pairVanishing_of_ergodic
stmt: [ErgodicVAdd G (X×X) (RelativeProduct.law μ q hq)] (M : Amenable.Mean G) : PairVanishing μ q hq M
body:
:= by
  intro φ hs v w hw
  apply M.norm_mean_zero_of_square
  apply pair_mean_sq_zero μ q hq M φ hs v w
  apply norm_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← norm_project_l2 μ q hq w, hw, norm_zero]

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
def Admissible (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) : Prop :=
  (∀ i∈s, Function.Surjective (φ i)) ∧
  ∀ i∈s, ∀ j∈s, i≠j → Function.Surjective (φ i - φ j)

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] in

name: Admissible.erase_diff
stmt: {s : Finset ι} {φ : ι → G →+ G} (ha : Admissible s φ) {j : ι} (hj : j∈s) : Admissible (s.erase j) (fun i => φ i - φ j)
body:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    exact ha.2 i (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi) j hj (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi)
  · intro i hi k hk hik
    have he : (φ i - φ j) - (φ k - φ j) = φ i - φ k := by abel
    rw [he]
    exact ha.2 i (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi) k (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hk) hik

variable [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
include hqcov in

name: avg_product_zero_of_pair
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hpair : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → G →+ G) (f : ι → Func X) (ha : Admissible s φ) (hc : ∃ j∈s, l2 μ (project μ q hq (f j)) = 0) : Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)) = 0
body:
:= by
  have main : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (s : Finset ι), s.card ≤ n → ∀ (φ : ι → G →+ G)
      (f : ι → Func X), Admissible s φ →
      (∃ j∈s, l2 μ (project μ q hq (f j)) = 0) →
      Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)) = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro s hn φ f ha hc
      have hs : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hn)
      obtain ⟨j,hj,_⟩ := hc
      simp [hs] at hj
    | succ n ih =>
      intro s hn φ f ha hc
      obtain ⟨j,hj,hfj⟩ := hc
      let e := s.erase j
      let ψ := fun i => φ i - φ j
      have he : e.card ≤ n := by
        have := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hj
        dsimp [e]
        omega
      have had : Admissible e ψ := ha.erase_diff hj
      let F : G → ι → Func X := fun h i => act (φ i h) (f i) * bmConj (f i)
      have replace (h : G) :
          Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈e, Family.orbit (ψ i) (F h i)) =
          Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈e, Family.orbit (ψ i) (project μ q hq (F h i))) := by
        apply EuclideanFiveColor.AlgebraReplacement.add_prod_replace
          (A := Family G X) (H := Lp ℂ 2 μ) (Family.avg μ M).toAddMonoidHom e
          (fun i => Family.orbit (ψ i) (F h i))
          (fun i => Family.orbit (ψ i) (project μ q hq (F h i)))
        intro t ht htn
        have hte := Finset.mem_powerset.mp ht
        rw [EuclideanFiveColor.AlgebraReplacement.mixed_prod e t hte]
        have heq : (∏ i∈e, if i∈t then
            Family.orbit (ψ i) (F h i) - Family.orbit (ψ i) (project μ q hq (F h i))
            else Family.orbit (ψ i) (project μ q hq (F h i))) =
            ∏ i∈e, Family.orbit (ψ i)
              (if i∈t then F h i - project μ q hq (F h i) else project μ q hq (F h i)) := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro i _
          split_ifs <;> simp only [Family.orbit_sub]
        rw [heq]
        apply ih e he ψ _ had
        obtain ⟨i,hit⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr htn
        refine ⟨i,hte hit, ?_⟩
        rw [ite_eq_left hit]
        exact center_project_l2 μ q hq (F h i)
      let C : ℝ := ∏ i∈e, (bound (f i) : ℝ)^2
      have hCb (h u : G) (x : X) :
          ‖(∏ i∈e, Family.orbit (ψ i) (project μ q hq (F h i))) u x‖ ≤ C := by
        simp only [Family.prod_apply, Family.orbit_apply, func_prod_apply]
        rw [norm_prod]
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun index _ => norm_nonneg _)
        intro i _
        apply project_bound μ q hq
        intro z
        dsimp only [F, mul_apply, act_apply, conj_apply]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_star, pow_two]
        exact mul_le_mul (norm_le_bound (f i) _) (norm_le_bound (f i) _) (norm_nonneg _) (bound (f i)).coe_nonneg
      let V := Family.toL2 μ (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (f i))
      let a := Amenable.Mean.normFn (pairSequence μ q hq (φ j) (bmConj (f j)) (f j))
      have hcorr (h : G) : M.correlation V V h ≤ C * a h := by
        dsimp only [V]
        rw [correlation_product μ M s j hj]
        change inner ℝ (Family.avg μ M (∏ i∈e, Family.orbit (ψ i) (F h i)))
          (l2 μ (bmConj (F h j))) ≤ _
        rw [replace]
        have hb := avg_project_bound μ q hq M
          (∏ i∈e, Family.orbit (ψ i) (project μ q hq (F h i))) (F h j)
          (fun u => ∏ i∈e, act (ψ i u) (conditional μ q (F h i)))
          (fun u => by
            filter_upwards [prod_act_project_lift μ q hq hqcov e ψ (F h) u] with x hx
            simpa only [Family.prod_apply, Family.orbit_apply, func_prod_apply, Finset.prod_apply] using hx) (hCb h)
        apply (le_abs_self _).trans (hb.trans_eq ?_)
        congr 1
        rw [norm_project_l2]
        change ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (F h j))‖ =
          ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (bmConj (f j) * act (φ j h) (f j)))‖
        dsimp only [F]
        rw [mul_comm]
      change M.vector V = 0
      apply M.vector_eq_zero_of_correlation_nonpos
      have hm := M.mono (M.correlation V V) (C • a) hcorr
      rw [map_smul, show M.map a = 0 from hpair (φ j) (ha.1 j hj) (bmConj (f j)) (f j) hfj,
        smul_zero] at hm
      exact hm
  exact main s.card s le_rfl φ f ha hc

end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable.Family
variable {G X : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
  [MeasurableSpace X]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (M : Amenable.Mean G)
def meanNorm (F : Family G X) : ℝ := M.map (Amenable.Mean.normFn (toL2 μ F))

name: meanNorm_nonneg
stmt: (F : Family G X) : 0 ≤ meanNorm μ M F
body:
:=
  M.positive _ (fun g => by
    change 0 ≤ ‖l2 μ (F g)‖
    exact norm_nonneg _)

name: meanNorm_mono
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g)‖ ≤ ‖l2 μ (H g)‖) : meanNorm μ M F ≤ meanNorm μ M H
body: := M.mono _ _ h

name: meanNorm_congr
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, F g =ᵐ[μ] H g) : meanNorm μ M F = meanNorm μ M H
body:
:= by
  apply congrArg M.map
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro g
  exact congrArg norm ((l2_eq_iff μ _ _).mpr (h g))

name: meanNorm_le
stmt: {F : Family G X} {C : ℝ} (h : ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g)‖ ≤ C) : meanNorm μ M F ≤ C
body:
:= by
  rw [meanNorm, ← M.map_const C]
  exact M.mono _ _ h

name: meanNorm_zero
stmt: : meanNorm μ M (0 : Family G X) = 0
body:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (meanNorm_nonneg μ M 0)
  apply meanNorm_le
  intro g
  change ‖l2 μ (0 : Func X)‖ ≤ 0
  rw [map_zero, norm_zero]

name: meanNorm_add_le
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (F+H) ≤ meanNorm μ M F + meanNorm μ M H
body:
:= by
  unfold meanNorm
  rw [← map_add]
  apply M.mono
  intro g
  simpa only [Amenable.Mean.normFn_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply,
    toL2_apply, add_apply, map_add] using norm_add_le (l2 μ (F g)) (l2 μ (H g))

name: meanNorm_neg
stmt: (F : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (-F) = meanNorm μ M F
body:
:= by
  apply congrArg M.map
  apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
  intro g
  change ‖l2 μ (-(F g))‖ = ‖l2 μ (F g)‖
  rw [map_neg, norm_neg]

name: meanNorm_sub_le
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : meanNorm μ M (F-H) ≤ meanNorm μ M F + meanNorm μ M H
body:
:= by
  have h := meanNorm_add_le μ M F (-H)
  rw [meanNorm_neg] at h
  change meanNorm μ M (F + -H) ≤ _
  exact h

name: meanNorm_mul_le
stmt: (F H : Family G X) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ g x, ‖H g x‖ ≤ C) : meanNorm μ M (F*H) ≤ C * meanNorm μ M F
body:
:= by
  unfold meanNorm
  calc
    _ ≤ M.map (C • Amenable.Mean.normFn (toL2 μ F)) := by
      apply M.mono
      intro g
      exact l2_mul_norm_le μ (F g) (H g) (hC g)
    _ = _ := by rw [map_smul]; rfl

name: meanNorm_const
stmt: (f : Func X) : meanNorm μ M (const f : Family G X) = ‖l2 μ f‖
body:
:= by
  have he : Amenable.Mean.normFn (toL2 μ (const f : Family G X)) =
      BoundedContinuousFunction.const G ‖l2 μ f‖ := by
    ext g
    rfl
  unfold meanNorm
  rw [he, M.map_const]

name: meanNorm_add_zero
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (hF : meanNorm μ M F = 0) (hH : meanNorm μ M H = 0) : meanNorm μ M (F+H) = 0
body:
:= by
  have h := meanNorm_add_le μ M F H
  rw [hF, hH, add_zero] at h
  exact le_antisymm h (meanNorm_nonneg μ M _)

name: meanNorm_mul_zero
stmt: {F H : Family G X} (hF : meanNorm μ M F = 0) : meanNorm μ M (F*H) = 0
body:
:= by
  have h := meanNorm_mul_le μ M F H H.norm_le_bound
  rw [hF, mul_zero] at h
  exact le_antisymm h (meanNorm_nonneg μ M _)

name: meanNorm_sum_zero
stmt: {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Family G X) (hF : ∀ i∈s, meanNorm μ M (F i) = 0) : meanNorm μ M (∑ i∈s, F i) = 0
body:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact meanNorm_add_zero μ M (hF i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
      (ih (fun j hj => hF j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: meanNorm_eq_zero_of_approx
stmt: {F : Family G X} (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ H : Family G X, meanNorm μ M H = 0 ∧ ∀ g, ‖l2 μ (F g - H g)‖ ≤ ε) : meanNorm μ M F = 0
body:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (meanNorm_nonneg μ M F)
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hd⟩ := h ε hε
  have hb := meanNorm_add_le μ M (F-H) H
  rw [hH, add_zero] at hb
  have ht : (F-H)+H = F := sub_add_cancel F H
  rw [ht] at hb
  have hd' : meanNorm μ M (F-H) ≤ ε := meanNorm_le μ M hd
  simpa only [zero_add] using hb.trans hd'
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable.Family

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BoundedContinuousFunction RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable
variable {G X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
  [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q)
namespace Family
omit [AddCommGroup G] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in
def conditional (F : Family G X) : Family G Y :=
  ⟨fun g => BoundedMeasurable.conditional μ q (F g), F.bound,
    fun g y => expect_bound _ _ (F.norm_le_bound g) y⟩
omit [AddCommGroup G] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: conditional_apply
stmt: (F : Family G X) (g : G) : conditional μ q F g = BoundedMeasurable.conditional μ q (F g)
body:
:= rfl
omit [AddCommGroup G] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: conditional_add
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : conditional μ q (F+H) = conditional μ q F + conditional μ q H
body:
:= by
  ext g y
  exact integral_add (integrable _ (F g)) (integrable _ (H g))
omit [AddCommGroup G] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: conditional_sub
stmt: (F H : Family G X) : conditional μ q (F-H) = conditional μ q F - conditional μ q H
body:
:= by
  ext g y
  exact integral_sub (integrable _ (F g)) (integrable _ (H g))
end Family
variable [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]

def covariance (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) : Family G Y :=
  Family.conditional μ q (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ w) -
    Family.const (conditional μ q v) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q w)
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: covariance_apply
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : covariance μ q φ v w g = conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w)
body:
:= rfl

omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: covariance_add_left
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v v' w : Func X) : covariance μ q φ (v+v') w = covariance μ q φ v w + covariance μ q φ v' w
body:
:= by
  apply Family.ext
  intro g
  change conditional μ q ((v+v')*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q (v+v') *
    act (φ g) (conditional μ q w) =
    (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w)) +
    (conditional μ q (v'*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q v' * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))
  unfold conditional
  rw [add_mul, expect_add, expect_add, add_mul]
  abel

omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in

name: covariance_add_right
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w w' : Func X) : covariance μ q φ v (w+w') = covariance μ q φ v w + covariance μ q φ v w'
body:
:= by
  have ha (g : G) (a b : Func X) : act g (a+b) = act g a + act g b := rfl
  have hb (g : G) (a b : Func Y) : act g (a+b) = act g a + act g b := rfl
  apply Family.ext
  intro g
  change conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) (w+w')) - conditional μ q v *
    act (φ g) (conditional μ q (w+w')) =
    (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w)) +
    (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w') - conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w'))
  unfold conditional
  rw [ha, mul_add, expect_add, expect_add, hb, mul_add]
  abel
variable [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
omit [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ] in
include hqcov in

name: conditional_mul_project_act
stmt: (g : G) (v w : Func X) : conditional μ q (v*act g (project μ q hq w)) =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q v * act g (conditional μ q w)
body:
:= by
  have h := act_lift μ q hq hqcov g (conditional μ q w)
  have hc : v*act g (project μ q hq w) =ᵐ[μ] v*comp (act g (conditional μ q w)) q hq := by
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    exact congrArg (fun t => v x*t) hx
  exact (conditional_congr μ q hq hc).trans (conditional_pullout μ q hq v _)

omit [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ] in
include hqcov in

name: covariance_center
stmt: (φ : G →+ G) (v w : Func X) (g : G) : covariance μ q φ v w g =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) (w-project μ q hq w))
body:
:= by
  have he : conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) (w-project μ q hq w)) =
      conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) - conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) (project μ q hq w)) := by
    rw [act_sub, mul_sub]
    exact (expectLinear (condDistrib id q μ)).map_sub _ _
  rw [he]
  filter_upwards [conditional_mul_project_act μ q hq hqcov (φ g) v w] with y hy
  simp only [covariance_apply, sub_apply]
  rw [hy]
  rfl

variable [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]

omit [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ] in
include hqcov in

name: covariance_mean_zero
stmt: (M : Amenable.Mean G) (hp : PairVanishing μ q hq M) (φ : G →+ G) (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (v w : Func X) : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0
body:
:= by
  rw [Family.meanNorm_congr (μ.map q) M (F := covariance μ q φ v w)
    (H := Family.conditional μ q (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ (w-project μ q hq w)))
    (fun g => by
      simpa only [Family.conditional_apply, Family.mul_apply, Family.const_apply, Family.orbit_apply]
        using covariance_center μ q hq hqcov φ v w g)]
  have he : Family.toL2 (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q
      (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ (w-project μ q hq w))) =
      pairSequence μ q hq φ v (w-project μ q hq w) := by
    ext g
    rfl
  unfold Family.meanNorm
  rw [he]
  exact hp φ hs v _ (center_project_l2 μ q hq w)
end EuclideanFiveColor.BoundedMeasurable

end

end OAI

name: inner_norm
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : ‖inner t r x₀ f b‖ ≤ ‖f‖
body:
:=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (norm_nonneg f)).mpr fun _ => f.norm_coe_le_norm _
def outer (f : C(X,ℝ)) : B →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun b => mean (inner t r x₀ f b))
    continuous_of_discreteTopology ‖f‖ (fun b => (mean_norm_le _).trans (inner_norm t r x₀ f b))
def average (f : C(X,ℝ)) : ℝ := mean (outer t r x₀ f)
omit [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [TopologicalSpace B] [DiscreteTopology B] in

name: inner_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (f+g) b = inner t r x₀ f b + inner t r x₀ g b
body:
:= by ext; rfl
omit [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [TopologicalSpace B] [DiscreteTopology B] in

name: inner_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (c • f) b = c • inner t r x₀ f b
body:
:= by ext; rfl
omit [AddCommGroup B] in

name: outer_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : outer t r x₀ (f+g) = outer t r x₀ f + outer t r x₀ g
body:
:= by
  ext b
  exact (congrArg mean (inner_add t r x₀ f g b)).trans (mean_add _ _)
omit [AddCommGroup B] in

name: outer_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : outer t r x₀ (c • f) = c • outer t r x₀ f
body:
:= by
  ext b
  exact (congrArg mean (inner_smul t r x₀ c f b)).trans (mean_smul _ _)

name: average_add
stmt: (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (f+g) = average t r x₀ f + average t r x₀ g
body:
:= by
  simp only [average,outer_add,mean_add]

name: average_smul
stmt: (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (c • f) = c * average t r x₀ f
body:
:= by
  simp only [average,outer_smul,mean_smul]

name: average_mono
stmt: {f g : C(X,ℝ)} (h : f ≤ g) : average t r x₀ f ≤ average t r x₀ g
body:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ average t r x₀ (g-f) := mean_nonneg _ fun b => mean_nonneg _ fun a => sub_nonneg.mpr (h _)
  have he : average t r x₀ (g-f) = average t r x₀ g - average t r x₀ f := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg,average_add,← neg_one_smul ℝ f,average_smul]; ring
  linarith

name: average_const
stmt: (c : ℝ) : average t r x₀ (ContinuousMap.const X c) = c
body:
:= by
  have hi (b : B) : inner t r x₀ (ContinuousMap.const X c) b = BoundedContinuousFunction.const A c := by ext; rfl
  have ho : outer t r x₀ (ContinuousMap.const X c) = BoundedContinuousFunction.const B c := by
    ext b
    change mean (inner t r x₀ _ b) = c
    rw [hi,mean_const]
  rw [average,ho,mean_const]

name: average_translation
stmt: (ht : ∀ a b x, t a (t b x) = t (a+b) x) (φ : B → A → A) (hc : ∀ a b x, t a (r b x) = r b (t (φ b a) x)) (a : A) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (ha : Continuous (t a)) : average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨t a,ha⟩) = average t r x₀ f
body:
:= by
  unfold average
  congr 1
  ext b
  change mean (inner t r x₀ (f.comp _) b) = mean (inner t r x₀ f b)
  have he : inner t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨t a,ha⟩) b = shift (φ b a) (inner t r x₀ f b) := by
    ext z
    change f (t a (r b (t z x₀))) = f (r b (t (z+φ b a) x₀))
    rw [hc,ht,add_comm]
  rw [he,mean_shift]

name: average_rotation
stmt: (hr : ∀ a b x, r a (r b x) = r (a+b) x) (b : B) (f : C(X,ℝ)) (hb : Continuous (r b)) : average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨r b,hb⟩) = average t r x₀ f
body:
:= by
  unfold average
  have he : outer t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨r b,hb⟩) = shift b (outer t r x₀ f) := by
    ext c
    change mean (inner t r x₀ (f.comp _) c) = mean (inner t r x₀ f (c+b))
    congr 1
    ext z
    change f (r b (r c (t z x₀))) = f (r (c+b) (t z x₀))
    rw [hr,add_comm]
  rw [he,mean_shift]
variable [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
def functional : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun f := average t r x₀ f.toContinuousMap
  map_add' := fun f g => average_add t r x₀ f.toContinuousMap g.toContinuousMap
  map_smul' := fun c f => average_smul t r x₀ c f.toContinuousMap
  monotone' := fun _ _ h => average_mono t r x₀ h
def measure : Measure X := RealRMK.rieszMeasure (functional t r x₀)
instance : IsFiniteMeasure (measure t r x₀) := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance
instance : (measure t r x₀).Regular := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance

name: integral
stmt: (f : C(X,ℝ)) : ∫ x, f x ∂measure t r x₀ = average t r x₀ f
body:
:=
  RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure (functional t r x₀) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.continuousMapEquiv f)
instance : IsProbabilityMeasure (measure t r x₀) := by
  have he := integral t r x₀ (ContinuousMap.const X 1)
  rw [average_const] at he
  change (∫ _ : X, (1:ℝ) ∂measure t r x₀) = 1 at he
  simp only [integral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] at he
  constructor
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_eq_one_iff _).mp he

name: preserving_of_average
stmt: (s : X ≃ₜ X) (hav : ∀ f : C(X,ℝ), average t r x₀ (f.comp ⟨s,s.continuous⟩) = average t r x₀ f) : MeasurePreserving s (measure t r x₀) (measure t r x₀)
body:
:= by
  refine ⟨s.continuous.measurable,?_⟩
  have : (Measure.map s (measure t r x₀)).Regular := Measure.Regular.map s
  apply Measure.ext_of_integral_eq_on_compactlySupported
  intro f
  change (∫ x, f.toContinuousMap x ∂(measure t r x₀).map s) = ∫ x, f.toContinuousMap x ∂measure t r x₀
  rw [integral_map s.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable f.continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact (integral t r x₀ (f.toContinuousMap.comp ⟨s,s.continuous⟩)).trans ((hav f.toContinuousMap).trans (integral t r x₀ f.toContinuousMap).symm)
end EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean
end

namespace PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory EuclideanFiveColor
instance K_countable : Countable K := by
  let f : K → E := fun k => ⟨(k.val : ℂ), mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr k.property⟩
  apply Function.Injective.countable (f := f)
  intro a b h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun z : E => (z : ℂ)) h

variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
  [MulAction K X] [MeasurableConstSMul K X]

name: exists_terminal_factor
stmt: (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicSMul K X μ] : ∃ p : X → OrbitSpace K, ∃ hp : Measurable p, (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (k • x) = k • p x) ∧ UniversalGood μ p ∧ ErgodicSMul K (X × X) (RelativeProduct.law μ p hp)
body:
:= by
  classical
  let z₀ : OrbitSpace K := ⟨fun _ => 0⟩
  have hbase : Nonempty (CodedMax.Model (K := K) μ (UniversalGood μ)) := by
    refine ⟨⟨fun _ => z₀, measurable_const, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro k
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by ext l; rfl
    · intro d hd _hw hw
      exact relative_singularity_base μ d hd z₀ hw
  have hjoin : ∀ q : ℕ → X → OrbitSpace K, (∀ n, Measurable (q n)) →
      (∀ n (k : K), ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, q n (k • x) = k • q n x) →
      (∀ n, UniversalGood μ (q n)) →
      (∀ i j, FactorLp.space μ (q i) ≤ FactorLp.space μ (q j) ∨
        FactorLp.space μ (q j) ≤ FactorLp.space μ (q i)) → UniversalGood μ (ChainJoin.code (K := K) q) := by
    intro q hq hqe hg hc d hd hde hw
    apply relative_singularity_approximation (W := OrbitSpace K) μ d (ChainJoin.code (K := K) q) hd
      (ChainJoin.code_measurable q hq) hde
      (fun k => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (ChainJoin.code_equivariant q k)) hw
    intro m H hH hB ε hε
    obtain ⟨j, H₀, hH₀, hB₀, hi, he⟩ := ChainJoin.approximation μ q hq hqe hc m H hH hB ε hε
    exact ⟨q j, hq j, hqe j, hg j, H₀, hH₀, hB₀, hi, he⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hamax⟩ := CodedMax.exists_maximal (K := K) μ (UniversalGood μ) hbase hjoin
  refine ⟨a.map, a.measurable, a.equivariant, a.good, ?_⟩
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hB, hnot, hc⟩ := CompactTower.strict_compact_successor μ a.map
    a.measurable a.equivariant hn
  let u := OrbitFactor.extend (K := K) a.map H
  have hum : Measurable u := OrbitFactor.measurable_extend a.measurable hH
  have hue (k : K) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, u (k • x) = k • u x :=
    OrbitFactor.extend_equivariant μ H a.equivariant k
  have hug : UniversalGood μ u := by
    intro d hd hde hw
    apply relative_singularity_successor μ d u Prod.fst hd hum measurable_fst hde hue
      (fun k => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => rfl) hw hc
    exact a.good
  let v := FactorCode.encode (K := K) u
  have hvm : Measurable v := FactorCode.encode_measurable hum
  have hve (k : K) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, v (k • x) = k • v x :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (FactorCode.encode_equivariant u k)
  have hvg : UniversalGood μ v := universalGood_of_factor μ v u
    (FactorCode.encode (K := K) (id : OrbitSpace K × OrbitSpace K → _)) hvm hum
    (FactorCode.encode_measurable measurable_id) hve hue (FactorCode.encode_as_comp μ u hue) hug
  let b : CodedMax.Model (K := K) μ (UniversalGood μ) := ⟨v, hvm, hve, hvg⟩
  have hab : a ≤ b := by
    apply FactorLp.le_of_factor μ a.map v
      (Prod.fst ∘ FactorCode.decode (K := K) (Y := OrbitSpace K × OrbitSpace K))
      (measurable_fst.comp FactorCode.decode_measurable)
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, v]
      rw [FactorCode.decode_encode]
      rfl
  have hba : FactorLp.space μ v ≤ FactorLp.space μ a.map := hamax hab
  have hHlp : MemLp H 2 μ := MemLp.of_bound hH.aestronglyMeasurable 2
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hB)
  let J : OrbitSpace K → ℂ := fun z => (FactorCode.decode
    (K := K) (Y := OrbitSpace K × OrbitSpace K) z).2.val 1
  have hJ : Measurable J := (measurable_pi_apply 1).comp
    (OrbitSpace.measurable_val.comp (measurable_snd.comp FactorCode.decode_measurable))
  have hHv : hHlp.toLp H ∈ FactorLp.space μ v := by
    apply FactorLp.mem_of_rep μ v _ J hJ
    filter_upwards [hHlp.coeFn_toLp] with x hx
    rw [hx]
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, J, v]
    rw [FactorCode.decode_encode]
    exact (OrbitFactor.orbit_one H x).symm
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hhe⟩ := FactorLp.exists_rep μ a.map _ (hba hHv)
  exact hnot ⟨g, hg, hHlp.coeFn_toLp.symm.trans hhe⟩

end PlaneFiveColor.Spectral
